summary.en: The chat display is a set of pieces that stack into a transcript: a scrolling layout, a message log, rows for each sender, bubbles, tool calls, a reasoning disclosure, a typing line, and an unread rule. Message bodies are slots. This suite does not render Markdown; pass plain text, or bring your own renderer.
summary.zh: `Chat` 这一套组件，就像积木一样，包含搭建完整聊天窗口所需的各个部件：滚动的对话外框、消息列表、区分发送者的消息行、聊天气泡、AI 工具调用折叠栏、思考过程折叠、正在输入动画，以及未读消息提示线。消息正文通过插槽传入。组件本身不带 Markdown 解析器，你可以直接放纯文本，也可以接上你自己喜欢的 Markdown 渲染库。

usage.en:
The chat display is a set of pieces that stack into a transcript: a scrolling layout, a message log, rows for each sender, bubbles, tool calls, a reasoning disclosure, a typing line, and an unread rule. Message bodies are slots. This suite does not render Markdown; pass plain text, or bring your own renderer.

`ChatLayout` is a column. The transcript grows, and the composer stays pinned to the bottom over a frosted scrim. By default the layout itself scrolls. Pass `scrollRef` when an ancestor should scroll instead, and the dock switches from sticky to fixed.

While the reader is at the bottom, new text keeps the view pinned there. Scrolling up lets go immediately and reveals the scroll-to-bottom button. If messages arrive while the view is unlocked, the button label changes to the localized “New messages” string, a live region announces it, and `ChatUnreadDivider` can mark the boundary. `ChatLayout` wires this through `useChatStreamScroll` and `useChatNewMessages`. Set `showScrollButton` to `false` to hide the built-in button, or replace it with the `scrollButton` slot.

The field is ChatComposer, placed in the layout's composer slot. The shell owns the draft, send, and stop. The default editor accepts chips, sends on Enter, and inserts a newline on Shift+Enter. The attachment drawer, header, and footer are slots. Dictation uses the browser's speech recognition, and the microphone stays hidden when that API is missing. The landing page and the transcript with a document panel are in [Patterns](/en/guide/patterns).

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer, ChatLayout, ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

function onSubmit(value: string) {
  console.log(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ChatLayout>
    <ChatMessageList>
      <ChatMessage sender="user">
        <ChatMessageBubble>
          Check the release notes for me.
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
        <ChatMessageBubble name="Assistant">
          The notes are in the docs.
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
    </ChatMessageList>
    <template #composer>
      <ChatComposer placeholder="Type a message…" @submit="onSubmit" />
    </template>
  </ChatLayout>
</template>
```

`ChatMessageList` is a `role="log"`. Pass `isStreaming` while an assistant reply is still growing, so a screen reader waits and announces the finished message once. `scrollToTopAction` runs when the top sentinel enters the scroll parent, and a spinner stays up until the promise settles.

`ChatMessage` is an article. `sender` is `user`, `assistant`, or `system`. A system row is centered and ignores the avatar, name, and metadata slots. Put the visible name on `ChatMessageBubble` when the body starts with a bubble, so the name lines up with the bubble padding.

`ChatToolCalls` takes the tool list an assistant turn already produced. One call is a single row. Several calls collapse behind a header; `label` replaces the localized count while the group is open. A call with `detail`, or the `detail` slot, can expand on its own. `v-model:is-expanded` controls the group.

`ChatReasoning` is the same kind of disclosure for a thinking trace. It starts collapsed. A plain-text default slot is reused as the one-line preview. `isStreaming` shimmers the label and hides both the preview and `duration`.

`ChatTypingIndicator` draws three dots. Pass `names` and it writes a sentence for one person, two people, or a named person plus a count. The root is `role="status"`, and that region is the only announcement. `ChatUnreadDivider` marks the first unread message, and new rows go below it.

The examples start with the composer beside the transcript, then follow layout, scroll button, message, bubble, list, metadata, system message, and tool calls.
usage.zh:
`Chat` 这一套组件，就像积木一样，包含搭建完整聊天窗口所需的各个部件：滚动的对话外框、消息列表、区分发送者的消息行、聊天气泡、AI 工具调用折叠栏、思考过程折叠、正在输入动画，以及未读消息提示线。消息正文通过插槽传入。组件本身不带 Markdown 解析器，你可以直接放纯文本，也可以接上你自己喜欢的 Markdown 渲染库。

**什么时候用：**
- 搭建大模型 AI 对话界面、客服客服聊天窗口或即时聊天应用时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 如果只是为了让用户留个言、发一条评论，用普通的表单评论区组件更轻快。
- 如果只是通知中心的一串流水消息，用时间线列表或通知流即可。

各个积木的组装分工如下：

- `ChatLayout` 是最外层的纵向布局容器。消息记录区在上方自适应伸展，输入框贴在底部，底部还带有一层毛玻璃磨砂效果。默认由布局自己滚动；如果外层已经有滚动容器，可以传入 `scrollRef`，底部停靠会自动调整为跟随固定的模式。
- 当用户浏览到最底部时，新生成的内容会自动把滚动条继续贴在底部。如果用户往上翻看历史记录，自动贴底会立刻暂停，并浮现一个回到最底部的圆形按钮。在没有贴底时来了新消息，按钮文字会变成「有新消息」，未读分割线 `ChatUnreadDivider` 也会标出新旧分界线。
- `ChatComposer` 是底部的输入套件，放进 `ChatLayout` 的 `composer` 插槽里。它负责草稿状态、回车发送、Shift 加回车换行、停止生成按钮等。它还支持附件抽屉以及基于浏览器原生语音识别的麦克风听写功能。落地页和带文档面板的整页会话见[应用模式](/guide/patterns)。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer, ChatLayout, ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

function onSubmit(value: string) {
  console.log(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ChatLayout>
    <ChatMessageList>
      <ChatMessage sender="user">
        <ChatMessageBubble>
          帮我看一下发布说明。
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
        <ChatMessageBubble name="助手">
          说明在文档里。
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
    </ChatMessageList>
    <template #composer>
      <ChatComposer placeholder="输入消息……" @submit="onSubmit" />
    </template>
  </ChatLayout>
</template>
```

- `ChatMessageList` 是承载消息记录的列表容器，带有 `role="log"`。当 AI 助手的文字还在持续生成时传入 `isStreaming`，读屏软件会等整段输出完毕后再统一朗读，避免不断打扰用户。当用户向上翻到顶部时，`scrollToTopAction` 会触发加载历史消息，加载完成前顶部会显示旋转动画。
- `ChatMessage` 代表单条消息行。`sender` 可以是 `user`（用户）、`assistant`（AI 助手）或 `system`（系统通知）。系统通知会默认水平居中。
- `ChatToolCalls` 用来展示 AI 调用的外部工具或函数。只有一次调用时直接显示一行；多次调用时会收拢进折叠栏，点击可以查看参数与结果明细。
- `ChatReasoning` 是折叠卡片，用来展示 AI 的思考推理过程，默认折叠收起。
- `ChatTypingIndicator` 用来展示「正在输入」的跳动三个小圆点，告诉用户对方正在打字或 AI 正在构思。

下面先看输入套件和消息列表放在一起的样子，再按布局、回到底部、消息、气泡、列表、元信息、系统消息、工具调用往下排。

en.text: Keep the transcript in the message list and the composer in the bottom slot, so the frosted dock and the scroll button stay aligned.
Set `isStreaming` for the whole time an assistant body is growing, and clear it when the message is complete.
Use `ChatUnreadDivider` at the first message the reader has not seen. The scroll button’s “New messages” label is the announcement; the divider is the visible mark.
Put plain text, citations, or your own renderer in the bubble slot. The bubble only supplies the surface.
Render a second scroll parent inside the layout. One element should own the transcript scroll, either the layout or the element passed as `scrollRef`.
Announce every streamed token yourself. The typing indicator speaks once through its own `role="status"`, and the new-message label speaks through the layout live region.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Spacing, bubble width, and the frosted dock. Messages can override it.

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: Element that scrolls instead of the layout. Leave it unset and the layout scrolls itself. The dock is sticky for self scroll and fixed for an external scroller.

rows.name: `showScrollButton`
rows.description: Renders the built-in scroll-to-bottom button. Set `false` when the `scrollButton` slot replaces it, or when the button should be absent.

rows.name: `isVisible`
rows.description: Whether the pill is shown. A hidden pill stays mounted so it can fade, and is marked `inert`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Widens the pill. Omit it for the icon-only down arrow. The accessible name falls back to “Scroll to bottom”.

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: Vertical alignment when the list is shorter than its container. `'bottom'` keeps a spacer above the rows; `'top'` drops it so rows start at the top.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Passed to messages that do not set their own.

rows.name: `gap`
rows.description: Gap between top-level rows, on the spacing scale. Overrides the density gap without changing padding.

rows.name: `scrollToTopAction`
rows.description: Loads older messages when the top sentinel intersects the scroll parent. A spinner shows while the promise is pending. A second intersection is ignored until it settles.

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: Sets `aria-busy` while an assistant message is still streaming.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the log.

rows.name: `sender`
rows.description: Who the row is from. `system` is centered and ignores avatar, name, and metadata.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Plain sender name. Prefer the bubble `name` when the body starts with a bubble.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Density for this row only.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `filled` paints the sender surface. `ghost` drops the background and the block padding so mixed content still lines up.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Sender name aligned to the bubble padding.

rows.name: `group`
rows.description: Tightens a corner when several bubbles stack. Leave it unset for a standalone bubble.

rows.name: `timestamp`
rows.description: Short time text. The `timestamp` slot replaces it.

rows.name: `footer`
rows.description: Secondary text, such as a model name. The `footer` slot replaces it.

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: Delivery state. The row renders nothing when timestamp, footer, and status are all absent.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `default` is a centered line. `divider` draws a rule on each side. The root is `role="status"`.

rows.name: `calls`
rows.description: Tool calls from one assistant turn. An empty array renders nothing. Each item may set `name`, `status`, `target`, `duration`, `node`, `additions`, `deletions`, `stats`, `errorMessage`, `key`, `resultDetail`, and `data`. `detail` is an alias of `resultDetail`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Summary shown while a group is expanded.

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: Controlled expanded state of a multi-call group.

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: Initial state while `isExpanded` is unbound.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Header label.

rows.name: `duration`
rows.description: Shown after the label once streaming has finished, such as `12s`.

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: Shimmers the label and hides the preview and the duration.

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: Controlled expanded state.

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: Initial state while `isExpanded` is unbound.

rows.name: `names`
rows.description: People currently typing. Empty names are dropped. No names leaves the dots only. One, two, and three or more each get their own sentence.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Short label at the end of the rule. The accessible name is “{label} messages below”.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: Controlled draft, bound with `v-model`. Omit it and the shell keeps the draft.

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.description: Shown while the draft is empty.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables editing and send. Stop stays clickable when it is shown.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Padding inside the body. Spacious uses the same spacing as balanced.

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: Low deepens on hover and focus. None is flat and uses a border. The focus ring appears only when the keyboard focuses the editor.

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: Shows stop instead of send.

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: Error uses alert. Warning uses status.

rows.name: `statusPosition`
rows.description: Places the bar above or below the body, tucked behind the radius.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: Controlled draft. Inside a shell, an omitted value follows the shell.

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.default: The shell or the localized placeholder
rows.description: Hint on the empty editor.

rows.name: `maxRows`
rows.description: The editor scrolls after this many lines. A line is 22px.

rows.name: `triggers`
rows.description: A trigger character at a word boundary opens suggestions. `hasMultiWordQuery` on a trigger keeps the query through spaces and punctuation until a line break, 64 characters, or the same trigger character again. Without it, a space or tab ends the query. An unmatched multi-word query hides the list when `emptySearchText` is omitted. The editor becomes a combobox.

rows.name: `debounceMs`
rows.description: Delay for an async search. Sync results are immediate, and the first async search starts at once.

rows.name: `hasHistory`
rows.description: Arrow Up at the start recalls the previous submission. Arrow Down at the end steps forward.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the editor.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables editing.

rows.name: `pasteAsToken`
rows.default: Pastes longer than 200 characters become a chip
rows.description: Pass false to insert the text as-is.

rows.name: `pasteAction`
rows.description: First chance at a plain-text paste. Return true and the input will not insert it.

rows.name: `count`
rows.description: Enables collapse and appears in the default summary.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Used in the summary and in the expand and collapse names.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Controlled collapsed state, bound with `v-model:is-collapsed`.

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: Initial state while unbound.

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: Stop is secondary. Send is primary. Stop ignores disabled.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.default: The draft is empty or the shell is disabled
rows.description: Disables send only.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Button size. The shell rounds it to the outer radius.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 间距、气泡宽度和底部磨砂。单条消息可以自己覆盖。

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: 代替布局自己滚动的元素。不传时由布局滚动。自己滚动时底部停靠是 sticky，外部滚动时改成 fixed。

rows.name: `showScrollButton`
rows.description: 是否渲染内置的回到底部按钮。用 `scrollButton` 插槽替换，或者根本不需要这个按钮时设为 `false`。

rows.name: `isVisible`
rows.description: 胶囊是否可见。隐藏时仍挂在树上，方便淡出，并带 `inert`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 把胶囊拉宽。不传时只有向下的图标。无障碍名称回退到「滚动到底部」。

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: 消息不到一屏时贴顶还是贴底。`'bottom'` 在消息前面留一块弹性空白；`'top'` 不留，消息从顶上排。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 传给没有自己设置密度的消息。

rows.name: `gap`
rows.description: 顶层行之间的间距，走间距刻度。只改间距，不改内边距。

rows.name: `scrollToTopAction`
rows.description: 顶部哨兵进入滚动容器时加载更早的消息。Promise 结束前显示加载指示。上一次还没结束时，再次进入不会重复触发。

en.heading: ChatLayout
en.text: A template ref exposes element and scrollToBottom(). scrollToBottom clears the new-message label and springs to the bottom.

en.heading: ChatLayoutScrollButton
en.text: Emits click when the button is pressed.

en.heading: ChatMessageList
en.text: The default slot is the rows. The emptyState slot shows when default is omitted; empty is its alias. The root is role="log" with aria-live="polite".

en.heading: ChatMessage
en.text: Slots: default (body), avatar, name (replaces the prop), metadata. The article is named from the visible name, or from “Message from {sender}”.

en.heading: ChatMessageBubble
en.text: Sender and density come from the surrounding ChatMessage. Slots: default, name, metadata. Attributes fall through to the bubble element.

en.heading: ChatMessageMetadata
en.text: The status icon’s accessible name is localized, for example “Message read”. On a user row the items run from the inline end.

en.heading: ChatSystemMessage
en.text: Slots: default, and icon (ignored for divider).

en.heading: ChatToolCalls
en.text: Emits expandedChange with the next boolean. The detail slot receives { call } and replaces call.resultDetail. A collapsed group shows the latest call; the panel is inert until opened. Pending and running calls use a spinner. An error is spoken from a visually hidden string.

en.heading: ChatReasoning
en.text: The default slot is the full trace. A single text node is also the collapsed preview. Emits expandedChange. The panel is inert while collapsed.

en.heading: ChatTypingIndicator
en.text: The root is role="status" with aria-live="polite". The sentence lives in that region and is not announced again through useAnnounce.

en.heading: ChatUnreadDivider
en.text: The root is role="separator". It is not a .astryx-chat-message, so the new-message tracker does not treat it as a message.

en.heading: ChatComposer
en.text: Slots are drawer, headerActions, headerContext, input, footerActions, sendActions, and sendButton. The template ref exposes element.

en.heading: ChatComposerInput
en.text: Events are change, update:modelValue, submit, files, and keydown. files comes from a paste or a drop, and a drop does not navigate away. keydown fires after an open suggestion list declines the event. preventDefault skips Enter-to-send and history. The template ref exposes insertToken, expandToken, insertText, focus, and getValue.

en.heading: ChatComposerDrawer
en.text: collapsedChange fires when the collapsed state changes. The default slot is the open content. collapsedSummary replaces the count and label. The button still owns the disclosure name.

en.heading: ChatSendButton
en.text: Events are send, stop, and click. sendIcon and stopIcon replace the arrow and the square. Inside a shell, a click with no listener of its own submits the draft or stops the shell.

en.heading: ChatDictationButton
en.text: Pass the return value of useChatDictation or useSpeechRecognition. size defaults to md. isHiddenWhenUnsupported defaults to true, so the control is absent when speech recognition is missing. Set it to false and the button stays, disabled. label replaces the start or stop dictation name. While listening, five bars follow the volume, and a loud signal blends the accent color toward the error color.

en.heading: ChatTokenizedText
en.text: The default slot holds the message text, and the text prop does the same job when a string is easier to pass. Each non-empty value in tokens is matched literally and replaced with a badge or custom content. Empty values are ignored. The same objects a trigger returns can be reused here.

en.heading: ChatComposerTokenElement
en.text: Wraps one chip so it cannot be edited inside the field and carries the serialized value. The input inserts these itself. Use it directly when a chip should render outside the editor.

en.heading: Composables
en.text: useChatStreamScroll({ scrollRef }) follows the bottom of scrollRef. The first time the content can scroll it jumps; later growth uses a spring, unless reduced motion is requested. Scrolling up unlocks at once. Settling within 10px of the bottom locks again. isScrolledUp feeds the button. useChatNewMessages({ isLocked, onResize }) watches the transcript height. When the last .astryx-chat-message changes while unlocked, hasNewMessages becomes true until dismiss(). ChatLayout announces that change. useChatStreamScroll, useChatNewMessages, and useAnnounce are exported from @astryx-vue/core. Reduced motion is read with useMediaQuery. The composer also exports useChatComposerContext, useChatComposerTokens, useChatPasteAsToken, useChatDictation, and useSpeechRecognition. Import them from the Chat entry. The package root re-exports them. Speech recognition uses the browser API and does not bind a speech service. A paste longer than 200 characters becomes a chip by default.

en.heading: Theming
en.text:
`packages/themes/neutral/chat.css` maps component variables onto semantic tokens. Another theme overrides those variables.

- `--astryx-chat-bubble-background` / `--astryx-chat-foreground`: filled bubble surface and text, mapped from `--astryx-color-neutral` and `--astryx-color-text-primary`.
- `--astryx-chat-foreground-secondary`, `--astryx-chat-foreground-muted`: metadata, system lines, and secondary tool text.
- `--astryx-chat-error`, `--astryx-chat-success`, `--astryx-chat-accent`: failed status, deletions, and a running tool.
- `--astryx-chat-unread-color`: the unread rule and its label. Neutral maps it to `--astryx-color-border-red`, so both viewports use one color.
- `--astryx-chat-focus`: keyboard outline on disclosure buttons.
- `--astryx-chat-scroll-background` / `--astryx-chat-scroll-shadow`: the scroll-to-bottom pill.
- `--astryx-chat-radius`: standalone bubble radius. Compact density uses `--astryx-chat-radius-compact`. Grouped bubbles use `--astryx-chat-radius-group` on the inner corners.
- `--astryx-duration-fast-max`, `--astryx-duration-medium-max`, `--astryx-duration-slow-max`, `--astryx-ease-standard`: pill, disclosure, and typing motion.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: `ChatLayout`, `ChatMessageList`, `ChatMessage`, `ChatSystemMessage`, `ChatToolCalls`, `ChatReasoning`, `ChatTypingIndicator`, `ChatUnreadDivider`, `ChatComposer`, `ChatComposerDrawer`, `ChatComposerInput`, and `ChatTokenizedText` forward attributes to their root. `ChatMessageBubble` forwards them to the bubble, not the name or metadata. `ChatMessageMetadata` forwards them to the metadata row. `ChatSendButton` and `ChatDictationButton` forward them to the button.

zh.heading: ChatLayout
zh.text: 模板引用暴露 element 和 scrollToBottom()。scrollToBottom 会清掉「有新消息」，再用弹簧滚到底部。

zh.heading: ChatLayoutScrollButton
zh.text: 按下按钮时发出 click。

zh.heading: ChatMessageList
zh.text: default 插槽是各行。emptyState 在没有 default 时显示，empty 是它的别名。根节点是 role="log"，aria-live="polite"。

zh.heading: ChatMessage
zh.text: 插槽：default（正文）、avatar、name（替换属性）、metadata。article 的名称优先用可见名字，否则是「来自{发送者}的消息」。

zh.heading: ChatMessageBubble
zh.text: 发送者和密度来自外层 ChatMessage。插槽：default、name、metadata。属性落到气泡元素上。

zh.heading: ChatMessageMetadata
zh.text: 状态图标的无障碍名称会本地化，例如「消息已读」。用户消息上，各项从行尾开始排。

zh.heading: ChatSystemMessage
zh.text: 插槽：default，以及 icon（divider 时忽略）。

zh.heading: ChatToolCalls
zh.text: 发出 expandedChange，参数是下一个布尔值。detail 插槽收到 { call }，用来替换 call.resultDetail。分组收起时只显示最新一条；面板在打开前是 inert。等待中和进行中用加载指示。错误会放进一段视觉隐藏的文字里读出来。

zh.heading: ChatReasoning
zh.text: 默认插槽是完整推理。只有一个文本节点时，它也是收起状态的预览。发出 expandedChange。收起时面板是 inert。

zh.heading: ChatTypingIndicator
zh.text: 根节点是 role="status"，并带 aria-live="polite"。文案就写在这个区域里，不再经 useAnnounce 播第二遍。

zh.heading: ChatUnreadDivider
zh.text: 根节点是 role="separator"。它没有 .astryx-chat-message，新消息追踪不会把它当成一条消息。

zh.heading: ChatComposer
zh.text: 插槽有 drawer、headerActions、headerContext、input、footerActions、sendActions、sendButton。模板引用暴露 element。

zh.heading: ChatComposerInput
zh.text: 事件有 change、update:modelValue、submit、files、keydown。files 来自粘贴或拖入的文件，拖入不会让浏览器打开文件。keydown 在建议列表处理完之后发出，preventDefault 会跳过回车发送和历史。模板引用上有 insertToken、expandToken、insertText、focus、getValue。

zh.heading: ChatComposerDrawer
zh.text: collapsedChange 在折叠状态变化时发出。默认插槽是展开后的内容。collapsedSummary 替换计数和名称，按钮自己仍带无障碍名称。

zh.heading: ChatSendButton
zh.text: send、stop、click 三个事件。sendIcon 和 stopIcon 替换上箭头和方块。放在外壳里且没有自己监听时，点击会提交当前草稿或发出外壳的停止。

zh.heading: ChatDictationButton
zh.text: 需要传入 useChatDictation 或 useSpeechRecognition 的返回值。size 默认 md。isHiddenWhenUnsupported 默认 true，不支持时不渲染；设为 false 时按钮留着并停用。label 覆盖开始或停止听写的无障碍名称。听的时候按钮上是五根音量条，音量过大时颜色从强调色混向错误色。

zh.heading: ChatTokenizedText
zh.text: 默认插槽放消息文字；要直接传字符串时用 text 属性，效果一样。tokens 里每个非空 value 按字面替换成徽章或自定义内容。空 value 会被忽略。同一组对象可以同时给输入框的 onSelect 和这里用。

zh.heading: ChatComposerTokenElement
zh.text: 包住一枚标记，让它在可编辑区域里不可编辑，并带上序列化用的值。一般由输入框自己插入，需要在气泡外单独画一枚时也可以直接用。

zh.heading: 组合式函数
zh.text: useChatStreamScroll({ scrollRef }) 跟着 scrollRef 的底部走。内容第一次能滚时直接跳到底；之后的增长用弹簧，除非用户要求减少动效。向上滚会立刻松开。停在距底部 10px 以内会重新贴住。isScrolledUp 决定按钮出不出现。 useChatNewMessages({ isLocked, onResize }) 看着记录高度。未贴底时，最后一个 .astryx-chat-message 换了，hasNewMessages 变成 true，直到 dismiss()。ChatLayout 会播报这次变化。 useChatStreamScroll、useChatNewMessages 和 useAnnounce 从 @astryx-vue/core 导出。减少动效通过 useMediaQuery 读取。 输入套件另外导出 useChatComposerContext、useChatComposerTokens、useChatPasteAsToken、useChatDictation 和 useSpeechRecognition。它们从 Chat 子路径引入，包根也会再导出一份。语音识别只用浏览器接口，不绑定语音服务。长文本粘贴的默认阈值是 200 个字符。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
`packages/themes/neutral/chat.css` 把组件变量映射到语义 token。换主题时覆盖这些变量即可。

- `--astryx-chat-bubble-background` / `--astryx-chat-foreground`：填充气泡的底色和文字，对应 `--astryx-color-neutral` 和 `--astryx-color-text-primary`。
- `--astryx-chat-foreground-secondary`、`--astryx-chat-foreground-muted`：元信息、系统行、工具调用的次要文字。
- `--astryx-chat-error`、`--astryx-chat-success`、`--astryx-chat-accent`：失败状态、删除行数、进行中的工具。
- `--astryx-chat-unread-color`：未读分隔线的线和标签，Neutral 映射到 `--astryx-color-border-red`，两条视口用同一个颜色。
- `--astryx-chat-focus`：折叠按钮的键盘焦点描边。
- `--astryx-chat-scroll-background` / `--astryx-chat-scroll-shadow`：回到底部的胶囊。
- `--astryx-chat-radius`：单独气泡的圆角。紧凑密度用 `--astryx-chat-radius-compact`。成组气泡的内侧用 `--astryx-chat-radius-group`。
- `--astryx-duration-fast-max`、`--astryx-duration-medium-max`、`--astryx-duration-slow-max`、`--astryx-ease-standard`：胶囊、折叠和输入中圆点的动效。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: `ChatLayout`、`ChatMessageList`、`ChatMessage`、`ChatSystemMessage`、`ChatToolCalls`、`ChatReasoning`、`ChatTypingIndicator`、`ChatUnreadDivider`、`ChatComposer`、`ChatComposerDrawer`、`ChatComposerInput`、`ChatTokenizedText` 把属性转到根节点。`ChatMessageBubble` 转到气泡，不转到名字或元信息。`ChatMessageMetadata` 转到元信息那一行。`ChatSendButton` 和 `ChatDictationButton` 转到按钮外层。

description.en: A narrow column. Press Enter and the draft is appended to the transcript. A tight container uses compact density, which fits a side panel or a drawer.
description.zh: 窄栏里的会话。输入文字后回车，这句话会出现在记录末尾。容器一窄就会用上紧凑密度。

description.en: A field with an attachment drawer, a header button, and dictation. With no text the send button is muted and cannot be clicked; it turns into the solid button once there is something to send. Attachments alone do not enable it. The drawer handle collapses the attachments. The microphone starts listening in browsers that support speech recognition.
description.zh: 带附件抽屉、顶栏按钮和语音按钮的输入区。没有字时发送按钮是浅色并且不能点，写上字才变成可点的实心按钮。只有附件、没有字，仍然不能发送。点抽屉把手可以收起附件。点麦克风会在支持语音的浏览器里开始听写。

description.en: The top field is disabled while a reply is in progress, and Stop stays clickable. The middle one is compact and flat, with a warning. The bottom one puts an error above the field.
description.zh: 上面一条正在生成，编辑停用，停止按钮仍可点。中间是紧凑、无阴影，并带警告。下面把错误放在输入区上方。

description.en: Type @ at the start of a word and keep going through spaces, as in Ada Lov, and the list narrows to Ada Lovelace. Arrow keys move the highlight, and Enter inserts that row rather than the first person in the list. A phrase with no match hides the list and leaves the typed text alone. Type / for a one-word command; a space closes that list. A person becomes a chip. A command is inserted as text.
description.zh: 词首输入 @ 可以连续打多个词，比如 Ada Lov，列表会跟着缩到 Ada Lovelace。方向键把高亮移到某一行，回车插入的是这一行，不是列表里的第一条。没有匹配的句子会把列表藏起来，已经打的字还在。词首输入 / 是单词命令，打一个空格列表就关上。选中的人变成标记，命令按原文插入。

description.en: The same chip definitions render inside a sent bubble.

summary.en: ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces. It renders messages in normal page flow and docks the composer to the bottom with a frosted glass blur layer. usage.en:
ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces. It renders messages in normal page flow and docks the composer to the bottom with a frosted glass blur layer. Set the `density` prop to control spacing; it defaults to `balanced`. Use it to wrap ChatMessageList and ChatComposer for a complete chat experience with built-in auto-scroll and a scroll-to-bottom button.

```ts
import { ChatLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
```
usage.zh:
`ChatLayout` 是整页对话的外壳。消息按普通文档流从上往下排，输入区用一层毛玻璃压在底部。`density` 控制疏密，默认是 `balanced`。把 `ChatMessageList` 和 `ChatComposer` 套进来，就得到一个带自动滚动和「滚到底」按钮的完整对话界面。

```ts
import { ChatLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
```

en.text: Pass ChatMessageList as children and ChatComposer as the `composer` slot for a complete chat interface.
Provide an `empty` slot so new conversations show a prompt instead of a blank screen.
Use `scrollRef` when the chat is embedded in a page where a parent element handles scrolling.
Apply a fixed height on the layout; let it fill its container with `flex: 1`.
Render multiple ChatLayout instances in the same scroll container; each expects to own its scroll context.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 默认插槽放 `ChatMessageList`，`composer` 插槽放 `ChatComposer`，这样就是一套完整的对话界面。
- 推荐: 给 `empty` 插槽一点内容，新对话才不至于是一块白屏。
- 推荐: 对话嵌在由外层负责滚动的页面里时，用 `scrollRef` 指定那个滚动元素。
- 避免: 给布局写死高度。让它用 `flex: 1` 填满外层就好。
- 避免: 在同一个滚动容器里放多个 `ChatLayout`。每个都认为自己独占滚动。

summary.en: Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.
summary.zh: `ChatMessage` 是一条消息的外壳，负责按发送者角色摆好头像、名字、元信息和对齐方向。

usage.en:
Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.

`sender` is required. It decides the alignment, and whether the avatar, name, and metadata slots are rendered at all: a `system` row is centered and ignores all three. Density comes from the surrounding `ChatMessageList` unless the row sets its own.

The name and metadata slots belong to the raw-content case. When the first child is a `ChatMessageBubble`, put the name on the bubble instead, so the name lines up with the bubble padding. The same goes for metadata on the last bubble.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageList>
    <ChatMessage sender="user">
      <ChatMessageBubble>
        Can you review the token validation changes?
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
    <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
      <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">
        Looks good — ship it.
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
  </ChatMessageList>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatMessage` 是一条消息的外壳，负责按发送者角色摆好头像、名字、元信息和对齐方向。

`sender` 必填。它决定这条消息靠哪边，也决定头像、名字、元信息三个插槽要不要渲染：`system` 行居中显示，这三样都不出。密度默认跟着外层 `ChatMessageList` 走，单条消息也可以自己指定。

名字和元信息这两个插槽是给「正文不是气泡」的情况用的。正文第一条是 `ChatMessageBubble` 时，把名字放到气泡上，名字才会跟气泡的内边距对齐；元信息放在最后一条气泡上，道理一样。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageList>
    <ChatMessage sender="user">
      <ChatMessageBubble>
        Can you review the token validation changes?
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
    <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
      <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">
        Looks good — ship it.
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
  </ChatMessageList>
</template>
```

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `default`: message content: bubbles, tool calls, reasoning, or raw nodes. Custom content renders flush with the message edge; wrap it in a ghost `ChatMessageBubble` to align it with the bubble text column.
- `avatar`: element rendered beside the message, typically `Avatar`. Ignored when `sender` is `system`.
- `name`: replaces the `name` prop.
- `metadata`: rendered below the body. Use it when the last child is raw content, not a bubble; with bubbles, use the bubble's `metadata` slot instead.

en.heading: Exposed
en.text: - `element`: the root `<article>` element.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `default`：消息正文，可以放气泡、工具调用、思考过程，或者一段自由内容。自由内容和消息边缘齐平；想让它跟气泡的文字列对齐，就套一个透明气泡。
- `avatar`：消息旁边的头像，一般用 `Avatar`。`sender` 是 `system` 时不显示。
- `name`：替代 `name` 属性。
- `metadata`：正文下方的元信息。最后一条不是气泡时用它；如果最后一条是气泡，改用气泡的 `metadata` 插槽。

zh.heading: 暴露
zh.text: - `element`：根元素 `<article>`。

summary.en: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.
summary.zh: `ChatToolCalls` 用来显示大模型这一轮都调了哪些工具、函数。传一组调用进去就行：只有一条时直接排成一行；有好几条时收成一个摘要，最近调的那条露在外面。凡是 AI 助手要交代自己干了什么的地方都能用。

usage.en:
ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.

An empty array renders nothing. Several calls collapse into one header row that shows the latest call; the header toggles between that summary and the full list. `v-model:is-expanded` controls the group, and `default-is-expanded` sets the state used while the model is unbound. `label` replaces the localized call count once the group is open. A call with `resultDetail` (or its `detail` alias), or the `detail` slot, expands on its own.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatToolCalls } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

const calls = [
  { name: 'bash', status: 'complete' as const, target: 'git status', duration: '1.2s' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
    <ChatToolCalls :calls="calls" />
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatToolCalls` 用来显示大模型这一轮都调了哪些工具、函数。传一组调用进去就行：只有一条时直接排成一行；有好几条时收成一个摘要，最近调的那条露在外面。凡是 AI 助手要交代自己干了什么的地方都能用。

数组为空时什么都不渲染。多条会收成一行表头，表头上显示最近那次调用；点一下就在摘要和完整列表之间切换。`v-model:is-expanded` 控制展开状态，`default-is-expanded` 是没绑 `v-model` 时的初始状态。展开后 `label` 会替掉本地化的调用条数。某条调用带 `resultDetail`（或它的别名 `detail`），或者你给了 `detail` 插槽，它自己还能再展开。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatToolCalls } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

const calls = [
  { name: 'bash', status: 'complete' as const, target: 'git status', duration: '1.2s' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
    <ChatToolCalls :calls="calls" />
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```

en.text: Include a target string on every call so the user can see what the tool acted on: a file path, a shell command, or a search query.
Show a duration on completed calls so users can judge which tools are slow and understand why a response took time.
Provide a group label when the automatic count does not explain what the calls represent.
Provide the `detail` slot with a code block for calls that produce output (diffs for edits, terminal output for shell commands) so users can inspect results inline.
Set a unique `key` on each call item when streaming so Vue can animate additions without re-mounting completed rows.
Don't omit the status field. Without it the call defaults to complete, which is misleading for calls that are still running or have failed.
Don't display tool calls outside a chat message context; they are designed to sit inside an assistant message, not as standalone UI.
Don't use custom wrappers around individual calls; the component handles single vs. grouped layout automatically based on the array length.

import type { ChatToolCallItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

])

  { name: 'read', status: 'complete', target: 'src/components/DataGrid.tsx', duration: '30ms' },
  { name: 'edit', status: 'complete', target: 'src/components/DataGrid.tsx', additions: 24, deletions: 8, duration: '85ms' },

summary.en: Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility. A flex spacer pushes messages to the bottom when the list isn't full; set `align="top"` to start them at the top instead.
summary.zh: `ChatMessageList` 是装消息的容器，只负责排版：它把疏密传给里面的消息，也支持滚到顶部加载更早的消息。它自带 `role="log"` 和 `aria-live="polite"`，读屏能把它当消息记录来读。消息不多、填不满时，底下有一块弹性占位把消息顶到底部；设成 `align="top"` 就改成从顶上开始排。

usage.en:
Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility. A flex spacer pushes messages to the bottom when the list isn't full; set `align="top"` to start them at the top instead.

Rows go in the default slot: usually `ChatMessage` and `ChatSystemMessage`. `density` flows down to the rows that do not set their own. `gap` overrides the row gap alone, without touching padding, which is what LLM event streams with uneven spacing need.

`scrollToTopAction` runs when a sentinel at the top of the list enters the scroll parent, and a spinner stays up until the promise settles. Pair it with an ancestor that scrolls; inside `ChatLayout` the layout owns that scroll.

`isStreaming` marks the log `aria-busy`, so a screen reader waits and announces the finished message once instead of re-reading partial text on every token.

`align` only changes where a short list rests. `bottom`, the default, keeps the spacer so a short conversation sits just above the composer; `top` drops it for document-style transcripts. Once rows overflow the container the spacer collapses either way, so scrolling and the layout's auto-scroll-to-bottom behave the same in both modes.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageList :is-streaming="true">
    <ChatMessage sender="user">
      <ChatMessageBubble>How should I structure a monorepo?</ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
    <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
      <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">
        Use workspaces with a shared packages directory.
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
  </ChatMessageList>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatMessageList` 是装消息的容器，只负责排版：它把疏密传给里面的消息，也支持滚到顶部加载更早的消息。它自带 `role="log"` 和 `aria-live="polite"`，读屏能把它当消息记录来读。消息不多、填不满时，底下有一块弹性占位把消息顶到底部；设成 `align="top"` 就改成从顶上开始排。

消息放进默认插槽，一般是 `ChatMessage` 和 `ChatSystemMessage`。`density` 会传给没有自己指定疏密的那些消息。`gap` 只改行与行之间的距离，不动内边距——大模型事件流那种行距不均匀的场景用得上。

`scrollToTopAction` 配一个顶部哨兵：哨兵一进入滚动容器就调用它，返回的 Promise 没结束前顶部一直显示加载中。它要跟一个真正会滚动的祖先配合；放在 `ChatLayout` 里时，滚动交给布局。

`isStreaming` 会把整个日志标成 `aria-busy`，读屏就会等助手写完再播报一次，而不是每来一个 token 就重念半句话。

`align` 只管消息不到一屏时停在哪里。默认 `bottom` 保留那块弹性占位，消息就贴在输入框上方；`top` 不留占位，适合文档式的会话记录。一旦消息撑满容器，两种模式占位都收成 0，滚动和布局的自动贴底行为完全一样。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageList :is-streaming="true">
    <ChatMessage sender="user">
      <ChatMessageBubble>How should I structure a monorepo?</ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
    <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
      <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">
        Use workspaces with a shared packages directory.
      </ChatMessageBubble>
    </ChatMessage>
  </ChatMessageList>
</template>
```

summary.en: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary. Supports name/metadata slots aligned with bubble padding, and multi-bubble grouping via the group prop for consecutive messages from the same sender.
summary.zh: `ChatMessageBubble` 是消息里那块带底色和圆角的内容框。它不给发送者属性，而是从外层 `ChatMessage` 自己读出来，于是底色、圆角、对齐都会跟着走。不在 `ChatMessage` 里时，按助手那一侧显示。

usage.en:
Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary. Supports name/metadata slots aligned with bubble padding, and multi-bubble grouping via the group prop for consecutive messages from the same sender.

The sender is not a prop: the bubble reads it from the surrounding `ChatMessage`, so it colors and aligns itself. Outside a `ChatMessage` it falls back to the assistant side. A bubble whose only child is a code block, or an element with class `astryx-chat-card`, drops its own padding and background so the card lines up with the bubble edges.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="user">
    <ChatMessageBubble>
      Can you review the token validation changes?
    </ChatMessageBubble>
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatMessageBubble` 是消息里那块带底色和圆角的内容框。它不给发送者属性，而是从外层 `ChatMessage` 自己读出来，于是底色、圆角、对齐都会跟着走。不在 `ChatMessage` 里时，按助手那一侧显示。

`variant` 选外观：`filled` 是常规的实心气泡；`ghost` 只保留内边距、去掉底色，正文没有可见边界但仍能对齐。名字和元信息各有插槽，左右内边距跟气泡正文一致。同一个人的连续几条用 `group` 写着 first / middle / last，靠发送者那一侧的圆角会收小，看起来是一整段。

气泡里只有一个代码块，或者只有带 `astryx-chat-card` 类的元素时，气泡会自己去掉内边距和底色，让卡片跟气泡边缘齐平。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="user">
    <ChatMessageBubble>
      Can you review the token validation changes?
    </ChatMessageBubble>
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```

usage.en:
Use ChatSystemMessage for concise, non-sender content inside a chat transcript. Choose the default variant for factual status notices and the divider variant for date or section breaks. Long default content wraps within the available width. The component exposes status semantics and the divider branch includes a labelled separator.

The row is `role="status"`, so a change here is announced without moving focus. Text goes in the default slot and is required. The `icon` slot renders before the text in the default variant; the divider variant renders a labelled `Divider` and ignores the icon.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatSystemMessage } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

  <ChatSystemMessage variant="divider">
    March 15, 2026
  </ChatSystemMessage>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatSystemMessage` 用在对话里放「不是某个人说的话」那一类内容：谁进群了、谁退群了、话题换了、今天几号。要陈述事实就用 `default`，要分隔日期或段落就用 `divider`。`default` 的长文本会在可用宽度里换行。整行带状态语义，`divider` 那一支还带一条有文字标签的分隔线。

这一行是 `role="status"`，所以内容变了读屏会播报，但焦点不动。文字放在默认插槽里，必填。`icon` 插槽的内容在 `default` 里排在文字前面；`divider` 渲染的是一条带标签的 `Divider`，不看图标。

en.text: Keep the visible message concise and self-contained so it remains understandable without an icon.
Use the divider variant for temporal or section boundaries and the default variant for factual status notices.

Use caller-provided icon artwork as the only source of meaning; the visible message must carry the same information.

summary.en: Use ChatTokenizedText inside a chat message when stored plain text contains serialized token values that should be projected as inline badges or caller-rendered token content. Unmatched text is preserved exactly and empty token values are ignored so rendering always finishes.
summary.zh: 存下来的纯文本里如果带着「标记的值」，用 `ChatTokenizedText` 就能在消息里把它们显示成行内徽章，或者显示成你自己画的内容。没匹配上的文字原样保留；标记的值是空字符串时不参与匹配，所以渲染总能收尾。

usage.en:
Use ChatTokenizedText inside a chat message when stored plain text contains serialized token values that should be projected as inline badges or caller-rendered token content. Unmatched text is preserved exactly and empty token values are ignored so rendering always finishes.

The text goes in the default slot. The `text` prop does the same job when a string is easier to pass, and it wins when both are set. Every token `value` is matched literally and costs one pass over the string, so the same token objects a composer trigger returns can be reused here. A structured token renders a `Badge`; a token with its own `render` function renders that markup instead and stays caller-owned.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatTokenizedText } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

const tokens = [
  { value: '@Cindy', label: '@Cindy', variant: 'blue' as const },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="user">
    <ChatMessageBubble>
      <ChatTokenizedText :tokens="tokens">
        Assign @Cindy as a reviewer.
      </ChatTokenizedText>
    </ChatMessageBubble>
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
存下来的纯文本里如果带着「标记的值」，用 `ChatTokenizedText` 就能在消息里把它们显示成行内徽章，或者显示成你自己画的内容。没匹配上的文字原样保留；标记的值是空字符串时不参与匹配，所以渲染总能收尾。

文字写在默认插槽里。要直接传一个字符串时，用 `text` 属性也一样；两个都写以属性为准。每个标记的 `value` 按字面匹配，所以输入框触发器返回的那组标记对象可以原样搬过来复用。普通标记渲染成 `Badge`；带 `render` 函数的标记渲染成你自己的内容，那部分由你负责。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatTokenizedText } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

const tokens = [
  { value: '@Cindy', label: '@Cindy', variant: 'blue' as const },
]
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessage sender="user">
    <ChatMessageBubble>
      <ChatTokenizedText :tokens="tokens">
        Assign @Cindy as a reviewer.
      </ChatTokenizedText>
    </ChatMessageBubble>
  </ChatMessage>
</template>
```

en.text: Reuse the same token definitions for composer insertion and message rendering so serialized values and visible labels stay aligned.
Use non-empty, stable serialized values so every definition identifies real message text.
Use token labels as a substitute for the surrounding message text; the complete message must remain understandable in reading order.
Put component-owned interaction or accessibility behavior inside a custom token renderer; custom token content remains caller owned.

usage.en:
Place ChatMessageMetadata below a message or in the last ChatMessageBubble metadata slot to show a timestamp, footer content, and optional delivery status. Non-rendering scalar slots (booleans and empty strings) create no separator; numeric zero remains visible. Composite slot content remains caller-owned.

The row renders nothing at all when `timestamp`, `footer`, and `status` are all absent. The dots between the three parts only appear next to a part that is actually there, so a two-part row reads `2:30 PM · Read` and a three-part row reads `2:30 PM · GPT-4o · Read`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessageMetadata } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageMetadata status="read" timestamp="2:30 PM" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ChatMessageMetadata` 放在消息下面，或者放进最后一条气泡的元信息插槽，用来显示时间、页脚内容和送达状态。这三样都是可选的。传空字符串这种「什么都不渲染」的值，不会多出一个分隔点；插槽里传数字 0 会照常显示。页脚里放什么由调用方决定，组件不接管。

`timestamp`、`footer`、`status` 三样都没有时，整行什么都不渲染。中间的小圆点只挨着真正有内容的那一段出现，所以两段是「2:30 PM · 已读」，三段是「2:30 PM · GPT-4o · 已读」。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatMessageMetadata } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
</script>

<template>
  <ChatMessageMetadata status="read" timestamp="2:30 PM" />
</template>
```

en.text: Put metadata in the last bubble metadata slot when the message uses bubbles, so it follows the bubble content.
Pass timestamp and footer content independently; separators are omitted for non-rendering scalar slots. Composite slot content is used as supplied.
Do not supply footer actions without their own accessible names and interaction behavior; the metadata row does not own those controls.
Do not put the same metadata on both a bubble and its enclosing message.

<script setup lang="ts">

import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList, ChatMessageMetadata } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

const rows: { status: ChatMessageStatus, text: string }[] = [

  { status: 'sent', text: 'Config pushed to staging.' },
  { status: 'delivered', text: 'Verified on the staging cluster.' },
  { status: 'read', text: 'Looks good — promoting to prod.' },
  { status: 'error', text: 'Rollback triggered, checking logs.' },
]

    <ChatMessage v-for="row in rows" :key="row.status" sender="user">

        <template #metadata>
          <ChatMessageMetadata :status="row.status" timestamp="10:15 AM" />

summary.en: ChatComposer is the message-entry shell for a chat surface. It coordinates a controlled or uncontrolled draft, provides a default token-capable input and send/stop action, and arranges optional drawer, header, footer, and status content. Custom inputs and send controls can join the same value, submission, disabled, stop, and focus contract through `useChatComposerContext()`.
summary.zh: `ChatComposer` 是对话页面里写字发送的那一整块。它管草稿（你给 `v-model` 就归你管，不给它自己存）、默认带标签能力的输入框、发送和停止两颗按钮，另外还有抽屉、页眉、页脚、状态提示这几个可选位置。自己写的输入框和发送按钮也能接进来：通过 `useChatComposerContext()` 拿到同一份草稿、提交、禁用、停止和聚焦的约定。

description.en: Chat composer with removable file tokens in a collapsible drawer. Use when users can attach files or context to their message.
description.zh: 抽屉里放可以逐个删掉的附件标签。用户能给这条消息带上文件或上下文时用它。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer, ChatComposerDrawer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
import { Token } from '@astryx-vue/core/Token'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const files = ref([
  'feature-prd.docx',
  '2026-roadmap.pdf',
  'user-flow.fig',
  'launch-plan.docx',
  'user-feedback.csv',
  'analytics-kpis.csv',
])

function remove(name: string): void {
  files.value = files.value.filter(item => item !== name)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ChatComposer>
    <template #drawer>
      <ChatComposerDrawer :count="files.length">
        <Token
          v-for="name in files"
          :key="name"
          removable
          :label="name"
          @remove="remove(name)"
        />
      </ChatComposerDrawer>
    </template>
  </ChatComposer>
</template>

  'requirements.docx',
  'wireframes.fig',
  'api-spec.yaml',
  'user-research.csv',
])

function remove(name: string): void {

}

description.en: Chat composer with streaming state and a stop button. Use when the assistant is generating a response and the user can cancel.
description.zh: 带有流式状态和停止按钮的输入区。助手正在生成回答、用户可以中途取消时用它。

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isStreaming = ref(false)

}

}

zh.text:
- 推荐: 希望发送和停止的行为跟着输入区走，就把它放进 `ChatComposer`。
- 推荐: 单独用时，把状态和对应的 `send` 或 `stop` 监听都显式给全。

en.text: Place the dictation button in the `sendActions` slot of ChatComposer so it sits next to the send button where users expect voice input controls.
Pass the input handle to `useChatDictation` so interim transcripts appear as ghost text in the composer input while the user speaks.
Enable `hasSounds` on `useChatDictation` to give users audio feedback when dictation starts and stops. This is especially helpful when the button's visual change is subtle.
Don't use the dictation button outside a chat composer context. It's designed for the composer's send-action layout, not as a standalone recording control.
Don't forget to handle the unsupported case. The button hides itself by default when the browser lacks SpeechRecognition, but you should still design the composer to work without it.

en.text: The button paints the accent color while it listens. When the input level goes past the clipping threshold, the bars mix toward the error color, so a loud microphone is visible at a glance.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 把语音按钮放进 `ChatComposer` 的 `sendActions` 插槽，它就挨着发送按钮，正是用户找语音入口的位置。
- 推荐: 把输入框的句柄传给 `useChatDictation`，用户说话时半截的话会以灰字出现在输入框里。
- 推荐: 给 `useChatDictation` 打开 `hasSounds`，开始和结束录音时给一声提示音。按钮变化本来就很细微，有声音更好判断。
- 避免: 把语音按钮拿到对话输入区外面单独用。它是为输入区发送按钮旁边那个位置设计的，不是通用的录音控件。
- 避免: 忘了处理浏览器不支持的情况。浏览器没有 SpeechRecognition 时按钮会自己藏起来，但你的输入区本身也得在不支持时能用。

summary.en: `Card` is a bordered surface with a background and rounded corners, and it turns a group of content into one thing you can treat on its own. Its job is appearance and space only: the background, the border, the corner radius, the padding, and passing that padding on to children that need to bleed past it.
summary.zh: `Card` 是一块带边框、带背景和圆角的容器，用来把一组内容圈成一个可以独立对待的整体。它的职责只有外观和空间：背景、边框、圆角、内边距，以及把这个内边距告诉需要向外延伸的子元素。

usage.en:
`Card` is a bordered surface with a background and rounded corners, and it turns a group of content into one thing you can treat on its own. Its job is appearance and space only: the background, the border, the corner radius, the padding, and passing that padding on to children that need to bleed past it.

A card is not the default layout tool. Most content groups on a page need no container at all; spacing and alignment already read as grouping. Reach for a card when an item needs a clear interaction boundary, or when it has to be compared side by side with its siblings in a row or a grid. A useful test is to ask: "could I reorder, remove, or take this away on its own?" If yes, it is a card. If no, it is just a region of the page, and a heading plus a `Stack` is the right answer.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Card>
    <VStack :gap="2">
      <Heading :level="3">
        Weekly report
      </Heading>
      <Text color="secondary">
        Your team closed 24 issues this week.
      </Text>
    </VStack>
  </Card>
</template>
```

`padding` takes a step from the spacing scale (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10) and applies it to all four sides. Leave it out and the card keeps the theme's card padding rather than one fixed step, so passing a step is a decision to override the theme instead of a way to restate its default.

`variant` picks the background. `default` is the standard card surface with a visible border, `transparent` has neither a background nor a border and only groups content, and `muted` uses the muted surface. The other ten names are the categorisation hues: `blue`, `cyan`, `gray`, `green`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `red`, `teal`, and `yellow`. Only `default` draws a border, and it draws it inside the padding: the border width is subtracted from each side, so the total inset (border plus padding) still equals the padding step and content sits at the same coordinates in a bordered card as in a borderless one.

`elevation` is the shadow the card rests at, and it can be `none`, `low`, `med`, or `high`. Raise a card only when it has to float above the content around it; a list where every card carries a shadow has no depth left to show.

`width`, `height`, `maxWidth`, and `minHeight` size the card, with numbers read as pixels and strings used as they are. In a flex row or a grid track the card yields to the track: it has a minimum width of zero, so a long value inside cannot widen a row or a `1fr` track. The card also clips content it cannot fit rather than turning into a scroll container, which would capture sticky descendants and make an overflowing card an unnamed keyboard tab stop. Truncate long values that cannot wrap — an ID, a hash, a URL — with `Text`'s `maxLines`, and give wide content such as a table or code its own scroll region. A fixed `height` changes that: the card becomes a viewport for its content, and the content scrolls inside it.

The card also publishes `--container-padding-inline-start`, `--container-padding-inline-end`, `--container-padding-block-start`, and `--container-padding-block-end` on its root. Children that need to extend to the card's edge — a `Divider` with `isFullBleed`, for example — read those variables to cancel the padding, so they never need to know how much padding the card used.
usage.zh:
`Card` 是一块带边框、带背景和圆角的容器，用来把一组内容圈成一个可以独立对待的整体。它的职责只有外观和空间：背景、边框、圆角、内边距，以及把这个内边距告诉需要向外延伸的子元素。

卡片不是默认的排版工具。页面上的大多数内容分组并不需要容器，间距和对齐本身就能形成分组；只有当一个条目需要清晰的交互边界，或者需要在一行、一个网格里与同类条目并排比较时，才值得用卡片。一个好用的判断是问自己：“这一块我能单独把它排序、删除或拿走吗？”如果答案是能，它是卡片；如果答案是不能，它只是页面的一段，用标题加 `Stack` 就够了。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Card>
    <VStack :gap="2">
      <Heading :level="3">
        Weekly report
      </Heading>
      <Text color="secondary">
        Your team closed 24 issues this week.
      </Text>
    </VStack>
  </Card>
</template>
```

`padding` 使用间距比例（0、0.5、1、1.5、2、3、4、5、6、8、10），作用于四边。省略它时，卡片用的是主题的卡片内边距，而不是某个固定步进值；也就是说，传一个步进值意味着你要覆盖主题，而不是复述默认值。

`variant` 决定背景：`default` 是标准的卡片表面并带一条可见的描边，`transparent` 既没有背景也没有描边（只用来做分组，不增加视觉重量），`muted` 使用弱化的背景色。其余十个名字是分类用的色相：`blue`、`cyan`、`gray`、`green`、`orange`、`pink`、`purple`、`red`、`teal`、`yellow`。只有 `default` 会画描边，而且描边画在内边距之内——它的宽度会从每一侧的内边距里减去，所以“描边 + 内边距”的总内缩仍然等于那个间距步进值，有边框的卡片和没有边框的卡片里，内容的坐标是一致的。

`elevation` 是静止时的阴影深度，可取 `none`、`low`、`med`、`high`。只有在卡片确实需要浮在周围内容之上时才抬升它；一个铺满列表的界面里每张卡片都带阴影，就失去了层次的意义。

`width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight` 控制尺寸，数字按像素解释，字符串按原样使用。卡片在弹性行或网格轨道里会让位给轨道：它有一个为零的最小宽度，所以一行或一条 `1fr` 轨道不会被一张卡片里的长内容撑宽。同时卡片用 `overflow: clip` 裁掉自己装不下的内容，而不是变成滚动容器——那样会让卡片内部的粘性元素粘到卡片上，也会让溢出的卡片变成一个没有名字的键盘停靠点。因此，无法换行的长文本（长 ID、哈希、URL）请交给 `Text` 的 `maxLines` 去截断，宽内容（表格、代码）请让它自己带滚动区域。给卡片一个固定的 `height` 时行为会变：这张卡片就是你为内容指定的视口，内容在卡片内部滚动。

卡片还会在根元素上发布 `--container-padding-inline-start`、`--container-padding-inline-end`、`--container-padding-block-start`、`--container-padding-block-end`。需要向外延伸到卡片边缘的子元素（例如 `isFullBleed` 的 `Divider`）读取这几个变量来抵消内边距，所以它不需要知道卡片用了多少 padding。

en.text: Ask first: "could I reorder or remove this on its own?" If yes, it is a card; if no, it is a page region, so use a heading plus a `Stack` or a `Section`.
Use cards for discrete items: one user, one notification, one metric, one product in a grid. Each card is one thing.
Keep `padding` the same across sibling cards so they line up in a grid or a list.
Truncate long IDs, hashes, and URLs with `Text`'s `maxLines="1"`, and put wide content such as tables and code in its own scroll region.
Set `elevation` only when the card has to float above the content around it.
Default to cards for visual grouping. A heading plus a `Stack` with proper spacing builds hierarchy without covering the page in borders.
Wrap page regions in cards. Form groups such as "General settings" or "Notification preferences" are page regions, not cards.
Nest cards inside other cards. Flatten the hierarchy with spacing and dividers instead.
Use the colour variants to carry status. Use `Banner` or `Badge` for that; a coloured card is for categorisation.

zh.text: 先问“这一块能单独排序或删除吗”。能，才是卡片；不能，就只是页面的一段，用标题加 `Stack` 或 `Section`。
用卡片承载离散的条目：一个用户、一条通知、一个指标、网格里的一个商品，每张卡片对应一个“东西”。
让同一组卡片的 `padding` 保持一致，这样它们在网格或列表里才会对齐。
长 ID、哈希、URL 用 `Text` 的 `maxLines="1"` 截断；表格、代码这类宽内容放进它自己的滚动区域。
只在卡片需要浮在内容之上时设置 `elevation`。
把卡片当成默认的视觉分组手段。标题加 `Stack` 的间距就能建立层次，铺满描边只会让页面变吵。
把页面区域包进卡片。“通用设置”“通知偏好”这类表单分组属于页面区域，不是卡片。
在卡片里再放卡片。层次应该靠间距和分隔线压平，而不是叠盒子。
用颜色变体表达状态。状态请交给 `Banner` 或 `Badge`，彩色卡片只用来分类。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Width of the card. Numbers are read as pixels and strings are used as they are. In a flex row or a grid track this is the preferred width: the card still yields when the row is narrower.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Height of the card. Numbers are read as pixels and strings are used as they are. A fixed height makes the card scroll its own content; `auto` and an omitted height leave the height to the content.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum width of the card.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum height of the card.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Padding on all four sides, as one step of the spacing scale: 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10. Omit it and the card uses the theme's card padding — spacing step 4 with no theme — so passing a step overrides the theme instead of restating the default.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Background variant. `default` uses the standard card surface and draws the border, `transparent` drops the background and the border, and `muted` uses the muted surface. The non-semantic hues are blue, cyan, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, and yellow.

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: Resting shadow depth: none, low, med, or high. Raise a card only when it has to float above the content around it.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-padding`
rows.description: The theme's card padding. The `padding` prop bypasses it when it is set. `--astryx-card-padding-inline`, `--astryx-card-padding-inline-start`, `--astryx-card-padding-inline-end`, `--astryx-card-padding-block-start`, and `--astryx-card-padding-block-end` refine it per axis.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-background`
rows.description: Background of the `default` variant.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-muted-background`
rows.description: Background of the `muted` variant.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-border`
rows.description: Border colour of the `default` variant. Its width comes from `--astryx-border-width`.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-<hue>-background`
rows.description: Background of each hue variant, for example `--astryx-card-blue-background`.

rows.name: `--astryx-card-shadow-low`, `-med`, `-high`
rows.description: The three elevation shadows, used by `elevation` low, med, and high. A built-in shadow is used when the theme defines none.

rows.name: `--_card-radius`
rows.description: The card's corner radius. Private, and a theme may override it.

rows.name: `--_card-elevation`
rows.description: The resting shadow, written from `elevation`. It composes with `--_card-ring` inside the card's `box-shadow`, so a ring and an elevation can coexist.

rows.name: `--_card-ring`
rows.description: An inset ring drawn in the card's shadow list, for a composing component that shows selection.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 卡片宽度。数字按像素解释，字符串按原样使用。在弹性行或网格轨道里这是首选宽度：行更窄时卡片仍然会让位。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 卡片高度。数字按像素解释，字符串按原样使用。给出固定高度后，卡片的内部内容会自己滚动；`auto` 和不传则交给内容决定。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 卡片的最大宽度。

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: 卡片的最小高度。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 四边的内边距，取间距比例的一档：0、0.5、1、1.5、2、3、4、5、6、8、10。省略时使用主题的卡片内边距（无主题时为间距步进 4），所以传入步进值意味着覆盖主题，而不是复述默认值。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 背景变体。`default` 使用标准卡片表面并带描边，`transparent` 去掉背景和描边，`muted` 使用弱化背景。非语义色相：blue、cyan、gray、green、orange、pink、purple、red、teal、yellow。

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: 静止时的阴影深度，可选 none、low、med、high。只有在卡片需要浮在周围内容之上时才抬升它。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-padding`
rows.description: 主题的卡片内边距。为 `padding` 传入步进值时会绕过它。同族的 `--astryx-card-padding-inline`、`--astryx-card-padding-inline-start`、`--astryx-card-padding-inline-end`、`--astryx-card-padding-block-start`、`--astryx-card-padding-block-end` 可以按边细化。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-background`
rows.description: `default` 变体的背景。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-muted-background`
rows.description: `muted` 变体的背景。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-border`
rows.description: `default` 变体的描边颜色。宽度固定为 `--astryx-border-width`。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-<色相>-background`
rows.description: 十个色相变体的背景，例如 `--astryx-card-blue-background`。

rows.name: `--astryx-card-shadow-low`、`-med`、`-high`
rows.description: 三档抬升阴影，分别对应 `elevation` 的 low、med、high。主题未定义时使用内置的阴影值。

rows.name: `--_card-radius`
rows.description: 卡片圆角。内部变量，主题可以覆盖。

rows.name: `--_card-elevation`
rows.description: 静止阴影，由 `elevation` 写入。它与 `--_card-ring` 一起组成卡片的 `box-shadow`，所以描边环和抬升阴影可以共存。

rows.name: `--_card-ring`
rows.description: 画在卡片阴影列表里的内环，供需要表达选中状态的组合组件设置。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The card's content, usually a `Stack` holding a heading, text, and actions.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 卡片的内容，通常是一个装着标题、文字和操作的 `Stack`。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`variant`, `elevation`, and `padding` are also reflected as `data-variant`, `data-elevation`, and `data-padding` on the root, and a fixed `height` adds `data-scrollable="true"`.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`variant`、`elevation`、`padding` 会同时反映为根元素上的 `data-variant`、`data-elevation`、`data-padding`，`height` 为固定值时还会带上 `data-scrollable="true"`。

description.en: Muted-variant cards for tips, notes, or supplementary information. Use when content should be visually distinct but not prominent.
description.zh: muted 变体适合提示、备注或补充信息。内容需要和页面区分开，但又不该太抢眼时使用。

examples.code:

description.en: The four elevation levels side by side. Cards are flat by default; raise a card with elevation only when it needs to float above surrounding content.
description.zh: 四种海拔并排。卡片默认是平的；只有需要浮在周围内容之上时才用 elevation 抬起。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Grid } from '@astryx-vue/core/Grid'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const levels = [
  { elevation: 'none' as const, caption: 'Flat — sits on the page (default)' },
  { elevation: 'low' as const, caption: 'Low — lifts off slightly' },
  { elevation: 'med' as const, caption: 'Med — clearly raised' },
  { elevation: 'high' as const, caption: 'High — floats well above' },

<template>
  <Grid :columns="2" :gap="4" :width="520">
    <Card v-for="level in levels" :key="level.elevation" :elevation="level.elevation">
      <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
        <Heading :level="4">
          elevation="{{ level.elevation }}"
        </Heading>
        <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
          {{ level.caption }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
</template>

description.en: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types.
description.zh: 默认、muted 和颜色变体并排。用颜色给卡片分类，例如团队色、项目标签或内容类型。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CardVariant } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const variants: { variant: CardVariant, label: string, note: string }[] = [
  { variant: 'default', label: 'General', note: '4 tasks due today' },

summary.en: `Collapsible` folds one content region behind a trigger: the trigger stays visible and a click expands or collapses the content underneath. It belongs in settings panels, FAQ pages, and detail views — places where the page should stay easy to scan while still letting people drill into what they care about. Several collapsibles side by side form a plain accordion, each managing its own state.
summary.zh: `Collapsible` 把一个内容区块收在触发器后面：触发器始终可见，点击后展开或收起下面的内容。它适合设置页、常见问题、订单详情这类需要让页面保持可扫读、又允许用户按需展开的地方。多个 `Collapsible` 放在一起就是一个手风琴列表，每一项各自管理自己的开关。

usage.en: `Collapsible` folds one content region behind a trigger: the trigger stays visible and a click expands or collapses the content underneath. It belongs in settings panels, FAQ pages, and detail views — places where the page should stay easy to scan while still letting people drill into what they care about. Several collapsibles side by side form a plain accordion, each managing its own state. The shortest form gives a label and the content: ```vue ``` A collapsible starts expanded. Pass `:default-is-open="false"` when the content should stay hidden until someone asks for it. In that mode the component owns the state: clicking the trigger flips the content and reports the new state through the `openChange` event. When something outside the component decides, lift the state with `v-model:is-open`. The component then renders exactly what the bound value says, and a click is only a request to change it: ```vue ``` The trigger is normally a plain text label passed to the `trigger` prop. When the label needs a heading, an icon, or extra controls, use the `trigger` slot instead; it replaces the prop completely. Expanding and collapsing play a real transition: the content region's height, padding, and opacity change together, and under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the change lands immediately without the movement. The trigger and the content are linked with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, so a screen reader can move from the button straight to the region it controls. While collapsed the region stays the same element — `aria-controls` always points at it — but it is set to `display: none`, which keeps it out of the tab order and out of the accessibility tree. `chevronPosition` decides which side of the label carries the disclosure chevron. The default `end` follows the label and points down while collapsed, up while expanded. Set it to `start` to lead the label with an arrow that points into the content while collapsed — mirrored in right-to-left layouts — and turns down when expanded, matching the rows of a file tree. `isDisabled` dims the trigger, stops it responding to clicks, marks it `aria-disabled`, and takes it out of the tab order. It never collapses content that is already open; it only stops further changes.
usage.zh: `Collapsible` 把一个内容区块收在触发器后面：触发器始终可见，点击后展开或收起下面的内容。它适合设置页、常见问题、订单详情这类需要让页面保持可扫读、又允许用户按需展开的地方。多个 `Collapsible` 放在一起就是一个手风琴列表，每一项各自管理自己的开关。 最简单的用法是给一个标签加上内容： ```vue ``` 默认是展开的。只希望用户在点击后才看到内容时传入 `:default-is-open="false"`。这种情况下组件自己管理开关状态：点击触发器切换内容，并通过 `openChange` 事件把新的状态告诉外部。 需要由外部决定展开状态时，用 `v-model:is-open` 把状态提升到父组件。此时组件的显示完全跟随绑定的值，点击只是向父组件发出更新请求： ```vue ``` 触发器通常用 `trigger` 属性给出一个纯文本标签；标签里需要标题、图标或其他控件时，改用 `trigger` 插槽，插槽会完全替换属性。展开和收起都有真实的过渡动画，内容区域的高度、内边距和透明度一起变化；在系统开启「减少动态效果」时这些动画会立即完成，状态变化本身不受影响。 触发器和内容区域通过 `aria-expanded` 与 `aria-controls` 关联，屏幕阅读器可以从按钮直接跳到它控制的内容。收起时内容区仍是同一个元素（`aria-controls` 始终指向它），但被设为 `display: none`，因此不会被键盘或读屏软件访问到。 `chevronPosition` 决定指示箭头位于标签的哪一侧。默认的 `end` 跟在标签后面：收起时朝下，展开时朝上。设为 `start` 时箭头移到标签前面，收起时指向内容一侧（在从右向左的语言下会自动镜像），展开时转成朝下，也就是文件树里常见的那种写法。 `isDisabled` 会让触发器变暗、不再响应点击，同时带上 `aria-disabled` 并退出 Tab 顺序。注意它不会收起已经展开的内容，只是让用户无法再操作这一项。

en.text: Name what the section holds. The label is the button's accessible name, so a vague "More" or "Details" leaves screen reader users guessing.
Collapse content that is long or only occasionally needed. A single short paragraph is better shown directly than hidden behind a click.
Lift the state with `v-model:isOpen` when something outside the component decides, so the parent stays the single source of truth.
Use `chevronPosition="start"` for nested rows and lists, where the arrow leaning into the content matches the file-tree convention, and keep the default `end` for standalone sections.
Keep the trigger to its label. Put actions inside the content region or on their own row so a click is never ambiguous.
Hide critical or required content behind a collapsible. Many people will never open it, and the information is lost.
Nest collapsibles more than two levels deep; the content becomes hard to find and navigate.
Put the outcome of an action or an error inside a collapsible. Show that kind of message directly, or use a banner.

zh.text: 触发器写清展开后是什么内容。标签本身就是按钮的无障碍名称，含糊的“更多”或“详情”会让屏幕阅读器用户无法判断。
内容较长、用户只需偶尔查看时使用折叠。只有一两行文字时直接显示出来，不必让用户多点一次。
需要由业务状态决定展开与否时使用 `v-model:isOpen`，让父组件成为唯一的状态来源。
多层结构或列表中的行使用 `chevronPosition="start"`，箭头指向内容一侧，和文件树的习惯一致；独立的小节保持默认的 `end`。
触发器只放标题文字。需要操作按钮时考虑显式地放在内容区或独立的行里，避免误触。
把关键或必读内容折起来。用户很可能不会点开，信息就丢失了。
嵌套超过两层折叠。层级一深，内容就难以查找和导航。
用折叠面板承载刚发生的结果或错误。这类消息应当直接显示，或改用提示条（Banner）。

en.heading: Theming
Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The trigger is a `<button type="button">` inside the root element; its `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-disabled`, and `tabindex` are maintained by the component. Disabling never sets the native `disabled` attribute, so assistive technology keeps perceiving the trigger.

zh.heading: 主题
原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

触发器是根元素内部的 `<button type="button">`，它的 `aria-expanded`、`aria-controls`、`aria-disabled` 与 `tabindex` 由组件维护。禁用时不会使用原生 `disabled`，以便触发器继续被辅助技术感知。

description.en: Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here.
description.zh: 由父级状态决定哪一节打开，因此不只是点击能切换：URL 参数、校验失败时跳到对应步骤，或这里的上一步 / 下一步。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const steps = ['profile', 'security', 'billing'] as const
const open = ref<(typeof steps)[number]>('profile')
const index = computed(() => steps.indexOf(open.value))

function previous() {
  open.value = steps[Math.max(0, index.value - 1)]
}
function next() {
  open.value = steps[Math.min(steps.length - 1, index.value + 1)]
}
</script>

<template>
  <Stack :gap="3" :max-width="440">
    <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="2">
      <Button label="Previous" variant="secondary" size="sm" :is-disabled="index <= 0" @click="previous" />
      <Button label="Next" variant="secondary" size="sm" :is-disabled="index >= steps.length - 1" @click="next" />
      <Text type="supporting">
        Step {{ index + 1 }} of {{ steps.length }}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
    <CollapsibleGroup v-model:value="open" type="single">
      <Stack :gap="2">
        <Card>
          <Collapsible trigger="Profile" value="profile">
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Name, email, and photo. Changes save as you type; the email address needs confirmation from the new inbox before it takes effect.
            </Text>
          </Collapsible>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <Collapsible trigger="Security" value="security">
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Two-factor authentication, active sessions, and recent login history. Signing out of a session revokes its token immediately.
            </Text>
          </Collapsible>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <Collapsible trigger="Billing" value="billing">
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Invoices, payment method, and plan. Invoices stay downloadable for seven years, including after a downgrade.
            </Text>
          </Collapsible>
        </Card>
      </Stack>
    </CollapsibleGroup>
  </Stack>
</template>

summary.en: `ClickableCard` is a card whose whole surface activates one action. The keyboard stop is a visually hidden link when `href` is set, and a button otherwise. Nested buttons and links keep their own clicks.
summary.zh: `ClickableCard` 是整张卡片触发同一个动作的卡片。有 `href` 时，键盘焦点落在一个视觉上隐藏的链接上，否则落在按钮上。里面的按钮和链接仍走自己的点击。

usage.en:
`ClickableCard` is a card whose whole surface activates one action. The keyboard stop is a visually hidden link when `href` is set, and a button otherwise. Nested buttons and links keep their own clicks.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ClickableCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/ClickableCard'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
</script>

<template>
  <ClickableCard href="/settings" label="Settings">
    <Heading :level="4">
      Settings
    </Heading>
  </ClickableCard>
</template>
```

`target="_blank"` opens `href` in a new tab. Modifier clicks and the middle button do the same. `elevation` and `variant` are forwarded to `Card`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ClickableCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/ClickableCard'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
</script>

<template>
  <ClickableCard href="/settings" label="Settings">
    <Heading :level="4">
      Settings
    </Heading>
  </ClickableCard>
</template>
```

`target="_blank"` 会在新标签页打开 `href`。按住修饰键或用中键点击也一样。`elevation` 和 `variant` 传给 `Card`。

summary.en: `SelectableCard` is a card with a selected state. The keyboard stop is a visually hidden checkbox. Bind the state with `v-model:is-selected`, or pass `:is-selected` and handle `update:isSelected` when several cards share one value.
summary.zh: `SelectableCard` 是带选中状态的卡片。键盘焦点落在一个视觉上隐藏的复选框上。单张卡片用 `v-model:is-selected`。几张卡片共用一个值时，传入 `:is-selected`，再处理 `update:isSelected`。

usage.en:
`SelectableCard` is a card with a selected state. The keyboard stop is a visually hidden checkbox. Bind the state with `v-model:is-selected`, or pass `:is-selected` and handle `update:isSelected` when several cards share one value.

The selected card draws an accent border and an inset ring. `elevation` stays in the shadow, and the ring is composed on top of it. `variant` recolors that accent.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectableCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/SelectableCard'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref('pro')
</script>

<template>
  <SelectableCard
    :is-selected="selected === 'pro'"
    label="Pro"
    @update:is-selected="(next) => { if (next) selected = 'pro' }"
  >
    Pro
  </SelectableCard>
</template>
```

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CardVariant } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Grid } from '@astryx-vue/core/Grid'
import { SelectableCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/SelectableCard'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const tags: Array<{ id: string, name: string, variant: CardVariant }> = [
  { id: 'react', name: 'React', variant: 'blue' },
  { id: 'typescript', name: 'TypeScript', variant: 'cyan' },
  { id: 'node', name: 'Node.js', variant: 'green' },
  { id: 'python', name: 'Python', variant: 'yellow' },
  { id: 'rust', name: 'Rust', variant: 'orange' },
  { id: 'go', name: 'Go', variant: 'teal' },
]

const selected = ref(new Set(['react', 'typescript']))

function toggle(id: string, next: boolean) {
  const copy = new Set(selected.value)
  if (next)
    copy.add(id)
  else
    copy.delete(id)
  selected.value = copy
}
</script>

<template>
  <Grid :columns="3" :gap="2" :width="400">
    <SelectableCard
      v-for="tag in tags"
      :key="tag.id"
      :is-selected="selected.has(tag.id)"
      :label="tag.name"
      :variant="tag.variant"
      @update:is-selected="toggle(tag.id, $event)"
    >
      <Text type="body" weight="bold">
        {{ tag.name }}
      </Text>
    </SelectableCard>
  </Grid>
</template>

summary.en: `CollapsibleGroup` coordinates the `Collapsible` sections inside it. Give each section a `value`. Inside the group, that section's own `isOpen` is ignored.
summary.zh: `CollapsibleGroup` 协调里面的 `Collapsible`。每一项都要有 `value`。进了组之后，单项自己的 `isOpen` 不再起作用。

usage.en:
`CollapsibleGroup` coordinates the `Collapsible` sections inside it. Give each section a `value`. Inside the group, that section's own `isOpen` is ignored.

`type="single"` keeps one section open. Opening another closes the previous one, and clicking the open section closes it. The value is a string, or `''` when everything is closed. `type="multiple"` toggles each section on its own, and the value is a list. `hasDividers` draws a hairline between sections. With dividers and no `density`, the padding is `balanced`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible'
</script>

<template>
  <CollapsibleGroup default-value="account" type="single">
    <Collapsible trigger="Account" value="account">
      Profile, email, and password.
    </Collapsible>
    <Collapsible trigger="Billing" value="billing">
      Invoices and payment method.
    </Collapsible>
  </CollapsibleGroup>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`CollapsibleGroup` 协调里面的 `Collapsible`。每一项都要有 `value`。进了组之后，单项自己的 `isOpen` 不再起作用。

`type="single"` 同时只展开一项。展开另一项会收起前一项，再点已展开的项会把它收起。值是字符串，全部收起时是 `''`。`type="multiple"` 每项各自开关，值是数组。`hasDividers` 在项与项之间画一条细线。开了分隔线又没写 `density` 时，内边距用 `balanced`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible'
</script>

<template>
  <CollapsibleGroup default-value="account" type="single">
    <Collapsible trigger="Account" value="account">
      Profile, email, and password.
    </Collapsible>
    <Collapsible trigger="Billing" value="billing">
      Invoices and payment method.
    </Collapsible>
  </CollapsibleGroup>
</template>
```

import type { CollapsibleGroupDensity } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible'

const densities: Array<{ value: CollapsibleGroupDensity, label: string }> = [
  { value: 'compact', label: 'compact' },
  { value: 'balanced', label: 'balanced — the default' },
  { value: 'spacious', label: 'spacious' },

const sections = [
