const code = `--- a/useUser.ts
+++ b/useUser.ts
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 export function useUser(id: string) {
-  const [user, setUser] = useState<User>()
+  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null)
   useEffect(() => {
-    fetchUser(id).then(setUser)

 }`

summary.en: `Timer` writes a running duration into a `<time>` element. `startTime` is unix milliseconds. Omit it and the count starts when this timer mounts. The text and `dateTime` are written on the element. The component does not re-render on every tick, and it does not use `aria-live`.
summary.zh: `Timer` 把一段正在增加的时长写进 `<time>`。`startTime` 是毫秒级 unix 时间。不传就从这次挂载开始计。文字和 `dateTime` 直接写在元素上。组件不会为每一次跳动重新渲染，也不使用 `aria-live`。

usage.en:
`Timer` writes a running duration into a `<time>` element. `startTime` is unix milliseconds. Omit it and the count starts when this timer mounts. The text and `dateTime` are written on the element. The component does not re-render on every tick, and it does not use `aria-live`.

`format="elapsed"` is the default. Under a minute it reads `Ns`. Under an hour it reads `Nm NNs`. At an hour and beyond it reads `Nh NNm` and drops seconds, both in the text and in `dateTime` (`PT{minutes * 60}S`). `format="clock"` stays on seconds: `m:ss`, or `h:mm:ss` past an hour, with `dateTime="PT{seconds}S"`.

The clock updates once a second until the elapsed format reaches an hour, then once a minute. If `startTime` is still in the future, the first change waits until one second after that start.

Typography matches `Timestamp`. `type` defaults to `supporting`, `color` to `secondary`. `type="inherit"` does not wrap the time in `Text`, so it takes the surrounding font. `color="disabled"` uses the disabled text color. `size` and `weight` override the type scale the same way they do on `Text`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Timer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timer'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body" color="primary">
    Processing for <Timer type="inherit" color="inherit" />
  </Text>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Timer` 把一段正在增加的时长写进 `<time>`。`startTime` 是毫秒级 unix 时间。不传就从这次挂载开始计。文字和 `dateTime` 直接写在元素上。组件不会为每一次跳动重新渲染，也不使用 `aria-live`。

默认 `format="elapsed"`。不到一分钟显示 `Ns`，不到一小时显示 `Nm NNs`，满一小时显示 `Nh NNm`，文字和 `dateTime` 都不再带秒（存成 `PT{分钟数 × 60}S`）。`format="clock"` 始终精确到秒：不到一小时是 `m:ss`，超过则是 `h:mm:ss`，`dateTime` 为 `PT{秒数}S`。

未满一小时时大约每秒更新一次，elapsed 满一小时后改为每分钟一次。如果 `startTime` 还在未来，第一次变化会等到开始后再过一秒。

排版和 `Timestamp` 同一套。`type` 默认 `supporting`，`color` 默认 `secondary`。`type="inherit"` 不用 `Text` 包一层，字体跟周围走。`color="disabled"` 用禁用文字色。`size` 和 `weight` 的覆盖方式和 `Text` 一样。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Timer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timer'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body" color="primary">
    Processing for <Timer type="inherit" color="inherit" />
  </Text>
</template>
```

en.text: Use `elapsed` next to a status word, and `clock` when the reader is watching seconds.
Pass the same `startTime` when two timers must agree.
Use `type="inherit"` inside a sentence so the duration matches the line.
Announce every tick. The time element updates in place and stays quiet.
Expect second precision from `elapsed` after one hour. That format switches to minutes on purpose.

summary.en: `Icon` draws one icon from an Iconify collection. Pass the name. You do not import an icon component for each glyph.
summary.zh: `Icon` 按名字画一个图标。名字来自 Iconify 的集合，不需要为每个图形单独 import 一个组件。

usage.en:
`Icon` draws one icon from an Iconify collection. Pass the name. You do not import an icon component for each glyph.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

The name is `collection:icon`, the same id Iconify uses. `carbon-settings` is accepted too, once the `carbon` collection is registered. A collection whose own name contains a hyphen, such as `material-symbols`, should keep the colon: `material-symbols:home`.

Nothing in `@astryx-vue/core` bundles those drawings. Install the collection you actually use, then let the Vite plugin pull in only the icons your source names:

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

`astryxIcons()` reads `@iconify-json/*` from the project's dependencies. A static `name="carbon:settings"` becomes a tiny module that registers that one icon. The rest of the Carbon set stays out of the bundle. Another set is the same step: install `@iconify-json/lucide` and write `name="lucide:settings"`. UnoCSS is not involved.

The plugin can only see names written in source. When the name is chosen at runtime, register the collection yourself. That ships the whole set:

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

addCollection(carbon)
```

Call `addCollection` before the icon renders, usually from the app entry. `addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` registers a single icon the same way.

Leave `size` off and the icon is `1em` square, painted with `currentColor`, so it follows the text around it. [Button](/en/components/button)'s `icon` and `end` slots, [IconButton](/en/components/icon-button), and a field's start and end slots already size that box. Put `Icon` in the slot and do not set `size` again.

```vue
<Button label="Settings">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>
```

A decorative icon is `aria-hidden`. Set `label` only when the icon is the only thing that carries the meaning, and the parent control does not already have a name.

`icon` still accepts a CSS class or your own component. Navigation `iconClass` is still a class. Those paths do not require UnoCSS either.
usage.zh:
`Icon` 按名字画一个图标。名字来自 Iconify 的集合，不需要为每个图形单独 import 一个组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

写法是 `集合:图标`，和 Iconify 的 id 相同。集合注册之后，`carbon-settings` 也指向 Carbon 的 settings。集合名本身带连字符时请保留冒号，例如 `material-symbols:home`，避免被拆错。

`@astryx-vue/core` 不打包这些图形。装你要用的集合，再用 Vite 插件只把源码里写到的图标打进去：

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

`astryxIcons()` 会读取项目依赖里的 `@iconify-json/*`。源码里的 `name="carbon:settings"` 会变成一个很小的模块，只注册这一枚图标，Carbon 的其余部分不会进包。再换一套也一样：安装 `@iconify-json/lucide`，然后写 `name="lucide:settings"`。不需要装 UnoCSS。

插件只能看到写在源码里的名字。名字要到运行时才拼出来时，自己注册整套集合，这一整套都会进包：

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

addCollection(carbon)
```

在图标渲染之前调用，一般放在应用入口。`addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` 用来注册单独的一枚。

不传 `size` 时，图标是 `1em` 见方，颜色用 `currentColor`，跟周围的文字走。[Button](/components/button) 的 `icon` 和 `end` 槽、[IconButton](/components/icon-button)，以及输入框开头和结尾的槽，盒子尺寸已经定好。把 `Icon` 放进去，不要再设 `size`。

```vue
<Button label="设置">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>
```

装饰性图标默认 `aria-hidden`。只有图标自己承载含义、旁边又没有文字时，才设置 `label`。父级按钮或链接已经有名字时不要再设。

`icon` 仍然可以收一个 CSS 类名，或你自己的组件。导航上的 `iconClass` 也还是类名。这些用法同样不要求 UnoCSS。

en.text: Use one collection inside a view. Mixing outline and filled drawings in the same row makes the row look unfinished.
Leave `size` unset inside a button or a field slot. The slot already decides the box, and `1em` fills it.
Set `label` when the icon stands alone and nothing next to it says what it means.
Install only the collections you reference. The plugin bundles the icons you name, not the whole set.
Import a component per icon. `name` is the API; the plugin does the lookup.
Set `label` on an icon inside a button or a link that already has a name. The name would be announced twice.
Rely on a name that is concatenated at runtime without `addCollection` or `addIcon`. The plugin never sees it, and the icon renders empty.

zh.text: 同一块界面里用同一套集合。线框和实心混在一行里，会显得没画完。
放进按钮或输入框的槽时不要再传 `size`。槽已经定好盒子，`1em` 会铺满它。
图标单独出现、旁边没有说明它是什么的文字时，设置 `label`。
只安装用到的集合。插件打包的是你写到的图标，不是整套。
每个图标 import 一个组件。对外的用法是 `name`，查找交给插件。
在已经有名字的按钮或链接里再给图标设 `label`。辅助技术会把名字读两遍。
运行时拼接名字，却不调用 `addCollection` 或 `addIcon`。插件看不到这个名字，图标会是空的。

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Iconify id, `collection:icon`. `carbon-settings` is the same as `carbon:settings` after the carbon collection is registered. Hyphenated collection names should keep the colon.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: A semantic name, a CSS icon class, or your own component. A semantic name resolves to an Iconify id from the nearest theme, and falls back to the built-in glyph until that icon is registered. Ignored when `name` is set.

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: Sets the color the icon's `currentColor` resolves to. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text color.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 12px, 16px, 20px, or 24px at a 16px root. When omitted, a `name` icon is `1em`. Any other icon falls back to `md` unless a parent provides a size.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for a meaningful icon. Sets `role="img"` and `aria-label`. Omit it for decoration (`aria-hidden="true"`). An empty string stays decorative.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Iconify 的 id，格式是 `集合:图标`。carbon 集合注册之后，`carbon-settings` 与 `carbon:settings` 相同。集合名里带连字符时请保留冒号。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 语义名、CSS 图标类，或你自己的组件。语义名由最近的主题换成 Iconify id；该图标尚未注册时用内置字形。设置了 `name` 时忽略它。

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: 决定图标里 `currentColor` 解析成哪种颜色。`inherit` 保持周围文字的颜色。

rows.name: `size`

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 有含义的图标的无障碍名称。会设置 `role="img"` 和 `aria-label`。装饰性图标省略它，保持 `aria-hidden="true"`。空字符串仍按装饰处理。

en.heading: Semantic names
en.text:
Inside the components, a name is the job, not a file in one collection. Search, close, check, and the downward chevron are that kind of name. Each one points at the Lucide icon that does the same job. Until that collection is registered, the built-in glyph stays, so the icon is not a blank box.

To change the set, point those names at Iconify ids on the theme. A theme that extends another one only lists the names it changes. A direct icon still uses `name`, and that wins over a semantic name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
</script>

<template>
  <Theme
    :theme="defineTheme({
      name: 'withCarbon',
      icons: { search: 'carbon:search', close: 'carbon:close' },
    })"
  >
    <slot />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

The full list is on the props page. Read the current id with `useSemanticIcon`, exported from the same entry as `Icon`.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- With no `label`, the root is `aria-hidden="true"`. The SVG is hidden as well.
- A non-empty `label` sets `role="img"` and `aria-label`, and removes `aria-hidden`. Use it for a status glyph that has no adjacent text.
- An empty `label` stays decorative.
- Do not set `label` when a parent button or link already names the control.
- The drawing uses `currentColor`. A color that is only a hex on the element will not follow the theme; use the `color` prop.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - Default: SVG written inline, used when neither name nor icon is set.

en.heading: Registration
en.text:
- `astryxIcons()`: `@astryx-vue/core/icons`
- `addIcon(name, data)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`
- `addCollection(collection)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`

en.heading: Semantic names
en.text:
`defineTheme({ icons })` overrides by name. Entries merge shallowly with the theme this one extends, and this theme wins. A name that is not listed keeps the default id. The collection has to be registered, or the built-in glyph stays.

These are the **shared names**. Every component draws from the same set. The `IconRegistry` type describes a complete registry that draws every shared name, and `upload` is required like the rest. A theme that supplies a whole icon set must give `upload` its own upload drawing instead of reusing `arrowUp`. Redrawing `upload` leaves the `arrowUp` used by sortable tables and the send button alone.

An icon that only one component draws does not become a shared name. It gets a namespaced key, `component:role`, typed as `NamespacedIconName`. There is one today:

A theme overrides it through the same `icons` map: `defineTheme({ icons: { 'numberInput:stepperDown': 'carbon:chevron-down' } })`. Without an override the built-in glyph is drawn. Adding a namespaced key never adds a required entry to `IconRegistry`.

`useSemanticIcon(name)` comes from `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` and from the package root. An unknown string with no theme entry returns empty, so the caller can still treat it as a CSS class.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
Color follows the icon tokens. A theme replaces one by setting the variable on the theme root.

```css
.my-theme {
  --astryx-icon-accent-foreground: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-icon-accent-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-success-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-error-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-warning-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-blue-foreground`, and the same pattern for cyan, green, gray, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, and yellow.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The root is a `<span>`. Without `label` it is `aria-hidden="true"`. With a non-empty `label` it is `role="img"` and that string is the accessible name. The SVG inside is always `aria-hidden`.

`class` and `style` fall through to the root. `name` does not: it selects the icon.

zh.heading: 语义名
zh.text:
组件内部说的是用途，不是某一套图形的文件名。搜索、关闭、勾选、向下的箭头，都是这种名字。默认指向 Lucide 里做同一件事的图标。那一套还没注册时，页面上仍是内置字形，不会空出一块。

换一整套时，在主题里把语义名指到 Iconify 的 id。子主题只写要改的名字，其余沿用上一层。直接指定某一枚图标仍然用 `name`，它优先于语义名。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
</script>

<template>
  <Theme
    :theme="defineTheme({
      name: 'withCarbon',
      icons: { search: 'carbon:search', close: 'carbon:close' },
    })"
  >
    <slot />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

完整名单在属性页。读取当前 id 用 `useSemanticIcon`，它和 `Icon` 从同一个入口导出。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 不传 `label` 时，根元素是 `aria-hidden="true"`，里面的 SVG 也隐藏。
- `label` 非空时，根元素变为 `role="img"` 并带上 `aria-label`，同时去掉 `aria-hidden`。没有相邻文字的状态图标才需要它。
- 空字符串的 `label` 仍按装饰处理。
- 父级按钮或链接已经有名字时，不要再设 `label`。
- 图形使用 `currentColor`。只在元素上写死一个十六进制颜色，不会跟着主题走；要换色就用 `color`。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - 默认插槽：内联 SVG。在既没有 name 也没有 icon 时使用。

zh.heading: 注册
zh.text:
- `astryxIcons()`: `@astryx-vue/core/icons`
- `addIcon(name, data)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`
- `addCollection(collection)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`

zh.heading: 语义名
zh.text:
`defineTheme({ icons })` 按名字覆盖。和被扩展的主题浅合并，当前这份优先。没写到的名字保持默认 id。集合要已经注册，否则仍画内置字形。

表里这些是**共享名字**，所有组件共用一套。`IconRegistry` 类型表示「每个共享名字都画了」的完整注册表，`upload` 也在必填之列。自己写一整套主题图标时，要给 `upload` 单独配一个上传图形，不能拿 `arrowUp` 顶替。换 `upload` 不会影响表格排序箭头或发送按钮用的 `arrowUp`。

只有某一个组件自己用的图标，不进共享名字，而是用带命名空间的键，写成 `组件:用途`，类型是 `NamespacedIconName`。现在有一个：

主题用同一个 `icons` 覆盖它：`defineTheme({ icons: { 'numberInput:stepperDown': 'carbon:chevron-down' } })`。不覆盖时用内置字形。加新的命名空间键不会让 `IconRegistry` 多出必填项。

`useSemanticIcon(name)` 从 `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` 引入，也从包根导出。未知字符串、主题也没有覆盖时，返回空，调用方可以继续把它当 CSS 类。

zh.text:
颜色走图标令牌。主题在根上覆盖对应变量即可。

```css

  --astryx-icon-accent-foreground: #0074e2;

en.heading: Overview
en.text: `@astryx-vue/charts` uses d3 to calculate scales and geometry, then renders SVG with Vue. Each chart contains a `<Chart>` canvas and one or more series, such as lines, bars, or areas.

en.heading: Install
en.text:
```bash
pnpm add @astryx-vue/charts
```

`@astryx-vue/charts` depends on `@astryx-vue/core` and `vue`. Make sure both are installed in your project.

The library includes base styles. Import the full stylesheet in your entry file:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/charts/charts.css'
```

To load styles on demand, import individual files from `@astryx-vue/charts/styles/`, such as `chart.css`, `chart-axis.css`, `chart-grid.css`, `chart-legend.css`, `chart-tooltip.css`, or `chart-swatch.css`.

en.heading: Your first chart
en.text:
A minimal chart requires three props on `<Chart>`:
- `data`: An array of objects where each item represents one row of data.
- `xKey`: The field name in each row to use for the horizontal x-axis.
- `series`: An array of series definitions created with functions such as `line()` or `bar()`.

Here is the shortest working line chart:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Chart, ChartAxis, ChartGrid, line } from '@astryx-vue/charts'

// 1. Prepare data
const data = [
  { month: 'Jan', revenue: 100, cost: 60 },
  { month: 'Feb', revenue: 150, cost: 80 },
  { month: 'Mar', revenue: 120, cost: 70 },
]

// 2. Define series: two lines reading revenue and cost
const series = [
  line('revenue', { label: 'Revenue' }),
  line('cost', { label: 'Cost' }),
]
</script>

<template>
  <Chart :data="data" x-key="month" :series="series" :height="260" legend tooltip>
    <template #grid>
      <ChartGrid />
    </template>
    <template #axes>
      <ChartAxis position="bottom" />
      <ChartAxis position="left" />
    </template>
  </Chart>
</template>
```

Here is the live result:

en.heading: Series
en.text:
A series defines a visual representation of data on the chart. A series object holds internal state during layout and rendering. Because of this, provide each series object to one `<Chart>` only. Create fresh series definitions for each chart instance.

When data has missing values (`null`, `undefined`) or non-finite numbers (`NaN`, `Infinity`), line marks break cleanly and leave an empty gap. They never drop to zero or draw false connections across gaps.

When `yDomain` is omitted, `yBaseline` controls how the y-axis range is calculated:
- `'auto'` (default): Marks with a zero baseline (bars, areas) include 0 in the scale. Continuous point marks (lines, dots) keep small padding on both ends so points do not clip at the edges.
- `'zero'`': Expands the scale symmetrically around 0. Useful for values that swing positive and negative, such as profit and loss.
- `'data'`: Clamps tightly to the minimum and maximum data values without forcing 0 or adding edge padding.

en.heading: Line (`line`)
en.text:
A line series shows continuous trends over time or across categories.

```ts
declare function line(dataKey: string, options?: LineOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Bar (`bar`)
en.text:
A bar series compares magnitudes across categories or time steps. Bars with the same `group` split the category bandwidth and sit side by side. Bars with the same `stack` stack on top of each other.

```ts
declare function bar(dataKey: string, options?: BarOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Area (`area`)
en.text:
An area series fills the region below a line. It is useful for showing total volume and changing proportions over time. Giving multiple area series the same `stack` name stacks them in order.

```ts
declare function area(dataKey: string, options?: AreaOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Dot (`dot`)
en.text:
A dot series shows the distribution of discrete data points.

```ts
declare function dot(dataKey: string, options?: DotOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Band (`band`)
en.text:
A band series fills a translucent area between an upper and a lower boundary field. It is often used to show forecast confidence intervals. Band marks are annotations, so they do not appear in legends or tooltips.

```ts
declare function band(options: BandOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Reference line (`referenceLine`)
en.text:
A reference line marks a specific horizontal or vertical threshold on the chart, or fills a shaded region between two horizontal values. Reference lines are annotations, so they do not appear in legends or tooltips.

```ts
declare function referenceLine(options: ReferenceLineOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Error bar (`errorBar`)
en.text:
An error bar (whisker) displays value uncertainty. It is usually paired with `bar()` or `dot()`. Boundary fields use absolute values, allowing asymmetric error intervals. If a row lacks an upper or lower bound, the chart skips that point instead of drawing misleading lines to zero. Error bars are annotations, so they do not appear in legends or tooltips.

```ts
declare function errorBar(options: ErrorBarOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Candlestick (`candlestick`)
en.text:
A candlestick series displays open, high, low, and close prices over time, commonly used in financial charts.

```ts
declare function candlestick(options: CandlestickOptions): SeriesDef
```

en.heading: Axes, grid, legend, tooltip
en.text: Supporting chart elements are provided as individual components. You can combine and configure them independently. Setting `legend` or `tooltip` to `true` on `<Chart>` enables their defaults. Pass an object to customize position and layout.

en.heading: Axes (`ChartAxis`)
en.text: Axes render along chart edges to display ticks and label text.

en.heading: Grid (`ChartGrid`)
en.text: Grid lines render behind series elements to help align values visually.

en.heading: Legend (`ChartLegend`)
en.text: A legend lists series names alongside their representative colors. Setting `legend` on `<Chart>` shows the legend (off by default), or use the `<ChartLegend>` component directly.

en.heading: Tooltip (`ChartTooltip`)
en.text: A tooltip displays details for the data row under the pointer.

en.heading: Swatch (`ChartSwatch`)
en.text: A swatch renders a small color marker representing a series, useful inside legends or custom tooltips.

en.heading: Custom tooltip content
en.text: When the default tooltip layout is not enough, customize the card content through the `#tooltip` slot on ``. The slot exposes the active `xValue` and row details in `rows`: ```vue ```

en.heading: Colors
en.text:
When a series does not set an explicit color, the chart assigns one automatically in order from the active theme palette.

All chart colors use CSS variables underneath. When switching themes or toggling dark mode, chart colors update automatically without re-rendering the SVG tree.

To inspect or use the current chart palette programmatically, call `useChartColors()`. It returns a shared object across the package:

- `categorical(n: number)`: Returns an array of `n` categorical colors. If `n` exceeds palette size, colors cycle.
- `sequential`: Sequential color scale helper supporting nine hues (`blue`, `shamrock`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `red`, `teal`, `yellow`, `gray`). Passing a count `n` returns a gradient color array.
- `diverging`: Two-pole diverging palette helper. Provides `positiveNegative`, `coldHot`, and `custom` (custom hues on each pole).
- `semantic`: Semantic status colors, containing `positive`, `negative`, `warning`, and `neutral`.
- `structural`: Structural colors for chart framing, containing `axis`, `grid`, `tick`, and `label`.
- `alpha(color: string, opacity: number)`: Generates a color with an alpha channel for a given opacity. CSS variables use `color-mix()` automatically.

en.heading: Formatting functions
en.text:
The library includes formatting helpers for common chart values. Formatting functions follow a safe fallback rule: if an input is `NaN`, `Infinity`, or cannot be parsed, the function returns the original string as-is instead of printing errors or throwing exceptions.

- `compactNumber(value, locale)`: Abbreviates large numbers. For example, `1200` becomes "1.2K", `1500000` becomes "1.5M", and `1e12` becomes "1T".
- `currency(symbol?, locale?)`: Creates a currency formatter. For example, `currency('$')` can be passed to `ChartAxis`'s `tickFormat`. Values over 1,000 are automatically abbreviated (such as "$1.5K").
- `percent(value, locale)`: Formats a decimal ratio as a percentage. For example, `0.45` becomes "45%" and `0.005` becomes "0.5%".
- `shortDate(value, locale)`: Formats dates as a short month and day. For example, "Jan 5".
- `monthYear(value, locale)`: Formats dates as month and year. For example, "Jan 2024".
- `formatList(values, locale)`: Formats a list of words into a natural language string according to locale rules, such as "A, B, and C".

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
Charts include built-in accessibility features so screen reader users can understand chart content:

- The root element has a `role="img"` attribute.
- The chart's accessible name prioritizes the `title` prop. When `title` is omitted, the component builds a semantic description from primary series and the x-axis field (such as "Monthly Revenue and Cost trend"). If only annotations are present, it falls back to "Chart".
- The `subtitle` prop maps to the chart's accessible description.
- When total data points (data rows × data columns) do not exceed 100 (`MAX_TABLE_POINTS`), the chart generates a visually hidden data table using `VisuallyHidden`. Screen readers can read exact values row by row. Above 100 points, the table is omitted to prevent excessive speech noise.

en.heading: Server-side rendering
en.text:
During server-side rendering (SSR), no browser DOM exists, so the component cannot measure parent container width in pixels.

When rendering on the server, pass an explicit `width` prop on `<Chart>`. This allows the server to compute scales and render complete SVG paths and rectangles into HTML. After client-side hydration, once the browser measures the real container width, the chart takes over and responds to container resize events.

en.heading: Not supported yet
en.text:
To stay lightweight and focused, the package currently leaves out:
- Four WebGL-based series marks for very large datasets (such as `dotGL`) are not yet included.
- The Nuxt module does not yet include auto-import switches for `@astryx-vue/charts`. Import components manually when using Nuxt.

en.heading: `<Chart>` props and slots
en.text: `<Chart>` is the root container. It measures container dimensions, builds coordinate scales, calculates geometry positions, and renders the SVG tree.

zh.heading: 概述
zh.text: `@astryx-vue/charts` 使用 d3 计算比例尺和图形路径，再由 Vue 渲染 SVG。每个图表由一个 `<Chart>` 画布和一个或多个系列组成；系列可以是折线、柱状、面积或其他数据标记。

zh.heading: 安装
zh.text:
```bash
pnpm add @astryx-vue/charts
```

`@astryx-vue/charts` 依赖同级的 `@astryx-vue/core` 和 `vue`，请确保项目中已经安装了它们。

图表内置了基础样式。你可以在入口文件引入完整样式文件：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/charts/charts.css'
```

如果你想按需加载样式，也可以只引入 `@astryx-vue/charts/styles/` 目录下的某一个样式文件（例如 `chart.css`、`chart-axis.css`、`chart-grid.css`、`chart-legend.css`、`chart-tooltip.css` 或 `chart-swatch.css`）。

zh.heading: 第一张图
zh.text:
画一张图最少需要给 `<Chart>` 传三个必填属性：
- `data`：要展示的数据数组，每一项是一行对象。
- `xKey`：指定每行对象中哪个字段当作横坐标（x 轴）。
- `series`：标记系列数组，用 `line()`、`bar()` 等函数生成。

下面是一段最短的可运行折线图代码：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Chart, ChartAxis, ChartGrid, line } from '@astryx-vue/charts'

// 1. 准备数据
const data = [
  { month: '1月', revenue: 100, cost: 60 },
  { month: '2月', revenue: 150, cost: 80 },
  { month: '3月', revenue: 120, cost: 70 },
]

// 2. 定义系列：画两条线，一条读 revenue，一条读 cost
const series = [
  line('revenue', { label: '收入' }),
  line('cost', { label: '成本' }),
]
</script>

<template>
  <Chart :data="data" x-key="month" :series="series" :height="260" legend tooltip>
    <template #grid>
      <ChartGrid />
    </template>
    <template #axes>
      <ChartAxis position="bottom" />
      <ChartAxis position="left" />
    </template>
  </Chart>
</template>
```

zh.heading: 系列
zh.text:
系列代表图表上展示的具体数据图形。同一个系列对象在布局和渲染时会被写入内部状态，所以同一个系列对象只能提供给一个 `<Chart>` 使用，每张图都要重新创建一份。

如果数据中存在缺失值（`null`、`undefined`）或非有限数字（`NaN`、`Infinity`），折线会自然断开形成空洞，不会强行掉到 0 基线上画出一条错误虚假的连线。

在不设置显式 `yDomain` 时，y 轴的范围由 `yBaseline` 决定：
- `'auto'`（默认）：带零基线的标记（柱状图、面积图）会把 0 算进坐标范围；只有离散连续点的图表（折线图、散点图等）会在上下两侧保留一点余量，防止数据点贴在画布边缘。
- `'zero'`：以 0 为中心对称展开坐标轴，适合展示正负波动数据（比如盈利与亏损）。
- `'data'`：紧贴实际数据的最大值与最小值，不强制包含 0，也不留任何边缘余量。

zh.heading: 折线（line）
zh.text:
折线用于展示数据随时间或类目的连续变化趋势。

```ts
declare function line(dataKey: string, options?: LineOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 柱状（bar）
zh.text:
柱状图用于对比不同分类或时间点下的数值大小。相同 `group` 的柱子会把带宽平分并排展示；相同 `stack` 的柱子会一层层堆叠起来展示。

```ts
declare function bar(dataKey: string, options?: BarOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 面积（area）
zh.text:
面积图在折线下方填充颜色，非常适合表现总量以及各部分占比的变化。如果给多个面积系列指定相同的 `stack` 名字，它们会逐层叠起来。

```ts
declare function area(dataKey: string, options?: AreaOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 散点（dot）
zh.text:
散点图用于展示离散数据点的分布情况。

```ts
declare function dot(dataKey: string, options?: DotOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 区间带（band）
zh.text:
区间带用于在上下两个边界字段之间涂满一层半透明的带状区域，通常用来展示预测区间的波动范围。它属于辅助标注标记，不会出现在图例和悬停提示框中。

```ts
declare function band(options: BandOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 参考线（referenceLine）
zh.text:
参考线可以在图表指定的数值位置画一条横线、竖线，或者在两条横线之间涂上一段浅色参考带，常用于标记阈值或目标值。它属于辅助标注标记，不进入图例和提示框。

```ts
declare function referenceLine(options: ReferenceLineOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 误差条（errorBar）
zh.text:
误差条（须线）用于展示数值的不确定性范围。它通常配合 `bar()` 或 `dot()` 一起使用。需要注意的是，误差条传入的上下界字段是绝对数值，因此即使上下误差不对称也可以正确绘制。如果某一行缺失了上界或下界，则会直接跳过该点，绝不绘制误导人的零刻度须线。它属于辅助标注标记，不进入图例和提示框。

```ts
declare function errorBar(options: ErrorBarOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 蜡烛图（candlestick）
zh.text:
蜡烛图（K 线图）用于金融等场景，展示一段时间内的开盘、最高、最低和收盘价。

```ts
declare function candlestick(options: CandlestickOptions): SeriesDef
```

zh.heading: 坐标轴、网格、图例、提示框
zh.text: 图表的辅助元素均以独立组件的形式提供，你可以自由组合和调整。在 `<Chart>` 上直接给 `legend` 或 `tooltip` 传 `true` 即可启用默认样式，也可以传配置对象调整位置。

zh.heading: 坐标轴（ChartAxis）
zh.text: 坐标轴绘制在图表四周，负责标注刻度与文字。

zh.heading: 网格（ChartGrid）
zh.text: 网格线绘制在数据图形底层，帮助读者对齐数值。

zh.heading: 图例（ChartLegend）
zh.text: 图例列出各个系列的名称与代表色。在 `<Chart>` 上写 `legend` 就会显示（默认不显示），也可以单独使用 `<ChartLegend>` 组件。

zh.heading: 提示框（ChartTooltip）
zh.text: 鼠标悬停在图表上时，提示框会展示当前位置对应的数据明细。

zh.heading: 颜色色块（ChartSwatch）
zh.text: 用于在图例或自定义提示框中绘制一小块系列代表色标。

zh.heading: 自定义提示框内容
zh.text: 如果内置提示框的样式无法满足要求，可以通过 `` 的 `#tooltip` 插槽自定义浮层内容。插槽向外暴露当前悬停的横坐标值 `xValue` 和各系列的数据明细 `rows`： ```vue ```

zh.heading: 颜色
zh.text:
如果创建系列时没有显式指定颜色，图表会根据主题里的分类色板，按顺序自动给每个系列分配颜色。

所有的图表颜色底层都是基于 CSS 变量实现的。这意味着当页面切换主题风格，或者从浅色模式切换到深色模式时，图表上的颜色会自动跟随环境刷新，不需要重新渲染整张图表。

如果你需要手动获取当前图表体系的配色方案，可以调用 `useChartColors()` 组合式函数。它返回的对象在整个包中全局共享且保持不变，其包含的成员如下：

- `categorical(n: number)`：获取包含指定数量的分类色数组。数量超出槽位时会自动循环。
- `sequential`：顺序色阶对象，支持 9 种色相（`blue`、`shamrock`、`orange`、`pink`、`purple`、`red`、`teal`、`yellow`、`gray`）。传入数量 `n` 即可返回渐变过渡色数组。
- `diverging`：双极发散配色。提供 `positiveNegative`（正负分明）、`coldHot`（冷暖分明）以及 `custom`（自定义两侧色相）方法。
- `semantic`：语义单色值对象，包含 `positive`、`negative`、`warning` 和 `neutral` 四种标准状态色。
- `structural`：图表骨架的结构色，包含 `axis`（坐标轴线）、`grid`（网格线）、`tick`（刻度短线）和 `label`（文本标签）四种颜色。
- `alpha(color: string, opacity: number)`：按指定透明度生成带透明通道的颜色值（若为 CSS 变量则自动采用 `color-mix()` 处理）。

zh.heading: 格式化函数
zh.text:
图表库内置了一组常用的格式化函数。所有格式化函数都遵循安全原则：如果遇到 `NaN`、`Infinity` 或无法解析的值，会原样返回原字符串，绝对不会在界面上打印出异常信息，也不会报错崩溃。

- `compactNumber(value, locale)`：将大数字缩写。例如 `1200` 转为「1.2K」，`1500000` 转为「1.5M」，`1e12` 转为「1T」。
- `currency(symbol?, locale?)`：创建货币格式化器。例如 `currency('¥')` 可以直接传给 `ChartAxis` 的 `tickFormat` 属性，数值大于一千时会自动应用缩写（如「¥1.5K」）。
- `percent(value, locale)`：将小数比例转换为百分比。例如 `0.45` 转换为「45%」，`0.005` 转换为「0.5%」。
- `shortDate(value, locale)`：将日期格式化为简短的月日。例如「Jan 5」或「3月12日」。
- `monthYear(value, locale)`：将日期格式化为年月。例如「Jan 2024」或「2025年3月」。
- `formatList(values, locale)`：按指定语言的语法规则把多个词汇拼接为自然语言列表，例如将数组拼成「甲、乙和丙」。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
图表在可访问性方面做了完善的无障碍设计，让视障人士通过读屏软件也能了解图表内容：

- 整个图表根元素具有 `role="img"` 角色属性。
- 图表的无障碍名称优先使用传入的 `title` 属性；如果没有提供 `title`，系统会根据包含的主要系列与 x 轴字段自动拼接出清晰的语义名称（如「月度 收入和成本 走势」）；如果全是辅助标注线，则默认退化为「图表」。
- 传入的 `subtitle` 会自动关联为图表的无障碍长描述。
- 当数据点总数（数据行数 × 数据列数）不超过 100 个（即常量 `MAX_TABLE_POINTS`）时，图表会自动生成一份在视觉上完全隐藏的数据表格（通过 `VisuallyHidden` 隐藏在屏幕外）。读屏软件能够直接逐行朗读表格中的精准数据；如果数据量超过 100 点，则不会生成表格以避免造成大量无效的语音噪音。

zh.heading: 服务端渲染
zh.text:
在服务端渲染（SSR）环境中运行时，由于不存在真实的浏览器 DOM，组件无法自动测量父级容器的实际像素宽度。

因此，在服务端渲染时，必须在 `<Chart>` 上显式传入 `width` 属性指定宽度像素值，服务端才能正确完成比例尺计算并完整输出包含路径和矩形的 SVG 标签。在浏览器端水合后，图表一旦首次测量到真实的容器宽度，便会自动接管并按真实容器尺寸响应式排版。

zh.heading: 现在不支持的
zh.text:
为了保持包的轻量和聚焦，目前以下能力暂未包含在当前包中：
- 4 个基于 WebGL 的超大数据集标记（例如 `dotGL` 等标记）尚未收录于此包中。
- Nuxt 模块中尚未提供针对 `@astryx-vue/charts` 的自动引入配置开关，在 Nuxt 项目中使用时需手动通过 npm 依赖导入。

summary.en: Every status badge steals attention. Only badge states where the user needs to notice or act: errors, warnings, items requiring follow-up. If no action is needed, plain text is fine.
summary.zh: `Badge`（徽标）是一块小小的只读标记，用来告诉用户某项内容的状态或所属分类，例如「已完成」、「待审核」或团队名称等。它很适合放在列表、卡片和表格行里，方便大家一眼扫过去就看清概况。

usage.en:
Import the component from its dedicated entry. The component loads its structural styles.

Import the theme in your application entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

Component usage:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
</script>

<template>
  <Badge variant="success">
    Completed
  </Badge>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Badge`（徽标）是一块小小的只读标记，用来告诉用户某项内容的状态或所属分类，例如「已完成」、「待审核」或团队名称等。它很适合放在列表、卡片和表格行里，方便大家一眼扫过去就看清概况。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
</script>

<template>
  <Badge variant="success">
    已完成
  </Badge>
</template>
```

**什么时候用：**
- 需要用颜色和简短词语突出展示某个条目的状态（如成功、警告、失败）或类别时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 徽标是纯展示用的，不能点击也不能关闭。如果需要一个可以点击、勾选或带删除叉号的标签，请改用 [Token](/components/token)。
- 如果只需要展示普通文字描述、日期或数量，请直接使用普通的排版文本（如 `Text` 组件），不要给每条普通信息都套上徽标。

样式主题只需在整个应用的主入口（如 `main.ts`）引入一次：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

en.text: Every status badge steals attention. Only badge states where the user needs to notice or act: errors, warnings, items requiring follow-up. If no action is needed, plain text is fine.
Use success, warning, and error variants only for system status that demands attention: "Failed", "Degraded", "Action Required". These have bold solid backgrounds designed to stand out.
Use color variants (blue, purple, teal, etc.) for category tags that group or classify items: team names, content types, priority levels.
Keep labels to one or two words. If you need more detail, put it in surrounding text instead of the badge.
Add an icon when it helps identify the badge type quickly, but always include a text label alongside it.

Apply a "success" badge to every healthy/active/normal item. If all rows show green "Active" badges, none stand out; the badge adds noise, not information. Show only the states that need user attention (errors, warnings, pending actions).
Use badges for metadata. Durations ("6h window"), counts ("12 trigger types"), dates, and descriptions are not statuses or categories; use description text (Text with type="supporting") instead.
Use semantic status variants (success, warning, error, info) for categories or informational content. These are visually loud and should only indicate system state.

Repeat the same badge in every row of a table or list. If the same value appears in most rows, it's not adding information; use plain text for common states and reserve badges for the exceptional ones.
Make badges clickable; they are read-only indicators. Use a button or link if the user needs to take action.

zh.text: 每个状态徽标都会抢占注意力。只为用户需要注意或处理的状态使用徽标：错误、警告和待跟进的项目。无需处理时，普通文本即可。
仅对需要关注的系统状态使用 success、warning 和 error 变体，例如 “Failed”、“Degraded”、“Action Required”。这些变体使用醒目的实底背景。
对用于分组或分类的徽标，使用颜色变体（蓝色、紫色、青色等）。例如团队名称、内容类型、优先级。
徽标文字保持一到两个词。需要更多说明时，把说明放在徽标外的文字中。
图标有助于快速识别徽标类型时，添加图标。图标旁必须保留文字。
为每个健康、活跃或正常的项目都使用 success 徽标。若每行都是绿色的 “Active”，徽标就无法突出。徽标只显示需要用户关注的状态，如错误、警告和待处理操作。
用徽标展示元数据。时长（“6h window”）、数量（“12 trigger types”）、日期和描述都不是状态或分类。应改用描述文本（Text 组件，type="supporting"）。
用 success、warning、error、info 等语义状态变体表示分类或说明性内容。这些变体视觉强烈，只用于表示系统状态。
在表格或列表的每一行都重复同一个徽标。若多数行都有相同的值，徽标就不再传递信息。常见状态使用普通文本，徽标只留给例外情况。
让徽标可点击。徽标是只读指示器。用户需要操作时，使用按钮或链接。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Sets the visual variant of the badge. Optional: neutral, info, success, warning, error, blue, cyan, green, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, yellow.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 徽标的视觉变体。语义变体：neutral、info、success、warning、error；分类颜色：blue、cyan、green、orange、pink、purple、red、teal、yellow。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Text content displayed by the badge.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Optional leading icon. An icon should not replace the text label.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 徽标的文字内容。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 可选的前置图标。不得用图标代替文字。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is `<span>`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

`Badge` is a read-only indicator. Do not add interactive behavior.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<span>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

`Badge` 是只读指示器。不得为徽标添加交互行为。

description.en: Blue, cyan, green, and the other category colors group teams or topics. They do not report system status.
description.zh: 用蓝、青、绿这类分类色区分团队或主题。这些颜色不表示系统状态。

description.en: A short number for unread messages or open tasks. Values past 99 can read 99+.
description.zh: 徽标里放一个短数字，用在未读消息或待办数量旁边。超过 99 可以写成 99+。

description.en: Success, warning, and error mark a state that needs attention. Neutral and info mark where something sits in a workflow.
description.zh: 用 success、warning、error 标出需要处理的状态，用 neutral 和 info 标出流程位置。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="6">
    <VStack :gap="2">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        System status
      </Text>
      <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
        <Badge variant="success">
          Active
        </Badge>
        <Badge variant="warning">
          Pending
        </Badge>
        <Badge variant="error">
          Failed
        </Badge>
      </HStack>
    </VStack>
    <VStack :gap="2">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Workflow
      </Text>
      <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
        <Badge variant="neutral">
          Draft
        </Badge>
        <Badge variant="info">
          In Review
        </Badge>
      </HStack>
    </VStack>
  </VStack>
</template>

en.description: An optional leading icon that helps identify the badge type at a glance.

en.name: Label
en.description: The text or number shown inside the badge.

zh.name: 图标
zh.description: 可选的前导图标，让人一眼看出徽章类型。

summary.zh: `Banner` 用于持续展示需要用户关注或处理的消息，例如功能更新、操作结果或需要解决的问题。与会自动消失的 Toast 不同，它会一直留在界面上，直到用户处理或主动关闭：

usage.en:
Use `Banner` for persistent messages that require attention or action.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Banner } from '@astryx-vue/core/Banner'
</script>

<template>
  <Banner
    status="success"
    title="Changes saved"
    description="Your settings are up to date."
    is-dismissable
  />
</template>
```

Import the theme once in the application entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```
usage.zh:
`Banner` 用于持续展示需要用户关注或处理的消息，例如功能更新、操作结果或需要解决的问题。与会自动消失的 Toast 不同，它会一直留在界面上，直到用户处理或主动关闭：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Banner } from '@astryx-vue/core/Banner'
</script>

<template>
  <Banner
    status="success"
    title="Changes saved"
    description="Your settings are up to date."
    is-dismissable
  />
</template>
```

主题在应用入口引入一次：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

en.text: Pick a status that matches the message: info for updates, warning for caution, error for problems, success for confirmations.
Use the card container inside page content and the section container for full-width messages that span the entire page.
Make info and success banners dismissable. Keep error banners visible until the user fixes the issue.
Keep titles short and scannable: "Payment failed" not "There was a problem processing your most recent payment."
Use Banner for short-lived messages that disappear on their own; use Toast instead.
Stack multiple banners with the same status; combine related messages into one banner.

zh.text: 选择与消息相符的状态：更新用 info，注意事项用 warning，问题用 error，确认用 success。
页面内容中使用 card 容器。覆盖整页宽度的消息使用 section 容器。
info 和 success 提示条可以关闭。error 提示条必须保留，直到用户解决问题。
标题保持简短、便于扫读。例如用 “Payment failed”，不用 “There was a problem processing your most recent payment.”
用提示条展示会自动消失的短暂消息。应改用 Toast。

en.heading: Usage guidance
en.text:
The `status` prop sets the tone of a banner, and picking the wrong one makes readers misjudge how urgent the message is. The list below covers which status fits which kind of message, plus two usages that are easy to overlook.

- Use `info` for general information and updates.
- Use `success` for the result of a successful action.
- Use `warning` for situations that call for caution.
- Use `error` for problems that block progress.
- Set `:collapsible="false"` for details that users must read, so those details stay visible and no click is needed to open them. Keep the default toggle when the detail is long enough to bury the banner's own message.
- Announce an async outcome from the transition that produced it, with `useAnnounce`.

`status` controls color and icon only. It does not create a live region. Add `role="status"` only when the visible banner should stay a persistent semantic mirror, and reserve `role="alert"` for genuinely urgent content that should interrupt current speech. Content already on the page at first render is not guaranteed to be announced again.

For a single field validation message, use [FieldStatus](/en/components/field-status).

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- Default: details below the header.
- `title`: replaces the visible title. The `title` prop remains required.
- `description`: replaces the supporting text.
- `icon`: replaces the decorative status icon.
- `end`: action buttons at the end of the header.

Title, description and detail slots accept block content.

en.heading: Expanding and collapsing
en.text:
- Detail content enables the expand button. - Details start collapsed by default. - `defaultIsOpen` sets the initial state only. - `v-model:isOpen` controls the current state. - `collapsible` set to `false` keeps details visible. - Collapsing unmounts the details. - If a parent closes focused details, focus returns to the expand button. ```vue

Review the updated settings before continuing.

 ```

en.heading: Dismissal
en.text:
- `isDismissable` shows a dismiss button.
- Clicking it hides the component.
- The component emits `dismiss`.
- Dismissal tries to restore focus to the element used before entering the banner.
- Remount the component or change its `key` to show it again.

en.heading: Events and template references
en.text:
- `update:isOpen(value)`: requests an expansion change.
- `dismiss()`: dismisses the banner.
- `element`: the root `HTMLDivElement | null`. It becomes `null` after dismissal.

en.heading: Localization
en.text:
Provide translated control labels:

- `dismissLabel`: dismiss button.
- `expandLabel`: expand button.
- `collapseLabel`: collapse button.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
```css
.my-banner {
  --astryx-banner-info-background: #ecfdf5;
  --astryx-banner-info-foreground: #065f46;
}
```

- `--astryx-banner-info-background`: information background.
- `--astryx-banner-info-foreground`: information text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-success-background`: success background.
- `--astryx-banner-success-foreground`: success text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-warning-background`: warning background.
- `--astryx-banner-warning-foreground`: warning text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-error-background`: error background.
- `--astryx-banner-error-foreground`: error text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-content-background`: detail background.
- `--astryx-banner-border`: detail border.
- `--astryx-radius-container`: card corner radius.

Neutral follows the active light or dark mode.

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
提示条的语气由 `status` 决定，选错状态会让用户误判消息的紧迫程度。下面按消息的性质说明该选哪个状态，以及两个容易忽略的用法。

- 一般的信息和更新使用 `info`。
- 操作成功的结果使用 `success`。
- 需要提醒用户注意的情况使用 `warning`。
- 阻止用户继续操作的问题使用 `error`。
- 用户必须读到的详情传入 `:collapsible="false"`，这样详情会始终显示，不需要再点开。详情很长、会把提示本身盖住时，保持默认可折叠。
- 用户操作之后才出现的结果，在这次操作的处理函数里用 `useAnnounce` 播报。

`status` 只决定颜色和图标，不会自己变成实时区域。需要一直被读屏当成状态时，显式写上 `role="status"`。只有真正紧急、必须打断当前朗读的内容才写 `role="alert"`。页面初次渲染时就已经在的内容，读屏不一定会再念一遍。

如果只是单个字段的校验消息，应改用 [FieldStatus](/components/field-status)。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽：标题区域下方的详情。
- `title`：替换标题的视觉内容。仍需提供 `title` 属性。
- `description`：替换说明文本。
- `icon`：替换状态图标。图标仅作装饰。
- `end`：标题区域末尾的操作按钮。

标题、说明和详情插槽可包含块级内容。

zh.heading: 展开与收起
zh.text:
- 默认插槽有内容时，组件显示展开按钮。 - 默认从收起状态开始。 - `defaultIsOpen` 只设置初始状态。 - `v-model:isOpen` 控制当前状态。 - `collapsible` 为 `false` 时，详情始终显示。 - 收起时，详情内容卸载。 - 父组件收起详情时，若焦点在详情内，焦点返回展开按钮。 ```vue

Review the updated settings before continuing.

 ```

zh.heading: 关闭
zh.text:
- `isDismissable` 显示关闭按钮。
- 点击关闭后，组件自行隐藏。
- 组件触发 `dismiss` 事件。
- 关闭时，组件尝试将焦点返回进入提示前的元素。
- 需要再次显示时，重新挂载组件或改变 `key`。

zh.heading: 事件与模板引用
zh.text:

- `dismiss()`：关闭提示。
- `element`：根元素的 `HTMLDivElement | null`。关闭后为 `null`。

zh.heading: 本地化
zh.text: 关闭、展开、收起跟着文档或应用当前的语言。英文是 Dismiss、Expand、Collapse；简体中文是关闭、展开、收起。需要改成别的说法时，再传 `dismissLabel`、`expandLabel`、`collapseLabel`。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A progress bar has no focusable element, so screen reader users rely on the ARIA attributes the component exposes to learn the current progress. The component therefore puts `role="progressbar"` on the track and fills in the progress values and name, so assistive technologies can announce it accurately:

- The progress range is described by `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`, which the component sets automatically from `min` and `max`.
- The current progress is described by `aria-valuenow`, which is also set automatically.
- When `label` is provided, the label is linked to the track through `aria-labelledby`.
- When `description` is provided, the description is linked to the track through `aria-describedby`.

When `isIndeterminate` is true the progress is unknown, so the component removes `aria-valuenow` and screen readers announce the bar without a specific value.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
进度条没有可以聚焦的元素，屏幕阅读器用户只能靠组件暴露的 ARIA 属性了解当前进度。因此组件在轨道上设置了 `role="progressbar"`，并由它负责补全进度数值和名称，让辅助技术能够如实播报：

- 进度范围由 `aria-valuemin` 和 `aria-valuemax` 描述，组件会依据 `min` 和 `max` 自动设置。
- 当前进度由 `aria-valuenow` 描述，同样由组件自动设置。
- 传入 `label` 时，标签通过 `aria-labelledby` 关联到轨道。
- 传入 `description` 时，说明文字通过 `aria-describedby` 关联到轨道。

`isIndeterminate` 为真时进度未知，组件会移除 `aria-valuenow`，此时屏幕阅读器只播报这是一个进度条，不再给出具体数值。

en.text: Match the size and shape of the content being loaded to create a realistic placeholder.
Stagger multiple skeletons with the `index` prop for a natural wave animation.
Use when the content dimensions are unknown; use Spinner instead.
Combine with a Spinner on the same content area; pick one loading pattern.
Show skeletons indefinitely; if loading takes too long, show an error or empty state instead.

zh.text: 让占位块的尺寸和形状贴近最终内容，加载完成后布局才不会发生明显跳动。

让骨架屏长时间停留，加载明显偏慢时应改显错误或空状态，让用户知道当前发生了什么。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- `Skeleton` sets `aria-hidden="true"` by default.
- Assistive technology does not read the default placeholders.
- Give the surrounding loading region an accessible name.
- Set `aria-busy="true"` on that region.
- If the system requests reduced motion, the pulse animation stops.
- In forced-colors mode, placeholders remain visible.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is `<div>`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

An explicit `aria-hidden` value overrides the default.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- `Skeleton` 默认设置 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 辅助技术不会读取默认的占位块。
- 外围加载区域必须提供名称。
- 外围加载区域必须设置 `aria-busy="true"`。
- 系统启用「减少动态效果」时，脉冲动画停止。
- 系统启用强制颜色模式时，占位块保持可见。

zh.heading: 原生属性

根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

传入 `aria-hidden` 时，该值覆盖默认值。

summary.en: `Spinner` shows a loading state when the duration of a process is unknown.

usage.zh:
`Spinner` 用于在耗时未知的过程中给出加载反馈，例如获取数据或提交表单，避免用户误以为页面没有响应。从独立入口导入后直接使用：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

en.text: Provide a meaningful label to describe what is loading for screen reader users.
Use the "onMedia" shade when placed on dark or accent-colored backgrounds.
Use for content areas with known dimensions; use Skeleton to preserve layout instead.
Stack multiple spinners in the same view; use one to represent the overall loading state.

zh.text: 通过 `label` 说明正在加载的内容，屏幕阅读器用户才能理解当前发生了什么。
在深色或强调色背景上使用时选择 `onMedia` 色调，保证圆环清晰可见。
在尺寸已知的内容区域只放 `Spinner`，它会撑开并挤压布局；改用 `Skeleton` 占位可以保持页面稳定。
在同一视图中堆叠多个 `Spinner`，会让加载状态显得混乱；用一个 `Spinner` 表示整体加载即可。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Ring diameter: 10px, 14px, 18px, or 28px.

rows.name: `shade`
rows.description: Color shade for light backgrounds, dark backgrounds, or inherited text color.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Text shown below the spinner. Also used as the accessible name.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 圆环的直径，sm 为 10px，md 为 14px，lg 为 18px，xl 为 28px。

rows.name: `shade`
rows.description: 圆环的配色层级，分别面向浅色背景、深色背景或继承周围文字颜色的场景。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 显示在加载态下方的文字，同时作为无障碍名称供屏幕阅读器播报。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A `Spinner` has no visible text of its own, so its loading state reaches assistive technology entirely through ARIA attributes. The component sets these for you, and you normally do not need to manage them yourself; the list below covers the attributes it actually uses and what each one does.

- The root element carries `role="status"`, so assistive technology treats it as a status region.
- When you pass a string `label`, it shows as visible text below the spinner and provides the accessible name through `aria-labelledby`.
- Without a `label`, the accessible name defaults to `Loading`; pass `aria-label` to change it to something more specific to the context.
- The ring is `aria-hidden` and carries no text of its own, so it is not read out separately.
- With reduced motion enabled, the arc slows to a 3-second cycle.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `label`: rich content below the spinner. Replaces the `label` prop text. With no visible text and no `aria-label`, the accessible name follows the locale: Loading in English, 加载中 in Simplified Chinese.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
```css
.my-spinner {
  --astryx-spinner-color-accent: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-spinner-diameter-{sm|md|lg|xl}`: ring diameter per size.
- `--astryx-spinner-stroke-width-{sm|md|lg|xl}`: stroke width per size.
- `--astryx-spinner-arc-fraction`: fraction of the ring covered by the moving arc.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-accent`: arc color for the `default` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-subtle`: arc color for the `subtle` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-track`: track color for the `default` and `subtle` shades.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-on-dark`: arc and track color for the `onMedia` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-group-gap`: space between the ring and the label.
- `--astryx-spinner-label-color`: label text color.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
`Spinner` 本身没有可见文字，加载状态要依靠 ARIA 属性才能被辅助技术理解。这些属性都由组件自动设置，通常不需要你手动维护，下面说明组件实际用到的属性和它们各自的作用。

- 根元素带有 `role="status"`，辅助技术会把这块区域当作状态提示来处理。
- 传入字符串类型的 `label` 时，它会显示为加载态下方的可见文字，并通过 `aria-labelledby` 成为无障碍名称。
- 不传 `label` 时，无障碍名称默认为 `Loading`；这时传入 `aria-label` 就可以改成更贴合场景的说法。
- 圆环带有 `aria-hidden`，自身不含任何文字，因此它不会被单独读出。
- 开启「减少动态效果」时，圆弧放慢为 3 秒一圈。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `label`：加载态下方的富文本内容，会替代 `label` 属性的文字。没有可见文字、也没有 `aria-label` 时，读屏念当前语言的默认名：英文 Loading，简体中文「加载中」。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
```css
.my-spinner {
  --astryx-spinner-color-accent: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-spinner-diameter-{sm|md|lg|xl}`：各尺寸的环直径。
- `--astryx-spinner-stroke-width-{sm|md|lg|xl}`：各尺寸的描边宽度。
- `--astryx-spinner-arc-fraction`：运动圆弧覆盖圆环的比例。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-accent`：`default` 色调的圆弧颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-subtle`：`subtle` 色调的圆弧颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-track`：`default` 和 `subtle` 色调的轨道颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-on-dark`：`onMedia` 色调的圆弧与轨道颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-group-gap`：圆环与文字之间的间距。
- `--astryx-spinner-label-color`：文字颜色。

summary.en: Always provide `label`; screen readers announce it via `aria-label`.
summary.zh: `StatusDot` 是一个轻量的状态指示点，常出现在头像角标、列表项和监控页面中，用颜色快速传达在线、异常等状态。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

Import the component from its dedicated entry. Structural styles are loaded automatically.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

usage.zh:
`StatusDot` 是一个轻量的状态指示点，常出现在头像角标、列表项和监控页面中，用颜色快速传达在线、异常等状态。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

en.text: Always provide `label`; screen readers announce it via `aria-label`.
Use the dot as a supporting signal alongside a visible text label.
Use `isPulsing` for live, ongoing activity such as streaming or syncing.
Rely on color alone for critical status. Color is not perceivable by everyone.
Use many pulsing dots on the same screen; it creates visual noise.

zh.text: `label` 是必填项：状态点本身没有文字，屏幕阅读器用户依赖这个 `aria-label` 理解当前状态，描述应写清状态的含义。
把状态点当作辅助信号，和附近的文字标签搭配使用，用户不必辨认颜色也能读懂状态。
直播、同步、录制等正在进行的活动可以开启 `isPulsing`，脉冲动画能明确传达“进行中”的感觉。
仅用颜色传达关键状态：色觉障碍用户无法区分颜色，关键状态必须同时给出文字或图标说明。
在同一界面放置过多脉冲状态点：持续动画容易分散注意力，只给真正有活动的状态开启。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: The semantic color variant of the status dot. Optional: `neutral`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Required accessible label. Announced by screen readers via `aria-label`.

rows.name: `isPulsing`
rows.description: Whether the dot pulses to indicate an active state.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon drawn inside the dot. Omit it to keep a color-only signal. The `icon` slot wins. The icon is hidden from assistive tech; the name stays `label`.

rows.name: `tooltip`
rows.description: Tooltip text shown on hover and on keyboard focus, for when the status needs a sentence to explain it.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 状态点的语义颜色变体，可选 neutral、info、success、warning、error。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 状态的无障碍标签，必填。会作为 `aria-label` 供屏幕阅读器读取。

rows.name: `isPulsing`
rows.description: 是否显示脉冲动画，开启后状态点会呼吸闪烁，用于提示正在进行中的活动。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 画在圆点里的图标。不传时圆点只靠颜色表达。插槽 `icon` 优先。图标对读屏隐藏，名字仍是 `label`。

rows.name: `tooltip`
rows.description: 悬停和键盘聚焦时显示的提示文字，需要一句话解释状态时用。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon drawn centered inside the dot, in the variant ink. Use a different icon per status so the meaning survives without color. Hidden from screen readers, which read `label`.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 画在圆点正中的图标，用变体的前景色。每种状态用不同图标，这样不靠颜色也能分辨。对读屏隐藏，读屏读的是 `label`。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<span>`.

The following are passed to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

zh.text:
根元素为 `<span>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

description.en: isPulsing makes the dot breathe, for a state that is still in progress.
description.zh: isPulsing 让点呼吸闪烁，用来表示正在进行的状态。

description.en: A label beside the dot for online, away, offline, and unknown.
description.zh: 点的旁边写上文字，用来表示在线、离开、离线和未知。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { StatusDotVariant } from '@astryx-vue/core/StatusDot'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { StatusDot } from '@astryx-vue/core/StatusDot'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const statuses: { variant: StatusDotVariant, label: string }[] = [
  { variant: 'success', label: 'Online' },
  { variant: 'warning', label: 'Away' },
  { variant: 'error', label: 'Offline' },
  { variant: 'neutral', label: 'Unknown' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="2">
    <HStack v-for="item in statuses" :key="item.variant" :gap="2" align="center">
      <StatusDot :variant="item.variant" :label="item.label" />
      <Text type="body">
        {{ item.label }}
      </Text>
    </HStack>
  </VStack>

summary.en: `Calendar` shows one or two months and selects a day or a start and end. It opens on the requested month, or on the selected day, or on today when that day still falls inside the earliest and latest dates.
summary.zh: `Calendar` 用月历网格选日期。可以选一天，也可以选一段起止日期，并排显示一个月或两个月。打开时先落到指定的月份；没有指定时，落在已选日期或今天，并尽量落进最早和最晚日期之间。

usage.en:
`Calendar` shows one or two months and selects a day or a start and end. It opens on the requested month, or on the selected day, or on today when that day still falls inside the earliest and latest dates.

A day is unavailable when it is outside those bounds, when a predicate returns true, or when any constraint returns false. A range can also require a minimum and maximum length, counting both ends. Week numbers can sit beside each row. Days from the neighboring months can fill the grid, and they cannot be picked. The grid can shrink to the weeks the month needs, or stay six rows tall. The week can start on Sunday or on any other day, given as a number or a short name. A handle can move the visible month to a date and focus that day.

Arrow keys move by a day or a week, cross into the next month, and skip days that cannot be picked. Home and End move to the first and last available day of the week. Page Up and Page Down move by a month. Enter or Space picks the focused day. Escape cancels a range that has a start but no end yet. Each month is a grid named with that month. Selection, today, and unavailable days are exposed to assistive technology.

Bind a date:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Calendar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 9, 11))
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar v-model="date" label="Select a date" />
</template>
```

The value is a local `Date`. The month title and weekday names follow the active locale. Built-in labels are English unless the app calls `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`.
usage.zh:
`Calendar` 用月历网格选日期。可以选一天，也可以选一段起止日期，并排显示一个月或两个月。打开时先落到指定的月份；没有指定时，落在已选日期或今天，并尽量落进最早和最晚日期之间。

最早日期、最晚日期、返回真值的判断，以及一组返回假值的约束，都会让对应的日子不能选。范围还可以限制最短和最长天数，天数把两端都算进去。周数可以显示在每一行左侧。相邻月份的日期可以留在格子里，但不能选。行数可以按当月缩短，也可以固定六行。一周从哪一天开始，用数字或星期缩写指定。外面也可以拿到一个句柄，直接把月份翻到某一天并聚焦它。

方向键按天或按周移动，到头会翻月，并跳过不能选的日子。Home 和 End 移到这一周里能选的第一天和最后一天。PageUp 和 PageDown 翻一个月。Enter 或空格确认。范围还没选完时，Escape 取消。每个月是一块带月份名字的网格，今天、选中和禁用都能被读屏读到。

基本用法只需要绑定一个日期值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Calendar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 9, 11))
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar v-model="date" label="选择日期" />
</template>
```

绑定值是原生 `Date`。通过 `min` 和 `max` 限制可选日期范围，通过 `isDateDisabled` 函数禁用特定日期。月份标题和星期名称跟随当前语言。组件自带文案默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文。

en.text: Always provide a visible label so the user knows what they are toggling. Use isLabelHidden only when surrounding context makes it obvious.
Add a description for choices that need extra context, like explaining what "Share usage data" actually shares.
Use the indeterminate state for "select all" checkboxes when only some items in a group are selected.
Use a checkbox for mutually exclusive choices; use RadioList when only one option can be selected.
Use a checkbox for actions that take effect immediately; use a toggle switch or button instead.
Wrap a disabled checkbox in Tooltip to explain why it is disabled; disabled controls swallow the hover events the wrapper needs. Use the disabledMessage prop instead.

zh.text: 必须提供可见的标签，让用户知道自己在切换什么。只有上下文已经明确时，才使用 isLabelHidden 隐藏标签。
对需要额外说明的选项添加描述。例如解释 “Share usage data” 实际会共享哪些内容。
当一组中只选中部分项目时，“全选”复选框使用不确定状态（indeterminate）。
用复选框表示互斥的选项。只能选一项时，应使用 RadioList。
用复选框表示立即生效的操作。应使用开关或按钮。
用 Tooltip 包裹禁用的复选框来解释禁用原因。禁用的控件会吞掉包裹层需要的悬停事件。应改用 disabledMessage 属性。

en.heading: Keyboard and accessibility
en.text:
`CheckboxInput` renders a native `<input type="checkbox">`, so keyboard behaviour follows the browser defaults: press Tab to focus the checkbox, and press Space to toggle the selection.

The component wires the label, description and status message together through ARIA attributes, so assistive technology reads them as one unit:

- Always provide `label`; screen readers use it to describe what this option means. `isLabelHidden` only hides the visual label, and the label text still provides the accessible name.
- `aria-describedby` references the description and the status message, so both are announced on focus.
- The mixed state comes from the native `indeterminate` property, which browsers and assistive technology recognise directly.
- `isRequired` enables the browser's native required validation.
- When the status is an error, the component sets `aria-invalid`.

For a decorative selection mark on its own, use [CheckboxIndicator](/en/components/checkbox-indicator).

en.heading: Status messages
en.text:
`status` contains these fields:

- `type`: `'error'`, `'warning'` or `'success'`.
- `message`: optional message text.
- `messageId`: optional message ID.

Messages appear below the checkbox. Errors use assertive announcements. Warnings and successes use polite announcements.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`: emits a boolean after activation.
- `change(value, event)`: fires after the model update.
- `actionError(error, value, event)`: fires when an action rejects or throws.

`event` is a cancelable `CheckboxInputChangeEvent`.
`event.detail.originalEvent` contains the native event.
Call `event.preventDefault()` in `change` to skip `changeAction`.
This does not undo the model update.

en.heading: Async actions
en.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` receives the new value and component event.

- Returning a Promise shows the loading state.
- Pending actions block repeat activation.
- Explicit parent updates override the temporary selection.
- Loading clears after success or failure.
- Failures do not revert values written to `v-model`.
- Use `@action-error` to show failure information.
- Update the bound value in application code if you need a rollback.

en.heading: Native forms
en.text:
- `htmlName` or `name` sets the field name.
- Native `value` sets the submitted value. The default is `'on'`.
- `value` does not control selection. Use `v-model` for selection.
- Unchecked and indeterminate fields do not submit.
- Checked read-only fields submit.
- Disabled fields do not submit.
- Fields with a disabled reason use `aria-disabled` and have no native form owner.
- `isOptional` overrides `isRequired`. An explicit native `required` attribute still applies.

After `form.reset()`, the component restores the current `v-model`.
To clear the selection, update the bound value in the form's `reset` handler.

en.heading: Template references and attributes
en.text:
- `element`: `HTMLInputElement | null`.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`: focuses the input.
- `blur()`: removes input focus.
- `class` and `style` apply to the outer component.
- Undeclared native attributes and events pass to `input`.
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` merge with internal IDs.
- The component owns `checked`, `indeterminate`, `type` and core ARIA states.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `labelIcon`: a decorative icon before the label. Overrides the `labelIcon` prop.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 键盘与无障碍
zh.text:
`CheckboxInput` 内部是原生的 `<input type="checkbox">`，键盘操作沿用浏览器的默认行为：按 Tab 聚焦复选框，按空格键切换选中状态。

标签、说明和状态消息由组件通过 ARIA 属性串联起来，辅助技术能把它们当成一个整体读出：

- 必须提供 `label`，屏幕阅读器靠它说明这个选项的含义；`isLabelHidden` 只隐藏视觉上的标签，标签文本仍然作为可访问名称提供。
- `description` 和状态消息关联到 `aria-describedby`，聚焦时会一并读出。
- 半选状态通过原生 `indeterminate` 属性提供，浏览器和辅助技术都能直接识别。
- `isRequired` 启用浏览器原生的必填校验。
- 出错时组件自动设置 `aria-invalid`。

如果只需要显示选中标记，请使用 [CheckboxIndicator](/components/checkbox-indicator)。

zh.heading: 状态消息
zh.text:
`status` 包含以下字段：

- `type`：`'error'`、`'warning'` 或 `'success'`。
- `message`：可选的消息文本。
- `messageId`：可选的消息 ID。

消息显示在复选框下方。错误使用 assertive 播报。警告和成功使用 polite 播报。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：用户切换后发出布尔值。
- `change(value, event)`：模型更新后触发。
- `actionError(error, value, event)`：异步操作拒绝或同步抛出错误时触发。

`event` 是可取消的 `CheckboxInputChangeEvent`。
`event.detail.originalEvent` 保留原生事件。
在 `change` 中调用 `event.preventDefault()` 可跳过 `changeAction`。
此操作不会撤销模型更新。

zh.heading: 异步操作
zh.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` 接收新值和组件事件。

- 操作返回 Promise 时，组件显示加载状态。
- 操作完成前，组件阻止重复切换。
- 父组件的新值优先于临时显示值。
- Promise 成功或失败后，组件清除加载状态。
- 失败时，组件不会撤销写入 `v-model` 的值。
- 使用 `@action-error` 显示失败信息。
- 需要回滚时，由业务层更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 原生表单
zh.text:
- `htmlName` 或 `name` 设置字段名。
- 原生 `value` 设置提交值。默认值是 `'on'`。
- `value` 不控制选中状态。选中状态由 `v-model` 控制。
- 未选和半选字段不参与提交。
- 只读字段在选中时参与提交。
- 禁用字段不参与提交。
- 带禁用原因的字段使用 `aria-disabled`，并脱离原生表单。
- `isOptional` 优先于 `isRequired`。单独传入的原生 `required` 仍生效。

原生 `form.reset()` 后，组件恢复当前 `v-model`。
需要清空选择时，在表单的 `reset` 事件中更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 模板引用与属性
zh.text:
- `element`：`HTMLInputElement | null`。
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`：聚焦输入元素。
- `blur()`：移除输入焦点。
- `class` 和 `style` 应用于组件外层。
- 未声明的原生属性和事件传入 `input`。
- `aria-labelledby` 和 `aria-describedby` 与组件内部 ID 合并。
- 组件管理 `checked`、`indeterminate`、`type` 和核心 ARIA 状态。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `labelIcon`：标签前的装饰图标。优先于 `labelIcon` 属性。

zh.heading: 主题

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CheckboxValue } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxInput'
import { CheckboxInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxInput'
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const items = ref({
  email: true,
  push: false,
  sms: true,
  slack: false,
})

const checkedCount = computed(() => Object.values(items.value).filter(Boolean).length)
const totalCount = computed(() => Object.keys(items.value).length)
const selectAll = computed<CheckboxValue>({
  get() {
    if (checkedCount.value === 0)
      return false
    if (checkedCount.value === totalCount.value)
      return true
    return 'indeterminate'
  },
  set(checked: CheckboxValue) {
    const next = checked === true
    items.value = { email: next, push: next, sms: next, slack: next }
  },
})
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="3">
    <CheckboxInput
      v-model="selectAll"
      label="Select all notifications"
      :description="`${checkedCount} of ${totalCount} enabled`"
    />
    <Divider />
    <VStack :gap="3">
      <CheckboxInput v-model="items.email" label="Email notifications" />
      <CheckboxInput v-model="items.push" label="Push notifications" />
      <CheckboxInput v-model="items.sms" label="SMS alerts" />
      <CheckboxInput v-model="items.slack" label="Slack messages" />
    </VStack>
  </VStack>
</template>

usage.en:
`CheckboxList` is a field around a list of `CheckboxListItem` rows. With `v-model`, the value is the array of checked item values.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxList, CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const selected = shallowRef(['email'])
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxList v-model="selected" label="Notifications">
    <CheckboxListItem label="Email" value="email" />
    <CheckboxListItem label="SMS" value="sms" />
  </CheckboxList>
</template>
```

Omit the bound value when a row owns its own checked state, such as a select-all row. Compact density uses the small checkbox. A checked row uses the accent-muted background. Read-only and disabled rows drop that background.

A read-only group keeps the checks and does not dim, but the checks cannot change. Disabled wins when both are set. When the group is disabled and a reason is set, every row stays focusable, and hovering or keyboard focus shows the reason. A row that is loading, or whose change is still running, shows a spinner inside the checkbox and cannot be toggled.

整组只读时，勾选状态还在，也不会变暗，但不能改。和禁用同时设置时按禁用处理。禁用并写上原因时，每一行仍可聚焦，悬停或用键盘停在上面能看到原因。某一行自己在加载，或者一次变更还没结束时，复选框里显示旋转指示，这一行不能再点。

description.en: Select all is indeterminate until every document is included.
description.zh: 没有全部选中时，全选行是半选。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxList, CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const documents = [
  { id: 'transactions', label: 'Transaction history' },
  { id: 'statements', label: 'Account statements' },
  { id: 'tax', label: 'Tax documents' },
  { id: 'invoices', label: 'Invoices' },
]
const selected = shallowRef(['transactions'])
const allIds = documents.map(document => document.id)
const allChecked = computed(() => allIds.every(id => selected.value.includes(id)))
const selectAllState = computed(() => allChecked.value ? true : selected.value.length === 0 ? false : 'indeterminate' as const)

function toggleAll(checked: boolean): void {
  selected.value = checked ? [...allIds] : []
}

function toggle(id: string, checked: boolean): void {
  selected.value = checked ? [...selected.value, id] : selected.value.filter(value => value !== id)
}
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxList label="Include in export" has-dividers>
    <CheckboxListItem label="Select all" :is-checked="selectAllState" @check="toggleAll" />
    <CheckboxListItem
      v-for="document in documents"
      :key="document.id"
      :label="document.label"
      :is-checked="selected.includes(document.id)"
      @check="checked => toggle(document.id, checked)"
    />
  </CheckboxList>
</template>

usage.en:
Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a `CheckboxList` with a value array) or standalone mode (inside `List`, or inside a `CheckboxList` without value, such as a select-all item).

```ts
import { CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
```

In collection mode the row's `value` is its identity: the parent [Checkbox List](/en/components/checkbox-list) holds the `v-model` array, and the row throws without a `value`. In standalone mode there is no array, so `isChecked` shows the state and `check` reports the next one; that is the shape used inside a [List](/en/components/list) or by a select-all row.
usage.zh:
复选列表里的一行，有名字、说明，末尾还能再放点东西。它有两种用法：跟着 `CheckboxList` 一起用，勾选状态存在父组件的数组里；或者自己单独用，比如放进 `List`，或者放进一个没有绑数组的 `CheckboxList`，做「全选」那行。

```ts
import { CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
```

跟着 [复选列表](/components/checkbox-list) 用时，`value` 就是这一行的身份证，父组件靠它在数组里找这一行，漏写会直接报错。单独用时没有数组，就用 `isChecked` 决定勾不勾，勾选变化通过 `check` 事件告诉你。放在 [列表](/components/list) 里，或者做「全选」行，都是这种单独用法。

summary.en: `DateInput` is a text field with a calendar button. People can type a date or open the calendar and pick a day.
summary.zh: `DateInput` 是一个日期输入组件，结合了文本输入框和日历弹出层。用户可以手动输入日期文本，也可以点击打开日历选择。

usage.en:
`DateInput` is a text field with a calendar button. People can type a date or open the calendar and pick a day.

Bind a date:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateInput v-model="date" />
</template>
```

The value is a local date. The field writes it back as a long date, such as March 21, 2026. It can also show a short date, a weekday, the system date, or custom text. A description can sit under the label, and validation can change the border or add a message under the field.

The calendar can open in a popover or a bottom sheet. The sheet shows one month. Picking a day writes it immediately, and Save closes the sheet. The month title opens month and year wheels. The system date control can be used all the time, or only on a touch device. When nothing is specified, a mouse gets the popover and a coarse pointer gets the system control. While a change is saving, the field cannot be edited. The save runs after the new value is written. The label can carry a hint and mark the field optional or required. The popover can show two months, and the week can start on a chosen day.
usage.zh:
`DateInput` 是一个日期输入组件，结合了文本输入框和日历弹出层。用户可以手动输入日期文本，也可以点击打开日历选择。

基本用法只需要绑定一个日期值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateInput v-model="date" placeholder="选择日期" />
</template>
```

绑定值是本地日期。写回字段时默认排成完整日期，例如 March 21, 2026。也可以改成短日期、带星期、系统日期，或自己排版。标签下面可以放说明。校验可以只改边框，也可以在字段下面写出原因。

日历可以从弹出层或底部面板打开。底部面板一次显示一个月，点一天就写入，保存才收起；点月份标题可以改月份和年份。系统日期控件可以一直用，也可以只在触摸设备上用。不指定时，鼠标走弹出层，触摸走系统控件。字段正在保存时不能改，保存会在新值写进去之后进行。标签可以带一条提示，并标明选填或必填。弹出的月历可以一次看两个月，一周从哪一天开始也能指定。

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 3, 6))

function iso(date: Date | null): string {
  if (!date)
    return ''
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`
}
</script>

<template>

summary.en: `DateRangeInput` selects a start date and an end date. The value is `{ start, end }` with ISO dates, or `null`.

usage.en:
`DateRangeInput` selects a start date and an end date. The value is `{ start, end }` with ISO dates, or `null`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateRange } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { DateRangeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const range = shallowRef<DateRange | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateRangeInput v-model="range" label="Date range" />
</template>
```

The popover shows two months under one header. The first click sets the start. The second click commits the range when the span is allowed. Clicking the start again commits a single day when the shortest span is one day, and cancels the selection otherwise. The closed field omits the year when both ends are in the current year. Presets stay beside the calendars. When the two months no longer fit side by side, they wrap onto separate rows. A constraint can still turn individual days off. While a change is saving, the field cannot be edited.

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateRange } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'

function isoDaysAgo(days: number): string {
  const date = new Date()
  date.setDate(date.getDate() - days)
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`
}

const range = shallowRef<DateRange | null>(null)
const presets = [
  { label: 'Last 7 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(7), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 14 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(14), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 30 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(30), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 90 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(90), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
]
</script>

usage.en:
`DateTimeInput` combines a date and a time. The value is `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`, or `null` until both parts are set.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateTimeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateTimeInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const meeting = shallowRef<string | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateTimeInput v-model="meeting" label="Meeting time" has-clear />
</template>
```

The date uses the date field. The time uses the same field as the time input. The two fields stay side by side and shrink with the row. They wrap only when the row is narrower than 16rem. `bottom-sheet` puts the date and the time in one bottom sheet, with tabs to move between them. Clear removes both parts. The date half can show two months and can start the week on a chosen day. While a change is saving, neither field can be edited.

summary.en: `Field` provides structure around a control:
summary.zh: `Field` 为控件补齐完整的字段结构，包括标签、补充说明、必填或可选提示和状态消息。它适合包装原生输入框、自研控件或第三方组件，让这些控件拥有与样式输入框一致的字段外观和无障碍关联。`TextInput` 已内置 `Field`，使用 `TextInput` 时直接传入字段属性即可，无需额外包裹。

usage.en:
`Field` provides structure around a control:

- A label.
- A description.
- Required or optional indicators.
- A status message.

`TextInput` includes `Field`. Pass field props directly to `TextInput`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { shallowRef, useId } from 'vue'

const volume = shallowRef(50)
const inputId = `volume-${useId()}`
</script>

<template>
  <Field :input-id="inputId" label="Volume" description="Set playback volume.">
    <template #default="field">
      <input
        :id="field.inputId" v-model.number="volume" type="range"
        :aria-labelledby="field.labelId" :aria-describedby="field.describedBy"
      >
    </template>
  </Field>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Field` 为控件补齐完整的字段结构，包括标签、补充说明、必填或可选提示和状态消息。它适合包装原生输入框、自研控件或第三方组件，让这些控件拥有与样式输入框一致的字段外观和无障碍关联。`TextInput` 已内置 `Field`，使用 `TextInput` 时直接传入字段属性即可，无需额外包裹。

下面的示例用 `Field` 包装一个原生滑块，通过默认插槽提供的关联 ID 把标签和说明挂到控件上：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { shallowRef, useId } from 'vue'

const volume = shallowRef(50)
const inputId = `volume-${useId()}`
</script>

<template>
  <Field :input-id="inputId" label="Volume" description="Set playback volume.">
    <template #default="field">
      <input
        :id="field.inputId" v-model.number="volume" type="range"
        :aria-labelledby="field.labelId" :aria-describedby="field.describedBy"
      >
    </template>
  </Field>
</template>
```

en.text: Wrap custom controls, native inputs, or third-party widgets that need labeling, helper text, optional/required indicators, or validation status.
Always provide a label for accessibility, even if visually hidden with isLabelHidden.
Use inputID and descriptionID to connect the label and description to the inner control with htmlFor and aria-describedby.
Nest Field around styled inputs such as TextInput, Typeahead, Select, DateInput, or TextArea; those components already render their own Field shell.
Use the attached status variant on non-bordered controls such as sliders, switches, or checkboxes; use detached so the message does not overlap the control.
Set both isOptional and isRequired on the same field.
Hide the label without providing an alternative way for the user to understand the field purpose.

zh.text: 包裹需要标签、辅助文字、必填或可选标识，或校验状态的自定义控件、原生输入框或第三方组件。
必须提供标签以保证无障碍，即使用 isLabelHidden 将其隐藏。
使用 inputID 和 descriptionID，将标签和描述通过 htmlFor 与 aria-describedby 关联到内部控件。
在 TextInput、Typeahead、Select、DateInput 或 TextArea 等样式输入框外层嵌套 Field。这些组件已自带 Field 外壳。
在滑块、开关或复选框等无边框控件上使用 attached 状态变体。应使用 detached，使消息不与控件重叠。
在同一字段上同时设置 isOptional 和 isRequired。
隐藏标签，又不提供其他方式让用户理解字段用途。
