summary.en: `ComplexSelector` is a field whose popup content you draw yourself. It owns the label, the trigger, the popover, focus return, and `changeAction`. The default slot owns the content: it receives `value`, `commit`, `close`, and `state`.
summary.zh: `ComplexSelector` 是一个弹层内容由你来画的字段。标签、触发器、弹出层、焦点归还和 `changeAction` 由它负责。默认插槽负责内容，参数是 `value`、`commit`、`close` 和 `state`。

usage.en:
`ComplexSelector` is a field whose popup content you draw yourself. It owns the label, the trigger, the popover, focus return, and `changeAction`. The default slot owns the content: it receives `value`, `commit`, `close`, and `state`.

`commit` writes the value and runs `changeAction` when one was provided. While that action is pending the trigger shows a spinner and the slot sees the value that was just committed. Arrow Down on the trigger opens the popup.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
</script>

<template>
  <ComplexSelector v-model="value" label="Deadline" :trigger-label="value">
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

The popup stays open until the slot calls `commit`. A tree can use `TreeList`. `status`, `isDisabled`, `isRequired`, and `description` are the same field props as the other inputs.

`alignment` places the popup along its axis. `startIcon` draws an icon in the trigger. `variant="ghost"` drops the border so the trigger matches a toolbar button. `renderTrigger`, or the `trigger` slot, replaces the field: spread the bindings onto your own control. `handleRef` and a template `ref` both expose `open`, `close`, `toggle`, and `isOpen`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComplexSelectorHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
const selector = shallowRef<ComplexSelectorHandle | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="selector?.open()">
    Open
  </button>
  <ComplexSelector
    ref="selector"
    v-model="value"
    label="Deadline"
    start-icon="calendar"
    :trigger-label="value"
    variant="ghost"
  >
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ComplexSelector` 是一个弹层内容由你来画的字段。标签、触发器、弹出层、焦点归还和 `changeAction` 由它负责。默认插槽负责内容，参数是 `value`、`commit`、`close` 和 `state`。

`commit` 写入新值，并在提供了 `changeAction` 时执行它。动作还没结束时，触发器显示加载指示，插槽看到的是刚提交的值。在触发器上按 Arrow Down 会打开弹层。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
</script>

<template>
  <ComplexSelector v-model="value" label="Deadline" :trigger-label="value">
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

弹层会一直开着，直到插槽调用 `commit`。树可以用 `TreeList`。`status`、`isDisabled`、`isRequired` 和 `description` 与其他输入框的字段属性相同。

`alignment` 决定弹层沿打开方向怎么对齐。`startIcon` 在触发器开头放一个图标。`variant="ghost"` 去掉边框，触发器看起来像工具栏按钮。`renderTrigger` 或 `trigger` 插槽会换掉整个字段：把参数展开到你自己的控件上。`handleRef` 和模板 `ref` 都能调用 `open`、`close`、`toggle` 和 `isOpen`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComplexSelectorHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
const selector = shallowRef<ComplexSelectorHandle | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="selector?.open()">
    Open
  </button>
  <ComplexSelector
    ref="selector"
    v-model="value"
    label="Deadline"
    start-icon="calendar"
    :trigger-label="value"
    variant="ghost"
  >
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

rows.name: `renderTrigger`
rows.description: 换掉字段和内置触发器。把 `props` 展开到你的控件上。`trigger` 插槽做同一件事。

rows.name: `handleRef`
rows.description: 拿到 `open`、`close`、`toggle` 和 `isOpen`。模板 `ref` 暴露同样的方法。

rows.name: `changeAction`
rows.description: 值变化后执行。还没结束时触发器显示加载指示。

rows.name: `update:modelValue`
rows.description: The value passed to `commit`.

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: Emitted with `update:modelValue`.

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: Emitted for a click on the trigger, before the popup opens. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep it closed. With the `trigger` slot or `renderTrigger` it runs after the toggle and cannot cancel it.

rows.name: `keydown`
rows.description: Emitted for keys on the trigger after the built-in handling, and receives every key, including the ArrowDown that opens the popup. With a custom trigger, keys the built-in handling cancels are not emitted.

rows.name: `openChange`
rows.description: Emitted whenever the surface opens or closes, however it happened: trigger, keyboard, light dismiss, Escape, `close()`, or the imperative handle.

rows.name: `update:modelValue`
rows.description: `commit` 写入的值。

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: 和 `update:modelValue` 一起发出。

rows.name: `click`

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TreeListItemData } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { TreeList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

interface Destination {
  id: string
  label: string
  path: string
  children?: Destination[]
}

const tree: Destination[] = [
  {
    id: 'workspace',
    label: 'Workspace',
    path: '/Workspace',
    children: [
      {
        id: 'workspace-research',
        label: 'Research',
        path: '/Workspace/Research',
        children: [
          { id: 'workspace-research-field-notes', label: 'Field notes', path: '/Workspace/Research/Field notes' },
          { id: 'workspace-research-interviews', label: 'Interviews', path: '/Workspace/Research/Interviews' },
        ],
      },
      { id: 'workspace-roadmap', label: 'Roadmap', path: '/Workspace/Roadmap' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'teams',
    label: 'Teams',
    path: '/Teams',
    children: [
      {
        id: 'teams-design-systems',
        label: 'Design systems',
        path: '/Teams/Design systems',
        children: [
          { id: 'teams-design-systems-components', label: 'Components', path: '/Teams/Design systems/Components' },
          { id: 'teams-design-systems-accessibility', label: 'Accessibility', path: '/Teams/Design systems/Accessibility' },
        ],
      },
      { id: 'teams-growth', label: 'Growth', path: '/Teams/Growth' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'archive',
    label: 'Archive',
    path: '/Archive',
    children: [
      { id: 'archive-2025', label: '2025 projects', path: '/Archive/2025 projects' },
    ],
  },
]

const value = ref<Destination>({
  id: 'teams-design-systems-accessibility',
  label: 'Accessibility',
  path: '/Teams/Design systems/Accessibility',
})
const query = ref('')

function filterTree(nodes: Destination[], term: string): Destination[] {
  const normalized = term.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (normalized === '')
    return nodes
  return nodes.flatMap((node) => {
    const children = node.children ? filterTree(node.children, normalized) : []
    if (node.label.toLowerCase().includes(normalized) || children.length > 0)
      return [{ ...node, children }]
    return []
  })
}

function toItems(nodes: Destination[], selectedId: string, pick: (node: Destination) => void): TreeListItemData[] {
  return nodes.map(node => ({
    id: node.id,
    label: node.label,
    isExpanded: true,
    isSelected: node.id === selectedId,
    onClick: () => pick(node),
    children: node.children ? toItems(node.children, selectedId, pick) : undefined,
  }))
}

const visible = computed(() => filterTree(tree, query.value))

function items(selectedId: string, pick: (node: Destination) => void) {
  return toItems(visible.value, selectedId, pick)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ComplexSelector
    v-model="value"
    description="Search and browse nested folders."
    label="Destination"
    :trigger-label="value.path"
    width="100%"
  >
    <template #default="{ value: selected, commit, close }">
      <VStack :gap="3">
        <TextInput
          v-model="query"
          has-clear
          is-label-hidden
          label="Search destinations"
          placeholder="Search folders or teams"
        />
        <TreeList
          v-if="visible.length > 0"
          density="compact"
          :items="items(selected.id, (node) => { commit(node); close() })"
        />
        <Text v-else color="secondary" type="supporting">
          No matching destinations.
        </Text>
      </VStack>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>

summary.en: Power Search splits a query into a field, an operator, and a value. Focusing the input lists the fields. Choosing one opens an editor when the operator still needs a value. A boolean field, an empty operator, and a content search become a filter immediately: the editor closes and focus returns to the search field. Clicking an existing empty-operator token does not open the built-in editor. It commits one edit. A consumer editor registered as `components.empty.editor`, or the editor slot, still opens.
summary.zh: 结构化搜索把一条查询拆成字段、运算符和值。聚焦输入框会列出字段。选中之后，如果这个运算符还要填值，就打开编辑器；布尔值、空运算符和全文搜索会直接变成一条条件，编辑器不留在页面上，焦点回到搜索框。再点一条已经存在的空条件，内置编辑器不会打开，只会再提交一次修改。如果调用方用 `components.empty.editor` 或编辑器插槽换了空运算符的编辑器，点这条条件仍会打开那个编辑器。

usage.en:
Power Search splits a query into a field, an operator, and a value. Focusing the input lists the fields. Choosing one opens an editor when the operator still needs a value. A boolean field, an empty operator, and a content search become a filter immediately: the editor closes and focus returns to the search field. Clicking an existing empty-operator token does not open the built-in editor. It commits one edit. A consumer editor registered as `components.empty.editor`, or the editor slot, still opens.

Backspace on an empty input removes the last token. The arrow keys move between tokens, Enter opens the focused one, and Backspace or Delete removes it. A read-only token cannot be edited or removed. Escape cancels the editor and returns focus.

The editor follows the width of the search field, from about 400 to 720, and stays inside the layer gutter (16 on each side of the viewport). When the viewport cannot hold the minimum, the floor gives way to that gutter. The editor hugs the side that opened it only after the maximum has squeezed it. The position is taken once, while it is open. When the editor itself is narrower than 400, the fields stack. That follows the editor’s width, not the window’s.

`createPowerSearchConfig` builds the operators from field definitions and returns `applyFilters`. That function filters rows on its own. It does not go through a table’s column filters. Time, relative dates, entities, and custom values keep every row unless the caller interprets them. A nested filter requires every child by default. An operator named or, or one whose name contains any, requires only one child.

Tokens can collapse to one line when the field loses focus. The inline mode expands in place. The layer mode floats over the field and leaves the content below where it is. A numeric result count is read with plural wording. A string is shown as given. Changes are announced politely, and the first paint is silent.

Pass a disabled reason together with the disabled state. The input stays focusable, and the reason appears on hover and keyboard focus. Do not wrap the field in another tooltip. A natively disabled control swallows the hover.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createPowerSearchConfig, PowerSearch } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const people = [
  { name: 'Alice', active: true },
  { name: 'Bob', active: false },
]
const { config, applyFilters } = createPowerSearchConfig([
  { key: 'name', type: 'string', label: 'Name' },
  { key: 'active', type: 'boolean', label: 'Active' },
])
const filters = ref([])
const matched = computed(() => applyFilters(filters.value, people))
</script>

<template>
  <PowerSearch v-model:filters="filters" :config="config" :result-count="matched.length" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
结构化搜索把一条查询拆成字段、运算符和值。聚焦输入框会列出字段。选中之后，如果这个运算符还要填值，就打开编辑器；布尔值、空运算符和全文搜索会直接变成一条条件，编辑器不留在页面上，焦点回到搜索框。再点一条已经存在的空条件，内置编辑器不会打开，只会再提交一次修改。如果调用方用 `components.empty.editor` 或编辑器插槽换了空运算符的编辑器，点这条条件仍会打开那个编辑器。

输入为空时，退格键删掉最后一条。左右方向键在标签之间移动，回车打开当前标签，退格或删除键去掉它。只读的条件不能改，也不能删。按 Esc 会取消编辑并把焦点还回去。

编辑器的宽度跟搜索条走，最窄大约 400，最宽 720，并且不越过浮层留白（视口两侧各 16）。窗口放不下一个最小宽度时，下限让给这道留白。只有被最大宽度压窄时，编辑器才贴向打开它的那一侧。位置在打开时定住，关掉以后不再跟着搜索条挪。编辑器自己窄于 400 时，字段上下排列，不看整个窗口有多宽。

`createPowerSearchConfig` 根据字段定义生成运算符，并返回一个独立的 `applyFilters`。它只负责把行滤出来，不经过表格自己的列过滤。时间、相对日期、实体和自定义值默认全部保留，调用方要自己解释。嵌套条件默认每一条都要满足；运算符名字里带 any，或者就是 or，则满足任意一条即可。

失焦时标签可以收成一行。`unfocused-inline` 在原处展开，`unfocused-layer` 浮在字段上，不把下面的内容往下推。结果数量是数字时会按单复数读出来，是字符串时原样显示。数量变化会礼貌地播报，第一次出现不播。

禁用原因和禁用一起用时，输入框仍然可以聚焦，悬停或键盘聚焦能看到原因。不要再在外面套一层提示，原生禁用会把悬停吃掉。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createPowerSearchConfig, PowerSearch } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const people = [
  { name: 'Alice', active: true },
  { name: 'Bob', active: false },
]
const { config, applyFilters } = createPowerSearchConfig([
  { key: 'name', type: 'string', label: 'Name' },
  { key: 'active', type: 'boolean', label: 'Active' },
])
const filters = ref([])
const matched = computed(() => applyFilters(filters.value, people))
</script>

<template>
  <PowerSearch v-model:filters="filters" :config="config" :result-count="matched.length" />
</template>
```

en.text: Group a long field list, and add aliases for the fields people actually type.
Point content search at one string field instead of letting every field consume free text.
Fold Power Search into a table column filter. Column filters stay substring and enum matches.
Save a nested filter while a child is unfinished. An unfinished child is not a filter yet.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: The icon sits before the tokens. endContent (also accepted as end) sits before the clear button and is the place for another action. The token and editor slots win over a component registered for a value type. The component also exposes focus and blur methods, so a button outside the field can send the cursor back.

en.heading: Field definitions
en.text:
`createPowerSearchConfig` accepts string, number, boolean, date, enum, enum list, and string list. Strings can contain, start with, end with, or equal a value. Numbers compare magnitude. Dates can be before, after, or between. A boolean does not ask for another value.

A hand-written config can also use time, a relative date, an entity list, a custom editor, and nested filters. A custom editor needs a way to read the value back as text.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: 图标放在条件前面。endContent（也接受旧名 end）放在清除按钮之前，适合再放一个操作。标签和编辑器插槽优先于按类型注册的替换组件。 组件还暴露聚焦和取消聚焦两个方法，给外面的按钮把光标送回输入框。

zh.heading: 字段定义
zh.text:
`createPowerSearchConfig` 接受字符串、数字、布尔、日期、枚举、枚举列表和字符串列表。字符串有包含、开头、结尾和等于。数字有大小比较。日期有早于、晚于和介于。布尔值不需要再填值。

手写配置时还可以使用时间、相对日期、实体列表、自定义编辑器和嵌套条件。自定义编辑器要同时提供怎么把值读成文字。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PowerSearchConfig, PowerSearchFilter } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { PowerSearch } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const config: PowerSearchConfig = {
  name: 'people',
  fields: [
    {
      key: 'match',
      label: 'Match',
      defaultOperator: 'all',
      operators: [
        { key: 'all', label: 'all of', value: { type: 'nested' } },
        { key: 'any', label: 'any of', value: { type: 'nested' } },
      ],
    },
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Name',
      defaultOperator: 'contains',
      operators: [
        { key: 'contains', i18nKey: '@astryx.powersearch.operator.contains', value: { type: 'string' } },
        { key: 'is', i18nKey: '@astryx.powersearch.operator.is', value: { type: 'string' } },
      ],
    },
    {
      key: 'active',
      label: 'Active',
      defaultOperator: 'is_true',
      operators: [
        { key: 'is_true', i18nKey: '@astryx.powersearch.operator.isTrue', value: { type: 'empty' } },
        { key: 'is_false', i18nKey: '@astryx.powersearch.operator.isFalse', value: { type: 'empty' } },
      ],
    },
  ],
}

const filters = ref<PowerSearchFilter[]>([])
</script>

<template>

en.heading: Install
en.text:
```bash
pnpm add @astryx-vue/richtext
```

`RichTextEditor` is built on Lexical. Install `lexical` and the `@lexical/*` packages required by the features you use, all pinned to `0.52.0`.

en.heading: Create an editor
en.text:
Import the stylesheet once in your application entry, then render `RichTextEditor`. The required `label` prop provides the editor's accessible name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RichTextEditor } from '@astryx-vue/richtext'
import '@astryx-vue/richtext/richtext.css'
</script>

<template>
  <RichTextEditor label="Publish content" placeholder="Write something..." />
</template>
```

Add `RichTextEditorToolbar` through the `#toolbar` slot to provide undo, block formats, inline styles, and link actions. The toolbar scrolls horizontally when space is limited.

en.heading: Save and display content
en.text:
The editor and read-only view use the same Lexical state JSON:

1. Listen to the editor's `@change` event and save `editorState.toJSON()` to your backend.
2. To edit the content again, pass the saved JSON string to `defaultValue`. This prop is read only when the editor mounts.
3. For read-only display, pass the same string to `RichTextView` through `value` instead of rendering a read-only editor.

When you register custom nodes through `nodes`, register the same set on both the editor and the read-only view so content round-trips without data loss.

en.heading: Keyboard commands
en.text:
At the end of a code block or table, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> inserts a paragraph when no content follows or when another code block or table immediately follows. This lets you place prose between these blocks. When ordinary content already follows, the arrow keys retain Lexical's native navigation.

- Insert a newline inside a code block: Insert a newline inside a code block
- Move between table cells: Move between table cells
- Create and move to a paragraph below a code block or table: Create and move to a paragraph below a code block or table
- Open or close the link dialog: Open or close the link dialog
- Leave the editor: Leave the editor

en.heading: Automatic links and server-side conversion
en.text:
Place `RichTextEditorAutoLinkPlugin` in the editor's default slot to turn typed URLs and email addresses into links. Use `matchers` to add custom matching rules.

To convert Markdown on the server, import `markdownToEditorStateJSON` and `editorStateJSONToMarkdown` from `@astryx-vue/richtext/markdown`. Neither function requires a browser DOM.

See the [props documentation](/en/components/rich-text-editor/props) for all properties, events, and slots.

en.heading: `<RichTextEditor>` props
en.text:
- **Events**: `@change="(editorState, editor) => void"` fires when content changes, used for saving state.
- **Slots**: `#toolbar` top toolbar slot; `#default` internal plugin slot (such as placing `<RichTextEditorAutoLinkPlugin>`).
- **Template ref methods**: `focus()` focuses; `clear()` clears; `getEditorState()` gets state; `getMarkdown()` exports Markdown; `getHTML()` exports HTML; `getEditor()` gets underlying Lexical instance.

en.heading: `<RichTextEditorToolbar>` props and slots
en.text: - **Slots**: `#end` custom slot at the end, rendered to the right of default buttons.

en.heading: `<RichTextView>` props, events and slots
en.text:
- **Events**: `@parseError="(error: Error) => void"` fires when parsing content fails.
- **Slots**: `#errorFallback` fallback content when parsing fails; `#default` internal extension slot.

zh.heading: 安装
zh.text:
```bash
pnpm add @astryx-vue/richtext
```

`RichTextEditor` 基于 Lexical。你还需要根据所用功能自行安装 `lexical` 和相应的 `@lexical/*` 子包，版本统一为 `0.52.0`。

zh.heading: 创建编辑器
zh.text:
在应用入口引入一次样式，然后渲染 `RichTextEditor`。`label` 是必填属性，用于标识编辑器的无障碍名称。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RichTextEditor } from '@astryx-vue/richtext'
import '@astryx-vue/richtext/richtext.css'
</script>

<template>
  <RichTextEditor label="发布内容" placeholder="请输入正文..." />
</template>
```

通过 `#toolbar` 插槽加入 `RichTextEditorToolbar`，即可获得撤销、块格式、行内样式和链接操作。工具栏空间不足时会横向滚动。

zh.heading: 保存并展示内容
zh.text:
编辑器和只读视图使用同一份 Lexical 状态 JSON：

1. 监听编辑器的 `@change`，将 `editorState.toJSON()` 保存到后端。
2. 再次编辑时，把保存的 JSON 字符串传给 `defaultValue`。该属性只在挂载时读取。
3. 只读展示时，把同一个字符串传给 `RichTextView` 的 `value`，不要再渲染一个只读编辑器。

如果通过 `nodes` 注册自定义节点，编辑器和只读视图必须注册同一组节点，否则内容无法完整往返。

zh.heading: 键盘操作
zh.text:
光标位于代码块或表格末尾时，<kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> 会在下方没有内容，或者下方紧邻另一个代码块或表格时插入段落。这样可以在这两类块之间补充正文；下方已经是普通内容时，方向键沿用 Lexical 的原生导航。

- 在代码块中换行: 在代码块中换行
- 在表格单元格之间移动: 在表格单元格之间移动
- 在代码块或表格末尾创建并进入下方段落: 在代码块或表格末尾创建并进入下方段落
- 打开或关闭链接对话框: 打开或关闭链接对话框
- 离开整个编辑器: 离开整个编辑器

zh.heading: 自动链接与服务端转换
zh.text:
将 `RichTextEditorAutoLinkPlugin` 放入编辑器默认插槽，可以把输入的网址和邮箱自动转换为链接；通过 `matchers` 可以扩展匹配规则。

需要在服务端读写 Markdown 时，从 `@astryx-vue/richtext/markdown` 导入 `markdownToEditorStateJSON` 和 `editorStateJSONToMarkdown`。这两个函数不依赖浏览器 DOM。

完整的属性、事件和插槽见[属性文档](/components/rich-text-editor/props)。

zh.heading: `<RichTextEditor>` 属性
zh.text:
- **事件**：`@change="(editorState, editor) => void"` 在内容改变时触发，用于保存状态。
- **插槽**：`#toolbar` 顶部工具栏插槽；`#default` 内部插件插槽（如放置 `<RichTextEditorAutoLinkPlugin>`）。
- **模板引用方法**：`focus()` 聚焦；`clear()` 清空；`getEditorState()` 获取状态；`getMarkdown()` 导出 Markdown；`getHTML()` 导出 HTML；`getEditor()` 获取底层 Lexical 实例。

zh.heading: `<RichTextEditorToolbar>` 属性与插槽
zh.text: - **插槽**：`#end` 尾部自定义插槽，渲染在默认按钮右侧。

zh.heading: `<RichTextView>` 属性、事件与插槽
zh.text:
- **事件**：`@parseError="(error: Error) => void"` 在内容解析失败时触发。
- **插槽**：`#errorFallback` 解析失败时的降级显示内容；`#default` 内部扩展插槽。

summary.en: Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.
summary.zh: 指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

usage.en:
Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxIndicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxIndicator state="indeterminate" size="sm" />
</template>
```

The box draws in every state. Unchecked is an empty box, not an empty gap. A mixed state draws a short bar.

For a control the user can operate, use [CheckboxInput](/en/components/checkbox-input). The check and the circle are [Check Indicator](/en/components/check-indicator) and [Radio Indicator](/en/components/radio-indicator).
usage.zh:
指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxIndicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxIndicator state="indeterminate" size="sm" />
</template>
```

方框每种状态都画。未选中是空盒子，不是留白。半选画一条短线。

需要用户操作时，使用 [复选框](/components/checkbox-input)。勾和圆点分别是 [勾选指示器](/components/check-indicator) 和 [单选指示器](/components/radio-indicator)。

en.text: Restyle the stable class first. Replacing the component is the heavier path, for when the shape itself is wrong.

Decide whether slot content replaces the mark with isRenderable, not a null check. The helper is shallow: it excludes null, undefined, booleans, and the empty string. An element still counts when its descendants later render nothing. A host writes a spinner with v-if="busy". When that condition is false, a null check deletes the state mark.
A replacement must set aria-hidden. The owning control provides the role and the accessible name. A visible indicator would be announced twice.
Use theme tokens for every color, radius, and border width in a replacement.

Render a single root element, and let it keep the border radius the focus ring should follow. The control paints that ring onto the indicator when the real input is visually hidden. The ring is never missing. It is only the wrong shape if the root has no radius of its own. Do not draw a second ring.
Pass hover or pressed state in as props. Hover reaches the graphic through the ancestor class astryx-indicator-scope, so hovering the row tints the control with no props involved.

Assume the graphic is mounted only when it is selected. The host renders it in every state and passes state. That is what lets a replacement draw where the default draws nothing, such as an empty circle on an unchosen row. Drawing nothing in a state is the indicator's decision.

zh.text: 先改稳定的类名。形状本身不对时，再替换组件。
用 isRenderable 判断插槽是否替换标记，不要用空值判断。它只排除空值、布尔值和空字符串。元素算数，哪怕里面后来是空的。宿主用 v-if="busy" 放转圈。条件为假时，空值判断会把状态标记删掉。
替换图形必须隐藏起来。角色和名称由外面的控件提供，再宣布一次就会读两遍。
替换图形里的颜色、圆角和边框宽度都用主题变量。
只渲染一个根元素，并保留焦点环要跟着走的圆角。真正的输入被藏起来时，控件把焦点环画在指示器上。环不会丢，只是根元素没有圆角时形状会不对。不要再自己画一圈。
把悬停或按下当成属性传进去。悬停通过祖先上的 astryx-indicator-scope 到达图形，移到行上就会变色。
以为只有选中时才会挂上图形。宿主每种状态都会渲染，并传入状态。替换图形才能在默认什么都不画的地方画出来，比如未选中行上的空心圆。某种状态不画，是指示器自己的决定。

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: Required. The visual state.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Indicator size.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Shows disabled styling.

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: 必需，要展示的标记状态。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 指示器尺寸，md 为 24px，sm 为 20px。

en.heading: Anatomy
en.text:
- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required. The persistent box or circle drawn by the checkbox and radio indicators in every state. The check indicator is the state mark itself and has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The checkmark, the indeterminate bar, or the radio dot shown inside the chrome for the current state.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the checkmark and the dash, drawn inside the box.
- An empty slot, including a condition that is false, keeps the marks. Use isRenderable rather than a null check.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in the slot.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- The root always has `aria-hidden="true"`.
- The component has no interactive role.
- It ignores `role`, `tabindex` and `contenteditable` attributes.
- It provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- The exposed `element` is `HTMLSpanElement | null`.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
The indicator shares color variables with [CheckboxInput](/en/components/checkbox-input/props#theme).

- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator`: outer box.
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-check`: checkmark.
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-dash`: indeterminate mark.
- `data-state`: current visual state.
- `data-size`: current size.
- `data-disabled`: disabled state.

zh.heading: 结构
zh.text:
- 外框（方框、圆点）: 外框（方框、圆点）
- 状态标记: 状态标记

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽替换勾和半选短线，画在方框里面。
- 插槽为空，包括条件不成立时，标记还在。用 isRenderable，不要用空值判断。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不得在插槽中放入可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 根元素固定为 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 组件不设置交互角色。
- 组件不接收 `role`、`tabindex` 或 `contenteditable`。
- 组件不提供点击事件或键盘行为。
- 模板引用的 `element` 是 `HTMLSpanElement | null`。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
指示器与 [CheckboxInput](/components/checkbox-input/props#主题) 共用颜色变量。

- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator`：指示器外框。
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-check`：勾选标记。
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-dash`：半选标记。
- `data-state`：当前显示状态。
- `data-size`：当前尺寸。
- `data-disabled`：禁用状态。

summary.en: Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.
summary.zh: 指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

usage.en:
Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/Indicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckIndicator state="checked" />
</template>
```

This is the mark on a chosen option. Unchecked, and with nothing in the slot, it renders nothing, so a list shows no empty box beside every row. It has no chrome of its own. It is the glyph, so a class passed by the host lands on the same element as the icon.

Map this name to [Radio Indicator](/en/components/radio-indicator) when every single-selection mark should be a circle, including the empty circle on an unchosen row. The box is [Checkbox Indicator](/en/components/checkbox-indicator).
usage.zh:
指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/Indicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckIndicator state="checked" />
</template>
```

这是选中项上的标记。未选中、插槽里又没有内容时，它什么都不渲染，列表不会在每一行旁边留一个空盒子。它没有自己的外框，本身就是那枚图形，所以宿主传入的类会落在图标同一个元素上。

想让所有单选标记都变成圆点时，把这个名字映射到 [单选指示器](/components/radio-indicator)。没选中的行也会画出空心圆。方框是 [复选指示器](/components/checkbox-indicator)。

en.text: Restyle the stable class first. Replacing the component is the heavier path, for when the shape itself is wrong.

Decide whether slot content replaces the mark with isRenderable, not a null check. The helper is shallow: it excludes null, undefined, booleans, and the empty string. An element still counts when its descendants later render nothing. A host writes a spinner with v-if="busy". When that condition is false, a null check deletes the chosen check.
A replacement must set aria-hidden. The owning control provides the role and the accessible name. A visible indicator would be announced twice.
Use theme tokens for every color, radius, and border width in a replacement.

Render a single root element, and let it keep the border radius the focus ring should follow. The control paints that ring onto the indicator when the real input is visually hidden. Do not draw a second ring.
Pass hover or pressed state in as props. Hover reaches the graphic through the ancestor class astryx-indicator-scope.
Assume the graphic is mounted only when it is selected. The host renders it in every state and passes state. That is what lets a replacement draw an empty circle on an unchosen row.

zh.text: 先改稳定的类名。形状本身不对时，再替换组件。
用 isRenderable 判断插槽是否替换标记，不要用空值判断。它只排除空值、布尔值和空字符串。元素算数，哪怕里面后来是空的。宿主用 v-if="busy" 放转圈。条件为假时，空值判断会把已选中的勾删掉。
替换图形必须隐藏起来。角色和名称由外面的控件提供，再宣布一次就会读两遍。
替换图形里的颜色、圆角和边框宽度都用主题变量。
只渲染一个根元素，并保留焦点环要跟着走的圆角。真正的输入被藏起来时，控件把焦点环画在指示器上。不要再自己画一圈。
把悬停或按下当成属性传进去。悬停通过祖先上的 astryx-indicator-scope 到达图形。
以为只有选中时才会挂上图形。宿主每种状态都会渲染，并传入状态。替换图形才能在未选中的行上画出空心圆。

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: Required. The default draws nothing when unchecked. A replacement may draw in both states.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Recorded on the element. The glyph itself is 1rem at both sizes, matching the small icon.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Visual only. The chosen glyph uses the disabled icon color. The owning row keeps the disabled semantics.

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: 必需。默认在未选中时什么都不画。替换图形可以两种状态都画。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 写到元素上。图形本身两种尺寸都是 1rem，和小图标一致。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 只改变外观。选中的图形用禁用色。禁用的语义留在外面的行上。

en.heading: Anatomy
en.text:
- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required on the box and the circle, which draw in every state. The check indicator is the state mark itself and has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The checkmark shown when the option is chosen. Unchecked draws nothing unless the slot has something renderable.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the mark in every state, chosen or not. A host passes a pending spinner through it.
- When the slot has something renderable, a 1rem box holds the place.
- With nothing renderable, an unchosen check renders nothing. Use isRenderable. A false condition must not delete a chosen check.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in it.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- The root is `aria-hidden="true"` when the check is drawn or the slot occupies its place.
- The component sets no interactive role and provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- A passed role, tab order, content editable flag, or attribute whose name starts with aria is dropped.
- The exposed element is empty when the mark is unchosen and the slot is empty.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
There is no chrome class. A chosen check is the icon. A slot is `.astryx-check-indicator`, 1rem square.

- Checked uses the accent icon color. Disabled uses the disabled icon color.
- `data-size` is sm or md.
- `data-disabled` is set when the row is disabled.

zh.heading: 结构
zh.text:
- 外框（方框、圆点）: 外框（方框、圆点）
- 状态标记: 状态标记

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽在每种状态都替换标记，选中与否都一样。宿主用它传入等待中的转圈。
- 插槽里有可渲染内容时，用 1rem 的盒子占住位置。
- 没有可渲染内容时，未选中的勾不渲染。用 isRenderable 判断。条件为假时不能把已选中的勾删掉。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不要放可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 勾被画出来，或插槽占住位置时，根元素是 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 组件不设置交互角色，也不提供点击或键盘行为。
- 传入的角色、Tab 顺序、可编辑属性，以及以 aria 开头的属性会被丢掉。
- 未选中且插槽为空时，暴露的元素为空。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
没有外框类。选中的勾就是图标本身。插槽占位是 `.astryx-check-indicator`，宽高 1rem。

- 选中用强调色图标，禁用用禁用色。
- `data-size` 是 sm 或 md。
- 行禁用时设置 `data-disabled`。

description.en: Unchecked reserves no box. Checked draws the glyph at both sizes. Disabled uses the disabled icon color.
description.zh: 未选中不留盒子。选中时两种尺寸都画这枚图形。禁用时用禁用色。

description.en: The same row of marks. The left card is the default check. Inside the theme on the right, that name draws a circle, including the empty circle when nothing is chosen.
description.zh: 同一行标记。左边是默认的勾。右边包在主题里之后变成圆点，没选中也会画出空心圆。

description.en: A spinner in the slot holds the check's place whether or not the row is chosen. Turning it off removes that place when the row is unchosen.
description.zh: 插槽里的转圈会占住勾的位置，选中与否都一样。关掉之后，未选中的行不再占位。

summary.en: A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across Astryx. Use it wherever you need a structured row: dropdown menus, selectors, contact lists, notifications, file browsers, and activity feeds.
summary.zh: 整个组件库里通用的「一行东西」：前面放内容、中间放名字和说明、后面再放内容。下拉菜单、选择器、联系人列表、通知、文件浏览、动态流，凡是要一行一行排的，都从它开始。

usage.en:
A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across Astryx. Use it wherever you need a structured row: dropdown menus, selectors, contact lists, notifications, file browsers, and activity feeds.

```ts
import { Item } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
```

Everything else that looks like a row is built from this one. [List Item](/en/components/list-item) adds the list element and the marker; menus, selectors, and result rows wrap it with the role their parent owns. The row paints nothing beyond text and slots, so the surrounding surface decides how it looks.
usage.zh:
整个组件库里通用的「一行东西」：前面放内容、中间放名字和说明、后面再放内容。下拉菜单、选择器、联系人列表、通知、文件浏览、动态流，凡是要一行一行排的，都从它开始。

```ts
import { Item } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
```

别的看起来像一行的东西都是拿它拼的。[列表项](/components/list-item) 在外面加了列表元素和行首标记；菜单、选择器、下拉结果各自补上父级要求的角色。这一行自己除了文字和插槽什么都不画，长什么样由外面那层面板决定。

en.text: Use named slots (`startContent`, `label`, `description`, `endContent`) for the common layout. These cover the 80% case.
Use `density="compact"` for menus and dense lists, `"balanced"` for standard rows, and `"spacious"` for roomier layouts.
Set `labelLines` and `descriptionLines` to control truncation when content length varies.
Use `align="start"` when start or end content is taller than a single line of text.
Give a swipe action a second home in the row (a menu or a button in `endContent`): the swipe is a touch accelerator, and a verb reachable only by swipe is unreachable by keyboard and by mouse.
Don't nest interactive elements (buttons, links) inside an interactive `Item`; it creates confusing focus and click targets.
Don't use `Item` for navigation between views; use proper navigation components instead.
Don't add read/unread or inbox-specific behavior directly; compose a thin wrapper like PreviewItem instead.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 这一行的主文字。写字符串或数字时只显示一行；要放别的内容就用 `label` 插槽。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 主文字下面那行小字，同样只显示一行。要多行或者放别的内容就用 `description` 插槽。

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: 根元素渲染成什么。只有在这一行自带 `role`、键盘交给父级管、并且行里不会多出一个 Tab 停留点时，才传组件；另外 `startContent` 和 `endContent` 里也不能放控件。

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: 前面和后面那两块内容竖直方向怎么对齐。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 疏密。`compact` 上下各 4px，`balanced` 8px，`spacious` 上下左右各 12px。

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: `stacked` 让说明单独占一行。`inline` 把说明和主文字放同一行，空间不够先截断说明，这样这一行能塞进高度固定的容器。

rows.name: `labelLines`
rows.description: 主文字最多显示几行，超过就用省略号。不传时，字符串主文字只显示一行。

rows.name: `descriptionLines`
rows.description: 说明最多显示几行，超过就用省略号。不传时，字符串说明只显示一行。

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: 点了之后做什么。给了它就渲染一个铺满行内容区的按钮，这一行也就有了按钮语义和悬停、按下样式。模板里写 `@click`。

rows.name: `interactiveRef`
rows.description: 指向行里那个本来就能操作的控件，比如 `startContent` 里的复选框。这时整行变成更大的点击区域，点行面就转给那个控件，行自己不再渲染按钮。它和 `onClick`、`href` 只能用一个，写了它那两个会被忽略。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 链接地址。行里会渲染一个链接元素。如果根元素本身就是链接组件（见 `as`），地址直接挂在根上，不再多画一个元素。

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: 链接在哪打开，只有写了 `href` 才有用。`_blank` 会自动补上 `noopener` 和 `noreferrer`。

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: 链接的 rel 值，会和自动补的那些合在一起。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用。这一行不动了，内容变淡。

rows.name: `isSelected`
rows.description: 选中状态。行的角色支持时写成 `aria-selected="true"`，不支持时写成 `aria-current="true"`。

rows.name: `isHighlighted`
rows.description: 画出高亮状态，就是键盘聚焦和鼠标悬停时那个样子。

rows.name: `swipeActions`
rows.description: 手指横滑能露出哪些操作，左右各一组，越靠后越靠外，每项是 `{ label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?, hasRemoval? }`。鼠标不会触发这次拖动。只有角色允许行内有可交互元素的才行，选项、菜单项、原生单选按钮的放大目标行都不能用。

rows.name: `swipeBehavior`
rows.description: `reveal` 松手后行停在滑开的位置，露出来的每项都是真按钮，拖得够远就触发最外面那个；`commit` 直接把行滑出去，松手就触发，什么都不留在屏幕上。

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `marker`: content before `startContent`, such as a list bullet or a counter.
- `startContent`: leading visual, such as an avatar, an icon, an image, or a checkbox.
- `label`: rich content replacing the `label` prop.
- `description`: rich content replacing the `description` prop.
- `endContent`: end-aligned content, such as badges, timestamps, or action buttons.

en.heading: Exposed
en.text: `element` (the root element), `focus()`, and `blur()`. Focusing lands on the control inside the row that can actually take focus.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 常见排版用带名字的插槽（`startContent`、`label`、`description`、`endContent`），八成的场景这样写就够了。
- 推荐: 菜单和密集列表用 `density="compact"`，普通行用 `"balanced"`，宽松布局用 `"spacious"`。
- 推荐: 内容长短不固定时，用 `labelLines` 和 `descriptionLines` 控制在第几行截断。
- 推荐: 前面或后面的内容比一行字更高时，用 `align="start"` 让它顶部对齐。
- 推荐: 横滑出来的操作要在行里再留一个入口（菜单，或者 `endContent` 里的按钮）。横滑只是给手指的快捷方式，只能滑出来的操作，键盘和鼠标用户永远够不着。
- 避免: 不要在可点的 `Item` 里再套按钮或链接。焦点和点击目标会变得难猜。
- 避免: 不要拿 `Item` 做页面之间的跳转。那种场景用导航组件。
- 避免: 不要把已读未读、收件箱之类的业务逻辑直接塞进来。包一层薄薄的组件（类似 PreviewItem）更好。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `marker`：排在 `startContent` 前面，比如列表的圆点或者序号。
- `startContent`：前面那块，比如头像、图标、图片、复选框。
- `label`：自己画主文字，替掉 `label` 属性。
- `description`：自己画说明，替掉 `description` 属性。
- `endContent`：末尾对齐的那块，比如徽章、时间、操作按钮。

zh.heading: 暴露
zh.text: `element`（根元素）、`focus()` 和 `blur()`。聚焦会落到行里那个真正能接焦点的控件上。

description.en: A basic item with a label, supporting description, and end-aligned timestamp. Use this for simple rows that need consistent text alignment and spacing.

description.en: Single-row, horizontally scrollable document switcher with compact selected rows, leading file icons, instant reveal-on-hover close actions with reserved geometry, stable separators, and an add control outside the scroll area. Use for editor tabs, workspace tabs, open documents, files, canvases, or panels.

import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'

const tabs = [
  { name: 'Project brief', isActive: true },
  { name: 'Research notes', isActive: false },
  { name: 'Interaction prototype', isActive: false },
]

function onSelect(): void {}
function onClose(): void {}
function onAdd(): void {}
</script>

<template>
  <HStack align="center" class="item-tabs" :gap="0.5">
    <HStack
      align="center"
      class="item-tabs__strip"
      role="group"

      :padding-inline="2"

      is-scrollable

        <Divider v-if="index > 0" orientation="vertical" class="item-tabs__rule" />
        <Item
          class="item-tabs__tab"
          :label="tab.name"
          density="compact"
          :is-selected="tab.isActive"

              icon="i-carbon-document"

    </HStack>

<style scoped>

summary.en: Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.
summary.zh: 指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

usage.en:
Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RadioIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/Indicator'
</script>

<template>
  <RadioIndicator state="checked" />
</template>
```

The circle draws in both states. Unchecked is an empty circle, which is what lets it stand in for a check in a selection slot. There is no mixed state. Inside a radio that has no size, the circle stays 18px and the dot stays 8px. On its own, sm is 20px and md is 24px.

The box is [Checkbox Indicator](/en/components/checkbox-indicator). The mark you replace to get this circle everywhere is [Check Indicator](/en/components/check-indicator).
usage.zh:
指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RadioIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/Indicator'
</script>

<template>
  <RadioIndicator state="checked" />
</template>
```

圆点两种状态都画。未选中是空心圆，所以它能替到勾的位置上。没有半选。放在没有尺寸的单选按钮里时，圆是 18px，点是 8px。单独使用时，小尺寸是 20px，中等尺寸是 24px。

方框是 [复选指示器](/components/checkbox-indicator)。想让各处的勾都变成这个圆点时，替换的是 [勾选指示器](/components/check-indicator)。

en.text: Restyle the stable class first. Replacing the component is the heavier path, for when the shape itself is wrong.
Decide whether slot content replaces the mark with isRenderable, not a null check. An empty slot, including a condition that is false, keeps the circle and its dot.
A replacement must set aria-hidden. The owning control provides the role and the accessible name. A visible indicator would be announced twice.
Use theme tokens for every color, radius, and border width in a replacement.
Render a single root element, and let it keep the border radius the focus ring should follow. The radio paints that ring onto the circle when the real input is focused. Do not draw a second ring.
Pass hover or pressed state in as props. Hover reaches the circle through the ancestor class astryx-indicator-scope.
Assume the graphic is mounted only when it is selected. The host renders the empty circle too. That is what lets it replace a check, which draws nothing when unchosen.

zh.text: 先改稳定的类名。形状本身不对时，再替换组件。
用 isRenderable 判断插槽是否替换标记，不要用空值判断。插槽为空，包括条件不成立时，圆圈和内点都还在。
替换图形必须隐藏起来。角色和名称由外面的控件提供，再宣布一次就会读两遍。
替换图形里的颜色、圆角和边框宽度都用主题变量。
只渲染一个根元素，并保留焦点环要跟着走的圆角。真正的输入聚焦时，单选按钮把焦点环画在圆圈上。不要再自己画一圈。
把悬停或按下当成属性传进去。悬停通过祖先上的 astryx-indicator-scope 到达圆圈。
以为只有选中时才会挂上图形。宿主也会渲染空心圆。勾在未选中时什么都不画，圆点才能替上去。

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: Required. Single selection has no mixed state. Unchecked draws an empty circle.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 20px or 24px. The inner dot is 8px or 10px. Omit it inside a radio that has no size, and the circle stays 18px.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Visual only. The circle fades and an empty one uses the muted background. The owning control keeps the disabled semantics.

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: 必需。单选没有半选。未选中画空心圆。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 20px 或 24px。内点是 8px 或 10px。放在没有尺寸的单选按钮里时不要传，圆保持 18px。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 只改变外观。圆圈变淡，空心圆用柔和背景。禁用的语义留在外面的控件上。

en.heading: Anatomy
en.text:
- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required. The persistent circle drawn in every state. The check indicator has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The filled inner dot, shown only when the circle is chosen.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the inner dot and is drawn inside the circle.
- An empty slot, including a condition that is false, keeps the circle and the dot.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in it.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- The root always has `aria-hidden="true"`.
- The component sets no interactive role and provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- A passed role, tab order, content editable flag, or attribute whose name starts with aria is dropped.
- The exposed element is the circle.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
- `.astryx-radio-indicator`: the circle.
- `.astryx-radio-indicator-dot`: the inner dot when chosen.
- `data-state`: unchecked or checked.
- `data-size`: sm or md. Omitted when no size is passed.
- `data-disabled`: disabled styling.

A chosen circle uses the input status color first, so a field error or warning still tints it, then the accent color. Hover comes from an ancestor `.astryx-indicator-scope`, and only for a pointer that can hover. Reduced motion turns the transition off. In forced colors, an empty circle uses the canvas color and a chosen circle uses the highlight.

The focus ring is painted by the radio on `.astryx-radio-native:focus-visible + .astryx-radio-indicator`. The circle's radius is what that outline follows.

zh.heading: 结构
zh.text:
- 外框（方框、圆点）: 外框（方框、圆点）
- 状态标记: 状态标记

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽替换内点，画在圆圈里面。
- 插槽为空，包括条件不成立时，圆圈和内点都还在。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不要放可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 根元素固定为 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 组件不设置交互角色，也不提供点击或键盘行为。
- 传入的角色、Tab 顺序、可编辑属性，以及以 aria 开头的属性会被丢掉。
- 暴露的元素是圆圈本身。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
- `.astryx-radio-indicator`：圆圈。
- `.astryx-radio-indicator-dot`：选中后的内点。
- `data-state`：unchecked 或 checked。
- `data-size`：sm 或 md。没传尺寸时不写。
- `data-disabled`：禁用外观。

选中色先看输入状态色，这样字段的错误和警告仍能着色，否则用强调色。悬停通过祖先上的 `.astryx-indicator-scope` 生效，只在可以悬停的指针上变色。减少动态效果时过渡关掉。强制颜色模式下，未选中用画布色，选中用高亮色。

焦点环由单选按钮画在 `.astryx-radio-native:focus-visible + .astryx-radio-indicator` 上。描边跟着圆圈自己的圆角走。

description.en: Empty and filled circles at sm and md, including disabled. Unchecked stays an empty circle.
description.zh: 小尺寸和中等尺寸的空心圆与实心圆，包括禁用。未选中始终是空心圆。

summary.en: `Center` puts its content in a flex container and aligns it to the middle of that box on one axis or on both. It is layout only: it paints nothing, draws no border, and adds no role or accessible name to the content, so empty states, loading screens, and login forms all fit without any extra markup.
summary.zh: `Center` 把内容放进一个弹性容器，并沿一条轴或两条轴把它居中。它只做布局：自己不上色、不画边框，也不给内容附加任何角色或名称，因此空状态、加载页、登录表单这类"内容需要在可用空间里居中"的场景都可以直接使用。

usage.en: `Center` puts its content in a flex container and aligns it to the middle of that box on one axis or on both. It is layout only: it paints nothing, draws no border, and adds no role or accessible name to the content, so empty states, loading screens, and login forms all fit without any extra markup. By default it centers on both axes: ```vue ``` Everything in the slot is centered as one block: `Center` never distributes space between several children. When you need to arrange multiple items along a direction, use `Stack` instead. `axis` selects which axis is centered. `both` (the default) centers the main and the cross axis, `horizontal` centers the inline direction only, and `vertical` centers the block direction only. The two single-axis values are named after horizontal writing; they end up on flex alignment, so in vertical writing they follow the flex main and cross axes. Centering an axis only shows when that axis has space to give, which is why `both` and `vertical` usually need a `height` — without one the container is only as tall as its content and looks exactly like an uncentered box. ```vue ``` The size of the container comes from `width`, `height`, `maxWidth`, and `minHeight`. Numbers are interpreted as pixels and strings pass through as CSS values, so `width="100%"` and `maxWidth="70rem"` both work. Padding uses the same spacing scale as `Stack`: `padding` sets all four edges, `paddingInline` and `paddingBlock` override their own axis, and `paddingInlineStart`, `paddingInlineEnd`, `paddingBlockStart`, and `paddingBlockEnd` override a single edge. The most specific input wins, and `0` is a real value, so it can clear the inset set by a broader one. `isInline` renders the container as `inline-flex`. It then takes part in the surrounding line of text instead of breaking the line box, which is what you want for a fixed-size box that centers an icon or a badge.
usage.zh: `Center` 把内容放进一个弹性容器，并沿一条轴或两条轴把它居中。它只做布局：自己不上色、不画边框，也不给内容附加任何角色或名称，因此空状态、加载页、登录表单这类"内容需要在可用空间里居中"的场景都可以直接使用。 默认同时在两条轴上居中： ```vue ``` 插槽里的内容被当作一个整体居中，`Center` 不会在多个子元素之间分配间距。需要沿某个方向排列多项时，请改用 `Stack`。 `axis` 决定居中哪条轴。`both`（默认值）同时居中主轴与交叉轴，`horizontal` 只居中行内方向，`vertical` 只居中块方向。后两个取值是按横向书写命名的：它们最终落在 flex 的对齐属性上，所以在纵向书写下跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴。单轴居中只有在对应方向上有可分配的空间时才看得出效果，因此 `both` 和 `vertical` 通常需要给出 `height`，否则容器只有内容那么高，视觉上和没有居中一样。 ```vue ``` 容器自身的尺寸由 `width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight` 控制。数字按像素处理，字符串按原样作为 CSS 值使用，例如 `width="100%"` 或 `maxWidth="70rem"`。内边距沿用与 `Stack` 相同的间距刻度：`padding` 设置四边，`paddingInline`、`paddingBlock` 覆盖各自的轴，`paddingInlineStart`、`paddingInlineEnd`、`paddingBlockStart`、`paddingBlockEnd` 再覆盖单条边。越具体的那一层生效，`0` 同样是有效取值，可以显式清掉上一层设置的内边距。 `isInline` 会把容器换成 `inline-flex`。这时它作为行内元素参与文字排版，不会打断行盒，适合给图标或角标做一个固定大小的小方块。

en.text: Use a single-axis value only in horizontal writing, or after checking which writing mode is active. Outside horizontal writing, a single-axis value follows the flex main and cross axes rather than the name of the prop.
Give `height` when you use `axis="vertical"` or the default `both` in horizontal writing. Centering needs space to distribute, and a container that is only as tall as its content shows no change.
Use `isInline` for small elements such as icons and badges. The box stays inside the current line, so the text around it is not broken.
Keep the semantic structure and the accessible names on the content. `Center` is a layout-only container: it adds no role and no label, so the content stays responsible for both.
Wrap whole page sections in `Center`. Page structure belongs to the surrounding layout; `Center` solves the centering of one block.
Use `Center` for horizontal lists of items. Several items in a row are clearer with `Stack` and `hAlign="center"`.

zh.text: 只在横向书写的界面里使用单轴取值，或者确认当前书写模式后再用。纵向书写时单轴取值跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴，而不是属性名的字面含义。
在横向书写下用 `axis="vertical"` 或默认的 `both` 时给出 `height`。居中需要有可分配的空间，容器只有内容那么高时看不出任何变化。
行内的小元素（图标、角标）用 `isInline` 居中，这样它仍然属于当前行，文字排版不会被拆断。
把语义结构和无障碍名称留在内容上。`Center` 是纯布局容器，不会添加角色或标签，内容自己负责这些信息。
用 `Center` 承担整页结构。页面骨架应该由外层布局决定，`Center` 只解决一块内容的居中。
用 `Center` 横向排列表格、列表等多项内容。多项排列用 `Stack` 配合 `hAlign="center"` 更直接。

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: Which axis to center. both centers the main and the cross axis, horizontal centers the inline direction only, and vertical centers the block direction only. A single-axis value ends up on flex alignment, so outside horizontal writing it follows the flex main and cross axes.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Container width. Numbers are interpreted as pixels, strings pass through as CSS values.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Container height. Numbers are interpreted as pixels. Vertical centering needs height to distribute, so the default both and vertical usually use it.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum container width. Numbers are interpreted as pixels.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum container height. Numbers are interpreted as pixels.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Inner padding on all four edges, using the Astryx spacing scale.

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: Inline-axis padding; overrides padding on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: Inline-start padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingInline and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: Inline-end padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingInline and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: Block-axis padding; overrides padding on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: Block-start padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingBlock and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode.

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: Block-end padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingBlock and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode.

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: Render as inline-flex, so the container stays in a line of text. Useful for centering small elements such as icons and badges.

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: 居中哪条轴。both 同时居中主轴与交叉轴，horizontal 只居中行内方向，vertical 只居中块方向。单轴取值落在 flex 的对齐属性上，纵向书写时跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 容器宽度。数字按像素处理，字符串按原样作为 CSS 值使用。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 容器高度。数字按像素处理。垂直居中需要有可分配的高度，所以默认的 both 和 vertical 通常会用到它。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 容器最大宽度。数字按像素处理。

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: 容器最小高度。数字按像素处理。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 四边的内边距，使用 Astryx 间距刻度。

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: 行内轴内边距，覆盖该轴上的 padding。

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: 行内起始边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingInline 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式和方向。

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: 行内结束边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingInline 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式和方向。

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: 块轴内边距，覆盖该轴上的 padding。

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: 块起始边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingBlock 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式。

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: 块结束边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingBlock 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式。

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: 使用 inline-flex 渲染，容器因此留在文字行内，适合居中图标或角标这类小元素。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The content to center. It is centered as one block: Center adds no space between several children and changes none of their semantics, colors, or reading order.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 要居中的内容。内容被当作一个整体居中，Center 不会在多个子元素之间分配间距，也不会改变它们各自的语义、颜色或阅读顺序。

en.heading: Props
en.text:
`SpacingStep` accepts these values:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

`Center` writes its own `data-axis` on the root element to reflect the axis in effect; a `data-axis` passed in by a consumer does not replace it.

zh.heading: Props
zh.text:
`SpacingStep` 支持以下值：

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

`Center` 会在根元素上写自己的 `data-axis`，用来反映当前生效的居中轴；消费者传入的同名 `data-axis` 不会覆盖它。

description.en: A formatting toolbar centered on the horizontal axis. In vertical writing, that axis follows flex rather than a guaranteed physical horizontal.
description.zh: 一组格式按钮沿水平轴居中。在竖排书写里，这条轴跟着 flex 主轴走，并不保证物理上的水平居中。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Center } from '@astryx-vue/core/Center'
import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'

const tools = [
  { label: 'Bold', icon: 'i-carbon-text-bold' },
  { label: 'Italic', icon: 'i-carbon-text-italic' },
  { label: 'Underline', icon: 'i-carbon-text-underline' },
  { label: 'List', icon: 'i-carbon-list' },
  { label: 'Link', icon: 'i-carbon-link' },
  { label: 'Image', icon: 'i-carbon-image' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padding="2" :width="520">
    <Center axis="horizontal" width="100%">
      <HStack align="center" :gap="0">
        <IconButton
          v-for="tool in tools"
          :key="tool.label"
          :label="tool.label"
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
        >
          <span class="css-icon css-icon--sm" :class="tool.icon" />
        </IconButton>
      </HStack>
    </Center>
  </Card>
</template>

description.en: An empty state centered both ways inside a fixed-height card. The height is what gives Center room to center.
description.zh: 空状态在固定高度的卡片里同时水平和垂直居中。高度决定了可以分配的居中空间。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Center } from '@astryx-vue/core/Center'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'

en.name: Container
en.description: A flexbox wrapper that aligns its children to the center along the chosen axis.

en.name: Content
en.description: Anything passed in the default slot to Center. Typically a card, form, spinner, or empty state message.

zh.name: 容器
zh.description: 沿所选轴向把内容居中的 flex 容器。

zh.name: 内容
zh.description: 放进 Center 默认插槽的任何东西。常见的是卡片、表单、转圈或空状态。

summary.en: `Divider` separates groups of content with a thin rule. It can carry a centered label.
summary.zh: `Divider` 用一条细线把相关内容分成若干区块，适合在表单、列表或设置项之间做视觉上的划分。需要为分区标注名称时，也可以把简短文字放在线条中间：

usage.en:
`Divider` separates groups of content with a thin rule. It can carry a centered label.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
</script>

<template>
  <Divider label="or" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Divider` 用一条细线把相关内容分成若干区块，适合在表单、列表或设置项之间做视觉上的划分。需要为分区标注名称时，也可以把简短文字放在线条中间：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
</script>

<template>
  <Divider label="或" />
</template>
```

en.text: Use subtle dividers between related content sections and strong dividers for high-contrast boundaries.
Add a label to the divider when sections need a visible category heading.
Overuse dividers; rely on spacing and layout to separate content when possible.

zh.text: 相关内容区块之间使用 `subtle` 分隔线；需要更醒目的边界时，改用 `strong`。
分区需要一个可见的类别标题时，为分隔线添加 `label`，文字会居中显示在线条上。
避免密集使用分隔线：能用留白和排版区分内容时，优先使用间距而不是线条。

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: Orientation of the divider.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Text centered on the divider. Also used as the accessible name. Numeric zero stays visible; an empty string does not.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Line weight. strong uses the emphasized border color.

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: Extend to the container edges with negative margins.

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: 分隔线的方向，垂直分隔线适合放在固定高度的行内。

rows.name: `label`

summary.en: `Grid` arranges its children into rows and columns with CSS grid. It solves two-dimensional layout: card galleries, dashboard panels, and any region where several columns have to line up. One-dimensional arrangement belongs to the `Stack` family; reach for `Grid` when rows and columns both matter.
summary.zh: `Grid` 用 CSS 网格把子元素排进行和列，解决的是二维布局：卡片墙、仪表盘面板，以及任何需要多列对齐的区域。一维排布交给 `Stack` 系列，只有当行和列都要对齐时才换成 `Grid`。

usage.en: `Grid` arranges its children into rows and columns with CSS grid. It solves two-dimensional layout: card galleries, dashboard panels, and any region where several columns have to line up. One-dimensional arrangement belongs to the `Stack` family; reach for `Grid` when rows and columns both matter. Give it a column configuration and it is ready: ```vue ``` A number for `columns` means a fixed number of equal-width columns. An object means responsive columns: `minWidth` is the smallest a column may get, in pixels, and the grid decides how many columns fit in the available width on its own, dropping to fewer columns on a narrow screen. ```vue ``` The responsive configuration has two more options. `repeat` decides what happens to the gap a partly filled last row leaves behind: `'fill'` (the default) keeps the empty tracks, so every column always has the same width, while `'fit'` collapses them so the columns that are present stretch across the whole row. `max` caps how many columns may appear, which keeps columns from growing uncomfortably wide on a large screen. The cap sits on the minimum track size rather than the maximum, so the count never exceeds `max` while the columns that are present still fill the row — no dead space on the right. `gap` sets the spacing between rows and columns, with `rowGap` and `columnGap` overriding it on a single axis, and all three take a step from the Astryx spacing scale. `rowHeight` fixes the height of implicit rows in pixels and, together with `GridSpan rows`, produces items that span several rows. Wrap an item in `GridSpan` when it has to span more than one column or row. Its `columns` takes a number for the number of columns, or `'full'` to span the entire row, and `rows` takes the number of rows. ```vue ``` `width`, `height`, `maxWidth`, and `minHeight` size the container itself: numbers are pixels and strings are used as they are. `align` controls how items sit vertically inside their row (`align-items`) and `justify` controls the horizontal axis (`justify-items`); both default to `stretch`, which makes every item fill its cell. The column template is written to the container as the CSS variable `--astryx-grid-template-columns` rather than as an inline `grid-template-columns` declaration. That way your own stylesheet, including a rule inside a media query, can still override the variable or the declaration itself.
usage.zh: `Grid` 用 CSS 网格把子元素排进行和列，解决的是二维布局：卡片墙、仪表盘面板，以及任何需要多列对齐的区域。一维排布交给 `Stack` 系列，只有当行和列都要对齐时才换成 `Grid`。 给出列配置就能开始使用： ```vue ``` `columns` 传数字表示固定列数，每一列等宽。传对象则表示响应式列：`minWidth` 是每列的最小宽度（像素），网格按可用宽度自己决定能放几列，窄屏时自动减少列数。 ```vue ``` 响应式配置里还有两个可选项。`repeat` 决定最后一行没排满时留下的空隙如何处理：`'fill'`（默认）保留空的轨道，所以每列宽度始终一致；`'fit'` 收起空轨道，让实际存在的列把整行撑满。`max` 限制最多几列，避免大屏上每一列被拉得过宽。列数上限加在轨道的最小尺寸上而不是最大尺寸上，因此列数不会超过 `max`，而排不满时留下的列依然会撑满整行，右侧不会出现空白。 `gap` 控制行列间距，`rowGap` 与 `columnGap` 可以分别在行、列方向覆盖它，取值都来自 Astryx 的间距刻度。`rowHeight` 用像素固定隐式行高，配合 `GridSpan` 的 `rows` 可以做出跨若干行的布局。 需要某一项跨列或跨行时，用 `GridSpan` 包一层。它的 `columns` 给数字表示跨几列，给 `'full'` 表示跨越整行；`rows` 表示跨几行。 ```vue ``` `width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight` 控制容器自身的尺寸，数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。`align` 控制项目在行内的垂直对齐（`align-items`），`justify` 控制水平对齐（`justify-items`），两者默认都是 `stretch`，也就是撑满所在的单元格。 列模板写在容器的 CSS 变量 `--astryx-grid-template-columns` 上，而不是内联的 `grid-template-columns` 声明。因此在自有样式或媒体查询里重写这个变量、或者直接重写 `grid-template-columns`，都能生效。

en.text: Use responsive columns (`:columns="{ minWidth: 280 }"`) whenever the layout should adapt to the screen. Let the grid work out the column count instead of writing media queries.
Cap the count with `max` on wide screens. Without a cap each column grows very wide and the contents of a row drift far apart.
Keep the default `repeat: 'fill'` when every column should have the same width, and switch to `'fit'` when the items of a partly filled row should stretch into the leftover space.
Leave spacing to `gap` and the container size to `width`, `maxWidth`, and friends rather than adding margins to the children.
Hand-write `display: grid` and `grid-template-columns` and compute the gaps yourself. `Grid` already does that work.
Fake a grid with a wrapping `HStack`. Use `Stack` for one-dimensional arrangement and `Grid` when both axes have to line up.
Express a fixed column count through the object form of `columns`. Pass a number, which says what it means.

zh.text: 布局需要随屏幕宽度变化时用响应式列（`:columns="{ minWidth: 280 }"`），让网格自己决定列数，不必再写媒体查询。
大屏上用 `max` 给列数封顶。没有上限时每一列会被拉得很宽，一行里的内容彼此离得太远。
需要每列宽度一致时保留默认的 `repeat: 'fill'`；希望不足一行的项目撑开剩余空间时改用 `'fit'`。
间距交给 `gap`，容器自身的尺寸交给 `width`、`maxWidth` 等属性，不要在子元素上再加外边距。
手写 `display: grid` 和 `grid-template-columns` 并自己计算间距，`Grid` 已经把这些处理好了。
用允许换行的 `HStack` 冒充网格。一维排布用 `Stack`，行和列都要对齐时才用 `Grid`。
用 `columns` 的对象形式表达固定列数。固定列数直接传数字，语义更清楚。

en.heading: Grid Props
en.text:
`GridResponsiveColumns` has this shape:

```ts
interface GridResponsiveColumns {
  minWidth: number
  max?: number
  repeat?: 'fill' | 'fit'
}
```

`SpacingStep` accepts these values:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

en.heading: Slots
en.text: `GridSpan` has a single default slot as well:

en.heading: CSS variables
en.text:
`Grid` writes these variables to its root element. They are an implementation detail, but a theme or an application may override them:

- `--astryx-grid-template-columns`: The computed column template. It lives in a variable rather than an inline `grid-template-columns` declaration, so a media query can still override it.
- `--astryx-grid-auto-rows`: The implicit row height derived from `rowHeight`.
- `--astryx-grid-gap`: The spacing token for `gap`, shared by both axes.
- `--astryx-grid-row-gap`: The spacing token for `rowGap`, which overrides `--astryx-grid-gap` on the row axis.
- `--astryx-grid-column-gap`: The spacing token for `columnGap`, which overrides `--astryx-grid-gap` on the column axis.
- `--astryx-grid-default-gap`: A theme token used as the spacing when no gap prop is given. The neutral theme sets it to `--astryx-spacing-0`, which leaves no space between items.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`Grid` and `GridSpan` both render a `
` at the root. The following go to the root element: - HTML attributes. - `aria-*` attributes. - `data-*` attributes. - `class`. - `style`. `class` is merged with the component's own classes. When style and the size props (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are both given, the props win; the same holds for GridSpan's columns and rows. `Grid` also writes `data-columns` (only when `columns` is a number), `data-gap`, `data-row-gap`, `data-column-gap`, `data-align`, and `data-justify`, so a theme can target it by attribute.

zh.heading: Grid Props
zh.text:
`GridResponsiveColumns` 的形状如下：

```ts
interface GridResponsiveColumns {
  minWidth: number
  max?: number
  repeat?: 'fill' | 'fit'
}
```

`SpacingStep` 支持以下值：

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: `GridSpan` 同样只有一个默认插槽：

zh.heading: CSS 变量
zh.text:
`Grid` 在根元素上写入以下变量。它们是内部实现，但可以被主题或应用覆盖：

- `--astryx-grid-template-columns`: 计算出的列模板。写在变量上而不是内联的 `grid-template-columns`，因此媒体查询里的覆盖仍然有效。
- `--astryx-grid-auto-rows`: `rowHeight` 转换出的隐式行高。
- `--astryx-grid-gap`: `gap` 对应的间距令牌，行、列共用。
- `--astryx-grid-row-gap`: `rowGap` 对应的间距令牌，覆盖 `--astryx-grid-gap`。
- `--astryx-grid-column-gap`: `columnGap` 对应的间距令牌，覆盖 `--astryx-grid-gap`。
- `--astryx-grid-default-gap`: 主题令牌，在没有传入任何间距属性时作为默认间距。Neutral 主题取 `--astryx-spacing-0`，也就是不留间距。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`Grid` 与 `GridSpan` 的根元素都是 `
`。 以下内容传入根元素： - HTML 属性。 - `aria-*` 属性。 - `data-*` 属性。 - `class`。 - `style`。 `class` 会与组件自身的类名合并。`style` 与尺寸属性（`width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight`）同时出现时，尺寸属性优先；GridSpan 的 columns、rows 同理。 `Grid` 还额外写入 `data-columns`（仅在 `columns` 为数字时）、`data-gap`、`data-row-gap`、`data-column-gap`、`data-align`、`data-justify`，供主题按属性选择。

usage.en: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows. ```ts import { GridSpan } from '@astryx-vue/core/Grid' ``` `GridSpan` wraps one child of a `Grid` and changes how many tracks that child takes. `columns` is a number of columns, or `full` to span the whole row; `rows` is a number of rows. Everything else about the grid — the column count, the gaps, the alignment — stays on `Grid`. `full` renders `grid-column: 1 / -1`, so it spans the row whatever the column count is. A row span needs a height to work with: give `Grid` a `rowHeight`, or the row grows to fit the tallest item that crosses it. ```vue ```
usage.zh: 占多列或多行的网格项。 ```ts import { GridSpan } from '@astryx-vue/core/Grid' ``` `GridSpan` 包住 `Grid` 里的一个子项，改的是这个子项占几条轨道。`columns` 写数字就是占几列，写 `full` 就是占满整行；`rows` 是占几行。网格本身的东西——列数、间距、对齐——还是由 `Grid` 管。 `full` 渲染成 `grid-column: 1 / -1`，不管一共几列都能占满一行。跨行要有高度才看得出效果：给 `Grid` 传 `rowHeight` 固定行高；不传的话，被跨过的那几行会按穿过它的最高那一项撑开。 ```vue ```

summary.zh: `Stack` 把子项排成一行或者一列，间距始终一致。子项之间的距离交给 `gap` 属性，不用自己算。

usage.en:
Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

```ts
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

`HStack` is `Stack` with the direction fixed to a row, so the same props work without repeating `direction`. `gap` takes a step from the spacing scale and is the only spacing the row needs: do not add margins to the children.

`hAlign` places the items along the row — `start`, `center`, `end`, `between`, `around`, or `evenly`. `vAlign` sets how the items sit against each other vertically, and `align` is a shorter alias for it. `wrap` lets a long row continue on the next line instead of overflowing.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="2">
    <Badge label="React" />
    <Badge label="TypeScript" />
    <Badge label="Node.js" />
  </HStack>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Stack` 把子项排成一行或者一列，间距始终一致。子项之间的距离交给 `gap` 属性，不用自己算。

```ts
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

`HStack` 就是把 `Stack` 的方向定成了横向，属性还是那一套，不用每次再写 `direction`。`gap` 取间距刻度上的一档，一行里的间距只靠它：不要给子元素加外边距。

`hAlign` 管这一行里的横向位置，可选 `start`、`center`、`end`、`between`、`around`、`evenly`。`vAlign` 管子项之间在纵向怎么对，`align` 是它的简写。一行放不下的时候用 `wrap` 让它换行，而不是溢出。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="2">
    <Badge label="React" />
    <Badge label="TypeScript" />
    <Badge label="Node.js" />
  </HStack>
</template>
```

en.heading: Props
en.text:
`HStack` takes every `Stack` prop except `direction`, which is fixed to `horizontal`.

The helper types are shared with `Stack`:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
type StackMainAlignment = 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between' | 'around' | 'evenly'
type StackCrossAlignment = 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'
type StackWrap = 'nowrap' | 'wrap' | 'wrap-reverse'
type StackSizeValue = number | string
type StackElement = Component | string
```

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The root element receives HTML attributes, `aria-*` attributes, `data-*` attributes, `class`, and `style`. `class` is merged with the component's own classes and `style` is merged with the sizing and spacing it already writes.

summary.en: Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.
summary.zh: `Stack` 把子项排成一行或者一列，间距始终一致。子项之间的距离交给 `gap` 属性，不用自己算。

usage.en:
Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

```ts
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

`VStack` is `Stack` with the direction fixed to a column, so the same props work without repeating `direction`. `gap` takes a step from the spacing scale and is the only spacing the column needs: do not add margins to the children.

`vAlign` places the items along the column — `start`, `center`, `end`, `between`, `around`, or `evenly`. `hAlign` sets how the items sit against each other horizontally, and `justify` is a shorter alias for it.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="3">
    <Heading :level="5">
      Weekly Report
    </Heading>
    <Text type="body" color="secondary">
      VStack arranges its children in a vertical column.
    </Text>
  </VStack>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Stack` 把子项排成一行或者一列，间距始终一致。子项之间的距离交给 `gap` 属性，不用自己算。

```ts
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

`VStack` 就是把 `Stack` 的方向定成了纵向，属性还是那一套，不用每次再写 `direction`。`gap` 取间距刻度上的一档，一列里的间距只靠它：不要给子元素加外边距。

`vAlign` 管这一列里的纵向位置，可选 `start`、`center`、`end`、`between`、`around`、`evenly`。`hAlign` 管子项之间在横向怎么对，`justify` 是它的简写。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="3">
    <Heading :level="5">
      周报
    </Heading>
    <Text type="body" color="secondary">
      VStack 把子项从上到下排成一列。
    </Text>
  </VStack>
</template>
```

en.text: Use the gap prop for spacing between items; don't add margins manually.
Use StackItem with `size="fill"` to make one item stretch and fill the leftover space.
Nest stacks inside stacks; try `wrap="wrap"` first to let items flow to the next line.

zh.text: 用 `gap` 属性控制项目间距，而不是给子元素手动添加外边距，间距更容易保持一致。
希望某个项目拉伸并填满剩余空间时，给它包一层 `size="fill"` 的 `StackItem`，其余项目仍保持固有尺寸。
为了换行而嵌套堆叠布局，优先给 `Stack` 设置 `wrap="wrap"` 让项目自动换行，结构会更扁平。

usage.en:
Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

```ts
import { StackItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

`StackItem` wraps one child of a `Stack` when that child needs its own sizing rule. `size` is `static` by default, which keeps the intrinsic size; `fill` lets the item take the space the other items leave over. `crossAlignSelf` overrides the stack's cross-axis alignment for this one item, and `isScrollable` turns the item into a scroll region of its own.

The wrapper also applies the flex reset — `min-width` and `min-height` of zero — so a long value inside cannot widen the row it sits in.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HStack, StackItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="3">
    <StackItem size="static">
      Static
    </StackItem>
    <StackItem size="fill">
      Fills remaining space
    </StackItem>
  </HStack>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Stack` 把子项排成一行或者一列，间距始终一致。子项之间的距离交给 `gap` 属性，不用自己算。

```ts
import { StackItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
```

某个子项需要单独定尺寸时，用 `StackItem` 把它包一层。`size` 默认是 `static`，保持它本来该多大；改成 `fill`，它就把其他项剩下的空间占满。`crossAlignSelf` 只改这一项在交叉轴上的对齐，不影响同层其他项。`isScrollable` 让这一项自己成为一块滚动区域。

这层包装还顺手清掉了 flex 的默认最小尺寸（`min-width` 和 `min-height` 归零），所以里面塞一长串内容也不会把整行撑宽。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HStack, StackItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="3">
    <StackItem size="static">
      固定宽度
    </StackItem>
    <StackItem size="fill">
      占满剩余空间
    </StackItem>
  </HStack>
</template>
```

summary.en: `AppShell` is the page frame. The default slot is the page content. `topNav`, `sideNav`, `banner`, and `mobileNav` are named slots.
summary.zh: `AppShell`（应用外壳）是承载整个网站或管理后台的大骨架，用来规整地安排顶部导航、侧边菜单、重要横幅以及中间的主内容区。默认插槽放页面的正文，其余重要区域通过具名插槽放入：`topNav`（顶栏）、`sideNav`（侧栏）、`banner`（通知横幅）和 `mobileNav`（移动端导航）。

usage.en: `AppShell` is the page frame. The default slot is the page content. `topNav`, `sideNav`, `banner`, and `mobileNav` are named slots. ```vue ``` `variant` is `wash`, `surface`, `section`, or `elevated` (the default). `contentPadding` is a spacing step for the content region. `height` is `fill` or `auto`. `fill` uses `100dvh`; an inline `height: 100%` overrides it when the shell sits in a sized preview. `mobileNav` is `false` or `{ breakpoint, isOpen, hasToggle }`. The default breakpoint is `md` (768px). Below the breakpoint the side nav moves into a drawer. A top nav inside the shell uses that drawer instead of opening one of its own. `v-model:mobile-nav-open` controls the drawer, and the component emits `mobileNavOpenChange`. A skip link points at `#astryx-app-shell-main`. The main region is a `div` with `role="main"` and `tabindex="-1"`. With `variant="elevated"` and both a top nav and a side nav on a wide viewport, the content sits on a rounded backdrop. `useAppShellMobile` reads the nearest shell. Outside a shell, or when mobile nav is off, `isMobile` and `isMobileNavEnabled` are false and the open and close methods do nothing.
usage.zh: `AppShell`（应用外壳）是承载整个网站或管理后台的大骨架，用来规整地安排顶部导航、侧边菜单、重要横幅以及中间的主内容区。默认插槽放页面的正文，其余重要区域通过具名插槽放入：`topNav`（顶栏）、`sideNav`（侧栏）、`banner`（通知横幅）和 `mobileNav`（移动端导航）。 **什么时候用：** - 构建后台管理系统、多页面 SaaS 应用或需要统一导航布局的完整平台时。 **什么时候不要用：** - 如果只是页面内部的一小块局部排版（例如卡片内的两栏布局），请使用专门的 [Layout](/components/layout) 或弹性盒/网格，不要滥用 AppShell。 - 独立的单页落地页、注册登录页或全屏沉浸式预览，通常不需要复杂的外壳，使用纯正文模式或直接排版即可。 ```vue ``` 外壳的常用配置项如下： - `variant` 可以调整底色风格：包含纯净底色 `wash`、面板底色 `surface`、区块底色 `section`，或者默认的浮起卡片质感 `elevated`。 - `contentPadding` 控制正文区域四周的留白间距等级。 - `height` 设置外壳的高度模式，可以填满全屏（`fill`，使用现代的 `100dvh`），也可以随内容自适应撑开（`auto`）。 - `mobileNav` 用来控制手机端的抽屉导航。默认在宽度低于 768px（`md` 断点）时，原本在左侧的侧边菜单会自动收拢进一个侧滑抽屉里。顶栏里的汉堡按钮会自动连接并控制这只抽屉，无需自己重复写逻辑。可以通过 `v-model:mobile-nav-open` 双向绑定抽屉的打开状态。 - 组件内置了专门为键盘操作和读屏用户准备的「跳转到主内容」快捷链接，回车即可将光标焦点直接定位到带有 `role="main"` 的正文容器上。 - `useAppShellMobile` 组合式函数可以在任何子组件里读取当前外壳的移动端适配状态（如抽屉是否开启、是否处于手机屏幕断点下）。

en.text: Put application navigation in the topNav and sideNav slots. Put page regions in Layout.
Give the side nav a heading so the mobile drawer has a name.
Open a second drawer from TopNav while it is inside an AppShell. The shell already owns that drawer.
Call useAppShellMobile and assume a shell is present. Check isMobileNavEnabled.

zh.text: 应用导航放在 topNav 和 sideNav。页面内部的区域用 Layout。
给侧栏一个标题，移动抽屉才有名字。
顶栏已经在 AppShell 里时，再让 TopNav 自己开一只抽屉。抽屉归外壳管。
调用 useAppShellMobile 时假定外壳一定存在。先看 isMobileNavEnabled。
