en.heading: App Shell Props
en.text: `SpacingStep` accepts `0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10`. The default breakpoint is md, and the query is (width < Npx). hasToggle defaults to true.

en.heading: useAppShellMobile
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core. It returns the nearest shell: The main region is #astryx-app-shell-main, a div with role="main" and tabindex="-1". The skip link label follows the active locale.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`AppShell` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The root sets `data-variant` and `data-height`.

zh.heading: useAppShellMobile

description.en: A shell with no navigation, for a full-bleed page, an auth screen, or an embedded view.
description.zh: 没有导航的外壳，适合通栏页面、登录页或嵌入视图。

description.en: The side nav heading carries the app identity, so a top nav is unnecessary.
description.zh: 侧栏标题承担应用身份，不再需要顶栏。

description.en: A top nav and no side navigation, for a landing page.
description.zh: 只有顶栏、没有侧栏，适合落地页。

description.en: The usual frame: a top nav for the app, and a side nav for the pages.
description.zh: 最常见的框架：顶栏表示应用，侧栏表示页面。

description.en: Top nav, side nav, and a dismissable info banner between the navigation and the content.
description.zh: 顶栏、侧栏，以及夹在导航和正文之间、可以关闭的信息横幅。

en.name: Page shell
en.description: Outermost application frame that owns page-level navigation, responsive shell behavior, and the main content landmark.

en.name: Skip link
en.description: First focusable element on the page. Visually hidden until focused, then moves focus to the main content area.

en.name: Banner
en.description: The banner slot, for system-wide announcements. Renders above the top nav, inside the banner landmark.

en.name: Top navigation
en.description: The topNav slot, typically TopNav. Below the mobile breakpoint it becomes a compact bar carrying the nav toggle.

en.name: Side navigation
en.description: The sideNav slot, typically SideNav. Inline above the breakpoint, moved into the mobile drawer below it.

en.name: Main content
en.description: The default slot, rendered in the main landmark. Scrolls internally when height is fill, and with the page when it is auto.

en.name: Mobile nav drawer
en.description: Generated below the breakpoint from the nav slots unless mobileNav disables or replaces it. A modal dialog: it traps focus and returns focus to the toggle on close.

zh.name: 页面框架
zh.description: 最外层的应用框。它管页面级导航、外壳在不同宽度下的行为，以及主内容地标。

zh.name: 跳过链接
zh.description: 页面上第一个可聚焦的元素。平时看不见，聚焦后才出现，并把焦点移到主内容。

zh.name: 通告条
zh.description: banner 插槽，用来放全站通告。画在顶栏上面，落在 banner 地标里。

zh.name: 顶部导航
zh.description: topNav 插槽，一般放 TopNav。窄于移动断点时，收成一条带着导航开关的紧凑栏。

zh.name: 侧边导航
zh.description: sideNav 插槽，一般放 SideNav。宽于断点时嵌在页面里，窄于断点时收进移动抽屉。

zh.name: 主内容
zh.description: 默认插槽，画在 main 地标里。height 为 fill 时在框架内滚动，为 auto 时跟着页面滚。

zh.name: 移动导航抽屉
zh.description: 窄于断点时，除非 mobileNav 关掉或换掉它，否则由导航插槽生成。它是模态对话框：锁住焦点，关闭后把焦点交回开关。

summary.en: `AspectRatio` keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio as its container changes size. Use it for images, video, thumbnails, and other media that should stay in proportion. The width comes from the parent, and the height is derived from `ratio`, so an ancestor needs a definite width.
summary.zh: `AspectRatio` 在容器变宽变窄时保持固定的宽高比，用来放图片、视频和缩略图。宽度来自父级，高度由 `ratio` 算出，所以祖先需要有明确的宽度。

usage.en: `AspectRatio` keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio as its container changes size. Use it for images, video, thumbnails, and other media that should stay in proportion. The width comes from the parent, and the height is derived from `ratio`, so an ancestor needs a definite width. ```vue ``` `ratio` is width divided by height. Write `16 / 9` rather than a rounded decimal. `shape` is `rectangle` or `ellipse`; an ellipse with `ratio` `1` is a circle. `fit` sizes the child: `cover` fills and crops, `contain` letterboxes, and `center` keeps the natural size. Leave `fit` unset when the child sizes itself. The ratio is written to the CSS variable `--astryx-aspect-ratio`, not as an inline `aspect-ratio` declaration, so a stylesheet can override it.
usage.zh: `AspectRatio` 在容器变宽变窄时保持固定的宽高比，用来放图片、视频和缩略图。宽度来自父级，高度由 `ratio` 算出，所以祖先需要有明确的宽度。 ```vue ``` `ratio` 是宽除以高，写成 `16 / 9`，不要写成四舍五入后的小数。`shape` 取 `rectangle` 或 `ellipse`；`ratio` 为 `1` 的椭圆是正圆。`fit` 决定子元素怎么填进框里：`cover` 裁切，`contain` 留边，`center` 保持原始尺寸。子元素自己负责尺寸时不要传 `fit`。 比例写在 CSS 变量 `--astryx-aspect-ratio` 上，不写成行内的 `aspect-ratio`，样式表可以覆盖它。

en.text: Pass one child when `fit` is set. Every direct child is stretched, so put an overlay inside that child.
Give images an `alt`, or `alt=""` when the image is decorative. The ratio box adds no accessible name of its own.
Use it as a general layout container. Use `Section`, `Card`, or `Layout` for page regions.
Set only a height. The width comes from the container, so a lone height clamps the box off ratio.

zh.text: 传了 `fit` 时只放一个子元素。每个直接子元素都会被拉伸，叠层内容放进这个子元素里面。
图片要写 `alt`。装饰性图片写 `alt=""`。比例框自己不提供无障碍名称。
拿它当普通布局容器。页面区域用 `Section`、`Card` 或 `Layout`。
只设高度。宽度来自容器，单独设高度会把比例框压变形。

rows.name: `ratio`
rows.description: Width divided by height. `16 / 9` is a widescreen frame. Written to `--astryx-aspect-ratio`, not as an inline `aspect-ratio`.

rows.name: `shape`
rows.description: Container shape. Both shapes follow `ratio`. `ellipse` with `ratio` `1` is a circle.

rows.name: `fit`
rows.description: How the child fills the box. `cover` crops, `contain` letterboxes, `center` keeps the natural size. Omit it and the child sizes itself.

rows.name: `ratio`
rows.description: 宽除以高。`16 / 9` 是宽屏。写在 `--astryx-aspect-ratio` 上，不写成行内 `aspect-ratio`。

rows.name: `shape`
rows.description: 容器外形。两种外形都遵循 `ratio`。`ellipse` 且 `ratio` 为 `1` 时是正圆。

rows.name: `fit`
rows.description: 子元素如何填满比例框。`cover` 裁切，`contain` 留边，`center` 保持原始尺寸。不传时子元素自己负责尺寸。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The content inside the ratio box. Pass one child when `fit` is set.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 放进比例框的内容。传了 `fit` 时只放一个子元素。

en.heading: CSS variables
en.text: - `--astryx-aspect-ratio`: The ratio. A stylesheet can override the variable or `aspect-ratio` itself.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`AspectRatio` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The root also sets `data-shape`.

zh.heading: CSS 变量
zh.text: - `--astryx-aspect-ratio`: 宽高比。样式表可以覆盖这个变量，也可以直接覆盖 `aspect-ratio`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`AspectRatio` 的根元素是 `<div>`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。根元素同时写 `data-shape`。

description.en: shape ellipse with ratio 1 clips the image to a circle.
description.zh: shape 为 ellipse、比例为 1 时，图片被裁成正圆。

description.en: A grid of images that share a 4:3 frame.
description.zh: 一组图片共用 4:3 的画幅。

description.en: A 1:1 frame for an avatar or a square image.
description.zh: 1:1 的方图，适合头像或方幅照片。

description.en: A 16:9 frame around an image.
description.zh: 16:9 的宽幅画面包住一张图片。

description.en: The frame holds a skeleton while the image is still loading.
description.zh: 图片还在加载时，画幅里放一块骨架屏。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AspectRatio } from '@astryx-vue/core/AspectRatio'
import { Center } from '@astryx-vue/core/Center'
import { Skeleton } from '@astryx-vue/core/Skeleton'
</script>

<template>
  <Center :width="600">
    <AspectRatio :ratio="16 / 9">
      <Skeleton height="100%" width="100%" />
    </AspectRatio>
  </Center>
</template>

en.name: Ratio box
en.description: The outer element that holds the aspect ratio and clips overflow. Carries the `astryx-aspect-ratio` theme target, and the elliptical clip when `shape` is `ellipse`.

en.name: Content slot
en.description: A wrapper that fills the ratio box and positions the child. With `fit` set it also sizes the child; without it the child styles itself.

zh.name: 比例盒
zh.description: 保持宽高比并裁掉溢出的外层。带有 astryx-aspect-ratio 主题目标；shape 为 ellipse 时裁成椭圆。

zh.name: 内容插槽
zh.description: 铺满比例盒并摆放里面内容的一层。设了 fit 时，里面内容的尺寸也由它定；没设时，里面的内容自己决定尺寸。

summary.en: `FormLayout` arranges fields. It is not a `<form>`. Put the fields in the default slot and choose a direction.
summary.zh: `FormLayout` 排列字段。它不是 `<form>`。字段放在默认插槽里，再选一个方向。

usage.en:
`FormLayout` arranges fields. It is not a `<form>`. Put the fields in the default slot and choose a direction.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FormLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/FormLayout'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
</script>

<template>
  <FormLayout>
    <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
    <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" />
  </FormLayout>
</template>
```

`direction` is `vertical` (the default), `horizontal`, or `horizontal-labels`. Vertical stacks fields with a gap of spacing step 4. Horizontal places them in equal columns. Horizontal labels put the label on the left and the control on the right, and collapse to a column below 480px.

`defaultOptionality` is `optional` or `required`. It changes the indicator and `aria-required` on fields that do not set their own `isOptional` or `isRequired`. It does not set the native `required` attribute. When a field sets both, optional wins. Outside a `FormLayout`, `aria-required` stays `isRequired && !isOptional`.

Nested layouts keep their own direction. A horizontal row can sit inside a vertical form.
usage.zh:
`FormLayout` 排列字段。它不是 `<form>`。字段放在默认插槽里，再选一个方向。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FormLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/FormLayout'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
</script>

<template>
  <FormLayout>
    <TextInput v-model="name" label="姓名" />
    <TextInput v-model="email" label="邮箱" />
  </FormLayout>
</template>
```

`direction` 取 `vertical`（默认）、`horizontal` 或 `horizontal-labels`。纵向按间距刻度 4 往下排。横向把字段放进等宽的列。横向标签把标签放在左边、控件放在右边，窄于 480px 时改回纵向。

`defaultOptionality` 取 `optional` 或 `required`。它只影响没有自己写 `isOptional` 或 `isRequired` 的字段的标记和 `aria-required`，不写原生 `required`。同一字段两个都写时，选填优先。没有 `FormLayout` 祖先时，`aria-required` 仍是 `isRequired && !isOptional`。

嵌套的布局各自保留方向。纵向表单里可以放一行横向字段。

en.text: Use horizontal for a short row of related fields, such as a first and last name.
Use horizontal-labels when every field has a label and the form is wider than a phone.
Put an unrelated control, such as a page title, in the layout. It participates in the grid.
Expect `defaultOptionality` to block submit. It only sets the indicator and `aria-required`.

zh.text: 一组短字段，例如名和姓，用横向。
每个字段都有标签、而且表单比手机宽时，用横向标签。
把页面标题这类无关内容放进布局。它会参加网格排列。
指望 `defaultOptionality` 拦住提交。它只改标记和 `aria-required`。

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: How the fields are arranged. `horizontal` uses equal columns. `horizontal-labels` puts the label on the left and stacks below 480px.

rows.name: `defaultOptionality`
rows.description: Default for fields that do not set `isOptional` or `isRequired`. It changes the indicator and `aria-required`. It does not set the native `required` attribute. When a field sets both, optional wins.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: 字段怎么排。`horizontal` 是等宽的列。`horizontal-labels` 把标签放在左边，窄于 480px 时改成纵向。

rows.name: `defaultOptionality`
rows.description: 没有自己写 `isOptional` 或 `isRequired` 的字段用这个默认值。它改标记和 `aria-required`，不写原生 `required`。两个都写时，选填优先。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The fields. A nested `FormLayout` keeps its own direction.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 字段。嵌套的 `FormLayout` 保留自己的方向。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`FormLayout` renders a `<div>`, not a `<form>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The root sets `data-direction`.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`FormLayout` 渲染的是 `<div>`，不是 `<form>`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

summary.en: `Layout` arranges up to five regions: header, start, content, end, and footer. The default slot is the content. The other regions are named slots. `AppShell` owns the page frame; use `Layout` inside a page, a card, or a dialog. Use `HStack` or `VStack` when the content is only a row or a column.
summary.zh: `Layout` 最多排五个区域：页眉、起始边、正文、结束边、页脚。默认插槽是正文，其余是具名插槽。页面外框交给 `AppShell`；`Layout` 用在页面内部、卡片或对话框里。内容只是一行或一列时用 `HStack` 或 `VStack`。

usage.en:
`Layout` arranges up to five regions: header, start, content, end, and footer. The default slot is the content. The other regions are named slots. `AppShell` owns the page frame; use `Layout` inside a page, a card, or a dialog. Use `HStack` or `VStack` when the content is only a row or a column.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        Orders
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      Select an order.
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`height` is `fill` or `auto`. `fill` stretches to the container and scrolls the content; `auto` grows with the content. `contentWidth` limits the width of the content and centers it. Dividers stay full width. A percentage, `fit-content`, `max-content`, `min-content`, or a bare `var()` uses the constrained width mode. `padding` sets this layout's own outer inset and does not pass to a nested layout. `defaultHasDividers` is the fallback for a header or footer that does not set `hasDivider`.

`LayoutHeader`, `LayoutFooter`, `LayoutContent`, and `LayoutPanel` are the region components. A panel's `width` is pixels when it is a number. Pass `resizable` from `useResizable` when a `ResizeHandle` controls that width.
usage.zh:
`Layout` 最多排五个区域：页眉、起始边、正文、结束边、页脚。默认插槽是正文，其余是具名插槽。页面外框交给 `AppShell`；`Layout` 用在页面内部、卡片或对话框里。内容只是一行或一列时用 `HStack` 或 `VStack`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        订单
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      选择一笔订单。
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`height` 取 `fill` 或 `auto`。`fill` 撑满容器，正文在中间滚动；`auto` 随内容长高。`contentWidth` 限制正文宽度并居中，分隔线仍然拉满。百分比、`fit-content`、`max-content`、`min-content` 或裸 `var()` 走约束宽度。`padding` 只作用于这一层，不会传给嵌套的 `Layout`。页眉或页脚没有写 `hasDivider` 时，用 `defaultHasDividers`。

`LayoutHeader`、`LayoutFooter`、`LayoutContent`、`LayoutPanel` 是四个区域组件。面板的 `width` 传数字时按像素。宽度由 `ResizeHandle` 控制时，把 `useResizable` 返回的 `props` 传给 `resizable`。

usage.en:
Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.

```ts
import { LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
```

`LayoutPanel` is a side region of a `Layout`. It goes in the `start` or `end` slot, keeps its own width, and scrolls independently of `LayoutContent`, so a navigation list or an inspector stays put while the middle of the page moves.

`width` is pixels when it is a number. When a `ResizeHandle` owns the width, pass the `props` from `useResizable` to `resizable` instead and the panel follows the drag. `hasDivider` draws the edge that faces the content; do not draw it when a resize handle already draws a line on that same edge. `isScrollable` is on by default; turn it off when the panel should only grow with its content.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { List, ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :width="200" role="navigation" label="Sections">
        <List>
          <ListItem is-selected label="Overview" />
          <ListItem label="Analytics" />
          <ListItem label="Settings" />
        </List>
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      Panel content goes here.
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
放导航、设置或者详情检视的侧栏。

```ts
import { LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
```

`LayoutPanel` 是 `Layout` 侧边那一块，放在 `start` 或 `end` 插槽里。它自己占一块宽度，自己管滚动，跟 `LayoutContent` 互不影响，所以导航列表或者详情检视会一直待着，只有中间那块在动。

`width` 写数字按像素。宽度交给 `ResizeHandle` 拖的时候，改成把 `useResizable` 返回的 `props` 传给 `resizable`，面板宽度就跟着拖拽走。`hasDivider` 画画朝内容的那条边；同一条边上已经有拖拽分隔条在画线了，就别再开。`isScrollable` 默认是开的，这块只需要跟着内容长高时就关掉。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { List, ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :width="200" role="navigation" label="分区">
        <List>
          <ListItem is-selected label="概览" />
          <ListItem label="分析" />
          <ListItem label="设置" />
        </List>
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      这里放正文。
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

usage.en:
Scrollable main content area.

```ts
import { LayoutContent } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
```

`LayoutContent` takes the space a `Layout` has left over between its header, its footer, and its panels, applies the region padding, and scrolls its own content once that content is taller than the space it was given. The header and the footer stay where they are.

`isScrollable` is on by default. Turn it off when the page scrolls as a whole and this region should only grow with its content. `padding` overrides the padding the surrounding `Layout` passes down, and `padding: 0` makes the region full bleed. `label` and `role` give the region a landmark role, so it shows up in a screen reader's landmark list.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        Orders
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      Select an order.
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

可滚动的主内容区域。

```ts
import { LayoutContent } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
```

`LayoutContent` 拿走 `Layout` 里剩下的那块地：页眉、页脚和面板占完以后的空间归它；它自己带内边距，内容比这块地高的时候就在它里面滚动，页眉和页脚待在原地不动。

`isScrollable` 默认是开的。整个页面一起滚动、这块只需要跟着内容长高时，把它关掉。`padding` 会盖掉外层 `Layout` 传下来的内边距，写 `padding: 0` 就是通栏。`label` 和 `role` 给这块地一个地标角色，读屏软件的地标列表里就能直接跳过来。

```vue
<template>

        订单
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      选择一笔订单。
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

summary.en: `ResizeHandle` is the separator between two regions. `useResizable` owns the size. Pass `sidebar.props` to both the handle and the panel.
summary.zh: `ResizeHandle` 是两个区域之间的分隔条。尺寸由 `useResizable` 管理。把 `sidebar.props` 同时传给分隔条和面板。

usage.en:
`ResizeHandle` is the separator between two regions. `useResizable` owns the size. Pass `sidebar.props` to both the handle and the panel.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size" />
      <ResizeHandle direction="horizontal" has-divider :resizable="sidebar.props" />
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`direction` is `horizontal` (width) or `vertical` (height). `position` is `inline` or `overlay`. `isReversed` flips the drag when the panel sits on the end edge. `hasDivider` draws the 1px line; the line is the handle. `isAlwaysVisible` keeps the grip visible at rest. `pillPlacement` is `auto`, `start`, `end`, or `center`.

The handle is `role="separator"`. A horizontal handle sets `aria-orientation="vertical"`. Arrow keys move 10px, and Shift moves 50px. With snap points, an arrow jumps to the next point and Shift jumps two. Home and End jump to the limits. End does nothing when no maximum is set; the separator then reports the window or container size as its maximum. While collapsed, only the arrow that grows the pane reopens it. Enter and double-click restore the size from before the collapse.

`useResizable` accepts one region, or a `regions` map. `snaps` keeps the size on the nearest listed point. An equal distance stays on the earlier point. A drag below `collapsedSize` (default 40) collapses a collapsible region to 0. `autoSaveId` stores the size under `astryx-resizable:` in `localStorage`. `percent()` builds a percentage size with a pixel minimum or maximum.
usage.zh:
`ResizeHandle` 是两个区域之间的分隔条。尺寸由 `useResizable` 管理。把 `sidebar.props` 同时传给分隔条和面板。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size" />
      <ResizeHandle direction="horizontal" has-divider :resizable="sidebar.props" />
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`direction` 取 `horizontal`（改宽度）或 `vertical`（改高度）。`position` 取 `inline` 或 `overlay`。面板在结束边时用 `isReversed` 把拖拽方向反过来。`hasDivider` 画出 1px 的线，线本身就是把手。`isAlwaysVisible` 让握把在静止时也可见。`pillPlacement` 取 `auto`、`start`、`end` 或 `center`。

分隔条的角色是 `separator`。横向分隔条的 `aria-orientation` 是 `vertical`。方向键每次移动 10px，按住 Shift 移动 50px。有吸附点时，方向键改成跳到相邻的点，Shift 跳两个。Home 和 End 跳到边界；没写最大尺寸时 End 不动，读屏用的最大值改报窗口或容器尺寸。折叠后只有让面板变大的方向键会展开。Enter 和双击恢复折叠前的尺寸。

`useResizable` 可以管一个区域，也可以用 `regions` 一次管多个。`snaps` 让尺寸只停在列出的点上。离两个点一样远时，留在更靠前的那个。可收起的区域被拖到低于 `collapsedSize`（默认 40）时，尺寸变成 0。`autoSaveId` 把尺寸存在 `localStorage`，键名以 `astryx-resizable:` 开头。`percent()` 用来写带像素上下限的百分比尺寸。

en.text: Give the handle a `label` that names the region it resizes.
Turn the panel divider off when the handle draws one.
Store the size in a separate ref and forget to pass `resizable`. The handle and the panel both read `props`.

zh.text: 用 `label` 说明这条分隔条在调整哪一块。
分隔条自己画线时，关掉面板上的分隔线。
另存一份尺寸却不传 `resizable`。分隔条和面板都读 `props`。

rows.description: `horizontal` changes width. `vertical` changes height. A horizontal handle sets `aria-orientation="vertical"`.

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: `inline` takes a track. `overlay` sits on the parent edge.

rows.name: `isReversed`
rows.description: Flips the drag when the panel is on the end edge.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Turns pointer and keyboard resizing off.

rows.name: `hasDivider`
rows.description: Draws the 1px line. The line is the handle.

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: Keeps the grip visible at rest.

rows.name: `pillPlacement`
rows.description: Where the grip sits on the line. `auto` stays on the panel side, and flips when the panel size is 0.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name. The English default is “Resize handle”.

rows.description: The `props` object returned by `useResizable`.

rows.description: Starting size. A number is pixels. With snap points, the starting value moves to the nearest point.

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: Allows the region to collapse to 0.

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: A drag below this pixel value collapses the region.

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: The size stops only on these pixel points. An equal distance stays on the earlier point.

rows.name: `shrinkOrder`
rows.description: Cascade priority for a `regions` map that shares `containerRef`. A lower number shrinks to `minSize` first when the container is narrower than the regions. Dragging still sets that region’s preferred size.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: Which container axis the percentage sizes read.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Element used to resolve percentages. An unmeasured container uses 1200 and does not persist.

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: Stores `{ size, isCollapsed }` at `astryx-resizable:` plus this id. A regions map appends `:key`.

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: Starts collapsed when `collapsible` is true.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Controlled collapsed state. Changes are reported through `onCollapseChange`.

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: Called after a resize settles on a size.

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: Called when the collapsed state changes.

rows.name: `regions`
rows.description: Several regions. Each entry accepts the size fields above.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: `horizontal` 改宽度，`vertical` 改高度。横向分隔条的 `aria-orientation` 是 `vertical`。

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: `inline` 占一格，`overlay` 贴在父级边缘。

rows.name: `isReversed`
rows.description: 面板在结束边时，把拖拽方向反过来。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 关掉指针和键盘调整。

rows.name: `hasDivider`
rows.description: 画出 1px 分隔线。线本身就是把手。

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: 静止时也显示握把。

rows.name: `pillPlacement`
rows.description: 握把相对分隔线的位置。`auto` 靠面板一侧，面板收到 0 时翻到另一侧。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 无障碍名称。英文默认是 “Resize handle”，中文默认是 “拖拽分隔条”。

rows.name: `resizable`
rows.description: `useResizable` 返回的 `props`。

rows.name: `defaultSize`
rows.description: 初始尺寸。数字是像素。有吸附点时，初值会落到最近的点上。

rows.name: `minSize`
rows.description: 展开时的最小尺寸。

rows.name: `maxSize`
rows.description: 最大尺寸。

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: 允许收到 0。

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: 拖拽低于这个像素值时收起。

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: 尺寸只会停在这些像素点上。离两个点一样远时，留在更靠前的那个。

rows.name: `shrinkOrder`
rows.description: 多个区域共用 `containerRef` 时的收缩顺序。容器比这些区域更窄时，数字更小的先收到 `minSize`。拖拽仍然改的是该区域自己的目标尺寸。

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: 百分比尺寸读取容器的哪一条轴。

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: 用来解析百分比的元素。还没量到时按 1200 计算，并且不写入存储。

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: 把 `{ size, isCollapsed }` 存在 `astryx-resizable:` 加这个 id。多个区域会再接 `:key`。

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: `collapsible` 为 true 时，一开始就收起。

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: 受控的收起状态。变化通过 `onCollapseChange` 报出。

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: 尺寸落下之后调用。

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: 收起状态变化时调用。

rows.name: `regions`
rows.description: 一次管多个区域。每一项接受上面的尺寸字段。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Replaces the grip. The separator role and keyboard behavior stay on the handle.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 替换握把。分隔条角色和键盘行为仍留在把手上。

en.heading: useResizable
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core. A single region returns { size, isCollapsed, collapse, expand, resize, props }. A regions map returns one of those objects per key. percent(value, { min }) or percent(value, { max }) builds a percentage size. min and max use { type: 'pixel', value }. Arrow keys move 10px. Shift moves 50px. With snap points, an arrow jumps to the next point and Shift jumps two. Home, End, and Enter jump to the minimum, a configured maximum, and the size from before collapse. End does nothing when no maximum is set.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`ResizeHandle` renders a `<div role="separator">`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged.

zh.heading: useResizable
zh.text: 从 @astryx-vue/core 引入。单个区域返回 { size, isCollapsed, collapse, expand, resize, props }。传入 regions 时，每个键各返回一份。 percent(value, { min }) 或 percent(value, { max }) 用来写百分比尺寸。min 和 max 的形状是 { type: 'pixel', value }。 方向键移动 10px，按住 Shift 移动 50px。有吸附点时改为跳到相邻吸附点，Shift 跳两个。Home、End、Enter 分别跳到最小值、配置过的最大值和折叠前的尺寸。没写最大值时 End 不动。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`ResizeHandle` 渲染 `<div role="separator">`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。

description.en: Dragging snaps to preset widths. Dragging past the minimum collapses the sidebar, and Expand restores it.
description.zh: 拖动会吸附到预设宽度。拖过最小宽度后侧栏收起，点 Expand 再把它展开。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
  collapsible: true,
  snaps: [200, 280],
})
</script>

<template>
  <Card :height="240" variant="muted" :width="500">
    <Layout height="fill">
      <template #start>
        <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size">
          <Text v-if="!sidebar.isCollapsed" color="secondary">
            {{ Math.round(sidebar.size) }}px wide
          </Text>
        </LayoutPanel>
        <ResizeHandle
          direction="horizontal"
          has-divider
          label="Resize sidebar"
          :resizable="sidebar.props"
        />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Text color="secondary">
            Drag the handle — it snaps at 200px and 280px. Drag all the way left to collapse the sidebar.
          </Text>
          <Button
            v-if="sidebar.isCollapsed"
            label="Expand sidebar"
            size="sm"
            variant="secondary"
            @click="sidebar.expand()"
          />
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>
  </Card>
</template>

summary.en: `ScrollableArea` is a native scroll viewport with an observed content box. It enters the tab order only while a requested axis actually overflows. `label` is required.
summary.zh: `ScrollableArea` 是一个原生滚动视口，里面有一块被观察的内容盒。只有请求的轴确实溢出时，它才会进入 Tab 顺序。`label` 必填。

usage.en: `ScrollableArea` is a native scroll viewport with an observed content box. It enters the tab order only while a requested axis actually overflows. `label` is required. ```vue ``` `axis` is `block` (the default), `inline`, or `both`. The component maps those logical axes through writing mode and direction. `overscroll` is `allow` or `contain`. `stickyContainment` is `whenScrollable` or `always`. Padding props apply to the content box and default to 0. `isFullBleed` lets the viewport escape an ancestor's padding without changing the content padding. Until overflow is measured, the requested axis uses `overflow: clip`. After a measurement, an overflowing axis uses `auto`. `always` keeps the viewport as a sticky boundary even when the content fits. The tolerance is 1px. `useScrollableArea` is the same measurement for a viewport and content box you already own. `useScrollOverflow` reports the inline start and end edges of one horizontal scroller.
usage.zh: `ScrollableArea` 是一个原生滚动视口，里面有一块被观察的内容盒。只有请求的轴确实溢出时，它才会进入 Tab 顺序。`label` 必填。 ```vue ``` `axis` 取 `block`（默认）、`inline` 或 `both`。组件按书写模式和方向把逻辑轴映射到物理轴。`overscroll` 取 `allow` 或 `contain`。`stickyContainment` 取 `whenScrollable` 或 `always`。内边距写在内容盒上，默认是 0。`isFullBleed` 让视口逃出祖先的内边距，内容的内边距不变。 溢出还没量到时，请求的轴用 `overflow: clip`。量到溢出后，溢出的轴改成 `auto`。`always` 即使内容装得下，也把这个视口留作 sticky 边界。容差是 1px。 视口和内容盒已经存在时，用 `useScrollableArea` 做同样的测量。`useScrollOverflow` 报告一个横向滚动容器的起始边和结束边有没有被挡住。

en.text: Give every area a short label that names what keyboard users will scroll.
Keep `overscroll="allow"` unless a nested area should stop the gesture.
Wrap it in another overflow container. One viewport should own the scroll.
Hide the scrollbar without another way to reach the overflow.

zh.text: 每块区域都写短标签，说明键盘用户会滚到什么。
没有特别要求时保持 `overscroll="allow"`。只有嵌套区域需要停住手势时才用 `contain`。
再套一层 overflow 容器。滚动只交给这一个视口。
藏起滚动条，却不提供别的办法到达溢出的内容。

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: Logical axes that may scroll. The physical axis follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name. Required. The viewport enters the tab order only while an axis overflows.

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: Role of the named viewport.

rows.name: `overscroll`
rows.description: Whether a gesture at the edge continues into an ancestor. Containment applies only while that axis overflows.

rows.name: `stickyContainment`
rows.description: `whenScrollable` passes sticky ownership outward when the content fits. `always` keeps this viewport as the sticky boundary.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Content padding on every edge.

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: Inline-axis content padding. Overrides `padding` on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: Inline-start content padding.

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: Inline-end content padding.

rows.name: `paddingBlock`

rows.description: Block-start content padding.

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: Block-end content padding.

rows.name: `isFullBleed`

rows.name: `scrollbars`
rows.description: Whether this area uses the custom scrollbar when a `ScrollbarsProvider` is above it. Set `false` to keep the native scrollbar.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Viewport width. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Viewport height. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum viewport width.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum viewport height.

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: 允许滚动的逻辑轴。物理方向随书写模式和方向变化。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 无障碍名称，必填。只有某一轴溢出时，视口才进入 Tab 顺序。

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: 这块命名视口的角色。

rows.name: `overscroll`
rows.description: 滚到边缘后，手势要不要交给外层。只有这一轴确实溢出时才会收住。

rows.name: `stickyContainment`
rows.description: `whenScrollable` 在内容装得下时把 sticky 交给外层。`always` 始终把这个视口留作 sticky 边界。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 内容盒四边的内边距。

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: 内容盒的行向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: 内容盒的行起始边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: 内容盒的行结束边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: 内容盒的块向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: 内容盒的块起始边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: 内容盒的块结束边内边距。

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: 让视口逃出祖先的内边距。内容内边距保持不变。

rows.name: `scrollbars`
rows.description: 外层有 `ScrollbarsProvider` 时，这块区域要不要换成自绘滚动条。设为 `false` 就保留原生滚动条。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 视口宽度。数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 视口高度。数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 视口最大宽度。

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: 视口最小高度。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Content inside the observed content box. Inline and both-axis modes size that box with `max-content` on the inline axis.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 放进被观察的内容盒。行向和双轴模式会把内容盒的行向尺寸设成 `max-content`。

en.heading: Working with ScrollbarsProvider
en.text:
When a [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/en/components/scrollbars-provider) sits above it, `ScrollableArea` switches to the custom overlay scrollbar on its own. You change no code. Without a provider you still get native scrollbars.

To keep the native scrollbar on one area, set `:scrollbars="false"`.

en.heading: useScrollableArea
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core when a component already owns the viewport and the content box. Options are axis, label, role, overscroll, and stickyContainment. It returns viewport (a callback ref), content, viewportAttrs, viewportStyle, and state. Overflow uses a 1px tolerance. Before a measurement, a requested axis is overflow: clip. Afterward, an overflowing axis is auto.

en.heading: useScrollOverflow
en.text: useScrollOverflow() watches one horizontal scroller. Bind scrollRef to the element. overflowStart, overflowEnd, and hasOverflow are refs. The tolerance is 1px.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`ScrollableArea` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to the viewport:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The viewport also sets `data-scroll-axis` and, once measured, `data-scrollable-*` and `data-scroll-*-start` / `data-scroll-*-end`.

zh.heading: 配合 ScrollbarsProvider
zh.text:
外层套了 [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/components/scrollbars-provider) 时，`ScrollableArea` 会自动换成自绘的覆盖式滚动条，不用改任何代码。不套就还是原生滚动条。

某一块想保留原生滚动条，给它写 `:scrollbars="false"`。

zh.heading: useScrollableArea
zh.text: 组件自己已经有视口和内容盒时，从 @astryx-vue/core 引入。选项是 axis、label、role、overscroll、stickyContainment。返回 viewport（回调 ref）、content、viewportAttrs、viewportStyle 和 state。 溢出容差是 1px。还没量到时，请求的轴是 overflow: clip。量到溢出后，溢出的轴改成 auto。

zh.heading: useScrollOverflow
zh.text: useScrollOverflow() 观察一个横向滚动容器。把 scrollRef 绑到元素上。overflowStart、overflowEnd、hasOverflow 都是 ref。容差是 1px。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`ScrollableArea` 渲染 `<div>`。

以下内容落到视口上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。视口还写 `data-scroll-axis`，测量之后再写 `data-scrollable-*` 以及 `data-scroll-*-start` / `data-scroll-*-end`。

description.en: axis inline scrolls the cards sideways. isFullBleed lets the rail reach the panel edges while the first card stays aligned with the heading.
description.zh: axis 为 inline 时卡片横向滚动。isFullBleed 让轨道贴到面板边缘，第一张卡片仍和标题对齐。

description.en: overscroll allow hands a finished gesture to the panel behind it. overscroll contain stops the gesture at the section edge.
description.zh: overscroll allow 把已经滚到底的手势交给后面的面板。contain 则停在这一节的边缘。

description.en: The scroll viewport is the sticky containing block, so section labels pin to the top of the list.
description.zh: 滚动视口是粘性定位的包含块，分组标签会钉在列表顶部。

description.en: A section that fits passes its sticky label outward. stickyContainment always keeps the next label inside its own box.
description.zh: 内容放得下的一节会把粘性标签交出去。下一节用 stickyContainment always 把标签留在自己的盒子里。

description.en: axis both gives the board max-content inline sizing, so one viewport scrolls both ways.
description.zh: axis 为 both 时，内容在行向上按 max-content 排布，一块看板可以同时横竖滚动。

en.name: Viewport
en.description: The root native scroll container, accessible name owner, focus target while effective, and `astryx-scrollable-area` theme target.

en.name: Content box
en.description: A real inner layout box observed together with the viewport. For inline scrolling it uses max-content inline sizing with a 100% minimum.

zh.name: 视口
zh.description: 根上的原生滚动容器。它拥有无障碍名称，生效时是焦点目标，也是 astryx-scrollable-area 主题目标。

zh.name: 内容盒
zh.description: 和视口一起被观察的真实内层布局盒。行内滚动时，行内尺寸用 max-content，最小为 100%。

summary.en: `Section` groups a region of a page: a settings group, a form section, or a highlighted block. It paints a background, applies padding from the spacing scale, and can draw a divider on any side.
summary.zh: `Section` 用来划分页面上的一块区域，例如一组设置、表单里的一段，或需要强调的一块。它负责背景、按间距刻度设置内边距，并可以在任意一边画分隔线。

usage.en: `Section` groups a region of a page: a settings group, a form section, or a highlighted block. It paints a background, applies padding from the spacing scale, and can draw a divider on any side. ```vue ``` `variant` is `section` (surface), `muted`, or `transparent`. `padding` defaults to step 4. A single edge overrides the axis, and an axis overrides `padding`. `dividers` accepts `top`, `bottom`, `start`, and `end`; `start` and `end` follow writing direction. The outer box uses a negative margin so a section can escape the padding of a parent container such as `Card` or `LayoutContent`.
usage.zh: `Section` 用来划分页面上的一块区域，例如一组设置、表单里的一段，或需要强调的一块。它负责背景、按间距刻度设置内边距，并可以在任意一边画分隔线。 ```vue ``` `variant` 取 `section`（表面色）、`muted` 或 `transparent`。`padding` 默认是刻度 4。单边覆盖轴向，轴向覆盖统一的 `padding`。`dividers` 接受 `top`、`bottom`、`start`、`end`，`start` 和 `end` 随书写方向翻转。 外层用负外边距，让区块能逃出父级容器（例如 `Card` 或 `LayoutContent`）的内边距。

en.text: Use Section for a region of a page. Use Card for one discrete item, such as a profile or a notification.
Start with the default variant. Use muted when one region should stand out.
Add a divider between adjacent sections that share a background.
Restate the theme padding with an extra margin on the children. Set `padding` on the section.

zh.text: 页面上的一块区域用 Section。单独一项，例如一条通知或一张资料卡，用 Card。
先用默认变体。只有某一块需要被注意到时再用 muted。
相邻且背景相同的区块，用分隔线隔开。
在子元素上再加外边距去重复主题内边距。内边距设在区块上。

rows.name: `padding`

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: Inline-axis padding. Overrides `padding` on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: Inline-end padding. Overrides the broader values on that edge.

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: Block-axis padding. Overrides `padding` on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: Block-start padding. Overrides the broader values on that edge.

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: Block-end padding. Overrides the broader values on that edge.

rows.name: `dividers`
rows.description: Edges that draw a 1px border. `start` and `end` follow writing direction.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Width. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Height. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum width. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum height. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 背景。`section` 用表面色，`muted` 用弱化底，`transparent` 不铺底。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 四边内边距。`0` 表示内容贴边。

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: 行向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: 行起始边内边距，只覆盖这一边。物理方向随书写方向翻转。

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: 块向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: 块起始边内边距，只覆盖这一边。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`Section` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The inner element sets `data-variant` and `data-divider-*` for each requested edge.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`Section` 的根元素是 `<div>`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。内层元素写 `data-variant`，并为每一条请求的边写 `data-divider-*`。

summary.en: A crumb in the middle of the trail can open a menu for sibling destinations. A short list is a menu array. Checkbox and radio rows go in the menu slot on that crumb, and the slot replaces the array. Those rows are exported from the breadcrumbs entry and are the same components the menu uses, so a choice opens and closes the same way.
summary.zh: 从独立入口导入 `Breadcrumbs` 与 `BreadcrumbItem`。

usage.en:
Import `Breadcrumbs` and `BreadcrumbItem` from their dedicated entry.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/">
      Home
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/components">
      Components
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
      Breadcrumbs
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </Breadcrumbs>
</template>
```

A crumb in the middle of the trail can open a menu for sibling destinations. A short list is a menu array. Checkbox and radio rows go in the menu slot on that crumb, and the slot replaces the array. Those rows are exported from the breadcrumbs entry and are the same components the menu uses, so a choice opens and closes the same way.
usage.zh:
从独立入口导入 `Breadcrumbs` 与 `BreadcrumbItem`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

<template>

    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
```

路径中间的一项可以打开菜单，用来在同级目的地之间切换。简单列表直接传一个菜单数组。需要勾选或单选时，改用菜单插槽把行写在这一项里面；写了插槽就不再使用数组。这些行从面包屑入口导出，和菜单里的勾选行、单选组是同一批组件，选中一项后的开关行为也相同。

en.text: Use semantic `` and `` markup so screen readers can identify the path.
Use `is-current` for the current page and render it as a `` with `aria-current="page"`.
Keep separators decorative with `aria-hidden="true"`.
Use overly long labels that wrap awkwardly on small screens.
Make the current page a clickable link; this creates circular navigation.

zh.text: 使用语义化 `` 与 `` 结构，便于屏幕阅读器识别路径。
对当前页使用 `is-current` 并渲染为 ``，自动添加 `aria-current="page"`。
为分隔符设置 `aria-hidden="true"`，避免辅助技术重复朗读。
在面包屑中使用过长的标签，导致小屏换行后难以阅读。
把当前页做成可点击链接，这会使用户迷失在循环导航中。

When omitted and no item is `true`, the last item on the page becomes current: it stays a link and gains `aria-current="page"` and the current style. `false` opts the item out of that detection.

summary.zh: 面包屑里的一格。它可以是一个去处、一个动作、当前位置，也可以是一个同级菜单的开关。

usage.en:
BreadcrumbItem represents one destination, action, current location, or sibling-menu trigger inside a Breadcrumbs trail.

Items after the first take their separator from the trail. `href` makes the crumb a link; without an address it is a button, and `isCurrent` turns it into plain text marked `aria-current="page"`. `menu` turns the crumb into a menu trigger for sibling destinations, which is why it and `href` are mutually exclusive.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="#home">
      Home
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="#settings">
      Settings
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
      Profile
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </Breadcrumbs>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
面包屑里的一格。它可以是一个去处、一个动作、当前位置，也可以是一个同级菜单的开关。

第一格之后的分隔符由整条面包屑决定。写了 `href` 就是链接；没写地址就渲染成按钮；`isCurrent` 让它变成纯文本，并标上 `aria-current="page"`。`menu` 把这一格变成同级去处的菜单开关，所以它和 `href` 只能二选一，同时写时用菜单。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="#home">
      首页
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="#settings">
      设置
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
      个人资料
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </Breadcrumbs>
</template>
```

summary.en: `MobileNav` is a dialog drawer that slides in from one side of the screen, not a bottom sheet. Bind `MobileNavToggle` to the same `v-model:is-open`. While open, focus stays in the drawer. Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and returns focus to where it was. If another layer opens inside the drawer, Escape closes that top layer first. Pinch-zoom stays with the browser, and the body can still scroll vertically.
summary.zh: `MobileNav` 是从屏幕一侧滑入的对话框抽屉，不是底部弹层。`MobileNavToggle` 和它绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`。打开后焦点留在抽屉里，Escape 或点遮罩关闭，并回到原来的焦点。抽屉里面再开一层浮层时，Escape 先关最上面那一层。双指缩放留给浏览器，内容区仍可以竖着滚。

usage.en:
`MobileNav` is a dialog drawer that slides in from one side of the screen, not a bottom sheet. Bind `MobileNavToggle` to the same `v-model:is-open`. While open, focus stays in the drawer. Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and returns focus to where it was. If another layer opens inside the drawer, Escape closes that top layer first. Pinch-zoom stays with the browser, and the body can still scroll vertically.

`side` is `start`, `end`, or `auto`. `auto` picks the side from where focus was when the drawer opened. The top nav creates this pair for you when its media query matches.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="Menu" side="start">
    <!-- items -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`MobileNav` 是从屏幕一侧滑入的对话框抽屉，不是底部弹层。`MobileNavToggle` 和它绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`。打开后焦点留在抽屉里，Escape 或点遮罩关闭，并回到原来的焦点。抽屉里面再开一层浮层时，Escape 先关最上面那一层。双指缩放留给浏览器，内容区仍可以竖着滚。

`side` 可以是 `start`、`end` 或 `auto`。`auto` 按打开时焦点的位置决定从哪一侧进入。顶栏的窄屏模式会自己创建这一对组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="菜单" side="start">
    <!-- 导航项 -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```

en.text: Point the toggle `controls` at the drawer id so the button and dialog are related.
Put ordinary links in the drawer. Do not wrap them in another `role="menu"`.
Do not use a bottom sheet for this navigation. It is a side drawer.

zh.text: 开关的 `controls` 指向抽屉的 id，读屏能把按钮和对话框连起来。
抽屉里放普通链接。不要再套一层 `role="menu"`。
不要用底部弹层来做这套导航。它是侧边抽屉。

usage.en:
The button that opens [Mobile Nav](/en/components/mobile-nav) on a narrow viewport. It draws the two-line menu glyph, turns it into a close mark while the drawer is open, and keeps `aria-expanded` in step.

```ts
import { MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
```

Bind the toggle and the drawer to the same `v-model:is-open`, and point `controls` at the drawer's id so the button and the dialog are related:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" label="Open navigation" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="Navigation" side="start">
    <!-- items -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
窄屏上打开 [移动端导航](/components/mobile-nav) 抽屉的那个按钮。它画的是两道杠的菜单图标，抽屉打开时变成关闭的样子，`aria-expanded` 也跟着改。

```ts
import { MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
```

开关和抽屉绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`，`controls` 指向抽屉的 id，按钮和对话框就关联起来了：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" label="打开导航" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="导航" side="start">
    <!-- 导航项 -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```

en.text: Bind the toggle and the drawer to the same `v-model:is-open`, so the glyph never disagrees with the drawer.
Share the same nav items between Mobile Nav and Side Nav by extracting them into a variable.
Give it a `label` when the page has more than one navigation region, so the button says which one it opens.
Use Mobile Nav on desktop: use a persistent Side Nav instead.

zh.text: 开关和抽屉绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`，图标状态才不会和抽屉对不上。
移动端导航和侧边导航用同一份导航项，把它抽成一个变量共用。
页面上不止一处导航时给它一个 `label`，让按钮说清自己打开的是哪个。
在桌面上用移动端导航。桌面该用常驻的侧边导航。

summary.en: `NavItem` is one row in a sidebar, top bar, or menu. It renders a link when `href` is set, and a button when it is disabled or has no address. Pass a CSS icon class through `iconClass`, or use the `icon` slot. `NavIcon`, exported from the same entry, draws the round emphasis badge.
summary.zh: `NavItem` 是侧栏、顶栏和菜单里的一条导航。有 `href` 时渲染成链接，禁用或没有地址时渲染成按钮。图标用 `iconClass` 传入 CSS icon，也可以用 `icon` 插槽。需要圆形强调底时用同目录导出的 `NavIcon`。

usage.en:
`NavItem` is one row in a sidebar, top bar, or menu. It renders a link when `href` is set, and a button when it is disabled or has no address. Pass a CSS icon class through `iconClass`, or use the `icon` slot. `NavIcon`, exported from the same entry, draws the round emphasis badge.

The link root defaults to `a`. Pass `RouterLink` as `as` and the item sets both `href` and `to`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" is-selected label="Home" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`NavItem` 是侧栏、顶栏和菜单里的一条导航。有 `href` 时渲染成链接，禁用或没有地址时渲染成按钮。图标用 `iconClass` 传入 CSS icon，也可以用 `icon` 插槽。需要圆形强调底时用同目录导出的 `NavIcon`。

链接根默认是 `a`。接入 Vue Router 时把 `RouterLink` 传给 `as`，组件会同时带上 `href` 和 `to`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" is-selected label="首页" />
</template>
```

en.text: Set `isSelected` for the current page. The item writes `aria-current="page"`.
Turn on `isIconOnly` when the label should stay available to assistive tech only.
Do not ship a built-in icon component. Icons stay as a class or a slot.

只显示图标时打开 `isIconOnly`，`label` 仍会成为无障碍名称。
不要把图标做成独立的图标组件再塞进导航。图标走 class 或插槽。

usage.en:
`NavIcon` is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as `TopNavHeading` and `PageNavHeader` to visually identify a section or application.

```ts
import { NavIcon } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
```

Pass a CSS icon class through `iconClass`, or put the icon element itself in the default slot.
usage.zh:
`NavIcon` 是一个圆形底、带强调色的图标容器。放在 `TopNavHeading`、`PageNavHeader` 这类导航标题里，让人一眼认出这是哪个分区或哪个应用。

```ts
import { NavIcon } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
```

图标可以用 `iconClass` 传一个 CSS 图标类，也可以把图标元素直接放进默认插槽。

en.text: Use in navigation headers to provide a recognizable visual anchor for the section.
Pass an `Icon` or similarly sized icon component to ensure proper proportions.
Use `NavIcon` for interactive purposes; it is a display-only container, not a button.

zh.text: 放在导航标题里，给这个分区一个认得出的视觉锚点。
传 `Icon`，或尺寸接近的图标组件，比例才不会变形。
别拿 `NavIcon` 当按钮用。它只是展示用的容器。

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `default`: the icon content, used when `iconClass` is not set. Put an `Icon` or any element of the same size here.

The badge is display-only: it is a `span`, never a button or a link, so do not hang a click handler on it. Reach for `IconButton` or `NavItem` when the thing has to be pressable.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `default`：图标内容。没有传 `iconClass` 时才用它。放一个 `Icon`，或任何同样大小的元素都可以。

这个圆只负责展示：它是一个 `span`，永远不会变成按钮或链接，所以不要往它上面挂点击。需要能按的时候用 `IconButton` 或者 `NavItem`。

usage.en:
Accessible menu container and items for nav heading popovers. `NavHeadingMenu` provides `role="menu"` with keyboard navigation; `NavHeadingMenuItem` renders individual selectable items. Pass it to the `menu` slot of `SideNavHeading` or `TopNavHeading`.

```ts
import { NavHeadingMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavHeadingMenu, NavHeadingMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
import { SideNav, SideNavHeading } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
</script>

<template>
  <SideNav>
    <template #header>
      <SideNavHeading heading="Acme Platform">
        <template #menu>
          <NavHeadingMenu label="Acme Platform" size="lg">
            <NavHeadingMenuItem href="/dashboard" label="Dashboard" />
            <NavHeadingMenuItem href="/analytics" label="Analytics" />
          </NavHeadingMenu>
        </template>
      </SideNavHeading>
    </template>
  </SideNav>
</template>
```

```ts
import { NavHeadingMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

<template>
```

summary.en: `NavMenu` is a `role="menu"`. `NavMenuItem` is one entry and becomes a link when `href` is set. `NavDisclosure` owns the trigger, positioning, and dismissal: click, hover, outside press, and Escape all close it. ArrowDown opens on the first item, ArrowUp on the last. Inside the menu, arrows move and a typed character jumps to a matching prefix.
summary.zh: `NavMenu` 是 `role="menu"` 的菜单。`NavMenuItem` 是其中一项，有 `href` 时是链接。`NavDisclosure` 负责触发按钮、定位和关闭：点击、悬停、点击外部和 Escape 都会关掉。ArrowDown 打开并聚焦第一项，ArrowUp 聚焦最后一项。菜单内部方向键移动，单字符会按前缀匹配。

usage.en:
`NavMenu` is a `role="menu"`. `NavMenuItem` is one entry and becomes a link when `href` is set. `NavDisclosure` owns the trigger, positioning, and dismissal: click, hover, outside press, and Escape all close it. ArrowDown opens on the first item, ArrowUp on the last. Inside the menu, arrows move and a typed character jumps to a matching prefix.

The top nav and overflow list already compose these parts. Use them directly for an account menu.

Menus attached to a side or top heading use `NavHeadingMenu` and `NavHeadingMenuItem`. Put the menu in the heading `menu` slot. The heading owns closing and where focus goes after open. An item with an address is a link. An item without one is a `menuitem`. Arrows move, and Enter or Space activates the current item.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavDisclosure, NavMenu, NavMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <NavDisclosure label="Account">
    <template #trigger="{ isOpen, panelId }">
      <button type="button" :aria-controls="panelId" :aria-expanded="isOpen">
        Account
      </button>
    </template>
    <template #default="{ close, focusRequest }">
      <NavMenu label="Account" :focus-request="focusRequest" @close="close">
        <NavMenuItem href="/profile" label="Profile" />
      </NavMenu>
    </template>
  </NavDisclosure>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`NavMenu` 是 `role="menu"` 的菜单。`NavMenuItem` 是其中一项，有 `href` 时是链接。`NavDisclosure` 负责触发按钮、定位和关闭：点击、悬停、点击外部和 Escape 都会关掉。ArrowDown 打开并聚焦第一项，ArrowUp 聚焦最后一项。菜单内部方向键移动，单字符会按前缀匹配。

顶栏和溢出列表已经包好了这组零件。需要自己做账号菜单时直接用它们。

挂在侧栏或顶栏标题上的菜单用 `NavHeadingMenu` 和 `NavHeadingMenuItem`。把它放进标题的 `menu` 插槽即可，关闭和打开后的焦点由标题负责。有地址的项是链接，没有地址的项是 `menuitem`。方向键移动，Enter 或 Space 激活当前项。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavDisclosure, NavMenu, NavMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <NavDisclosure label="账号">
    <template #trigger="{ isOpen, panelId }">
      <button type="button" :aria-controls="panelId" :aria-expanded="isOpen">
        账号
      </button>
    </template>
    <template #default="{ close, focusRequest }">
      <NavMenu label="账号" :focus-request="focusRequest" @close="close">
        <NavMenuItem href="/profile" label="个人资料" />
      </NavMenu>
    </template>
  </NavDisclosure>
</template>
```

en.text: Write `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the trigger. The slot already passes that state.
Items close the menu by default. Set `keepOpen` when the menu should stay.
Do not leave `menuitem` elements in a drawer. Set `isMenuItem` to false there.

zh.text: 触发按钮写上 `aria-expanded` 和 `aria-controls`，插槽已经把状态传出来了。
选中一项后默认关闭。需要留下菜单时给项设置 `keepOpen`。
不要把菜单项单独放进抽屉。抽屉里把 `isMenuItem` 设成 false，避免菜单项脱离菜单。

summary.en: `Pagination` splits a long list into pages. People move with the page buttons or the previous and next controls.
summary.zh: `Pagination` 是一个分页导航组件，用于将大量数据分割成多个页面展示。用户可以通过点击页码、上下页按钮或输入页码跳转到指定页面。

usage.en:
`Pagination` splits a long list into pages. People move with the page buttons or the previous and next controls.

Pass the total and bind the current page:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Pagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Pagination'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const page = ref(1)
const total = ref(100)
</script>

<template>
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="total" />
</template>
```

`pageSize` is how many items each page holds. `showSizeChanger` lets people change that. `showTotal` shows how many items exist and which range the current page covers.

The visible labels are English unless the app calls `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`.
usage.zh:
`Pagination` 是一个分页导航组件，用于将大量数据分割成多个页面展示。用户可以通过点击页码、上下页按钮或输入页码跳转到指定页面。

基本用法需要提供总条目数和当前页码：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Pagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Pagination'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const page = ref(1)
const total = ref(100)
</script>

<template>
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="total" />
</template>
```

通过 `pageSize` 属性设置每页显示的条目数。开启 `showSizeChanger` 后，用户可以自行选择每页显示数量。按钮和总数文案默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文。

数据量大时提供页码跳转和每页数量选择功能。

在窄屏上铺一长排页码按钮。页码很多时让控件保持紧凑。

summary.en: `SideNav` is the navigation landmark along one side of a page. Compose it with `SideNavSection`, `SideNavHeading`, and `SideNavItem`. With `collapsible`, the bar can shrink to an icon rail. `SideNavCollapseButton` sits at the top end of the sidebar. Items without an icon are omitted while collapsed. Items with children open in a side menu. The `actions` slot on `SideNavItem` sits beside the primary control, outside the link, and is not rendered while the rail is collapsed.
summary.zh: `SideNav` 是页面一侧的导航地标。里面按 `SideNavSection`、`SideNavHeading`、`SideNavItem` 组织。`collapsible` 打开后，栏可以收成只剩图标的窄条，`SideNavCollapseButton` 在侧栏顶部靠右。收起后，没有图标的项不会渲染；有下级的项改成从侧面弹出的菜单。`SideNavItem` 的 `actions` 插槽和主控件并排，不放进链接里面，侧栏收起后不再渲染。

usage.en:
`SideNav` is the navigation landmark along one side of a page. Compose it with `SideNavSection`, `SideNavHeading`, and `SideNavItem`. With `collapsible`, the bar can shrink to an icon rail. `SideNavCollapseButton` sits at the top end of the sidebar. Items without an icon are omitted while collapsed. Items with children open in a side menu. The `actions` slot on `SideNavItem` sits beside the primary control, outside the link, and is not rendered while the rail is collapsed.

Control it with `v-model:is-collapsed`. Pass an object to `collapsible` to hide the built-in button or to set a hotkey such as `mod+\\`. With `resizable`, the trailing edge can be dragged. The width starts at 260px and stays between 180px and 480px. The handle hides while the bar is collapsed. Dragging below 160px collapses the bar when collapse is also enabled.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SideNav, SideNavItem, SideNavSection } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const collapsed = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SideNav v-model:is-collapsed="collapsed" collapsible>
    <SideNavSection title="Workspace">
      <SideNavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" label="Home" />
    </SideNavSection>
  </SideNav>
</template>
```

<SideNavCollapseFigure class="nav-collapse-figure" />
usage.zh:
`SideNav` 是页面一侧的导航地标。里面按 `SideNavSection`、`SideNavHeading`、`SideNavItem` 组织。`collapsible` 打开后，栏可以收成只剩图标的窄条，`SideNavCollapseButton` 在侧栏顶部靠右。收起后，没有图标的项不会渲染；有下级的项改成从侧面弹出的菜单。`SideNavItem` 的 `actions` 插槽和主控件并排，不放进链接里面，侧栏收起后不再渲染。

用 `v-model:is-collapsed` 受控。`collapsible` 也可以传对象，关掉内置按钮，或给一个快捷键，例如 `mod+\\`。`resizable` 打开后，结束边上可以拖宽度，默认从 260px 起，范围是 180px 到 480px。收起后把手会藏起来。拖到 160px 以下、并且侧栏可以收起时，栏会收成图标条。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SideNav, SideNavItem, SideNavSection } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const collapsed = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SideNav v-model:is-collapsed="collapsed" collapsible>
    <SideNavSection title="工作区">
      <SideNavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" label="首页" />
    </SideNavSection>
  </SideNav>
</template>
```

en.text: Give every collapsible item an icon, or it disappears in the rail.
Set `href` when a row both navigates and has children. The label navigates; the chevron collapses.
Turn on `resizable` when people should drag the width. Keep collapse on `v-model:is-collapsed` instead of setting it on both `collapsible` and `resizable`.

usage.en:
Navigation item with icon, selected state, optional end content, and nesting support via children.

Put `SideNavItem` elements in the default slot of a `SideNav` or a `SideNavSection`. An item with children becomes a group: the chevron collapses it, and when the item also has an `href` the label navigates while the chevron opens the group. In a collapsed rail an item with children opens its children in a side popover. `end` sits at the trailing edge of the row.

```ts
import { SideNavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```
usage.zh:
侧栏里的一条导航：可以有图标、选中状态、末尾内容，也能带下级。

`SideNavItem` 放在 `SideNav` 或 `SideNavSection` 的默认插槽里。带下级时这一项变成一个分组，箭头负责展开和收起；如果它同时有 `href`，点文字是跳转，点箭头才展开分组。侧栏收成窄栏后，带下级的项会在侧面的弹层里列出下级。`end` 在这一行的末尾。

```ts
import { SideNavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```

usage.en:
Product/suite/account heading with smart interaction boundary logic for links and a menu popover.

Pass it to the `header` slot of a `SideNav`. `icon` goes before the text. `superheading` is the small line above the title and `subheading` the one below, and each line can carry its own link. A `menu` slot turns the text into a popover trigger with a chevron, while a plain `headingHref` with no menu makes the whole heading one link. `end` sits at the trailing edge.

```ts
import { SideNavHeading } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```
usage.zh:
产品名、套件名或账户名，放在 `SideNav` 的 `header` 插槽里。它按「哪里能点」自动分工：标志、标题、上下两行小字可以各自成链接，再加一个菜单时标题旁边会长出箭头。

`icon` 放在文字前面。`superheading` 是标题上面那行小字，`subheading` 是下面那行，两行都能单独带链接。给了 `menu` 插槽，标题就变成弹出菜单的开关并出现箭头；只给 `headingHref` 没有菜单时，整段标题是一个大链接。`end` 靠在这一行的末尾。

```ts
import { SideNavHeading } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```

usage.en:
Section grouping with an optional title, subtitle, and end content.

A section is a named group of `SideNavItem` elements. `subtitle` adds a second, smaller line under the title, and `end` sits at the trailing edge of the header row. While the rail is collapsed the header is only hidden visually, so screen readers still hear the group name. `isHeaderHidden` hides it at any width.

```ts
import { SideNavSection } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```

usage.en:
Toggle button for sidenav collapse. Place inside SideNav (reads context automatically) or outside it (hand the same controlled collapsible config to both). Renders as an icon-only ghost button by default.

Inside a `SideNav` the button finds the collapse state by itself. Outside it, bind `v-model:is-collapsed`, or pass the same `collapsible` config (`{ isCollapsed, onCollapsedChange }`) to the button and the `SideNav`, so the two stay in step. Pass `label` to turn the icon-only square into a text button.

```ts
import { SideNavCollapseButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
```

`label` 一传，方形的图标按钮就变成带文字的按钮。不传时，文字跟着状态在「展开侧栏」和「收起侧栏」之间切换，读屏读到的就是这句话。

summary.en: Import `TabList` and `Tab` from their dedicated entry and control selection with `v-model:value`.
summary.zh: `TabList` 把一组 `Tab` 组织成标签页，让用户在同一区域内切换相关内容，常用于设置页、详情页的分区浏览。从独立入口导入组件后，通过 `v-model:value` 控制当前选中项：

usage.en:
Import `TabList` and `Tab` from their dedicated entry and control selection with `v-model:value`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="overview">
      Overview
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="props">
      Props
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="examples">
      Examples
    </Tab>
  </TabList>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TabList` 把一组 `Tab` 组织成标签页，让用户在同一区域内切换相关内容，常用于设置页、详情页的分区浏览。从独立入口导入组件后，通过 `v-model:value` 控制当前选中项：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="overview">
      总览
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="props">
      属性
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="examples">
      示例
    </Tab>
  </TabList>
</template>
```

en.text: Leave `role` unset for a navigation landmark that marks the current tab with `aria-current="true"`. Set `role="tablist"` to opt into the tabs pattern, with `role="tab"` and `aria-selected`. Tabs wider than the strip scroll sideways by default.
Give each `Tab` a unique `value` for selection and keyboard navigation.
Use `disabled` for unavailable tabs; keyboard navigation skips them automatically.
Put too many tabs in a single strip; consider scrolling or reorganizing content when it overflows.
Use TabList for page-level navigation; Breadcrumbs or Link are better for wayfinding.

zh.text: 不传 `role` 时，标签条是导航地标，当前项用 `aria-current="true"`。写成 `role="tablist"` 才进入标签页模式，带 `role="tab"` 和 `aria-selected`。标签比条宽时默认横向滚动。
为每个 `Tab` 提供唯一的 `value`：它是选中状态的标识，也是键盘导航定位标签的依据。
需要暂时不可用的标签时设置 `disabled`，键盘导航会自动跳过，用户也不会误点。
避免在单个 TabList 中放入过多标签：标签过多会增加查找成本，超出容器时应考虑滚动或重新组织内容。
避免用 TabList 承担页面级导航：标签页适合切换同页内容，跨页面跳转应使用链接或面包屑。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: Currently selected tab value. Supports `v-model:value`.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Tab size. Optional: `sm`, `md`, `lg`.

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: Tab layout. Optional: `hug`, `fill`. `hug` sizes to content, `fill` distributes evenly.

rows.name: `hasDivider`
rows.description: Whether to show a bottom divider.

rows.name: `overflow`
rows.description: What happens when the tabs are wider than the strip. `auto` and `scroll` scroll sideways, fade the hidden edge, and offer page arrows. `visible` does not scroll. A selected tab that is out of view scrolls back into view immediately.

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: ARIA role of the strip. `tablist` selects the tabs pattern: tabs get `role="tab"` with `aria-selected`, and each tab points at its panel through `panelId`. Left unset, the strip is a navigation landmark that marks the current tab with `aria-current` and renders a tab with `href` as a link. Any other value is passed through to the element.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: Unique tab value.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Visible text of the tab, also used as the accessible name when `isLabelHidden` is set. The default slot wins when both are given.

rows.name: `href`

usage.en:
Individual tab item that renders as a button or an anchor link, with selected-state styling and optional icons.

A `Tab` reads the selection and the size from the surrounding `TabList`, so it always renders inside one. The default slot is the label. `icon` shows while the tab is not selected and `selectedIcon` while it is; `endContent` follows the label for a badge or a status dot. With `href` the tab renders as a link, unless the strip is a `role="tablist"` and the tab points at its panel with `panelId` instead.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('inbox')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="inbox">
      Inbox
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="sent">
      Sent
    </Tab>
  </TabList>
</template>
```

标签页里的一个标签。它渲染成按钮或者链接，选中时换一套样式，还能带图标。

```vue

import { Tab, TabList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'

const value = ref('inbox')

<template>

      已发送
    </Tab>
  </TabList>

```

summary.en: `TopNav` is the navigation landmark across the top of a page. `heading`, `start`, the default slot, and `center` run from the leading edge, and `end` stays at the trailing edge. `TopNavHeading` can show a logo, a line above the title, a line below it, and a menu. `TopNavMenu` opens a menu. `TopNavMegaMenu` opens a larger panel with items and a featured card. summary.zh: `TopNav` 是页面顶部的导航地标。`heading`、`start`、默认插槽和 `center` 从左到右排，`end` 靠右。`TopNavHeading` 可以带标志、上下行和标题菜单。`TopNavMenu` 打开普通菜单，`TopNavMegaMenu` 打开带分组和推荐卡的大菜单。推荐卡可以放图片，行动文字单独成链接。方向键在菜单项之间移动，Escape 关闭。

usage.en:
`TopNav` is the navigation landmark across the top of a page. `heading`, `start`, the default slot, and `center` run from the leading edge, and `end` stays at the trailing edge. `TopNavHeading` can show a logo, a line above the title, a line below it, and a menu. `TopNavMenu` opens a menu. `TopNavMegaMenu` opens a larger panel with items and a featured card. The card can show an image, and its action is its own link. Arrow keys move through the items and Escape closes the panel.

Pass `mobileQuery` and, when it matches, the leading and center content moves into `MobileNav`. The bar keeps the heading, the end slot, and the toggle. A slot is not rendered in both places at once.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNav mobile-query="(max-width: 800px)">
    <template #heading>
      <TopNavHeading heading="Northwind" href="/" />
    </template>
    <TopNavMenu label="Product" :items="[{ label: 'Analytics', href: '/analytics' }]" />
  </TopNav>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TopNav` 是页面顶部的导航地标。`heading`、`start`、默认插槽和 `center` 从左到右排，`end` 靠右。`TopNavHeading` 可以带标志、上下行和标题菜单。`TopNavMenu` 打开普通菜单，`TopNavMegaMenu` 打开带分组和推荐卡的大菜单。推荐卡可以放图片，行动文字单独成链接。方向键在菜单项之间移动，Escape 关闭。

传入 `mobileQuery` 后，查询命中时起始和中间的内容收进 `MobileNav`，栏上只留标题、结束内容和开关。同一个插槽不会同时出现在两处。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNav mobile-query="(max-width: 800px)">
    <template #heading>
      <TopNavHeading heading="Northwind" href="/" />
    </template>
    <TopNavMenu label="产品" :items="[{ label: '分析', href: '/analytics' }]" />
  </TopNav>
</template>
```

en.text: Give menu items an `href`. ArrowDown opens, arrows move, Escape closes.
Use `mobileQuery` on small screens instead of copying the same links into a drawer.
Do not put a form in the mega menu. It is navigation, not a dialog.

窄屏用 `mobileQuery`，不要把同一组链接再复制进抽屉。
大菜单里不要塞表单。它是导航，不是对话框。

rows.name: `heading`
rows.description: 产品或应用的名字，就是标题本身。只有标志、没有文字时可以不传。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 和 `headingHref` 是同一个意思，写出来是为了让顶栏和侧栏的标题用同样的属性名。两个都写时以 `headingHref` 为准。

rows.name: `subheading`

rows.name: `subheadingHref`

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `logo`: logo rendered before the heading text. An image, a `NavIcon`, or any element.
- `icon`: same place as `logo`. `logo` wins when both are passed.
- `end`: content at the trailing edge of the heading row, such as a badge.
- `menu`: menu content shown in a popover. A chevron indicator appears automatically. With no href the whole header opens the menu; with hrefs the links are independent and the chevron area opens it. Receives `close` and `focusRequest`.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `logo`：标题左边的标志，可以是图片、`NavIcon`，或者任意元素。
- `icon`：和 `logo` 是同一个位置。两个都写时用 `logo`。
- `end`：标题这一行的末尾，例如放一个徽章。
- `menu`：弹出菜单的内容。给了它，标题旁边会自动出现箭头。没有链接时点整段标题打开菜单；有链接时链接各管各的，只有箭头打开菜单。插槽参数有 `close` 和 `focusRequest`。

usage.en:
`TopNavItem` is a navigation link item for the `start` slot or the default slot of `TopNav`: it renders as an anchor with hover and selected states.

With `href` set, the item is a link. Without an address, or with `isDisabled`, it renders as a button instead, so it cannot navigate.

```ts
import { TopNavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
```

```ts

```

usage.en:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavItem, TopNavMegaMenu, TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard, TopNavMegaMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNav label="Main navigation">
    <template #heading>
      <TopNavHeading heading="DevTools" href="#home" />
    </template>
    <TopNavItem href="#overview" label="Overview" />
    <TopNavMegaMenu label="Products">
      <TopNavMegaMenuItem title="Deploy" description="Ship to production in seconds" href="#deploy" />
      <TopNavMegaMenuItem title="Documentation" description="Guides, references, and tutorials" href="#documentation" />
      <template #featured>
        <TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
          title="What's New"
          description="Check out our latest features and improvements in the Q2 release."
          link-label="Read the changelog"
          link-href="#changelog"
        />
      </template>
    </TopNavMegaMenu>
  </TopNav>
</template>
```

summary.en: Standard featured card for the `TopNavMegaMenu` featured slot. Provides a consistent card with optional image, title, description, and CTA link.
summary.zh: 这是放在 `TopNavMegaMenu` 的 `featured` 插槽里的标准推荐卡片。它把「图片 + 标题 + 说明 + 行动链接」固定成一套版式，各个大菜单里看起来都一致。

usage.en:
Standard featured card for the `TopNavMegaMenu` featured slot. Provides a consistent card with optional image, title, description, and CTA link.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
    title="What's New"
    description="Check out the latest features and improvements in the Q2 release."
    link-label="Read the changelog"
    link-href="#changelog"
  />
</template>
```

`title` is required. `image` renders above the body; without `imageAlt` the image stays decorative, which is usually right because the card already carries a visible title. `linkLabel` and `linkHref` add the action at the bottom of the card, and `linkHref` falls back to `href`. Pass `href` without `linkLabel` to make the whole card one link. Text in the default slot lands under the description.
usage.zh:
这是放在 `TopNavMegaMenu` 的 `featured` 插槽里的标准推荐卡片。它把「图片 + 标题 + 说明 + 行动链接」固定成一套版式，各个大菜单里看起来都一致。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
    title="What's New"
    description="Check out the latest features and improvements in the Q2 release."
    link-label="Read the changelog"
    link-href="#changelog"
  />
</template>
```

标题是必填的。传了 `image` 就在正文上方显示图片；不传 `imageAlt` 时图片只当装饰，因为卡片上已经有可见标题，读屏跳过它反而更干净。`linkLabel` 加 `linkHref` 会在卡片底部多出一个行动链接，`linkHref` 不传就用 `href`。只传 `href`、不传 `linkLabel` 时，整张卡片本身就是一个链接。默认插槽里的内容显示在说明文字下方。

summary.en: An individual item inside an TopNavMegaMenu. Renders itself in both desktop (popover grid) and mobile drawer modes via render mode context.
summary.zh: `TopNavMegaMenuItem` 是大菜单（`TopNavMegaMenu`）里的一项，一项就是一个去处。桌面端它排在弹出面板的网格里，手机端排在抽屉的列表里，用哪种形态跟着所在菜单走，你不用自己切换。

usage.en:
An individual item inside an TopNavMegaMenu. Renders itself in both desktop (popover grid) and mobile drawer modes via render mode context.

```ts
import { TopNavMegaMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
```

One item stands for one destination: a title, an optional description under it, and an optional leading icon. Pass `href` to render a link; leave it out and the item is a `<button type="button">`. The icon comes from an `iconClass` CSS icon class or from the `icon` slot, which wins when both are present.

Items go in the default slot of `TopNavMegaMenu`, next to the optional `featured` slot. Clicking an item closes the menu it sits in. Rendered on its own it still shows the title, description, and icon, but there is no menu around it to close.
usage.zh:
`TopNavMegaMenuItem` 是大菜单（`TopNavMegaMenu`）里的一项，一项就是一个去处。桌面端它排在弹出面板的网格里，手机端排在抽屉的列表里，用哪种形态跟着所在菜单走，你不用自己切换。

```ts
import { TopNavMegaMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
```

传了 `href` 这一项就是链接，不传就是一个 `<button type="button">` 按钮，两种样子一样。左边的图标用 `iconClass` 给一个 CSS 图标类名，或者用 `icon` 插槽放自己的图标，两个都给时插槽优先。`description` 可以不传，传了就显示在标题下面一行小字。

点一下会关掉它所在的大菜单。单独拿出来用也能正常显示标题、描述和图标，只是身边没有菜单可关。
