summary.en: `Stepper` lists the steps of a flow. `activeStep` is the zero-based current step. A step before it is completed, the current step is in progress, and the rest have not started.
summary.zh: `Stepper` 列出一个流程里的步骤。`activeStep` 是从 0 开始的当前步。它前面的步骤已完成，当前步进行中，后面的还没开始。

usage.en:
`Stepper` lists the steps of a flow. `activeStep` is the zero-based current step. A step before it is completed, the current step is in progress, and the rest have not started.

Pass `@step-click` when a step can be chosen out of order. The handler receives the zero-based index, and only then do the steps render as buttons. The default `separated` layout draws a track above each horizontal step, with the indicator and the label on one row. `indicatorPosition="on-track"` sets the indicator into the connector and centers the label under it. `indicator` defaults to `auto`: a check when the step is done, a ring on the current step, and a number after that.

`horizontalOptions.minimumStepWidth` defaults to `112`. A horizontal stepper collapses once it is narrower than that width times the step count, and shows the current step with Previous and Next. The track stays. `collapsedVariant` defaults to `withLabelAndControls` and skips disabled steps. `withLabel` drops the controls, and `hiddenLabel` leaves only the track.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(2)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper
    :active-step="active"
    :horizontal-options="{ minimumStepWidth: 112 }"
    @step-click="active = $event"
  >
    <Step label="Cart" :step="0" />
    <Step label="Shipping" :step="1" />
    <Step label="Payment" :step="2" />
    <Step label="Review" :step="3" />
    <Step label="Confirm" :step="4" />
  </Stepper>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Stepper` 列出一个流程里的步骤。`activeStep` 是从 0 开始的当前步。它前面的步骤已完成，当前步进行中，后面的还没开始。

步骤可以不按顺序点时，传入 `@step-click`。回调拿到从 0 开始的序号，只有这时步骤才会渲染成按钮。默认的 `separated` 在水平步骤上方画轨道，圆标和标签排在同一行。`indicatorPosition="on-track"` 把圆标嵌进连接线，标签居中放在圆标下面。`indicator` 默认是 `auto`：完成的步骤是勾，当前步是环，后面的步骤是数字。

`horizontalOptions.minimumStepWidth` 默认是 `112`。水平步骤条窄于「112 × 步骤数」时会自动收起，只留当前步，并带 Previous 和 Next。轨道还在。`collapsedVariant` 默认是 `withLabelAndControls`，并跳过禁用的步骤。`withLabel` 不显示这两个按钮，`hiddenLabel` 只留轨道。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(2)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper
    :active-step="active"
    :horizontal-options="{ minimumStepWidth: 112 }"
    @step-click="active = $event"
  >
    <Step label="Cart" :step="0" />
    <Step label="Shipping" :step="1" />
    <Step label="Payment" :step="2" />
    <Step label="Review" :step="3" />
    <Step label="Confirm" :step="4" />
  </Stepper>
</template>
```

description.zh: 垂直步骤各自占页面的一块。内容可以是表单、摘要或横幅，并且只渲染当前步骤。

description.en: None leaves progress to the bar and the label. Auto uses a check, a ring, or a number. Number always shows the step. A custom icon can replace the glyph.

description.en: On a horizontal track, each indicator sits in the connector so the numbers read as beads on one line. Labels center under their node.

description.en: On a vertical rail, the indicator sits on the connector, with the label and description beside the node.
description.zh: 垂直轨道上，指示器落在连续的连接线上，标签和说明放在节点旁边。

description.en: Success, error, and accent recolor the indicator in a verification flow. Status never recolors the connector.
description.zh: 校验流程里，成功、错误和强调色只改变指示器。连接线的颜色不受状态影响。

description.en: At 320px, four steps fall below the 112px minimum width and collapse to the current step, with Previous and Next.
description.zh: 宽度 320px 时，四步低于 112px 的最小宽度，收成当前步骤，并带上一步和下一步。

en.name: Stepper
en.description: The ordered list holding the steps. Owns the orientation and the indicator placement the whole flow is laid out on.

en.name: Frame
en.description: The layout frame that groups the ordered steps with the optional compact summary shown at narrow widths.

en.name: Compact summary
en.description: The optional row a horizontal Stepper adds directly beneath the track once it is too narrow to label every step. horizontalOptions.collapsedVariant chooses a label with Previous/Next controls, the label alone, or no row for a bare progress track. The on-track layout keeps its indicators on the rail instead of repeating the active indicator beside the label. Every step keeps its name in the accessible sequence at any width.

en.name: Step
en.description: One step in the flow, and the element carrying its status. Wraps the indicator, label, description, and the track segments belonging to it.

en.name: Progress bar
en.description: A 4px segmented bar per step. Filled for completed and active steps. Advancing one step grows the fill along the track it just covered, so the movement reads as progress rather than a bar changing color. Every other change applies at once: going back, jumping forward by more than one step, mounting mid-flow, and any change at all under prefers-reduced-motion. Where a span is drawn by more than one segment (the on-track layouts split it between two steps, three when a content slot sits between them), the segments run in track order at one constant speed, so the fill reads as a single line growing rather than pieces lighting in turn.

en.name: Connector
en.description: The track drawn between indicators in the on-track layouts. Each connector paints an unfilled line and, over it, the accent fill covering the progress made. How many pieces a connector is drawn from is an implementation detail of the layout, not a themeable part; use --step-connector-gap to hold the track off the indicator.

en.name: Indicator
en.description: A numbered badge, a check, or any custom icon. Controlled via the indicator prop.

en.name: Label
en.description: Text identifying the step.

en.name: Description
en.description: Supporting text below the label with additional context.

zh.name: 步骤条
zh.description: 装着各步的有序列表。整条流程的方向，以及指示放在哪里，都由它决定。

zh.name: 框架
zh.description: 把有序的步骤和窄宽度下可选的紧凑摘要组合在一起的布局框。

zh.name: 紧凑摘要
zh.description: 横向 Stepper 窄到没法给每一步都标字时，直接加在轨道下方的可选一行。horizontalOptions.collapsedVariant 决定这一行是「标签加上一页和下一页」、只有标签，还是不出现、只留一条进度轨。轨道上的布局把指示留在轨上，不会在标签旁边再重复当前指示。无论多窄，每一步的名字都留在无障碍序列里。

zh.name: 步骤
zh.description: 流程里的一步，也是带着这一步状态的元素。里面有指示、标签、说明，以及属于它的轨段。

zh.name: 进度条
zh.description: 每一步一条 4px 的分段条。已完成和当前步是填满的。前进一步时，填充沿着刚走过的那段轨长出来，读起来是在前进，而不是一根条在变色。其余变化一次完成：往回走、一次跳过不止一步、中途挂载，以及 prefers-reduced-motion 下的任何变化。一段跨度由不止一段画出时（轨道上的布局会把它分给两步，中间再插内容插槽时是三步），这些段按轨道顺序、以同一个恒定速度走，所以填充读起来是一条线在长，而不是一段段依次点亮。

zh.name: 连接线
zh.description: 轨道上的布局里，指示之间画出的轨。每条连接线先画一条未填充的线，再在上面画表示已完成进度的强调填充。一条连接线由几段拼成，是布局的实现细节，不是可以单独换主题的部分。用 --step-connector-gap 让轨和指示保持距离。

zh.name: 指示
zh.description: 数字徽章、勾，或任意自定义图标。由 indicator 属性控制。

zh.name: 标签
zh.description: 标识这一步的文字。

zh.name: 说明
zh.description: 标签下面的补充文字。

summary.en: Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description. Progress (completed/active/not-started) is derived from the parent Stepper's activeStep and this step's step index.
summary.zh: 步骤条里的一步。它画出一段进度条、一个指示器，还有带说明的名称。它算完成、进行中还是没开始，全看父级 `Stepper` 的 `activeStep` 和它自己的序号，不用自己设。

usage.en:
Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description. Progress (completed/active/not-started) is derived from the parent Stepper's activeStep and this step's step index.

`step` is the zero-based index and decides the progress, so it is never set directly. The default slot puts content under the description, outside the clickable label row, so a form inside keeps its own targets. `end` adds trailing content to the label row, and `icon` replaces the built-in indicator artwork.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(1)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper :active-step="active" @step-click="active = $event">
    <Step label="Cart" :step="0" />
    <Step label="Shipping" :step="1" />
    <Step label="Payment" :step="2" />
  </Stepper>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
步骤条里的一步。它画出一段进度条、一个指示器，还有带说明的名称。它算完成、进行中还是没开始，全看父级 `Stepper` 的 `activeStep` 和它自己的序号，不用自己设。

`step` 是序号，从 0 开始。默认插槽的内容放在说明下面、可点击的那一行外面，所以里面的表单和按钮还能各自点。`end` 在名称这一行的末尾追加内容，`icon` 换掉内置的指示器图形。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(1)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper :active-step="active" @step-click="active = $event">
    <Step label="购物车" :step="0" />

In a full flow you gate the slot on the step being active. That is what turns a vertical stepper into an expanding one.

description.en: Everything the indicator prop accepts: the auto default, an always-number badge, a custom node, and none, each on its own completed Step so the prop is the only difference between them. Every variant occupies the same 16px box, so a step swapping its number for a check as it completes never shifts the label beside it. The last cell shows that a custom node can be live rather than static: a Spinner on a step that is in progress, shaded inherit so it picks up the step's own tint like any other glyph.
description.zh: indicator 能接受的全部写法：默认的 auto、一直显示序号、塞一个自定义节点，还有干脆不显示。每一格都放在自己那个已完成的 Step 上，所以唯一的差别就是这一个属性。所有写法都占同样 16px 的方框，所以完成时把数字换成勾，旁边的文字也不会跟着跳。最后一格说明自定义节点可以是活的：进行中的那一步放一个 Spinner，颜色用 inherit，跟别的图形一样蘸上这一步的色调。

description.en: Every state a single Step can land in, each shown as one Step in its own Stepper. Completed, current, and upcoming are derived by comparing the step index against the parent activeStep, so they are never set directly; isDisabled and status are the two a step declares itself. Status is a separate axis from progress, which is why a completed step can still carry a warning.
description.zh: 单独一步能落到的每一种状态，每格是它自己那条步骤条里的一步。完成、当前、未开始都是拿序号和父级的 activeStep 比出来的，不能直接设；isDisabled 和 status 才是这一步自己声明的两个。状态和进度是两条轴，所以已完成的步骤也可以带一个警告。

usage.en:
`TabMenu` collects tabs that do not fit on the `TabList`. It has to be a child of `TabList`. Arrow keys move onto the trigger without changing the selected tab. Enter or Space opens the menu. The menu items are `menuitemradio` controls, and choosing one selects that tab through the list.

`label` is the trigger text when none of the options is selected, and the menu's accessible name. When an option is the selected tab, the trigger shows that option's label and takes the selected tab style. `iconClass` is a CSS icon class on an option, for example `i-carbon-settings`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList, TabMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="overview">
      Overview
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="activity">
      Activity
    </Tab>
    <TabMenu
      label="More"
      :options="[
        { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' },
        { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' },
      ]"
    />
  </TabList>
</template>
```

summary.en: `Outline` is a table of contents. Each item is `{ id, label, level }`. `id` matches a heading element on the page. `level` is 1 through 6. Levels 1 and 2 share the first indent. Level 3, 4, and 5–6 step inward after that.
summary.zh: `Outline` 是目录。每一项是 `{ id, label, level }`。`id` 对应页面上标题元素的 id。`level` 从 1 到 6。1 和 2 共用第一档缩进，3、4、以及 5–6 再逐档往里收。

usage.en:
`Outline` is a table of contents. Each item is `{ id, label, level }`. `id` matches a heading element on the page. `level` is 1 through 6. Levels 1 and 2 share the first indent. Level 3, 4, and 5–6 step inward after that.

Leave `activeId` unset and the outline follows scroll. It uses `scrollContainer` when you pass one, otherwise the nearest scrollable ancestor, otherwise the viewport. The active item is the last heading whose top has passed the resting line. At the bottom of the scroll, the last item is active. `offset` shifts that line and the scroll landing by the same amount, on top of each heading’s own `scroll-margin-top`.

Pass `activeId` and scroll-spy stays off. `v-model:active-id` keeps the highlight in your own state. `navigateStart` fires when a click starts a scroll. `navigateEnd` fires once for that navigation, when the scroll settles, when the reader interrupts it, or after 1.2 seconds.

`hasScrollOnClick` is on by default. A click with a modifier key, or a click whose target id is missing, does not take over the browser’s own behavior. Activating an item writes the hash with `history.pushState`.

`parseOutlineFromMarkdown` builds the outline from Markdown. The ids match the anchors `Markdown` renders on its headings. A hash inside a fence is not a heading. A heading inside a quote or a list consumes a duplicate id and stays out of the outline. `useOutlineFromMarkdown` recomputes when the source changes. `useOutlineFromDOM` reads h1–h6 that already have an id inside a container.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Outline } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'

const items = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', level: 2 },
  { id: 'theming', label: 'Theming', level: 2 },
  { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens', level: 3 },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Outline :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Outline` 是目录。每一项是 `{ id, label, level }`。`id` 对应页面上标题元素的 id。`level` 从 1 到 6。1 和 2 共用第一档缩进，3、4、以及 5–6 再逐档往里收。

不传 `activeId` 时，大纲跟着滚动走。传了 `scrollContainer` 就盯这个容器，否则找最近的可滚动祖先，再没有就用视口。当前项是顶部已经越过停留线的最后一个标题。滚到底时，最后一项为当前项。`offset` 把停留线和滚动落点一起下移，标题自己的 `scroll-margin-top` 仍然算在里面。

传入 `activeId` 后，滚动侦测关闭。`v-model:active-id` 把高亮留在你自己的状态里。点击开始滚动时发出 `navigateStart`。同一次导航结束时发出一次 `navigateEnd`：滚动停稳、读者中途打断，或超过 1.2 秒，都会结束。

`hasScrollOnClick` 默认打开。带修饰键的点击，或目标 id 在页面上不存在时，不接管浏览器自己的行为。激活一项会用 `history.pushState` 写入 hash。

`parseOutlineFromMarkdown` 从 Markdown 抽出目录，id 和 `Markdown` 写到标题上的锚点是同一套。围栏代码里的井号不算标题。引用或列表里的标题会占掉重复 id，但不出现在目录里。`useOutlineFromMarkdown` 在正文变化时重算。`useOutlineFromDOM` 读取容器里带 id 的 h1 到 h6。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Outline } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'

const items = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', level: 2 },
  { id: 'theming', label: 'Theming', level: 2 },
  { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens', level: 3 },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Outline :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Point each `id` at a real heading, and keep `level` equal to that heading’s level.
Set `offset` to the height of a sticky header so the active item and the scroll landing agree.
Use `density="compact"` in a narrow sidebar, and `default` beside a long article.
Pass `activeId` and also expect the built-in scroll-spy to keep updating it. A provided id turns the spy off.
Indent by hand with extra markup. The level already chooses the indent.

summary.en: `AlertDialog` is a modal with a single job: it asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before that action happens. Deleting content, revoking access, and discarding unsaved work all belong here — the work cannot be undone, so it is worth interrupting the user, stating the consequence, and letting them decide.
summary.zh: `AlertDialog`（警告对话框）只专心做一件事：在具有破坏性或无法撤回的操作（比如永久删除文件、清空数据、注销账户）真正执行前，跳出来跟用户再次确认。因为这些动作做完就没法反悔，所以必须郑重其事地停下来，向用户说清楚后果，再交由用户自己做决定。

usage.en:
`AlertDialog` is a modal with a single job: it asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before that action happens. Deleting content, revoking access, and discarding unsaved work all belong here — the work cannot be undone, so it is worth interrupting the user, stating the consequence, and letting them decide.

It implements the WAI-ARIA Alert Dialog pattern. The root element uses `role="alertdialog"`, the title names the dialog through `aria-labelledby`, and the consequence description is announced with it through `aria-describedby`. Focus moves into the dialog on open and lands on Cancel, then returns to the element that opened it on close. The dialog cannot be dismissed by clicking the backdrop, and Escape is the same as canceling.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Delete project" variant="destructive" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <AlertDialog
    :is-open="isOpen"
    title="Delete this project?"
    description="This cannot be undone. Its deployments and every dashboard built on it go with it."
    action-label="Delete project"
    @action="isOpen = false"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

The parent owns the open state. Cancel and Escape only emit `openChange(false)`, so the dialog never closes itself, and the confirm action only emits `action` without closing either. That gap is deliberate: real work takes time, so you close the dialog when the work settles. While it runs, set `isActionLoading` to show a spinner on the confirm button and hold the dialog open:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const isActionLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {
  isActionLoading.value = true
  await revokeAccess()
  isActionLoading.value = false
  isOpen.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog
    :is-action-loading="isActionLoading"
    :is-open="isOpen"
    action-label="Revoke access"
    description="This member loses access to every shared folder and draft immediately."
    title="Revoke access?"
    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

The confirm action uses the `destructive` variant by default, because the dialog exists to confirm destructive work. When the confirmation is not destructive — publishing a draft, for instance — set `actionVariant` to `primary` so the color matches the meaning.

The action layout follows the available width. Above 640px the actions sit in one row, Cancel then confirm, and the row wraps when the labels are long. At 640px and below both buttons fill the width and the confirm action sits above Cancel. Either way, initial focus stays on Cancel, the least destructive choice, and the narrow layout keeps visual, DOM, and tab order aligned so screen readers read the actions in the order they are shown.

`isInline` renders the whole surface in normal flow for documentation previews, without the `<dialog>` element, the backdrop, or focus behavior. Because it is not modal, it does not claim to be: the root element uses `role="group"` instead.
usage.zh:
`AlertDialog`（警告对话框）只专心做一件事：在具有破坏性或无法撤回的操作（比如永久删除文件、清空数据、注销账户）真正执行前，跳出来跟用户再次确认。因为这些动作做完就没法反悔，所以必须郑重其事地停下来，向用户说清楚后果，再交由用户自己做决定。

**什么时候用：**
- 执行无法挽回或后果严重的破坏性操作前，需要用户郑重确认时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 需要用户在弹窗里填写表单、编辑复杂内容时，请改用普通对话框 [Dialog](/components/dialog)。
- 普通的状态提醒或操作成功通知，请改用轻提示 [useToast](/components/use-toast)，不要频繁打断用户。

它实现了 WAI-ARIA 规范中的 Alert Dialog 模式。根元素带有 `role="alertdialog"`，标题通过 `aria-labelledby` 作为弹窗名称，后果描述通过 `aria-describedby` 连同标题一起被读屏工具念出。打开时焦点会自动落在最为安全的「取消」按钮上，关闭后再把焦点还给触发它的元素。为了防止误触，点击背景遮罩不会关闭它，按键盘上的 Escape 键则等同于点击取消。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="删除项目" variant="destructive" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <AlertDialog
    :is-open="isOpen"
    title="要删除这个项目吗？"
    description="删除后无法恢复，项目下的部署与所有仪表盘都会一并移除。"
    action-label="删除项目"
    @action="isOpen = false"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

打开状态完全由父组件掌握。按下「取消」或按 Escape 只会发出 `openChange(false)`，组件不会自己关闭；确认按钮同样只发出 `action` 事件，也不会关闭对话框。这是刻意留出的位置：异步操作需要时间，你可以在操作结束后再设置 `isOpen`。等待期间把 `isActionLoading` 设为 `true`，确认按钮会显示加载指示，对话框保持打开：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const isActionLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {
  isActionLoading.value = true
  await revokeAccess()
  isActionLoading.value = false
  isOpen.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog
    :is-action-loading="isActionLoading"
    :is-open="isOpen"
    action-label="撤销授权"
    description="该成员会立即失去所有共享文件夹和草稿的访问权限。"
    title="要撤销授权吗？"
    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

确认按钮默认使用 `destructive` 变体，因为对话框本身就是为确认破坏性操作而存在的。如果这次确认并不具有破坏性，例如「发布变更」，把 `actionVariant` 改成 `primary`，颜色就会和语义一致。

按钮的排列会随可用宽度变化。宽于 640px 时，操作区是一行，按「取消 → 确认」的顺序排列，标签过长时整行自动换行；640px 及以下时两个按钮都占满宽度，确认操作排在「取消」上方。无论哪种排列，初始焦点始终落在「取消」上，因为那是破坏性最小的选择；窄屏下的层级、DOM 顺序与 Tab 顺序保持一致，屏幕阅读器读到的顺序和眼睛看到的顺序不会打架。

`isInline` 用于文档预览：它以普通文档流渲染整个表面，不使用 `<dialog>`、遮罩与焦点限制。既然没有模态行为，它也不会声称自己是模态的，根元素的角色改为 `role="group"`。

en.text: Make the confirm label say what will happen. "Delete project" lets the user judge the outcome before pressing; "OK" or "Yes" does not.
Put the consequence in `description`: whether the data can be recovered, what else is affected, who gets notified. This is where the decision is actually made.
Keep Cancel as the least destructive focus target. On a narrow screen the confirm action is visually and structurally first, but initial focus stays on Cancel.
Hold the dialog open with `isActionLoading` while an async action runs, and close it once the work really settles.
Reserve it for destructive or irreversible work. For plain information, or for filling something in, a lighter dialog is the better fit.
Signal danger with color alone. A red button does not say what will happen; the label does.
Close the dialog inside the `action` handler. The loading state then has nowhere to live, and the user never learns whether the work succeeded.
Nest a confirmation dialog inside another dialog. Split a multi-step flow into steps inside one dialog, or use a full page.

zh.text: 让确认按钮的标签说清会发生什么。「删除项目」比「确定」或「是」更能让人在按下之前判断后果。
在 `description` 里写清后果：删除后能否恢复、会影响哪些数据、是否通知他人。用户是在这里做出决定的。
保持「取消」是最不具破坏性的焦点目标。窄屏下确认操作在视觉和结构上都排在前面，但初始焦点仍然留在「取消」上。
异步操作期间使用 `isActionLoading` 撑住对话框，等工作真正结束后再关闭它。
只用来确认破坏性或不可逆的操作。普通的信息提示、表单填写改用量更轻的对话框。
只靠颜色表达危险。红色按钮本身不说明会发生什么，标签才是。
在 `action` 事件里立刻关闭对话框。这样一来加载状态无处安放，用户也不知道操作到底有没有成功。
把确认对话框套在另一个对话框里。多步流程请拆成同一个对话框里的步骤，或改用整页。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The dialog opens through the native `showModal()`, so modality, the inert page behind it, and focus restoration on close all come from the browser. The title and description are linked with `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`, so assistive technology announces the question, the consequence, and the available actions together, instead of making the user explore the surface first.

Initial focus is pinned to Cancel through `data-autofocus`, so the least destructive choice keeps the focus even when the narrow layout rearranges the buttons. Escape and the Cancel button take the same path: they only emit `openChange(false)` and leave the decision to the parent. Clicking the backdrop never closes the dialog — a confirmation of destructive work should not disappear on a stray click.

While the confirm action is loading it carries `aria-busy`, and Cancel stays available so the user can back out of work that has not finished.

en.heading: Theme
useImperativeAlertDialog
en.text:
- `show(options)`: opens the dialog with the given options — every prop except `isOpen`, plus an `onAction` callback.
- `hide()`: closes the dialog.
- `isOpen`: the open state, as a writable ref.
- `Host`: component to render once in the template.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<dialog>` in the modal case and a `<div>` in the inline preview.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The component maintains `role`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`, and `aria-describedby` itself, so those keep the values it derives.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
对话框通过原生 `<dialog>` 的 `showModal()` 打开，因此模态行为、页面其余部分的不可交互状态、以及关闭后的焦点归还都由浏览器提供。标题与描述分别通过 `aria-labelledby` 与 `aria-describedby` 关联，屏幕阅读器在进入对话框时会读出「标题 + 后果描述 + 可用操作」这一整段信息，用户不必先摸索一圈才知道发生了什么。

初始焦点固定在「取消」上，并通过 `data-autofocus` 标记，所以即使窄屏下按钮的排列发生变化，获得焦点的仍然是最不具破坏性的那个选择。Escape 与按下「取消」走的是同一条路径：只发出 `openChange(false)`，是否关闭由父组件决定。点击遮罩不会关闭对话框——破坏性操作的确认不应该因为一次误触而消失。

确认按钮加载期间会带上 `aria-busy`，「取消」仍然可以按，用户可以取消一个还没结束的操作。

zh.heading: 主题
useImperativeAlertDialog
zh.text:
- `show(options)`：以给定选项打开对话框。选项为除 `isOpen` 之外的全部属性，另加一个 `onAction` 回调。
- `hide()`：关闭对话框。
- `isOpen`：打开状态，为可写的 ref。
- `Host`：在模板中渲染一次的组件。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
模态下根元素为 `<dialog>`，行内预览下为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

组件自己维护 `role`、`aria-modal`、`aria-labelledby` 与 `aria-describedby`，因此这些属性以组件推导出的值为准。

description.en: Revoke stays in a loading state for two seconds. The dialog is shown inline so the pending action is visible without opening it first.

const isLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {

}

    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="() => {}"
  />
</template>

summary.en: `BottomSheet` rises from the bottom edge of the viewport to hold mobile-first content: filters, share targets, quick actions, and forms. The panel carries a decorative grab handle, a scrolling content area underneath, and a scrim that dims and blocks the page. It is built on the native `<dialog>` element, so an open sheet keeps focus inside itself, makes the rest of the page inert, and returns focus to whatever opened it when it closes.
summary.zh: `BottomSheet` 从视口底部升起一块面板，用来承载筛选、分享、快速操作和表单这类移动端优先的内容。面板顶部有一条装饰性的拖拽条，下面是可以滚动的内容区；背景由遮罩压暗并阻挡交互。它基于原生 `<dialog>` 元素，因此在打开时会把焦点锁在面板内部、把页面其余部分设为不可交互，关闭后把焦点还给打开它的元素。

usage.en: `BottomSheet` rises from the bottom edge of the viewport to hold mobile-first content: filters, share targets, quick actions, and forms. The panel carries a decorative grab handle, a scrolling content area underneath, and a scrim that dims and blocks the page. It is built on the native `` element, so an open sheet keeps focus inside itself, makes the rest of the page inert, and returns focus to whatever opened it when it closes. The shortest form manages its own state and takes a name and the content: ```vue ``` `label` is required and becomes the sheet's accessible name, which a screen reader announces on entry. The panel has no built-in heading, so that name has to come from you. Whether the sheet is open is decided by `isOpen`: leave it unbound and the component owns its state, so Escape, a scrim click, and a downward swipe all close it; bind it and the component renders exactly the bound value while those gestures only emit `openChange(false)` and let the parent decide. `height` sets how tall the panel is once expanded, and it has three named budgets. `hug` fits the content up to 92% of the viewport, which suits short, bounded content. `capped` is the default at roughly 62% of the viewport, the usual choice for lists. `tall` pins the panel near full height for forms and content that keeps growing. You can also pass a number of pixels or any CSS length, such as `420` or `"min(70vh, 30rem)"`. Whatever the budget, content taller than the visible panel scrolls inside it instead of stretching the page. `snapPoints` lets someone drag the panel to an intermediate height rather than only fully open or closed. Each stop is the panel's visible height: a number is a viewport fraction (`0.5` is half the screen), `"50%"` means the same thing, and `"320px"` is an absolute height. The panel's own height is always the tallest stop, so `snap-points="[0.5]"` reads as "half a screen or all of it". A stop that is a quarter of the panel or less counts as a peek: it slides the panel partly off-screen instead of reflowing the content into a sliver, and it thins the scrim. Without `snapPoints` the sheet only opens and closes, and dragging it down still dismisses it. A downward drag closes the sheet, and a fast upward flick expands it to the tallest stop. The scrim's depth follows the panel while it moves, and on release the sheet settles on the nearest stop. Both the handle and, once it is scrolled to the top, the content area can start a drag. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the entrance and exit movements collapse to almost nothing, while the position and state changes still happen. `purpose` controls implicit dismissal, matching `Dialog`. The default `info` allows Escape, a scrim click, and a swipe. `form` allows Escape only, so a stray click on the scrim cannot throw away typed input. `required` blocks every implicit path and announces the sheet as an alert dialog for flows that must end through an explicit choice. When the page behind the sheet should stay usable, set `hasScrim` to `false`: the sheet then opens non-modally, the page keeps scrolling and responding to clicks, and a swipe still dismisses it. A non-modal sheet never takes focus away from the page, so Escape dismisses it while focus is inside the sheet. `padding` sets the content area's inset on the spacing scale. When omitted, the theme decides, falling back to the `--spacing-4` step (16px) on every logical edge; pass `0` for a content box flush with the panel. The content area publishes the inset it applies: a lone child region that carries its own inset escapes it, and bleed children such as a table or a divider line up with that edge instead of sitting inside it twice.
usage.zh: `BottomSheet` 从视口底部升起一块面板，用来承载筛选、分享、快速操作和表单这类移动端优先的内容。面板顶部有一条装饰性的拖拽条，下面是可以滚动的内容区；背景由遮罩压暗并阻挡交互。它基于原生 `` 元素，因此在打开时会把焦点锁在面板内部、把页面其余部分设为不可交互，关闭后把焦点还给打开它的元素。 最基本的用法是自己管理开关状态，把标签和内容交给组件： ```vue ``` `label` 是必填项，它会成为面板的无障碍名称，屏幕阅读器在进入面板时会读出它。面板本身没有内置标题，所以这个名称需要由你提供。是否打开由 `isOpen` 决定：不绑定 `v-model:is-open` 时组件自己管理状态，Escape、点击遮罩或向下拖动都会关闭它；绑定时组件完全跟随绑定的值，这些操作只会发出 `openChange(false)` 请求，是否关闭由父组件决定。 `height` 决定面板展开后的高度，可以使用三个命名档位。`hug` 让面板贴合内容，最多占到视口的 92%，适合内容固定且不长的场景；`capped` 是默认档，约占视口高度的 62%，是列表类内容的常用选择；`tall` 固定在接近满屏的高度，适合表单或内容会持续变长的场景。也可以直接传数字（像素）或任意 CSS 长度，例如 `420` 或 `"min(70vh, 30rem)"`。无论哪个档位，内容超过可见高度时都在面板内部滚动，不会把页面撑长。 `snapPoints` 让用户可以拖动面板停在中间高度，而不仅仅是全开或关闭。每个点位写的是面板的可见高度：数字是视口比例（`0.5` 就是半个屏幕），`"50%"` 是同样的意思，`"320px"` 是绝对高度。面板自身的高度始终是最高的那一档，所以 `snap-points="[0.5]"` 表示「要么半屏，要么全屏」。短到只有自身四分之一以下的档位被视为「露一角」：它不重排内容，而是把整块面板滑走一部分，同时把遮罩调淡。不传 `snapPoints` 时面板只支持打开和关闭，拖动仍然可以关闭它。 向下拖动可以关闭面板，向上快速一甩会把面板展开到最高档。拖动时遮罩的深浅跟随面板的位置变化，松手后停到最近的档位。拖动条和（滚动到顶部后的）内容区都可以发起拖动。系统开启「减少动态效果」时，进入和退出的动画会缩短到几乎不可见，但面板的位置和状态变化照常发生。 `purpose` 控制隐式关闭的尺度，和 `Dialog` 一致。默认的 `info` 允许 Escape、点击遮罩和向下拖动；`form` 只允许 Escape，避免用户误触遮罩丢失已经输入的内容；`required` 屏蔽全部隐式关闭，并使用 `alertdialog` 语义，用于必须由用户明确响应的流程。想要面板和页面同时可交互时，把 `hasScrim` 设为 `false`：面板会用非模态方式打开，背景不再被压暗，页面可以继续滚动和点击，拖动关闭依旧可用。非模态面板不会把焦点从页面上抢走，因此 Escape 只在焦点位于面板内部时才会关闭它。 `padding` 设置内容区的内边距，取值来自全局间距刻度。不设置时使用主题为底部弹窗定义的内边距，主题没有定义时取 `--spacing-4`（16px），四个逻辑边相同；传入 `0` 可以让内容紧贴面板边缘。内容区会把实际用上的边距发布给里面的内容：唯一子元素如果是自带内边距的区块，会顶掉这层边距；表格和分隔线会伸到这条边上，不会再缩一圈。

en.text: Reserve it for small screens and momentary tasks: filters, sharing, quick actions, detail previews. Rising from the bottom edge keeps content inside thumb reach.
Pick the height that fits the content: `hug` for short bounded content, `capped` for lists, `tall` for forms and content that streams in.
Use `purpose="form"` to protect entered data against stray taps while keeping Escape available, and reserve `required` for flows that must end through an explicit action.
Write a `label` that says what the sheet holds. It is the only context a screen reader gets when focus moves in.
Let the sheet content run long. Break a long task into steps or move it to a full page instead.
Treat it as the default dialog on desktop. Use `Dialog` when a centered modal is what the task calls for.
Rely on the swipe as the only way out. Escape, a scrim click, and an explicit action button matter just as much.

zh.text: 用在小屏上的临时任务：筛选、分享、快速操作、详情预览。让内容从底部升起，符合拇指的触达范围。
按内容选择高度档位：内容固定且短用 `hug`，列表用 `capped`，表单或持续变长的内容用 `tall`。
用 `purpose="form"` 保护已经输入的内容，同时保留 Escape；只有必须由用户明确结束的流程才用 `required`。
给 `label` 写清楚面板是什么，例如「筛选条件」「分享到」，它是屏幕阅读器进入面板时唯一的上下文。
让面板内容过长。内容很多时考虑拆成多个步骤，或改用整页。
在桌面端把它当默认的弹窗使用。需要居中的模态对话框时使用 `Dialog`。
依赖拖动作为唯一的关闭方式。Escape、遮罩点击和显式的操作按钮同样重要。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the sheet, and required. It is associated through `aria-label`; the panel has no built-in heading to derive a name from.

rows.name: `v-model:isOpen`
rows.description: Controlled open state. Bound, the sheet renders exactly this value and Escape, a scrim click, or a swipe only asks for a change; unbound, the component owns its state.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: How tall the sheet is. Named budgets are hug (fits content, up to 92% of the viewport), capped (about 62%), and tall (about 92%); a number is pixels and a string is used as a CSS length. Content taller than the visible panel scrolls inside it.

rows.name: `snapPoints`
rows.description: Extra heights the sheet can rest at when dragged. A number is a viewport fraction, `'50%'` a percentage, and `'320px'` an absolute height; the sheet's own height is always the tallest stop. Without it the sheet only opens and closes.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Inner padding of the content box using the spacing scale. When omitted, the theme decides, falling back to the `--spacing-4` step (16px) on every logical edge; pass `0` for a flush content box. The content box is a container, so a lone child that carries its own inset escapes the padding.

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: Implicit dismissal, matching `Dialog`. info allows Escape, a scrim click, and a swipe; form allows Escape only; required blocks every implicit path and uses `alertdialog` semantics.

rows.name: `hasScrim`
rows.description: Whether to render a scrim and open modally. `true` uses `showModal()`: top layer, focus confinement, page scroll lock, and an inert background. `false` uses `show()`, leaving the page interactive and scrollable.

rows.name: `finalFocusRef`
rows.description: Element that receives focus after the sheet closes, replacing the element that was focused when it opened. Use it when the opener can remount or the active element is not a reliable trigger.

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: Renders the panel in the document flow instead of a `<dialog>`, without a scrim, focus trap, or motion. Used to preview the surface inside a container that is already inert, such as component documentation.

rows.name: `activeSheet`
rows.description: The current sheet's `sheetId`. Bind it with `v-model:active-sheet`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the whole flow.

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: How the whole flow can be dismissed.

rows.name: `hasScrim`
rows.description: Whether the flow has one scrim. It stays up across pages.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 面板的无障碍名称，必填。它通过 `aria-label` 与面板关联；面板没有内置标题可以自动取名。

rows.name: `v-model:isOpen`
rows.description: 受控的打开状态。绑定后组件完全跟随这个值，Escape、遮罩点击和拖动只发出更新请求；不绑定时组件自己管理状态。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 面板的高度。命名档位 hug（贴合内容，最多 92%）、capped（约 62%）、tall（约 92%）；数字按像素解释，字符串按 CSS 长度原样使用。内容超出可见高度时在面板内部滚动。

rows.name: `snapPoints`
rows.description: 拖动时可以停靠的额外高度。数字是视口比例，`'50%'` 是百分比，`'320px'` 是绝对高度；面板自身高度始终是最高的档位。不传时面板只能打开和关闭。

rows.name: `padding`

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: 隐式关闭的尺度，与 `Dialog` 一致。info 允许 Escape、遮罩点击和拖动关闭；form 只允许 Escape；required 屏蔽全部隐式关闭并使用 `alertdialog` 语义。

rows.name: `hasScrim`

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The panel is built on the native `<dialog>` element. With a scrim it opens through `showModal()`, which puts it in the top layer, makes the background inert, and confines Tab to the sheet. Without a scrim it opens through `show()`, leaving the page usable. `label` names the sheet through `aria-label`, and `purpose="required"` switches the role to `alertdialog`.

On open, focus lands on the first element with `data-autofocus` inside the panel, or on the panel itself when there is none. On close, focus returns to the element that was focused when the sheet opened — if it is still in the page — or to the element named by `finalFocusRef`. The handoff happens once the exit motion has finished, so focus never lands on a surface that is still sliding away.

Escape closes the sheet unless `purpose` is `required` — a modal sheet confines focus inside itself, while a non-modal one never takes focus from the page, so focus has to be inside the sheet — and an Escape pressed while an input method is composing text cancels the composition instead. Once the content area is scrolled to the top, a downward drag can close the sheet, and at the end of its content an upward drag can expand it; with a `purpose` other than `info` a drag only settles on the nearest stop and never dismisses.

While the content actually overflows, the scrolling area becomes focusable, carries `role="group"`, and is named by the sheet's `label`, so a keyboard user can focus it and scroll with the arrow keys.

en.heading: Theming
BottomSheetSwitcher
en.text:
A multi-step flow shares one dialog. `v-model:active-sheet` names the child `BottomSheet` `sheetId` that is current. The scrim stays while the page changes, and the previous sheet remains briefly underneath so the heights can line up. Set `activeSheet` to `null` to close the flow.

- `cancel(event: Event)`: fires before the switcher acts on a native dialog cancel, such as Escape. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep the flow open.

A child `BottomSheet` with `sheetId` no longer opens its own dialog. The switcher decides which one is visible.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The root element is the panel <div> (class astryx-bottom-sheet), wrapped in a fixed-position <dialog>. The following are passed to the panel element: - HTML attributes. - aria-* attributes, except aria-label and aria-labelledby, which name the dialog around it. - data-* attributes. - class. - style.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
面板基于原生 `<dialog>` 元素构建。带遮罩时使用 `showModal()` 打开，浏览器会把它放到顶层、把背景设为不可交互，并把 Tab 焦点限制在面板内；不带遮罩时使用 `show()` 打开，页面保持可用。`label` 通过 `aria-label` 成为面板的名称，`purpose="required"` 时角色变为 `alertdialog`。

打开时，焦点会落到面板内第一个带 `data-autofocus` 的元素上；没有这样的元素时，焦点落在面板本身。关闭后，焦点回到打开面板时的那个元素（如果它还在页面里），或者回到 `finalFocusRef` 指定的元素。抬起与关闭的动画结束后才执行焦点归还，避免焦点落在正在滑走的面板上。

Escape 只在 `purpose` 不是 `required` 时关闭面板（带遮罩的模态面板会把焦点限制在内部；无遮罩的面板不抢焦点，因此焦点需要位于面板内）；输入法正在组合文字时按下的 Escape 属于取消输入，不会关闭面板。内容区滚动到顶部后可以向下拖动关闭面板，滚动到内容底部时可以向上拖动展开面板；`purpose` 不是 `info` 时拖动只会停靠在最近的档位，不会关闭。

当内容区实际溢出时，它会成为一个可聚焦的滚动区域，带 `role="group"` 和面板的 `label` 作为名称，键盘用户可以聚焦它并用方向键滚动内容。

zh.heading: 主题
BottomSheetSwitcher
zh.text:
多步流程共用一个对话框。当前页用 `v-model:active-sheet` 指向子级 `BottomSheet` 的 `sheetId`。换页时遮罩留着，上一张会短暂留在下面并对齐高度。关掉时把 `activeSheet` 设为 `null`。

- `cancel(event: Event)`：切换器处理原生 dialog 的取消请求（例如 Escape）之前触发。调用 `event.preventDefault()` 可以留住这段流程。

子级 `BottomSheet` 加上 `sheetId` 后不再自己打开对话框，由切换器决定哪一张可见。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素是面板的 `
`（类名 astryx-bottom-sheet），它被包裹在一个固定的 <dialog> 里。 以下内容传入面板元素： - HTML 属性。 - `aria-*` 属性（aria-label 与 aria-labelledby 例外，它们用于命名外层的对话框）。 - `data-*` 属性。 - `class`。 - `style`。

description.en: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.
description.zh: 对比 hug、capped、tall 三种起始高度，分别适合不同体量的内容。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { BottomSheetHeight } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const descriptions: Record<BottomSheetHeight, string> = {
  hug: 'Hug fits short, bounded content.',
  capped: 'Capped starts at a comfortable mid-height for lists and filters.',
  tall: 'Tall reserves most of the viewport for long or changing content.',
}

const height = ref<BottomSheetHeight | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="2" wrap="wrap">
    <Button label="Open hug" @click="height = 'hug'" />
    <Button label="Open capped" @click="height = 'capped'" />
    <Button label="Open tall" @click="height = 'tall'" />
  </HStack>
  <BottomSheet
    :height="height ?? 'hug'"
    :is-open="height != null"
    :label="`${height ?? 'Hug'} height`"
    @update:is-open="open => { if (!open) height = null }"
  >
    <VStack :gap="4">
      <Heading :level="3">
        {{ height ?? 'Hug' }} height
      </Heading>
      <Divider />
      <Text type="body">
        {{ descriptions[height ?? 'hug'] }}
      </Text>
      <Button label="Close" @click="height = null" />
    </VStack>
  </BottomSheet>
</template>

description.en: Drag-to-resize stops: a half-height working surface, and a peek that slides away and thins the scrim.
description.zh: 拖动时可以停在半屏，也可以停在一条细缝上；细缝会把面板滑出，并减弱遮罩。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'

import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { BottomSheetHeight, BottomSheetPurpose } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import type { DialogPurpose } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { useMediaQuery } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Dialog, DialogHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { TextArea } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextArea'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const TOUCH_ORIENTED_LG_QUERY = '(max-width: 1024px) and (pointer: coarse) and (hover: none)'

type AdaptivePresentation = 'dialog' | 'fullscreen' | 'bottom-sheet'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const name = ref('Ruby Cheung')
const email = ref('ruby@example.com')
const notes = ref('')
const isTouchOriented = useMediaQuery(TOUCH_ORIENTED_LG_QUERY)

const purpose: DialogPurpose = 'form'
const touchPresentation: AdaptivePresentation = 'bottom-sheet'
const bottomSheetHeight: BottomSheetHeight = 'tall'

function resolvedPresentation(): AdaptivePresentation {
  return isTouchOriented.value ? touchPresentation : 'dialog'
}
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Edit profile" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <BottomSheet
    v-if="resolvedPresentation() === 'bottom-sheet'"
    v-model:is-open="isOpen"
    :height="bottomSheetHeight"
    label="Edit profile"
    :purpose="purpose as BottomSheetPurpose"
  >
    <VStack :gap="4">
      <Heading :level="3">
        Edit profile
      </Heading>
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Dialog remains the default presentation. This example explicitly opts into a Bottom Sheet only at lg and below when the device has a coarse pointer and no hover. Pass the presentation prop to make tests or unusual environments deterministic.
      </Text>
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        In Bottom Sheet presentation, purpose="form" blocks scrim clicks and swipe dismissal while preserving Escape. Use this opt-in only when that contract is acceptable; keep AlertDialog/destructive confirmations on Dialog unless a product deliberately chooses otherwise.
      </Text>
      <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
      <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" />
      <TextArea v-model="notes" label="Notes" :rows="6" />
      <HStack :gap="2" h-align="end" wrap="wrap">

      </HStack>
    </VStack>
  </BottomSheet>
  <Dialog
    v-else
    :is-open="isOpen"
    max-height="75dvh"
    :purpose="purpose"
    :variant="resolvedPresentation() === 'fullscreen' ? 'fullscreen' : 'standard'"
    :width="480"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  >
    <Layout>
      <template #header>
        <DialogHeader title="Edit profile" @open-change="isOpen = $event" />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Dialog remains the default presentation. This example explicitly opts into a Bottom Sheet only at lg and below when the device has a coarse pointer and no hover. Pass the presentation prop to make tests or unusual environments deterministic.
          </Text>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            In Bottom Sheet presentation, purpose="form" blocks scrim clicks and swipe dismissal while preserving Escape. Use this opt-in only when that contract is acceptable; keep AlertDialog/destructive confirmations on Dialog unless a product deliberately chooses otherwise.
          </Text>
          <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
          <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" />
          <TextArea v-model="notes" label="Notes" :rows="6" />
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
      <template #footer>
        <LayoutFooter>
          <HStack :gap="2" h-align="end" wrap="wrap">
            <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" @click="isOpen = false" />
            <Button label="Save profile" variant="primary" @click="isOpen = false" />
          </HStack>
        </LayoutFooter>

    </Layout>
  </Dialog>

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useMediaQuery } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { DropdownMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'

const items = computed(() => [
  'Edit project',
  'Duplicate project',
  'Share project',
  'Archive project',
].map(label => ({
  label,
  onClick: () => {

summary.en: Coordinates a multi-step bottom-sheet flow in one shared dialog; bind `v-model:active-sheet` to a nested `BottomSheet`'s `sheet-id` to open or switch steps, and to `null` to close.
summary.zh: 把一串分步的底部弹窗放进同一个对话框里。用 `v-model:active-sheet` 指向某张 `BottomSheet` 的 `sheet-id` 就打开或切到那一步，指向 `null` 就整段关掉。

usage.en: Coordinates a multi-step bottom-sheet flow in one shared dialog; bind `v-model:active-sheet` to a nested `BottomSheet`'s `sheet-id` to open or switch steps, and to `null` to close. ```vue ``` Every child needs its own `sheet-id` and a non-empty `label`. The switcher names the dialog from its own `label`, falling back to the active sheet's label, so the flow keeps one accessible name the whole way through. Only the sheet whose `sheet-id` matches `active-sheet` is interactive; during a handoff the previous panel stays painted underneath, inert, until the new step has settled, so changing steps does not flash the scrim. `purpose` sets how the whole flow can be dismissed, matching `Dialog`. Leave it out and the step that is showing decides: `info` allows Escape, a scrim click, and a swipe, `form` allows Escape only so typed input is not thrown away, and `required` blocks every implicit path. `hasScrim` defaults to `true` and draws one scrim for the entire flow; it stays up while steps change and only goes away when the flow closes, which is what makes a multi-step flow feel like one surface instead of several dialogs. Escape asks the switcher to close. `cancel` fires first with the native cancel event, so calling `event.preventDefault()` on it keeps the flow open. ```ts import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetSwitcher } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet' ```
usage.zh: 把一串分步的底部弹窗放进同一个对话框里。用 `v-model:active-sheet` 指向某张 `BottomSheet` 的 `sheet-id` 就打开或切到那一步，指向 `null` 就整段关掉。 ```vue ``` 每一张子面板都要有自己的 `sheet-id` 和一个非空的 `label`。对话框的名字优先用切换器自己的 `label`，没写就取当前那张的 `label`，所以整段流程从头到尾只有一个无障碍名称。只有 `sheet-id` 和 `active-sheet` 对上的那一张可以交互；换页时上一张还留在底下，但已经不可交互，等新的一张落定之后才撤掉，所以切步骤的时候遮罩不会闪一下。 `purpose` 决定整段流程怎么被关掉，和 `Dialog` 一致。不传就跟着当前那张走：`info` 允许 Escape、点遮罩和下滑，`form` 只允许 Escape，免得把填到一半的内容丢掉，`required` 堵住所有隐式关闭。`hasScrim` 默认是 `true`，整段流程共用一层遮罩：换页时它一直留着，只有整段关掉才消失，这样多步流程看起来才是一块完整的表面，而不是好几个对话框连着弹。 按 Escape 会请求关闭。在此之前先发 `cancel` 事件，参数就是原生的 cancel 事件；在它上面调 `event.preventDefault()` 就能留住这段流程。 ```ts import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetSwitcher } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet' ```

en.text: Use when each step depends on the previous one and only one step needs attention at a time.

Give every child a unique `sheet-id` and non-empty `label`, choose its `purpose` to match dismissal requirements, and follow the [WAI-ARIA Dialog (Modal) pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/) for scrim-backed flows.
Don't split information across sheets when people need to compare it; use a full-page layout that keeps the relevant content visible together instead.
Don't use the switcher when multiple panels must stay interactive or visible together; `active-sheet` intentionally selects one interactive step.

zh.text: 只在后一步依赖前一步、而且同一时间只需要看一步时使用。
给每张子面板一个不重复的 `sheet-id` 和非空的 `label`，按关闭要求选好各自的 `purpose`；带遮罩的流程请按 [WAI-ARIA 对话框（模态）模式](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/)来做。
把需要互相对照的信息拆到几张面板里。这种情况用整页布局，让相关内容能同时看到。
需要多张面板同时可交互或同时可见时使用切换器。`active-sheet` 本来就是只让一步可交互。

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:activeSheet(value: string | null)`: fires with the step the switcher wants to show, or `null` to close. This is the `v-model:active-sheet` binding.
- `cancel(event: Event)`: fires when the dialog receives a native cancel request, before the flow closes. Call `event.preventDefault()` on the event to keep it open.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `default`: the `BottomSheet` steps. Each one needs a unique `sheet-id` and its own `label`.

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:activeSheet(value: string | null)`：切换器想切到哪一步就发哪个 `sheet-id`，想关掉时发 `null`。这就是 `v-model:active-sheet` 的绑定。
- `cancel(event: Event)`：对话框收到原生 cancel 请求时先发这个事件。在事件上调用 `event.preventDefault()` 可以留住这段流程，不让它关掉。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `default`：放各个 `BottomSheet` 步骤。每一张都要有自己不重复的 `sheet-id` 和自己的 `label`。

summary.zh: `Dialog`（模态对话框）会在当前页面之上浮起一个独立的小窗口，并把背景内容锁住，用来让用户集中精力完成某个具体任务，比如填写表单、配置选项或编辑资料。

usage.en: `Dialog` presents one modal task above the page. It uses the native `` element, so it traps focus, locks the page behind a backdrop, and returns focus to the element that opened it. Pair it with `DialogHeader` to get a focusable title, an optional subtitle, and a close button. ```vue ```
usage.zh: `Dialog`（模态对话框）会在当前页面之上浮起一个独立的小窗口，并把背景内容锁住，用来让用户集中精力完成某个具体任务，比如填写表单、配置选项或编辑资料。 它基于浏览器原生的 `` 元素构建，打开时会自动锁定网页背景、把光标焦点限制在窗口内部，关闭后还会贴心地把焦点还给刚才点开它的那个按钮。搭配 `DialogHeader` 一起使用，可以自带标题、副标题以及右上角的关闭叉号： ```vue ``` **什么时候用：** - 需要打断用户当前操作，让他们专注完成一步独立任务（如输入资料、配置参数）时。 **什么时候不要用：** - 如果只是为了在删除、覆盖或撤销授权等不可逆操作前确认一下，请改用专门的 [AlertDialog](/components/alert-dialog)。 - 如果只是一句轻量的成功反馈（如“保存成功”），不要弹对话框打断用户，请改用轻提示 [useToast](/components/use-toast)。 - 如果流程很长很复杂、需要来回切换多个页面，请直接做成独立的新页面，不要在一个小弹窗里硬塞太多东西。 - 不要在一个对话框里再弹出一个新的对话框。如有分步需求，请在同一个弹窗内部切换步骤。

en.text: Choose the right purpose: info for dismissable content, form to prevent accidental backdrop dismissal, required when the user must respond.
Include a clear title in the header so users immediately understand what the dialog is asking.
Use purpose="form" for dialogs with inputs so the user can't accidentally lose data by clicking the backdrop.
Keep dialogs focused on a single task; if the content grows beyond what fits, consider a full page instead.
Use a dialog for simple messages that could be shown inline or as a toast notification.
Nest dialogs inside other dialogs; restructure the flow into steps within a single dialog instead.
Use the fullscreen variant for simple confirmations; it is meant for complex content like editors or long forms.

zh.text: 选择正确的用途：info 用于可关闭的内容，form 用于防止误点遮罩关闭，required 用于必须由用户作出响应的场景。
在头部添加清晰的标题，让用户立即了解对话框要他们做什么。
含有输入内容的对话框使用 purpose="form"。这样用户不会因误点遮罩而丢失数据。
对话框只处理单一任务。内容超出可容纳范围时，考虑改用整页。
用对话框展示简单消息。这类消息可以内联显示，或使用 Toast 通知。
在对话框中嵌套对话框。应把流程拆成单个对话框内的多个步骤。
为简单确认使用 fullscreen 变体。它适用于编辑器或长表单等复杂内容。

rows.name: `isInline`

rows.name: `variant`

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: `required` disables Escape and backdrop dismissal. `form` allows Escape only. `info` allows both.

rows.name: `padding`

rows.name: `title`

rows.name: `subtitle`

rows.name: `hasCloseButton`

rows.name: `endContentEdgeCompensation`

rows.name: `hasDivider`

rows.name: `isInline`

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 首选宽度，数字单位为像素，字符串原样使用。窄屏时夹取到视口内，全屏变体忽略此项。

rows.name: `maxHeight`
rows.description: 最大高度，数字单位为像素，字符串原样使用。全屏变体忽略此项。

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: 对话框的静态偏移，支持 `top`、`bottom`、`start`、`end`，未设置时居中。逻辑属性 `start` 与 `end` 在 RTL 下自动镜像，全屏变体忽略此项。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 对话框变体：standard 为标准对话框，fullscreen 占满整个视口。

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: 允许的关闭方式：`required` 禁用 Escape 与点击遮罩，必须由用户响应；`form` 仅允许 Escape；`info` 两者都允许。

rows.name: `padding`

rows.name: `title`

rows.name: `subtitle`

rows.name: `hasCloseButton`

rows.name: `endContentEdgeCompensation`

rows.name: `closeButtonLabel`
rows.description: 关闭按钮的无障碍名称。不传时英文 Close、中文「关闭」。

rows.name: `hasDivider`

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
`Dialog` is built on the native `<dialog>` element, so the modal behavior, the focus trap, and the focus handoff on close all come from the browser rather than from extra configuration.

The dialog is shown with `showModal()`, which makes the rest of the page inert while it is open. When it opens, initial focus goes to the first element with `data-autofocus`; if no element has that attribute, focus goes to the `DialogHeader` title.

The dialog takes its name from the `DialogHeader` title, which the component associates with the dialog through `aria-labelledby`. An explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` replaces that name with the one you provide.

Escape and backdrop clicks do not close the dialog directly. They emit `openChange(false)`, and the parent decides whether to close. When the dialog closes, focus returns to the element that was focused when it opened, as long as that element is still in the page.

en.heading: Limitations
en.text:
Two constraints shape what you can put inside a dialog, and both are worth knowing before you combine it with other components.

- Tooltip and Popover render into `body`. Inside an open `Dialog` they sit beneath the modal top layer, so they cannot be seen or used. Do not nest them inside a dialog until they are moved into the dialog's own layer.
- Dialogs cannot be nested. If a flow needs several steps, restructure it as steps within a single dialog rather than opening a second one.

en.heading: Layout
en.text: The standard variant sizes itself with `width` and `maxHeight`, and clamps to the viewport with spacing gutters on narrow screens. `position` places it at a static offset. Logical `start` and `end` offsets mirror under RTL.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires with `false` when the user requests dismissal through Escape or a backdrop click, depending on `purpose`. The parent sets `isOpen` to close.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `default`: dialog content. Usually a `DialogHeader` followed by body content and actions.

en.heading: DialogHeader Events and Slots
en.text:
- `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires with `false` from the close button.
- `title`: inline content in place of the title string.
- `subtitle`: inline content for the subtitle.
- `startContent`: content before the title, such as a back button.
- `endContent`: content after the title, before the close button.

en.heading: useImperativeDialog
en.text:
- `show(content, options?)`: opens the dialog with content. Options merge with the defaults passed to the hook.
- `hide()`: closes the dialog.
- `isOpen`: readonly ref of the open state.
- `Host`: component to render once in the template.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
`Dialog` 基于原生 `<dialog>` 元素构建，模态行为、焦点限制和关闭后的焦点归还都由浏览器提供，因此不需要额外配置就能获得正确的无障碍表现。

对话框通过 `showModal()` 打开，打开期间页面其余部分不可交互。打开后，初始焦点落在第一个带有 `data-autofocus` 的元素上；如果没有元素带这个属性，焦点落在 `DialogHeader` 的标题上。

对话框的名称默认取自 `DialogHeader` 的标题，组件会把标题与对话框通过 `aria-labelledby` 关联起来。如果显式设置了 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby`，则以你提供的名称为准。

Escape 与点击遮罩不会直接关闭对话框，它们只发出 `openChange(false)`，由父组件决定是否关闭。关闭后，如果打开对话框之前的那个元素仍在页面中，焦点会回到它身上。

zh.heading: 限制
zh.text:
下面两点决定了你能在对话框里放什么内容，在组合 Tooltip、Popover 或多步流程之前需要先了解。

- Tooltip 与 Popover 会渲染到 `body`。在打开的 `Dialog` 内使用时，它们位于模态顶层之下，因此既看不到也无法操作；在它们获得对话框自身的层级之前，请不要把它们嵌套进对话框。
- 对话框不可嵌套。需要多步流程时，请把流程拆分为同一个对话框内的步骤。

zh.heading: 布局
zh.text: 标准变体通过 `width` 与 `maxHeight` 定尺寸，在窄屏上以间距令牌为边距夹取到视口内。`position` 设置静态偏移；逻辑属性 `start` 与 `end` 在 RTL 下自动镜像。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：用户通过 Escape 或点击遮罩请求关闭时以 `false` 触发，是否触发取决于 `purpose`。父组件通过设置 `isOpen` 来关闭。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `default`：对话框内容。通常为 `DialogHeader`，之后是正文与操作区。

zh.heading: DialogHeader 事件与插槽
zh.text:
- `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：点击关闭按钮时以 `false` 触发。
- `title`：替换标题文字的行内内容。
- `subtitle`：副标题的行内内容。
- `startContent`：标题之前的内容，例如返回按钮。
- `endContent`：标题之后、关闭按钮之前的内容。

zh.heading: useImperativeDialog
zh.text:
- `show(content, options?)`：以给定内容打开对话框。选项与传给 Hook 的默认选项合并。
- `hide()`：关闭对话框。
- `isOpen`：只读的打开状态。
- `Host`：在模板中渲染一次的组件。

zh.heading: 主题

description.en: Dialog stays the default. On a coarse pointer at lg and below, the same profile form opens as a bottom sheet.
description.zh: 默认仍是对话框。触屏且宽度不超过 lg 时，同一份资料表单改为底部弹层。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { BottomSheetHeight, BottomSheetPurpose } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import type { DialogPurpose } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { useMediaQuery } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Dialog, DialogHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { TextArea } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextArea'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const TOUCH_ORIENTED_LG_QUERY = '(max-width: 1024px) and (pointer: coarse) and (hover: none)'

type AdaptivePresentation = 'dialog' | 'fullscreen' | 'bottom-sheet'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const name = ref('Ruby Cheung')
const email = ref('ruby@example.com')
const notes = ref('')
const isTouchOriented = useMediaQuery(TOUCH_ORIENTED_LG_QUERY)

const purpose: DialogPurpose = 'form'
const touchPresentation: AdaptivePresentation = 'bottom-sheet'
const bottomSheetHeight: BottomSheetHeight = 'tall'

function resolvedPresentation(): AdaptivePresentation {
  return isTouchOriented.value ? touchPresentation : 'dialog'
}
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Edit profile" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <BottomSheet
    v-if="resolvedPresentation() === 'bottom-sheet'"
    v-model:is-open="isOpen"
    :height="bottomSheetHeight"
    label="Edit profile"
    :purpose="purpose as BottomSheetPurpose"
  >
    <VStack :gap="4">
      <Heading :level="3">
        Edit profile
      </Heading>
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Dialog remains the default presentation. This example explicitly opts into a Bottom Sheet only at lg and below when the device has a coarse pointer and no hover. Pass the presentation prop to make tests or unusual environments deterministic.
      </Text>
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        In Bottom Sheet presentation, purpose="form" blocks scrim clicks and swipe dismissal while preserving Escape. Use this opt-in only when that contract is acceptable; keep AlertDialog/destructive confirmations on Dialog unless a product deliberately chooses otherwise.
      </Text>
      <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
      <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" />
      <TextArea v-model="notes" label="Notes" :rows="6" />
      <HStack :gap="2" h-align="end" wrap="wrap">
        <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" @click="isOpen = false" />
        <Button label="Save profile" variant="primary" @click="isOpen = false" />
      </HStack>
    </VStack>
  </BottomSheet>
  <Dialog
    v-else
    :is-open="isOpen"
    max-height="75dvh"
    :purpose="purpose"
    :variant="resolvedPresentation() === 'fullscreen' ? 'fullscreen' : 'standard'"
    :width="480"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  >
    <Layout>
      <template #header>
        <DialogHeader title="Edit profile" @open-change="isOpen = $event" />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Dialog remains the default presentation. This example explicitly opts into a Bottom Sheet only at lg and below when the device has a coarse pointer and no hover. Pass the presentation prop to make tests or unusual environments deterministic.
          </Text>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            In Bottom Sheet presentation, purpose="form" blocks scrim clicks and swipe dismissal while preserving Escape. Use this opt-in only when that contract is acceptable; keep AlertDialog/destructive confirmations on Dialog unless a product deliberately chooses otherwise.
          </Text>
          <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
          <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" />
          <TextArea v-model="notes" label="Notes" :rows="6" />
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
      <template #footer>
        <LayoutFooter>
          <HStack :gap="2" h-align="end" wrap="wrap">
            <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" @click="isOpen = false" />
            <Button label="Save profile" variant="primary" @click="isOpen = false" />
          </HStack>
        </LayoutFooter>
      </template>
    </Layout>
  </Dialog>
</template>

description.en: Asks before a destructive action. The inline preview stays on the page; its buttons open the real dialog.
description.zh: 破坏性操作前先确认。页面上的预览一直留着，点按钮才会打开真正的对话框。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Dialog, useImperativeDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { h } from 'vue'
import ConfirmBody from './confirm-body.vue'

const dialog = useImperativeDialog({ width: 400, purpose: 'form' })

function openDialog() {
  dialog.show(() => h(ConfirmBody, { requestClose: () => dialog.hide() }))
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog is-open is-inline :width="400" purpose="form">
    <ConfirmBody :request-close="openDialog" />
  </Dialog>
  <component :is="dialog.Host" />
</template>

en.name: Header
en.description: Title, optional subtitle, and close button. The title receives focus on open and labels the dialog via aria-labelledby.

en.name: Body
en.description: The main content area: text, forms, lists, or any layout.

en.name: Footer
en.description: Action buttons like Save/Cancel or Accept/Decline, aligned to the end.

en.name: Backdrop
en.description: Semi-transparent overlay behind the dialog that blocks page interaction.

zh.name: 页眉
zh.description: 标题、可选副标题和关闭按钮。打开时焦点落到标题上，标题通过 aria-labelledby 标出对话框。

zh.name: 正文
zh.description: 主要内容：文字、表单、列表或任意布局。

zh.name: 页脚
zh.description: 保存、取消或接受、拒绝这类操作按钮，靠尾部对齐。

zh.name: 遮罩

summary.en: `DialogHeader` gives a dialog a labelled title area and an optional close control. It reads context from the parent `Dialog`: the title becomes the dialog's accessible name, and focus lands on it when the dialog opens.
summary.zh: `DialogHeader` 给对话框提供一块带标签的标题区，以及可选的关闭按钮。它从父级 `Dialog` 读取上下文：标题会成为对话框的无障碍名称，对话框打开时焦点也落在标题上。

usage.en: `DialogHeader` gives a dialog a labelled title area and an optional close control. It reads context from the parent `Dialog`: the title becomes the dialog's accessible name, and focus lands on it when the dialog opens. `title` is required. A subtitle is skipped when it is an empty string. The close button only appears when you pass `hasCloseButton`; clicking it emits `openChange(false)` and the parent decides whether to close. ```vue ``` Without a parent `Dialog`, the title is not associated with any dialog and the close button does not take part in the dialog's default focus behaviour. Render it inside the default slot of `Dialog`.
usage.zh: `DialogHeader` 给对话框提供一块带标签的标题区，以及可选的关闭按钮。它从父级 `Dialog` 读取上下文：标题会成为对话框的无障碍名称，对话框打开时焦点也落在标题上。 标题是必填的。副标题为空字符串时不渲染。传入 `hasCloseButton` 才会出现关闭按钮，点击时发出 `openChange(false)`，由父组件决定是否真的关闭。 ```vue ``` 单独使用 `DialogHeader` 时没有父级上下文，标题不会关联到任何对话框，关闭按钮也不会获得默认聚焦行为。它应当始终放在 `Dialog` 的默认插槽里。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The title is exposed as a heading through `role="heading"` and `aria-level="2"`, and it labels the parent dialog through `aria-labelledby`. A screen reader announces the dialog by its title text.

When the dialog opens, the title carries `tabindex="-1"` and receives initial focus, so keyboard users hear the name right away instead of starting in the middle of the body.

The close control is an `IconButton`. When `closeButtonLabel` is omitted, its accessible name follows the active language: Close in English, 关闭 in Chinese.

The `title` and `subtitle` slots take inline content, such as emphasis or a link. An empty subtitle string with no slot renders nothing.

Theme targets are `dialog-header`, `dialog-header-start-content`, `dialog-header-title-block`, `dialog-header-end-content`, and `dialog-header-close-icon`. They sit on the row, the leading slot, the title block, the trailing slot, and the close glyph. With a close button, the trailing slot pulls in on the block edges and the inline end, cancelling the button's own padding. `endContentEdgeCompensation` selects `inline`, `block`, or `all`.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires with `false` when the close button is clicked.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `title`: inline content in place of the title string. The heading still names the dialog.
- `subtitle`: inline content for the subtitle.
- `startContent`: content before the title, such as a back button.
- `endContent`: content before the close button.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
标题通过 `role="heading"` 和 `aria-level="2"` 暴露给辅助技术，同时用 `aria-labelledby` 与父级对话框关联，所以屏幕阅读器读到的对话框名称就是标题文字。

对话框打开时，标题带 `tabindex="-1"` 并接收初始焦点。这让键盘用户一进入对话框就听到名称，而不是从正文中间开始。

关闭按钮是 `IconButton`。没写 `closeButtonLabel` 时，无障碍名称跟界面语言走：英文 Close，中文「关闭」。

标题和副标题都可以用插槽放行内内容，例如一段强调或一个链接。副标题是空字符串、又没有插槽时，那一行不渲染。

换肤挂点是 `dialog-header`、`dialog-header-start-content`、`dialog-header-title-block`、`dialog-header-end-content`、`dialog-header-close-icon`，分别落在标题行、前置槽、标题块、后置槽和关闭图标上。有关闭按钮时，后置槽默认把上下和行末各收进一档间距，用来抵消按钮自己的内边距。`endContentEdgeCompensation` 可以只收行末（`inline`）、只收上下（`block`），或两边都收（`all`）。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：点击关闭按钮时以 `false` 触发。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `title`：替换标题里的文字，适合放行内内容。标题元素仍是对话框的名字。
- `subtitle`：副标题里的行内内容。
- `startContent`：标题之前的内容，例如返回按钮。
- `endContent`：关闭按钮之前的内容。

summary.en: `HoverCard` opens a card of richer content when the pointer hovers the trigger or keyboard focus lands on it. It differs from `Tooltip` in what it carries: a tooltip holds a line of plain text, while a hover card can hold an avatar, a name, a short bio, and action buttons. Use it for user profiles, link previews, and inline definitions.
summary.zh: `HoverCard` 在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦触发元素时，弹出一张承载更丰富内容的卡片。它和 `Tooltip` 的区别在于内容：`Tooltip` 只放一行纯文本，而悬浮卡片可以放头像、姓名、简介和操作按钮，因此要显示用户的资料、链接的预览或术语的解释时，它是合适的选择。

usage.en: `HoverCard` opens a card of richer content when the pointer hovers the trigger or keyboard focus lands on it. It differs from `Tooltip` in what it carries: a tooltip holds a line of plain text, while a hover card can hold an avatar, a name, a short bio, and action buttons. Use it for user profiles, link previews, and inline definitions. Showing waits 300 milliseconds by default, so a pointer passing across the trigger does not flash the card. Hiding waits 200 milliseconds and is cancelled when the pointer enters the card, so the user can travel from the trigger into the card and keep reading or clicking without it vanishing on the way. The trigger goes in the default slot and the card content goes in the `content` slot: ```vue ``` When the trigger is plain text the component gives it a dashed underline and makes it focusable, so a keyboard user can open the card with Tab. When the trigger is an element such as a button or link, the component listens on that element and writes `aria-haspopup` and `aria-controls` onto it. Passing `label` exposes the card to assistive technology as a named `role="dialog"`; without it the card is a `role="group"` linked to the trigger by `aria-describedby`.
usage.zh: `HoverCard` 在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦触发元素时，弹出一张承载更丰富内容的卡片。它和 `Tooltip` 的区别在于内容：`Tooltip` 只放一行纯文本，而悬浮卡片可以放头像、姓名、简介和操作按钮，因此要显示用户的资料、链接的预览或术语的解释时，它是合适的选择。 卡片有一个默认 300 毫秒的显示延迟，避免指针扫过触发元素时就闪出卡片。隐藏也有一个默认 200 毫秒的延迟，并且指针移入卡片会取消这次隐藏，所以用户可以从触发元素把指针移进卡片里继续阅读或点击，卡片不会在途中消失。 触发元素写在默认插槽里，卡片内容写在 `content` 插槽里： ```vue ``` 触发元素是纯文字时，组件会给它加上虚线底划线并让它可聚焦，键盘用户按 Tab 就能打开卡片；触发元素本身是一个按钮或链接时，组件直接监听那个元素，并把 `aria-haspopup`、`aria-controls` 这类属性写在它身上。传入 `label` 后卡片会以具名的 `role="dialog"` 暴露给屏幕阅读器，不传 `label` 时则是 `role="group"`，并通过 `aria-describedby` 指向卡片内容。

en.text: Keep the card supplementary: understanding improves with it, but the task is still completable without it.
Use plain text as the trigger so the dashed underline and keyboard focus work by default; users then see that it is hoverable.
Pass `label` for content such as a profile, so the card enters the assistive-technology reading order as a named dialog.
Leave `touchTrigger` on `auto`: a trigger that does nothing on its own opens on a tap, while a button or link keeps its tap.
Put critical actions or required information only inside the card; it disappears as soon as the pointer leaves.
Use a hover card where a tooltip or popover would do. A one-line hint belongs in `Tooltip`, and content the user must confirm belongs in `Popover`.
Put a long form inside the card. The pointer leaving closes it; that content belongs in a dialog.
Place it directly inside a ``, a heading, or a link. Those placements work, but the layer's relationship to the document flow becomes hard to predict, so prefer a block context.

zh.text: 把悬浮卡片当作补充信息：有它更好理解，没它也能完成任务。
用纯文字作为触发元素，让虚线下划线和键盘聚焦默认生效，用户能看出这里可以悬停。
内容是资料那就传 `label`，卡片会以具名对话框的形式出现在辅助技术的浏览顺序里。
让 `touchTrigger` 保持默认的 `auto`：本身不执行操作的触发元素轻点即打开，按钮和链接的轻点仍然归它们自己。
把关键操作或必须看到的信息只放在卡片里。指针一移开卡片就消失，用户很容易错过。
用悬浮卡片替代简单的提示或弹层。一行说明用 `Tooltip`，需要用户点击确认的内容用 `Popover`。
在卡片里放需要长时间输入的表单。指针离开会让它关闭，这类内容应放进对话框。
在 ``、标题或链接内部直接使用。这些位置虽然可用，但浮层与文档流的关系会变得难以预测，优先放在块级上下文里。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The hover card is a separate layer, and the component relates it to the trigger with ARIA attributes so assistive technology can both learn that the trigger carries extra context and read the structure and controls inside the open card:

- The card has `role="group"`; with `label` it becomes a named `role="dialog"`, because an unnamed dialog is invalid while an unnamed group is not.
- Without `label`, the trigger carries `aria-describedby` pointing at the card.
- With `label`, the trigger carries `aria-haspopup="dialog"` instead, plus `aria-controls` while the card is open. `aria-expanded` is only written when the trigger's own role allows it; a plain-text `<span>` trigger has no such role, so it never gets the attribute.
- Attributes the trigger already carried — `aria-haspopup`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-describedby` — are preserved and restored when the component unmounts.

The keyboard path is complete: focusing the trigger opens the card immediately, and moving focus between the trigger and the card keeps it open. Pressing Escape while the card is showing closes it; if focus was inside the card it returns to the trigger, and that refocus does not reopen the card. In the controlled mode Escape only emits `openChange(false)` and the parent decides whether to close.

A touch screen has no hover, so `touchTrigger` decides what a tap does. The default `auto` opens the card on a tap of a trigger that performs no action of its own, and leaves the tap to buttons, links, and form controls; once open, a tap outside the card dismisses it. Because the content appears only briefly, keep information a user must see to complete a task out of the card.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires when the card shows or hides. In the controlled mode, Escape emits `false` and the parent decides whether to close.

en.heading: Methods
en.text:
- `show()`: shows the card immediately, skipping the hover delay.
- `hide()`: hides the card immediately.
- `element`: the card layer element, or `null` before it mounts.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The component renders a fragment: a trigger wrapper `<span class="astryx-hover-card__trigger">` plus a layer teleported to `body`. Attributes land on the wrapper; the layer receives none.

- HTML attributes, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `class`, and `style` all go to the wrapper.
- The wrapper is a `display: contents` box when the trigger is an element, and the trigger itself, `display: inline`, when the trigger is plain text. Put layout attributes on the trigger element directly; on a text trigger you can put them on the component.
- The `aria-haspopup`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-describedby` the component manages are written onto the real trigger element and restored to their previous values when it unmounts.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
悬浮卡片是一层独立的浮层，组件把两者用 ARIA 属性关联起来，屏幕阅读器既能知道触发元素多了一段说明，也能在卡片打开时读到里面的结构和操作：

- 卡片带有 `role="group"`；传入 `label` 后改为具名的 `role="dialog"`，因为无名对话框不符合规范，而无名的 `group` 是合法的。
- 未传 `label` 时，触发元素带有 `aria-describedby` 指向卡片。
- 传了 `label` 时，触发元素改为带有 `aria-haspopup="dialog"`，卡片打开期间再带上 `aria-controls`。`aria-expanded` 只在触发器本身允许该属性时才会写入；纯文字触发的 `<span>` 没有对应角色，因此不会带上它。
- 触发元素原有的 `aria-haspopup`、`aria-controls`、`aria-expanded`、`aria-describedby` 会被保留，组件卸载时恢复原值。

键盘也能完整操作：聚焦触发元素会立即打开卡片，焦点在触发元素和卡片之间移动时卡片保持打开。卡片显示期间按 Escape 会关闭它；如果焦点当时在卡片内部，焦点会回到触发元素，且不会因为这次回焦而重新打开。受控模式下 Escape 只发出 `openChange(false)`，是否关闭由父组件决定。

触摸设备上没有悬停，所以轻点触发元素的行为由 `touchTrigger` 决定：默认的 `auto` 让本身不执行操作的触发元素轻点即打开，按钮、链接和表单控件则保留自己的轻点；打开后的卡片在卡片外轻点即关闭。因为内容只出现一小会儿，不要把用户完成任务必须看到的信息只放在卡片里。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：卡片显示或隐藏时触发。受控模式下按 Escape 会发出 `false`，由父组件决定是否关闭。

zh.heading: 方法
zh.text:
- `show()`：立即显示卡片，跳过悬停延迟。
- `hide()`：立即隐藏卡片。
- `element`：卡片浮层元素，或尚未挂载时的 `null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
组件渲染为片段：触发元素包裹层 `<span class="astryx-hover-card__trigger">`，加上一个传送到 `body` 的浮层。传入的属性会落到包裹层上，浮层不接收属性。

- HTML 属性、`aria-*` 属性、`data-*` 属性、`class`、`style` 都会落到包裹层。
- 包裹层在元素作为触发元素时是 `display: contents` 的透明盒子，在纯文字触发元素时是 `display: inline` 的触发元素本身。因此布局相关的属性请直接写在触发元素上，纯文字触发元素则可以直接写在组件上。
- 组件自己管理的 `aria-haspopup`、`aria-controls`、`aria-expanded`、`aria-describedby` 写在真正的触发元素上，并在卸载时恢复原值。

zh.heading: 主题

description.en: Hover a term in a sentence to read a short definition.
description.zh: 悬停句子里的术语，读一段简短解释。
