summary.en: `Overlay` lays one piece of content on top of another bounded piece — a photo, a video, a card, any block that owns its own edges — with a scrim between them that darkens or lightens what is underneath so the content on top stays readable. The content is usually a single action or a single label: a quick view button over a gallery thumbnail, a play button over a video poster, a title over a cover image.
summary.zh: `Overlay` 把一段内容叠在另一段有边界的内容上面，并用一层遮罩压暗或提亮底层的画面，让叠上去的内容看得清楚。底层可以是一张图片、一段视频、一张卡片，或任何自带边界的区块；叠上去的内容通常只有一个按钮或一行标签。用来做图库里的"快速查看"、视频上的播放按钮、封面图上的标题，都很合适。

usage.en: `Overlay` lays one piece of content on top of another bounded piece — a photo, a video, a card, any block that owns its own edges — with a scrim between them that darkens or lightens what is underneath so the content on top stays readable. The content is usually a single action or a single label: a quick view button over a gallery thumbnail, a play button over a video poster, a title over a cover image. ```vue ``` The default slot is the base content and the `content` slot is what goes on top; without a `content` slot only the base content renders and no scrim appears. The scrim is dark by default, and it does more than paint a background: everything inside it switches to the dark surface theme, so text, icons, and buttons pick up the colors that belong on a dark surface. You do not write any white text yourself. `scrim="light"` does the same for a light scrim, and `scrim={false}` drops the background entirely while keeping the overlay content and its placement. There are three ways to decide when the overlay shows. `showOn` is pure CSS: `always`, the default, keeps it visible; `hover` shows it while the pointer is over the surface; `focus` shows it only while something inside the surface holds focus. `isOpen` is controlled from JavaScript and wins over both, bound with `v-model:isOpen`: ```vue ``` In hover mode, keyboard focus inside the surface reveals the overlay as well, so a keyboard-only user still reaches the action, and it settles back once focus leaves. A touch device has no hover to follow, so that mode becomes tap-to-toggle: one tap on the base content opens the overlay, another closes it. A tap that lands on a button or a link that was already inside the surface belongs to that element and does not toggle anything. `position` decides how much of the surface the scrim covers. `fill` covers all of it, while `bottom` and `top` are strips pinned to one edge that slide in from that edge and slide back out. `align` places the content inside the scrim: `start` at the leading edge, `end` at the trailing edge, `center` on both axes. The container copies the border radius of the base content and clips the scrim with the same radius, so the scrim never covers a rounded corner. An `Overlay` is a covering layer that belongs to its own content, not a floating layer over the page: reach for `Popover` when the surface is anchored to a trigger, and for `Dialog` when the user must answer before continuing. When the container already exists and only the behavior is missing, use `useOverlay` directly. It returns the attributes for the container and the `OverlayScrim` to render inside it: ```vue ``` The container needs both `containerProps` — which bring the positioning, the clipping, and the tap toggle — and `containerRef`, and the scrim has to render inside that container for the hover and focus selectors to find it. The returned state is reactive: pass a `ref` or a `computed` for options such as `showOn` and `isOpen` and the scrim follows them, while plain values are read once at setup.
usage.zh: `Overlay` 把一段内容叠在另一段有边界的内容上面，并用一层遮罩压暗或提亮底层的画面，让叠上去的内容看得清楚。底层可以是一张图片、一段视频、一张卡片，或任何自带边界的区块；叠上去的内容通常只有一个按钮或一行标签。用来做图库里的"快速查看"、视频上的播放按钮、封面图上的标题，都很合适。 ```vue ``` 默认插槽是底层内容，`content` 插槽是要叠上去的内容；没有 `content` 插槽时只渲染底层内容，遮罩不会出现。默认遮罩是深色，它同时把遮罩内部的内容切换到"深色表面"这一套语义：文字、图标和按钮都会换成适合深色背景的颜色，所以你不必手写任何白色样式。`scrim="light"` 反过来处理浅色遮罩，`scrim={false}` 不画遮罩，只保留叠放的内容和位置。 遮罩出现的方式有三种。`showOn` 完全由 CSS 驱动：默认的 `always` 一直可见，`hover` 在指针悬停时出现，`focus` 只在容器内有焦点时出现。`isOpen` 由 JavaScript 控制，优先级最高，用 `v-model:isOpen` 绑定： ```vue ``` `hover` 模式下，键盘把焦点移进容器同样会让遮罩出现，所以只用键盘的用户不会漏掉叠上去的按钮；焦点离开时它会收回去。触屏设备没有"悬停"这件事，所以这一模式下改成点一下底层内容打开、再点一下关闭。如果这一下点在容器里本来就有的按钮或链接上，那一下属于那个元素，不会顺带切换遮罩。 `position` 决定遮罩覆盖的范围：`fill` 铺满整块内容，`bottom` 和 `top` 是贴在一条边上的横条，出现和消失时会从那条边滑进滑出。`align` 决定内容在遮罩里的对齐方式，`start` 靠起始边，`end` 靠结束边，`center` 居中。 容器会照抄底层内容的圆角，再按同样圆角把遮罩裁掉，所以遮罩不会盖住圆角。`Overlay` 是贴着内容本身的覆盖层，不是浮在页面上的浮层：需要锚定在元素旁边的浮层用 `Popover`，需要模态对话框用 `Dialog`。 如果容器已经存在，只想给它加上同样的行为，可以直接用 `useOverlay`。它返回要挂在容器上的属性，以及要渲染在容器内部的 `OverlayScrim`： ```vue ``` 容器上要同时挂 `containerProps`（它带来定位、裁剪和点按切换）和 `containerRef`，遮罩要渲染在这个容器内部，悬停和焦点的祖先选择器才找得到它。返回的属性是响应式的：`showOn`、`isOpen` 这些选项传 `ref` 或 `computed` 时，遮罩会跟着变；传普通值时它们只在初始化时读一次。

en.text: Keep it to the actions and labels that belong to this content: quick view, play, a cover title.
Keep the overlay content short. The more you place on the scrim, the less of the base surface reads and the harder the text is to read.
Use `showOn="hover"` when keyboard users need the overlay too: it answers to focus as well as to the pointer.
Pick the scrim from what is underneath, not from the page theme. A dark photo wants a dark scrim, a bright one wants a light scrim.
Put content the user must answer before continuing on it. That belongs in a `Dialog`.
Pour long text or a multi-field form onto the scrim. The room over a surface is sized for one line or one button.
Use it as a floating layer anchored to a trigger. `Popover`, `Tooltip`, and `Dialog` are the tools for that.

zh.text: 只把属于这块内容自己的动作或标签放进来：快速查看、播放、封面标题。
叠上去的内容保持精简。遮罩上放得越多，底层的画面越看不清，文字也越难读。
需要键盘用户也能看到时用 `showOn="hover"`：它同时响应悬停和焦点，而不只是鼠标。
遮罩的深浅按底层画面选，而不是按页面主题选。深色照片上用深色遮罩，浅色照片上用浅色遮罩。
用它承载需要用户先回答才能继续的内容。那属于 `Dialog`。
在遮罩里塞长文本或多行表单。遮罩的空间是给一行字或一个按钮的。
用它做锚定在元素旁边的浮层。`Popover`、`Tooltip`、`Dialog` 才是那类需求的工具。

rows.name: `showOn`
rows.description: What reveals the overlay while `isOpen` stays unbound, driven entirely by CSS. `always` keeps it visible, `hover` reveals it on hover or when focus enters the container, `focus` only on focus, and `hover-or-focus` is an alias of `hover`. On a touch device `hover` becomes tap-to-toggle.

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: Visibility controlled from JavaScript, taking precedence over `showOn` and over the tap toggle. Bind it with `v-model:isOpen`; leaving it unbound hands visibility back to `showOn`. While it is `false` the scrim is hidden and made `inert`, so its buttons leave the tab order.

rows.name: `scrim`
rows.description: The scrim background, which also decides the surface theme the content inside it uses. `dark` and `light` resolve the content against a dark and a light surface respectively; `false` draws no background and leaves the content on the ambient theme.

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: How much of the base surface the scrim covers. `fill` covers all of it, while `bottom` and `top` are strips pinned to one edge that slide in from and out to that edge.

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: Alignment of the content inside the scrim. The scrim lays content out in a column, so this is the horizontal axis: `start` at the leading edge, `end` at the trailing edge, and `center` on both axes.

rows.name: `scrim`
rows.description: The scrim background and the surface theme its content uses.

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: How much of the base surface the scrim covers.

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: Alignment of the content inside the scrim.

rows.name: `showOn`
rows.description: What reveals the overlay while `isOpen` stays unbound.

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: Controlled visibility. When set, `showOn` is ignored and a `false` value marks the scrim `inert`.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Attach it to the container element with `ref="containerRef"`.

rows.name: `containerProps`
rows.description: The attributes the container needs (scope class, tap toggle), spread with `v-bind`. They bring the positioning, the clipping, and the tap toggle on a touch device.

rows.name: `scrimProps`
rows.description: Pass them to the `OverlayScrim` rendered inside the container.

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: The visibility the scrim actually uses: the bound `isOpen`, the tap toggle state, or `undefined` when CSS decides.

rows.name: `hasTouchToggle`
rows.description: Whether the container currently toggles by tap (a touch device in hover mode).

rows.name: `toggle`
rows.description: Flips the tap toggle state. Ignored while `isOpen` is bound.

rows.name: `showOn`
rows.description: 未绑定 `isOpen` 时遮罩的出现方式，完全由 CSS 驱动。`always` 一直可见；`hover` 在悬停或容器内获得焦点时出现；`focus` 只在容器内获得焦点时出现；`hover-or-focus` 是 `hover` 的别名。触屏设备上 `hover` 改成点按切换。

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: 由 JavaScript 控制的可见性，优先级高于 `showOn` 和点按切换。用 `v-model:isOpen` 绑定；不绑定时可见性交回 `showOn`。为 `false` 时遮罩不可见、并设为 `inert`，里面的按钮不会进入 Tab 顺序。

rows.name: `scrim`
rows.description: 遮罩的背景，同时决定遮罩内部内容使用哪一套表面语义。`dark` 和 `light` 分别让内部内容按深色、浅色表面取色；`false` 不画背景，内容保持页面当前主题。

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: 遮罩覆盖的范围。`fill` 铺满整块内容；`bottom` 和 `top` 是贴在一条边上的横条，出现和消失时从那条边滑进滑出。

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: 内容在遮罩里的对齐方式。遮罩按列排布，所以这是水平方向：`start` 靠起始边，`end` 靠结束边，`center` 两轴居中。

rows.description: 内容在遮罩里的对齐方式。

rows.name: `showOn`
rows.description: 未绑定 `isOpen` 时的出现方式。

rows.description: 受控可见性。传入时忽略 `showOn`，并在为 `false` 时把遮罩设为 `inert`。

en.heading: OverlayScrim
en.text: `OverlayScrim` is the rendering component of the scrim itself, exported from `@astryx-vue/core/Overlay` for the consumers of `useOverlay`. `Overlay` renders it internally, and the props mean the same as above. Its default slot is the overlay content. The root carries data-position, data-align, data-scrim, and data-visibility for theming, and the content is wrapped in a data-astryx-media="dark | light" element that switches the surface theme without affecting layout.

en.heading: useOverlay
en.text: `useOverlay` adds the same overlay behavior to a container that already exists. Its options match the props of `Overlay`, except that it accepts a `ref` or a `computed` for any of them.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `
`. The following go to the root element: - HTML attributes. - `aria-*` attributes. - `data-*` attributes. - `class`. - `style`. `class` is merged with astryx-overlay, and `style` with the border radius the component writes. A click handler you pass runs alongside the tap toggle.

zh.heading: OverlayScrim
zh.text: `OverlayScrim` 是遮罩本身的渲染组件，从 `@astryx-vue/core/Overlay` 导出，供 `useOverlay` 的使用者渲染遮罩。`Overlay` 内部用的就是它，属性含义与上表一致。 它的默认插槽就是遮罩内容，根元素上带有 data-position、data-align、data-scrim、data-visibility，主题可以据此定制；遮罩内部的内容包在一层 data-astryx-media="dark | light" 的代理元素里，它只负责切换表面语义，不影响布局。

zh.heading: useOverlay
zh.text: `useOverlay` 给一个已经存在的容器加上同样的遮罩行为。选项与 `Overlay` 的属性同名，区别在于可以传 `ref` 或 `computed` 保持响应式。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `
`。 以下内容传入根元素： - HTML 属性。 - `aria-*` 属性。 - `data-*` 属性。 - `class`。 - `style`。 `class` 会与 astryx-overlay 合并，`style` 与组件自己写入的圆角合并。传入的点击处理与触屏点按切换会同时生效。

en.text: Keep popover content focused on a single task or piece of information.
Provide a clear way to close: either by clicking outside or with an explicit close button.
Nest popovers inside other popovers; it creates confusing focus and navigation.
Use a popover for content that requires heavy user input; use a Dialog instead.
Put too much content in a popover; if it needs scrolling, use a Dialog instead.

rows.description: Controlled visibility. When unset, the trigger manages visibility.

rows.name: `isEnabled`
rows.description: Prevents the trigger from opening the surface when false.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Surface width. Numbers are pixels. When unset, the surface is at least as wide as the trigger and at most 320px (and never wider than the viewport).

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Inner padding, mapped to the `--astryx-spacing-*` tokens.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the dialog. Provide it when `role` is `dialog`.

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: Use `dialog` for interactive content. Use `none` when the content already has its own role.

rows.name: `isModal`
rows.description: Keeps Tab focus inside the surface while it is open. Applies to `dialog` only.

rows.name: `hasCloseButton`
rows.description: Shows a close button that is visible only when focused.

rows.name: `closeButtonLabel`
rows.description: Text and accessible name of the close button.

rows.name: `hasAutoFocus`
rows.description: Moves focus into the surface when it opens.

rows.name: `hasLightDismiss`
rows.description: Closes when the user presses outside the surface and the trigger.

rows.name: `hasEscapeDismiss`
rows.description: Closes when the user presses Escape.

rows.name: `anchor`
rows.description: External element to anchor to. No trigger wrapper is rendered and the default slot can be omitted; click, keydown and ARIA wiring land on the button inside that element.

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: 浮层相对触发元素的方向。所选方向空间不足时会自动翻转。

rows.name: `alignment`
rows.description: 浮层沿位置方向的对齐方式：靠起始端、居中或靠末端。

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: 受控显示状态。未设置时，开合由触发元素自行管理。

rows.name: `isEnabled`
rows.description: 是否启用。为 false 时触发元素无法打开浮层。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 浮层宽度，数字单位为像素。未设置时最小与触发元素等宽，最大为 320px，且不超出视口。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 浮层内边距，取值对应 `--astryx-spacing-*` 令牌。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 浮层作为对话框时的无障碍名称，`role` 为 `dialog` 时应提供。

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: 浮层的语义角色：包含交互内容时使用 `dialog`；内容自带角色（例如菜单）时使用 `none`。

rows.name: `isModal`
rows.description: 浮层打开期间将 Tab 焦点限制在浮层内。仅对 `dialog` 角色生效。

rows.name: `hasCloseButton`
rows.description: 是否显示关闭按钮。关闭按钮在获得焦点前保持视觉隐藏。

rows.name: `closeButtonLabel`
rows.description: 关闭按钮的文字，同时作为它的无障碍名称。

rows.name: `hasAutoFocus`
rows.description: 打开时是否把焦点移入浮层。仅对 `dialog` 角色生效。

rows.name: `hasLightDismiss`
rows.description: 是否允许点击浮层与触发元素以外的区域来关闭。

rows.name: `hasEscapeDismiss`
rows.description: 是否允许按下 Escape 关闭浮层。

rows.name: `anchor`
rows.description: 用外部元素当锚点。这时不渲染触发容器，默认插槽可以不写；点击、键盘和 ARIA 属性都挂到该元素里的按钮上。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A popover has to communicate its presence, its current open state, and its content to people who use a screen reader or a keyboard. The component links the trigger to the surface automatically and manages focus as the surface opens and closes, so you only need to supply the accessible name.

- The trigger receives `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls`, so assistive technology knows it is a button that opens a surface and can announce whether that surface is currently expanded.
- A `dialog` surface has `role="dialog"`; when `isModal` is set it also has `aria-modal="true"`, and the `label` serves as its accessible name.
- Focus moves to the first focusable element inside the surface on open, and returns to the trigger when the user presses Escape or closes the surface.
- With `isModal` set, Tab focus stays inside the surface while it is open.
- The built-in close button is visually hidden until it receives focus, so it appears once the keyboard reaches it.

en.heading: Layout
en.text: The surface is positioned with JavaScript. It recalculates its position when the page scrolls or resizes, and it flips to the other side when the chosen side has no room.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires when the surface opens or closes, including when the user dismisses it.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `default`: the trigger. Use a `button` or an element with `role="button"`. Not needed when `anchor` is set.
- `content`: the surface content.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
弹出层要把自己的存在、当前的开合状态和内部内容告诉使用屏幕阅读器或键盘的用户。组件会自动把触发元素和浮层关联起来，并在浮层打开、关闭时管理焦点，你只需要提供必要的无障碍名称。

- 触发元素上带有 `aria-haspopup`、`aria-expanded` 与 `aria-controls`，辅助技术由此知道这是一个会打开浮层的按钮，并能读出浮层当前是展开还是收起。
- `dialog` 类型的浮层带有 `role="dialog"`；设置 `isModal` 时还会带有 `aria-modal="true"`，并以 `label` 作为无障碍名称。
- 打开时焦点移入浮层中的第一个可聚焦元素；用户按下 Escape 或关闭浮层时，焦点回到触发元素。
- 设置 `isModal` 后，浮层打开期间 Tab 焦点保持在浮层内。
- 内置关闭按钮在获得焦点前视觉隐藏，键盘聚焦到它时才显示出来。

zh.heading: 布局
zh.text: 浮层通过 JavaScript 定位。页面滚动或窗口尺寸变化时会重新计算位置；所选方向空间不足时翻转到另一侧。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：浮层打开或关闭时触发，包括用户主动关闭。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `default`：触发元素。请使用 `button` 或带有 `role="button"` 的元素。设置 `anchor` 后可以不写。
- `content`：浮层内容。

zh.heading: 主题

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'

import { Section } from '@astryx-vue/core/Section'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { h, ref } from 'vue'

function svgIcon(paths: string[]): Component {
  return () => h('svg', {
    'viewBox': '0 0 24 24',
    'fill': 'none',
    'stroke': 'currentColor',
    'stroke-width': 1.5,
    'stroke-linecap': 'round',
    'stroke-linejoin': 'round',
  }, paths.map(d => h('path', { d })))
}

const UserIcon = svgIcon(['M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2', 'M9 11a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8'])
const TagIcon = svgIcon(['M20.6 13.4 12 22l-8.6-8.6a2 2 0 0 1-.6-1.4V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2 2 0 0 1 1.4.6L20.6 8a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.8Z', 'M7.5 7.5h.01'])
const CalendarIcon = svgIcon(['M8 2v4', 'M16 2v4', 'M3 10h18', 'M5 4h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2Z'])

const actions = [
  { icon: UserIcon, label: 'Assign owner', description: 'Route follow-up to a teammate.' },
  { icon: TagIcon, label: 'Add label', description: 'Group this item with related work.' },
  { icon: CalendarIcon, label: 'Set due date', description: 'Pick a reminder for review.' },
]

const isOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Open project actions" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <BottomSheet v-model:is-open="isOpen" label="Project actions" height="hug">
    <Section :padding-block="4" :padding-inline="1">

          <Heading :level="3">
            Project actions

          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Use this modal touch surface when the task should move away from its trigger and stay close to the bottom edge.

            v-for="action in actions"
            :key="action.label"
            :label="action.label"
            :description="action.description"
            :on-click="() => { isOpen = false }"

            <template #startContent>

            </template>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </VStack>
    </Section>
  </BottomSheet>

summary.en: Place `ToastViewport` once near the root of your app, then call `useToast` from any component.
summary.zh: `Toast` 是一种不打断操作的轻量反馈，用来确认操作结果或提示状态变化，数秒后自动消失。使用时，在应用根节点放置一次 `ToastViewport`，然后在任意组件中调用 `useToast` 弹出提示。

usage.en: Place `ToastViewport` once near the root of your app, then call `useToast` from any component. On a touch screen, a swipe toward the toast's edge dismisses it: down when it sits at the bottom, up when it sits at the top. A horizontal drag is left to the page. A swipe that starts on a button or link does not dismiss. A mouse drag does not dismiss either. ```vue ```
usage.zh: `Toast` 是一种不打断操作的轻量反馈，用来确认操作结果或提示状态变化，数秒后自动消失。使用时，在应用根节点放置一次 `ToastViewport`，然后在任意组件中调用 `useToast` 弹出提示。 在触摸屏上，朝提示所在的那条边滑动可以关掉它：贴在屏幕下方的向下滑，贴在上方的向上滑。横向滑动留给页面滚动。滑在按钮或链接上时不关，那一下属于控件自己。鼠标拖动不会关掉提示。 ```vue ```

en.text: Put `ToastViewport` at the top level so toasts overlay every page.
Use `type="error"` for failures and rely on `role="alert"`.
Keep toast copy short — one line describing the outcome is enough.
Flood the screen with many toasts at once.
Use toasts for actions that need user confirmation.

zh.text: 将 `ToastViewport` 放在应用顶层，确保提示能覆盖所有页面，位置与堆叠顺序也保持一致。
错误信息使用 `type="error"`，组件会自动应用 `role="alert"`，让屏幕阅读器优先播报。
保持提示文本简洁，一行说明操作结果即可，用户通常只会扫一眼。
避免同时弹出大量提示：信息过载会让用户忽略真正重要的内容，必要时合并为一条。
避免用 Toast 替代需要用户确认的对话框：提示会自动消失，用户可能来不及做出响应。

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: Visual type. Optional: info, success, warning, error.

rows.name: `body`
rows.description: Toast message text.

rows.name: `isAutoHide`
rows.description: Whether the toast dismisses itself. Error toasts stay until they are dismissed unless this is set.

rows.name: `autoHideDuration`
rows.description: Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds. A pause on hover, focus, or window blur keeps at least one second on the clock.

rows.name: `autoClose`
rows.description: Older name of `isAutoHide`. Both work; `isAutoHide` wins.

rows.name: `duration`
rows.description: Older name of `autoHideDuration`. Both work; `autoHideDuration` wins.

rows.name: `uniqueID`
rows.description: Identity shared by toasts that collapse into one.

rows.name: `collisionBehavior`
rows.description: What happens when a toast reuses a visible `uniqueID`.

rows.name: `endContent`
rows.description: Trailing action, such as an undo button. Use the `end` slot for one-off content.

rows.name: `onDismiss`
rows.description: Runs when the toast is dismissed from inside the card: the timer, the close button, or custom content. Options for `useToast()` only.

rows.name: `onHide`
rows.description: Runs when the toast is removed, however it was dismissed, including the dismiss function returned by `useToast()`. Options for `useToast()` only.

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: Position of the toast stack in the viewport. Optional: top-start, top-center, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-center, bottom-end.

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: 提示的类型，可选 info、success、warning、error；error 类型会自动应用 `role="alert"`。

rows.name: `body`
rows.description: 提示的正文文本，默认渲染在提示内容区。

rows.name: `isAutoHide`
rows.description: 是否自动关闭。error 类型默认一直留着，直到被关掉。

rows.name: `autoHideDuration`
rows.description: 自动关闭前的停留时长，单位毫秒。悬停、聚焦或窗口失焦会暂停计时，恢复后至少还剩一秒。

rows.name: `autoClose`
rows.description: `isAutoHide` 的旧名字，写哪个都行，同名时以 `isAutoHide` 为准。

rows.name: `duration`
rows.description: `autoHideDuration` 的旧名字，写哪个都行，同名时以 `autoHideDuration` 为准。

rows.name: `uniqueID`
rows.description: 用来把同一条提示合并成一个的标识。

rows.name: `collisionBehavior`
rows.description: 屏幕上已有同 `uniqueID` 的提示时怎么办。

rows.name: `endContent`
rows.description: 末尾动作，例如撤销按钮。临时内容用 `end` 插槽。

rows.name: `onDismiss`
rows.description: 卡片自己关掉提示时触发：计时器、关闭按钮或自定义内容。`useToast()` 的参数里使用。

rows.name: `onHide`
rows.description: 提示被移除时触发，包括用 `useToast()` 返回的函数关掉的情况。`useToast()` 的参数里使用。

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: 提示在屏幕上的弹出位置，可选 top-start、top-center、top-end、bottom-start、bottom-center、bottom-end。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Custom toast content. Defaults to `body`.

rows.name: `end`
rows.description: Trailing content, replacing `endContent`.

rows.name: `content`
rows.description: Replaces the whole card content and receives `{ body, endContent, type, isAutoHide, autoHideDuration, dismiss }`. The empty-state close button is not rendered, so the custom layout owns every control.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 自定义提示的内容区域，未提供时默认显示 `body` 文本。

rows.name: `end`
rows.description: 末尾内容，替代 `endContent`。

rows.name: `content`
rows.description: 替换整块卡片内容，参数是 `{ body, endContent, type, isAutoHide, autoHideDuration, dismiss }`。这时不再渲染自带的关闭按钮，控件全部由自定义布局负责。

rows.name: `dismiss`
rows.description: Emitted with the reason (`'auto'` or `'manual'`) when the card dismisses itself.

rows.name: `close`
rows.description: Older name of `dismiss`, emitted at the same time without the reason.

rows.name: `dismiss`
rows.description: 卡片自己关闭提示时触发，参数是原因（`'auto'` 或 `'manual'`）。

rows.name: `close`
rows.description: `dismiss` 的旧名字，同时触发，不带原因。

en.heading: useToast

zh.heading: useToast

usage.en:
`Tooltip` shows a short hint next to a trigger on hover or keyboard focus. The trigger keeps its own behavior.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Tooltip } from '@astryx-vue/core/Tooltip'
</script>

<template>

</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Tooltip` 为触发元素补充一段简短的说明文字，在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时出现在它旁边，适合解释图标按钮的含义、补充字段的格式要求这类轻量场景；触发元素自身的行为不受影响。最简单的用法是用 `content` 传入提示文字，并把触发元素放进默认插槽：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Tooltip } from '@astryx-vue/core/Tooltip'
</script>

<template>
  <Tooltip content="保存你的更改">
    <Button label="保存" />
  </Tooltip>
</template>
```

en.text: Keep tooltip content concise: aim for under 140 characters of plain text.
Add a tooltip to icon-only buttons and controls that lack a visible label.
Place interactive elements like links or buttons inside a tooltip; use HoverCard or Popover instead.
Use tooltips for essential information that users must see to complete a task.

用提示框展示用户完成任务必须看到的关键信息。

rows.name: `content`
rows.description: 提示文字。需要展示富文本时，改用 `content` 插槽。

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: 提示相对触发元素的方向。所选方向空间不足时会自动翻转。

rows.name: `alignment`
rows.description: 气泡沿位置方向的对齐方式：靠起始端、居中或靠末端。

rows.name: `delay`
rows.description: 悬停或聚焦后，提示显示前的等待时间（毫秒）。

rows.name: `hideDelay`
rows.description: 鼠标或焦点离开后，提示隐藏前的等待时间（毫秒）。为 0 时使用 100 毫秒，给鼠标移入气泡留出时间。

rows.name: `focusTrigger`
rows.description: 聚焦时是否显示提示：auto 仅在触发元素本身可聚焦时监听，always 始终监听，never 从不监听。

rows.name: `touchTrigger`
rows.description: 触摸设备上点击触发元素时的行为：auto 时点击切换提示，但按钮、链接和表单控件自身的点击不触发；tap 总是切换；none 不打开。

rows.name: `isEnabled`
rows.description: 是否启用提示。为 false 时禁用悬停与聚焦触发。

rows.name: `hasHoverIndication`
rows.description: 是否在纯文字触发元素上显示虚线下划线。auto 时仅对纯文字触发元素生效。

rows.name: `isOpen`
rows.description: 受控显示状态。设置后悬停与聚焦不再触发提示。

rows.name: `isDefaultOpen`
rows.description: 是否在挂载时就显示提示。仅在未设置 isOpen 时生效。

rows.name: `anchorsOnSelf`
rows.description: 不再包一层 span，插槽的根元素自己当触发器。标题和段落必须这样用。

rows.name: `anchor`
rows.description: 用外部元素当触发器。这时不渲染外层 span，默认插槽可以不写，悬停、聚焦和 `aria-describedby` 都挂到该元素上。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The tooltip bubble is a separate layer, and the component links it to the trigger with ARIA attributes so assistive technology can announce both the extra description attached to the trigger and the text inside the bubble:

- The bubble has `role="tooltip"`, which tells assistive technology to treat it as a hint.
- The trigger receives `aria-describedby` pointing to the bubble's `id`.

The hint appears on mouse hover or keyboard focus. While it is showing, pressing Escape closes an uncontrolled tooltip; a controlled tooltip instead emits `openChange(false)`, and the parent decides whether to close it.

Because the hint appears only on hover or focus and disappears again, users can easily miss it, and touch devices do not always trigger it. Keep essential information that users must see to complete a task out of tooltips.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`: fires when the tooltip shows or hides. With `isOpen`, it fires with `false` on Escape and the parent decides whether to close.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `default`: the trigger.
- `content`: rich tooltip content. Replaces the `content` prop text.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
提示框的气泡是一个独立的浮层，组件用 ARIA 属性把它和触发元素关联起来，屏幕阅读器既能知道触发元素多了一段补充说明，也能在气泡出现时读出里面的文字：

- 气泡带有 `role="tooltip"`，辅助技术据此把它识别为提示。
- 触发元素带有 `aria-describedby`，指向气泡的 `id`。

提示只在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时出现。在显示状态下按 Escape 可以关闭非受控提示框；受控提示框此时会发出 `openChange(false)`，是否关闭由父组件决定。

也正因为提示转瞬即隐，用户很容易错过，触摸设备上也未必能触发，所以不要把用户完成任务必须看到的关键信息只放在提示框里。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: - `openChange(isOpen: boolean)`：提示显示或隐藏时触发。受控模式下，按 Escape 会发出 `false`，由父组件决定是否关闭。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `default`：触发元素。
- `content`：富文本提示内容。会替代 `content` 属性的文字。

zh.heading: 主题

summary.en: `CommandPalette` is a searchable command list. It owns the dialog, the search field, grouping, the empty state, and keyboard movement. The commands themselves come from a `SearchSource`. An empty query calls `bootstrap`; a typed query calls `search`.
summary.zh: `CommandPalette`（命令面板）是一个可以通过键盘全局唤起、支持即时搜索的指令弹窗，类似于 VS Code 或 Mac 上的 Spotlight 搜索。它把居中弹窗、输入搜索框、指令分组、键盘上下选行、以及搜不到时的空状态都封装在了一起。只要传入数据源 `SearchSource`，输入框为空时它会展示推荐列表（`bootstrap`），用户打字时则会即时进行关键词搜索（`search`）。

usage.en:
`CommandPalette` is a searchable command list. It owns the dialog, the search field, grouping, the empty state, and keyboard movement. The commands themselves come from a `SearchSource`. An empty query calls `bootstrap`; a typed query calls `search`.

`isInline` draws the palette in the page instead of a modal. Production palettes leave it off. Opening from a shortcut is the page's job: `useHotkeys` already handles `mod+k`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createStaticSource, useHotkeys } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { CommandPalette } from '@astryx-vue/core/CommandPalette'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const source = createStaticSource([
  { id: 'home', label: 'Home' },
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings' },
])

function openPalette() {
  isOpen.value = true
}

useHotkeys([{ keys: 'mod+k', onPress: openPalette }])
</script>

<template>
  <CommandPalette
    :is-open="isOpen"
    :search-source="source"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

`v-model:value` turns the palette into a picker: the matching row stays selected, and choosing a row writes that id. `auxiliaryData.group` splits the list into groups in first-seen order. The `item` slot replaces the row label; `footer` replaces the hint row.

Arrow keys move the highlight and do not wrap. Home and End stay in the input and leave the highlight where it is. Page Up jumps to the first enabled row, and Page Down jumps to the last. Enter selects the highlighted row. Escape closes the palette and drops an in-flight search. Moving the pointer highlights a row without scrolling the list. The highlight stays empty until the pointer or the keyboard moves it.
usage.zh:
`CommandPalette`（命令面板）是一个可以通过键盘全局唤起、支持即时搜索的指令弹窗，类似于 VS Code 或 Mac 上的 Spotlight 搜索。它把居中弹窗、输入搜索框、指令分组、键盘上下选行、以及搜不到时的空状态都封装在了一起。只要传入数据源 `SearchSource`，输入框为空时它会展示推荐列表（`bootstrap`），用户打字时则会即时进行关键词搜索（`search`）。

**什么时候用：**
- 需要为高级用户提供全局快捷键（如 `Cmd + K` 或 `Ctrl + K`），让他们能够秒级搜索页面、执行快捷操作或跳转路由时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 普通表单里的局部下拉选择，请使用 [Selector](/components/selector) 或下拉菜单。
- 站内文章的全文搜索结果页，更适合使用带翻页的专属搜索大页面。

通过快捷键打开面板非常简单，配合 `useHotkeys` 监听快捷键，控制 `isOpen` 开关即可：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createStaticSource, useHotkeys } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { CommandPalette } from '@astryx-vue/core/CommandPalette'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const source = createStaticSource([
  { id: 'home', label: 'Home' },
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings' },
])

function openPalette() {
  isOpen.value = true
}

useHotkeys([{ keys: 'mod+k', onPress: openPalette }])
</script>

<template>
  <CommandPalette
    :is-open="isOpen"
    :search-source="source"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

其他好用的配置包括：

- `v-model:value`：可以把命令面板变成单选选择器，当前选中的项会保留打勾标记。
- 在数据项里配置 `auxiliaryData.group`，组件就会自动将菜单整理成带标题的分类区域。
- 上下方向键在选项间移动高亮，到头就停住。Home 和 End 留在输入框里，不改高亮。Page Up 跳到第一项可用项，Page Down 跳到最后一项可用项。Enter 执行当前高亮行。Escape 关掉面板，并丢掉还没回来的异步搜索。鼠标划过只会移动高亮，不会把列表滚走。
- 只有在做组件文档演示或特殊内嵌时才开启 `isInline`（将面板平铺在页面里），正常的实际业务项目中请保持默认的模态弹窗形式。

description.en: Search waits briefly, then filters filenames. An empty query asks for a filename.
description.zh: 搜索会稍等一下再按文件名过滤。还没输入时提示输入文件名。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SearchSource } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { CommandPalette, CommandPaletteInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/CommandPalette'

const files = [
  { id: 'readme', label: 'README.md' },
  { id: 'package', label: 'package.json' },
  { id: 'tsconfig', label: 'tsconfig.json' },
  { id: 'index', label: 'src/index.ts' },
  { id: 'app', label: 'src/App.tsx' },
]

const source: SearchSource = {
  async search(query: string) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 400))
    const normalized = query.toLowerCase()
    return files.filter(file => file.label.toLowerCase().includes(normalized))
  },
  bootstrap() {
    return []
  },
}
</script>

<template>
  <CommandPalette
    empty-bootstrap-text="Type a filename to search"
    empty-search-text="No files found"
    is-inline
    is-open
    :search-source="source"
  >
    <template #input>
      <CommandPaletteInput placeholder="Search files..." />
    </template>
  </CommandPalette>
</template>

description.en: Rows show the command and, when one is set, its shortcut.
description.zh: 行上显示命令；设置了快捷键时，右侧会显示按键。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SearchableItem } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { createStaticSource } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { CommandPalette } from '@astryx-vue/core/CommandPalette'
import { Kbd } from '@astryx-vue/core/Kbd'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

interface RichCommand extends SearchableItem<{ group?: string, shortcut?: string }> {}

const commands: RichCommand[] = [
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Open Settings', auxiliaryData: { group: 'Navigation', shortcut: 'mod+,' } },
  { id: 'profile', label: 'View Profile', auxiliaryData: { group: 'Navigation' } },
  { id: 'new-file', label: 'Create New File', auxiliaryData: { group: 'Actions', shortcut: 'mod+n' } },
  { id: 'search', label: 'Search Files', auxiliaryData: { group: 'Actions', shortcut: 'mod+p' } },
]

const source = createStaticSource(commands)

function shortcut(item: { auxiliaryData?: unknown }): string | undefined {
  const data = item.auxiliaryData
  if (data != null && typeof data === 'object' && 'shortcut' in data && typeof data.shortcut === 'string')
    return data.shortcut
  return undefined
}
</script>

<template>
  <CommandPalette is-inline is-open :search-source="source">
    <template #item="{ item }">
      <Text type="body" style="flex: 1">
        {{ item.label }}
      </Text>
      <Kbd v-if="shortcut(item)" :keys="shortcut(item)!" />
    </template>
  </CommandPalette>
</template>

en.text: Keep each `value` unique within the result list so highlight, active-descendant identity, and selection resolve to the same item.
Use non-interactive child content such as icons, descriptions, and shortcut hints; activate the option itself instead of nesting buttons or links.
Treat `isHighlighted` as selection. Highlight is the active keyboard result; `isSelected` represents the chosen value.

zh.text: 每个 `value` 在同一份结果里保持唯一，这样高亮、active-descendant 和选中才能对上同一行。
行里只放不带交互的内容，例如图标、说明和快捷键提示。要点就点这一行本身，别在里面再套按钮或链接。
把 `isHighlighted` 当成选中。高亮表示键盘当前停在哪一行，`isSelected` 才表示选中的值。

summary.en: `Lightbox` opens media in a native `<dialog>`. Bind `isOpen` with `v-model:is-open`. A single `media` object is one image or video. An array is a gallery: previous, next, and a counter stay mounted, and the ends disable instead of disappearing.
summary.zh: `Lightbox` 用原生 `<dialog>` 打开媒体。`isOpen` 用 `v-model:is-open` 绑定。`media` 传一个对象就是单张图片或一段视频。传数组就是图库：上一张、下一张和计数一直留在页面上，到头时禁用，而不是消失。

usage.en:
`Lightbox` opens media in a native `<dialog>`. Bind `isOpen` with `v-model:is-open`. A single `media` object is one image or video. An array is a gallery: previous, next, and a counter stay mounted, and the ends disable instead of disappearing.

`useLightbox({ media })` owns the open state and the index. Bind `bindings` onto `Lightbox`, and call `open(index)` from a thumbnail.

`hasZoom` turns an image into a button. Double-click, Enter, Space, `+`, and `-` toggle between 1× and 2×. While zoomed, drag or the arrow keys pan; each arrow moves 50px. A drag does not also close the dialog. Video items keep the browser controls and do not zoom. `hasAutoPlay` starts a video when that item is shown.

Escape and the close button emit `update:isOpen` with `false`. A backdrop click on the dialog or the frame does the same.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Lightbox, useLightbox } from '@astryx-vue/core/Lightbox'
import { Thumbnail } from '@astryx-vue/core/Thumbnail'

const photo = {
  src: '/template-assets/light-scene-horizontal-1.png',
  alt: 'Coastal shoreline with ocean waves',
  caption: 'A scenic coastline with waves rolling onto a sandy beach beneath a clear sky.',
}
const { bindings, open } = useLightbox({ media: photo })
</script>

<template>
  <Thumbnail :src="photo.src" :alt="photo.alt" :label="photo.alt" @click="open()" />
  <Lightbox v-bind="bindings" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Lightbox` 用原生 `<dialog>` 打开媒体。`isOpen` 用 `v-model:is-open` 绑定。`media` 传一个对象就是单张图片或一段视频。传数组就是图库：上一张、下一张和计数一直留在页面上，到头时禁用，而不是消失。

`useLightbox({ media })` 管打开状态和下标。把 `bindings` 绑到 `Lightbox` 上，缩略图里调用 `open(index)`。

`hasZoom` 把图片变成按钮。双击、Enter、Space、`+`、`-` 在 1 倍和 2 倍之间切换。放大后可以拖动，方向键每次平移 50px。拖动结束时的那一下点击不会把对话框关掉。视频用浏览器自己的控件，不能缩放。`hasAutoPlay` 在显示出视频时开始播放。

Escape 和关闭按钮都会发出 `update:isOpen`，值为 `false`。点对话框或画面外的遮罩也一样。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Lightbox, useLightbox } from '@astryx-vue/core/Lightbox'
import { Thumbnail } from '@astryx-vue/core/Thumbnail'

const photo = {
  src: '/template-assets/light-scene-horizontal-1.png',
  alt: 'Coastal shoreline with ocean waves',
  caption: 'A scenic coastline with waves rolling onto a sandy beach beneath a clear sky.',
}
const { bindings, open } = useLightbox({ media: photo })
</script>

<template>
  <Thumbnail :src="photo.src" :alt="photo.alt" :label="photo.alt" @click="open()" />
  <Lightbox v-bind="bindings" />
</template>
```

Open a gallery at the thumbnail the reader chose, with `open(index)`.
Turn on `hasZoom` only for a still image that has detail worth inspecting.
Put `hasZoom` on a video. The controls stay native, and zoom is ignored.
Leave `alt` empty. The dialog name and the image name both come from it.

en.heading: useLightbox
en.text:
```ts
const { bindings, open, close, isOpen, index, getTriggerProps } = useLightbox({
  media,
  hasZoom: false,
  hasAutoPlay: false,
})
```

`bindings` is the set of props and update listeners for `v-bind`. `open(index)` sets the index and opens the dialog. `getTriggerProps(index)` returns `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, and keyboard activation for a custom trigger.

summary.en: `List` presents a collection of related entries, and `ListItem` is one row inside it. The pair renders a semantic `<ul>` or `<ol>` and lays out every row as start content, label, description, and end content, so a settings screen, an inbox, or a set of steps does not have to rebuild that row layout each time.
summary.zh: `List` 用来呈现一组彼此相关的条目，`ListItem` 是其中的一行。它渲染出语义正确的 `<ul>` 或 `<ol>`，并统一安排一行内部「起始内容 + 标签 + 描述 + 结束内容」四块位置，所以设置项、通知、步骤说明这类界面不必每次都重新写一遍行布局。

usage.en:
`List` presents a collection of related entries, and `ListItem` is one row inside it. The pair renders a semantic `<ul>` or `<ol>` and lays out every row as start content, label, description, and end content, so a settings screen, an inbox, or a set of steps does not have to rebuild that row layout each time.

One row needs nothing more than a `label`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { List, ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
</script>

<template>
  <List header="Inbox">
    <ListItem label="Mentions" description="Comments that name you" />
    <ListItem label="Build finished" description="main passed every check" />
  </List>
</template>
```

`description` is the secondary line under the label. The `startContent` and `endContent` slots place an icon, an avatar, a badge, or an action at either end of the row, and `label` and `description` each have a same-named slot for content that needs richer markup than a string.

The list sets the density for all of its rows, and a single row can override it. `compact` uses 4px of block padding, `balanced` is the 8px default, and `spacious` uses 12px and widens the inline padding by one step as well. `hasDividers` rules a line between neighbouring rows, and the last row never draws one.

`listStyle` decides what appears in front of each row: `disc` draws a filled bullet, `circle` draws an outlined one, and `decimal` switches the list to an `<ol>` and numbers the rows, with `start` choosing the first number. The default `none` draws no marker at all.

A row becomes interactive in one of two ways. Give it `onClick` and a button appears inside the row, filling the content area, so keyboard users can tab to it and press Enter or Space; give it `href` and that same place becomes a link, with `noopener` and `noreferrer` added automatically when `target="_blank"`. Clicking another control inside the row, such as a button in `endContent`, does not run the row's own action.

`isSelected` marks the row as selected. When the row carries a role that permits `aria-selected` — `option`, `tab`, or `row`, for instance — the state is written there; otherwise it falls back to `aria-current="true"`, which is valid on any element, so assistive technology still hears which row is current. `isDisabled` makes the row inert and dims its content.

The `header` slot renders a title above the list and associates it through `aria-labelledby`, so a screen reader announces the title when it enters the list. `edgeCompensation="inline"` is for a list placed inside a padded container: it pulls every row toward the container's inline content edges so the row text lines up with a sibling heading, cancelling no more than the container padding each edge actually publishes.

The package also exports the more general `Item` primitive. `ListItem` is that primitive rendered as an `<li>` with the density and marker from its list; use `Item` directly when the same row layout is needed outside a list, or when you need its extra controls — `as`, `align`, `labelLines`, `descriptionLines`, and `layout`. Most screens only need `List` and `ListItem`.
usage.zh:
`List` 用来呈现一组彼此相关的条目，`ListItem` 是其中的一行。它渲染出语义正确的 `<ul>` 或 `<ol>`，并统一安排一行内部「起始内容 + 标签 + 描述 + 结束内容」四块位置，所以设置项、通知、步骤说明这类界面不必每次都重新写一遍行布局。

一行最少只需要一个 `label`：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { List, ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
</script>

<template>
  <List header="Inbox">
    <ListItem label="Mentions" description="Comments that name you" />
    <ListItem label="Build finished" description="main passed every check" />
  </List>
</template>
```

`description` 是标签下方的次要文字。使用 `startContent` 和 `endContent` 两个插槽可以把图标、头像、徽章或操作按钮放在行的两端；`label` 和 `description` 也各有一个同名插槽，当文字需要用富文本表达时改用它即可。

列表的密度由 `List` 的 `density` 统一决定，单行可以用 `ListItem` 的 `density` 覆盖它。`compact` 对应 4 像素的上下内边距，`balanced` 是默认的 8 像素，`spacious` 是 12 像素并把左右内边距也放宽一档。`hasDividers` 会在相邻两行之间画一条分隔线，最后一行不会画。

`listStyle` 决定每行前面画什么标记：`disc` 是实心圆点，`circle` 是空心圆点，`decimal` 会改用 `<ol>` 渲染并给出序号，`start` 用来指定序号从几开始。不需要标记时保持默认的 `none`。

一行可以通过两种方式变成可交互。给出 `onClick` 之后，行内部会出现一个占满内容区的按钮，键盘用户可以用 Tab 聚焦它、用回车或空格触发；给出 `href` 时同一位置会变成链接，`target="_blank"` 会自动补上 `noopener` 和 `noreferrer`。点击行内的其他控件（例如 `endContent` 里的按钮）不会触发这一行自己的动作。

`isSelected` 把行标记为选中。如果这一行带有允许 `aria-selected` 的角色，例如 `option`、`tab` 或 `row`，状态会写进 `aria-selected`；否则会退回到在任何元素上都合法的 `aria-current="true"`，屏幕阅读器仍然能读到当前项。`isDisabled` 会让行变成惰性的，并把它的内容调淡。

`header` 插槽会在列表上方渲染一段标题，并用 `aria-labelledby` 与列表关联起来，于是屏幕阅读器在进入列表时会先读出这个标题。`edgeCompensation="inline"` 用于把列表放在带内边距的容器里时让每一行的文字与同级的标题对齐：它会按每个逻辑边缘各自可用的容器内边距，抵消掉行自身的左右内边距，最多抵消到零。

包里同时导出了更通用的原语 `Item`。`ListItem` 就是它在 `<li>` 上的一层封装，加上来自 `List` 的密度和标记；需要在非列表结构里复用同一套行布局时，可以直接使用 `Item`，它能通过 `as` 决定根元素，并提供 `align`、`labelLines`、`descriptionLines`、`layout` 等额外控制。大多数界面只需要 `List` 和 `ListItem`。

en.text: Give the list a `header`. A screen reader announces it on entering the list, and sighted users get the context of the collection immediately.
Put icons, avatars, badges, or timestamps in `startContent` and `endContent`, so the two ends of a row carry the category and the status.
Use `isSelected` to distinguish the current row and let the component pick `aria-selected` or `aria-current` from the row's role, instead of writing ARIA by hand.
Set `descriptionLines` when the length of the content varies, or rely on the default single-line truncation for string descriptions, so the row height does not jump.
Nest a second control inside an interactive row as its main action. The row's button already fills the content area, and two click targets make the focus order and the behaviour hard to predict.
Use a list for a single entry. A list means the entries belong together; a short paragraph reads more naturally for one item.
Mix interactive and static rows in one list without a visible difference, leaving users unsure which rows open something.

zh.text: 用 `header` 给列表一个标题。屏幕阅读器进入列表时会先读出它，用户也能立刻知道这组内容是什么。
用 `startContent` 和 `endContent` 放置图标、头像、徽章或时间戳，让行的两端承担分类和信息提示的作用。
需要区分当前项时使用 `isSelected`，让组件根据角色选择 `aria-selected` 或 `aria-current`，而不是自己写 ARIA 属性。
内容长度不定时给出 `descriptionLines`，或者让组件按默认的单行截断来裁剪字符串描述，避免行高随文字跳动。
在可点击的行里再放一个可点击的控件作为主要操作。行的按钮已经占据整块内容区，两个点击目标会让焦点顺序和行为都变得难以预测。
为单个条目使用列表。列表意味着这些内容属于同一组，条目太少时用普通的段落更自然。
在同一个列表里混用可点击和不可点击的行而不作区分，用户会不知道哪些行可以打开。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Spacing density for the rows: compact (4px of block padding), balanced (8px), or spacious (12px, which also widens the inline padding by one step). A single row can override it with its own `density`.

rows.name: `hasDividers`
rows.description: Whether to rule a line between neighbouring rows. The last row never draws one, and rows lose their rounded corners while dividers are on.

rows.name: `edgeCompensation`
rows.description: Cancels each row's inline inset, up to the container padding published on each edge, so row text lines up with a sibling heading. It reads `--container-padding-inline-start` and `--container-padding-inline-end` and treats a missing value as zero, so a row is never pulled outside its container. Omitting the prop leaves row positions unchanged.

rows.name: `listStyle`
rows.description: The marker drawn in front of each row: none, disc (filled bullet), circle (outlined bullet), or decimal (numbers). `decimal` renders the list as an `<ol>`.

rows.name: `start`
rows.description: The first number of an ordered list, only used when `listStyle="decimal"`. It is written both to the `start` attribute of the `<ol>` and to the CSS counter.

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: Plain-text title rendered above the list and associated with it through `aria-labelledby`. Use the `header` slot for rich content.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: The primary text identifying the row. A string or a number truncates to one line; use the `label` slot for rich content.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary text below the label, also truncated to one line. Use the `description` slot for multiple lines or rich content.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Overrides the density of the surrounding `List`. When omitted the row inherits the list's density, or balanced outside a list.

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: Click handler. It renders a button that fills the row's content area and enables the hover and pressed states. Write `@click` in a template.

rows.name: `interactiveRef`
rows.description: A ref to a control inside the row that already carries its keyboard access and action, such as a checkbox in `startContent`. The row becomes an enlarged click target that forwards surface clicks to that control and renders no button of its own, so it adds no second tab stop. Mutually exclusive with `onClick` and `href`, which are ignored while it is set.

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: Link URL. A link element is rendered inside the row.

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: Where the link opens, only used with `href`. `_blank` automatically adds `noopener` and `noreferrer`.

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: Link relationship tokens, merged and de-duplicated with the ones added automatically.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disabled state. The row becomes inert, its content dims, and `aria-disabled="true"` is written. A row that carries its own `role` is left non-inert, because its parent owns the interaction.

rows.name: `isSelected`
rows.description: Selected state. Written as `aria-selected="true"` when the role permits it, and as `aria-current="true"` otherwise. An `aria-current` you pass yourself wins.

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: The root element. Give a component only when the row carries a `role`, so the parent keeps keyboard access and the row adds no second tab stop.

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: Vertical alignment of the start and end content slots. Use `start` when either end is taller than one line of text.

rows.name: `labelLines`
rows.description: Maximum lines before the label truncates. A string label truncates to one line when this is omitted; slot content is never truncated.

rows.name: `descriptionLines`
rows.description: Maximum lines before the description truncates. A string description truncates to one line when this is omitted; slot content is left alone in a stacked layout.

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: How the label and description sit together. `inline` shares one line and ellipsizes the description first, keeping the row height fixed for hosts such as a trigger.

rows.name: `isHighlighted`
rows.description: The highlighted appearance, which is what keyboard focus and hover paint. Menu-like components use it for the row they have moved to.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 行的间距密度：compact（4px 上下内边距）、balanced（8px）、spacious（12px，左右内边距也放宽一档）。单行可以用自己的 `density` 覆盖它。

rows.name: `hasDividers`
rows.description: 是否在相邻两行之间绘制分隔线。最后一行不会绘制，带分隔线时行不再有圆角。

rows.name: `edgeCompensation`
rows.description: 按每个逻辑边缘可用的容器内边距，抵消行自身的左右内边距，让行内文字与同级标题对齐。它读取容器发布的 `--container-padding-inline-start` 与 `--container-padding-inline-end`，没有发布时按 0 处理，因此不会把行拉出容器之外。省略时行的位置不变。

rows.name: `listStyle`
rows.description: 每行前面的标记：none、disc（实心圆点）、circle（空心圆点）、decimal（序号）。`decimal` 会改用 `<ol>` 渲染。

rows.name: `start`
rows.description: 有序列表的第一个编号，仅在 `listStyle="decimal"` 时生效。同时写入 `<ol>` 的 `start` 属性和 CSS 计数器。

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: 列表上方的纯文本标题，会以 `aria-labelledby` 与列表关联。需要富文本时改用 `header` 插槽。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 标识这一行的主要文字。字符串和数字会自动单行截断；需要富文本时改用 `label` 插槽。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标签下方的次要文字，同样会自动单行截断；需要多行或富文本时改用 `description` 插槽。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 覆盖所在 `List` 给定的密度。留空时继承列表的密度；不在列表中时按 balanced 处理。

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: 点击处理函数。给出后行内会渲染一个占满内容区的按钮，并启用悬停与按下状态。模板里写 `@click` 即可。

rows.name: `interactiveRef`
rows.description: 指向行内已经承载键盘操作与动作的控件（例如 `startContent` 中的复选框）。行会变成放大的点击区域，把表层点击转发给该控件，并且不再渲染自己的按钮，因此不会多出一个 Tab 停留点。与 `onClick`、`href` 互斥，设置后二者会被忽略。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 链接地址。给出后行内会渲染一个链接元素。

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: 链接打开方式，仅在给出 `href` 时生效。`_blank` 会自动补上 `noopener` 和 `noreferrer`。

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: 链接关系标记，会与自动补充的标记合并去重。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用状态。行会变成惰性（不响应指针事件），内容调暗，并写入 `aria-disabled="true"`。行带有自己的 `role` 时不设置为惰性，由父级负责。

rows.name: `isSelected`
rows.description: 选中状态。角色允许时写入 `aria-selected="true"`，否则写入 `aria-current="true"`；使用方自己传入的 `aria-current` 优先。

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: 根元素。行带有 `role` 时才可以传入组件，这样键盘操作仍由父级负责，行不会多出一个 Tab 停留点。

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: 起始与结束内容插槽的垂直对齐方式。`start` 用于两端内容高于一行文字的场景。

rows.name: `labelLines`
rows.description: 标签截断前的最大行数。字符串标签留空时按单行截断，插槽内容不截断。

rows.name: `descriptionLines`
rows.description: 描述截断前的最大行数。字符串描述留空时按单行截断，插槽内容在 stacked 布局下不截断。

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: 标签与描述的排布。`inline` 让两者共用一行，描述优先被省略，因此行高固定，适合放进触发器这类固定高度的容器。

rows.name: `isHighlighted`
rows.description: 高亮状态，也就是键盘焦点和悬停时使用的外观。菜单类组件用它表示当前定位到的行。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The entries of the list, usually `ListItem`.

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: Content rendered above the list, associated with it through `aria-labelledby`.

rows.name: `startContent`
rows.description: Content before the label: an icon, an avatar, or a checkbox.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Rich content replacing the `label` prop. It is exempt from the automatic truncation.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Rich content replacing the `description` prop.

rows.name: `endContent`
rows.description: Content after the label: a badge, a timestamp, or a chevron.

rows.name: `marker`
rows.description: The marker drawn at the head of the row as a direct child. `Item` exposes it; `ListItem` fills it from the list's `listStyle`.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 列表的条目，通常是 `ListItem`。

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: 列表上方的标题内容，会以 `aria-labelledby` 与列表关联。

rows.name: `startContent`
rows.description: 标签之前的起始内容：图标、头像或复选框。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 富文本形式的标签，会替代 `label` 属性，并且不套用自动截断。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 富文本形式的描述，会替代 `description` 属性。

rows.name: `endContent`
rows.description: 标签之后的结束内容：徽章、时间戳或箭头。

rows.name: `marker`
rows.description: 行首的标记，作为行的直接子元素渲染。仅 `Item` 直接提供，`ListItem` 会根据列表的 `listStyle` 自行填充。

en.heading: Item
en.text:
`Item` also accepts everything `ListItem` accepts: `label`, `description`, `density`, `onClick`, `interactiveRef`, `href`, `target`, `rel`, `isDisabled`, and `isSelected`.

`swipeActions` are the actions a touch drag reveals. `leading` opens when the row is dragged toward its end, and `trailing` opens toward its start. `swipeBehavior` defaults to `reveal`, which stays open after release. `commit` slides out and runs the outermost action once the drag passes the threshold, and that side should hold one action. A mouse drag does not start, so each action also needs a control in the row itself.

en.heading: Exposed
en.text: `ListItem` and `Item` also expose element (the root element), focus(), and blur(); focusing lands on the control inside the row that can actually take focus. - `element`: `ComputedRef`

en.heading: List
en.text:
The root element is a `
    `, or an `
      ` when listStyle="decimal". A header adds a wrapper element around it. The following go to the list element: - HTML attributes. - `aria-*` attributes. - `data-*` attributes. - `class`. - `style`. The component writes `role="list"`, `data-density`, `data-dividers`, `data-list-style`, and `data-edge-compensation`. Without a rendered header an `aria-labelledby` you pass is kept; with one, the list's own header takes over.

en.heading: ListItem / Item
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>` by default, and an `<li>` for `ListItem`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes such as `role` and `id`.
- `aria-*` attributes. An `aria-current` you pass wins over the one derived from the selected state.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The component writes `data-density`, `data-align`, `data-interactive`, `data-selected`, `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-inert`, `aria-disabled`, and the derived `aria-selected` / `aria-current`. Those are not overridden by an attribute of the same name passed in.

zh.heading: Item
zh.text:
`Item` 同时接受 `ListItem` 的全部属性，以及 `label`、`description`、`density`、`onClick`、`interactiveRef`、`href`、`target`、`rel`、`isDisabled`、`isSelected`。

`swipeActions` 给出触摸横滑露出的操作，`leading` 是往行内末尾拖，`trailing` 是往行内开头拖。`swipeBehavior` 默认 `reveal`，松手后停开；`commit` 越过阈值就滑出并触发最外侧，一侧只适合一个操作。鼠标不会开始这次拖动，每个操作还要在行自己的内容里能点到。

zh.heading: 暴露的方法
zh.text: `ListItem` 和 `Item` 另外暴露 element（根元素）、focus() 与 blur()，聚焦时会落在行内真正可聚焦的控件上。 - `element`: `ComputedRef`

zh.heading: List
zh.text:
根元素是 `<ul>`，`listStyle="decimal"` 时是 `<ol>`；给出 `header` 时外层会多一个包裹元素。

以下内容传入列表元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

组件自己写入 `role="list"`、`data-density`、`data-dividers`、`data-list-style` 与 `data-edge-compensation`。未渲染 `header` 时，使用方传入的 `aria-labelledby` 会保留；渲染了 `header` 时由组件的标题接管。

zh.heading: ListItem / Item
zh.text:
根元素默认是 `<div>`，`ListItem` 是 `<li>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性（`role`、`id` 等）。
- `aria-*` 属性，使用方传入的 `aria-current` 优先于选中状态推导出的值。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

组件自己写入 `data-density`、`data-align`、`data-interactive`、`data-selected`、`data-disabled`、`data-highlighted`、`data-inert`、`aria-disabled` 与推导出的 `aria-selected` / `aria-current`，这些属性不会被传入的同名属性覆盖。

usage.en:
List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.

```ts
import { ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
```

One row of a [List](/en/components/list), rendered as an `<li>`. The row draws itself from `label` and `description`, and takes a leading and a trailing slot around them. It stays a plain row until you give it something to do: an `@click` turns the row into a button, `href` turns it into a link, and `interactiveRef` points at a control inside the row that already carries the action.

`ListItem` is the list-shaped entry point to the general row primitive, [Item](/en/components/item). Use `Item` when the row does not live in a list.
usage.zh:
列表里的一行：有名字、有说明，前面能放点东西，后面也能放点东西，还能变成可以点的行。

```ts
import { ListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/List'
```

它是 [列表](/components/list) 里的一行，渲染成一个 `<li>`。名字和说明直接写 `label` 和 `description`，前后各留一个插槽。默认它只是一行字，给它一件事做才会变成控件：加 `@click` 就变按钮，加 `href` 就变链接，加 `interactiveRef` 就指向行内那个本来就能操作的控件。

`ListItem` 是列表形状的入口，底下用的是通用的 [Item](/components/item)。行不在列表里时，直接用 `Item`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 这一行的主文字。写字符串或数字时只显示一行，超出用省略号；要放别的内容就用 `label` 插槽。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 主文字下面那行小字，同样只显示一行。要多行或者放别的内容就用 `description` 插槽。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 盖掉外层 `List` 的疏密。不在列表里时默认是 `'balanced'`。

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: 点了之后做什么。给了它就渲染一个铺满行内容区的按钮，悬停和按下的样式也跟着有。模板里写 `@click`。

rows.name: `interactiveRef`
rows.description: 指向行里那个本来就能操作的控件，比如 `startContent` 里的复选框。这时整行变成更大的点击区域，点行面就转给那个控件，行自己不再渲染按钮，也就不会多一个 Tab 停留点。它和 `onClick`、`href` 只能用一个，写了它那两个会被忽略。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 链接地址。行里会渲染一个链接元素。

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: 链接在哪打开，只有写了 `href` 才有用。`_blank` 会自动补上 `noopener` 和 `noreferrer`。

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: 链接的 rel 值，会和自动补的那些合在一起。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用。这一行不动了，内容变淡，同时写上 `aria-disabled="true"`。

rows.name: `isSelected`
rows.description: 选中状态。行的角色支持时写成 `aria-selected="true"`，不支持时写成 `aria-current="true"`。你自己传的 `aria-current` 优先。

rows.name: `swipeActions`
rows.description: 手指横滑能露出哪些操作，左右各一组，每项是 `{ label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?, hasRemoval? }`。鼠标不会触发这次拖动。每个操作都要在行里再有个入口，否则键盘和鼠标用户够不着。

rows.name: `swipeBehavior`
rows.description: `reveal` 松手后行停在滑开的位置，拖得够远就触发最外面那个操作；`commit` 直接把行滑出去，松手就触发，什么都不留在屏幕上。

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `startContent`: content before the label area, such as an icon or an avatar.
- `label`: rich content replacing the `label` prop.
- `description`: rich content replacing the `description` prop.
- `endContent`: content after the label area, such as a badge, a count, or a timestamp.

en.heading: Exposed
en.text: `element` (the root element), `focus()`, and `blur()`. Focusing lands on the control inside the row that can actually take focus.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `startContent`：名字前面，比如图标或头像。
- `label`：自己画主文字，替掉 `label` 属性。
- `description`：自己画说明，替掉 `description` 属性。
- `endContent`：名字后面，比如徽章、数量、时间。

zh.heading: 暴露
zh.text: `element`（根元素）、`focus()` 和 `blur()`。聚焦会落到行里那个真正能接焦点的控件上。

usage.en:
`MetadataList` lays out label and value pairs. `MetadataListItem` is one pair. A single column places the label beside the value. Several columns, or a numeric column count, stack the label above the value and repeat the track. `columns="multi"` uses `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))`.

`orientation="horizontal"` wraps the pairs in one row and ignores `columns`, `label`, and `maxNumOfItems`. `maxNumOfItems` hides the rest behind a show more control. `label.width` only applies when the label sits beside the value. A long label or value can break inside a word so a narrow container is not pushed wider. Extra attributes on `MetadataListItem` land on the `dt` when the label sits beside the value, and on the wrapper around the pair when the label is stacked above it.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MetadataList, MetadataListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/MetadataList'
</script>

<template>
  <MetadataList>
    <MetadataListItem label="Name">
      MetadataList
    </MetadataListItem>
    <MetadataListItem label="Status">
      Active
    </MetadataListItem>
  </MetadataList>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`MetadataList` 排列一组标签和值。`MetadataListItem` 是其中一对。单列时标签在值旁边。多列或数字列数时，标签叠在值上面，轨道按列数重复。`columns="multi"` 使用 `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))`。

`orientation="horizontal"` 把每一对排成可换行的一行，并忽略 `columns`、`label` 和 `maxNumOfItems`。`maxNumOfItems` 把多出来的项收进「显示更多」。`label.width` 只在标签位于值旁边时生效。长标签和长值会在单词内部断开，避免把窄容器撑开。写在 `MetadataListItem` 上的其余属性，并排时落在 `dt` 上，标签叠在值上面时落在包住这一对的那一层上。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MetadataList, MetadataListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/MetadataList'
</script>

<template>
  <MetadataList>
    <MetadataListItem label="名称">
      MetadataList
    </MetadataListItem>
    <MetadataListItem label="状态">
      使用中
    </MetadataListItem>
  </MetadataList>
</template>
```

en.text: Keep labels short. The value is the thing a person came to read.
Use one column for a narrow details pane, and `multi` when the pane is wide enough for several pairs.
Set `maxNumOfItems` when a record has more fields than the page should show at once.
Put a long sentence in a label. The label track is sized for a short name.
Combine `orientation="horizontal"` with a column count and expect the count to apply. Horizontal layout ignores it.

en.heading: Theming
en.text: `packages/core/styles/metadata-list.css` reads semantic tokens. Labels use the body size at medium weight and the secondary text color. Values use the primary text color. Side-by-side pairs have an 8px row gap and a 16px column gap, and the value row is at least 24px tall. Stacked pairs use a 2px gap. The title has 12px of space below it. The show more control uses the accent color.

summary.en: A single labeled metadata value within an `MetadataList`.

usage.en:
A single labeled metadata value within an `MetadataList`.

```ts
import { MetadataListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/MetadataList'
```

One label and one value inside a [Metadata List](/en/components/metadata-list). The label goes in the `label` prop and the value in the default slot, so the value can be anything: plain text, a badge, a link, or your own markup. The list decides whether the pair sits side by side or stacked, and whether a label track has a fixed width; the item follows.

`label` is required, because it is the only thing that says what the value means.
usage.zh:
元数据列表里的一对「名字 + 值」。

```ts
import { MetadataListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/MetadataList'
```

它是 [元数据列表](/components/metadata-list) 里的一项。名字写 `label`，值写在默认插槽里，所以值可以随便放：纯文字、徽章、链接，或者你自己的一段结构。名字放旁边还是放上面、名字那一栏要不要固定宽度，都由外面的列表决定，这一项只负责跟着走。

`label` 是必填的，因为只有它说明这个值是什么意思。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: `label`

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 这一项的名字，必填。值写在默认插槽里。

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- default: the value. Any content works: a string, a badge, a link, or markup of your own.
- `icon`: a leading icon drawn before the label.

The pair renders as a `<dt>` and a `<dd>`, or as one stacked block when the list puts labels above values. Either way the label is announced before the value.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - 默认插槽：这一项的值。放什么都行：文字、徽章、链接，或者自己写的一段结构。 - `icon`：名字前面的图标。 名字和值会渲染成 <dt> 和 <dd>；列表把名字放到上面时，会变成一个上下叠的小块。两种情况下读屏都是先念名字再念值。

usage.en:
`OverflowList` decides how many items fit in the container and moves the rest into a More menu. It collapses from the end by default. `collapseFrom="start"` collapses from the start. `visibleCount` skips measurement and is what tests use.

Each item is `{ label, href?, iconClass? }`. Customize a row with the `item` slot and the overflow menu with the `overflow` slot.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { OverflowList } from '@astryx-vue/core/OverflowList'

const items = [
  { href: '/home', label: 'Home' },
  { href: '/files', label: 'Files' },
  { href: '/settings', label: 'Settings' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverflowList :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`OverflowList` 按容器宽度决定能放下几项，剩下的收进「更多」菜单。默认从末尾收起，`collapseFrom="start"` 时从开头收起。`visibleCount` 可以直接指定可见项数，跳过测量，测试时用得上。

每一项是 `{ label, href?, iconClass? }`。自定义外观用 `item` 插槽，自定义溢出菜单用 `overflow` 插槽。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { OverflowList } from '@astryx-vue/core/OverflowList'

const items = [
  { href: '/home', label: '首页' },
  { href: '/files', label: '文件' },
  { href: '/settings', label: '设置' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverflowList :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Let the list take its width from the parent. Extra items move into the menu on their own.

需要至少留下几项时设置 `minVisibleItems`。
不要同时用插槽把同一项再画一遍到菜单外面。可见项和溢出项是切开的两段。

summary.en: `Table` renders from `data` and `columns`. Each column has a `key`, a `header`, and an optional `width` from `proportional()` or `pixel()`. A cell shows `row[key]` unless `renderCell` returns something else. `idKey` identifies a row. The default is `id`.
summary.zh: `Table`（数据表格）用来以行和列的方式整整齐齐地展示结构化数据。只要传入行数据 `data` 和列配置 `columns` 就能快速渲染出表格。每一列都要有唯一标识 `key`、表头文字 `header`，也可以用 `proportional()` 或 `pixel()` 来分配宽度。单元格默认直接显示数据字段的值，需要自定义内容时可以通过 `renderCell` 渲染徽标、链接或按钮。`idKey` 用来区分每一行的唯一身份，默认取数据里的 `id`。

usage.en:
`Table` renders from `data` and `columns`. Each column has a `key`, a `header`, and an optional `width` from `proportional()` or `pixel()`. A cell shows `row[key]` unless `renderCell` returns something else. `idKey` identifies a row. The default is `id`.

Behavior is added with plugins, composed in the `plugins` object:

- `useTableSortable` cycles a header through ascending, descending, and unsorted. Shift-click adds a column when `isMultiSortEnabled` is set. `useTableSortableState` holds the sort and returns the sorted rows.
- `useTableSelection` adds a checkbox column and highlights selected rows. `useTableSelectionState` holds the selected ids. Pass its `selectionState` to `TableSelectionToolbar` to run bulk actions on the selection; the bar stays hidden until something is selected. Set `hasRowHighlight` to `false` when the row background already means something else. Checked rows stay `aria-selected`.
- `useTablePagination` renders a pager under the table. Slice the rows with `paginateData` before passing `data`.
- `useTableColumnSettings` shows only the active column keys, and keeps `isAlwaysVisible` columns on.
- `useTableColumnResize` lets a header edge be dragged. The smallest width is 60px.
- `useTableFiltering` puts a string or enum filter on any column whose `filter` names a field. `applyTableFilters` returns the matching rows. String fields match a substring. Enum fields match exactly. This filtering stays separate from Power Search.
- `useTableGroupedRows` turns the rows you already filtered, sorted, and sliced into sections. Pass its data, plugin, and row identity back to the table together. A collapsed section keeps its header. Replace the collapsed set instead of mutating it.
- `useTableTreeState` decides which nodes are open. `useTableTreeData` draws the indent and the buttons. Child rows reuse the parent columns. The header button expands or collapses every branch, and a cycle is skipped.
- `useTableRowExpansion` places a detail panel under a row. The same action is on the row’s context menu. `hasRowClickExpansion` also toggles from a click on the row, and leaves buttons, links, editable text, and an existing text selection alone. The panel lines up with the first column and is not counted as a striped row. Use the tree plugins when the children should reuse the columns.
- `useTableStickyColumns` pins the contiguous run from the first column through a listed key, or from a listed key through the last column. The shadow appears only while the table overflows. An empty config pins nothing.
- `useTableRowStatus` puts a success, warning, or error mark at the start of a row. A custom color can be a named color or a plain dot.
- `useTableRowIndex` numbers real rows. Group headers do not take a number.

A column with no width stays at least 60px wide. A `style.minWidth` smaller than the sum of those floors is raised so the columns stay readable; a larger value is kept. A table that fits does not trap the scroll chain. Horizontal overscroll is contained only while the table actually overflows.

`density` is `compact`, `balanced`, or `spacious`. `dividers` is `rows`, `columns`, `grid`, or `none`. `isStriped` and `hasHover` are independent. An empty `data` array renders the localized empty message, or the `empty` slot.

Without `data`, the table is composed from `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHeaderCell`, and `TableCell`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { proportional, Table } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com' },
]
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Table :data="rows" :columns="columns" has-hover />
</template>
```

Pass the column filter state through a getter so the table reads the latest value:

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
}))
```

`rowCount` and `rowIndexStart` report where the visible window sits in the full result. Setting either one numbers the data rows. When only the start is set, the total count is unknown. Group headers and detail panels are not numbered.
usage.zh:
`Table`（数据表格）用来以行和列的方式整整齐齐地展示结构化数据。只要传入行数据 `data` 和列配置 `columns` 就能快速渲染出表格。每一列都要有唯一标识 `key`、表头文字 `header`，也可以用 `proportional()` 或 `pixel()` 来分配宽度。单元格默认直接显示数据字段的值，需要自定义内容时可以通过 `renderCell` 渲染徽标、链接或按钮。`idKey` 用来区分每一行的唯一身份，默认取数据里的 `id`。

**什么时候用：**
- 需要对比多条结构相似的数据（例如订单列表、用户清单、财务账目），或者需要对数据进行排序、筛选、分页和多选时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 数据结构不规则，或者更适合用卡片呈现视觉封面时，请改用网格或卡片列表。
- 在屏幕极窄的手机端，普通大表格容易被挤压，可以考虑使用精简列表或折叠详情面板。

常用的高级功能可以通过配套的函数插件（`plugins`）按需开启：

- `useTableSortable`：让用户点击表头在升序、降序和恢复默认之间切换。开启 `isMultiSortEnabled` 后，按住 Shift 键再点表头可以同时按多个列排序。搭配 `useTableSortableState` 保存排序规则并返回排好序的数据。
- `useTableSelection`：在每行最左侧添加复选框，点击可以选中或高亮当前行。搭配 `useTableSelectionState` 保存选中的行 ID。选中之后把返回的 `selectionState` 交给 `TableSelectionToolbar`，就可以对选中项做批量操作；一个都没选中时这条不出现。周围已经用行底色表示别的含义时，把 `hasRowHighlight` 设为 `false`，选中行不再铺底色，读屏仍能读到已选中。
- `useTablePagination`：在表格底部添加分页器。在传给表格前，用 `paginateData` 把总数据切出当前页的内容。
- `useTableColumnSettings`：让用户自己勾选显示或隐藏哪些列，带有 `isAlwaysVisible` 的列会固定保留。
- `useTableColumnResize`：允许用户拖动表头边缘自由调整列宽，最小宽度为 60px。
- `useTableFiltering`：为指定列开启文字模糊搜索或选项精确匹配。搭配 `applyTableFilters` 过滤出符合条件的行。
- `useTableGroupedRows`：把已经排好序的数据按某个分类整理成分组折叠行。
- `useTableTreeState` 与 `useTableTreeData`：支持像文件夹树一样展开或折叠带有层级关系的子行。
- `useTableRowExpansion`：允许点击行首箭头在某一行下方展开一整块详情面板。打开 `hasRowClickExpansion` 后点整行也能展开；点到按钮、链接、可编辑文字或已经选中的文字时不会切换。详情和第一列对齐，不把面板算进斑马纹。
- `useTableStickyColumns`：当表格很宽需要横向滚动时，把左侧或右侧的指定列钉住固定不动。
- `useTableRowStatus`：在行首显示成功、警告或错误等状态标记圆点，鼠标悬停时还可以看到文字解释。
- `useTableRowIndex`：自动为真正的数据行生成连续的序号。

没写宽度的列至少留 60px。写在表格上的 `style.minWidth` 如果比各列下限的总和还小，表格会抬到这个下限，避免列被压到读不清；写得更大时保留你给的值。表格放得下时，滚轮继续交给外面的页面；横向溢出之后才拦住回弹。

表格的显示风格也很灵活：`density` 可以调节行高间距（紧凑 `compact`、适中 `balanced` 或宽松 `spacious`）；`dividers` 控制网格线的样式（仅行线 `rows`、仅列线 `columns`、全网格 `grid` 或无边框 `none`）；`isStriped` 开启隔行换色的斑马纹，`hasHover` 开启鼠标悬停高亮。当 `data` 为空时，表格会自动显示贴心的缺省提示，也可以通过 `empty` 插槽换成自己的图文。

如果不需要配置式的驱动，也可以直接使用 `TableHeader`、`TableBody`、`TableFooter`、`TableRow`、`TableHeaderCell` 和 `TableCell` 这些原子组件像写普通 HTML 表格一样自由拼接。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { proportional, Table } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com' },
]
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Table :data="rows" :columns="columns" has-hover />
</template>
```

如果开启了列过滤，状态要用函数（getter）的形式传进去，表格才能敏锐察觉到过滤词的变化：

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
}))
```

`rowCount` 和 `rowIndexStart` 用来告诉读屏软件当前这一页数据在全表里的位置。两者只要填了一个，读屏就能准确播报当前行号。分组的表头和展开的详情面板不会占用行号。

en.text: Give every row a stable `idKey`. Selection and row identity depend on it.
Use `pixel()` for short numeric columns and `proportional()` for text that should share the remaining width.
Keep sort, selection, and filter state outside the table and pass the derived rows in `data`.
Sort or paginate inside `renderCell`. The cell only paints the row it is given.
Turn on every plugin in one table. A dense grid rarely also needs filters, resize, and selection at once.

rows.name: `data`
rows.description: Rows. When omitted, the default slot composes the table by hand.

rows.name: `columns`
rows.description: `key`, `header`, `width`, `align`, `verticalAlign`, `sortable`, `filter`, and `renderCell`.

rows.name: `idKey`
rows.description: Row identity. Grouped rows need a function so the synthetic headers stay stable.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Cell padding. Compact is 4×8, balanced is 8×12, spacious is 12×16.

rows.name: `dividers`
rows.description: The header always keeps its bottom border. The last body row does not draw a row rule.

rows.name: `isStriped`
rows.description: Even body rows use the muted background.

rows.name: `hasHover`
rows.description: Hover fill, only when the pointer can hover.

rows.name: `verticalAlign`
rows.description: Default vertical alignment. A column can override it.

rows.name: `textOverflow`
rows.description: Whether cell text wraps or clips to one line.

rows.name: `plugins`
rows.description: Sort, selection, pagination, column settings, resize, filtering, groups, trees, expansion, sticky columns, row status, and row numbers.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the table.

rows.name: `rowIndexStart`
rows.description: Where the first visible data row sits in the full result. Setting this or the total count numbers the data rows.

rows.name: `rowCount`
rows.description: How many rows the full result has. With only a start index, the total is unknown.

rows.name: `data`
rows.description: Rows after filtering, sorting, and paging.

rows.name: `groupBy`
rows.description: Which section a row belongs to.

rows.name: `collapsedGroups`
rows.description: Sections that are collapsed. Replace the set when it changes.

rows.name: `onToggleGroup`
rows.description: Called from the header or its chevron.

rows.name: `renderGroupHeader`
rows.description: Content to the right of the chevron.

rows.name: `getRowKey`
rows.description: Stable identity for a real row.

rows.name: `groupOrder`
rows.description: Keys listed here come first.

rows.name: `data`
rows.description: Nested rows.

rows.name: `idKey`
rows.description: Node identity. It remembers expansion and skips a cycle.

rows.name: `childrenKey`
rows.description: Field that holds child rows.

rows.name: `expandedIds`
rows.description: Controlled expansion. Omit it and the state stays inside the composable.

rows.name: `defaultExpandedIds`
rows.description: Nodes open on the first render.

rows.name: `onExpandedIdsChange`
rows.description: Called when the open set changes.

rows.name: `hasExpandAllControl`
rows.description: Puts an expand-all button on the tree column header.

rows.name: `hasRowClickExpansion`
rows.description: A row click toggles a node that has children. Clicks on controls or a text selection do not.

en.heading: useTableRowStatus
en.text: `getStatus` returns null for an empty cell. A semantic status draws the success, warning, or error icon. A custom status takes a color: an icon when one is given, otherwise a dot. The label is in the tooltip and in the accessible name.

en.heading: useTableRowIndex
en.text:
`data` is the rows the table is painting, after grouping. `startFrom` begins at 1. `getRowKey` recognizes the same row; without it, identity is the object itself. `label` is the column header, and the default is a hash mark.

`proportional(value)` shares leftover width. Its default minimum is 120px. A column with no width is flexible with a 60px floor. `pixel(value)` sets both width and minimum width.

en.heading: TableSelectionToolbar
en.text: `count` is the number of selected rows. The `clear` event asks the caller to drop the selection. The default slot is the bulk actions. The count, the clear label, and the region name come from the table messages.

en.heading: Theming
en.text: Header text uses the label size, semibold weight, and the secondary text color. Body text uses the body size. A selected row uses the accent muted fill. Stripes use the muted background. Hover uses the hover overlay. Inside a card, the scroll area uses the card’s container padding so the first and last cells line up with the heading.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 推荐
- 推荐: 推荐
- 推荐: 推荐
- 避免: 避免
- 避免: 避免

zh.heading: useTableRowStatus
zh.text: `getStatus` 返回 `null` 时这一格是空的。语义状态用成功、警告或错误图标。自定义状态给一个颜色；有图标就画图标，没有就画一个圆点。说明会进提示，也会读给辅助技术。

zh.heading: useTableRowIndex
zh.text:
`data` 是表格正在画的行，分组之后的那一份。`startFrom` 默认从 1 开始。`getRowKey` 用来认出同一行；不传就按对象本身比较。`label` 是这一列表头，默认是一个井号。

`proportional(value)` 分剩余宽度，默认最小 120px。没写宽度的列是弹性列，下限 60px。`pixel(value)` 同时设定宽度和最小宽度。

zh.heading: TableSelectionToolbar
zh.text: `count` 是选中的行数。`clear` 事件让调用方清掉选择。默认插槽放批量操作。数量、清除文案和区域名称来自表格的文案。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text: 表头用标签字号、半粗字重和次要文字色。表体用正文字号。选中行用强调色的淡底。斑马纹用淡底。悬停用悬停遮罩。放进卡片时，滚动区域会用卡片公布的容器内边距，让首尾单元格和标题对齐。
