examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ColumnSettingsOption, TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { MultiSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/MultiSelector'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { proportional, Table, useTableColumnSettings, useTableColumnSettingsState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Toolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toolbar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
  department: string
  status: string
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Platform', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'Designer', department: 'Product', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Charlie Brown', email: 'charlie@example.com', role: 'Manager', department: 'Platform', status: 'Away' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diana Prince', email: 'diana@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Infra', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Eve Davis', email: 'eve@example.com', role: 'Admin', department: 'Operations', status: 'Inactive' },
]

const allColumns: TableColumn<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'department', header: 'Department', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', width: proportional(1) },
]

const columnOptions: ColumnSettingsOption<string>[] = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', isAlwaysVisible: true },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email' },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role' },
  { key: 'department', label: 'Department' },
  { key: 'status', label: 'Status' },
]

const activeKeys = ref(columnOptions.map(column => column.key))
const state = useTableColumnSettingsState<string>({
  columns: columnOptions,
  activeColumnKeys: activeKeys,
  onChangeActiveColumnKeys(keys) {
    activeKeys.value = [...keys]
  },
})
const plugin = useTableColumnSettings<User>(state.columnSettingsConfig)
const selectorOptions = columnOptions.map(column => ({
  value: column.key,
  label: column.label,
  disabled: column.isAlwaysVisible === true,
}))

function onColumnsChange(keys: (string | number)[]) {
  state.setActiveColumnKeys(keys.map(String))
}
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3" width="100%">
    <Toolbar label="Table actions">
      <template #start>
        <Text type="label">
          Team
        </Text>
      </template>
      <template #end>
        <MultiSelector
          label="Columns"
          label-hidden
          :options="selectorOptions"
          :model-value="[...state.activeColumnKeys]"
          @update:model-value="onColumnsChange"
        />
      </template>
    </Toolbar>
    <Table
      :data="users"
      :columns="allColumns"
      id-key="id"
      has-hover
      :plugins="{ columnSettings: plugin }"
    />
  </Stack>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
}

const names = [
  'Alice Johnson',
  'Bob Smith',
  'Charlie Brown',
  'Diana Prince',
  'Eve Davis',
  'Frank Miller',
  'Grace Lee',
  'Hank Wilson',
  'Ivy Chen',
  'Jack Turner',
  'Karen White',
  'Leo Garcia',
  'Mia Thompson',
  'Noah Martinez',
  'Olivia Clark',
  'Paul Harris',
  'Quinn Walker',
  'Rachel Adams',
  'Sam Robinson',
  'Tina Scott',
]
const roles = ['Engineer', 'Designer', 'Manager', 'Admin', 'Analyst']
const users: User[] = names.map((name, index) => ({
  id: String(index + 1),
  name,
  email: `${name.split(' ')[0]!.toLowerCase()}@example.com`,
  role: roles[index % roles.length]!,
}))

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableGroupedRows, useTableRowIndex } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface Employee extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  role: string
}

const employees: Employee[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diego', role: 'Designer' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Employee>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: pixel(140) },
]

const collapsed = ref(new Set<string>())

function toggleGroup(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(collapsed.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  collapsed.value = next
}

const { data: groupedRows, plugin: groupedPlugin, idKey } = useTableGroupedRows<Employee>(() => ({
  data: employees,
  groupBy: employee => employee.role,
  collapsedGroups: collapsed.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
  groupOrder: ['Designer', 'Engineer'],
}))

const numbers = useTableRowIndex<Employee>(() => ({
  data: groupedRows.value,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="groupedRows"
    :columns="columns"
    :id-key="idKey"
    :plugins="{ grouped: groupedPlugin, numbers }"
  />
</template>

  { id: '2', name: 'Inventory', detail: 'Low stock', state: 'warning' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Mail', detail: 'Bounced', state: 'error' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Notes', detail: 'No signal', state: 'neutral' },
]

  { key: 'detail', header: 'Detail', width: proportional(1) },

en.name: Table
en.description: Semantic table element that groups the table sections, rows, and cells.

en.name: Scroll region
en.description: Outer region that scrolls horizontally, enters the keyboard order, and contains overscroll only while the columns overflow.

en.name: Header section
en.description: Column-heading section generated when data-driven columns are present, or supplied with TableHeader when composing the table from slots.

en.name: Column header cell
en.description: Cell that identifies one column and may contain sorting or bulk-selection controls.

en.name: Sort control
en.description: Button that wraps a sortable column label and changes that column's sort direction.

en.name: Sort indicator glyph
en.description: Directional symbol rendered by Icon inside a Sort control.

en.name: Sort priority
en.description: Number shown for a sorted column when multi-column sorting is active.

en.name: Selection control
en.description: CheckboxInput rendered in the header and selectable body rows by the selection plugin.

en.name: Body section
en.description: Section containing data rows or the current empty state; data-driven mode renders it automatically.

en.name: Row
en.description: Repeated TableRow that groups cells in a standard header, body, or footer row.

en.name: Cell
en.description: TableCell containing one value or caller-provided content in a standard body or footer row.

en.name: Default empty state
en.description: Compact EmptyState shown for an empty data array unless it is replaced or disabled.

en.name: Expansion control
en.description: Button in a leading cell that expands or collapses one expandable row.

en.name: Expansion glyph
en.description: Directional symbol rendered by Icon inside an Expansion control.

en.name: Expanded detail panel
en.description: Detail row and spanning cell rendered below an expanded row around caller-provided content.

en.name: Footer section
en.description: Optional summary or totals section supplied with TableFooter when composing the table from slots.

summary.en: `TableBody` is the `<tbody>` wrapper for children mode. It holds the data rows. A row must sit inside a section: `<table>` cannot contain a `<tr>` directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied `<tbody>` when it parses server-rendered markup and the client render does not, so rows written straight into `Table` mismatch on hydration. The data-driven `data={...}` mode renders this element itself; in children mode it is yours to supply.
summary.zh: `TableBody` 就是 children 模式里的 `<tbody>` 包装，数据行都放在它里面。行必须待在一个 section 里：`<table>` 不能直接套 `<tr>`，因为浏览器解析服务端渲染出来的 HTML 时会自动补一个隐含的 `<tbody>`，客户端渲染时却不会补，两边结构对不上，水合（hydration）就会报错。所以直接写进 `Table` 的行会出问题。用 `data={...}` 那套数据驱动模式时，这个元素由表格自己渲染；children 模式下就得你自己写。

usage.en:
`TableBody` is the `<tbody>` wrapper for children mode. It holds the data rows. A row must sit inside a section: `<table>` cannot contain a `<tr>` directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied `<tbody>` when it parses server-rendered markup and the client render does not, so rows written straight into `Table` mismatch on hydration. The data-driven `data={...}` mode renders this element itself; in children mode it is yours to supply.

```ts
import { TableBody } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

summary.en: `<tfoot>` wrapper for children mode. Holds summary or total rows beneath the body. A row must sit inside a section: `<table>` cannot contain a `<tr>` directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied `<tbody>` when it parses server-rendered markup and Vue does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. summary.en: `TableSelectionToolbar` is the bulk-action bar for a table with row selection. `useTableSelectionState` returns two pieces that go to matching consumers: `selectionConfig` to `useTableSelection`, `selectionState` to this bar. usage.en:
`TableSelectionToolbar` is the bulk-action bar for a table with row selection. `useTableSelectionState` returns two pieces that go to matching consumers: `selectionConfig` to `useTableSelection`, `selectionState` to this bar. The bar reads the count from that state and clears every selected key, so it stays in step with the row checkboxes. Passing a plain `count` and handling `clear` yourself still works.

Product actions go in the `start` slot and the bar owns the count text and the clear command on the trailing side. The bar owns no table or sticky layout: place it in flow above the table, or pin it yourself with `class` or `style`.

```ts
import { TableSelectionToolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>` with `role="toolbar"` and `aria-orientation="horizontal"`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

Three strings come from the locale messages: the accessible name (`Bulk actions`), the count text (`{count} selected`), and the clear label (`Unselect All`). They switch to Chinese after `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`, and `label`, `clearLabel`, and the `label` slot replace them one by one.

When `selection` is passed and nothing is selected, the bar renders nothing at all. The `count` form always renders, so a bar mounted for a fixed count keeps its place.

Two React-only props are not in the Vue API: `xstyle` becomes `class` or `style`, and the whole toolbar is placed by the surrounding layout. `renderSelectionLabel` and `startContent` become the `label` and `start` slots.

summary.en: `TreeList` is a data-driven tree. Each item has an `id` and a `label`. `children` nests the next level. `isExpanded` is the starting state. A click on a branch toggles it. A leaf with `href` is a link. A leaf with `onClick` is a button.
summary.zh: `TreeList` 用数据画出一棵树。每一项有 `id` 和 `label`。`children` 是下一层。`isExpanded` 是初始展开状态。点分支会切换展开。带 `href` 的叶子是链接。带 `onClick` 的叶子是按钮。

usage.en:
`TreeList` is a data-driven tree. Each item has an `id` and a `label`. `children` nests the next level. `isExpanded` is the starting state. A click on a branch toggles it. A leaf with `href` is a link. A leaf with `onClick` is a button.

`variant="lineGuides"` draws the connectors. `noGuides` keeps the indent and drops the lines. `density` changes the row padding: compact 4px, balanced 8px, spacious 12px.

`icon` and `endIcon` are either an `Icon` glyph name or a CSS icon class that starts with `i-`. `badge` is a short trailing count. The `start` and `end` slots can replace those strings when the content is richer than an icon.

Keyboard behavior follows the tree pattern: up and down move, left and right collapse and expand (they swap in right-to-left layouts), Home and End jump, Enter and Space activate, and typing focuses a matching label.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TreeList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'

const items = [
  {
    id: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    isExpanded: true,
    children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx', onClick: () => {} }],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <TreeList :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TreeList` 用数据画出一棵树。每一项有 `id` 和 `label`。`children` 是下一层。`isExpanded` 是初始展开状态。点分支会切换展开。带 `href` 的叶子是链接。带 `onClick` 的叶子是按钮。

`variant="lineGuides"` 画连接线。`noGuides` 只保留缩进。`density` 改变行的上下内边距：紧凑 4px，适中 8px，宽松 12px。

`icon` 和 `endIcon` 可以是 `Icon` 的字形名，也可以是以 `i-` 开头的 CSS 图标类。`badge` 是末尾的短计数。内容比图标复杂时，用 `start` 和 `end` 插槽替换这两处字符串。

键盘遵循树的常见习惯：上下移动，左右展开和折叠（从右到左的布局里左右对调），Home 和 End 跳到两端，Enter 和空格激活，继续打字会跳到匹配的标签。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TreeList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'

const items = [
  {
    id: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    isExpanded: true,
    children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx', onClick: () => {} }],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <TreeList :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Give every item a stable `id`. Focus and expansion are tracked by it.
Use `lineGuides` when the nesting is deep enough that indent alone is hard to follow.
Put counts in `badge` and a trailing affordance in `endIcon`, instead of appending them to the label.
Mix links and buttons in one row. A row is one action.
Expand every branch by default in a large tree. Start from the path the reader is on.

en.heading: TreeListItemData
en.text: The start and end slots receive { item } and replace icon and endIcon. A row's accessible name is its label. The description is exposed with aria-describedby, so the chevron and icons stay out of the name. Typeahead matches the label only. A visible header names the tree and wins over a passed aria-label. A keydown listener on the root that calls preventDefault keeps arrow keys from moving focus inside the tree.

en.heading: Theming
en.text: Indent is --astryx-spacing-4. Row content uses --astryx-spacing-2 of inline padding and the same gap. The guide is a 1px emphasized border. Focus uses the shared focus outline tokens. A selected row uses the accent muted fill.

zh.text: start 和 end 插槽收到 { item }，用来替换 icon 和 endIcon。 读屏时一行的名字只有标题。说明通过 aria-describedby 单独读出，展开按钮和图标不进名字。敲字符跳转也只匹配标题。有可见 header 时，树的名字用这个标题，不用外面传来的 aria-label。在根上监听按键并 preventDefault 之后，方向键不再移动树里的焦点。

summary.en: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.
summary.zh: 把整个应用包起来，告诉里面的组件现在用哪种语言，顺便可以塞进更多翻译目录，或者针对某种语言改几个词。子树里的组件都按这份设置取文案。没有这个 provider 时，组件就用内置的英文。

usage.en:
Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.

```ts
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'
```

`messages` and `overrides` are both a map from a BCP 47 tag to a catalog keyed by the original `@astryx.*` message keys, so the same JSON shape works for a whole language and for a handful of keys. The two layers merge per key: a catalog replaces the shipped text for that locale, and the sparse overrides are laid on top. Overrides are keyed by locale, so a runtime locale swap picks up the right set.

`dir` only sets the direction Astryx reads. It does not touch the DOM `dir` attribute: set that on `<html>` or a wrapping element yourself, and pass the same value to both. `getLocaleDirection(locale)` derives the value from a tag.

Nesting works: the inner provider wins for its subtree.
usage.zh:
把整个应用包起来，告诉里面的组件现在用哪种语言，顺便可以塞进更多翻译目录，或者针对某种语言改几个词。子树里的组件都按这份设置取文案。没有这个 provider 时，组件就用内置的英文。

```ts
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'
```

`messages` 和 `overrides` 都是「语言标签 → 目录」的映射，目录里的键就是原版那套 `@astryx.*`。也就是说，整门语言的 JSON 和只想改几个键的小对象是同一个写法。两层按同一个键合并：`messages` 里的目录替换这门语言的内置文案，`overrides` 再稀疏地盖在上面。覆盖是按语言存的，所以运行时换语言会自动用上对的那一份。

`dir` 只决定 Astryx 组件读到的书写方向，不会去动 DOM 的 `dir` 属性。要自己给 `<html>` 或者外层元素设上 `dir`，并且两边写一样的值。`getLocaleDirection(locale)` 可以按语言标签算出这个值。

可以嵌套：内层的 provider 管住自己那一段子树。

en.text: Give `messages` a whole-language catalog for your target locale, in the same shape as the Astryx locale JSON.
Use a same-shape local catalog only when Astryx has not shipped that locale yet or you are testing in-progress translations.
Use real BCP 47 tags such as `fr-FR`, `pt-BR`, or `ar-SA`; regional locales fall back to their base language before English.
Set the `dir` attribute on `` (or a wrapping element) yourself; the provider does not set it. Use `getLocaleDirection(locale)` to derive the value for both the provider and the DOM.
Cast custom catalog maps to `any`; `ProviderMessagesByLocale` and `ProviderOverrides` type a local catalog.

summary.en: Layer utilities provide the app-level provider used by overlay systems. Use `LayerProvider` at the app root for toast/layer configuration; use higher-level `Popover`, `HoverCard`, or `Tooltip` APIs for most overlay UI. Rendered layer content, not the provider's application subtree, uses theme body text defaults and exits ancestor surface/group membership. Establish intentional groups and complete required providers inside each layer. Every anchored layer keeps a gutter from each viewport edge — the spacing-4 step or the device safe-area inset, whichever is larger — and is capped to the viewport, never to the room beside its trigger. An app that floats a persistent bar over a viewport edge declares it once as `inset` on `LayerProvider` (`blockStart`, `blockEnd`, `inlineStart`, `inlineEnd`); each edge adds to that edge's gutter for every anchored layer and moves the toast viewport by the same amount, and defaults to zero. The inset is app configuration, not a theme value.
summary.zh: 浮层这一套东西有一个应用级的 provider。要配 toast 或者整个应用的浮层参数，就在应用最外层放一个 `LayerProvider`；一般的浮层界面直接用 `Popover`、`HoverCard`、`Tooltip` 这些更上层的组件就行。浮层内容渲染出来之后，用的是主题里正文的默认文字样式，也不再继承外面那层 surface/group 的成员关系，所以每个浮层里该有的分组和必需的 provider 都要自己补上。每个贴着触发器定位的浮层，离视口四条边都留着一段空隙：间距第 4 档和设备安全区取较大的那个；它只受视口限制，不会被触发器旁边的空间限制。

usage.en:
Layer utilities provide the app-level provider used by overlay systems. Use `LayerProvider` at the app root for toast/layer configuration; use higher-level `Popover`, `HoverCard`, or `Tooltip` APIs for most overlay UI. Rendered layer content, not the provider's application subtree, uses theme body text defaults and exits ancestor surface/group membership. Establish intentional groups and complete required providers inside each layer. Every anchored layer keeps a gutter from each viewport edge — the spacing-4 step or the device safe-area inset, whichever is larger — and is capped to the viewport, never to the room beside its trigger. An app that floats a persistent bar over a viewport edge declares it once as `inset` on `LayerProvider` (`blockStart`, `blockEnd`, `inlineStart`, `inlineEnd`); each edge adds to that edge's gutter for every anchored layer and moves the toast viewport by the same amount, and defaults to zero. The inset is app configuration, not a theme value.

```ts
import { LayerProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/LayerProvider'
```

`toast` takes `position` (the toast viewport corner), `maxVisible` (how many toasts are on screen at once), and its own `inset`, which overrides the provider inset per edge for toasts only.

Nested `LayerProvider` instances never open a second toast viewport: the outer one stays in charge of toasts. One that declares its own `inset`, though, narrows that inset for the anchored layers in its subtree.
usage.zh:
浮层这一套东西有一个应用级的 provider。要配 toast 或者整个应用的浮层参数，就在应用最外层放一个 `LayerProvider`；一般的浮层界面直接用 `Popover`、`HoverCard`、`Tooltip` 这些更上层的组件就行。浮层内容渲染出来之后，用的是主题里正文的默认文字样式，也不再继承外面那层 surface/group 的成员关系，所以每个浮层里该有的分组和必需的 provider 都要自己补上。每个贴着触发器定位的浮层，离视口四条边都留着一段空隙：间距第 4 档和设备安全区取较大的那个；它只受视口限制，不会被触发器旁边的空间限制。

如果应用有一条常驻的条子浮在视口某条边上，就在 `LayerProvider` 上用 `inset` 声明一次，写明 `blockStart`、`blockEnd`、`inlineStart`、`inlineEnd`。每条边上的值会加到所有贴边浮层离那条边的空隙上，toast 视口也按同样的量挪进去。不写就是每条边都是 0。这份 inset 属于应用配置，不是主题里的值。

```ts
import { LayerProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/LayerProvider'
```

`toast` 里有三样：`position` 是 toast 视口贴哪个角，`maxVisible` 是同时最多显示几条，还有一个只对 toast 生效的 `inset`，会逐边盖掉 provider 上的同一条边。

嵌套的 `LayerProvider` 是个例外：它不会再开一套 toast 视口，但如果它自己声明了 `inset`，这份 inset 只收紧它子树里的锚定浮层，toast 视口仍然看最外层。不声明 `inset` 的内层 provider 什么也不做。

en.text: Declare a persistent bar floating over the viewport once, as `inset` on `LayerProvider`; every anchored layer and toast then stays clear of it.
Use `LayerProvider` once near the app root when you need shared toast/layer configuration.
Build on higher-level components like `Popover`, `HoverCard`, and `Tooltip` for common overlay patterns.
Add nested `LayerProvider` instances for anything but a subtree that declares its own `inset`: they add depth without a second toast viewport.

summary.en: Wraps your app to replace the default `<a>` tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Vue Router's `RouterLink`) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.
summary.zh: 把应用包一层，让所有 Astryx 组件渲染链接时不再直接用 `<a>`，而是换成框架自己的链接组件，例如 Vue Router 的 `RouterLink`，这样点击走的是前端路由，不会整页刷新。

usage.en:
Wraps your app to replace the default `<a>` tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Vue Router's `RouterLink`) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.

```ts
import { LinkProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/LinkProvider'
```

The component receives `href` and `to`, so a router link can read whichever one it expects. A single component's own `as` prop still wins over the provider. `useLinkComponent()` reads the provider from a descendant when you render a link yourself.
usage.zh:
把应用包一层，让所有 Astryx 组件渲染链接时不再直接用 `<a>`，而是换成框架自己的链接组件，例如 Vue Router 的 `RouterLink`，这样点击走的是前端路由，不会整页刷新。

```ts
import { LinkProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/LinkProvider'
```

这个组件会同时收到 `href` 和 `to`，路由链接认哪个就用哪个。单个组件自己写的 `as` 优先级更高，仍然会盖掉 provider。自己渲染链接时，可以用 `useLinkComponent()` 读到外层给的那个组件。

en.heading: Components that follow the provider
en.text:
These render their link through the provider unless they are given their own `as`:

- `Link`, `Button`, `Avatar`, `Token`
- `NavItem`, `NavMenuItem`, `NavHeadingMenuItem`, `SideNavHeading`, `TopNavItem`, `TopNavMegaMenuItem`, `TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard`
- `BreadcrumbItem`, `Tab`, `Item` (List)
- `DropdownMenuItem`, `ContextMenuItem`, `MoreMenuRow`, `TreeListItem`

Not routed through the provider: the `AppShell` skip link, `Outline` links (in-page anchors), `ClickableCard` (its overlay control is a visually hidden anchor), and links rendered from Markdown.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The component renders no element of its own, so class and style are not forwarded.

zh.heading: 会走 provider 的组件
zh.text:
下面这些组件在没写自己的 `as` 时，链接会交给 provider 里的组件：

- `Link`、`Button`、`Avatar`、`Token`
- `NavItem`、`NavMenuItem`、`NavHeadingMenuItem`、`SideNavHeading`、`TopNavItem`、`TopNavMegaMenuItem`、`TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard`
- `BreadcrumbItem`、`Tab`、`Item`（List）
- `DropdownMenuItem`、`ContextMenuItem`、`MoreMenuRow`、`TreeListItem`

不走 provider 的：`AppShell` 的跳转正文链接、`Outline` 的页内锚点、`ClickableCard`（它的可点击控件是一层视觉隐藏的 `<a>`），以及 Markdown 渲染出来的链接。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: 组件本身不渲染元素，class 和 style 不会传下去。

description.en: Routes every Astryx link through a custom component that intercepts the click, the hook frameworks like Vue Router use for client-side navigation. Click the link to see the custom handler fire instead of a full-page load.

en.text: Use to give icon-only buttons and controls an accessible name that screen readers announce.
Render as a block element (as="div") with aria-live to announce dynamic updates like drag-and-drop or result counts.
Use it to hide content from everyone; it stays in the accessibility tree; use conditional rendering or `hidden` to remove content entirely.
Put interactive controls inside it; the content is not visible and cannot receive pointer input.

用它对所有人隐藏内容。内容仍保留在无障碍树中。如需完全移除，应使用条件渲染或 hidden。
在其中放置交互控件。内容不可见，也无法接收指针输入。

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
The component exposes `element` with type `HTMLElement | null`.
`element` points to the rendered root element.

en.heading: Styling constraints
en.text:
- The component ignores incoming `class`.
- The component ignores incoming `style`.
- External styles cannot replace the fixed hiding rules.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element receives:

- `aria-*` attributes.
- `role`.
- `id`.
- `data-*` attributes.
- Native event listeners.

description.en: When the task moves to the next column, aria-live reads the new place. People who can see the label do not need that sentence.
description.zh: 任务被移到下一列时，aria-live 把新位置读出来。看见箭头的人不用听这段话。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { VisuallyHidden } from '@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden'
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const columns = ['Backlog', 'In progress', 'Done'] as const
const column = shallowRef(0)
const current = computed(() => columns[column.value])

function move(): void {
  column.value = (column.value + 1) % columns.length
}
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" h-align="start">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Drag-and-drop and other visual-only changes are silent to screen readers. A live region narrates them.
    </Text>
    <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
      <Button label="Move task" variant="secondary" @click="move" />
      <Text type="body">
        Task is in <Text as="span" weight="bold">
          {{ current }}
        </Text>
      </Text>
    </HStack>
    <VisuallyHidden as="div" aria-live="polite">
      Task moved to {{ current }}
    </VisuallyHidden>
  </VStack>
</template>

description.en: The group is obvious on screen and has no visible heading. A hidden h2 gives screen-reader users a landmark to jump to.
description.zh: 这一组在视觉上已经成块，但没有可见标题。隐藏的 h2 让屏幕阅读器能跳到这里。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { VisuallyHidden } from '@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden'

const items = [
  { name: 'astryx-core', status: 'Passing', variant: 'success' },
  { name: 'astryx-charts', status: 'Failing', variant: 'error' },
  { name: 'astryx-cli', status: 'Passing', variant: 'success' },
] as const
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="3" h-align="start">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      The layout makes this group obvious to sighted users. A hidden heading gives screen-reader users the same landmark to jump to.
    </Text>
    <VisuallyHidden as="h2">
      Build status
    </VisuallyHidden>
    <VStack :gap="2">
      <Card v-for="item in items" :key="item.name" variant="muted" :padding="3">
        <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
          <Text type="body">
            {{ item.name }}
          </Text>
          <Badge :variant="item.variant">
            {{ item.status }}
          </Badge>
        </HStack>
      </Card>
    </VStack>
  </VStack>
</template>

description.en: The arrow is decoration. Whether the number went up or down is written in VisuallyHidden for a screen reader.
description.zh: 箭头只是装饰。涨了还是跌了，写在 VisuallyHidden 里给屏幕阅读器。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { VisuallyHidden } from '@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden'

const stats = [
  { label: 'Revenue', value: '$48.2k', delta: '+12%', direction: 'up' },
  { label: 'Churn', value: '2.1%', delta: '-4%', direction: 'down' },
] as const
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="4" wrap="wrap">
    <Card v-for="item in stats" :key="item.label" variant="muted">
      <VStack :gap="1">
        <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
          {{ item.label }}
        </Text>
        <Text type="display-3">
          {{ item.value }}
        </Text>
        <HStack :gap="1" align="center">
          <span
            class="css-icon css-icon--sm"
            :class="item.direction === 'up' ? 'i-carbon-arrow-up' : 'i-carbon-arrow-down'"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <Text type="body">
            {{ item.delta }}
            <VisuallyHidden>
              {{ item.direction === 'up' ? ' increase' : ' decrease' }} from last month
            </VisuallyHidden>
          </Text>
        </HStack>
      </VStack>
    </Card>
  </HStack>
</template>

summary.en: `MediaTheme` is the provider for content on an inverted surface: an image overlay, a scrim, a toast, or a tooltip. It sets `data-astryx-media` so text, icons, and buttons use the on-dark or on-light colors. It does not paint a background. Put the surface color on the parent.
summary.zh: `MediaTheme` 是反色表面上的提供者，用在图片叠字、遮罩、toast 和 tooltip 上。它设置 `data-astryx-media`，让文字、图标和按钮改用深底或浅底上的颜色。它自己不铺背景，背景写在父元素上。

usage.en: `MediaTheme` is the provider for content on an inverted surface: an image overlay, a scrim, a toast, or a tooltip. It sets `data-astryx-media` so text, icons, and buttons use the on-dark or on-light colors. It does not paint a background. Put the surface color on the parent. `mode` is required: `dark`, `light`, `auto`, or `off`. `auto` measures the color the parent actually paints, translucent layers included, and picks the side whose text color, the theme's `--color-on-dark` or `--color-on-light`, reads better on it. It picks `off` when the surrounding text already clears 3:1. A background image cannot be measured from CSS. The measurement runs again when the surface changes. `fallback` is the side used before that measurement, and when the surface cannot be measured. The default is `dark`. `off` keeps the element and drops the media attribute, so children are not remounted. `useMediaTheme()` returns that resolved mode. Import both from `@astryx-vue/core/Theme`. ```vue ``` A theme can add tokens for these surfaces with `onDark` and `onLight` on `defineTheme()`.
usage.zh: `MediaTheme` 是反色表面上的提供者，用在图片叠字、遮罩、toast 和 tooltip 上。它设置 `data-astryx-media`，让文字、图标和按钮改用深底或浅底上的颜色。它自己不铺背景，背景写在父元素上。 `mode` 必填：`dark`、`light`、`auto` 或 `off`。`auto` 测量父元素实际画出来的颜色（半透明的几层会叠在一起算），再看主题自己的 `--color-on-dark` 和 `--color-on-light` 哪个在上面更清楚，就选哪一边；周围文字对比已经达到 3:1 时选 `off`。背景图片没法从 CSS 量出来。表面颜色变了会重新测量。`fallback` 是还没量到、或量不到时用的一边，默认 `dark`。`off` 仍渲染这个元素，只是去掉媒体属性，子节点不会被拆掉重建。 `useMediaTheme()` 返回解析后的模式。两者都从 `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` 引入。 ```vue ``` 主题可以用 `defineTheme()` 的 `onDark` 和 `onLight` 给这些表面加 token。

en.text: Use it for content over a dark image, a scrim, or another inverted surface.
Prefer `mode="auto"` when the surface color comes from a theme token.
Set the background on the parent. MediaTheme only flips the token context.
Use it for page-wide dark mode. Use `Theme` with `mode="dark"` or `mode="system"`.

zh.text: 用在深色图片、遮罩，或其他需要反色的表面上。
表面颜色来自主题 token 时，优先用 `mode="auto"`。
背景写在父元素上。MediaTheme 只翻转 token。
用它做整页深色模式。整页用 `Theme` 的 `mode="dark"` 或 `mode="system"`。

summary.en: `SyntaxTheme` is the provider for code colors. It sets `--astryx-code-syntax-*` and `--astryx-code-block-background` for every `CodeBlock` inside it. `useSyntaxTheme()` reads the nearest syntax theme, including one set with `defineTheme({ syntax })`.
summary.zh: `SyntaxTheme` 是代码颜色的提供者。它给里面的每个 `CodeBlock` 写上 `--astryx-code-syntax-*` 和 `--astryx-code-block-background`。`useSyntaxTheme()` 读取最近的语法主题，也包括 `defineTheme({ syntax })` 带上的那份。

usage.en:
`SyntaxTheme` is the provider for code colors. It sets `--astryx-code-syntax-*` and `--astryx-code-block-background` for every `CodeBlock` inside it. `useSyntaxTheme()` reads the nearest syntax theme, including one set with `defineTheme({ syntax })`.

A single block can take the `syntaxTheme` prop instead of a wrapper. Use the wrapper when a region of code should share one preset.

Presets are exported from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`: `oneDarkPro`, `dracula`, `monokai`, `nord`, `tokyoNight`, `catppuccinMocha`, `githubDark`, `githubLight`, `solarizedLight`, `oneLight`, `catppuccinLatte`, and `tokyoNightLight`. `defineSyntaxTheme()` builds another one. All 14 color tokens are required. Five diff slots are optional and use the same `--astryx-code-syntax-*` names: `added`, `removed`, `diff-header`, `added-marker`, and `removed-marker`. Leave them out and the markers follow the punctuation color, with no extra header paint. A `[light, dark]` tuple is stored as `light-dark()`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, dracula, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const code = `const status = response.ok ? 'success' : 'error'`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="dracula">
    <CodeBlock :code="code" language="ts" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`SyntaxTheme` 是代码颜色的提供者。它给里面的每个 `CodeBlock` 写上 `--astryx-code-syntax-*` 和 `--astryx-code-block-background`。`useSyntaxTheme()` 读取最近的语法主题，也包括 `defineTheme({ syntax })` 带上的那份。

单个代码块可以直接传 `syntaxTheme`。一整块区域共用一套预设时，用 `SyntaxTheme` 包起来。

预设从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 导出：`oneDarkPro`、`dracula`、`monokai`、`nord`、`tokyoNight`、`catppuccinMocha`、`githubDark`、`githubLight`、`solarizedLight`、`oneLight`、`catppuccinLatte`、`tokyoNightLight`。`defineSyntaxTheme()` 用来做自定义主题。14 个颜色 token 都要给。差异行另外有五个可选槽，名字仍是 `--astryx-code-syntax-*`：`added`、`removed`、`diff-header`、`added-marker`、`removed-marker`。不写时，标记跟着标点色，差异头不另铺底色。`[浅色, 深色]` 会存成 `light-dark()`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, dracula, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const code = `const status = response.ok ? 'success' : 'error'`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="dracula">
    <CodeBlock :code="code" language="ts" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```

en.text: Set `syntax` on `defineTheme()` when the whole app should share one code palette.

zh.text: 整个应用共用一套代码配色时，写在 `defineTheme()` 的 `syntax` 上。
只有某一段要换预设时，用 `SyntaxTheme`。
只有一个 `CodeBlock` 时，直接传 `syntaxTheme`，不必再包一层。
用一次性 CSS 给代码块上色。预设会把 token 颜色和背景放在一起。

summary.en: `Theme` is the theme provider. It applies a `defineTheme()` object to its subtree with CSS variables, and descendants read that theme with `useTheme()`. There is no separate provider component.
summary.zh: `Theme` 本身就是主题提供者。它把 `defineTheme()` 返回的主题写到子树的 CSS 变量上，子组件用 `useTheme()` 读取。没有另外一个 Provider 组件。

usage.en: `Theme` is the theme provider. It applies a `defineTheme()` object to its subtree with CSS variables, and descendants read that theme with `useTheme()`. There is no separate provider component. Token names are the upstream names (`--color-accent`) or this package's names (`--astryx-color-accent`). A `[light, dark]` tuple becomes `light-dark()`. `mode` is `system` by default, or `light` / `dark`. The outermost `Theme` also writes `data-astryx-theme` and `data-astryx-color-mode` on `document.documentElement`. Nested themes do not. `syntax` on the theme object sets code colors for the subtree. A closer `SyntaxTheme` wins. Import the component from `@astryx-vue/core/Theme`. ```vue ``` `neutralTheme` is the empty theme. Its colors still come from `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`. The seven shipped themes stay handwritten CSS. They are not rebuilt from the generators below.
usage.zh: `Theme` 本身就是主题提供者。它把 `defineTheme()` 返回的主题写到子树的 CSS 变量上，子组件用 `useTheme()` 读取。没有另外一个 Provider 组件。 token 名可以用原版的 `--color-accent`，也可以用这个包的 `--astryx-color-accent`。`[浅色, 深色]` 会写成 `light-dark()`。`mode` 默认是 `system`，也可以是 `light` 或 `dark`。最外层的 `Theme` 会把 `data-astryx-theme` 和 `data-astryx-color-mode` 同步到 `document.documentElement`，嵌套的不会。 主题对象上的 `syntax` 给这棵子树里的代码上色。更近的 `SyntaxTheme` 优先。从 `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` 引入。 ```vue ``` `neutralTheme` 是不覆盖 token 的主题。颜色仍然来自 `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`。七套现成主题也仍是手写 CSS，不会改成下面这套生成结果。

en.text: Pass token names with the `--` prefix, such as `--color-accent` or `--astryx-color-accent`.
Use a `[light, dark]` tuple when the two modes differ.
Nest `Theme` when one region needs a different theme.
Use `Theme` to flip a single image overlay. That is `MediaTheme`.

zh.text: token 名带上 `--`，例如 `--color-accent` 或 `--astryx-color-accent`。
明暗两套颜色不同时，写成 `[浅色, 深色]`。

en.heading: Generated from a few numbers
en.text:
`color`, `typography`, `radius`, and `motion` fill tokens on the theme object. A matching `tokens` entry wins. A reference such as `var(--color-accent)` is rewritten to the `--astryx-` name.

`color.accent` is one hex color, or `[light, dark]`. The palette is HCT: hue and chroma come from the seed, tone walks a fixed ramp, and the stops are paired into light and dark. Omit the accent and set `neutralStyle` to recolor only the neutrals. `--color-on-accent` is baked from the seed so the contrast holds. The muted, text, and icon accent tokens reference `--color-accent`, so a later accent override carries them along.

Type sizes come from `typography.scale` `base` and `ratio`, rounded from `base × ratio` at each step. Radii come from `radius` `base` and `multiplier`. `none` and `full` stay fixed. Durations come from `motion` `fast`, `medium`, `slow`, and `ratio`. The min step multiplies the base by the ratio, and the max step divides by it. Both round to 5 milliseconds.

`components` overrides styles by theme target, written `<component-kebab>-<part>`, such as `button` or `card-header`. `base` hits the target itself. `variant:secondary` hits `[data-variant="secondary"]`. `Theme` puts the compiled rules in the `astryx.overrides` layer, scoped to its `data-astryx-theme` subtree and stopping at a nested theme. `localTokens`, `adaptations`, removed target names, and `extends` are covered in [Extending a theme](/en/themes/extending). The semantic icon table is still `icons`: a name points at an Iconify id.

```ts
const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  color: { accent: '#0064E0' },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  radius: { base: 4, multiplier: 1 },
  motion: { fast: 125, medium: 300, slow: 700, ratio: 0.75 },
})
```

For the tokens alone, call `expandColorScale`, `expandTypeScale`, `expandRadiusScale`, or `expandMotionScale`. They return the unprefixed names. Pass that object to `defineTheme()` as `tokens`.

- `tokens`: `tokens`
- `localTokens`: `localTokens`
- `color`: `color`

- `onDark`: `onDark`

en.heading: useTheme
en.text:
`useTheme()` reads the nearest theme. Outside a `Theme`, the name is `neutral` and `token()` reads the document's custom properties. Values are the theme's root values; adaptation rules apply through CSS only. The returned object and `token` are created once, and `tokens` changes only when the theme or the mode does.

- `name`: `name`
- `mode`: `mode`
- `token(name)`: `token(name)`
- `tokens`: `tokens`

en.heading: Template ref
en.text: The component exposes `element` with type `HTMLElement | null`.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The root is a `div` with `display: contents`. `class` and `style` are applied to it. Other attributes are not forwarded.

zh.heading: 从几个数生成
zh.text:
`color`、`typography`、`radius`、`motion` 会算出一批 token，写进主题对象。同名的 `tokens` 优先。`var(--color-accent)` 这种引用会改成带 `--astryx-` 前缀的名字。

`color.accent` 是一个十六进制颜色，也可以写成 `[浅色, 深色]`。调色板按 HCT 来：色相和彩度取自种子色，明度走固定阶梯，再配成浅色和深色。不写 accent、只写 `neutralStyle` 时，强调色保持原样，只重算中性色。`--color-on-accent` 按种子色算好对比色；弱化色、文字强调色和图标强调色则引用 `--color-accent`，所以后面改强调色时它们会跟着走。

字号用 `typography.scale` 的 `base` 和 `ratio`，按 `base × ratio` 的步长取整。圆角用 `radius` 的 `base` 和 `multiplier`，`none` 和 `full` 不动。时长用 `motion` 的 `fast`、`medium`、`slow` 和 `ratio`。最小档是基准乘以 ratio，最大档是基准除以 ratio，再取整到 5 毫秒。

`components` 按换肤挂点覆盖样式，挂点写成 `组件名-部位`，比如 `button`、`card-header`。`base` 作用在挂点本身，`variant:secondary` 作用在 `[data-variant="secondary"]` 上。`Theme` 把编译结果放进 `astryx.overrides` 层，只作用在自己的 `data-astryx-theme` 子树里，遇到嵌套的主题就停下。`localTokens`、`adaptations`、已删除的旧挂点名和 `extends` 的细节，见 [扩展与自定义主题](/themes/extending)。语义图标表仍然是 `icons`，按名字换成 Iconify id。

```ts
const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  color: { accent: '#0064E0' },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  radius: { base: 4, multiplier: 1 },
  motion: { fast: 125, medium: 300, slow: 700, ratio: 0.75 },
})
```

只要 token、不要组件时，也可以直接调用 `expandColorScale`、`expandTypeScale`、`expandRadiusScale`、`expandMotionScale`。它们返回的还是不带前缀的名字，交给 `defineTheme()` 的 `tokens` 即可。

zh.heading: defineTheme
zh.text:
- `name`: `name`
- `tokens`: `tokens`
- `localTokens`: `localTokens`
- `color`: `color`
- `typography`: `typography`
- `radius`: `radius`
- `motion`: `motion`
- `components`: `components`
- `adaptations`: `adaptations`
- `extends`: `extends`
- `syntax`: `syntax`
- `onDark`: `onDark`
- `onLight`: `onLight`
- `icons`: `icons`
- `indicators`: `indicators`

zh.heading: useTheme
zh.text:
`useTheme()` 读取最近的主题。不在 `Theme` 里时，名字是 `neutral`，`token()` 读文档上的 CSS 变量。读到的是主题本身的值，环境规则只在 CSS 里生效。返回的对象和 `token` 函数只创建一次，`tokens` 只在主题或明暗模式变了的时候才变。

- `name`: `name`
- `mode`: `mode`
- `token(name)`: `token(name)`
- `tokens`: `tokens`

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text: 组件暴露 `element`，类型是 `HTMLElement | null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: 根节点是 `display: contents` 的 `div`。`class` 和 `style` 会写到它上面。其他属性不转发。

import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'

const warmTheme = defineTheme({
  name: 'warm-docs',

    '--color-accent': ['#D97706', '#FBBF24'],

summary.en: Wrap your app once, and every scrolling Astryx component swaps the browser's native scrollbar for a custom overlay one. It is thin, takes no layout width, hides itself when idle, and follows the light and dark theme.
summary.zh: 把应用包一层，所有会滚动的 Astryx 组件就从浏览器自带的滚动条，换成一套自绘的覆盖式滚动条：细、不占宽度、不滚的时候自己收起来，明暗主题自动跟着走。

usage.en:
Wrap your app once, and every scrolling Astryx component swaps the browser's native scrollbar for a custom overlay one. It is thin, takes no layout width, hides itself when idle, and follows the light and dark theme.

This is an extra in astryx-vue. The original Astryx does not have it. It is built on [OverlayScrollbars](https://kingsora.github.io/OverlayScrollbars/) (MIT), which ships inside `@astryx-vue/core`, so you install nothing extra.

**It is off by default.** Without a `ScrollbarsProvider`, components behave exactly as before. And without one, neither the OverlayScrollbars JS nor its CSS ends up in your bundle, because only `ScrollbarsProvider` imports them.

```ts
import { ScrollbarsProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Scrollbars'
```

Setup takes about 30 seconds. Wrap your app in `App.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ScrollbarsProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Scrollbars'
</script>

<template>
  <ScrollbarsProvider>
    <RouterView />
  </ScrollbarsProvider>
</template>
```

The props you will use most:

- `enabled`: the switch, `true` by default. Set it to `false` and the whole subtree goes back to native scrollbars.
- `autoHide`: when the scrollbar hides. `'scroll'` (default) shows it while scrolling, `'leave'` hides it after the pointer leaves, `'move'` shows it while the pointer moves, `'never'` keeps it visible.
- `autoHideDelay`: how many milliseconds to wait before hiding. Default 800.
- `options`: passed straight to OverlayScrollbars and wins over everything else. Examples are below.
usage.zh:
把应用包一层，所有会滚动的 Astryx 组件就从浏览器自带的滚动条，换成一套自绘的覆盖式滚动条：细、不占宽度、不滚的时候自己收起来，明暗主题自动跟着走。

这是 astryx-vue 额外加的能力，原版 Astryx 没有。底层用的是 [OverlayScrollbars](https://kingsora.github.io/OverlayScrollbars/)（MIT 协议），已经内置在 `@astryx-vue/core` 里，不用自己装。

**默认是关的。** 不套 `ScrollbarsProvider`，组件和以前完全一样。而且没套的时候，OverlayScrollbars 的 JS 和 CSS 都不会进你的包，因为只有 `ScrollbarsProvider` 会引它们。

```ts
import { ScrollbarsProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Scrollbars'
```

30 秒接入，在 `App.vue` 里套一层就行：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ScrollbarsProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Scrollbars'
</script>

<template>
  <ScrollbarsProvider>
    <RouterView />
  </ScrollbarsProvider>
</template>
```

常用的几个属性：

- `enabled`：开关，默认 `true`。设成 `false` 就整棵子树回到原生滚动条。
- `autoHide`：什么时候把滚动条收起来。`'scroll'`（默认）是滚的时候才出现，`'leave'` 是鼠标离开后收起，`'move'` 是鼠标动的时候出现，`'never'` 是一直显示。
- `autoHideDelay`：收起前等多少毫秒，默认 800。
- `options`：直接传给 OverlayScrollbars 的选项，优先级最高，后面有例子。

en.heading: Components that switch automatically
en.text:
Inside a provider, the scroll areas of these components switch to the custom scrollbar. You do not change any code:

- Scroll containers: `ScrollableArea`, `Layout` (`LayoutContent` and `LayoutPanel` when they scroll), `Card`, `Stack` and `StackItem` (when they scroll)
- Menus and pickers: `DropdownMenu`, `ContextMenu`, `MoreMenu`, `Selector`, `MultiSelector`, `ComplexSelector`, `CommandPalette`
- Suggestion lists: the lists in `Typeahead`, `Tokenizer` and `PowerSearch`, plus `TimeInput` and `DateRangeInput`
- Overlays: `Popover`, `AlertDialog`, `BottomSheet`
- Navigation: `SideNav`, `MobileNav`
- Data display: `Table`, `CodeBlock`
- Conversation: the `Chat` message area and its trigger menu

en.heading: What stays native
en.text:
- The `Chat` input. It is an editable area, and swapping it would get in the way of typing.
- `<textarea>`.
- Horizontal scrolling of tables inside `Markdown`.
- The page's own scrollbar (`body`).

These keep the native scrollbar.

en.heading: Your own scroll containers
en.text: Reach for [`ScrollableArea`](/en/components/scrollable-area) first. It already comes with an accessible name, keyboard focus and overflow detection, and inside a provider it gets the custom scrollbar for free. Use `useScrollbars` only when you already have a hand-written scroll container and do not want to move to `ScrollableArea`. Pass it the element's ref: ```vue ``` A few things to know: - The container itself is the scrolling viewport. Its children are not moved. The hook only appends two extra `div`s at the end of the container for the scrollbars. - With no `ScrollbarsProvider` above it, `useScrollbars` does nothing and `active` stays `false`. - The scrollbar follows whatever `overflow` the container has. Making it scrollable is up to you. - Call `useScrollbars` in a **descendant** of `ScrollbarsProvider`. Calling it in the same component that renders the provider will not find it.

en.heading: Turning it off locally
en.text:
To keep native scrollbars on just one part, pick the scope you need.

**One `ScrollableArea`:**

```vue
<ScrollableArea label="Logs" :height="240" :scrollbars="false">
  ...
</ScrollableArea>
```

**One subtree.** Nest another provider. The inner one wins:

```vue
<ScrollbarsProvider>
  <Main />
  <ScrollbarsProvider :enabled="false">
    <Sidebar />
  </ScrollbarsProvider>
</ScrollbarsProvider>
```

**One of your own containers.** Pass `enabled` to `useScrollbars`. It can be a boolean, a ref or a getter:

```ts
const { active } = useScrollbars(el, { enabled: () => props.fancy })
```

If the outer provider is off, `true` here does not turn it on.

en.heading: Changing the look
Changing behavior with options
en.text:
`options` goes to OverlayScrollbars as is. It is deep-merged and has the highest priority, so it even overrides `autoHide`.

```vue
<ScrollbarsProvider
  :options="{
    scrollbars: {
      clickScroll: 'instant',
      visibility: 'visible',
    },
  }"
>
  <App />
</ScrollbarsProvider>
```

- `clickScroll: 'instant'`: clicking the track jumps the viewport there. Off by default. The animated variant (`true`) also needs OverlayScrollbars' `ClickScrollPlugin` registered.
- `visibility: 'visible'`: the scrollbar is always shown. The default is `'auto'`, which shows it only when content overflows.

See the [OverlayScrollbars docs](https://kingsora.github.io/OverlayScrollbars/) for the full option list.

en.heading: Notes
en.text:
- **Server rendering**: the first paint shows native scrollbars. They swap to the custom ones after the page mounts, so you may see a brief style change on load.
- **macOS**: the system default is "Show scroll bars: when scrolling", so native scrollbars there are already overlay ones. After the swap, the main difference is a consistent look across platforms.
- **Reduced motion**: when the user's system asks for reduced motion, scrollbar transitions are turned off.
- **Keyboard, touch and screen readers**: no change. The element that scrolls is still the original one. The scrollbar is only drawn on top of it.
- **No provider**: nothing happens, and no extra code is loaded.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The component renders no element of its own, so class and style are not forwarded.

zh.heading: 会自动换上的组件
zh.text:
套了 Provider 之后，下面这些组件里的滚动区域会自动换成自绘滚动条，不用你改代码：

- 滚动容器：`ScrollableArea`、`Layout`（`LayoutContent` 和 `LayoutPanel` 可滚动时）、`Card`、`Stack` 和 `StackItem`（可滚动时）
- 菜单和选择：`DropdownMenu`、`ContextMenu`、`MoreMenu`、`Selector`、`MultiSelector`、`ComplexSelector`、`CommandPalette`
- 输入候选：`Typeahead`、`Tokenizer`、`PowerSearch` 的候选列表，`TimeInput`、`DateRangeInput`
- 浮层：`Popover`、`AlertDialog`、`BottomSheet`
- 导航：`SideNav`、`MobileNav`
- 数据展示：`Table`、`CodeBlock`
- 对话：`Chat` 的消息区和触发菜单

zh.heading: 不会换的地方
zh.text:
- `Chat` 的输入框。它是可编辑区，换了会影响输入。
- `<textarea>`。
- `Markdown` 里表格的横向滚动。
- 页面本身（`body`）的滚动条。

这些地方还是原生滚动条。

zh.heading: 自己的滚动容器
zh.text: 首选 [`ScrollableArea`](/components/scrollable-area)。它自带无障碍名称、键盘聚焦和溢出判断，套了 Provider 就自动换上自绘滚动条，不用再想别的。 只有一种情况需要 `useScrollbars`：你已经有一个自己写的滚动容器，不想换成 `ScrollableArea`。把这个元素的 ref 交给它： ```vue ``` 几个要点： - 容器自己就是滚动的视口，里面的子节点不会被搬动。它只会在容器末尾多追加两个滚动条用的 `div`。 - 外层没有 `ScrollbarsProvider` 时，`useScrollbars` 什么都不做，`active` 一直是 `false`。 - 容器的 `overflow` 是什么，滚动条就跟着是什么。你自己要保证它能滚。 - `useScrollbars` 要在 `ScrollbarsProvider` 的**后代组件**里调用。在写 Provider 的那个组件里直接调，是读不到的。

zh.heading: 局部关掉
zh.text:
只想让某一块保留原生滚动条，有三种办法，看你想关多大的范围。

**关掉一块 `ScrollableArea`：**

```vue
<ScrollableArea label="日志" :height="240" :scrollbars="false">
  ...
</ScrollableArea>
```

**关掉一棵子树。** 嵌套一层 Provider，里面的覆盖外面的：

```vue
<ScrollbarsProvider>
  <Main />
  <ScrollbarsProvider :enabled="false">
    <Sidebar />
  </ScrollbarsProvider>
</ScrollbarsProvider>
```

**关掉自己的某个容器。** 给 `useScrollbars` 传 `enabled`，可以是布尔值、ref 或者 getter：

```ts
const { active } = useScrollbars(el, { enabled: () => props.fancy })
```

外层 Provider 是关的时候，这里写 `true` 也不会生效。

zh.heading: 改外观
用 options 改行为
zh.text:
`options` 会原样传给 OverlayScrollbars，深合并，并且优先级最高，连 `autoHide` 都会被它盖掉。

```vue
<ScrollbarsProvider
  :options="{
    scrollbars: {
      clickScroll: 'instant',
      visibility: 'visible',
    },
  }"
>
  <App />
</ScrollbarsProvider>
```

- `clickScroll: 'instant'`：点一下轨道，视口直接跳到那里。默认是关的。想要平滑滚过去（`true`），得另外注册 OverlayScrollbars 的 `ClickScrollPlugin`。
- `visibility: 'visible'`：滚动条一直显示。默认 `'auto'`，只在内容溢出时显示。

完整的选项见 [OverlayScrollbars 文档](https://kingsora.github.io/OverlayScrollbars/)。

zh.heading: 注意事项
zh.text:
- **服务端渲染**：首屏先显示原生滚动条，页面挂载后才换成自绘的。所以刚打开页面时可能有一瞬间的样式变化。
- **macOS**：系统默认「滚动时显示滚动条」，原生滚动条本来就是覆盖式的。在 macOS 上换完以后，主要差别是各个平台的样式统一了。
- **减少动效**：用户系统开了「减少动效」时，滚动条的过渡会关掉。
- **键盘、触屏、读屏**：行为不变。因为真正在滚动的，仍然是原来的那个元素，滚动条只是画在它上面。
- **没套 Provider**：什么都不会发生，也不会多加载任何代码。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: 组件本身不渲染元素，class 和 style 不会传下去。

description.en: A ScrollableArea with a long list and a CodeBlock that scrolls sideways, both inside one ScrollbarsProvider. Flip the switch to compare the native scrollbars with the custom ones.
description.zh: 一块带长列表的 ScrollableArea，一块有横向滚动的 CodeBlock，一起包在 ScrollbarsProvider 里。打开和关掉开关，对比原生滚动条和自绘滚动条。

title.en: Scrollbars Provider — Your Own Scroll Container
title.zh: Scrollbars Provider — 自己的滚动容器

description.en: A hand-written overflow: auto div that gets the custom scrollbar through useScrollbars. The look is tuned with CSS variables: a thicker bar in the accent color.
description.zh: 一个自己写的 overflow: auto 的 div，用 useScrollbars 接上自绘滚动条。外观用 CSS 变量改：这里调粗了滚动条，换成了强调色。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ScrollbarsProvider, useScrollbars } from '@astryx-vue/core/Scrollbars'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { defineComponent, h, shallowRef } from 'vue'

/**
 * `useScrollbars` reads the nearest provider, so the hook lives in a child
 * component that sits inside `ScrollbarsProvider`.
 */
const Feed = defineComponent({
  name: 'DemoFeed',
  setup() {
    const el = shallowRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)
    const { active } = useScrollbars(el)
    const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => `Event ${index + 1}`)
    return () => h('div', {
      'ref': el,
      'class': 'scrollbars-provider-preview__feed',
      'data-active': String(active.value),
      'tabindex': 0,
      'role': 'region',
      'aria-label': 'Event feed',
    }, rows.map(row => h('div', { key: row, class: 'scrollbars-provider-preview__row' }, h(Text, { type: 'body' }, () => row))))
  },
})
</script>

<template>
  <ScrollbarsProvider>
    <Feed />
  </ScrollbarsProvider>
</template>

summary.en: Imperatively announces a message to screen readers through a visually-hidden live region. Use it for state that is only conveyed visually; search result counts, "no results", loading and saved confirmations, validation errors (WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages). The polite and assertive regions are created empty on first use and stay mounted, which is what makes announcements reliable: most screen readers ignore a live region that is inserted together with its content. Each message is cleared a couple of seconds after it is announced so stale status does not linger in the accessibility tree.
summary.zh: 用一块视觉上隐藏的 live region，主动把一句话念给读屏软件听。只靠眼睛才能看出来的状态用它播报：搜索结果条数、"没有结果"、加载中和已保存的提示、校验错误（WCAG 4.1.3 状态消息）。polite 和 assertive 两块区域在第一次使用时以空内容创建，之后一直留在页面里，只换文字——这正是一次播报能被听到的原因：很多读屏软件会忽略和内容同时插入的 live region。每条消息播报完一两秒后会被清空，旧状态不会一直留在无障碍树里。

usage.en:
Imperatively announces a message to screen readers through a visually-hidden live region. Use it for state that is only conveyed visually; search result counts, "no results", loading and saved confirmations, validation errors (WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages). The polite and assertive regions are created empty on first use and stay mounted, which is what makes announcements reliable: most screen readers ignore a live region that is inserted together with its content. Each message is cleared a couple of seconds after it is announced so stale status does not linger in the accessibility tree.

```ts
import { useAnnounce } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```ts
const announce = useAnnounce()

announce('12 results')
announce('The file could not be saved.', 'assertive')
```
usage.zh:
用一块视觉上隐藏的 live region，主动把一句话念给读屏软件听。只靠眼睛才能看出来的状态用它播报：搜索结果条数、"没有结果"、加载中和已保存的提示、校验错误（WCAG 4.1.3 状态消息）。polite 和 assertive 两块区域在第一次使用时以空内容创建，之后一直留在页面里，只换文字——这正是一次播报能被听到的原因：很多读屏软件会忽略和内容同时插入的 live region。每条消息播报完一两秒后会被清空，旧状态不会一直留在无障碍树里。

```ts
import { useAnnounce } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```ts
const announce = useAnnounce()

announce('找到 12 条结果')
announce('文件保存失败。', 'assertive')
```

en.text: Reach for this instead of hand-rolling an `aria-live` div; a region rendered with its content usually does not announce at all.
Keep `"polite"` for status and result counts; reserve `"assertive"` for errors and time-sensitive alerts, since it interrupts whatever the screen reader is saying.
Announce the outcome, not the interaction; `"12 results"` rather than `"search ran"`.
Announce content that is already visible and correctly labeled in the DOM; that doubles up for screen reader users.

rows.name: `announce`
rows.description: Speaks a message through the shared live region. Politeness defaults to `polite`; an empty message clears any lingering status instead of announcing.

rows.name: `announce`
rows.description: 通过共享的 live region 念一句话。第二项默认是 `polite`；传空字符串表示清空残留的状态，不播报。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 需要播报时用它，不要自己搭一个 `aria-live` 的 div：区域和文字一起出现时，读屏通常不念。
- 推荐: `"polite"` 留给状态和结果条数；`"assertive"` 留给错误和和时间有关的提醒，因为它会打断读屏正在念的内容。
- 推荐: 播报结果，而不是操作；说 `"12 条结果"`，不要说 `"搜索跑了一次"`。
- 避免: 播报 DOM 里已经看得见、标签也写对的内容；读屏用户会听到两遍。

summary.en: Hook for reading and controlling AppShell mobile navigation state from descendants of AppShell. Use it for custom mobile nav triggers, closing the drawer after route changes, or coordinating AppShell-adjacent mobile experiences with the same breakpoint used by mobile nav.
summary.zh: 用在 AppShell 里面，读和控制 AppShell 的移动端导航状态。想做自己的移动端导航按钮、路由变化后关掉抽屉，或者让挨着 AppShell 的移动端界面跟导航用同一个断点，都用它。

usage.en:
Hook for reading and controlling AppShell mobile navigation state from descendants of AppShell. Use it for custom mobile nav triggers, closing the drawer after route changes, or coordinating AppShell-adjacent mobile experiences with the same breakpoint used by mobile nav.

```ts
import { useAppShellMobile } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAppShellMobile } from '@astryx-vue/core'

const { isMobile, isMobileNavEnabled, mobileNavId, openMobileNav } = useAppShellMobile()
</script>

<template>
  <button
    v-if="isMobile && isMobileNavEnabled"
    type="button"
    :aria-controls="mobileNavId"
    @click="openMobileNav"
  >
    Open navigation
  </button>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
用在 AppShell 里面，读和控制 AppShell 的移动端导航状态。想做自己的移动端导航按钮、路由变化后关掉抽屉，或者让挨着 AppShell 的移动端界面跟导航用同一个断点，都用它。

```ts
import { useAppShellMobile } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAppShellMobile } from '@astryx-vue/core'

const { isMobile, isMobileNavEnabled, mobileNavId, openMobileNav } = useAppShellMobile()
</script>

<template>
  <button
    v-if="isMobile && isMobileNavEnabled"
    type="button"
    :aria-controls="mobileNavId"
    @click="openMobileNav"
  >
    打开导航
  </button>
</template>
```

en.text: Use inside the AppShell tree when building custom mobile navigation controls, route-aware nav items, or UI that should update at the same breakpoint as AppShell mobile nav.
Prefer `MobileNavToggle` for the standard hamburger trigger: use this hook when you need custom placement, styling, or extra behavior.
Call `closeMobileNav` after a custom mobile nav item changes route so the drawer dismisses cleanly.
Use as a general responsive primitive when the UI is not inside AppShell or does not need to align with AppShell mobile nav: use `useMediaQuery` instead.
Assume it throws outside AppShell. The hook returns safe defaults and no-op callbacks when no provider is present.

rows.name: `isMobile`
rows.description: Whether the current viewport is below the AppShell mobile navigation breakpoint. Use this to synchronize AppShell-adjacent mobile UI with the same breakpoint as mobile nav.

rows.name: `isMobileNavOpen`
rows.description: Whether the AppShell-managed mobile navigation drawer is open.

rows.name: `mobileNavId`
rows.description: DOM id of the mobile navigation drawer, set by AppShell. Point `aria-controls` of a custom toggle at this so screen-reader users know which element the toggle expands. Undefined outside an AppShell that manages the drawer.

rows.name: `toggleMobileNav`
rows.description: Toggle the AppShell-managed mobile navigation drawer. No-ops when mobile nav is disabled.

rows.name: `openMobileNav`
rows.description: Open the AppShell-managed mobile navigation drawer. No-ops when mobile nav is disabled.

rows.name: `closeMobileNav`
rows.description: Close the AppShell-managed mobile navigation drawer.

rows.name: `isMobileNavEnabled`
rows.description: Whether AppShell mobile navigation is enabled and managed by AppShell. False when `mobileNav` is `false`, there is no nav content, or a fully custom `mobileNav` slot owns the drawer.

rows.name: `hasAutoToggle`
rows.description: Whether AppShell auto-toggle behavior is enabled. False when `mobileNav.hasToggle` is set to `false`; combine with `isMobile` and `isMobileNavEnabled` before rendering custom toggles.

rows.name: `hasSideNav`
rows.description: Whether the AppShell has a `sideNav` slot. Mobile navigation is only managed when there is nav content to show.

rows.name: `isMobile`
rows.description: 当前视口是否小于 AppShell 移动端导航的断点。用它让挨着 AppShell 的移动端界面跟移动端导航踩同一个断点。

rows.name: `isMobileNavOpen`
rows.description: AppShell 管的那个移动端导航抽屉是否打开。

rows.name: `mobileNavId`
rows.description: 移动端导航抽屉的 DOM id，由 AppShell 设置。自定义按钮把它填进 `aria-controls`，读屏用户就知道这个按钮展开的是哪一块。不在管理抽屉的 AppShell 里时是 undefined。

rows.name: `toggleMobileNav`
rows.description: 切换 AppShell 管的移动端导航抽屉。移动端导航停用时不做任何事。

rows.name: `openMobileNav`
rows.description: 打开 AppShell 管的移动端导航抽屉。移动端导航停用时不做任何事。

rows.name: `closeMobileNav`
rows.description: 关闭 AppShell 管的移动端导航抽屉。

rows.name: `isMobileNavEnabled`
rows.description: 移动端导航是否已启用、并由 AppShell 管理。以下情况为 false：`mobileNav` 传了 `false`、没有导航内容、或者整个抽屉由自定义的 `mobileNav` 插槽负责。

rows.name: `hasAutoToggle`
rows.description: AppShell 的自动切换按钮是否启用。`mobileNav.hasToggle` 传 `false` 时为 false。自己画按钮之前，先和 `isMobile`、`isMobileNavEnabled` 一起判断。

rows.name: `hasSideNav`
rows.description: AppShell 有没有 `sideNav` 插槽。只有存在导航内容时才会托管移动端导航。

en.heading: Returns
en.text: The returned object is stable and reactive. Read the fields in a template or a computed and they follow the AppShell as the viewport changes.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 在 AppShell 子树里做自定义移动端导航控件、跟着路由走的导航项，或者需要跟移动端导航同步断点的界面时用它。
- 推荐: 标准汉堡按钮直接用 `MobileNavToggle`；只有要换位置、改样式或者加行为时才用这个 hook。
- 推荐: 自定义的移动端导航项跳完路由后调 `closeMobileNav`，抽屉才能干净地收起来。
- 避免: 界面不在 AppShell 里、也不需要跟 AppShell 移动端导航对齐时，别拿它当通用的响应式工具；改用 `useMediaQuery`。
- 避免: 以为在 AppShell 外面会报错。没有提供者时它返回一组安全的默认值和不做事的空函数。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: 返回的对象是稳定的、响应式的。在模板或计算属性里读这些字段，视口变化时它们会跟着更新。

title.zh: useAppShellMobile — 自定义移动端触发按钮

description.en: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.
description.zh: 用 useAppShellMobile 做的自定义移动端导航按钮。它读的是外面那层 AppShell 的上下文，不自己套一层外壳。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAppShellMobile } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const {
  closeMobileNav,
  isMobile,
  isMobileNavEnabled,
  isMobileNavOpen,
  openMobileNav,
} = useAppShellMobile()
</script>

<template>
  <VStack v-if="!isMobileNavEnabled" :gap="2">
    <Button is-disabled label="Open navigation" variant="secondary" />
    <Text color="secondary" type="body">
      No active AppShell mobile navigation context was detected. This hook returns safe defaults outside AppShell, or when the surrounding AppShell has mobile navigation disabled.
    </Text>
  </VStack>
  <VStack v-else-if="!isMobile" :gap="2">
    <Button is-disabled label="Open navigation" variant="secondary" />
    <Text color="secondary" type="body">
      AppShell mobile navigation context is available. Narrow the viewport below the AppShell mobile breakpoint to make the custom trigger active.
    </Text>
  </VStack>
  <VStack v-else :gap="2">
    <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
      <Button
        :label="isMobileNavOpen ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'"
        variant="secondary"
        @click="isMobileNavOpen ? closeMobileNav() : openMobileNav()"
      />
      <Text color="secondary" type="body">
        {{ isMobileNavOpen ? 'Mobile nav is open' : 'Mobile nav is closed' }}
      </Text>
    </HStack>
    <Text color="secondary" type="body">
      This button controls the nearest AppShell mobile nav from context.
    </Text>
  </VStack>
</template>

summary.en: Makes a container element clickable while preserving nested interactive element behavior. Solves the "nested interactive elements" problem: when a card is clickable but contains buttons/links, clicking those should NOT trigger the card's action. Detects interactive ancestors between the click target and the container, and ignores text selections. Supports href navigation (including middle-click and Ctrl/Cmd+click for new tabs).
summary.zh: 让整块容器可以点，同时不改变里面嵌套控件的原有行为。它解决的是「嵌套可交互元素」这个老问题：卡片整体可点，但卡片里还有按钮和链接，点这些控件不应该顺带触发卡片的动作。做法是看点击目标到容器之间有没有可交互的祖先，同时忽略文字选择。支持带 `href` 的跳转，包括中键和 Ctrl/Cmd 点击开新标签页。

usage.en: Makes a container element clickable while preserving nested interactive element behavior. Solves the "nested interactive elements" problem: when a card is clickable but contains buttons/links, clicking those should NOT trigger the card's action. Detects interactive ancestors between the click target and the container, and ignores text selections. Supports href navigation (including middle-click and Ctrl/Cmd+click for new tabs). ```ts import { useClickableContainer } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

summary.en: Copy-to-clipboard behavior: the clipboard write, a transient `isCopied` flag with its own reset timer, and an optional polite screen-reader announcement. Extracted so every copy affordance is a thin control over one implementation instead of re-deriving the timer and announcement. Rapid re-copies restart the reset timer so the confirmation always lasts the full duration, and the timer is cleaned up when the effect scope is disposed. `CodeBlock` builds its built-in copy button on it; reach for it directly when building a copy affordance that is not a plain icon button (a menu item, a labeled text button, a copy-on-click value chip).
summary.zh: `useClipboard` 把「复制文本到剪贴板」这件常见的小事封装好了。它帮我们打理好了一整套细节：写入剪贴板、复制成功后在短暂时间内变成 `true` 的 `isCopied` 状态、自动恢复默认状态的倒计时定时器，以及读屏软件的无障碍朗读播报。

usage.en:
Copy-to-clipboard behavior: the clipboard write, a transient `isCopied` flag with its own reset timer, and an optional polite screen-reader announcement. Extracted so every copy affordance is a thin control over one implementation instead of re-deriving the timer and announcement. Rapid re-copies restart the reset timer so the confirmation always lasts the full duration, and the timer is cleaned up when the effect scope is disposed. `CodeBlock` builds its built-in copy button on it; reach for it directly when building a copy affordance that is not a plain icon button (a menu item, a labeled text button, a copy-on-click value chip).

```ts
import { useClipboard } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

The same function is also exported as `useCopyToClipboard`, from `@astryx-vue/core` and from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`. `isCopied` is a `ref`, so the template unwraps it.
usage.zh:
`useClipboard` 把「复制文本到剪贴板」这件常见的小事封装好了。它帮我们打理好了一整套细节：写入剪贴板、复制成功后在短暂时间内变成 `true` 的 `isCopied` 状态、自动恢复默认状态的倒计时定时器，以及读屏软件的无障碍朗读播报。

这样一来，我们在写复制按钮时就不必到处重复写 `setTimeout` 和重置逻辑。当用户连续多次点击复制时，它还会自动重新计算等待时间，确保「复制成功」的提示完整展示给用户看。代码组件 `CodeBlock` 右上角的复制按钮就是基于它构建的。

**什么时候用：**
- 需要在点击按钮或文字后把一段字符串（如兑换码、分享链接、代码片段）快速写进系统剪贴板时。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 如果是浏览器普通的表单全选复制，或者用户习惯性的划词右键复制，不需要特意使用这个组合式函数。

```ts
import { useClipboard } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

同一个函数也可以通过 `useCopyToClipboard` 的别名导入，`@astryx-vue/core` 和 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 都支持引用。导出的 `isCopied` 是 Vue 的 `ref` 对象，在模板里直接写名字即可自动解包。

en.text: Drive the copied confirmation (copy → check icon, label swap) off the returned `isCopied` ref rather than tracking your own state.
Pass a localized `announce` message so the copy is spoken by screen readers; swapping the button `aria-label` alone is not reliably announced.
For the common compact icon copy button, render a ghost `IconButton` with a "Copy" tooltip and wire `@click` to `copy()`; the tooltip stays "Copy" and the icon flip is the confirmation.
Track a separate `copied` ref alongside the hook; `isCopied` already reflects the copied window and resets itself.

rows.description: Configuration object. Optional.

rows.name: `options.announce`
rows.description: Message announced to a polite live region on a successful copy. A swapped `aria-label` alone is not reliably announced, so pass the localized confirmation (e.g. "Copied") to have it spoken. Omit to skip the announcement.

rows.name: `options.resetAfterMs`
rows.description: Milliseconds `isCopied` stays true after a successful copy before reverting.

rows.name: `copy`
rows.description: Writes `text` to the clipboard. On success flips `isCopied` to true, announces the configured message, restarts the reset timer, and resolves true. A clipboard rejection is a silent no-op that leaves the copied state unchanged and resolves false.

rows.name: `isCopied`
rows.description: True for `resetAfterMs` after the most recent successful copy, then reverts. Drive the copied confirmation (e.g. a copy → check icon flip) off this.

rows.name: `options.resetAfterMs`
rows.description: 复制成功后 `isCopied` 保持为 true 的毫秒数。

rows.name: `copy`
rows.description: 把 `text` 写进剪贴板。成功时 `isCopied` 变为 true、播报配置的句子、重置定时器，并返回 true。写入被拒绝时什么都不改，返回 false。

rows.name: `isCopied`
rows.description: 最近一次复制成功后的 `resetAfterMs` 内为 true，之后归位。复制成功的提示（例如复制图标换成对勾）看它即可。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 复制成功的提示（复制图标换成对勾、文字换成「已复制」）看返回的 `isCopied`，不要自己再存一份状态。
- 推荐: 传一个本地化好的 `announce` 句子，让读屏念出来；只换按钮的 `aria-label` 经常不会被念。
- 推荐: 常见的小图标复制按钮，用 ghost 的 `IconButton` 配一个「复制」的 Tooltip，`@click` 调 `copy()`；Tooltip 一直是「复制」，靠图标翻转表示已复制。
- 避免: 在 hook 之外再维护一个 `copied` 变量；`isCopied` 已经反映这段提示窗口，并且会自己归位。

usage.en: Reusable hook that encapsulates the collapsible state machine. Supports three modes: group-controlled (inside `CollapsibleGroup`), controlled (`isOpen` + `onOpenChange`), and uncontrolled (self-managed with `defaultIsOpen`). Used internally by `Collapsible`. ```ts import { useCollapsible } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible' ``` Call it in `setup()` and read `isOpen` / `isEnabled`, or bind `isOpen` to `v-show`. The hook only owns state; the trigger markup stays yours. ```vue ``` Pass an object to `isCollapsible` for controlled state. `isOpen` is the model ref, usually `v-model:isOpen`: ```ts const isOpen = ref(false) const collapsible = useCollapsible({ isCollapsible: { isOpen, onOpenChange: (next) => { isOpen.value = next } }, }) ```
usage.zh: 可复用的组合式函数，封装了折叠面板的状态机。支持三种模式：组管理（在 `CollapsibleGroup` 里）、受控（`isOpen` + `onOpenChange`）、不受控（用 `defaultIsOpen` 自己管）。`Collapsible` 组件内部也用它。 ```ts import { useCollapsible } from '@astryx-vue/core/Collapsible' ``` 在 `setup()` 里调用，读 `isOpen` / `isEnabled`，或者把 `isOpen` 绑到 `v-show`。hook 只管状态，触发器长什么样由你决定。 ```vue ``` 要做受控，就给 `isCollapsible` 传一个对象。`isOpen` 就是那个 model ref，平时是 `v-model:isOpen`： ```ts const isOpen = ref(false) const collapsible = useCollapsible({ isCollapsible: { isOpen, onOpenChange: (next) => { isOpen.value = next } }, }) ```

summary.en: Returns the sanctioned locale-aware comparator for custom sorting. The collator is recreated when the provider locale or an option changes.

usage.en:
Returns the sanctioned locale-aware comparator for custom sorting. The collator is recreated when the provider locale or an option changes.

```ts
import { useCollator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
```

```ts
const collator = useCollator({ numeric: true })

const sorted = computed(() => [...items.value].sort((a, b) => collator.value.compare(a, b)))
```

```ts

```

