summary.en: A headless hover/focus reveal primitive. Gives a container a scoped trigger that reveals (or conceals) content inside it when the container is hovered or receives keyboard focus: the classic "row actions appear on hover" pattern. The reveal is CSS-only: no hover state lives in Vue and hovering never triggers a re-render. The caller authors no CSS for the reveal itself; the hook hands out the container and content classes, and a nested container shadows its ancestor, so nested containers never leak hover/focus into one another. Accessible by construction: revealed content is visually hidden at rest with position and opacity (never `display: none`), so it stays mounted, keeps its place in the tab order, and is announced to assistive technology; it reveals on `:focus-within` so keyboard users see it when tabbing in, stays visible on touch (never gated behind hover on coarse pointers), and honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.
summary.zh: 一个不带外观的「悬停或聚焦才露出」原语。给容器挂上一段作用域内的触发逻辑：鼠标停在容器上，或者键盘焦点进到容器里，容器里的内容就露出来（或者反过来藏起来），也就是常见的「行操作悬停才出现」。露出完全由 CSS 完成：Vue 里不存悬停状态，悬停也不会引起重新渲染。调用方不用为露出写任何 CSS，hook 会给容器的类，也会给内容的类；嵌套的容器盖住外层，所以两层互不串味。无障碍上是自带的：藏起来的内容用定位和不透明度藏（绝不 `display: none`），所以它仍然挂在树上、仍然在 Tab 顺序里、读屏也读得到；`:focus-within` 时会露出，键盘 Tab 进来就能看见；触摸设备上一直可见（不会因为粗指针没有 hover 而丢掉）；也尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

usage.en:
A headless hover/focus reveal primitive. Gives a container a scoped trigger that reveals (or conceals) content inside it when the container is hovered or receives keyboard focus: the classic "row actions appear on hover" pattern. The reveal is CSS-only: no hover state lives in Vue and hovering never triggers a re-render. The caller authors no CSS for the reveal itself; the hook hands out the container and content classes, and a nested container shadows its ancestor, so nested containers never leak hover/focus into one another. Accessible by construction: revealed content is visually hidden at rest with position and opacity (never `display: none`), so it stays mounted, keeps its place in the tab order, and is announced to assistive technology; it reveals on `:focus-within` so keyboard users see it when tabbing in, stays visible on touch (never gated behind hover on coarse pointers), and honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

`containerProps()` returns `class` and `style` for the container; `contentProps()` returns the `class` for each revealed child. Bind them with `:class` and `:style`.

```ts
import { useContainerReveal } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
一个不带外观的「悬停或聚焦才露出」原语。给容器挂上一段作用域内的触发逻辑：鼠标停在容器上，或者键盘焦点进到容器里，容器里的内容就露出来（或者反过来藏起来），也就是常见的「行操作悬停才出现」。露出完全由 CSS 完成：Vue 里不存悬停状态，悬停也不会引起重新渲染。调用方不用为露出写任何 CSS，hook 会给容器的类，也会给内容的类；嵌套的容器盖住外层，所以两层互不串味。无障碍上是自带的：藏起来的内容用定位和不透明度藏（绝不 `display: none`），所以它仍然挂在树上、仍然在 Tab 顺序里、读屏也读得到；`:focus-within` 时会露出，键盘 Tab 进来就能看见；触摸设备上一直可见（不会因为粗指针没有 hover 而丢掉）；也尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

`containerProps()` 返回容器的 `class` 和 `style`，`contentProps()` 返回每个待露出子元素的 `class`。分别用 `:class` 和 `:style` 绑上去。

```ts
import { useContainerReveal } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Destructure `containerProps` and `contentProps`; bind `containerProps()` on the container (alongside your own classes) and `contentProps()` on the content to reveal.
Use for secondary affordances: reveal-on-hover row actions (edit/copy/remove on list or table rows) and overlay controls on a card or media tile (e.g. `Thumbnail`'s remove button).
Gate the reveal with `isEnabled` when a consumer prop decides whether content is revealed on hover or always shown; it can change at any time.
Pass `isLayoutPreserved` for absolutely-positioned or overlay content to reserve its box and avoid layout shift when it appears.
Set a `hoverDelay` (100-250ms) on rows in a long list, so a cursor travelling across the list does not light up every row it passes; keyboard and touch still reveal immediately.

Reach for `forceState` when something other than the pointer owns the interaction (a drag, a scroll or motion gate, an open row menu), and `forceVisibility` when just one element should ignore the container.
Reach past the API into the hook's private custom properties (`--_reveal-opacity` and friends) to suppress a reveal; use `forceState` / `forceVisibility`, which survive a rename.
Use it to hide content that must always be discoverable; keep essential actions visible instead of gating them behind hover.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for the reveal container. Optional.

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: When false the hook is inert: the container gets no classes and the content getters return nothing, so content is always shown. Read on every call, so a component can flip it after mount (e.g. `revealOn === "hover"`).

rows.name: `containerProps(options?).hoverDelay`
rows.description: Milliseconds the pointer must dwell before the reveal starts: a hover-intent gate like Tooltip's and HoverCard's delay, so a cursor sweeping across a list leaves nothing painted behind it. Keyboard and coarse pointers never wait.

rows.name: `containerProps(options?).forceState`
rows.description: Pins the trigger state when the caller owns it: a motion gate, a scroll, or a row whose menu is open. `'inactive'` still yields to keyboard focus and coarse pointers.

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).isRevealInverted`
rows.description: Conceal on hover instead of reveal on hover. Pointer only; keyboard focus and touch still show the content.

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).isLayoutPreserved`
rows.description: Reserves the layout box while hidden (opacity only) and avoids layout shift.

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).forceVisibility`
rows.description: Pins this one element's appearance whatever the container is doing. `'hidden'` yields to focus.

rows.name: `containerProps`
rows.type: `(options?: ContainerRevealOptions) => { class?: string | Record<string, boolean>, style?: CSSProperties }`
rows.description: Bind onto the container whose hover and focus-within drive the reveal. Accepts `hoverDelay` and `forceState`. Returns an empty object when the hook is disabled.

rows.name: `contentProps`
rows.description: Bind onto each revealed or concealed child. Accepts `isRevealInverted`, `isLayoutPreserved`, and `forceVisibility`. Returns an empty object when the hook is disabled.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 露出的配置对象，可以不传。

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: 为 false 时这个 hook 完全失效：容器拿不到类，内容也拿不到类，内容一直可见。每次调用都会重新读，所以组件挂载后也能改（例如按 `revealOn === "hover"` 决定）。

rows.name: `containerProps(options?).hoverDelay`
rows.description: 指针要停多少毫秒才开始露出，和 Tooltip、HoverCard 的延时一样，是个「确认要悬停」的闸门：光标扫过列表时不会把沿途的行都点亮。键盘和粗指针不等待。

rows.name: `containerProps(options?).forceState`
rows.description: 把触发状态钉住，交给调用方掌管的时候用：动效门控、滚动中、行的菜单已打开。`'inactive'` 仍然让键盘焦点和粗指针看见内容。

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).isRevealInverted`
rows.description: 反过来：平时可见，悬停时藏起。只影响指针，键盘焦点和触摸照样能看到。

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).isLayoutPreserved`
rows.description: 藏起时仍占住原来的位置（只改不透明度），避免布局跳动。

rows.name: `contentProps(options?).forceVisibility`
rows.description: 单独钉住这一个元素的可见性，不跟容器走。`'hidden'` 在焦点进来时仍会露出。

rows.name: `containerProps`
rows.type: `(options?: ContainerRevealOptions) => { class?: string | Record<string, boolean>, style?: CSSProperties }`
rows.description: 绑在容器上，容器的悬停和 focus-within 决定露出。可以传 `hoverDelay` 和 `forceState`。hook 关掉时返回空对象。

rows.name: `contentProps`
rows.description: 绑在每一个要露出或要藏起的子元素上。可以传 `isRevealInverted`、`isLayoutPreserved` 和 `forceVisibility`。hook 关掉时返回空对象。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 取出 `containerProps` 和 `contentProps`：`containerProps()` 绑在容器上（和你自己的类一起），`contentProps()` 绑在要露出的内容上。
- 推荐: 只用来放次要操作：列表或表格行上的编辑、复制、删除，卡片或媒体块上的浮层控件（例如 `Thumbnail` 的删除按钮）。
- 推荐: 组件自己的 prop 决定「悬停才露出」还是「一直显示」时，用 `isEnabled` 关掉它；它随时可以变。
- 推荐: 绝对定位或浮层类的内容传 `isLayoutPreserved`，提前占好位置，出现时不会把布局顶动。
- 推荐: 长列表的行设一个 `hoverDelay`（100-250 毫秒），鼠标扫过列表时就不会一路点亮每一行；键盘和触摸仍然立即露出。
- 推荐: 交互由别的东西掌管时（拖拽、滚动或动效门控、行的菜单已打开）用 `forceState`；只要某一个元素不跟容器走时用 `forceVisibility`。
- 避免: 绕过 API 去改 hook 内部的私有自定义属性（`--_reveal-opacity` 之类）来压住露出；用 `forceState` / `forceVisibility`，改名也不会坏。
- 避免: 用它藏那些必须随时能被发现的内容；重要操作就一直显示，别挂在悬停后面。

title.zh: useContainerReveal — 悬停露出的行操作

description.en: File rows keep their edit and delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.
description.zh: 文件行平时把编辑和删除藏起来，悬停或用键盘聚焦时通过 useContainerReveal 露出；操作一直在树上，也在 Tab 顺序里。

summary.en: Fires a dev-only "Component: message" console warning once per mount while the condition holds. It is the safe way for a component to flag misuse: the same check written straight into a `computed` getter or a `watch` callback repeats on every change, and gating it with state adds a re-render, so this watches the condition instead and warns once. For a warning outside a component, use the imperative `devWarn` utility.
summary.zh: 条件成立时打一条 `Component: message` 形式的控制台警告，只在开发构建里输出，每次挂载只打一次。组件想指出用法错误时用它最稳：同样的检查直接写在 `computed` 的取值函数或 `watch` 回调里，每次变化都会再跑一遍；用状态挡下来又多一次渲染。所以这里改成盯着条件，条件第一次成立时警告一次。组件之外要警告，用命令式的 `devWarn`。

usage.en:
Fires a dev-only "Component: message" console warning once per mount while the condition holds. It is the safe way for a component to flag misuse: the same check written straight into a `computed` getter or a `watch` callback repeats on every change, and gating it with state adds a re-render, so this watches the condition instead and warns once. For a warning outside a component, use the imperative `devWarn` utility.

```ts
import { useDevWarning } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

`devWarn` comes from the same entry: `import { devWarn } from '@astryx-vue/core'`. It writes the same `Component: message` line without needing a component instance, and it is stripped from production builds the same way.
usage.zh:
条件成立时打一条 `Component: message` 形式的控制台警告，只在开发构建里输出，每次挂载只打一次。组件想指出用法错误时用它最稳：同样的检查直接写在 `computed` 的取值函数或 `watch` 回调里，每次变化都会再跑一遍；用状态挡下来又多一次渲染。所以这里改成盯着条件，条件第一次成立时警告一次。组件之外要警告，用命令式的 `devWarn`。

```ts
import { useDevWarning } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

`devWarn` 也从同一个入口拿出来：`import { devWarn } from '@astryx-vue/core'`。它不需要组件实例，输出同样的 `Component: message`，生产构建里同样会被整段去掉。

en.text: Say what is wrong and what the builder should do instead; the message is the whole value of the warning.
Warn about combinations the types cannot express, such as two mutually exclusive props being set together.
Use it for anything a user could see or for runtime error handling; it is stripped from production builds.

rows.name: `component`
rows.description: Component or hook name, used as the message prefix. Required.

rows.name: `message`
rows.description: What went wrong and how to fix it. Required.

rows.name: `condition`
rows.description: Whether to warn. A plain boolean, a `ref`, or a getter all work. The first time it is true during a mount the warning fires once, and toggling it again in the same mount stays quiet.
Nothing is returned. The watcher stops when the component or effect scope is disposed, and in a production build the function does nothing at all.

rows.name: `component`
rows.description: 组件或组合式函数的名字，用作消息前缀。必填。

rows.name: `message`
rows.description: 哪里错了、该怎么改。必填。

rows.name: `condition`
rows.description: 是否要警告。普通布尔值、`ref`、getter 都行。一次挂载里第一次成立时警告一次，之后再反复变成 true 也不再输出。
没有返回值。组件或作用域销毁时 watch 自动停掉；生产构建里这个函数什么也不做。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 先说清哪里错了，再说清应该怎么改。警告的全部价值就在这句话里。
- 推荐: 用来提示类型表达不了的组合，例如两个互斥的 prop 同时给了值。
- 避免: 拿它做用户看得见的提示，或当运行时报错用。生产构建里它会被去掉。

summary.en: Returns a class for animating an element on mount. Only animates when the element is dynamically inserted after the initial page paint; elements rendered on page load are not animated. Uses Astryx motion tokens (duration, easing) for consistent animation timing. Nothing animates during server rendering.
summary.zh: 返回一个 class，元素挂载时用它播放入场动画。只有首屏画完之后才动态插进来的元素才有动画；页面一开始就渲染出来的元素不播。时长和缓动取自 Astryx 的 motion token，动画节奏和其他地方保持一致。服务端渲染时不会有任何动画。

usage.en:
Returns a class for animating an element on mount. Only animates when the element is dynamically inserted after the initial page paint; elements rendered on page load are not animated. Uses Astryx motion tokens (duration, easing) for consistent animation timing. Nothing animates during server rendering.

```ts
import { useEntryAnimation } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

Bind the returned `entryClass` next to the element's own classes; Vue merges `class` bindings, so it never replaces them. `entryClass` is `null` when the element should not animate, and a class binding drops `null`, which is exactly the behavior you want. The class carries the shared keyframes from `styles/motion.css`, so duration, easing, and the reduced-motion fallback all come from the theme.
usage.zh:
返回一个 class，元素挂载时用它播放入场动画。只有首屏画完之后才动态插进来的元素才有动画；页面一开始就渲染出来的元素不播。时长和缓动取自 Astryx 的 motion token，动画节奏和其他地方保持一致。服务端渲染时不会有任何动画。

```ts
import { useEntryAnimation } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

把返回的 `entryClass` 和元素自己的 class 写在一起；Vue 会合并 `class` 绑定，不会把原来的覆盖掉。不该播动画时 `entryClass` 是 `null`，而 `null` 会被 class 绑定直接丢掉，正好是不播的效果。这个 class 带的是 `styles/motion.css` 里那套共享关键帧，所以时长、缓动和「减少动态效果」的兜底都跟着主题走。

en.text: Use for conditionally rendered elements like validation messages, toasts, or expanding sections.
Add the returned class next to the element's own classes, so the animation stacks with its styling instead of replacing it.
Use for elements that should be visible on initial page load; they will not animate.

rows.name: `preset`
rows.description: Animation preset to apply on mount. `slideDown` drops in from above, `slideUp` rises from below, `fadeIn` only fades, and `scaleIn` fades while scaling up.

rows.name: `entryClass`
rows.description: A shared motion class for the entry animation, or `null` if the element was rendered on initial page load (no animation needed). One of `astryx-motion-slide-in-below`, `astryx-motion-slide-in-above`, `astryx-motion-fade-in`, or `astryx-motion-scale-in`.

rows.name: `preset`
rows.description: 挂载时播放的动画。`slideDown` 从上方落下来，`slideUp` 从下方升上来，`fadeIn` 只淡入，`scaleIn` 一边放大一边淡入。

rows.name: `entryClass`
rows.description: 入场动画用的共享 class；元素是在首屏渲染出来的（不需要动画）时为 `null`。取值是 `astryx-motion-slide-in-below`、`astryx-motion-slide-in-above`、`astryx-motion-fade-in`、`astryx-motion-scale-in` 之一。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用在按条件渲染的元素上：校验提示、toast、展开的区块。
- 推荐: 把返回的 class 和元素自己的 class 写在一起，动画叠在原有样式上，而不是替掉它。
- 避免: 用在首屏就该看见的元素上。它们不会播动画。

summary.en: Traps focus within a container element following the WAI-ARIA dialog focus trap pattern. While the trap is active it listens to `keydown` on the document and wraps Tab and Shift+Tab, so focus cycles inside the container instead of leaving it. Turning the trap on also moves focus in: the element returned by `initialFocus`, or else the first focusable element. Turning it off is the whole teardown, so a dialog can toggle the state without unmounting the hook.
summary.zh: `useFocusTrap` 就像一个看不见的小管家，遵循 WAI-ARIA 规范，负责把键盘的光标焦点规整地关在指定的弹窗或容器里。

usage.en: Traps focus within a container element following the WAI-ARIA dialog focus trap pattern. While the trap is active it listens to `keydown` on the document and wraps Tab and Shift+Tab, so focus cycles inside the container instead of leaving it. Turning the trap on also moves focus in: the element returned by `initialFocus`, or else the first focusable element. Turning it off is the whole teardown, so a dialog can toggle the state without unmounting the hook. When the trap deactivates or unmounts, focus goes back to the element that was focused before activation. It stays put when focus was already moved elsewhere, or when focus never entered the trap — so a popup that keeps focus on its trigger, like a combobox, is left alone. Focus returned after a pointer close lands on the trigger without a focus ring; after a keyboard close the ring shows as usual. Tab is cancelled only while focus is inside the container, so a layer that is open while focus legitimately sits outside it does not take Tab away from the page. When initial focus sits on the container itself, Tab moves into the tabbable cycle. An Escape that cancels an input-method composition does not call `onEscape`. Mouse clicks outside the container are not intercepted; use a light-dismiss handler for that. ```ts import { useFocusTrap } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```
usage.zh: `useFocusTrap` 就像一个看不见的小管家，遵循 WAI-ARIA 规范，负责把键盘的光标焦点规整地关在指定的弹窗或容器里。 当弹窗打开并且焦点陷阱激活时，用户不断按下 Tab 键切换焦点，如果按到了容器里的最后一个按钮，再按 Tab 键就会悄悄绕回容器的第一个元素，焦点永远在弹窗内部循环，绝对不会不小心跳到背景网页上。打开陷阱时，它还会把光标焦点送进容器内部：优先定位到 `initialFocus` 指定的元素上，如果没有指定就会自动停留在第一个可以聚焦的元素上。 当弹窗关闭或陷阱解除时，它会把焦点原路还给刚才点开它的那个元素，确保键盘操作流程顺畅完整。焦点从没进过容器（比如焦点一直留在输入框上的下拉列表），或者已经被挪到别处时，就不还。用鼠标或手指关掉的，焦点回到触发器上但不画焦点环；用键盘关掉的照常画。 Tab 键只在焦点真的在容器里面时才会被拦下，浮层开着、焦点合理地留在外面时，整个页面照样能用 Tab。程序把初始焦点放在容器自己身上时，按 Tab 会进入里面的循环。输入法正在拼字时按的 Escape 是取消拼字，不会触发 `onEscape`。在容器外面用鼠标点击不会被拦截，方便实现点击遮罩空白处关闭弹窗。 **什么时候用：** - 编写自定义的模态对话框（Modal）、抽屉（Drawer）等全屏遮罩浮层，需要限制键盘焦点不能跑到弹窗外面时。 **什么时候不要用：** - 像 Tooltip（文字提示）、下拉菜单（DropdownMenu）这类普通的浮层，请不要把焦点强行关在里面；它们需要的是轻量的点击外部关闭，而不是把焦点牢牢锁死。 - 如果已经使用了官方的 [Dialog](/components/dialog) 或 [AlertDialog](/components/alert-dialog)，它们底层已经内置好了完备的焦点管理逻辑，无需再手动调用 `useFocusTrap`。 ```ts import { useFocusTrap } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Call `focusFirst()` when opening a dialog/modal to move focus into the trapped region.
Provide an `onEscape` callback to close the dialog when Escape is pressed.
Rely on the built-in focus restoration on close; only add your own focus handling when you need to send focus somewhere other than the previously-focused element.
Use on non-modal content like tooltips or dropdowns; those need light-dismiss, not focus trapping.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for the focus trap. Every field inside it is optional.

rows.name: `options.container`
rows.description: The element that traps focus. Bind the same template ref in the template. Leave it out and the hook creates its own, returned as `containerRef`.

rows.name: `options.isActive`
rows.description: Whether the focus trap is currently active. Turning it on installs the listeners and moves focus in; turning it off removes them and restores focus. `isEnabled` is the same switch under its other name; either one being true activates the trap.

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: The same switch as `isActive`, for callers that read better with it. Pass either name, not both.

rows.name: `options.onEscape`
rows.description: Callback when Escape is pressed inside the trapped container. The trap does not consume the key: a light-dismiss handler beside it still sees the event.

rows.name: `options.initialFocus`
rows.description: Element to focus when the trap turns on. Return `null` to fall back to the first focusable element.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Ref to attach to the container element that should trap focus. It is the ref you passed as `container`, or the one the hook made for you.

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: Focuses the first focusable element inside the container.

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: Focuses the last focusable element inside the container.

rows.name: `update`
rows.description: Kept for callers that re-measure after the container's children change. It does nothing: the focusable elements are read on each key press.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 焦点陷阱的配置对象。里面的字段都是可选的。

rows.name: `options.container`
rows.description: 要关住焦点的元素。模板里绑同一个模板引用。不传也行，hook 自己建一个，从返回值的 `containerRef` 取。

rows.name: `options.isActive`
rows.description: 陷阱当前是否生效。打开时装上监听并把焦点送进去，关闭时摘掉监听并把焦点还回去。`isEnabled` 是同一个开关的另一个名字，任一为真即生效。

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: 和 `isActive` 是同一个开关，习惯哪个名字就用哪个。两个都传没意义。

rows.name: `options.onEscape`
rows.description: 容器里按下 Escape 时调用。陷阱不吞这个键：旁边的轻关闭处理照样收得到。

rows.name: `options.initialFocus`
rows.description: 陷阱打开时先聚焦哪个元素。返回 `null` 就退回第一个可聚焦元素。

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: 绑到要关住焦点的容器上的 ref。就是你传进来的 `container`，没传时是 hook 自己建的那个。

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: 聚焦容器里的第一个可聚焦元素。

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: 聚焦容器里的最后一个可聚焦元素。

rows.name: `update`
rows.description: 留给需要在子元素变化后重新测量的调用方。它什么都不做：可聚焦元素在每次按键时都会重新读。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 打开对话框或模态时调 `focusFirst()`，把焦点送进被关住的区域。
- 推荐: 传 `onEscape`，容器里按下 Escape 时关掉对话框。
- 推荐: 关闭后的焦点还原用内置的就行；只有确实要送别处时，才自己再写一套。
- 避免: 用在 Tooltip、下拉菜单这类非模态内容上；它们要的是轻关闭，不是关住焦点。

summary.en: Manages keyboard navigation within a 2D grid following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern. Supports arrow keys for cell-to-cell navigation, Home/End for row boundaries, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End for grid boundaries, and Page Up/Down for custom callbacks (e.g., month navigation in calendars). Boundary navigation callbacks allow cross-grid navigation.
summary.zh: 按 WAI-ARIA 的 grid 模式管二维网格里的键盘导航。方向键一格一格走，Home/End 走到当前行的首尾，Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End 走到整张网格的首尾，Page Up/Down 交给调用方（日历里就是翻月）。走到边界时可以把事件交出去，让另一张网格接住焦点，例如翻到上个月后继续用方向键。

usage.en:
Manages keyboard navigation within a 2D grid following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern. Supports arrow keys for cell-to-cell navigation, Home/End for row boundaries, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End for grid boundaries, and Page Up/Down for custom callbacks (e.g., month navigation in calendars). Boundary navigation callbacks allow cross-grid navigation.

```ts
import { useGridFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

The hook reads the cells out of the DOM, so `gridRef` and `handleKeyDown` go on the grid container. `handleFocus` goes on the container's `focusin` event: a `focus` event does not bubble in the DOM, so `@focus` on the container would never hear the cells.
usage.zh:
按 WAI-ARIA 的 grid 模式管二维网格里的键盘导航。方向键一格一格走，Home/End 走到当前行的首尾，Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End 走到整张网格的首尾，Page Up/Down 交给调用方（日历里就是翻月）。走到边界时可以把事件交出去，让另一张网格接住焦点，例如翻到上个月后继续用方向键。

```ts
import { useGridFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

这个函数从 DOM 里读格子，所以 `gridRef` 和 `handleKeyDown` 挂在网格容器上。`handleFocus` 挂在容器的 `focusin` 上：DOM 里 `focus` 不冒泡，挂在容器的 `@focus` 上永远听不到格子的焦点。

en.text: Use for calendar date grids: wire `onPageUp` / `onPageDown` to month navigation and `onNavigateBefore` / `onNavigateAfter` for cross-month arrow key navigation.
Attach both `gridRef` and `handleKeyDown` to the grid container element.

For roving-tabindex grids (e.g. Calendar), set `hasRovingTabIndex: true` and attach `handleFocus` to the container's `focusin` event; seed one focus target with `tabindex="0"` and the hook repairs and moves it.
Use for simple linear lists; prefer `useListFocus` for 1D navigation.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for grid focus behavior. Required.

rows.name: `options.columns`
rows.description: Number of columns in the grid. Used for up/down navigation (moves by this many cells). Required.

rows.name: `options.cellSelector`
rows.description: Selector for cells within the grid. Should match ALL cell positions in DOM order (including disabled/empty) so grid geometry is preserved.

rows.name: `options.isCellFocusable`
rows.description: Predicate for whether a matched cell can receive focus. Omit to treat every matched cell as focusable.

rows.name: `options.getFocusTarget`
rows.description: Resolves the element to focus for a cell, e.g. a button inside a `role="gridcell"` wrapper.

rows.name: `options.onNavigateBefore`
rows.description: Callback when navigation would go before the first cell. Receives the current column index and the offset (1 for horizontal, columns for vertical).

rows.name: `options.onNavigateAfter`
rows.description: Callback when navigation would go after the last cell. Receives the current column index and the offset.

rows.name: `options.onPageUp`
rows.description: Callback for Page Up (e.g., navigate to the previous month in calendars). Without it the key is left alone.

rows.name: `options.onPageDown`
rows.description: Callback for Page Down (e.g., navigate to the next month in calendars). Without it the key is left alone.

rows.name: `options.hasRovingTabIndex`

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用在日历这种日期网格上：`onPageUp` / `onPageDown` 接翻月，`onNavigateBefore` / `onNavigateAfter` 接跨月继续用方向键。
- 推荐: `gridRef` 和 `handleKeyDown` 都挂在网格容器上。
- 推荐: 用 roving tabindex 的网格（例如日历）打开 `hasRovingTabIndex: true`，把 `handleFocus` 挂在容器的 `focusin` 上；先给一个目标元素写 `tabindex="0"`，函数会自己修正并移动它。
- 不要: 用它做普通的一维列表；一维导航用 `useListFocus`。

summary.en: Registers global keyboard shortcuts with a single window `keydown` listener per hook instance. The shortcut list is read from a ref or getter, so updating it never re-subscribes. Skips events from typing targets (`input`, `textarea`, `select`, `contenteditable`) unless `allowInInputs`, skips `defaultPrevented` events, skips keys that belong to an IME composition, and calls `preventDefault()` on match. SSR-safe: the listener is only installed on mount.
summary.zh: 注册全局快捷键。每个 hook 实例只在 window 上挂一个 `keydown` 监听。快捷键列表从一个 ref 或 getter 读，列表变化不会重新订阅。焦点在输入控件里（`input`、`textarea`、`select`、`contenteditable`）时默认不触发，除非这一条写了 `allowInInputs`；已经 `defaultPrevented` 的事件跳过，输入法组合中用到的键也跳过；命中时调用 `preventDefault()`。SSR 安全：监听只在挂载时装上。

usage.en:
Registers global keyboard shortcuts with a single window `keydown` listener per hook instance. The shortcut list is read from a ref or getter, so updating it never re-subscribes. Skips events from typing targets (`input`, `textarea`, `select`, `contenteditable`) unless `allowInInputs`, skips `defaultPrevented` events, skips keys that belong to an IME composition, and calls `preventDefault()` on match. SSR-safe: the listener is only installed on mount.

```ts
import { useHotkeys } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

The listener is removed when the component unmounts, not when the list changes.
usage.zh:
注册全局快捷键。每个 hook 实例只在 window 上挂一个 `keydown` 监听。快捷键列表从一个 ref 或 getter 读，列表变化不会重新订阅。焦点在输入控件里（`input`、`textarea`、`select`、`contenteditable`）时默认不触发，除非这一条写了 `allowInInputs`；已经 `defaultPrevented` 的事件跳过，输入法组合中用到的键也跳过；命中时调用 `preventDefault()`。SSR 安全：监听只在挂载时装上。

```ts
import { useHotkeys } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

监听在组件卸载时摘掉，列表变化时不会重挂。

en.text: Use for app-level shortcuts like command palettes (`mod+k`), help overlays (`shift+/`), and navigation keys.
Pair with the `Kbd` component to display the same combo you register; both resolve `mod` per platform identically.
Use `isDisabled` to suspend shortcuts while a modal or wizard owns the keyboard, instead of unmounting the hook.
Use for focus-scoped keyboard navigation inside a widget; use `useListFocus` or `useGridRovingFocus` instead.

rows.description: Shortcut registrations. A plain array, a ref, or a getter all work; the list is read on each key press. Required.

Aliases: `esc`, `space`, `up`, `down`, `left`, `right`, `return`, and `plus` for a literal `+`. Without `shift` in the combo, the shift state is ignored, so a single letter does not care about case.

rows.name: `hotkeys[].onPress`
rows.description: Called when the combo matches, after `preventDefault()`.

rows.name: `hotkeys[].allowInInputs`
rows.description: Lets the hotkey fire while typing in an input, textarea, select, or contenteditable region.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用于应用级快捷键：命令面板（`mod+k`）、帮助浮层（`shift+/`）、导航键。
- 推荐: 用 `Kbd` 组件把同一条组合显示出来；两边对 `mod` 的平台判断是同一套。
- 推荐: 弹窗或向导占用键盘时，用 `isDisabled` 暂时停掉快捷键，而不是把 hook 卸掉。
- 避免: 用它做控件内部的焦点导航；那种场景用 `useListFocus` 或 `useGridRovingFocus`。

summary.en: Headless hook for hover-triggered floating cards. Builds on `useLayer` with hover/focus intent detection, configurable delays, safe hover behavior, and accessible `aria-describedby` linking. Use for rich previews on hover when you need full control over the trigger or rendered content.
summary.zh: 悬停触发的浮层卡片。它在 `useLayer` 之上加了悬停 / 焦点意图识别、可配置延迟、安全的悬停行为，以及 `aria-describedby` 关联。需要完全掌控触发器或卡片内容时用它。

usage.en: Headless hook for hover-triggered floating cards. Builds on `useLayer` with hover/focus intent detection, configurable delays, safe hover behavior, and accessible `aria-describedby` linking. Use for rich previews on hover when you need full control over the trigger or rendered content. ```ts import { useHoverCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/HoverCard' ``` Bind `triggerRef` to the element that reveals the card. The hook attaches the pointer, focus, and touch handlers and keeps the card open while the pointer travels into it. Render the surface yourself and spread `contentProps` on it: ```vue ``` With a `label` the card is exposed as a named `role="dialog"` and the trigger advertises it with `aria-haspopup` / `aria-controls` / `aria-expanded`. Without one it falls back to `role="group"` and an `aria-describedby` link. `contentProps` carries the role, the label, and the handlers that keep the card open.
usage.zh: 悬停触发的浮层卡片。它在 `useLayer` 之上加了悬停 / 焦点意图识别、可配置延迟、安全的悬停行为，以及 `aria-describedby` 关联。需要完全掌控触发器或卡片内容时用它。 ```ts import { useHoverCard } from '@astryx-vue/core/HoverCard' ``` 把 `triggerRef` 绑到要弹卡片的元素上：hook 会挂指针、焦点和触摸处理，并让指针能移进卡片而不中途关闭。卡片自己渲染，把 `contentProps` 摊上去： ```vue ``` 给了 `label`，卡片就是有名字的 `role="dialog"`，触发器用 `aria-haspopup` / `aria-controls` / `aria-expanded` 宣告它；不给就退回 `role="group"`，走 `aria-describedby`。`contentProps` 里带着 role、label，以及保持卡片打开的处理函数。

summary.en: Detects whether an image is predominantly dark or light by sampling pixels through `OffscreenCanvas`. Uses APCA perceptual lightness (sRGB linearization plus a power curve) for accurate detection, especially on saturated colors. Runs entirely off the paint path: no visible canvas, no layout thrash. Supports regional sampling for detecting luminance where text overlays will appear. Returns `null` while loading and falls back gracefully on CORS or network errors.
summary.zh: 采样图片的像素，判断它整体偏暗还是偏亮。采样通过 `OffscreenCanvas` 进行，不往页面上画任何东西。亮度用 APCA 的感知亮度（先把 sRGB 线性化，再做一次幂曲线），饱和色也能判得准。整个过程不在绘制路径上：没有可见画布，也不会引起布局抖动。可以只采一块区域，用来判断文字浮层所在位置的亮度。还在加载时返回 `null`，跨域或网络失败时退回 `fallback`。

usage.en:
Detects whether an image is predominantly dark or light by sampling pixels through `OffscreenCanvas`. Uses APCA perceptual lightness (sRGB linearization plus a power curve) for accurate detection, especially on saturated colors. Runs entirely off the paint path: no visible canvas, no layout thrash. Supports regional sampling for detecting luminance where text overlays will appear. Returns `null` while loading and falls back gracefully on CORS or network errors.

The image is fetched, drawn into a 10×10 offscreen canvas, and averaged, so a new `src` cancels the answer that is still in flight. `src` and `options` may be refs or getters.

```ts
import { useImageMode } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
采样图片的像素，判断它整体偏暗还是偏亮。采样通过 `OffscreenCanvas` 进行，不往页面上画任何东西。亮度用 APCA 的感知亮度（先把 sRGB 线性化，再做一次幂曲线），饱和色也能判得准。整个过程不在绘制路径上：没有可见画布，也不会引起布局抖动。可以只采一块区域，用来判断文字浮层所在位置的亮度。还在加载时返回 `null`，跨域或网络失败时退回 `fallback`。

实现上会先 fetch 图片，画进 10×10 的离屏画布再取平均，所以 `src` 一变，还没回来的那次结果就作废。`src` 和 `options` 都可以写成 ref 或 getter。

```ts
import { useImageMode } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Pair with `MediaTheme` to automatically adapt text color over dynamic background images.
Use the `region` option to sample only the area where text overlays will appear for more accurate results.
Use for images that change rapidly (e.g. video frames); each `src` change triggers a new fetch and analysis.

rows.name: `src`
rows.description: Image source URL to analyze. A plain string, a ref, or a getter. When null or undefined, the result is the fallback value. Required.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Optional configuration for the analysis. Read on each run, so a getter keeps it current.

rows.name: `options.region`
rows.description: Region to sample within the image, using normalized 0-1 coordinates `{ x, y, width, height }`.

rows.name: `options.threshold`
rows.description: Luminance threshold for the dark/light split. Below is dark, above is light.

rows.name: `options.fallback`
rows.description: Value returned while loading or on error.

rows.name: `mode`
rows.description: Detected luminance mode of the image. Returns `null` while loading, or the fallback when `src` is null or undefined.

rows.name: `src`
rows.description: 要分析的图片地址。普通字符串、ref、getter 都行。为 null 或 undefined 时直接给 `fallback`。必填。

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 分析的可选配置。每次分析时重新读，写成 getter 就能一直取到最新值。

rows.name: `options.region`
rows.description: 只采这一块。坐标都按 0 到 1 的比例给出：`{ x, y, width, height }`。

rows.name: `options.threshold`
rows.description: 分深浅的亮度阈值。低于算暗，高于算亮。

rows.name: `options.fallback`
rows.description: 还在加载，或者读图失败时返回的值。

rows.name: `mode`
rows.description: 图片的深浅。还在加载时是 `null`，`src` 为空时是 `fallback`。

en.heading: Returns
en.text: The two pieces of the analysis are exported too: `perceptualLightness(r, g, b)` returns the APCA lightness of one color, and `imageModeFromPixels(pixels, threshold)` averages an RGBA buffer into `'dark'` or `'light'`.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 和 `MediaTheme` 一起用，让图片上的文字颜色跟着背景图自动切换。
- 推荐: 用 `region` 只采文字浮层会出现的那一块，结果更准。
- 避免: 用在变化很快的图上（例如视频帧）；每次 `src` 变化都会重新拉取和分析。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: 分析的两段也一起导出了：`perceptualLightness(r, g, b)` 返回一个颜色的 APCA 感知亮度，`imageModeFromPixels(pixels, threshold)` 把一段 RGBA 像素平均成 `'dark'` 或 `'light'`。

summary.en: Hook for showing an alert dialog without managing open state. Call `alert.show(options)` to open and `alert.hide()` to close. Render `alert.Host` once in your template.
summary.zh: 不用自己管「开没开」这个状态，就能弹出一个警示对话框。调 `alert.show(options)` 打开，调 `alert.hide()` 关掉。把 `alert.Host` 在模板里渲染一次即可。

usage.en:
Hook for showing an alert dialog without managing open state. Call `alert.show(options)` to open and `alert.hide()` to close. Render `alert.Host` once in your template.

```ts
import { useImperativeAlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useImperativeAlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'

const alert = useImperativeAlertDialog()
const AlertHost = alert.Host

function askToDelete(): void {
  alert.show({
    title: 'Delete item?',
    description: 'This action cannot be undone.',
    actionLabel: 'Delete',
    onAction: () => alert.hide(),
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="askToDelete">
    Delete item
  </button>
  <AlertHost />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
不用自己管「开没开」这个状态，就能弹出一个警示对话框。调 `alert.show(options)` 打开，调 `alert.hide()` 关掉。把 `alert.Host` 在模板里渲染一次即可。

```ts
import { useImperativeAlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useImperativeAlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'

const alert = useImperativeAlertDialog()
const AlertHost = alert.Host

function askToDelete(): void {
  alert.show({
    title: '删除这一项？',
    description: '删除之后无法恢复。',
    actionLabel: '删除',
    onAction: () => alert.hide(),
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="askToDelete">
    删除
  </button>
  <AlertHost />
</template>
```

usage.en:
Hook for showing a dialog without managing open state. Call `dialog.show(content, options)` to open and `dialog.hide()` to close. Render `dialog.Host` once in your template.

```ts
import { useImperativeDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogHeader, useImperativeDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/Dialog'
import { h } from 'vue'

const dialog = useImperativeDialog({ width: 400 })
const DialogHost = dialog.Host

function askToDelete(): void {
  dialog.show(
    () => h(DialogHeader, { title: 'Delete project?', hasCloseButton: true }),
    { purpose: 'form' },
  )
}
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="askToDelete">
    Delete project
  </button>
  <DialogHost />
</template>
```

summary.en: Draws the standard focus ring on the indicator of a control whose real input is visually hidden; a checkbox or radio focuses an opacity-0 input, so the ring has to appear on the picture beside it. The ring is painted on the indicator's own element, which is the only element whose border-radius can shape it, and only on `:focus-visible`, so pointer clicks stay quiet. Owning it here means a theme-supplied indicator cannot ship a control with no visible focus (WCAG 2.4.7) by ignoring a prop.
summary.zh: 给「真输入框看不见、画面上的图形代替它」的控件画标准焦点环。复选框和单选框真正的 input 是透明的，焦点环只能画在旁边那个图形上。环画在指示器自己的元素上，只有这个元素自己的圆角能决定环的形状；而且只在 `:focus-visible` 时画，鼠标点一下不会亮。统一放在这里管，主题换掉指示器也不会出现「控件没有可见焦点」（WCAG 2.4.7）——不会因为主题漏了一个属性就整块没法用键盘。

usage.en:
Draws the standard focus ring on the indicator of a control whose real input is visually hidden; a checkbox or radio focuses an opacity-0 input, so the ring has to appear on the picture beside it. The ring is painted on the indicator's own element, which is the only element whose border-radius can shape it, and only on `:focus-visible`, so pointer clicks stay quiet. Owning it here means a theme-supplied indicator cannot ship a control with no visible focus (WCAG 2.4.7) by ignoring a prop.

```ts
import { useIndicatorFocusRing } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

The ring is drawn by the `styles/indicator-focus-ring.css` stylesheet that this hook brings along: the hook marks the indicator with `data-astryx-focus-ring` and the stylesheet paints the outline from the theme's focus tokens. In a template, bind `focusProps.onFocus` to `@focusin` and `focusProps.onBlur` to `@focusout` on the wrapper, because a `focus` event does not bubble in the DOM.
usage.zh:
给「真输入框看不见、画面上的图形代替它」的控件画标准焦点环。复选框和单选框真正的 input 是透明的，焦点环只能画在旁边那个图形上。环画在指示器自己的元素上，只有这个元素自己的圆角能决定环的形状；而且只在 `:focus-visible` 时画，鼠标点一下不会亮。统一放在这里管，主题换掉指示器也不会出现「控件没有可见焦点」（WCAG 2.4.7）——不会因为主题漏了一个属性就整块没法用键盘。

```ts
import { useIndicatorFocusRing } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

环由这个函数带上的 `styles/indicator-focus-ring.css` 画：函数给指示器加上 `data-astryx-focus-ring`，样式表用主题里的焦点色描边。模板里把 `focusProps.onFocus` 绑到 `@focusin`、`focusProps.onBlur` 绑到 `@focusout`，因为 DOM 里 `focus` 不冒泡。

en.text: Wrap only the indicator in the ref'd element; a wrapper holding label text would ring the whole row.
Bind `focusProps` on the element that contains the hidden input (`@focusin` / `@focusout`), not on the input itself.
Ask a themeable indicator to draw its own focus ring; a replacement that ignores the prop leaves the control with no visible focus.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Ref to an element wrapping only the indicator, so its single element child is unambiguously the thing to ring. Required.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Skip the ring; a disabled control is not focusable.

rows.name: `focusProps`
rows.description: Bind on the element that owns the focusable input: `onFocus` to `@focusin`, `onBlur` to `@focusout`.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: 必填。只包住指示器的那个元素。它唯一的元素子节点就是要画环的东西。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 停用时跳过焦点环，因为停用的控件本来就接不到焦点。

rows.name: `focusProps`
rows.description: 绑在拿着可聚焦输入框的那个元素上：`onFocus` 绑 `@focusin`，`onBlur` 绑 `@focusout`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 被 ref 指向的元素只包指示器；连文案一起包会把整行都圈起来。
- 推荐: `focusProps` 绑在「包着那个隐藏输入框」的元素上（`@focusin` / `@focusout`），不要绑在输入框自己身上。
- 不要: 让主题里的指示器自己画焦点环；换一个不理这个属性的指示器，控件就没有可见焦点了。

summary.en: Makes an input container wrapper clickable, delegating focus to the inner input/textarea when the user clicks non-interactive areas (icons, padding, status indicators). Built on top of `useClickableContainer`, so nested interactive elements (clear buttons, calendar toggles, links) are handled safely; clicking them does NOT steal focus from the input. Automatically detects input type: text-like inputs receive `.focus()`, while other types (checkbox, radio, file) receive `.click()`.
summary.zh: 让输入框外面那一圈也能点：点在图标、内边距、状态图标这些没有交互的地方时，把焦点交给里面的输入框或文本域。底座是 `useClickableContainer`，所以清空按钮、日历开关、链接这些嵌套的控件点上去还是它们自己的事，不会把焦点从输入框抢走。输入类型会自己判断：文本类的输入框收 `.focus()`，复选框、单选框、文件这类收 `.click()`。

usage.en:
Makes an input container wrapper clickable, delegating focus to the inner input/textarea when the user clicks non-interactive areas (icons, padding, status indicators). Built on top of `useClickableContainer`, so nested interactive elements (clear buttons, calendar toggles, links) are handled safely; clicking them does NOT steal focus from the input. Automatically detects input type: text-like inputs receive `.focus()`, while other types (checkbox, radio, file) receive `.click()`.

```ts
import { useInputContainer } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

Put `ref` on the wrapper and on the inner input, then attach `onClick` to `@click` and `onMouseUp` to `@mouseup` on the wrapper. The hook adds `data-pressable-container` to that wrapper on the first click, so nested containers do not fight over the same click.
usage.zh:
让输入框外面那一圈也能点：点在图标、内边距、状态图标这些没有交互的地方时，把焦点交给里面的输入框或文本域。底座是 `useClickableContainer`，所以清空按钮、日历开关、链接这些嵌套的控件点上去还是它们自己的事，不会把焦点从输入框抢走。输入类型会自己判断：文本类的输入框收 `.focus()`，复选框、单选框、文件这类收 `.click()`。

```ts
import { useInputContainer } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

外层的包装元素和里面的输入框各挂一个 `ref`，再把 `onClick` 挂到包装元素的 `@click`、`onMouseUp` 挂到 `@mouseup`。第一次点击时这个函数会给包装元素加上 `data-pressable-container`，嵌套的可点容器因此不会抢同一次点击。

en.text: Use inside input wrapper components (TextInput, NumberInput, TimeInput, TextArea) to make the full container area clickable.
Attach both `onClick` and `onMouseUp` to the wrapper element for full interaction handling.
Use on bare inputs without a wrapper; there is no benefit if the input already fills the full clickable area.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for the input container. Required.

rows.name: `options.containerRef`
rows.description: Ref to the outer container/wrapper element. Required.

rows.name: `options.inputRef`
rows.description: Ref to the inner input, textarea, or other focusable control. Required.

rows.name: `options.disabled`
rows.description: Whether the input is disabled. Read again on every event.

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: Click handler to attach to the container wrapper.

rows.name: `onMouseUp`
rows.description: Mouse up handler to attach to the container wrapper.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 必填。输入框容器的配置对象。

rows.name: `options.containerRef`
rows.description: 必填。外层容器（要变成可点的那一圈）的 ref。

rows.name: `options.inputRef`
rows.description: 必填。里面那个输入框、文本域或别的可聚焦控件的 ref。

rows.name: `options.disabled`
rows.description: 输入框是否停用。每次事件都重新读一次。

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: 挂到外层容器的 `click` 上。

rows.name: `onMouseUp`
rows.description: 挂到外层容器的 `mouseup` 上。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用在把输入框包起来的组件里（TextInput、NumberInput、TimeInput、TextArea），让整块容器都能点。
- 推荐: `onClick` 和 `onMouseUp` 都挂到外层那个元素上，交互才完整。
- 不要: 用在没有外层包装的裸输入框上；输入框本来就铺满可点区域，套上去没有好处。

summary.en: Builds the on-field status affordance for a bordered input, so every input in the family behaves the same for a given status. The attached variant renders a plain glyph and leaves the text to the message box; the detached variant renders nothing here, because the message box already carries its own icon; the tooltip variant renders a real focusable button whose tooltip is reachable by keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive tech. Use it when building a bordered input, not for field-level messaging.
summary.zh: 决定带边框的输入框里那颗状态图标画什么，让同一状态下这一类输入框长得一样。`attached` 只画一个图形，文案留给下面的状态栏；`detached` 这里什么都不画，因为状态栏自己带了图标；`tooltip` 画一个真按钮，键盘、鼠标、触摸、读屏都能摸到它的说明。给带边框的输入框用它，不要拿它做字段级的提示文案。

usage.en:
Builds the on-field status affordance for a bordered input, so every input in the family behaves the same for a given status. The attached variant renders a plain glyph and leaves the text to the message box; the detached variant renders nothing here, because the message box already carries its own icon; the tooltip variant renders a real focusable button whose tooltip is reachable by keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive tech. Use it when building a bordered input, not for field-level messaging.

```ts
import { useInputStatusIcon } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

`statusIcon` is a component and `statusIconProps` are its props, so the pair renders as `<component :is="statusIcon" v-bind="statusIconProps" />` inside the input container.

The accessibility wiring stays with `Field` in this port: it already renders the status message as visually hidden text and puts it in the input's `aria-describedby`, and the info-tip button references its own tooltip, so the hook does not return an id of its own.
usage.zh:
决定带边框的输入框里那颗状态图标画什么，让同一状态下这一类输入框长得一样。`attached` 只画一个图形，文案留给下面的状态栏；`detached` 这里什么都不画，因为状态栏自己带了图标；`tooltip` 画一个真按钮，键盘、鼠标、触摸、读屏都能摸到它的说明。给带边框的输入框用它，不要拿它做字段级的提示文案。

```ts
import { useInputStatusIcon } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

`statusIcon` 是组件、`statusIconProps` 是它的属性，所以在输入框容器里写成 `<component :is="statusIcon" v-bind="statusIconProps" />`。

这个移植版里，无障碍那一半由 `Field` 管：它已经把状态文案渲染成视觉隐藏文本、接进输入框的 `aria-describedby`；信息按钮自己也引用着自己的 tooltip。所以这里不再返回 id。

en.text: Render `statusIcon` inside the input container with `statusIconProps`.
Let it decide when nothing should render; pass `isInGroup` and `statusVariant` through rather than branching at the call site.
Use it to convey the status by icon alone; the tooltip variant is the only one that carries the message, so the others still need a message box.

rows.name: `status`
rows.type: `FieldStatusInput | undefined`，或它的 ref / 取值函数
rows.description: 输入框的状态（类型加文案），没有状态就不传。

rows.name: `statusVariant`

- 推荐: 在输入框容器里渲染 `statusIcon`，属性接 `statusIconProps`。
- 推荐: 该不该画交给它判断，`isInGroup` 和 `statusVariant` 原样传进去，不要在调用处自己分支。

summary.en: Resolves what a polymorphic component should render as, in one place: href wins, then a click handler, then inert. Use it in any component that is sometimes a link, sometimes a button, and sometimes plain content; Token, Thumbnail and Item all do.
summary.zh: 把「这个多态组件到底渲染成什么」收在一处决定：有地址就是链接，没地址但有点击就是按钮，都没有就是一段普通内容。一个组件时而当链接、时而当按钮、时而只是内容的，都该走这里；Token、Thumbnail、Item 都是这么做的。

usage.en:
Resolves what a polymorphic component should render as, in one place: href wins, then a click handler, then inert. Use it in any component that is sometimes a link, sometimes a button, and sometimes plain content; Token, Thumbnail and Item all do.

```ts
import { useInteractiveRole } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

It takes a boolean for the click handler instead of the handler itself, because a function and a getter look the same in Vue: pass `hasOnClick: () => props.onClick != null`.

Upstream also reads an interactive trigger context supplied by a parent (Popover, DropdownMenu and friends), so a component built on it becomes a valid trigger for new surfaces without changing. The overlays in this port do not accept child elements as triggers, so there is no such context to read and the resolution stops at the click handler.
usage.zh:
把「这个多态组件到底渲染成什么」收在一处决定：有地址就是链接，没地址但有点击就是按钮，都没有就是一段普通内容。一个组件时而当链接、时而当按钮、时而只是内容的，都该走这里；Token、Thumbnail、Item 都是这么做的。

```ts
import { useInteractiveRole } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

点击这一项收的是布尔值，不是处理函数本身：Vue 里「函数」和「取值函数」分不开，传 `() => props.onClick` 会被当场调用掉，所以写成 `hasOnClick: () => props.onClick != null`。

上游还会读父级给的「触发上下文」（Popover、DropdownMenu 之类），让组件不用改就自动成为新浮层的合法触发器。这个移植版的浮层不支持用子元素当触发器，没有这份上下文可读，所以判断停在点击这一层。

en.text: Switch on the returned role to pick the element, and render an anchor only for `"link"` so keyboard and middle-click behavior come from the platform.
Pass `isDisabled` through rather than dropping the href yourself; the hook already ignores a disabled href when it resolves the role.
Add another ad-hoc href / click precedence check in a component; every consumer should inherit the same order.

rows.name: `options.href`
rows.type: `string | undefined`, or a ref / getter of it
rows.description: URL for navigation. Highest priority: with a non-empty href the component is a link.

rows.name: `options.hasOnClick`
rows.type: `boolean`, or a ref / getter of it
rows.description: Whether the component has a click handler. Resolves to a button, ahead of anything else after the href. Upstream takes the handler itself; a boolean keeps a handler and a getter apart.

rows.name: `options.isDisabled`
rows.type: `boolean`, or a ref / getter of it
rows.description: When true, href is ignored for role resolution (a disabled link is an anti-pattern), so the role comes from the click handler, then inert.

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: The element the component should render: an anchor, a button, or a non-interactive span / div.

rows.name: `options.href`
rows.type: `string | undefined`，或它的 ref / 取值函数
rows.description: 要跳转的地址。优先级最高：有非空地址就是链接。

rows.name: `options.hasOnClick`
rows.description: 组件有没有点击处理。地址之后轮到它：有就是按钮。上游收的是处理函数本身，这里收布尔值是为了把处理函数和取值函数分开。

rows.name: `options.isDisabled`
rows.description: 为真时判断角色不看 href（停用的链接本身就不该是链接），于是角色从点击往下找，都没有就是 inert。

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: 组件该渲染的元素：链接渲染 `a`，按钮渲染 `button`，剩下的是不带交互的 `span` / `div`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 按返回的角色挑元素，只有 `"link"` 才渲染 `a`，键盘和中键新开标签这些行为就由浏览器负责。
- 推荐: `isDisabled` 原样传进去，不要自己先把 href 丢掉；判断角色时它会自己忽略停用的地址。
- 不要: 在组件里再写一套 href / 点击谁优先的判断；所有组件都该用同一个顺序。

summary.en: Shows an ephemeral "← → to navigate" hint anchored to the focused item the first time a roving-tabindex composite receives keyboard focus. It teaches sighted keyboard users that arrow keys move within the group. The hint renders arrow keys with `Kbd`, is positioned `fixed` next to the focused element, so overflow containers never clip it, and is `aria-hidden`. It dismisses on the first arrow press, on timeout, or when focus leaves the group, and after a dismissal it does not show again for that instance. Reach for the hook directly when building a custom roving-tabindex widget; `Toolbar`, `TabList`, and `SegmentedControl` do not mount it for you.
summary.zh: 一组靠方向键移动的控件，第一次被键盘点进来时，在当前项旁边短暂提示一句「用方向键移动」。这是给看得见键盘用户的：告诉他方向键在这个组里能走。提示里的方向键用 `Kbd` 画，用 `fixed` 定位跟在当前项旁边，所以不会被滚动容器裁掉，并且是 `aria-hidden`。按过方向键、超时、或者焦点离开这个组，它都会自己关掉；关掉之后这个实例就不再提示。自己搭 roving-tabindex 控件时才会直接用到这个 hook；`Toolbar`、`TabList`、`SegmentedControl` 不会替你挂。

usage.en:
Shows an ephemeral "← → to navigate" hint anchored to the focused item the first time a roving-tabindex composite receives keyboard focus. It teaches sighted keyboard users that arrow keys move within the group. The hint renders arrow keys with `Kbd`, is positioned `fixed` next to the focused element, so overflow containers never clip it, and is `aria-hidden`. It dismisses on the first arrow press, on timeout, or when focus leaves the group, and after a dismissal it does not show again for that instance. Reach for the hook directly when building a custom roving-tabindex widget; `Toolbar`, `TabList`, and `SegmentedControl` do not mount it for you.

The `Hint` component returned by the hook is rendered inside the composite container, as its last child.

```ts
import { useKeyboardHint } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
一组靠方向键移动的控件，第一次被键盘点进来时，在当前项旁边短暂提示一句「用方向键移动」。这是给看得见键盘用户的：告诉他方向键在这个组里能走。提示里的方向键用 `Kbd` 画，用 `fixed` 定位跟在当前项旁边，所以不会被滚动容器裁掉，并且是 `aria-hidden`。按过方向键、超时、或者焦点离开这个组，它都会自己关掉；关掉之后这个实例就不再提示。自己搭 roving-tabindex 控件时才会直接用到这个 hook；`Toolbar`、`TabList`、`SegmentedControl` 不会替你挂。

hook 返回的 `Hint` 组件要放在这一组容器里面，作为最后一个子元素。

```ts
import { useKeyboardHint } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Compose the returned `onFocus` and `onKeyDown` with your existing handlers rather than replacing them: call `onKeyDown` first (it only dismisses, never prevents), then your navigation handler.
Render `Hint` as the last child of the composite container; it is `position: fixed` and `aria-hidden`, so it never affects layout or the accessibility tree.
Match `orientation` to the arrow keys your widget actually responds to so the hint shows the correct icons.
Use for single controls or widgets without roving-tabindex navigation; the hint only makes sense where arrows move focus within a group.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for the keyboard hint. Optional.

rows.name: `options.orientation`
rows.description: Which arrow-key axis the composite navigates, controlling which arrow icons the hint shows (← → for horizontal, ↑ ↓ for vertical, all four for both).

rows.name: `options.dismissAfterMs`
rows.description: Milliseconds before the hint auto-dismisses after appearing.

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: Whether the hint is enabled. Set to false to suppress it for a specific instance (e.g. a disabled or read-only widget).

rows.name: `Hint`
rows.description: The hint element to render inside the composite container as the last child, e.g. `<component :is="hint.Hint" />`. It positions itself `fixed`, renders arrow keys with `Kbd`, and manages its own visibility. Render it unconditionally.

rows.name: `visible`
rows.description: Whether the hint is currently shown. `Hint` reads it; a custom hint element can too.

rows.name: `anchor`
rows.description: The focused item the hint is anchored to. `null` before the first show.

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: The resolved orientation, with the default applied.

rows.name: `onFocus`
rows.description: Bind to the container's `focusin` (`@focusin`), because focus does not bubble. Shows the hint on the first keyboard-focus (`:focus-visible`) entry from outside the composite.

rows.name: `onBlur`
rows.description: Bind to the container's `focusout` (`@focusout`). Hides the hint when focus leaves the composite entirely and counts that as a dismissal, so it does not come back for this instance; focus moves within the composite only re-anchor it.

rows.name: `onKeyDown`
rows.description: Bind to the container's `keydown`. Dismisses the hint on the first arrow press (the user has discovered the interaction). Never prevents default or stops propagation.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 提示的配置对象，可以不传。

rows.name: `options.orientation`
rows.description: 这一组控件用哪个方向键导航，决定提示里画哪几个箭头（横向 ← →，纵向 ↑ ↓，双向四个都画）。

rows.name: `options.dismissAfterMs`
rows.description: 出现之后过多少毫秒自己消失。

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: 是否启用提示。某处不想提示时（例如控件被禁用或只读）设为 false。

rows.name: `Hint`
rows.description: 提示元素本身，渲染在这一组容器的最后，例如 `<component :is="hint.Hint" />`。它自己用 `fixed` 定位、用 `Kbd` 画方向键、自己管显示与隐藏。无条件渲染即可。

rows.name: `visible`
rows.description: 提示当前是否显示。`Hint` 读的就是它；自己画提示时也可以用。

rows.name: `anchor`
rows.description: 提示跟在哪个元素旁边，也就是当前聚焦的那一项。第一次出现之前是 `null`。

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: 补过默认值的方向。

rows.name: `onFocus`
rows.description: 绑在容器的 `focusin` 上（`@focusin`），因为 focus 不冒泡。第一次从组外靠键盘（`:focus-visible`）进入时显示提示。

rows.name: `onBlur`
rows.description: 绑在容器的 `focusout` 上（`@focusout`）。焦点彻底离开这一组时藏起提示，并算作这次提示已经用完，这个实例不会再提示；焦点在组内移动时只把提示挪到新的当前项。

rows.name: `onKeyDown`
rows.description: 绑在容器的 `keydown` 上。第一次按方向键时收起提示（用户已经发现这个交互了）。它不会 preventDefault，也不会停止传播。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 返回的 `onFocus` 和 `onKeyDown` 要和你自己的处理函数叠加，不要替换：先调 `onKeyDown`（它只负责收起提示，不会拦截），再调你的导航处理。
- 推荐: `Hint` 渲染成这一组容器的最后一个子元素；它是 `fixed` 定位且 `aria-hidden`，所以不影响布局，也不进无障碍树。
- 推荐: `orientation` 要和控件真正响应的方向一致，提示才会画对图标。
- 避免: 用在单个控件，或者没有 roving-tabindex 导航的控件上；只有「方向键在一组里移动焦点」时这个提示才有意义。

description.en: A custom roving-tabindex toolbar shows an ephemeral arrow-key hint on first keyboard focus via useKeyboardHint, teaching sighted keyboard users that arrows move within the group.
description.zh: 自己搭的 roving-tabindex 工具栏，第一次被键盘聚焦时通过 useKeyboardHint 短暂提示方向键，让看得见的用户知道组里可以用方向键移动。

summary.en: Core positioning hook for rendering overlay content. Use it as the foundation for custom popovers, hover cards, tooltips, and fixed-position layers when the higher-level components are not enough.
summary.zh: 渲染浮层内容的内核：定位、开合、点击外部关闭都在这里。想自己搭 popover、hover card、tooltip 或固定坐标浮层，而现成组件又不够用时，从它开始。

usage.en: Core positioning hook for rendering overlay content. Use it as the foundation for custom popovers, hover cards, tooltips, and fixed-position layers when the higher-level components are not enough. ```ts import { useLayer } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` `context` mode follows an anchor element; `fixed` mode places the layer at explicit `x` / `y` viewport coordinates. The hook owns the open state, the measured coordinates, click-outside dismissal, and the layer ID. It renders nothing: you decide where the layer lives and what it looks like. ```vue ``` `contentStyle` carries the measured `top` / `left` (plus `position: fixed` in fixed mode), so the surface only needs its own background, radius, and shadow. Positions are measured in the viewport, so render the layer into a `Teleport` — that also keeps it out of ancestor clipping and stacking.
usage.zh: 渲染浮层内容的内核：定位、开合、点击外部关闭都在这里。想自己搭 popover、hover card、tooltip 或固定坐标浮层，而现成组件又不够用时，从它开始。 ```ts import { useLayer } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` `context` 模式跟着锚点元素走；`fixed` 模式放在 `x` / `y` 指定的视口坐标上。开合状态、量出来的坐标、点击外部关闭和浮层 ID 都由它管。它不渲染任何东西：浮层放哪里、长什么样，你自己决定。 ```vue ```

en.text: Use context mode for anchor-positioned overlays relative to a trigger element, and fixed mode for manually positioned overlays at specific coordinates.
Build on higher-level components like `Popover`, `HoverCard`, and `Tooltip` for common overlay patterns.
Render the layer through `Teleport` so it escapes ancestor clipping and stacking, and keep the theme variables it needs available where it lands.
Implement ARIA patterns directly in a layer unless you also own the full accessibility behavior.
