en.heading: Dismissal: one press closes the top layer
en.text:
Every layer shares one dismissal stack. Escape, and a press outside a layer, close only the top-most layer: with a menu open inside a Dialog, the first Escape closes the menu and leaves the Dialog up, and the second closes the Dialog. A press outside the menu but inside the Dialog closes the menu only.

A press on the layer's own trigger does not count as an outside press — the trigger owns that toggle, so the layer cannot be dismissed and reopened in one click. Escape during an IME composition cancels the composition and dismisses nothing.

A layer that drills into its own sub-levels can handle Escape itself through `useDismiss`'s `onEscape`; an outside press still closes the whole layer.

en.heading: Where the layer lands
en.text: Layers render into the body by default. An open Dialog is a native modal, so a layer outside it is painted over by the backdrop and cannot be clicked; the Dialog therefore provides its own mount point and layers prefer it. `useLayerTeleportTarget()` returns that target (or `'body'`), ready for `Teleport`.

en.heading: Text styles
en.text: A teleported layer still inherits the typography of where it was written. Put `astryx-layer` on the layer root and font size, weight, line height, alignment, letter spacing, and wrapping fall back to the body baseline; the container-padding variables are zeroed there too. Our `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `HoverCard`, `DropdownMenu`, `ContextMenu`, `TabMenu`, and `Selector` surfaces already carry these resets.

zh.heading: 关闭：一次只关最上面那一层
zh.text:
所有浮层共用一个关闭栈。按 Escape、或者点在浮层外面，都只关最上面那一层：Dialog 里开一个下拉菜单，第一次 Escape 只关菜单，Dialog 还在；再按一次才关 Dialog。点在菜单外面、Dialog 里面，也只关菜单。

点浮层自己的触发器不算「点外面」，那一下交给触发器自己开关，所以不会出现「先被点外面关掉、又被点击重新打开」的闪一下。输入法拼字过程中按 Escape 是取消拼字，不关浮层。

菜单这类要逐层退栈的浮层，可以用 `useDismiss` 的 `onEscape` 单独处理 Escape，点击外面仍然整层关闭。

zh.heading: 落在哪里
zh.text:
浮层平时挂在 `body`。Dialog 打开时它是一个原生模态层，挂在外面的浮层会被遮罩挡住、也点不到，所以 Dialog 会提供自己内部的挂载点，浮层优先挂进去。`useLayerTeleportTarget()` 会把这目标算好（没有就是 `'body'`），直接给 `Teleport` 用：

```vue
<Teleport :to="teleportTarget">
```

zh.heading: 文字样式
zh.text:
浮层离开原来的位置之后，仍然会继承触发器所在位置的排版。给浮层根元素加上 `astryx-layer` 类，字号、字重、行高、对齐、字距、换行这些会回到正文的基准，容器内边距系统的变量也会在这里归零。组件自己的 `Popover`、`Tooltip`、`HoverCard`、`DropdownMenu`、`ContextMenu`、`TabMenu`、`Selector` 已经自动带上这些重置。

`contentStyle` 里是量出来的 `top` / `left`（fixed 模式还带 `position: fixed`），所以浮层只需要管自己的背景、圆角和阴影。坐标是按视口算的，请把浮层放进 `Teleport` 渲染，这样也顺带躲开了祖先的裁剪和层叠。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: 相对某个触发器定位的浮层用 context 模式；要放在指定坐标上的浮层用 fixed 模式。
- Do: 常见的浮层形态优先用 `Popover`、`HoverCard`、`Tooltip` 这些更上层的组件。
- Do: 用 `Teleport` 渲染浮层，躲开祖先的裁剪和层叠；同时保证它落地的地方拿得到需要的主题变量。
- Don't: 除非整套无障碍行为也由你负责，否则不要在浮层里直接手写 ARIA 模式。

description.en: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.
description.zh: 用 useLayer 加自定义表面渲染一个底层锚点浮层。

summary.en: Manages keyboard navigation within a linear list following WAI-ARIA menu, listbox, and toolbar patterns. Supports arrow key navigation (vertical, horizontal, or both), Home/End for boundaries, optional wrap-around, RTL, and Escape to close. Opt into `hasRovingTabIndex` for composite widgets (toolbars, segmented controls, tab strips) that own a single tab stop. Suitable for dropdown menus, toolbars, and any 1D focusable list.
summary.zh: 管一维列表里的键盘导航，做法对齐 WAI-ARIA 的菜单、列表框和工具栏模式。方向键可以纵向、横向或两个方向都走；Home/End 到两头；可以选到头绕回；RTL 里左右对调；Escape 用来关闭。工具栏、分段控件、标签条这类「整组只有一个 Tab 停靠点」的组合控件，打开 `hasRovingTabIndex` 交给它管。下拉菜单、工具栏，以及任何一维的可聚焦列表都适用。

usage.en:
Manages keyboard navigation within a linear list following WAI-ARIA menu, listbox, and toolbar patterns. Supports arrow key navigation (vertical, horizontal, or both), Home/End for boundaries, optional wrap-around, RTL, and Escape to close. Opt into `hasRovingTabIndex` for composite widgets (toolbars, segmented controls, tab strips) that own a single tab stop. Suitable for dropdown menus, toolbars, and any 1D focusable list.

Attach `listRef` to the container, `handleKeyDown` to its keys, and `handleFocus` to its focus event. `handleFocus` is a no-op unless `hasRovingTabIndex` is on, so it is always safe to attach.

```ts
import { useListFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
管一维列表里的键盘导航，做法对齐 WAI-ARIA 的菜单、列表框和工具栏模式。方向键可以纵向、横向或两个方向都走；Home/End 到两头；可以选到头绕回；RTL 里左右对调；Escape 用来关闭。工具栏、分段控件、标签条这类「整组只有一个 Tab 停靠点」的组合控件，打开 `hasRovingTabIndex` 交给它管。下拉菜单、工具栏，以及任何一维的可聚焦列表都适用。

`listRef` 绑在容器上，`handleKeyDown` 绑容器的按键，`handleFocus` 绑容器的聚焦事件。`hasRovingTabIndex` 没开时 `handleFocus` 什么都不做，所以可以无脑绑上。

```ts
import { useListFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Set `orientation` to `'horizontal'` for toolbars and tab bars, `'vertical'` for dropdown menus.
Provide an `onEscape` callback for menus/dropdowns to return focus to the trigger.
Enable `hasRovingTabIndex` (and `hasCaretGuard` when the widget can contain text inputs) for toolbar-style composites that should be a single tab stop.
Use for 2D grid navigation; prefer `useGridRovingFocus` for grids and calendars.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for the list focus behavior. All fields are optional.

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: Selector for the focusable items within the list.

rows.name: `options.boundarySelector`
rows.description: Selector identifying a list boundary, for lists that contain nested lists of the same kind (e.g. a menu with submenu flyouts). When set, item collection and key handling are scoped to this level's own container. Typically `'[role="menu"]'`.

rows.name: `options.wrap`
rows.description: Whether arrow navigation wraps around at the ends.

rows.name: `options.onEscape`
rows.description: Callback when Escape is pressed (e.g. close the menu). Supplying it also consumes the key (`preventDefault`); without it Escape passes through to the surrounding layer.

rows.name: `options.orientation`
rows.description: Navigation orientation. `'horizontal'` uses ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, `'vertical'` uses ArrowUp/ArrowDown, `'both'` accepts all four arrows. A horizontal list follows the container's writing direction, so RTL swaps the two arrow keys.

rows.name: `options.hasHomeEnd`
rows.description: Whether Home/End jump to the first/last enabled item.

rows.name: `options.hasPaging`
rows.description: Whether PageDown/PageUp page through a scrolling list: PageDown moves to the last enabled item fully visible in the container, and pressed there again one viewport further; PageUp mirrors it. Neither wraps; in a list that does not scroll they act as End/Home.

rows.name: `options.hasRovingTabIndex`
rows.description: Opt into roving-tabindex ownership: the hook stamps a single tab stop (one item `tabindex="0"`, the rest `-1`), repairs it as items mount, unmount, or toggle disabled, and moves it with arrow navigation. When false, the hook only moves focus and never touches `tabindex`.

rows.name: `options.hasCaretGuard`
rows.description: When true, arrow keys are not stolen from a nested text input/textarea whose caret is not at the boundary in the direction of travel (or that has a selection), and are never stolen from a nested contenteditable. Preserves inline text editing within the list.

rows.name: `listRef`
rows.description: Bind to the list container element.

rows.name: `handleKeyDown`
rows.description: Key down handler to attach to the list container.

rows.name: `handleFocus`
rows.description: Focus handler for the container. Keeps the roving tab stop in sync when `hasRovingTabIndex` is enabled; a no-op otherwise, so it is always safe to attach.

rows.name: `focusItem`
rows.description: Focus a specific item by index, clamped to the valid range.

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: Focus the first enabled item. Returns true when an item was focused.

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: Focus the last enabled item. Returns true when an item was focused.

rows.name: `ownsEvent`
rows.description: Whether a key event belongs to this list level rather than a nested list sharing the same `boundarySelector`. Always true when no `boundarySelector` is set. Use it to guard consumer-added key handling (Enter/Space, typeahead).

rows.name: `getItems`
rows.description: This level's focusable items in DOM order, already scoped by `boundarySelector` and with hidden ones dropped. Build typeahead targets from this instead of re-querying.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 列表焦点行为的配置对象，所有字段都可以不填。

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: 列表里可聚焦项的选择器。

rows.name: `options.boundarySelector`
rows.description: 列表边界的标志。列表里还嵌着同类列表时用（例如带子菜单弹出层的菜单）。设了之后，取项和按键处理都只在这一层自己的容器里。一般传 `'[role="menu"]'`。

rows.name: `options.wrap`
rows.description: 方向键到头之后是否绕回另一头。

rows.name: `options.onEscape`
rows.description: 按下 Escape 时调用（例如关闭菜单）。传了就会吃掉这个键（`preventDefault`）；不传则 Escape 交给外层处理。

rows.name: `options.orientation`
rows.description: 导航方向。`'horizontal'` 用左右方向键，`'vertical'` 用上下方向键，`'both'` 四个都收。横向时会看容器的书写方向，RTL 里左右对调。

rows.name: `options.hasHomeEnd`
rows.description: Home/End 是否跳到第一个/最后一个可用项。

rows.name: `options.hasPaging`
rows.description: PageDown/PageUp 是否按视口翻页：PageDown 跳到容器里最后一个完整可见的可用项，在那儿再按一次就往后再翻一屏；PageUp 反过来。两者都不绕回；列表不滚动时它们等于 End/Home。

rows.name: `options.hasRovingTabIndex`
rows.description: 交给它管 roving tabindex：只有一个项是 `tabindex="0"`，其余是 `-1`；项挂载、卸载、切换禁用时它会修好，方向键移动焦点时它跟着挪。为 false 时只移动焦点，不碰 `tabindex`。

rows.name: `options.hasCaretGuard`
rows.description: 为 true 时，嵌在列表里的文本框如果光标不在移动方向的边界上（或者有选中内容），方向键就不抢走；嵌进来的 contenteditable 也永远不抢。列表里的行内编辑因此还能正常用。

rows.name: `listRef`
rows.description: 绑到列表容器元素上。

rows.name: `handleKeyDown`
rows.description: 按键处理，绑在列表容器上。

rows.name: `handleFocus`
rows.description: 聚焦处理，绑在容器上。`hasRovingTabIndex` 打开时用来对齐 tab 停靠点；没打开时什么都不做，所以绑上总是安全的。

rows.name: `focusItem`
rows.description: 按序号聚焦某一项，超出范围会被夹到最近的合法值。

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: 聚焦第一个可用项。真的聚焦到了返回 true。

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: 聚焦最后一个可用项。真的聚焦到了返回 true。

rows.name: `ownsEvent`
rows.description: 这个按键是不是属于当前这一层，而不是共用同一个 `boundarySelector` 的嵌套列表。没配 `boundarySelector` 时恒为 true。调用方自己加按键处理（Enter/Space、typeahead）时用它挡一下。

rows.name: `getItems`
rows.description: 当前这一层、DOM 顺序上的项，已经按 `boundarySelector` 限定过，并去掉了藏起来的项。要算 typeahead 目标就用它，别自己再查一遍。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 工具栏和标签条把 `orientation` 设成 `'horizontal'`，下拉菜单设成 `'vertical'`。
- 推荐: 菜单和下拉菜单传 `onEscape`，在按下 Escape 时把焦点还给触发器。
- 推荐: 工具栏式组合控件要成为单个 Tab 停靠点时，打开 `hasRovingTabIndex`；控件里可能有文本框时再打开 `hasCaretGuard`。
- 避免: 用它做二维网格导航；网格和日历用 `useGridRovingFocus`。

summary.en: Reads the authoritative Astryx locale. Use it to thread the provider locale into pure formatting helpers and sibling-package APIs; do not derive a second locale from `navigator.language` or a hardcoded literal.
summary.zh: 读当前生效的 Astryx 语言标签。把它交给需要显式语言的纯格式化函数或同系列的包，别从 `navigator.language` 或者写死的字面量里另取一份。

usage.en:
Reads the authoritative Astryx locale. Use it to thread the provider locale into pure formatting helpers and sibling-package APIs; do not derive a second locale from `navigator.language` or a hardcoded literal.

```ts
import { useLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
```

The returned `locale` is a computed string, so the template unwraps it and any `watch` or `computed` follows the provider when it switches language. Tags are normalized on the way out: `zh`, `zh-CN`, and `zh-Hans` read as `zh-CN`, and every other tag keeps its region with canonical casing, so `en-gb` reads as `en-GB`.
usage.zh:
读当前生效的 Astryx 语言标签。把它交给需要显式语言的纯格式化函数或同系列的包，别从 `navigator.language` 或者写死的字面量里另取一份。

```ts
import { useLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
```

返回的 `locale` 是 computed 字符串，模板里会自动取值，`watch` 和 `computed` 也会跟着 provider 换语言而重算。标签在出口统一收过一次：`zh`、`zh-CN`、`zh-Hans` 都读作 `zh-CN`，其余标签保留地区、只规范大小写，例如 `en-gb` 读作 `en-GB`。

en.text: Pass the returned locale to pure Astryx helpers or package APIs that require an explicit locale.
Use `navigator.language` or a hardcoded display locale as a fallback; `InternationalizationProvider` is the locale source.

rows.name: `locale`
rows.description: The active InternationalizationProvider BCP 47 locale. Falls back to `'en'` when no provider is present.

rows.name: `locale`
rows.description: 最近的 `InternationalizationProvider` 的 BCP 47 语言标签。没有 provider 时是 `'en'`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 把返回的语言标签交给纯 Astryx 函数，或交给需要显式语言的包。
- 避免: 把 `navigator.language` 或写死的展示语言当兜底。语言只认 `InternationalizationProvider` 这一处来源。

summary.en: Detects a single-finger press-and-hold and reports where it happened, so touch users can reach affordances that a pointer gets from right-click. iOS Safari never synthesizes a `contextmenu` event on long-press, which makes this the only touch route into a cursor-positioned surface such as `ContextMenu`. The press cancels on movement, lift, multi-touch or unmount.
summary.zh: 检测单指按住不放，并告诉你按在哪里，于是触摸用户也能用到「指针靠右键才有」的那些功能。iOS Safari 在长按后根本不会产生 `contextmenu` 事件，所以它是通往「按坐标定位的浮层」（例如 `ContextMenu`）的唯一触摸途径。手指移动、抬起、多指按下，或者组件卸载，都会取消这次按住。

usage.en:
Detects a single-finger press-and-hold and reports where it happened, so touch users can reach affordances that a pointer gets from right-click. iOS Safari never synthesizes a `contextmenu` event on long-press, which makes this the only touch route into a cursor-positioned surface such as `ContextMenu`. The press cancels on movement, lift, multi-touch or unmount.

The hook attaches no listeners itself. Two ways to bind it: spread the returned `handlers` onto the element (`<div v-on="longPress.handlers">`), or drive it yourself with `start(point)` on `pointerdown`, `moveTo(point)` on `pointermove`, and `cancel` on `pointerup` and `pointercancel`. `ContextMenu` wires the second form on its trigger, and skips mouse pointers so a right-click keeps its own path.

```ts
import { useLongPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useLongPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isDisabled = ref(false)

const longPress = useLongPress({
  disabled: isDisabled,
  onLongPress: (point) => { openMenuAt(point.x, point.y) },
})
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" v-on="longPress.handlers">
    Hold me
  </button>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
检测单指按住不放，并告诉你按在哪里，于是触摸用户也能用到「指针靠右键才有」的那些功能。iOS Safari 在长按后根本不会产生 `contextmenu` 事件，所以它是通往「按坐标定位的浮层」（例如 `ContextMenu`）的唯一触摸途径。手指移动、抬起、多指按下，或者组件卸载，都会取消这次按住。

hook 自己不加任何监听。两种绑法：把返回的 `handlers` 摊到元素上（`<div v-on="longPress.handlers">`）；或者自己驱动——`pointerdown` 时调 `start(point)`，`pointermove` 时调 `moveTo(point)`，`pointerup` 和 `pointercancel` 时调 `cancel`。`ContextMenu` 用的是后一种，并且会跳过鼠标指针，让右键走自己的路。

```ts
import { useLongPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useLongPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isDisabled = ref(false)

const longPress = useLongPress({
  disabled: isDisabled,
  onLongPress: (point) => { openMenuAt(point.x, point.y) },
})
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" v-on="longPress.handlers">
    按住我
  </button>
</template>
```

en.text: Use the reported point to position the surface you open, so it appears under the finger.
Pair it with the pointer `contextmenu` handler rather than replacing it; this hook only covers touch.
Use it for the primary action of a control; press-and-hold is undiscoverable as the only way to do something.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object. Required.

rows.name: `options.onLongPress`
rows.description: Fired with the press start point once the press is held for `delayMs`. Required.

rows.name: `options.disabled`
rows.description: When true the detector is inert, so a disabled trigger can flip the flag without re-registering anything. Read on each press, so a ref or a getter works as well as a plain boolean.

rows.name: `options.isDisabled`
rows.description: The same switch under its other name; either one being true keeps the detector inert.

rows.name: `options.delayMs`
rows.description: Hold duration before the press fires, in milliseconds.

rows.name: `options.moveCancelPx`
rows.description: Movement past this distance on either axis cancels the press, treating it as a scroll or drag.

rows.name: `handlers`
rows.description: The four touch listeners to spread onto the target element, e.g. `<button v-on="press.handlers">`. A second finger, a lift, or a cancel ends the press; a move past `moveCancelPx` does too.

rows.name: `start`
rows.description: Begins detection at a point. Call it from `pointerdown`. It clears any pending press first, then re-arms the timer.

rows.name: `moveTo`
rows.description: Reports the pointer's new position. Returns true while the press is still inside the tolerance; past it the press is cancelled and it returns false. Returns false as well when no press is pending.

rows.name: `cancel`
rows.description: Drops any pending press. Bind it to `pointerup` and `pointercancel`. Also runs when the component unmounts.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 配置对象。必填。

rows.name: `options.onLongPress`
rows.description: 按满 `delayMs` 之后触发，参数是按下时的坐标。必填。

rows.name: `options.disabled`
rows.description: 为 true 时这次不检测，所以被禁用的触发器只要改这个值，不用重新注册。每次按下时读，写普通布尔值、ref 或 getter 都行。

rows.name: `options.isDisabled`
rows.description: 同一个开关的另一个名字，任一为真就不检测。

rows.name: `options.delayMs`
rows.description: 要按住多少毫秒才算长按。

rows.name: `options.moveCancelPx`
rows.description: 任一轴上移动超过这个距离就取消，当作滚动或拖拽。

rows.name: `handlers`
rows.description: 四个触摸监听，直接摊到目标元素上，例如 `<button v-on="press.handlers">`。第二根手指、抬手、取消都会结束这次按住；移动超过 `moveCancelPx` 也一样。

rows.name: `start`
rows.description: 从一个坐标开始检测。在 `pointerdown` 里调。它会先清掉上一次没完成的按住，再重新计时。

rows.name: `moveTo`
rows.description: 报告指针的新位置。还在容差内返回 true；超出去就取消这次按住并返回 false。没有正在进行的按住时也返回 false。

rows.name: `cancel`
rows.description: 丢掉还没完成的按住。绑在 `pointerup` 和 `pointercancel` 上。组件卸载时也会执行。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用报上来的坐标给打开的浮层定位，让它出现在手指下面。
- 推荐: 和指针的 `contextmenu` 处理一起用，而不是替换它；这个 hook 只管触摸。
- 避免: 把按住不放做成控件的主操作；只能靠长按才能做到的事，用户发现不了。

summary.en: SSR-safe media query hook that subscribes to `window.matchMedia` changes. Returns whether the given media query matches. The first value is read during setup whenever `matchMedia` exists, so a layout decision does not have to wait for mount; on the server the ref starts as `false`. Changes are followed while the component is alive, and the listener is removed on unmount.
summary.zh: SSR 安全的媒体查询 hook，订阅 `window.matchMedia` 的变化，返回这条媒体查询当前是否匹配。只要 `matchMedia` 存在，第一次的值在 setup 阶段就读出来了，所以布局判断不用等到挂载；服务端上这个 ref 从 `false` 开始。组件存活期间会跟着变化走，卸载时摘掉监听。

usage.en:
SSR-safe media query hook that subscribes to `window.matchMedia` changes. Returns whether the given media query matches. The first value is read during setup whenever `matchMedia` exists, so a layout decision does not have to wait for mount; on the server the ref starts as `false`. Changes are followed while the component is alive, and the listener is removed on unmount.

The query argument is a plain string, read once per call. To follow a query that itself changes, call the hook again from wherever that value comes from.

```ts
import { useMediaQuery } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
SSR 安全的媒体查询 hook，订阅 `window.matchMedia` 的变化，返回这条媒体查询当前是否匹配。只要 `matchMedia` 存在，第一次的值在 setup 阶段就读出来了，所以布局判断不用等到挂载；服务端上这个 ref 从 `false` 开始。组件存活期间会跟着变化走，卸载时摘掉监听。

查询字符串是一段普通字符串，每次调用只读一次。要跟着一个会变的查询走，就在那个值所在的地方重新调用一次 hook。

```ts
import { useMediaQuery } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Use for responsive layout switching based on viewport width, color scheme, or motion preferences.
Prefer Astryx responsive tokens and component props over manual breakpoint logic when possible.
Use for server-rendered content that must match on first paint; on the server the hook always returns false.

rows.name: `query`
rows.description: CSS media query string to evaluate, e.g. `'(max-width: 640px)'`. Read once per call, so pass a stable string. Required.

rows.name: `matches`
rows.description: Whether the media query currently matches. Read during setup on the client, and `false` on the server.

rows.name: `query`
rows.description: 要判断的 CSS 媒体查询字符串，例如 `'(max-width: 640px)'`。每次调用只读一次，请传固定的字符串。必填。

rows.name: `matches`
rows.description: 这条媒体查询当前是否匹配。客户端在 setup 阶段读一次，服务端上是 `false`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用来做响应式的布局切换：视口宽度、深浅色偏好、动效偏好。
- 推荐: 能用 Astryx 的响应式 token 和组件属性时，优先用它们，别手写断点逻辑。
- 避免: 用在服务端渲染、且首屏必须对得上的内容上；服务端上它永远返回 false。

description.en: The media query is product policy and the presentation stays a deterministic override on top of it: the hook only answers whether the touch-oriented range matches.
description.zh: 媒体查询是产品策略，呈现方式仍然是压在它上面的一层确定性覆盖：hook 只回答「是不是触摸取向的那一档」。

summary.en: The press model of a menu surface, for any pointer. A press that starts on a row is claimed: the highlight follows a held finger as it moves, and the row under the RELEASE is the row that acts — its click is dispatched for it, carrying the release's modifier keys. The click the browser reports at the end of a touch, aimed at the row where the touch began, is swallowed so nothing acts twice. The pointer is tracked at document level by `pointerId`, so a finger that slid off the row it landed on is still followed. A mouse press keeps the highlight on the row it landed on and lets that row's own click act; a mouse released outside the menu calls `onDismiss`; a finger released outside leaves the menu open; `pointercancel` or a second pointer ends the gesture with nothing acting.
summary.zh: 菜单表面的按压模型，鼠标和触摸都适用。从某一行开始的按压会被接管：按住手指时高亮跟着手指走，**松开**时手指下面是哪一行就由哪一行执行——替它派发一次 click，带上松开时的修饰键。触摸结束时浏览器补发的那次 click（目标是手指落下的那一行）会被吞掉，所以不会执行两次。指针按 `pointerId` 在文档层面跟踪，所以手指从落下那一行滑走之后仍然跟着走。鼠标按下时高亮就停在落下的那一行，由那一行自己的 click 执行；鼠标在菜单外松开时调用 `onDismiss`；手指在菜单外松开则让菜单继续开着；`pointercancel` 或者第二根手指按下，这次手势就以什么都不执行结束。

usage.en:
The press model of a menu surface, for any pointer. A press that starts on a row is claimed: the highlight follows a held finger as it moves, and the row under the RELEASE is the row that acts — its click is dispatched for it, carrying the release's modifier keys. The click the browser reports at the end of a touch, aimed at the row where the touch began, is swallowed so nothing acts twice. The pointer is tracked at document level by `pointerId`, so a finger that slid off the row it landed on is still followed. A mouse press keeps the highlight on the row it landed on and lets that row's own click act; a mouse released outside the menu calls `onDismiss`; a finger released outside leaves the menu open; `pointercancel` or a second pointer ends the gesture with nothing acting.

`ContextMenu` already mounts it. Reach for it directly only when building a menu-like surface of your own: give it the menu root's ref, enable it while the menu is open, and spread `menuProps` onto the root. `onPointerDown` is the same handler on its own, for markup that cannot take an object spread.

Rows are the enabled `[role="menuitem"]`, `[role="menuitemradio"]`, and `[role="menuitemcheckbox"]` elements inside the root, and the menu boundary is `[role="menu"]`. Pass `itemSelector` to pick rows with a selector of your own, `onHighlight` to highlight some way other than DOM focus, and `onActivate` to act on the row yourself. `resetMenuPress()` forgets an armed click swallower; it is for unmount and tests.

The trigger side is optional. Give it `triggerRef` and `onTriggerPress`, spread `triggerProps` onto the trigger, and a primary-button press there opens the menu at once while a finger has to rest for `longPressDelayMs`. A right-click is left alone, so its own `contextmenu` route keeps working. Either way the press can slide straight into the menu: rows highlight under the held pointer and the row under the release acts. The click that ends that gesture is reported by `isTriggerClickFromPress()`, so the trigger's own click neither toggles nor reopens. `triggerProps.onContextMenu` suppresses the browser's own long-press menu for a finger; a mouse's right-click still reaches the application.

```ts
import { useMenuPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
菜单表面的按压模型，鼠标和触摸都适用。从某一行开始的按压会被接管：按住手指时高亮跟着手指走，**松开**时手指下面是哪一行就由哪一行执行——替它派发一次 click，带上松开时的修饰键。触摸结束时浏览器补发的那次 click（目标是手指落下的那一行）会被吞掉，所以不会执行两次。指针按 `pointerId` 在文档层面跟踪，所以手指从落下那一行滑走之后仍然跟着走。鼠标按下时高亮就停在落下的那一行，由那一行自己的 click 执行；鼠标在菜单外松开时调用 `onDismiss`；手指在菜单外松开则让菜单继续开着；`pointercancel` 或者第二根手指按下，这次手势就以什么都不执行结束。

`ContextMenu` 已经挂上了。只有自己搭类似菜单的表面时才需要直接用它：把菜单根的 ref 传进来，菜单打开时启用，把 `menuProps` 摊到根上。`onPointerDown` 是同一个处理函数，不好摊对象时单独绑它。

行就是根里面可用的 `[role="menuitem"]`、`[role="menuitemradio"]`、`[role="menuitemcheckbox"]` 元素，层边界是 `[role="menu"]`。想用别的选择器挑行就传 `itemSelector`；不想用 DOM 焦点表示高亮就传 `onHighlight`；想自己执行那一行就传 `onActivate`。`resetMenuPress()` 用来清掉已经布好的「吞掉多余 click」，卸载和测试里用。

触发器那一侧是可选能力：给它 `triggerRef` 和 `onTriggerPress`，把 `triggerProps` 摊到触发器上，主键一按下就开，手指要按满 `longPressDelayMs` 才开；右键不碰，它自己的 `contextmenu` 照旧能用。两种都能一路滑进菜单里：手指下面那一行跟着高亮，松开时手指下面是哪一行就由哪一行执行。结束这次手势的那次 click 用 `isTriggerClickFromPress()` 问出来，触发器自己的 click 就不会再切换或重开。`triggerProps.onContextMenu` 只管挡掉手指长按时浏览器自带的那套菜单，鼠标右键仍然交给应用自己处理。

```ts
import { useMenuPress } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Pass a selector for ENABLED rows only, so a disabled row or a divider under the pointer picks nothing instead of lighting up.

Let the default highlight be DOM focus; the hook focuses the row under the pointer with `preventScroll`. Style the active row with `:focus`. Supply `onHighlight` only for a listbox that must keep focus on its combobox.

Declare `touch-action` on the menu root: `pinch-zoom` when its rows fit, `pan-y pinch-zoom` when it scrolls, so the browser — not the hook — decides when a finger is scrolling, and a two-finger pinch still zooms the page.
Act on a row from its own `pointerdown` or `pointerup` handler as well; the hook already activates the row under the release, and a second path acts twice.

Read a row click with `detail` 0 as a keyboard activation; the hook dispatches its pointer activation with `detail` 0 too. The dispatched click is untrusted, so check `event.isTrusted` to tell them apart.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object. Required.

rows.name: `options.menuRef`
rows.description: The menu root carrying `role="menu"`: the surface whose rows a press picks from. Required.

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: Whether the model is live, read on each press. Pass the menu's open state.

rows.name: `options.onDismiss`
rows.description: A mouse was released outside the menu with nothing acting: close it. A finger released outside leaves the menu open, so this is never called then.

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: Selector matching the ENABLED rows. A pointer over anything else inside the menu (a divider, a heading, a disabled row) picks nothing. Rows must still sit inside a `[role="menu"]` boundary.

rows.name: `options.triggerRef`
rows.description: The control that opens the menu, when a press may start there.

rows.name: `options.onTriggerPress`
rows.description: A mouse pressed the trigger, or a finger rested on it for `longPressDelayMs`: open the menu under the held pointer and return whether it opened. Return false when the press closed an open menu instead.

rows.name: `options.onHighlight`
rows.description: Move the highlight. Defaults to moving DOM focus with `preventScroll` onto the row. A picker that highlights through `aria-activedescendant` supplies its own.

rows.name: `options.onActivate`
rows.description: Act on the row under the release. Defaults to dispatching a click on the row that carries the release button and modifier keys.

rows.name: `options.getScroller`
rows.description: The element to scroll while a held pointer rests within 24 px of its top or bottom edge. Return null for none.

rows.name: `options.hitTest`
rows.description: Resolves the element under a viewport point. A finger's events stay with the element it landed on, so the row under it is found by position. A test seam.

rows.name: `options.longPressDelayMs`
rows.description: How long a finger must rest on the trigger before the menu opens under it.

rows.name: `menuProps`
rows.description: Spread onto the menu root (`v-bind="press.menuProps"`). Claims presses that begin inside it and marks the root as carrying the press model.

rows.name: `onPointerDown`
rows.description: The same handler as `menuProps.onPointerdown`, on its own. Bind it to the menu root's `pointerdown` when an object spread is not an option.

rows.name: `triggerProps`
rows.description: Spread onto the trigger: a primary-button press opens the menu at once; a finger held for the delay opens it with the finger still down. A right-click is left alone, so its `contextmenu` route keeps working. The `contextmenu` handler suppresses the browser's own long-press menu for a finger, and leaves a mouse's right-click to the application.

rows.name: `isTriggerClickFromPress`
rows.description: Whether the click reaching the trigger belongs to the gesture that just pressed it. That press already opened or closed the menu, so the click must neither toggle nor reopen.

rows.name: `cancel`
rows.description: End the gesture in flight with nothing acting, for when the menu closes under it.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 配置对象。必填。

rows.name: `options.menuRef`
rows.description: 带 `role="menu"` 的菜单根，也就是按压要从哪些行里挑的表面。必填。

rows.name: `options.isEnabled`
rows.description: 这套按压模型当前是否生效，每次按下时读。传菜单的打开状态即可。

rows.name: `options.onDismiss`
rows.description: 鼠标在菜单外松开、且什么都没执行时调用：关闭菜单。手指在菜单外松开则让菜单继续开着，那种情况不会调用它。

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: 只匹配可用行的选择器。指针压在菜单里别的东西上（分割线、标题、禁用行）就什么都不挑。挑出来的行仍然得落在 `[role="menu"]` 边界内。

rows.name: `options.triggerRef`
rows.description: 打开菜单的那个控件：按压可以从它开始。

rows.name: `options.onTriggerPress`
rows.description: 鼠标按下了触发器，或者手指在触发器上按满了 `longPressDelayMs`：在按住的指针下面打开菜单，并返回是否打开了。这一次按压其实是关掉已开的菜单时返回 false。

rows.name: `options.onHighlight`
rows.description: 挪动高亮。不传就把 DOM 焦点用 `preventScroll` 挪到那一行。靠 `aria-activedescendant` 表示高亮的列表自己传。

rows.name: `options.onActivate`
rows.description: 执行松开时指针下面的那一行。不传就替它派发一次 click，带上松开时的按钮和修饰键。

rows.name: `options.getScroller`
rows.description: 按住时指针停在上下边缘 24 像素内要自动滚动的元素。返回 null 表示不滚。

rows.name: `options.hitTest`
rows.description: 按视口坐标找元素。手指的事件一直发给它落下的元素，所以靠坐标判断现在在哪一行。测试里用来替换。

rows.name: `options.longPressDelayMs`
rows.description: 手指在触发器上要按多久，菜单才在手指下面打开。

rows.name: `menuProps`
rows.description: 摊到菜单根上（`v-bind="press.menuProps"`）。接下从根内开始的按压，并在根上标记「这里用了这套按压模型」。

rows.name: `onPointerDown`
rows.description: 和 `menuProps.onPointerdown` 是同一个函数，单独拿出来。不好摊对象时直接绑到菜单根的 `pointerdown` 上。

rows.name: `triggerProps`
rows.description: 摊到触发器上：主键一按下就打开菜单；手指按满延时之后，手指还按着的时候打开。右键不碰，它自己的 `contextmenu` 照旧能用。`contextmenu` 那个只挡掉手指长按时浏览器自带的菜单，鼠标右键仍然交给应用。

rows.name: `isTriggerClickFromPress`
rows.description: 到达触发器的这次 click 是不是就是刚按下它的那一次手势。那次按压已经开或关过菜单了，所以这次 click 不能再切换、也不能再打开。

rows.name: `cancel`
rows.description: 结束正在进行的这次手势，什么都不执行。菜单在手势中途关掉时用。

en.heading: Returns
en.text:
The module also exports:

- `resetMenuPress()`: forgets an armed stray-click swallower. Call it when a surface unmounts outside the hook's own teardown, and in tests.
- `isMenuPressActivation()`: true for the synchronous extent of a row activation the model dispatched, so a row that forwards activation to a link inside it can tell the model's click from the browser's stray one.
- `MENU_PRESS_MARKER`: the attribute name that marks a menu root.
- `menuPressStep`, `MENU_PRESS_SETTLE_MS` and their types: the pure state machine. The release of the press that opened the menu acts only once the pointer has entered the menu or the press has lasted 300 ms; otherwise the menu stays open and nothing acts.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 传的选择器只挑可用的行，这样指针压在分割线、标题或禁用行上时什么都不挑，而不是亮一下。
- 推荐: 让高亮就是 DOM 焦点：hook 会把指针下面那一行聚焦（`preventScroll`）。当前行用 `:focus` 画出来。只有列表要把焦点留在组合框上时，才自己传 `onHighlight`。
- 推荐: 在菜单根上声明 `touch-action`：行放得下时用 `pinch-zoom`，会滚动时用 `pan-y pinch-zoom`，让浏览器（而不是 hook）判断手指是不是在滚动，双指捏合也仍然能缩放页面。
- 避免: 又在自己行的 `pointerdown` 或 `pointerup` 里执行一次；hook 已经按松开位置执行那一行，两条路会执行两遍。
- 避免: 把 `detail` 为 0 的行 click 当成键盘触发；hook 派发的指针激活 `detail` 也是 0。派发出来的 click 不是可信事件，用 `event.isTrusted` 区分。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text:
模块还导出：

- `resetMenuPress()`：清掉已经布好的「吞掉多余 click」。表面在 hook 自己的拆卸之外被移除时调用它，测试里也用得上。
- `isMenuPressActivation()`：按压模型派发的那次行激活正在同步进行时为 true。把激活转交给里面链接的行用它分清这是模型的 click 还是浏览器多出来的那个。
- `MENU_PRESS_MARKER`：菜单根上的标记属性名。
- `menuPressStep`、`MENU_PRESS_SETTLE_MS` 和相关类型：不碰 DOM 的纯状态机。打开菜单的那次按压，只有指针进过菜单、或者按满 300 毫秒，松开时才执行下面那一行；否则菜单留着、什么都不执行。

summary.en: Combines multiple object or callback refs into one stable callback ref. Use it when a component must forward a consumer ref while also attaching internal refs. Unlike writing an inline function in a `:ref` binding, the callback identity stays stable across unrelated rerenders, so Vue does not detach and reattach the element.
summary.zh: 把多个对象 ref 和函数 ref 合成一个稳定的函数 ref。组件既要往外转发使用者给的 ref，又要自己挂内部 ref 时用它。如果在 `:ref` 里直接写一个内联函数，每次渲染都会造出新函数，Vue 只能先解绑再重新绑定；这里返回的始终是同一个回调，不会白折腾元素。

usage.en:
Combines multiple object or callback refs into one stable callback ref. Use it when a component must forward a consumer ref while also attaching internal refs. Unlike writing an inline function in a `:ref` binding, the callback identity stays stable across unrelated rerenders, so Vue does not detach and reattach the element.

```ts
import { useMergedRefs } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

Bind the returned function as the element's `:ref`. Every entry in the array receives the same value; `null` and `undefined` slots are skipped, so an optional forwarded ref can sit in the list unconditionally. Vue calls it with `null` when the element unmounts, which clears each target.
usage.zh:
把多个对象 ref 和函数 ref 合成一个稳定的函数 ref。组件既要往外转发使用者给的 ref，又要自己挂内部 ref 时用它。如果在 `:ref` 里直接写一个内联函数，每次渲染都会造出新函数，Vue 只能先解绑再重新绑定；这里返回的始终是同一个回调，不会白折腾元素。

```ts
import { useMergedRefs } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

把返回的函数绑给元素的 `:ref`。数组里每一项都会收到同一个值；`null` 和 `undefined` 直接跳过，所以可选的外部 ref 可以一直留在列表里。元素卸载时 Vue 会传 `null` 进来，每个目标都会被清空。

en.text: Use useMergedRefs when one element must receive both a forwarded ref and one or more internal refs.
Keep the call in `setup` and bind the function it returns, so the element sees the same callback on every render.
Write an inline arrow function in a `:ref` binding; that creates a new callback on every render and forces unnecessary detach and attach work.

rows.name: `refs`
rows.description: Up to six refs that should all receive the same element. One entry is a `Ref<T | null>`, a function ref, `null`, or `undefined`; empty slots are skipped. Required.

rows.name: `mergedRef`
rows.description: A merged callback ref that remains stable for the life of the component. It accepts whatever Vue hands a template ref, including `null` on unmount, and forwards the value to every entry in `refs`.

rows.name: `refs`
rows.description: 最多六个目标，它们会收到同一个元素。每一项可以是 `Ref<T | null>`、函数 ref、`null` 或 `undefined`；空着的位置直接跳过。必填。

rows.name: `mergedRef`
rows.description: 合并出来的函数 ref，组件存活期间一直是同一个函数。它接收 Vue 交给模板 ref 的任何值，卸载时也会收到 `null`，然后转发给 `refs` 里的每一项。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 一个元素既要收外部传进来的 ref，又要收一个或多个内部 ref 时，用 useMergedRefs。
- 推荐: 在 `setup` 里调用一次，绑它返回的那个函数，这样每次渲染元素拿到的都是同一个回调。
- 避免: 在 `:ref` 里直接写内联箭头函数。那样每次渲染都会换一个新回调，白白多做一轮解绑和绑定。

summary.en: Measures children rendered in a hidden container to determine how many fit in the available width without flickering. Uses ResizeObserver to react to container and measured-child size changes. The measurement container should hold all items plus an optional overflow indicator element (identified by a `data-overflow-indicator` attribute).
summary.zh: 在屏幕外的那块隐藏容器里把所有子项都排一遍，量出当前宽度能放下几项，这样切换时不会闪。容器和子项尺寸变化都用 ResizeObserver 盯着。测量容器里按顺序放全部项，最后可以再放一个溢出指示器，给它标上 `data-overflow-indicator`。

usage.en: Measures children rendered in a hidden container to determine how many fit in the available width without flickering. Uses ResizeObserver to react to container and measured-child size changes. The measurement container should hold all items plus an optional overflow indicator element (identified by a `data-overflow-indicator` attribute). The two containers are template refs here, so bind them with `ref`. `visibleCount`, `rows`, and `rowHeight` are refs you can render right away; `remeasure()` measures again on demand. ```ts import { useOverflow } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ``` The measured container is painted out of sight, so every item keeps its real width. Put `inert` on it so it stays out of the tab order and the accessibility tree. The visible container renders `visibleCount` items and an overflow indicator of its own, which is not measured.
usage.zh: 在屏幕外的那块隐藏容器里把所有子项都排一遍，量出当前宽度能放下几项，这样切换时不会闪。容器和子项尺寸变化都用 ResizeObserver 盯着。测量容器里按顺序放全部项，最后可以再放一个溢出指示器，给它标上 `data-overflow-indicator`。 这块测量容器画在看不见的地方，所以每一项都还是真实宽度。给它加上 `inert`，它就不会进键盘顺序，也不会被读屏读到。看得见的容器只渲染 `visibleCount` 项，再自己放一个溢出提示，这个提示不参与测量。 这两个容器在这里都是模板 ref，用 `ref` 绑上去就行。`visibleCount`、`rows`、`rowHeight` 都是 ref，可以直接拿去渲染；想立刻重量一次就调 `remeasure()`。 ```ts import { useOverflow } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Render all items into the `measureRef` container (hidden) and only the first `visibleCount` items into the `containerRef` container (visible).
Include an overflow indicator (e.g., "+N more" button) as the last child of the measurement container with a `data-overflow-indicator` attribute.
Use for vertical overflow; this hook measures horizontal width only.

rows.name: `itemCount`
rows.description: Total number of items to measure for overflow.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for overflow behavior.

rows.name: `options.gap`
rows.description: Gap between items in pixels. Used in width calculations.

rows.name: `options.minVisibleItems`
rows.description: Minimum number of items to always show, even if they don't fit.

rows.name: `options.maxVisibleItems`
rows.description: Upper bound on visible items, even when everything fits. The floor wins when it is larger.

rows.name: `options.maxRows`
rows.description: Wrap up to this many rows before the rest collapse into the indicator. Omitted or `1` keeps a single row.

rows.name: `options.collapseFrom`
rows.description: Which end to collapse items from.

rows.name: `options.behavior`
rows.description: Which element to observe for overflow calculations. `observeParent` uses the container's parent element width, allowing the visible container to remain content-sized.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Template ref to attach to the visible container element.

rows.name: `measureRef`
rows.description: Template ref to attach to the hidden measurement container that holds all items.

rows.name: `visibleCount`
rows.description: Number of items that fit in the visible container.

rows.name: `hasOverflow`
rows.description: Whether any items are overflowing (`visibleCount < itemCount`).

rows.name: `rows`
rows.description: How many rows the visible items occupy. `1` in the single-row mode, `0` when nothing is visible.

rows.name: `rowHeight`

rows.name: `返回值`
rows.description: 内容是不是比盒子高。

en.heading: Element overload
en.text: `useOverflow(element, isActive)` is the other signature. It measures one box instead of a row of items: it reports whether the element's content is taller than its own visible area, and returns a single `Ref<boolean>`. It is off as long as `isActive` is false.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: 全部项都渲染进 `measureRef` 那块隐藏容器，只有前 `visibleCount` 项渲染进 `containerRef` 那块看得见的容器。
- Do: 测量容器最后放一个溢出指示器（比如「+N 更多」按钮），并给它标上 `data-overflow-indicator`。
- Don't: 拿它量竖向溢出，这个函数只量横向宽度。

zh.heading: 元素版
zh.text: `useOverflow(element, isActive)` 是另一个签名。它不量一排项，只量一个盒子：判断这个元素里的内容是不是比它自己的可视区域高，返回一个 `Ref<boolean>`。`isActive` 为 false 时它不做测量。

summary.en: Headless hook for click-triggered popovers with focus trapping. Combines `useLayer` with `useFocusTrap`, auto-focus, light dismiss, and Escape handling for accessible dialog-like popover behavior.
summary.zh: 点击触发、带焦点陷阱的浮层内核。它在 `useLayer` 之上叠加了 `useFocusTrap`、自动聚焦、点击外部关闭和 Escape 处理，做出「像对话一样」的无障碍弹出层。

usage.en: Headless hook for click-triggered popovers with focus trapping. Combines `useLayer` with `useFocusTrap`, auto-focus, light dismiss, and Escape handling for accessible dialog-like popover behavior. ```ts import { usePopover } from '@astryx-vue/core/Popover' ``` Bind `triggerRef` to the element that should open the popover. The hook attaches the click and keyboard handlers and writes `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` on that element. Render the surface yourself and spread `surfaceProps` and `contentStyle` on it: ```vue ``` `contentStyle` carries the measured coordinates. Give the surface `position: fixed` in your own CSS. Every painted surface is the canonical `popover` target.
usage.zh: 点击触发、带焦点陷阱的浮层内核。它在 `useLayer` 之上叠加了 `useFocusTrap`、自动聚焦、点击外部关闭和 Escape 处理，做出「像对话一样」的无障碍弹出层。 ```ts import { usePopover } from '@astryx-vue/core/Popover' ``` 把 `triggerRef` 绑到负责打开浮层的元素上：hook 会给它挂点击和键盘处理，并写好 `aria-haspopup`、`aria-expanded`、`aria-controls`。浮层自己渲染，把 `surfaceProps` 和 `contentStyle` 摊到浮层元素上： ```vue ``` `contentStyle` 里是量出来的坐标，浮层需要自己写 `position: fixed`。绘制出来的那层表面就是统一的 `popover` 目标。

en.text: Use for interactive content such as menus, pickers, forms, and command panels that need focus management.
Prefer the `Popover` component for standard trigger-content pairs; use the hook for custom trigger patterns.
Use popover as the broad canonical surface target.
When a custom composition needs its own theme refinement, pass and document an owned class such as `selector-popup`. It refines the popover surface rather than creating another anatomy part.
Use for non-interactive hover previews: use `useHoverCard` or `useTooltip` instead.
