zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: 菜单、选择器、表单、命令面板这类需要管焦点的交互内容用它。
- Do: 标准的「触发器 + 内容」组合优先用 `Popover` 组件；触发器形态特殊时再用 hook。
- Do: 把 popover 当作宽泛的统一表面目标。
- Do: 自定义组合需要自己的主题细化时，传一个自己的 class（比如 `selector-popup`）并在文档里写明。它细化的是 popover 表面，不是另造一个解剖部件。
- Don't: 不要拿它做非交互的悬停预览：那种场景用 `useHoverCard` 或 `useTooltip`。

description.en: Custom quick-actions popover using usePopover for trigger refs, ARIA attributes, and focus trapping.
description.zh: 用 usePopover 搭自定义快速操作弹层，触发器 ref、ARIA 属性和焦点陷阱都由 hook 负责。

summary.en: The touch press model every Astryx pressable uses, for a local component that paints its own press. Under a finger, CSS `:active` paints on the touch itself and can outlive the start of a scroll; the press model instead waits 150 ms before believing a press, cancels it the moment the finger travels 10 px or a scroll claims the gesture, never brings it back inside that gesture, answers a quick tap at the lift, and fades the release over 200 ms — the clocks a native list uses. One document-level controller does this for every marked element (installed by the first pressable to mount, removed by the last to unmount), so calling the hook adds no listener or state to your element. Under a mouse nothing changes: keep your `:active` rule, and drop it under `@media (pointer: coarse)` the way the built-in components do.
summary.zh: Astryx 里每个可按的地方都用的触摸按压模型，给自己画按压反馈的组件也用这一套。手指按下去的时候，CSS 的 `:active` 会立刻亮，而且滚动已经开始了它还可能亮着；按压模型反过来：先等 150 毫秒，确认这真是按压；手指一动超过 10 像素、或者页面滚走了，马上作废，这次手势里不再亮回来；快速点一下则在抬手时补上；松手后用 200 毫秒淡出。这几个时间和系统列表的手感一致。一个文档级控制器给所有带标记的元素做这件事（第一个用到的组件装上，最后一个卸载时拆掉），所以调用这个函数不会给你的元素加监听，也不加状态。鼠标上的表现不变：留着你的 `:active`，按内置组件的写法在 `@media (pointer: coarse)` 里把它丢掉就行。

usage.en:
The touch press model every Astryx pressable uses, for a local component that paints its own press. Under a finger, CSS `:active` paints on the touch itself and can outlive the start of a scroll; the press model instead waits 150 ms before believing a press, cancels it the moment the finger travels 10 px or a scroll claims the gesture, never brings it back inside that gesture, answers a quick tap at the lift, and fades the release over 200 ms — the clocks a native list uses. One document-level controller does this for every marked element (installed by the first pressable to mount, removed by the last to unmount), so calling the hook adds no listener or state to your element. Under a mouse nothing changes: keep your `:active` rule, and drop it under `@media (pointer: coarse)` the way the built-in components do.

```ts
import { usePressFeedback } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { usePressFeedback } from '@astryx-vue/core'

const { pressableProps } = usePressFeedback()
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" class="card" v-bind="pressableProps">
    Press me
  </button>
</template>
```

The hook brings `styles/pressable.css` along. The default `astryx-pressable` class paints the pressed token on a `::after` layer, keeps `:active` for a mouse, and under a finger reads the `data-astryx-press` attribute the controller writes (`on` while held, `fading` for the release). The press's strength is the registered `--astryx-press-alpha`; the release animates it from 1 to 0. A component that paints its own press passes `{ hasOverlay: false }` and paints both `[data-astryx-press]` states from `var(--_press-paint-image)` in its own styles.
usage.zh:
Astryx 里每个可按的地方都用的触摸按压模型，给自己画按压反馈的组件也用这一套。手指按下去的时候，CSS 的 `:active` 会立刻亮，而且滚动已经开始了它还可能亮着；按压模型反过来：先等 150 毫秒，确认这真是按压；手指一动超过 10 像素、或者页面滚走了，马上作废，这次手势里不再亮回来；快速点一下则在抬手时补上；松手后用 200 毫秒淡出。这几个时间和系统列表的手感一致。一个文档级控制器给所有带标记的元素做这件事（第一个用到的组件装上，最后一个卸载时拆掉），所以调用这个函数不会给你的元素加监听，也不加状态。鼠标上的表现不变：留着你的 `:active`，按内置组件的写法在 `@media (pointer: coarse)` 里把它丢掉就行。

```ts
import { usePressFeedback } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { usePressFeedback } from '@astryx-vue/core'

const { pressableProps } = usePressFeedback()
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" class="card" v-bind="pressableProps">
    按我
  </button>
</template>
```

样式文件 `styles/pressable.css` 会跟着这个函数一起带上：默认的 `astryx-pressable` 类在元素的 `::after` 上画按下的颜色，给鼠标留着 `:active`，手指下读控制器写的 `data-astryx-press`（`on` 是按住，`fading` 是抬手淡出）。按压强度是注册过的 `--astryx-press-alpha`，淡出就是它从 1 降到 0。组件想自己画按压时传 `{ hasOverlay: false }`，在自己的样式里用 `var(--_press-paint-image)` 画 `[data-astryx-press]` 两种状态。

en.text: Spread the result on the element whose background paints the press, and use `--astryx-color-overlay-pressed` to theme it.

Let the shipped style own the press on every pointer: it keeps `:active` for a mouse and drops it under `@media (pointer: coarse)`, so a finger sees only the press model. A rule of your own that paints `:active` would paint under a finger too, on the touch and through a scroll.
Add a pointer listener or component state to the element to track the press; the controller already writes the attribute, and per-element listeners are what a long list cannot afford.
Call it for a control rendered by an Astryx component; those are marked already, and the innermost marked element takes the press.

rows.name: `options.hasOverlay`
rows.description: Whether to bring the default press paint (the `astryx-pressable` class, a layer on `::after`). Pass false when the component paints the press itself from `--_press-paint-image` and only needs the marker.

rows.name: `pressableProps`
rows.description: Spread with `v-bind` on the element that paints the press: the `data-astryx-pressable` marker, plus `class: 'astryx-pressable'` by default. Under a finger the controller writes `data-astryx-press="on"` while the press is believed and `"fading"` for the release. The default style paints `--astryx-color-overlay-pressed` at the press's strength on the first frame and fades it over 200 ms, keeping `:active` for a mouse.

rows.name: `options.hasOverlay`
rows.description: 要不要带上默认的按压色（`astryx-pressable` 类，在 `::after` 上画一层）。组件自己在样式里读 `--_press-paint-image` 画按压时传 false，只拿标记。

rows.name: `pressableProps`
rows.description: 用 `v-bind` 铺到「画按压」的元素上：标记属性 `data-astryx-pressable`，默认还有 `class: 'astryx-pressable'`。手指按压成立时控制器在元素上写 `data-astryx-press="on"`，抬手淡出时写 `"fading"`。默认样式在按压成立的第一帧画出 `--astryx-color-overlay-pressed`，抬手后 200 毫秒淡出，鼠标仍然走 `:active`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 结果铺在「背景画按压」的那个元素上，用 `--astryx-color-overlay-pressed` 调颜色。
- 推荐: 各种指针都交给自带的样式：它给鼠标留着 `:active`，在 `@media (pointer: coarse)` 里丢掉，手指只会看到按压模型。自己再写一条 `:active`，手指下也会亮，落手就亮、滚动也不灭。
- 不要: 为了跟按压给元素加指针监听或者组件状态；控制器已经写好属性了，每个元素一套监听正是长列表受不了的。
- 不要: 给 Astryx 组件渲染出来的控件再调一次；那些本来就有标记，最里面那个带标记的元素才算数。

summary.en: Hook for adding drag-to-resize behavior to layout regions. Supports single-region and multi-region configurations with snap points, collapsible panels, localStorage persistence, and cascade resize ordering.
summary.zh: 给布局区域加上「拖着改大小」的能力。支持单区域和多区域；区域可以吸到固定的吸附点、可以整体收起，尺寸能存进 localStorage，多区域挤在一起时还能按顺序让出空间。

usage.en:
Hook for adding drag-to-resize behavior to layout regions. Supports single-region and multi-region configurations with snap points, collapsible panels, localStorage persistence, and cascade resize ordering.

```ts
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```
usage.zh:
给布局区域加上「拖着改大小」的能力。支持单区域和多区域；区域可以吸到固定的吸附点、可以整体收起，尺寸能存进 localStorage，多区域挤在一起时还能按顺序让出空间。

```ts
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

en.text: Use `percent(40, { min: pixel(333) })` for a 40% size with a 333px floor, or `percent(10, { max: pixel(400) })` for a 10% size with a 400px ceiling. The options argument is required and carries a floor XOR a ceiling.
A structured default is an initial choice only; a structured `minSize` or `maxSize` remains live. State, persistence, callbacks, `resize()`, paint, and ARIA all use resolved pixel numbers.
Import `percent` from `@astryx-vue/core` and Table's `pixel` from `@astryx-vue/core/Table`. They are the same pixel binding, exposed once from each entry.
Use with `Layout` or `AppShell` sidebar for resizable navigation panels.
Set `autoSaveId` to persist user-chosen sizes across page reloads.
Set `minSize` too small; content becomes unreadable. Prefer `collapsible` for panels that can hide entirely.

rows.name: `defaultSize`
rows.description: Initial size. Numbers, exact `"Npx"`, and `pixel(value)` are pixels. Exact `"N%"` has no additional pixel bound. `percent(value, { min: pixel(value) })` or `percent(value, { max: pixel(value) })` adds one pixel floor or ceiling. A percentage resolves once into pixels, against `containerRef` when supplied and against the viewport otherwise, and does not track its basis afterwards.

rows.name: `minSize`
rows.description: Minimum size. Numbers, exact `"Npx"`, and `pixel(value)` remain pixels; exact `"N%"` has no additional pixel bound; `percent()` adds exactly one. Percentage minimums re-resolve when their basis changes and clamp the current pixel selection.

rows.name: `maxSize`
rows.description: Maximum size. Numbers, exact `"Npx"`, and `pixel(value)` remain pixels; exact `"N%"` has no additional pixel bound; `percent()` adds exactly one. Percentage maximums re-resolve when their basis changes and clamp the current pixel selection.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: The element a percentage is a share of. Caller-owned: the hook never infers one. Omitted, percentages use the viewport. The ref may point at a different element over time and the basis follows it. Until that element is laid out (not yet mounted, `display:none`, detached) percentages use a temporary 1200px basis and nothing is persisted from it.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: Which axis this region resizes along. Selects the container's inline or block content-box size as the percentage basis, and must match the direction given to `ResizeHandle`.

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: Whether dragging below the collapsed threshold collapses the region to zero.

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: Pixel threshold below which a collapsible region snaps to zero.

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: The size stops only on these pixel points. An equal distance stays on the earlier point.

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: Key for localStorage persistence of size and collapse state across sessions, stored under `astryx-resizable:`.

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: Initial collapse state (uncontrolled). A persisted entry wins over it.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Controlled collapse state. `collapse()`, `expand()` and a drag past the threshold then report through `onCollapseChange` instead of changing state internally.

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: Called with the resolved pixel size after every drag, resize, or collapse.

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: Called once per collapse state change, via drag or programmatically.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Current size in pixels. Reactive.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Whether the region is currently collapsed. Reactive.

rows.name: `collapse`
rows.description: Programmatically collapse the region.

rows.name: `expand`
rows.description: Expand from collapsed state.

rows.name: `resize`
rows.description: Resize to a specific pixel value.

rows.name: `props`
rows.description: Props to spread on the resizable component or pass to `ResizeHandle`.

rows.name: `defaultSize`
rows.description: 初始尺寸。数字、精确的 `"Npx"`、以及 `pixel(value)` 都按像素算。精确的 `"N%"` 不带额外像素限制。`percent(value, { min: pixel(value) })` 或 `percent(value, { max: pixel(value) })` 会再加上一个像素下限或上限。百分比只解析一次成像素：给了 `containerRef` 就按它算，否则按视口算，之后不再跟着基准变化。

rows.name: `minSize`
rows.description: 最小尺寸。数字、精确的 `"Npx"`、`pixel(value)` 仍按像素；精确的 `"N%"` 不带额外像素限制；`percent()` 会加且只加一个限制。百分比下限在基准变化时会重新解析，并把当前像素值夹回范围内。

rows.name: `maxSize`
rows.description: 最大尺寸。数字、精确的 `"Npx"`、`pixel(value)` 仍按像素；精确的 `"N%"` 不带额外像素限制；`percent()` 会加且只加一个限制。百分比上限在基准变化时会重新解析，并把当前像素值夹回范围内。

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: 百分比按谁算。这个 ref 由调用方提供，hook 不会自己去猜。不传就按视口算。ref 指的元素以后可以换，基准跟着换。目标元素还没完成布局时（没挂载、`display:none`、已脱离文档），百分比先按临时的 1200px 算，也不会写进持久化。

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: 这个区域沿哪个方向改尺寸。它决定百分比的基准取容器的行内还是块方向内容盒尺寸，也必须和交给 `ResizeHandle` 的方向一致。

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: 拖到收起阈值以下时，是否把区域收成 0。

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: 可收起的区域低于这个像素阈值就吸到 0。

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: 尺寸只会停在这些像素点上。离两个点一样远时，留在更靠前的那个。

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: 把尺寸和收起状态存进 localStorage 的键名，实际键名前面带 `astryx-resizable:`。

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: 初始收起状态（非受控）。localStorage 里有记录时以记录为准。

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: 受控的收起状态。传了它，`collapse()`、`expand()` 和拖过阈值都不再自己改状态，而是通过 `onCollapseChange` 报给你。

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: 每次拖动、调整或收起之后，带上解析好的像素尺寸调用。

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: 收起状态每变一次调用一次，拖动或代码触发都算。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 当前尺寸，单位像素。响应式。

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: 区域当前是否已收起。响应式。

rows.name: `collapse`
rows.description: 用代码把区域收起来。

rows.name: `expand`
rows.description: 从收起状态展开。

rows.name: `resize`
rows.description: 调到指定的像素尺寸。

rows.name: `props`
rows.description: 展开给可调整的组件，或者交给 `ResizeHandle`。

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: `useResizable({ regions })` instead takes regions (a map of key to ResizableRegionConfig) plus direction, containerRef, and autoSaveId. Each region accepts the size, collapse, and snap fields above, and shrinkOrder: a lower number gives up space first when the container is narrower than the regions.

en.heading: Returns
en.text: With a regions map, the return value is Record<string, ResizableRegion>: one object of the same shape per key.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 想要 40% 宽、最窄 333px，写 `percent(40, { min: pixel(333) })`；想要 10% 宽、最宽 400px，写 `percent(10, { max: pixel(400) })`。第二个参数必填，且只能给下限或上限其中一个。
- 推荐: 结构化的默认值只决定初始值；结构化的 `minSize` / `maxSize` 是持续生效的。状态、持久化、回调、`resize()`、绘制和 ARIA 用的都是解析后的像素数。
- 推荐: `percent` 从 `@astryx-vue/core` 引入，Table 的那个 `pixel` 从 `@astryx-vue/core/Table` 引入。两处是同一个 pixel 绑定，各从自己的入口导出一次。
- 推荐: 和 `Layout` 或 `AppShell` 的侧栏一起用，做可拖宽的导航面板。
- 推荐: 想跨刷新记住用户拖出来的尺寸，设 `autoSaveId`。
- 避免: 把 `minSize` 设得太小，内容会看不清。能整块藏起来的面板，改用 `collapsible`。

zh.heading: 参数
zh.text: 传 regions 走多区域模式时，参数是 regions（键到 ResizableRegionConfig 的映射）加上 direction、containerRef、autoSaveId。每个区域除了上面这些尺寸、收起和吸附字段，还能给 shrinkOrder：容器装不下时，数字小的先让出空间。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: 传 regions 时返回 Record<string, ResizableRegion>：每个键对应一个形状相同的对象。

description.en: Horizontal resizable split with a draggable handle between two panels.
description.zh: 水平方向的两栏分割，中间是一条可拖动的分隔条。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 200,
  minSize: 120,
  maxSize: 400,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Card :height="280" variant="muted" :width="600">
    <Layout height="fill">
      <template #start>
        <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size">
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Heading :level="4">
              Sidebar
            </Heading>
            <Text color="secondary">
              {{ Math.round(sidebar.size) }}px wide
            </Text>
          </VStack>
        </LayoutPanel>
        <ResizeHandle direction="horizontal" has-divider label="Resize sidebar" :resizable="sidebar.props" />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Heading :level="4">
            Content
          </Heading>
          <Text color="secondary">
            Drag the handle to resize the sidebar.
          </Text>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>
  </Card>
</template>

title.zh: Resizable — 可收起并带吸附点

description.en: A collapsible sidebar with snap points, driven by useResizable. Dragging snaps to preset widths, dragging past the minimum collapses the panel, and the expand method restores it programmatically.
description.zh: 用 useResizable 驱动的可收起侧栏，带吸附点。拖动会吸到预设宽度，拖过最小值就收起，expand 方法能把它恢复回来。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
  collapsible: true,
  snaps: [200, 280],
})
</script>

<template>
  <Card :height="240" variant="muted" :width="500">
    <Layout height="fill">
      <template #start>
        <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size">
          <Text v-if="!sidebar.isCollapsed" color="secondary">
            {{ Math.round(sidebar.size) }}px wide
          </Text>
        </LayoutPanel>
        <ResizeHandle
          direction="horizontal"
          has-divider
          label="Resize sidebar"
          :resizable="sidebar.props"
        />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Text color="secondary">
            Drag the handle — it snaps at 200px and 280px. Drag all the way left to collapse the sidebar.
          </Text>
          <Button
            v-if="sidebar.isCollapsed"
            label="Expand sidebar"
            size="sm"
            variant="secondary"
            @click="sidebar.expand()"
          />
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>
  </Card>
</template>

summary.en: Locks `body` scroll while `isLocked` is true, so the page behind a modal or a dialog stays where it is. `isLocked` is a ref: pass the same flag that opens the overlay, and the hook follows it.
summary.zh: `isLocked` 为 true 的时候把 `body` 的滚动锁住，弹层后面的页面就停在原地不动。`isLocked` 是个 ref：把打开弹层的那个开关传进来，它自己跟着走。

usage.en:
Locks `body` scroll while `isLocked` is true, so the page behind a modal or a dialog stays where it is. `isLocked` is a ref: pass the same flag that opens the overlay, and the hook follows it.

The lock is reference counted. The page is released only when the outermost lock goes away, so closing a sheet that sits inside a dialog does not unlock the page under it. The inline `overflow` that `body` had before is put back when the last lock is released. Where the scrollbar takes space (Windows and Linux desktops, or macOS set to always show scroll bars), its gutter is held open while locked (`scrollbar-gutter: stable`, with padding as the fallback), so neither the page nor its fixed-position chrome jumps sideways, and a scope that goes away releases its own lock.

```ts
import { useScrollLock } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
useScrollLock(isOpen)
```
usage.zh:
`isLocked` 为 true 的时候把 `body` 的滚动锁住，弹层后面的页面就停在原地不动。`isLocked` 是个 ref：把打开弹层的那个开关传进来，它自己跟着走。

这个锁按次数算。最外层的锁都放开，页面才真的松开，所以对话框里再叠一个抽屉，抽屉关掉不会把下面那层解锁。锁住之前 `body` 上原本的 `overflow` 会记下来，最后一层解开时写回去。滚动条是占地方的那种（Windows、Linux 桌面，或者 macOS 设成始终显示滚动条）时，锁住期间给它留住位置（`scrollbar-gutter: stable`，不支持的浏览器补 padding），页面和固定定位的元素都不会左右跳。作用域被清理掉的时候，它自己那一层也会放开。

```ts
import { useScrollLock } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
useScrollLock(isOpen)
```

en.text: Use when opening full-screen modals or dialogs to prevent background content from scrolling.
Pass the same ref that controls dialog visibility as the `isLocked` argument.
Keep the call in the scope that owns the overlay. Leaving that scope releases the lock.
Use for non-modal overlays like popovers or tooltips; users should be able to scroll away from those.

rows.name: `isLocked`
rows.description: Whether body scroll should be locked. Read through a watcher, so pass a ref or a computed, not a plain boolean.

rows.name: `isLocked`
rows.description: 要不要锁住 `body` 的滚动。它是用 watch 读的，所以要传 ref 或 computed，不能传普通布尔值。

en.heading: Returns
en.text: None. The lock is a side effect on `document.body.style.overflow`, and nothing is rendered.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: 打开全屏的对话框或弹窗时用它，免得后面的内容跟着滚。
- Do: `isLocked` 传控制弹层开关的那个同一个 ref。
- Do: 调用放在拥有这个弹层的作用域里。作用域没了，锁也就放了。
- Don't: 拿它管气泡卡、提示这类非模态的浮层，那些东西应该允许用户滚开视线。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: 没有返回值。它只改 `document.body.style.overflow`，不渲染任何东西。

summary.en: Tracks scroll overflow state for a horizontally scrollable container. Returns a ref callback and state booleans that update as the user scrolls or the container resizes. Uses scroll event listeners and ResizeObserver for reactive updates. Tolerance of 1px is applied to avoid sub-pixel false positives.
summary.zh: 盯着一个横向滚动的容器，报告两边有没有被挡住。返回一个 ref 回调和几条布尔状态，用户滚动或容器尺寸变化时会跟着更新。滚动监听和 ResizeObserver 一起用。容差 1px，免得因为亚像素算出来一堆假的溢出。

usage.en: Tracks scroll overflow state for a horizontally scrollable container. Returns a ref callback and state booleans that update as the user scrolls or the container resizes. Uses scroll event listeners and ResizeObserver for reactive updates. Tolerance of 1px is applied to avoid sub-pixel false positives. `scrollRef` is a function ref, so bind it with `:ref="scrollRef"`. Give the container `overflow-x: auto` or `overflow-x: scroll`; the hook only reads the edges the container already has. ```ts import { useScrollOverflow } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```
usage.zh: 盯着一个横向滚动的容器，报告两边有没有被挡住。返回一个 ref 回调和几条布尔状态，用户滚动或容器尺寸变化时会跟着更新。滚动监听和 ResizeObserver 一起用。容差 1px，免得因为亚像素算出来一堆假的溢出。 `scrollRef` 是函数 ref，用 `:ref="scrollRef"` 绑上去。容器自己要带上 `overflow-x: auto` 或 `overflow-x: scroll`，这个函数只读它已有的边界。 ```ts import { useScrollOverflow } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Use to show/hide scroll navigation buttons or fade edges on carousels and horizontal lists.
Apply the `scrollRef` to a container with `overflow-x: auto` or `overflow-x: scroll`.
Use for vertical scroll tracking; this hook only measures horizontal overflow.

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: Function ref to attach to the horizontally scrollable container element.

rows.name: `overflowStart`
rows.description: Whether content overflows the start edge (left in LTR, right in RTL).

rows.name: `overflowEnd`
rows.description: Whether content overflows the end edge (right in LTR, left in RTL).

rows.name: `hasOverflow`
rows.description: Whether the container has any scroll overflow at all (`scrollWidth > clientWidth`).

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: 绑到那个横向滚动容器上的函数 ref。

rows.name: `overflowStart`
rows.description: 起始边外面还有没有内容（从左到右的语言是左边，从右到左的语言是右边）。

rows.name: `overflowEnd`
rows.description: 结束边外面还有没有内容（从左到右的语言是右边，从右到左的语言是左边）。

rows.name: `hasOverflow`
rows.description: 容器有没有任何横向溢出（`scrollWidth > clientWidth`）。

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: None. The hook reads the element it is bound to.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: 用它决定轮播和横向列表两边的前进、后退按钮显不显示，或者边缘的渐隐要不要露出来。
- Do: `scrollRef` 绑到的容器要带 `overflow-x: auto` 或 `overflow-x: scroll`。
- Don't: 拿它看竖向滚动，这个函数只量横向溢出。

zh.heading: 参数
zh.text: 没有参数。它读的是自己绑上去的那个元素。

summary.en: Adds canonical axis-aware scroll behavior to structure owned by the caller. An axis is effective only when its computed overflow is scroll-capable and geometry exceeds the shared 1px tolerance. Both viewport and content boxes are observed.
summary.zh: 给调用方自己搭的结构加上一套标准的、跟着书写方向走的滚动行为。一个轴要真的能用，得同时满足两件事：这一轴算出来的 `overflow` 是能滚的，并且内容和盒子差得超过共用的 1px 容差。视口和内容盒两块都在观察范围里。

usage.en: Adds canonical axis-aware scroll behavior to structure owned by the caller. An axis is effective only when its computed overflow is scroll-capable and geometry exceeds the shared 1px tolerance. Both viewport and content boxes are observed. Bind `viewport` to the scrolling box as a function ref, and `content` to the box your content sits in. `viewportAttrs` carries `role`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`, and the `data-scroll-*` attributes written from the current measurement. `viewportStyle` carries `overflow` and `overscroll-behavior`. Name and role come from `label` and `role`, or from `keyboardAccess`, which also says where the keyboard enters. The measured state is registered as a scroll owner, so nested areas and focus delegation can tell which level scrolls. A hidden or zero-size viewport cannot be measured and keeps its last state. Options are read reactively, so a component's `props` object can be passed straight in and later changes are picked up. ```ts import { useScrollableArea } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```
usage.zh: 给调用方自己搭的结构加上一套标准的、跟着书写方向走的滚动行为。一个轴要真的能用，得同时满足两件事：这一轴算出来的 `overflow` 是能滚的，并且内容和盒子差得超过共用的 1px 容差。视口和内容盒两块都在观察范围里。 把 `viewport` 当函数 ref 绑到滚动的那块上，把 `content` 绑到装内容的盒子上。`viewportAttrs` 里是 `role`、`aria-label`、`tabindex`，还有按当前测量结果写出的 `data-scroll-*`；`viewportStyle` 里是 `overflow` 和 `overscroll-behavior`。名字和角色用 `label`、`role` 给，或者用 `keyboardAccess` 说清键盘从哪里进来。量出来的状态会登记成「滚动归属」，嵌套的滚动区域和焦点委托靠它分清哪一层在滚。视口藏起来、尺寸为 0 时量不出来，保留上一次的结果。选项是按响应式读取的，所以组件的 `props` 也可以直接传进来，后面变了也会跟着更新。 ```ts import { useScrollableArea } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Bind both `viewport` and `content`. A real observed content box is required for live overflow changes.
Give the area a concise `label`. The viewport enters the tab order only while it actually scrolls.
Use `axis` for the direction you intend to scroll, and `both` only when the content really scrolls two ways.
Keep `overscroll` at `allow` unless a finished gesture should stop at this box.
Write your own `overflow` on the viewport; `viewportStyle` picks `clip` or `auto` from the measurement.
Wrap it in another overflow container. One viewport should own the scroll.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Logical scroll intent, overscroll policy, and Sticky containment.

rows.name: `options.axis`
rows.description: Which logical axis may scroll.

rows.name: `options.keyboardAccess`
rows.description: Where the keyboard enters a scrolling area. `{ owner: 'content' }`: the content has its own focusable cells, so the viewport stays out of the Tab order and unnamed. `{ owner: 'viewport', label, role? }`: the viewport becomes a Tab stop while it scrolls. `{ owner: 'contentOrViewport', label, role? }`: the same, but a Tab into it hands focus straight to a plain leading button or link inside; arrow-key scrolling stays with the browser.

rows.name: `options.label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the viewport. Used when `keyboardAccess` is not given.

rows.name: `options.role`
rows.description: Role of the viewport.

rows.name: `options.overscroll`
rows.description: Overscroll policy for an axis that is actually scrollable.

rows.name: `options.stickyContainment`
rows.description: Whether the viewport is a Sticky containing block only while it scrolls, or in every state.

rows.name: `viewport`
rows.description: Function ref for the viewport element. It attaches the scroll listener and the ResizeObserver.

rows.name: `content`
rows.description: Template ref for the content box. Its size changes are observed too.

rows.name: `viewportAttrs`
rows.description: `role`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`, and the `data-scroll-*` attributes for the current measurement.

rows.name: `viewportStyle`
rows.description: `overflow` for both axes, plus `overscroll-behavior` for the requested axes.

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: `inline` and `block`, each with `isScrollable`, `atStart`, and `atEnd`.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 想滚哪个方向、越界手势怎么处理、Sticky 包含关系怎么给。

rows.name: `options.axis`
rows.description: 哪个逻辑轴可以滚。

rows.name: `options.keyboardAccess`
rows.description: 能滚动时键盘从哪里进来。`{ owner: 'content' }`：内容自己有可聚焦的东西，视口不进 Tab 顺序、不带名字。`{ owner: 'viewport', label, role? }`：视口能滚时成为 Tab 停靠点。`{ owner: 'contentOrViewport', label, role? }`：同上，但 Tab 进来时如果内容里第一个就是普通按钮或链接，焦点直接交给它，方向键滚动仍归浏览器。

rows.name: `options.label`
rows.description: 视口的无障碍名称。没传 `keyboardAccess` 时用。

rows.name: `options.role`
rows.description: 视口的角色。

rows.name: `options.overscroll`
rows.description: 对真的能滚的轴，越界手势怎么处理。

rows.name: `options.stickyContainment`
rows.description: 视口是只在能滚的时候当 Sticky 包含块，还是一直当。

rows.name: `viewport`
rows.description: 视口元素的函数 ref。滚动监听和 ResizeObserver 都在这里挂上。

rows.name: `content`
rows.description: 内容盒的模板 ref。它的尺寸变化也在观察范围里。

rows.name: `viewportAttrs`
rows.description: 按当前测量结果算出的 `role`、`aria-label`、`tabindex` 和 `data-scroll-*`。

rows.name: `viewportStyle`
rows.description: 两个轴的 `overflow`，以及所请求轴上的 `overscroll-behavior`。

rows.name: `state`
rows.description: `inline` 和 `block` 两个轴，每个都有 `isScrollable`、`atStart`、`atEnd`。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: `viewport` 和 `content` 两个都绑上。内容盒是真的在观察的，溢出变化才跟得上。
- Do: 给这块区域一个简短的 `label`。视口只有在真的能滚的时候才进键盘顺序。
- Do: `axis` 写你真正想滚的方向，只有两个方向都要滚时才用 `both`。
- Do: `overscroll` 保持 `allow`，除非手势滑到头就该停在这个盒子上。
- Don't: 自己在视口上写 `overflow`。`viewportStyle` 会按测量结果在 `clip` 和 `auto` 之间挑。
- Don't: 再套一层 overflow 容器。一块视口应该独占滚动。

summary.en: Smooths bursty streamed text into a steady character-by-character reveal using requestAnimationFrame. Decouples arrival rate from display rate. Advances on grapheme boundaries, so a slice never cuts a surrogate pair, a flag, or a joined emoji in half. Animation timing comes from the `--astryx-duration-fast-min` motion token, with a fallback outside a theme provider. Snaps to full text when `isStreaming` becomes false, and stays on the full text while the reader prefers reduced motion.
summary.zh: 把一坨一坨到达的文字抹平成稳定的逐字显示，用 requestAnimationFrame 推进。到达的速度和显示的速度互不影响。每次推进会退回到字素边界，所以不会把代理对、旗帜或拼在一起的 emoji 切成两半。节奏取自 `--astryx-duration-fast-min` 这个动效 token，不在主题里时用兜底值。`isStreaming` 变成 false 时直接跳到全文；用户偏好减少动态效果时也一直是全文。

en.text: Pass the accumulated text (not individual chunks) as `targetText`; the hook handles incremental reveal internally.
Set `isStreaming` to false when the stream completes to snap to the final text.
Use `speed="instant"` for non-animated contexts like search results or when reduced motion is preferred.
Use for static text that does not change; the hook adds unnecessary overhead for non-streaming content.

rows.name: `targetText`
rows.description: The full target text to reveal. As new chunks arrive, update this value with the accumulated text.

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: Whether text is currently being streamed. When false, the hook returns the full `targetText` immediately.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Optional configuration for streaming behavior.

rows.name: `options.speed`
rows.description: Speed preset for text reveal. `natural` reveals a short run at each motion tick, `fast` ticks twice as often so it drains the backlog sooner, and `instant` returns the full text with no animation.

rows.name: `displayedText`
rows.description: The portion of `targetText` to render. Grows steadily toward the full `targetText` during streaming, or equals `targetText` when not streaming.

rows.name: `targetText`
rows.description: 要显示出来的完整文字。有新分片到达时，把累积后的文字更新到这里。

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: 现在是不是还在流式输出。为 false 时直接返回完整的 `targetText`。

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 显示节奏的配置，可以不传。

rows.name: `options.speed`
rows.description: 显示节奏的档位。`natural` 每个动效节拍往前推一小段；`fast` 的节拍快一倍，落后的量追得更快；`instant` 不带动画，直接给全文。

rows.name: `displayedText`
rows.description: 该渲染出来的那一段。流式过程中会稳稳地往完整的 `targetText` 长；不在流式时就是 `targetText` 本身。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- Do: `targetText` 传累积后的整段文字，不要传一块一块的分片；增量显示它自己会处理。
- Do: 流结束的时候把 `isStreaming` 设成 false，直接跳到最终文字。
- Do: 不需要动画的场合用 `speed="instant"`，比如搜索结果，或者用户偏好减少动态效果。
- Don't: 用在不会变的静态文字上；它本来就不流式，白搭一层开销。

description.en: Smooth bursty generated text into a steady reveal with useStreamingText.
description.zh: 用 useStreamingText 把一阵一阵到达的生成文字抹平成稳定显示。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useStreamingText } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Section } from '@astryx-vue/core/Section'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const target = 'Astryx hooks keep behavior reusable while components keep visuals consistent.'

const source = ref('')
const isStreaming = ref(false)
const displayedText = useStreamingText(source, isStreaming)

let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined

function stop(): void {
  if (timer !== undefined) {
    clearInterval(timer)
    timer = undefined
  }
}

function stream(): void {
  stop()
  source.value = ''
  isStreaming.value = true
  let offset = 0
  // 每 200ms 送一小段，模拟生成中的分块到达
  timer = setInterval(() => {
    offset = Math.min(offset + 8, target.length)
    source.value = target.slice(0, offset)
    if (offset >= target.length) {
      isStreaming.value = false
      stop()
    }
  }, 200)
}

onBeforeUnmount(stop)
stream()
</script>

<template>
  <Section variant="muted" :padding="4" :max-width="520">
    <Card :padding="4" width="100%">
      <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3">
        <Stack direction="horizontal" :gap="2" align="center">
          <Heading :level="4">
            Assistant response
          </Heading>
          <Badge :variant="isStreaming ? 'info' : 'success'">
            {{ isStreaming ? 'Streaming' : 'Complete' }}
          </Badge>
        </Stack>
        <Text class="streaming-text" type="body">
          {{ displayedText }}
        </Text>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" :gap="2">
          <Button label="Stream again" size="sm" variant="secondary" @click="stream" />
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </Section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.streaming-text {
  min-height: 3.5rem;
}
</style>

summary.en: Hook that returns a `TablePlugin` adding draggable resize handles to column header borders. Every resizable column gets a handle on its inline end, except the last proportional column: that one keeps flexing to fill whatever space is left. Dragging previews the new widths, and releasing the pointer commits them: `onColumnResizeEnd` receives a map of every column key whose width changed, and you merge it into `columnWidths`.
summary.zh: 这个组合式函数返回一个 `TablePlugin`，给列表头的边缘加上可以拖的把手。除了最后一列比例列之外，每列行末都有一个把手；最后一列比例列不给把手，它负责吃掉剩下的空间。拖动时先按新宽度预览，松开指针才提交：`onColumnResizeEnd` 拿到所有宽度变了的列，你把它并进 `columnWidths`。

rows.name: `columnWidths`
rows.description: Controlled pixel-width overrides keyed by column key. When a key is present it overrides the column's declared width.

rows.name: `onColumnResizeEnd`
rows.description: Called when a resize completes (pointer release or a key press). Receives a map of every column key whose width changed; merge it into your `columnWidths` state. The last column is left out because its width follows the space that is left.

rows.name: `minWidth`
rows.description: Global minimum column width in pixels during a resize. Overrides the per-column floors.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Global maximum column width in pixels during a resize.

rows.name: `columns`
rows.description: Column definitions, used to derive per-column minimums and to tell proportional columns from pixel ones when picking the neighbour and the last column. `Table` passes its own columns, so you only need this when you call the helper functions yourself.

rows.name: `widthFor`
rows.description: Returns the committed override for one column, or `undefined` when the column has none.

rows.name: `resizeFor`
rows.type: `(column: TableColumn<T>, columns: readonly TableColumn<T>[]) => TableColumnResizeContribution | null`
rows.description: Describes how one column takes part in a resize: its current width, its minimum and maximum, the neighbour that gives up width, and whether the column gets a handle.

rows.name: `onColumnResizeEnd`
rows.description: Called by `Table` with every changed column. It rounds each width to whole pixels and passes the map on to your `onColumnResizeEnd`.

rows.name: `columnResizeMinWidth`
rows.description: The narrowest a column may get: the global minimum when set, otherwise the column's own floor.

rows.name: `isProportionalColumnWidth`
rows.description: True for a proportional column and for a column with no declared width.

rows.name: `resizeColumnWidths`
rows.description: Applies a pointer movement in pixels to a set of column snapshots and returns every resulting width.

rows.name: `columnResizeStep`
rows.description: How far one arrow key press moves a handle: 10px, or 50px with Shift.

rows.name: `columnResizeDirectionSign`
rows.description: The sign a horizontal movement gets in the current writing direction. RTL returns `-1`.

rows.name: `columnWidths`
rows.description: 已经提交的像素宽度，键是列 key。有值时覆盖列自己声明的宽度。

rows.name: `onColumnResizeEnd`
rows.description: 一次拖动结束（松开指针或按键）时调用。参数是「列 key → 新宽度」的映射，包含所有宽度变了的列，把它并进 `columnWidths` 就是新的状态。最后一列不在里面，它的宽度跟着剩余空间走。

rows.name: `minWidth`
rows.description: 拖动时所有列共用的最窄像素，一设就盖过每一列自己的下限。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 拖动时所有列共用的最宽像素。

rows.name: `columns`
rows.description: 列定义。用来取每一列的下限，并区分比例列和固定像素列，好决定相邻列和最后一列怎么动。表格自己会传，只有自己调下面的辅助函数时才需要给。

rows.name: `widthFor`
rows.description: 返回某一列已经提交的宽度，没有就返回 `undefined`。

rows.name: `resizeFor`
rows.type: `(column: TableColumn<T>, columns: readonly TableColumn<T>[]) => TableColumnResizeContribution | null`
rows.description: 说明一列怎么参与拖动：当前宽度、最窄、最宽、让出宽度的相邻列，以及这一列有没有把手。

rows.name: `onColumnResizeEnd`
rows.description: `Table` 把变了的列交给它。它把宽度取整到整像素，再转给你的 `onColumnResizeEnd`。

rows.name: `columnResizeMinWidth`
rows.description: 一列能拖到的最窄像素：设了全局下限就用它，否则用列自己的下限。

rows.name: `isProportionalColumnWidth`
rows.description: 比例列和没写宽度的列都算比例列。

rows.name: `resizeColumnWidths`
rows.description: 把指针位移（像素）套到一组列宽快照上，返回算好的每一列宽度。

rows.name: `columnResizeStep`
rows.description: 按一下方向键走多少像素：10px，按住 Shift 是 50px。

rows.name: `columnResizeDirectionSign`
rows.description: 横向位移在书写方向上的符号。RTL 返回 `-1`。

en.heading: How narrow and how wide
en.text: Each column's floor comes from the column itself: `proportional(n, { minWidth })` uses that `minWidth`, a `pixel(n)` column cannot get narrower than `n`, and a column without a `width` stops at 60px. Setting `minWidth` on the config overrides all of them, and `maxWidth` caps every column during a resize.

en.heading: Keyboard and RTL
en.text: The handle is a WAI-ARIA window splitter: focus it and use ArrowLeft / ArrowRight to move 10px, hold Shift for 50px, Home to jump to the narrowest allowed width, and End to jump to `maxWidth`. Right and left follow the writing direction, so in RTL the arrows resize the other way.

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: `useTableColumnResize()` takes one config object. Wrap it in a getter or a `ref` so the table reads the current widths: `useTableColumnResize(() => ({ ... }))`.

en.heading: Returns
en.text: `useTableColumnResize()` returns one `TablePlugin<T>`. Pass it to `Table` in `plugins`. The plugin fills three fields of the plugin contract:

en.heading: Helpers
en.text: The same module exports the pieces the plugin is built from, so you can reuse the arithmetic in your own UI.

zh.heading: 能拖多窄、多宽
zh.text: 每列的下限来自列自己：`proportional(n, { minWidth })` 用它给的 `minWidth`，`pixel(n)` 的列不会窄过 `n`，没有 `width` 的列停在 60px。配置里的 `minWidth` 一设就盖过这些下限，`maxWidth` 是所有列共同的上限。

zh.heading: 键盘和 RTL
zh.text: 把手是一个 WAI-ARIA 窗口分隔条：聚焦后按左、右方向键移动 10px，按住 Shift 移动 50px，按 Home 跳到最窄，按 End 跳到 `maxWidth`。左右跟随书写方向，所以在 RTL 下按键调宽的方向是反的。

zh.heading: 参数
zh.text: `useTableColumnResize()` 只接一个配置对象。宽度存在 `ref` 里时用 getter 包一层，表格每次读都能拿到最新的值：`useTableColumnResize(() => ({ ... }))`。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: `useTableColumnResize()` 返回一个 `TablePlugin<T>`，放进 `Table` 的 `plugins` 里。它填的是插件约定里的三个字段：

zh.heading: 辅助函数
zh.text: 同一个模块也导出插件内部用的计算函数，自己的界面需要算宽度时可以直接用。

description.en: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; the width is committed when you release the pointer. The remaining proportional columns share what is left.
description.zh: 用 useTableColumnResize 的表格。拖任意列表头的右边缘就能改宽，松开指针后提交。剩下的比例列分掉剩余宽度。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableColumnResize } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Charlie Brown', email: 'charlie@example.com', role: 'PM' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diana Prince', email: 'diana@example.com', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Eve Davis', email: 'eve@example.com', role: 'Analyst' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name' },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: pixel(120) },
]

const columnWidths = ref<Record<string, number>>({})
const resizePlugin = useTableColumnResize<User>(() => ({
  columnWidths: columnWidths.value,
  onColumnResizeEnd: (updates) => {
    columnWidths.value = { ...columnWidths.value, ...updates }
  },
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="users"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    has-hover
    :plugins="{ columnResize: resizePlugin }"
  />
</template>

summary.en: Headless column visibility and ordering management for Table. The plugin keeps only the columns whose key is in `activeColumnKeys`, in that array's order, so one list drives both your column picker and the table. `useTableColumnSettingsState` is the toggle helper: it holds the keys, puts `isAlwaysVisible` columns back when they are removed, and knows which set to restore for "Reset to default".
summary.zh: 给 Table 做列的显示与排序，只管逻辑，不画控件。插件只留下 key 在 `activeColumnKeys` 里的列，顺序也按这个数组来，所以列选择器和表格读的是同一份列表。`useTableColumnSettingsState` 是配套的开关助手：它保存 key，被删掉的 `isAlwaysVisible` 列会被放回去，还知道「恢复默认」该恢复哪一组。

usage.en:
Headless column visibility and ordering management for Table. The plugin keeps only the columns whose key is in `activeColumnKeys`, in that array's order, so one list drives both your column picker and the table. `useTableColumnSettingsState` is the toggle helper: it holds the keys, puts `isAlwaysVisible` columns back when they are removed, and knows which set to restore for "Reset to default".

```ts
import { useTableColumnSettings, useTableColumnSettingsState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

The config is read again on every access, so pass a getter when the keys live in a `ref`. A plain object works too, but the table keeps the keys it saw first.

The picker itself is yours to build. `MultiSelector` takes `{ value, label, disabled }` options, so map each column to that shape and mark `isAlwaysVisible` ones as disabled. Give an option a `group` and you can render the columns under headings.

`defaultColumnKeys` is the column set behind "Reset to default". Without it, resetting shows every column.

```ts
const state = useTableColumnSettingsState({
  columns: columnOptions,
  activeColumnKeys: activeKeys,
  onChangeActiveColumnKeys(keys) {
    activeKeys.value = [...keys]
  },
  defaultColumnKeys: ['name', 'email'],
})
```

`resetToDefault()` hands `defaultColumnKeys` to `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`; `showAllColumns()` hands every column instead. The two are what the reset button and the "select all" row in a picker call.

`useTableColumnSettings()` hides and reorders columns. It does not decide which columns exist; the table still receives every column, and the plugin drops the ones that are turned off.
usage.zh:
给 Table 做列的显示与排序，只管逻辑，不画控件。插件只留下 key 在 `activeColumnKeys` 里的列，顺序也按这个数组来，所以列选择器和表格读的是同一份列表。`useTableColumnSettingsState` 是配套的开关助手：它保存 key，被删掉的 `isAlwaysVisible` 列会被放回去，还知道「恢复默认」该恢复哪一组。

```ts
import { useTableColumnSettings, useTableColumnSettingsState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

每次读配置都会重新取值，所以 key 存在 `ref` 里时要传 getter。直接传对象也能跑，但表格会用第一次读到的 key。

列选择器由你自己搭。`MultiSelector` 的选项是 `{ value, label, disabled }`，把每列映射成这个形状，`isAlwaysVisible` 的标成禁用即可；选项带上 `group` 就能把列分成若干组显示。

`defaultColumnKeys` 是「恢复默认」要恢复的那组列。不传就恢复成全部列。

```ts
const state = useTableColumnSettingsState({
  columns: columnOptions,
  activeColumnKeys: activeKeys,
  onChangeActiveColumnKeys(keys) {
    activeKeys.value = [...keys]
  },
  defaultColumnKeys: ['name', 'email'],
})
```

`resetToDefault()` 把 `defaultColumnKeys` 交给 `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`，`showAllColumns()` 交出去的是全部列。恢复按钮和选择器顶部的「全选」各自调它们。

`useTableColumnSettings()` 只负责藏起和重排。列本身还是全部交给表格，插件从中挑出要显示的那些。

rows.name: `columns`
rows.description: Required. All available columns with metadata for the settings UI. Each entry has `key`, `label`, and optional `isAlwaysVisible` and `group`.

rows.name: `activeColumnKeys`
rows.description: Required. Currently active column keys, in display order. Only columns with keys in this array are shown.

rows.name: `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`
rows.description: Called when active columns change. `useTableColumnSettings()` never calls it; it belongs to the config that `useTableColumnSettingsState()` hands back.

rows.name: `defaultColumnKeys`
rows.description: Default column set for "Reset to default". When omitted, reset shows all columns.

rows.name: `transformColumns`
rows.description: Drops the columns that are not in `activeColumnKeys`, then sorts the rest into that array's order.

rows.name: `activeColumnKeys`
rows.description: The keys you passed in, read through on every access.

rows.name: `toggleColumn`
rows.description: Turns one column on or off. An `isAlwaysVisible` key is ignored.

rows.name: `isColumnActive`
rows.description: Whether the column is currently shown. Use it to check a picker option.

rows.name: `isColumnToggleable`
rows.description: Whether the column may be turned off. `false` for `isAlwaysVisible` columns, which is what disables their picker option.

rows.name: `showAllColumns`
rows.description: Reports every column in `columns` as active.

rows.name: `resetToDefault`
rows.description: Reports `defaultColumnKeys`, or every column when it is not set. This is what a "Reset to default" button calls.

rows.name: `setActiveColumnKeys`
rows.description: Reports the given keys with every `isAlwaysVisible` key added back, then calls `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`.

rows.name: `columnSettingsConfig`
rows.description: Config for `useTableColumnSettings()`, wired to `setActiveColumnKeys` and carrying `defaultColumnKeys`.

rows.name: `key`
rows.description: Column key. It must match a `TableColumn.key`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Human-readable label for the settings UI.

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: The column cannot be hidden. Use it for essential columns such as Name or ID.

rows.name: `group`
rows.description: Optional group name for organized column lists. Columns with the same group are rendered together under a heading.

rows.name: `columns`
rows.description: 必填。全部可选的列，带设置界面要用的信息。每一项有 `key`、`label`，还可以有 `isAlwaysVisible` 和 `group`。

rows.name: `activeColumnKeys`
rows.description: 必填。当前打开的列 key，按显示顺序。只有 key 在这个数组里的列会显示。

rows.name: `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`
rows.description: 打开的列变了时调用。`useTableColumnSettings()` 自己不会调它；它属于 `useTableColumnSettingsState()` 交回来的那份配置。

rows.name: `defaultColumnKeys`
rows.description: 「恢复默认」用的那组列。不传就恢复成全部列。

rows.name: `transformColumns`
rows.description: 丢掉 key 不在 `activeColumnKeys` 里的列，再把剩下的按这个数组的顺序排好。

rows.name: `activeColumnKeys`
rows.description: 你传进来的 key，每次读都重新取值。

rows.name: `toggleColumn`
rows.description: 开关一列。`isAlwaysVisible` 的 key 会被忽略。

rows.name: `isColumnActive`
rows.description: 这一列现在是打开的吗。用来勾选选择器里的选项。

rows.name: `isColumnToggleable`
rows.description: 这一列允许被关掉吗。`isAlwaysVisible` 的列是 `false`，选择器里把它标成禁用。

rows.name: `showAllColumns`
rows.description: 把 `columns` 里的全部列报成打开。

rows.name: `resetToDefault`
rows.description: 报出 `defaultColumnKeys`，没设就报出全部列。「恢复默认」按钮调它。

rows.name: `setActiveColumnKeys`
rows.description: 把给的 key 补上所有 `isAlwaysVisible` 的 key 再报出去，然后调 `onChangeActiveColumnKeys`。

rows.name: `columnSettingsConfig`
rows.description: 给 `useTableColumnSettings()` 用的配置，写入接到 `setActiveColumnKeys`，并带上 `defaultColumnKeys`。

rows.name: `key`
rows.description: 列的 key，必须和某个 `TableColumn.key` 一致。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 设置界面里显示的名字。

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: 这一列不能被隐藏。用在 Name、ID 这种必须留着的列上。

rows.name: `group`
rows.description: 分组名。同组的列在设置列表里排在一起，可以带个小标题。

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: `useTableColumnSettings()` takes one config object. Wrap it in a getter or a `ref` so the table reads the current keys: `useTableColumnSettings(() => state.columnSettingsConfig)`.

en.heading: Returns
en.text: `useTableColumnSettings()` returns one `TablePlugin<T>`. Pass it to `Table` in `plugins`. The plugin fills one field of the plugin contract:

en.heading: useTableColumnSettingsState

zh.heading: 参数
zh.text: `useTableColumnSettings()` 只接一个配置对象。key 存在 `ref` 里时用 getter 包一层，表格每次读都能拿到最新的值：`useTableColumnSettings(() => state.columnSettingsConfig)`。

description.en: Table with a column visibility picker in the toolbar. Toggle columns on and off; the Name column always stays.
description.zh: 工具栏里放一个列选择器的表格。可以开关列，Name 列始终保留。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ColumnSettingsOption, TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { MultiSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/MultiSelector'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { proportional, Table, useTableColumnSettings, useTableColumnSettingsState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Toolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toolbar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
  department: string
  status: string
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Platform', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'Designer', department: 'Product', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Charlie Brown', email: 'charlie@example.com', role: 'Manager', department: 'Platform', status: 'Away' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diana Prince', email: 'diana@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Infra', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Eve Davis', email: 'eve@example.com', role: 'Admin', department: 'Operations', status: 'Inactive' },
]

const allColumns: TableColumn<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'department', header: 'Department', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', width: proportional(1) },
]

const columnOptions: ColumnSettingsOption<string>[] = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', isAlwaysVisible: true },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email' },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role' },
  { key: 'department', label: 'Department' },
  { key: 'status', label: 'Status' },
]

const activeKeys = ref(columnOptions.map(column => column.key))
const state = useTableColumnSettingsState<string>({
  columns: columnOptions,
  activeColumnKeys: activeKeys,
  onChangeActiveColumnKeys(keys) {
    activeKeys.value = [...keys]
  },
})
const plugin = useTableColumnSettings<User>(state.columnSettingsConfig)
const selectorOptions = columnOptions.map(column => ({
  value: column.key,
  label: column.label,
  disabled: column.isAlwaysVisible === true,
}))

function onColumnsChange(keys: (string | number)[]) {
  state.setActiveColumnKeys(keys.map(String))
}
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3" width="100%">
    <Toolbar label="Table actions">
      <template #start>
        <Text type="label">
          Team
        </Text>
      </template>
      <template #end>
        <MultiSelector
          label="Columns"
          label-hidden
          :options="selectorOptions"
          :model-value="[...state.activeColumnKeys]"
          @update:model-value="onColumnsChange"
        />
      </template>
    </Toolbar>
    <Table
      :data="users"
      :columns="allColumns"
      id-key="id"
      has-hover
      :plugins="{ columnSettings: plugin }"
    />
  </Stack>
</template>

summary.en: Managed state hook for table filtering. Returns the current filter map, an onChange handler, and a way to clear everything. Pass the map and the handler to `useTableFiltering`, and the map to `applyTableFilters()` to get the matching rows.
summary.zh: 管表格过滤状态。它交出当前的过滤映射、一个改值的处理函数，还有一个清空的办法。把映射和处理函数交给 `useTableFiltering`，把映射交给 `applyTableFilters()` 就能拿到匹配的行。

usage.en:
Managed state hook for table filtering. Returns the current filter map, an onChange handler, and a way to clear everything. Pass the map and the handler to `useTableFiltering`, and the map to `applyTableFilters()` to get the matching rows.

```ts
import { useTableFilterState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

A filter is "off" when its key is missing. Setting `null`, an empty string, or an empty array removes the key instead of storing an empty value, so a truthy key in the map always means a live filter.

Give it an initial map when the table should open with a filter already applied. Pass the map directly, or wrap it as `initialState`. The initial object is shallow copied, so later writes never touch it.

```ts
const direct = useTableFilterState({ role: 'Engineer' })
const wrapped = useTableFilterState({ initialState: { role: 'Engineer' } })
```
usage.zh:
管表格过滤状态。它交出当前的过滤映射、一个改值的处理函数，还有一个清空的办法。把映射和处理函数交给 `useTableFiltering`，把映射交给 `applyTableFilters()` 就能拿到匹配的行。

```ts
import { useTableFilterState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

一条过滤「关掉」的意思是它的 key 不在映射里。写 `null`、空字符串或空数组时，key 会被删掉，而不是存一个空值，所以映射里还留着的 key 一定是生效的过滤。

需要打开页面就带着过滤时，给一个初始映射。可以直接把映射传进去，也可以写成 `initialState`。初始对象是浅拷贝的，后面怎么写都不会改到你传进去的那份。

```ts
const direct = useTableFilterState({ role: 'Engineer' })
const wrapped = useTableFilterState({ initialState: { role: 'Engineer' } })
```

rows.name: `initial`
rows.description: The initial filter map itself. It is shallow copied, so the object you pass is never written to.

rows.name: `initial.initialState`
rows.description: The same map behind an `initialState` key: `useTableFilterState({ initialState })`. A filter value is never an object, so a key named `initialState` with an object value can only be this form.

rows.name: `filters`
rows.description: The live filter map. Read `filters.value` for the current state.

rows.name: `onFilterChange`
rows.description: Sets or clears one field. The map is replaced with a new object, so a getter over it stays in sync.

rows.name: `clearAll`
rows.description: Empties the map. Every filter turns off at once.

rows.name: `[fieldKey]`
rows.description: Field key to filter value. `TableFilterValue` is `string | number | string[]`.

rows.name: `initial`
rows.description: 直接给初始过滤映射。它是浅拷贝的，你传进去的对象不会被写。

rows.name: `initial.initialState`
rows.description: 把同一份映射放在 `initialState` 键里：`useTableFilterState({ initialState })`。过滤值不可能是对象，所以键名叫 `initialState` 且值是对象时，只可能是这种写法。

rows.name: `filters`
rows.description: 活的过滤映射。读 `filters.value` 拿到当前状态。

rows.name: `onFilterChange`
rows.description: 设置或清掉一个字段。映射会换成新对象，所以用 getter 读它的地方会跟着更新。

rows.name: `clearAll`
rows.description: 清空整张映射。所有过滤一起关掉。

rows.name: `[fieldKey]`
rows.description: 字段 key 到过滤值的映射。`TableFilterValue` 是 `string | number | string[]`。

summary.en: Table plugin that adds column filters with popover or inline controls. A column gets a filter when its `filter` names a field in `fields`. In the `inline` variant the control sits in the header cell under the column label; `inline-compact` puts the same control in a tighter frame when the table is short on space; in the `popover` variant it hides behind a funnel button and applies on confirm. Pairs with `useTableFilterState` for managed state.
summary.zh: 给表格的列加过滤器，控件可以是行内的，也可以在弹出层里。列的 `filter` 指向 `fields` 里的某个字段时，这一列才有过滤器。`inline` 变体把控件放在表头单元格里、列名下面；`inline-compact` 是同一个位置，但控件更紧凑，表格窄的时候用；`popover` 变体把它藏在一个漏斗按钮后面，确认后才生效。状态交给 `useTableFilterState` 管。

usage.en:
Table plugin that adds column filters with popover or inline controls. A column gets a filter when its `filter` names a field in `fields`. In the `inline` variant the control sits in the header cell under the column label; `inline-compact` puts the same control in a tighter frame when the table is short on space; in the `popover` variant it hides behind a funnel button and applies on confirm. Pairs with `useTableFilterState` for managed state.

```ts
import { useTableFiltering, useTableFilterState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

Five field types are supported, and each one gets a matching control:

```ts
const fields: TableFilterField[] = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', type: 'string' },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role', type: 'enum', options: roleOptions },
  { key: 'teams', label: 'Teams', type: 'multi-select', options: teamOptions },
  { key: 'age', label: 'Age', type: 'number', min: 18, max: 70, isIntegerOnly: true },
  { key: 'hired', label: 'Hired', type: 'date' },
]
```

`applyTableFilters()` returns the rows that match every active filter, so the plugin never touches `data` itself.

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
  variant: 'inline',
}))
const rows = computed(() => applyTableFilters(employees, filters.value, fields))
```

The config is read again on every access, so pass a getter when the filters live in a `ref`. A plain object works too, but the table keeps the filters it saw first.

In the inline variants a filtered column that declares no `width` gets `proportional(1)`, so the control has room to sit under the label.

This filtering is separate from Power Search. A column without `filter` is never filtered, and the plugin renders nothing for it.
usage.zh:
给表格的列加过滤器，控件可以是行内的，也可以在弹出层里。列的 `filter` 指向 `fields` 里的某个字段时，这一列才有过滤器。`inline` 变体把控件放在表头单元格里、列名下面；`inline-compact` 是同一个位置，但控件更紧凑，表格窄的时候用；`popover` 变体把它藏在一个漏斗按钮后面，确认后才生效。状态交给 `useTableFilterState` 管。

```ts
import { useTableFiltering, useTableFilterState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

支持五种字段类型，每种都有对应的控件：

```ts
const fields: TableFilterField[] = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', type: 'string' },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role', type: 'enum', options: roleOptions },
  { key: 'teams', label: 'Teams', type: 'multi-select', options: teamOptions },
  { key: 'age', label: 'Age', type: 'number', min: 18, max: 70, isIntegerOnly: true },
  { key: 'hired', label: 'Hired', type: 'date' },
]
```

`applyTableFilters()` 返回同时满足所有生效过滤的行，插件自己不碰 `data`。

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
  variant: 'inline',
}))
const rows = computed(() => applyTableFilters(employees, filters.value, fields))
```

每次读配置都会重新取值，所以过滤值存在 `ref` 里时要传 getter。直接传对象也能跑，但表格会用第一次读到的过滤值。

行内变体里，带过滤但没有写 `width` 的列会被补成 `proportional(1)`，控件在列名下面放得开。

这套过滤和 Power Search 是分开的。没有 `filter` 的列永远不会被过滤，插件对它什么也不画。

rows.name: `filters`
rows.description: Required. Current filter state: a map from field key to filter value.

rows.name: `onFilterChange`
rows.description: Required. Called when the user changes a filter value. `null` clears the filter.

rows.name: `fields`
rows.description: Required. The fields a column may filter on. Each entry has `key`, `label`, `type`, and the options or limits that type needs.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Where the control sits. `inline` and `inline-compact` render it in the header cell under the label, `inline-compact` in a tighter frame; `popover` keeps it behind a funnel button that applies on confirm.

rows.name: `transformColumns`
rows.description: Only set for the inline variants: a filtered column without a `width` gets `proportional(1)` so the control fits under the label.

rows.name: `filterFor`
rows.description: Builds the control for a column, or `null` when the column has no `filter` or names a field that is not in `fields`.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: The resolved variant, after the default is applied.

rows.name: `field`
rows.description: The field the column named, taken from `fields`.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: The current value from `filters`, or `null` when the field has no filter.

rows.name: `onChange`
rows.description: Reports a new value through your `onFilterChange`, already keyed by the field.

rows.name: `key`
rows.description: Field key. A column's `filter` holds this string, and the field reads `row[key]`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Label and placeholder of the control. It also names the control for screen readers.

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: How the filter matches. `string` matches a substring, `enum` one option, `multi-select` any of the picked options, `number` the same number, and `date` a cell date later than the picked day.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Choices for an `enum` or `multi-select` field. Without options the control renders an empty list.

rows.name: `min`
rows.description: Smallest value a `number` field accepts.

rows.name: `max`
rows.description: Largest value a `number` field accepts.

rows.name: `step`
rows.description: Step of a `number` field.

rows.name: `isIntegerOnly`
rows.description: A `number` field that only accepts whole numbers.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: A `number` field stores a number, `multi-select` stores an array of option values, and the rest store a string. A `date` field stores an ISO calendar day such as `2026-03-21`.

rows.name: `filters`
rows.description: 必填。当前的过滤状态：字段 key 到过滤值的映射。

rows.name: `onFilterChange`
rows.description: 必填。用户改过滤值时调用。`null` 表示清掉这个过滤。

rows.name: `fields`
rows.description: 必填。列可以过滤的字段。每一项有 `key`、`label`、`type`，以及这种类型需要的选项或范围。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 控件放在哪。`inline` 和 `inline-compact` 放在表头单元格里、列名下面，后者更紧凑；`popover` 藏在漏斗按钮后面，确认后才生效。

rows.name: `transformColumns`
rows.description: 只有行内变体才给：带过滤而且没写 `width` 的列补成 `proportional(1)`，控件在列名下面放得开。

rows.name: `filterFor`
rows.description: 生成这一列的控件。列没有 `filter`，或者它指的字段不在 `fields` 里时返回 `null`。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 补完默认值之后的摆放方式。

rows.name: `field`
rows.description: 列指到的字段，来自 `fields`。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 当前值，来自 `filters`。这个字段还没有过滤时是 `null`。

rows.name: `onChange`
rows.description: 把新值交给你的 `onFilterChange`，字段 key 已经带上了。

rows.name: `key`
rows.description: 字段 key。列的 `filter` 里写这个字符串，字段读的是 `row[key]`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 控件的标签和占位文字，也是读屏读到的名字。

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: 命中方式。`string` 匹配子串，`enum` 匹配一个选项，`multi-select` 匹配勾选中的任意一项，`number` 比数值，`date` 要求单元格日期比选的更晚。

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: `enum` 和 `multi-select` 的选项。没有选项时列表是空的。

rows.name: `min`
rows.description: `number` 字段能接受的最小值。

rows.name: `max`
rows.description: `number` 字段能接受的最大值。

rows.name: `step`
rows.description: `number` 字段的步进。

rows.name: `isIntegerOnly`
rows.description: `number` 字段只接受整数。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: `number` 字段存数字，`multi-select` 存选项值数组，其余存字符串。`date` 字段存 ISO 日期，例如 `2026-03-21`。

summary.en: Hook that groups a flat data array into collapsible section rows. Each distinct groupBy value becomes a full-width section-header row with a chevron toggle, the group label, and a member count; collapsing hides that group's data rows while keeping the header visible. The disclosure state lives on the chevron button, not the native table row. Mirrors useTableTreeState: the consumer owns the collapsedGroups set and the hook returns {data, plugin, idKey}: pass them to Table as data, plugins, and idKey respectively. Grouping runs on the rows you hand it, so with pagination the order is filter, sort, slice, then group: sort by the group key first and the user's keys second, so a section's rows stay contiguous and each page appends to the bottom of the table instead of splicing rows in above the reader. A page that ends on a row count still cuts mid-section, and the heading then counts what has loaded rather than what exists: "6" quietly becoming "10". Where the full result set is in hand, carry the cut forward to the end of the section it lands in: every rendered section is then whole and its count is a total.
summary.zh: 把一个扁平的数组收成可折叠的分组行。每个不同的 groupBy 值变成一整行的分组表头，带折叠按钮、分组名和成员数；折叠后这一组的数据行隐藏，表头还在。展开折叠的状态在按钮上，不在原生的表格行上。和 useTableTreeState 一样：被折叠的集合由你保存，hook 返回 {data, plugin, idKey}，分别传给 Table 的 data、plugins 和 idKey。分组发生在你交进来的行上，所以分页时顺序是过滤、排序、切片、再分组：先把分组字段排好，再排用户选的字段，这样同一组的行是连续的，新的一页接在表格下面，而不是插到读者上方。按行数切页仍会切在一组中间，这时表头数的是已经加载的行，而不是总数：「6」会悄悄变成「10」。整份结果都在手上时，把切点推到它落在的那一组末尾：这样每个渲染出来的分组都是完整的，数量也是总数。

usage.en:
Hook that groups a flat data array into collapsible section rows. Each distinct groupBy value becomes a full-width section-header row with a chevron toggle, the group label, and a member count; collapsing hides that group's data rows while keeping the header visible. The disclosure state lives on the chevron button, not the native table row. Mirrors useTableTreeState: the consumer owns the collapsedGroups set and the hook returns {data, plugin, idKey}: pass them to Table as data, plugins, and idKey respectively. Grouping runs on the rows you hand it, so with pagination the order is filter, sort, slice, then group: sort by the group key first and the user's keys second, so a section's rows stay contiguous and each page appends to the bottom of the table instead of splicing rows in above the reader. A page that ends on a row count still cuts mid-section, and the heading then counts what has loaded rather than what exists: "6" quietly becoming "10". Where the full result set is in hand, carry the cut forward to the end of the section it lands in: every rendered section is then whole and its count is a total.

```ts
import { useTableGroupedRows } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

`data` is a computed, so the table re-renders only when the config changes. Give the config as a getter, and replace the collapsed set with a new one instead of mutating it in place; a mutated set is the same object and the computed never re-runs.

```ts
const { data, plugin, idKey } = useTableGroupedRows(() => ({
  data: employees,
  groupBy: employee => employee.team,
  collapsedGroups: collapsed.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
}))
```

A section header is an ordinary object in the array. Use the exported `isTableGroupHeader(row)` to tell one from a data row, for example before numbering rows.

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: `useTableGroupedRows()` takes one config object. Wrap it in a getter or a `ref` so the sections follow the current rows and the current collapsed set: `useTableGroupedRows(() => ({ ... }))`.

description.en: A table grouped into collapsible sections with useTableGroupedRows. Each group gets a full-width header with a chevron, label, and member count; click to collapse or expand.
description.zh: 用 useTableGroupedRows 分成可折叠分组的表格。每组一整行表头，带折叠按钮、组名和成员数；点一下就折叠或展开。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableGroupedRows, useTableRowIndex } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface Employee extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  role: string
}

const employees: Employee[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diego', role: 'Designer' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Employee>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: pixel(140) },
]

const collapsed = ref(new Set<string>())

function toggleGroup(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(collapsed.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  collapsed.value = next
}

const { data: groupedRows, plugin: groupedPlugin, idKey } = useTableGroupedRows<Employee>(() => ({
  data: employees,
  groupBy: employee => employee.role,
  collapsedGroups: collapsed.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
  groupOrder: ['Designer', 'Engineer'],
}))

const numbers = useTableRowIndex<Employee>(() => ({
  data: groupedRows.value,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="groupedRows"
    :columns="columns"
    :id-key="idKey"
    :plugins="{ grouped: groupedPlugin, numbers }"
  />
</template>

summary.en: Call useTablePagination with a config object containing page state and callback. Pass the returned plugin to Table via the plugins prop.
summary.zh: 把当前页和翻页回调交给 `useTablePagination`，再把返回的插件放进 `Table` 的 `plugins`。

usage.en:
Call useTablePagination with a config object containing page state and callback. Pass the returned plugin to Table via the plugins prop.

```ts
import { paginateData, useTablePagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

The hook draws the controls only. You slice the rows yourself: `paginateData(rows, page, pageSize)` returns the window for the current page, and the same `pageSize` has to reach both the slice and the config.

`totalItems` is what the controls count with. When you already know the page count, give `totalPages` instead, and for cursor-based data where the total is unknown, set `hasMore: true` while another page exists. The controls stay out of the way when there is only one page and nothing more to load.

```ts
const page = ref(1)
const pageSize = 5
const plugin = useTablePagination(() => ({
  page: page.value,
  onPageChange(next) {
    page.value = next
  },
  totalItems: users.length,
  pageSize,
}))
const rows = computed(() => paginateData(users, page.value, pageSize))
```

`variant` picks what sits between the previous and next buttons: page numbers, a count, a compact "page X of Y", dots, or nothing. `position` decides whether the controls render above the table, below it, on both sides, or not at all; with `both` the two navs get distinct names so screen readers can tell them apart.

The config is read again on every access, so pass a getter when the page lives in a `ref`. A plain object works too, but the controls keep the page they saw first.
usage.zh:
把当前页和翻页回调交给 `useTablePagination`，再把返回的插件放进 `Table` 的 `plugins`。

```ts
import { paginateData, useTablePagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

这个 hook 只画控件，行还是你自己切：`paginateData(rows, page, pageSize)` 返回当前页的窗口，同一个 `pageSize` 要同时给切片和配置。

页数靠 `totalItems` 算。已经知道页数时改给 `totalPages`；游标分页不知道总数时，只要后面还有内容就把 `hasMore` 设成 `true`。只有一页、也没有下一页时控件自己藏起来。

```ts
const page = ref(1)
const pageSize = 5
const plugin = useTablePagination(() => ({
  page: page.value,
  onPageChange(next) {
    page.value = next
  },
  totalItems: users.length,
  pageSize,
}))
const rows = computed(() => paginateData(users, page.value, pageSize))
```

`variant` 决定上一页和下一页之间放什么：页码、条数、紧凑的「第几页 / 共几页」、圆点，或者什么都不放。`position` 决定控件在表格上方、下方、上下都有，还是不要；取 `both` 时两块导航区的名字会区分开，读屏不会把它们当成同一个。

每次读配置都会重新取值，所以页码存在 `ref` 里时要传 getter。直接传对象也能跑，但控件会用第一次读到的页码。

rows.description: Required. Current page number, 1-based.

rows.name: `onPageChange`
rows.description: Required. Called when the page changes.

rows.name: `totalItems`
rows.description: Total number of items across all pages, used to calculate the page count. Without it, and without `totalPages`, the controls only know about `hasMore`.

rows.name: `totalPages`
rows.description: Total number of pages. Use it when you know the page count but not the item count. It wins over the count derived from `totalItems`.

rows.name: `hasMore`
rows.description: Whether more pages exist after the current one. Use it for cursor-based data where the total is unknown; the next button stays enabled while it is true.

rows.name: `pageSize`
rows.description: Number of items per page. Slice the rows with the same number.

rows.name: `onPageSizeChange`
rows.description: Called when the user changes the page size. A page size selector appears only when this and `pageSizeOptions` are both set.

rows.name: `pageSizeOptions`
rows.description: Available page size options. The selector still needs `onPageSizeChange` to be shown.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: What the controls show between the previous and next buttons: page number buttons, a "X-Y of Z" count, a compact "page X of Y", dot indicators, or nothing.

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: Where the controls render relative to the table. With `'both'` there are two sets, one on each side.

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: Horizontal alignment of the controls.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Height of the controls.

rows.description: Accessible name for the pagination nav landmark. With `position: 'both'` the two navs get distinct names, the label suffixed with "(top)" and "(bottom)", so same-type landmarks stay unique.

rows.description: Renders the controls above the table for `position: 'above'` and `'both'`.

rows.name: `below`
rows.description: Renders the controls under the table for `position: 'below'` and `'both'`.

rows.name: `page`
rows.description: 必填。当前页，从 1 计。

rows.name: `onPageChange`
rows.description: 必填。翻页时调用。

rows.name: `totalItems`
rows.description: 全部条目数，用来算页数。没给它也没给 `totalPages` 时，控件只认 `hasMore`。

rows.name: `totalPages`
rows.description: 总页数。只知道页数、不知道条目数时用它。它优先于从 `totalItems` 算出来的页数。

rows.name: `hasMore`
rows.description: 后面还有没有下一页。游标分页用它：总数未知也能翻。为真时下一页按钮一直可点。

rows.name: `pageSize`
rows.description: 每页条目数。切行的时候要用同一个数。

rows.name: `onPageSizeChange`
rows.description: 用户改每页条数时调用。它和 `pageSizeOptions` 都给，才会出现每页条数选择器。

rows.name: `pageSizeOptions`
rows.description: 可选的每页条数。要出现选择器还需要 `onPageSizeChange`。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 上一页和下一页之间放什么：页码按钮、「第几条到第几条 / 共几条」、紧凑的「第几页 / 共几页」、圆点，或者什么都不放。

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: 控件放在表格的哪一侧。取 `'both'` 时上下各有一组。

rows.name: `align`
rows.description: 控件的水平对齐。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 控件高度。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 分页导航区的无障碍名称。取 `position: 'both'` 时两块导航区的名字会区分开，后面分别加 `(top)` 和 `(bottom)`，同类型地标不会重名。

rows.name: `above`
rows.description: `position` 是 `'above'` 或 `'both'` 时，在表格上方画控件。

rows.name: `below`
rows.description: `position` 是 `'below'` 或 `'both'` 时，在表格下方画控件。

en.heading: Parameters
en.text: `useTablePagination()` takes one config object. Wrap it in a getter or a `ref` so the controls read the current page: `useTablePagination(() => ({ ... }))`.

en.heading: Returns
en.text: `useTablePagination()` returns one `TablePlugin<T>`. Pass it to `Table` in `plugins`. The plugin fills two fields of the plugin contract: Both return null when position is 'none', or when the table holds a single page and hasMore is not true.

zh.heading: 参数
zh.text: `useTablePagination()` 只接一个配置对象。页码存在 `ref` 里时用 getter 包一层，控件每次读都能拿到最新的值：`useTablePagination(() => ({ ... }))`。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: `useTablePagination()` 返回一个 `TablePlugin<T>`，放进 `Table` 的 `plugins` 里。它填的是插件约定里的两个字段： position 是 'none'，或者表格只有一页而且 hasMore 不是 true 时，两个都返回 null。

    id-key="id"

summary.en: Hook that returns a TablePlugin which expands a full-width detail panel below a row, rendered by the consumer via renderExpanded(item). Adds a leading chevron column and a right-click "Expand/Collapse row" action; the consumer owns the expandedKeys set. The panel spans the row but starts its content at the first column, past the chevron, so detail lines up with the labels above it; the inset follows the table density. Use it for master-detail rows (order details, forms, charts, nested tables). For hierarchical data where child rows reuse the parent columns, use useTableTreeData + useTableTreeState instead.
summary.zh: 这个组合式函数返回一个 TablePlugin，能在某一行下面展开一整块详情面板，内容由使用方通过 renderExpanded(item) 画出。它会加上一列前置的折叠按钮，并在右键菜单里加一项「展开/折叠行」；被展开的 expandedKeys 集合由你保存。面板横跨整行，但内容从第一列开始、跳过折叠按钮，所以详情和上面的列名对得齐；左侧留白跟着表格密度走。适合主从结构的行（订单详情、表单、图表、嵌套表格）。子行复用父行那些列的层级数据，用 useTableTreeData + useTableTreeState。

usage.en:
Hook that returns a TablePlugin which expands a full-width detail panel below a row, rendered by the consumer via renderExpanded(item). Adds a leading chevron column and a right-click "Expand/Collapse row" action; the consumer owns the expandedKeys set. The panel spans the row but starts its content at the first column, past the chevron, so detail lines up with the labels above it; the inset follows the table density. Use it for master-detail rows (order details, forms, charts, nested tables). For hierarchical data where child rows reuse the parent columns, use useTableTreeData + useTableTreeState instead.

```ts
import { useTableRowExpansion } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

`renderExpanded` returns a `VNodeChild`, so build the panel with `h()` or render a component you imported. The config is read again on every access: pass a getter, and replace the expanded set with a new one instead of mutating it.

```ts
const expansion = useTableRowExpansion(() => ({
  expandedKeys: expanded.value,
  onToggle: toggle,
  getRowKey: order => order.id,
  renderExpanded: order => h('p', order.note),
}))
```

The chevron column is prepended to your columns under the key `__expansion`. It is 40px wide, its header is hidden from sight but kept for screen readers, and it cannot be resized.


`renderExpanded` 返回 `VNodeChild`，所以用 `h()` 搭面板，或者渲染一个你已经引入的组件。每次读配置都会重新取值：用 getter 传配置，展开集合要换成新对象，不要原地改。

```ts
const expansion = useTableRowExpansion(() => ({
  expandedKeys: expanded.value,
  onToggle: toggle,
  getRowKey: order => order.id,
  renderExpanded: order => h('p', order.note),

```

折叠按钮那一列的 key 是 `__expansion`，插在你的列前面。宽 40px，表头视觉上留空但保留给读屏，不能拖动改宽。

rows.name: `expandedKeys`
rows.description: Required. Set of currently-expanded row keys. Consumer-owned.

rows.name: `onToggle`
rows.description: Required. Called with a row key when its expansion is toggled, by the chevron or by the context-menu action.

rows.name: `getRowKey`
rows.description: Required. Derive a stable unique key from a row item.

rows.name: `renderExpanded`
rows.description: Required. Render the detail content shown in a full-width panel below the row when it is expanded. Receives the row item.

rows.name: `getIsItemExpandable`
rows.description: Control which rows are expandable. Non-expandable rows show no chevron, no context-menu action, and never render a panel. Defaults to all rows expandable.

rows.name: `panelVariant`
rows.description: Background behind the detail panel. `'transparent'` paints nothing: the panel is the row's continuation and takes whatever surface the table sits on, so a Card shows through and a striped table's zebra reads on unchanged. `'muted'` washes it, marking it as commentary rather than another row of data — reach for it in a bare table with no card, dividers or striping, where nothing else makes that distinction. The wash is a low-alpha near-black, so it is close to invisible over a dark card: `'muted'` is largely a light-theme effect.

rows.name: `hasRowClickExpansion`
rows.description: Toggle a row by clicking anywhere on it, not only on its chevron. A pointer-only convenience layered over the chevron, which stays the accessible control for keyboard and assistive tech. Clicks on interactive cell content (buttons, links, form controls) or on a text selection do not toggle, and non-expandable rows stay inert.
