description.en: A table where each row opens a full-width detail panel. Click the chevron, or right-click a row for the expand action.
description.zh: 每行都能展开一整块详情面板的表格。点折叠按钮，或者右键一行选展开。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableRowExpansion } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { h, ref } from 'vue'

interface Order extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  customer: string
  total: string
  note: string
}

const orders: Order[] = [
  { id: '1042', customer: 'Northwind', total: '$240', note: 'Two seats, ships Friday.' },
  { id: '1043', customer: 'Contoso', total: '$80', note: 'Gift wrap requested.' },
  { id: '1044', customer: 'Fabrikam', total: '$560', note: 'Hold for pickup.' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Order>[] = [
  { key: 'id', header: 'Order', width: pixel(100) },
  { key: 'customer', header: 'Customer', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'total', header: 'Total', width: pixel(100) },
]

const expanded = ref(new Set<string>(['1042']))

function toggle(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(expanded.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  expanded.value = next
}

const expansion = useTableRowExpansion<Order>(() => ({
  expandedKeys: expanded.value,
  onToggle: toggle,
  getRowKey: order => order.id,
  panelVariant: 'muted',
  hasRowClickExpansion: true,
  renderExpanded: order => h('p', order.note),
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="orders"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    :plugins="{ expansion }"
  />
</template>

summary.en: Hook that returns a TablePlugin which prepends a narrow column signaling per-row status. Return `{status, label}` for a semantic success, warning, or error: Table resolves the matching glyph and tone through the active theme. Return `{color, icon?, label}` for a custom marker: every color is paint-only, an omitted icon renders the stable 8px dot, and an explicit icon renders that caller-selected glyph. Named custom icons keep their released Icon color mapping; raw CSS custom icons inherit the caller's exact paint instead of the previous primary fallback. `label` is required and becomes the accessible image name plus supplemental hover tooltip; return `null` for no indicator. The column header is visually blank but carries a screen-reader-only localized name ("Row status", i18n key `@astryx.table.rowStatus.columnHeader`). Put `getStatus` inside a getter when it reads reactive state; the plugin calls it on every render.
summary.zh: 返回一个 `TablePlugin`，在表格最前面加一列窄列，用来标示每一行的状态。语义状态返回 `{status, label}`，只接受 success、warning、error 三个值：图标和色调由当前主题决定。自定义标记返回 `{color, icon?, label}`：`color` 只决定颜色，不给 `icon` 就画一个固定的 8px 圆点，给了 `icon` 就画你指定的那个图标。图标名仍然沿用 Icon 的颜色映射；用原始 CSS 颜色的自定义图标，完全按你给的颜色画。`label` 是必填的：它既做无障碍名称，也做悬浮提示；返回 `null` 表示这一行不放标记。列表头视觉上是空的，但对读屏软件有一个本地化的名字。`getStatus` 里如果要读响应式状态，把它放进 getter 里；插件每次渲染都会调用它。

Even color values named success/error/warning remain dots without icon. Valid icon names: close, chevronDown, chevronLeft, chevronRight, chevronsLeft, chevronsRight, check, success, error, warning, info, calendar, clock, externalLink, menu, moreHorizontal, search, upload, arrowUp, arrowDown, arrowsUpDown, funnel, eyeSlash, viewColumns, copy, checkDouble, wrench, stop, microphone, image. The branches are exclusive, label is required and announced via `role="img"`, and `null` leaves the row status cell empty.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn, TableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { proportional, Table, useTableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

interface Check extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  detail: string
  state: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral'
}

const checks: Check[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Payments', detail: 'Settled', state: 'success' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Inventory', detail: 'Low stock', state: 'warning' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Mail', detail: 'Bounced', state: 'error' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Notes', detail: 'No signal', state: 'neutral' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Check>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Service', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'detail', header: 'Detail', width: proportional(1) },
]

function statusFor(check: Check): TableRowStatus | null {
  if (check.state === 'neutral')
    return { color: 'gray', label: 'No signal' }
  if (check.state === 'success')
    return { status: 'success', label: 'Settled' }
  if (check.state === 'warning')
    return { status: 'warning', label: 'Low stock' }
  return { status: 'error', label: 'Bounced' }
}

const status = useTableRowStatus<Check>({ getStatus: statusFor })
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="checks"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    :plugins="{ status }"
  />

Selection state is read through the getters on every render, so the checkbox cells follow whatever reactive state those getters read; there is no provider to wrap the table in.
summary.zh: 返回一个 `TablePlugin`，实现行选择：复选框列、全选，以及 `aria-selected`。复选框列由表格自己加，不用你在 `columns` 里写。选择状态是从你给的 getter 里现读的，这些 getter 读到哪个响应式状态，复选框就跟着哪个状态走，不需要再套一层 provider。

usage.en:
Hook that returns a TablePlugin implementing row selection with checkboxes, select-all, and `aria-selected`. The table adds the checkbox column itself. Selection state is read through the getters on every render, so the checkbox cells follow whatever reactive state those getters read; there is no provider to wrap the table in.

```ts
import { useTableSelection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

Two getters decide what a row looks like. `getIsItemSelectable` removes the checkbox from a row that has nothing to select, and `getIsItemEnabled` keeps the checkbox in place but disabled, for a row that cannot be picked right now.

```ts
const selection = useTableSelection({
  getIsItemSelected: item => selectedKeys.value.has(item.id),
  onSelectItem: ({ item, isSelected }) => { /* ... */ },
  onSelectAll: ({ isAllSelected }) => { /* ... */ },
  getIsAllSelected: () => /* ... */ false,
  getIsItemSelectable: item => item.role !== 'System',
  getIsItemEnabled: item => item.status !== 'Locked',
})
```

`hasRowHighlight` only controls the accent wash on checked rows. `aria-selected` stays on them either way, so the selection is still announced when the surrounding UI already uses row background for something else.
usage.zh:
返回一个 `TablePlugin`，实现行选择：复选框列、全选，以及 `aria-selected`。复选框列由表格自己加，不用你在 `columns` 里写。选择状态是从你给的 getter 里现读的，这些 getter 读到哪个响应式状态，复选框就跟着哪个状态走，不需要再套一层 provider。

```ts
import { useTableSelection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

两个 getter 决定一行长什么样。`getIsItemSelectable` 让没什么可选的行连复选框都不显示；`getIsItemEnabled` 保留复选框但把它禁用，用在「这一行现在不能选」的场合。

```ts
const selection = useTableSelection({
  getIsItemSelected: item => selectedKeys.value.has(item.id),
  onSelectItem: ({ item, isSelected }) => { /* ... */ },
  onSelectAll: ({ isAllSelected }) => { /* ... */ },
  getIsAllSelected: () => /* ... */ false,
  getIsItemSelectable: item => item.role !== 'System',
  getIsItemEnabled: item => item.status !== 'Locked',
})
```

`hasRowHighlight` 只管选中行上那层浅色底。`aria-selected` 无论如何都写在选中的行上，所以就算周围界面已经用行底色表达别的意思，选中状态照样念得出来。

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { proportional, Table, useTableSelection, useTableSelectionState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Charlie', email: 'charlie@example.com', role: 'Manager' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diana', email: 'diana@example.com', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Eve', email: 'eve@example.com', role: 'Admin' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: proportional(1) },
]

const selectedKeys = ref(new Set<string>())
const { selectionConfig } = useTableSelectionState<User>({
  data: users,
  idKey: 'id',
  selectedKeys,
  setSelectedKeys(keys) {
    selectedKeys.value = keys
  },
})
const selectionPlugin = useTableSelection<User>(selectionConfig)
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="users"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    :plugins="{ selection: selectionPlugin }"
  />
</template>

summary.en: State management companion for `useTableSelection`. Returns `selectionConfig` for the behaviour plugin plus `selectionState` for selection-aware UI such as `TableSelectionToolbar`. The selection itself stays controlled: you own the `Set` of selected keys and pass a setter. Select-all only takes the rows that can be checked, so rows that are not selectable or are disabled keep whatever state they had. `idKey` takes a property name or a function that returns the key.
summary.zh: `useTableSelection` 的配套状态工具。它返回两个东西：`selectionConfig` 交给选择插件，`selectionState` 交给关心选择状态的界面，比如 `TableSelectionToolbar`。选中结果仍然是受控的：选中的键那个 `Set` 由你保存，再给一个写回的函数。全选只勾真正能勾的行，不能选和被禁用的行保留原来的状态。`idKey` 可以给属性名，也可以给一个从行里取键的函数。

  { key: 'friday', header: 'Friday', width: pixel(140) },
]

const sticky = useTableStickyColumns<Shift>({
  startKeys: ['name'],

})

summary.en: Headless tree plugin for Table: renders nested rows with per-level indentation and expand/collapse chevrons in the tree column (the first column by default), and reflects hierarchy on body rows via `aria-level` and `aria-expanded`. Composable with the other Table plugins: the canonical plugin order places tree before selection, so the checkbox column lands left of the indented tree column. Feed it the config that `useTableTreeState` builds for you, or construct the config directly for server-driven or pre-flattened trees. When no row is expandable (flat data), every transform is a pass-through and the table renders identically to one without the plugin. Known limitation: the tree column wraps its cell content, so `textOverflow="truncate"` tooltips do not apply within the tree column.
summary.zh: 给表格用的无渲染树插件。树列（默认是第一列）里会按层级缩进，并画出展开/收起的箭头；表体行上会带 `aria-level` 和 `aria-expanded`，把层级关系说出来。它和别的表格插件可以叠着用：约定顺序是树在前、选择在后，这样复选框列就落在缩进过的树列左边。配置可以直接用 `useTableTreeState` 帮你拼好的那份，也可以在服务端驱动或者数据已经拍平的场景自己拼。一行都不可展开时（比如拍平的普通数据），它的每个变换都是原样返回，表格看起来和没装这个插件一样。已知限制：树列里的内容会自动换行，所以 `textOverflow="truncate"` 的提示在树列里不生效。

usage.en:
Headless tree plugin for Table: renders nested rows with per-level indentation and expand/collapse chevrons in the tree column (the first column by default), and reflects hierarchy on body rows via `aria-level` and `aria-expanded`. Composable with the other Table plugins: the canonical plugin order places tree before selection, so the checkbox column lands left of the indented tree column. Feed it the config that `useTableTreeState` builds for you, or construct the config directly for server-driven or pre-flattened trees. When no row is expandable (flat data), every transform is a pass-through and the table renders identically to one without the plugin. Known limitation: the tree column wraps its cell content, so `textOverflow="truncate"` tooltips do not apply within the tree column.

```ts
import { useTableTreeData } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { proportional, Table, useTableTreeState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

interface Node extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  owner: string
  children?: Node[]
}

const nodes: Node[] = [
  {
    id: 'platform',
    name: 'Platform',
    owner: 'Ada',
    children: [
      { id: 'api', name: 'API', owner: 'Grace' },
      {
        id: 'web',
        name: 'Web',
        owner: 'Lin',
        children: [
          { id: 'docs', name: 'Docs', owner: 'Maya' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'design', name: 'Design', owner: 'Noah' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Node>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'owner', header: 'Owner', width: proportional(1) },
]

const { visibleData, plugin: treePlugin } = useTableTreeState<Node>({
  data: nodes,
  idKey: 'id',
  defaultExpandedIds: ['platform'],
  hasExpandAllControl: true,
  hasRowClickExpansion: true,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="visibleData"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    has-hover
    :plugins="{ tree: treePlugin }"
  />
</template>

summary.en: State management companion for `useTableTreeData`. Owns the expanded set (controlled or uncontrolled) and flattens nested data into the visible row array; collapsed subtrees are unmounted, not hidden, so the table body contains exactly the visible rows. Returns `expandAll` / `collapseAll` helpers, the aggregate `isAllExpanded` state (true/false/indeterminate) for a header expand-all control, and a ready-to-use `plugin` for the tree. Note: because collapsed rows unmount, local component state inside collapsed subtrees is lost on collapse; lift state that must survive.
summary.zh: `useTableTreeData` 的配套状态工具。展开集合由它管（受控或不受控都行），嵌套数据也由它拍平成可见的行。收起的分支是真的不渲染，不是藏起来，所以表体里正好只有看得见的那些行。它会返回 `expandAll` / `collapseAll` 两个方法、给表头全展开开关用的汇总状态 `isAllExpanded`（true/false/indeterminate），以及一个拿来就能用的 `plugin`。注意：收起的行不渲染，所以收起的子树里组件自己的局部状态会丢；需要活下来的状态往上抬。

usage.en:
State management companion for `useTableTreeData`. Owns the expanded set (controlled or uncontrolled) and flattens nested data into the visible row array; collapsed subtrees are unmounted, not hidden, so the table body contains exactly the visible rows. Returns `expandAll` / `collapseAll` helpers, the aggregate `isAllExpanded` state (true/false/indeterminate) for a header expand-all control, and a ready-to-use `plugin` for the tree. Note: because collapsed rows unmount, local component state inside collapsed subtrees is lost on collapse; lift state that must survive.

```ts
import { useTableTreeState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

summary.en: Programmatic access to theme tokens for non-CSS consumers like SVG, canvas, Vega, D3, maps, or chart libraries that need values in JavaScript instead of CSS custom property references.
summary.zh: 用代码拿主题 token 的值。给不吃 CSS 的地方用：SVG、canvas、Vega、D3、地图、图表库，它们要的是 JavaScript 里的具体值，而不是一个 CSS 变量名。

usage.en:
Programmatic access to theme tokens for non-CSS consumers like SVG, canvas, Vega, D3, maps, or chart libraries that need values in JavaScript instead of CSS custom property references.

```ts
import { useTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
```

```ts
const { mode, token, tokens } = useTheme()

const accent = token('--color-accent')
const categorical = tokens.value['--color-data-categorical-blue']
```
usage.zh:
用代码拿主题 token 的值。给不吃 CSS 的地方用：SVG、canvas、Vega、D3、地图、图表库，它们要的是 JavaScript 里的具体值，而不是一个 CSS 变量名。

```ts
import { useTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
```

```ts
const { mode, token, tokens } = useTheme()

const accent = token('--color-accent')
const categorical = tokens.value['--color-data-categorical-blue']
```

en.text: Use `tokens` or `token(name)` when integrating theme colors into SVG attributes, canvas drawing, chart options, or other non-CSS configuration objects inside Vue components.
Prefer CSS variables for ordinary component styling; use this hook only when JavaScript needs token values.
Use data visualization tokens such as `--color-data-categorical-blue` for chart series instead of arbitrary UI colors.
Hardcode light/dark colors in data visualizations: resolve them through the current theme instead.
Assume the hook reflects every CSS cascade override. It resolves tokens for the current `Theme` mode; local media-surface overrides and arbitrary external CSS may not be represented.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Name of the nearest theme, or `neutral` when no `Theme` is present.

rows.name: `mode`
rows.description: Resolved effective color mode. `system` is resolved to `light` or `dark`.

rows.name: `token`
rows.description: Resolve a single design token to its current CSS value for the effective mode. Outside a `Theme`, it reads the document's custom properties.

rows.name: `tokens`
rows.description: Tokens declared by the nearest theme, resolved for the effective mode. A `[light, dark]` tuple becomes one value. Stable until the active theme or mode changes.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: 最近一层主题的名字。没有 `Theme` 时是 `neutral`。

rows.name: `mode`
rows.description: 实际生效的颜色模式。`system` 已经解析成 `light` 或 `dark`。

rows.name: `token`
rows.description: 按当前模式把一个设计 token 解析成实际的 CSS 值。不在 `Theme` 里时，读的是文档根元素上的自定义属性。

rows.name: `tokens`
rows.description: 最近一层主题声明的 token，按当前模式解析后的结果。`[浅色, 深色]` 会收成一个值。主题或模式不变时结果是稳定的。

en.heading: Returns
en.text: Token names may be written either way: --color-accent or --astryx-color-accent.

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 在 Vue 组件里往 SVG 属性、canvas 绘制、图表配置这类非 CSS 的对象里填颜色时，用 `tokens` 或 `token(name)`。
- 推荐: 普通组件样式优先用 CSS 变量；只有 JavaScript 真需要具体值时才用这个 hook。
- 推荐: 图表系列色用 `--color-data-categorical-blue` 这类数据可视化 token，不要随手挑一个界面颜色。
- 避免: 在数据可视化里把浅色和深色写死：应该从当前主题解析出来。
- 避免: 以为这个 hook 能反映所有 CSS 层叠覆盖。它只按当前 `Theme` 的模式解析；局部的媒体表面覆盖、以及外来的任意 CSS，不一定能体现出来。

zh.heading: 返回值
zh.text: token 名两种写法都可以：--color-accent 或 --astryx-color-accent。

description.en: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.
description.zh: 用 useTheme 读出解析后的 token 值，给 SVG 图表这类不吃 CSS 的地方用。

summary.en: Hook for showing toast notifications from anywhere in your component tree. Returns a function that accepts toast options and shows the notification. Toasts live in a module-level store, so the hook works in any component; render `ToastViewport` once to give them a place to appear. `LayerProvider` only supplies the viewport's placement and visible limit.
summary.zh: `useToast` 是一个在页面的任何地方都能随时呼叫的组合式函数，用来向用户弹出一句轻量、会自动消失的文字提示（Toast，又称轻提示），比如「保存成功」或「复制到剪贴板」。

usage.en:
Hook for showing toast notifications from anywhere in your component tree. Returns a function that accepts toast options and shows the notification. Toasts live in a module-level store, so the hook works in any component; render `ToastViewport` once to give them a place to appear. `LayerProvider` only supplies the viewport's placement and visible limit.

```ts
import { useToast } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toast'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToastViewport, useToast } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toast'

const toast = useToast()
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="toast({ body: 'Document saved successfully', type: 'success' })">
    Show toast
  </button>
  <ToastViewport />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`useToast` 是一个在页面的任何地方都能随时呼叫的组合式函数，用来向用户弹出一句轻量、会自动消失的文字提示（Toast，又称轻提示），比如「保存成功」或「复制到剪贴板」。

它返回一个调用函数，只要传入提示内容和类型就能触发显示。所有的提示消息都统一保存在底层的全局状态里，所以在任何深层子组件里调用都管用。只需要在应用外层（或根组件）挂载一个 `<ToastViewport />`，提示就会整整齐齐地呈现在那里。

**什么时候用：**
- 用户完成某个操作后，给出短暂且不打扰人的成功反馈（如“更新成功”、“已发送”）。
- 轻微且不致命的操作错误提示。

**什么时候不要用：**
- 如果是不可逆的危险操作（如永久删除数据）或者需要用户仔细确认的报错，严禁使用 Toast，必须改用会锁屏确认的 [AlertDialog](/components/alert-dialog)。
- 如果提示需要用户驻足阅读并点击多个按钮处理，请改用对话框 [Dialog](/components/dialog) 或顶部常驻横幅。

```ts
import { useToast } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toast'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToastViewport, useToast } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toast'

const toast = useToast()
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="toast({ body: '文档已保存', type: 'success' })">
    弹出提示
  </button>
  <ToastViewport />
</template>
```

en.text: Use for transient success/error feedback that does not require user action.
Set `uniqueID` to deduplicate toasts from rapid user actions.
Render `ToastViewport` once near the app root, so every toast has a place to appear.
Use for critical errors that require acknowledgment; use `AlertDialog` instead.

usage.en: Headless hook for hover/focus-triggered tooltips. Builds on `useLayer` with hover intent, keyboard focus handling, and accessible `aria-describedby` linking. Use for custom trigger elements that need tooltip behavior without the wrapper component. ```ts import { useTooltip } from '@astryx-vue/core/Tooltip' ``` Bind `triggerRef` to the element that owns the tooltip. The hook attaches the pointer and focus handlers and appends its ID to `aria-describedby`, keeping whatever the element already had. Render the bubble yourself and spread `contentProps` on it: ```vue ``` `contentProps` carries `role="tooltip"`, the ID, and the pointer handlers that keep the bubble open while the pointer is inside it. Give the bubble `position: fixed` in your own CSS; `contentStyle` only supplies the measured coordinates.

summary.en: Returns a translator function that resolves keys against the current locale, provider overrides, and the shipped English fallback catalog. Call inside a component; the returned function can be used anywhere within that component's scope.
summary.zh: 返回一个翻译函数，按当前语言、provider 给的覆盖和包内自带的英文兜底目录把消息键换成成品文案。在组件里调用；拿到的函数在这个组件的范围内哪里都能用。

usage.en:
Returns a translator function that resolves keys against the current locale, provider overrides, and the shipped English fallback catalog. Call inside a component; the returned function can be used anywhere within that component's scope.

```ts
import { useTranslator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
```

The key is an upstream message key such as `@astryx.pagination.next`. Placeholder values are passed in order and formatted with the active locale's rules, so plural forms and number grouping follow that language. A key that has no slot in this package comes back unchanged, which makes a missing key visible instead of blank. `t` reads the provider on every call, so one translator keeps working after the provider switches language.
usage.zh:
返回一个翻译函数，按当前语言、provider 给的覆盖和包内自带的英文兜底目录把消息键换成成品文案。在组件里调用；拿到的函数在这个组件的范围内哪里都能用。

```ts
import { useTranslator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
```

键用的是原版的消息键，例如 `@astryx.pagination.next`。占位符的值按顺序传进去，按当前语言的规则拼，所以复数和千分位都跟着这门语言走。这个包里没有对应位置的键会原样返回，缺键能一眼看见，而不是变成一片空白。`t` 每次调用都重新读 provider，所以 provider 换语言之后同一个翻译函数照样能用。

rows.name: `t`
rows.type: `(key: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>) => string`
rows.description: A translator function bound to the current InternationalizationProvider context. Call it with a message key and optional placeholder values to get the formatted string in the active locale. The function itself stays the same for the life of the component; every call reads the provider, so it is safe to use in render, event handlers, watchers, or any code that runs during the component's lifecycle.

rows.name: `t`
rows.type: `(key: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>) => string`
rows.description: 绑在当前 `InternationalizationProvider` 上的翻译函数。传一个消息键和可选的占位符值，拿回当前语言的成品文案。函数本身在组件存活期间一直是同一个；每次调用才去读 provider，所以在渲染、事件处理、watch，或组件生命周期里任何会跑到的代码中都能用。

summary.en: Manages roving-tabindex focus and the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model. ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End roam linearly over the visible treeitems (skipping disabled ones), while ArrowRight/ArrowLeft carry tree semantics (expand/collapse, move to first-child/parent). Enter/Space activate, and printable characters trigger typeahead.
summary.zh: 管理树形控件的 roving tabindex 焦点，以及 WAI-ARIA 树的那套键盘规则。上、下、Home、End 在可见的树节点之间按顺序移动（跳过停用的节点）；右、左带树的语义（展开或收起，去第一个子节点或回父节点）。Enter 和空格激活，直接敲字符会触发 typeahead 跳到以这些字符开头的节点。

usage.en: Manages roving-tabindex focus and the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model. ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End roam linearly over the visible treeitems (skipping disabled ones), while ArrowRight/ArrowLeft carry tree semantics (expand/collapse, move to first-child/parent). Enter/Space activate, and printable characters trigger typeahead. Turn on `hasRovingTabIndex` to let the hook own the single tab stop. Leave it off to keep the tab stop yourself: `onActiveChange` then tells you which item the hook moved focus to. ```ts import { useTreeFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList' ``` ```vue ```
usage.zh: 管理树形控件的 roving tabindex 焦点，以及 WAI-ARIA 树的那套键盘规则。上、下、Home、End 在可见的树节点之间按顺序移动（跳过停用的节点）；右、左带树的语义（展开或收起，去第一个子节点或回父节点）。Enter 和空格激活，直接敲字符会触发 typeahead 跳到以这些字符开头的节点。 打开 `hasRovingTabIndex` 就由这个 hook 管唯一那个 tab 停靠点。不打开就自己管：hook 把焦点移到哪个节点，会通过 `onActiveChange` 告诉你。 ```ts import { useTreeFocus } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Use for hierarchical tree widgets: wire `onToggleExpand` to your expansion state, and either turn on `hasRovingTabIndex` or move your own tab stop from `onActiveChange`.
Attach both `treeRef` and `handleKeyDown` to the `role="tree"` container element (`ref="treeRef"` and `@keydown="handleKeyDown"`).
Attach `handleFocus` to the container's `@focus` when the hook owns the tab stop: that is how it is repaired after a click.
Use for linear lists (prefer `useListFocus`) or 2D grids (prefer `useGridRovingFocus`); those traversals differ from a tree.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: Configuration object for tree focus behavior. Required; every field inside it is optional.

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: Selector for the visible treeitems within the tree, in DOM order.

rows.name: `options.isItemDisabled`
rows.description: Predicate for whether a treeitem is disabled and must be skipped during navigation. Defaults to reading `data-tree-disabled` and `aria-disabled`.

rows.name: `options.getLevel`
rows.description: Reads the 1-based nesting level of a treeitem. Defaults to the `aria-level` attribute.

rows.name: `options.onToggleExpand`
rows.description: Called to expand or collapse the treeitem with the given id: ArrowRight on a collapsed parent, ArrowLeft on an expanded parent, and Enter or Space on a parent without its own action. The id is the item's `data-tree-id`, or its `id` attribute when that is absent.

rows.name: `options.onActivate`
rows.type: `(item: HTMLElement, id: string | undefined) => boolean | void`
rows.description: Called when Enter or Space activates a treeitem. Return `true` when handled; return `false` or nothing to let the hook fall back to toggling expansion.

rows.name: `options.onActiveChange`
rows.description: Notified when the hook moves focus to a treeitem. Consumers use this to move a single roving tab stop when the hook does not own it, and to keep their own active state in step.

rows.name: `options.hasRovingTabIndex`
rows.description: When true, the hook owns a single roving tab stop across the visible treeitems: it stamps `tabindex` 0/-1, repairs the stop on mount, and moves it with navigation. An existing `tabindex="0"` seed is preserved on mount. Attach the returned `handleFocus` to keep the stop in sync after clicks.

rows.name: `options.typeahead`
rows.description: Whether typeahead is enabled: a printable character jumps to the next item whose text starts with the typed characters.

rows.name: `treeRef`
rows.description: Ref to attach to the tree container element (`role="tree"`).

rows.name: `handleKeyDown`
rows.description: Key down handler to attach to the tree container.

rows.name: `handleFocus`
rows.description: Focus handler to attach to the container's `@focus`. Keeps the roving tab stop in sync when `hasRovingTabIndex` is on, and does nothing otherwise, so it is always safe to attach.

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: Focus the first enabled visible treeitem.

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: Focus the last enabled visible treeitem.

rows.name: `options`
rows.description: 树形焦点行为的配置。必传，里面的字段都是可选的。

rows.name: `options.itemSelector`
rows.description: 树里可见节点的选择器，按 DOM 顺序。

rows.name: `options.isItemDisabled`
rows.description: 判断某个节点是否停用、导航时要跳过。不传时读 `data-tree-disabled` 和 `aria-disabled`。

rows.name: `options.getLevel`
rows.description: 读某个节点的层级（从 1 开始）。不传时读 `aria-level` 属性。

rows.name: `options.onToggleExpand`
rows.description: 展开或收起指定 id 的节点时调用：右方向键按在收起的父节点上、左方向键按在展开的父节点上、以及父节点自己没有动作时按 Enter 或空格。id 取节点的 `data-tree-id`，没有就取它的 `id` 属性。

rows.name: `options.onActivate`
rows.type: `(item: HTMLElement, id: string | undefined) => boolean | void`
rows.description: Enter 或空格激活节点时调用。你自己处理了就返回 `true`；返回 `false` 或不返回，hook 会退回去切换展开状态。

rows.name: `options.onActiveChange`
rows.description: hook 把焦点移到某个节点之后通知。tab 停靠点不归 hook 管时，用它自己挪；也可以用它同步自己的选中状态。

rows.name: `options.hasRovingTabIndex`
rows.description: 为 true 时由 hook 管唯一的 tab 停靠点：给各项打上 `tabindex` 0/-1，挂载时对齐一次，导航时跟着走。挂载时已有的 `tabindex="0"` 会被保留为起点。点了之后想让它对齐，把返回的 `handleFocus` 接上。

rows.name: `options.typeahead`
rows.description: 是否启用 typeahead：敲一个可打印字符，跳到下一个文本以这些字符开头的节点。

rows.name: `treeRef`
rows.description: 绑到树容器（`role="tree"`）上的 ref。

rows.name: `handleKeyDown`
rows.description: 绑到树容器上的按键处理函数。

rows.name: `handleFocus`
rows.description: 绑到容器 `@focus` 上的处理函数。`hasRovingTabIndex` 打开时靠它把 tab 停靠点对齐，没打开时它什么都不做，所以一直绑着也不会有副作用。

rows.name: `focusFirst`
rows.description: 聚焦第一个可用的可见节点。

rows.name: `focusLast`
rows.description: 聚焦最后一个可用的可见节点。

zh.heading: 建议
zh.text:
- 推荐: 用在有层级的树形控件里：把 `onToggleExpand` 接到你的展开状态上；tab 停靠点要么交给 `hasRovingTabIndex`，要么自己在 `onActiveChange` 里挪。
- 推荐: 把 `treeRef` 和 `handleKeyDown` 一起绑到 `role="tree"` 的容器上（`ref="treeRef"` 和 `@keydown="handleKeyDown"`）。
- 推荐: 由 hook 管 tab 停靠点时，把 `handleFocus` 接到容器的 `@focus` 上：点完之后靠它对齐。
- 避免: 用在线性列表（改用 `useListFocus`）或二维网格（改用 `useGridRovingFocus`）上；那些遍历方式和树不一样。

summary.en: Adds APG type-to-focus search to a collection: printable keystrokes are buffered (resetting after a pause), and the first item whose label starts with the buffer is reported through `onMatch`. Pressing the same letter repeatedly cycles through the matches rather than filtering deeper. It moves nothing itself; pair it with the collection's own focus management, most often `useListFocus` or `useGridRovingFocus`.
summary.zh: 给一组选项加上 APG 里的「打字跳转」：打出来的字符先攒在缓冲区里，停一会儿就清空；只要某一项的标签以这段字符开头，就把它的下标交给 `onMatch`。同一个字母一直按，会在匹配上的几项之间轮着走，而不是把条件收得更窄。它自己不动焦点，要跟你已有的焦点管理配合，通常就是 `useListFocus` 或 `useGridRovingFocus`。

usage.en: Adds APG type-to-focus search to a collection: printable keystrokes are buffered (resetting after a pause), and the first item whose label starts with the buffer is reported through `onMatch`. Pressing the same letter repeatedly cycles through the matches rather than filtering deeper. It moves nothing itself; pair it with the collection's own focus management, most often `useListFocus` or `useGridRovingFocus`. `onKeyDown` takes a native `KeyboardEvent` and returns `true` when it consumed a printable character, so let it look at the event first and fall through to arrow-key navigation only when it returns `false`. Space counts as part of the query only when something is already typed, so Space still activates the focused item. `reset()` clears a pending buffer, for example when the collection closes. ```ts import { useTypeahead } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```
usage.zh: 给一组选项加上 APG 里的「打字跳转」：打出来的字符先攒在缓冲区里，停一会儿就清空；只要某一项的标签以这段字符开头，就把它的下标交给 `onMatch`。同一个字母一直按，会在匹配上的几项之间轮着走，而不是把条件收得更窄。它自己不动焦点，要跟你已有的焦点管理配合，通常就是 `useListFocus` 或 `useGridRovingFocus`。 `onKeyDown` 收的是原生 `KeyboardEvent`，吃掉一个可打印字符时返回 `true`。所以先让它看一眼事件，它返回 `false` 时再交给方向键。空格只有在缓冲区里已经有字的时候才算查询的一部分，所以空格照样能激活当前项。`reset()` 清掉还没超时的缓冲区，比如这组选项关掉的时候。 ```ts import { useTypeahead } from '@astryx-vue/core' ``` ```vue ```

en.text: Wire `onMatch` to the focus manager you already have (`useListFocus().focusItem`) instead of moving focus yourself.
Let it see the key event first and fall through to arrow-key navigation only when it returns `false`.
Pass `getCurrentIndex` so repeated presses of one letter walk through matches instead of sticking on the first.
Use it on a text input; the field already receives the characters, and typeahead would fight the value.

- Do: `onMatch` 接到你已有的焦点管理上（比如 `useListFocus().focusItem`），不要自己挪焦点。
- Do: 让按键事件先过它，它返回 `false` 时再交给方向键。

body.en:
# Accessibility

Components are built around accessible names, the keyboard, and screen readers. Docs and examples do not drop the focus ring or the contrast to get a look.

Keyboard focus uses `--astryx-focus-outline-*`: 2px, `solid`, the color `--astryx-color-accent`, and a 3px offset. Do not zero `outline` globally. The docs site removes the extra outline only on controls that already draw their own focus, such as inputs with a rounded focus treatment.

An icon-only button needs a name. `IconButton`'s `label` is that name. `NavItem`'s `label` is required too. Decorative graphics use `aria-hidden`. An icon class is not text.

When content has to stay in the accessibility tree and disappear visually, use `VisuallyHidden` from `@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden`.

Announcements go through `useAnnounce`. Changing a button's text after a copy often is not spoken, so `useClipboard` accepts `announce` and speaks that string after a successful write. Popup dismissal uses the Escape stack in `useDismiss`. Dialogs trap Tab with `useFocusTrap` and return focus with `useRestoreFocus`. `useScrollLock` locks background scroll while a popup is open.

Arrow keys for lists and menus live in `useListFocus`, `useGridRovingFocus`, and `useTypeahead`. `ChatMessageList` is `role="log"`. Keep `isStreaming` true while an assistant reply is still growing so a screen reader waits for the finished message instead of speaking every token.

Motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion`. The shared motion classes collapse distance and scale to zero. See [Motion](/en/themes/motion).

There is no separate third-party audit to cite. Keyboard and screen reader behavior for a component is what that component's docs and the repository tests say.
body.zh:
# 无障碍

让所有人都能顺畅使用界面，是组件库的基础设计原则。无论是用键盘操作，还是依赖读屏软件（屏幕阅读器），都能正常使用。组件与示例不会为了好看而去掉焦点环，也不会为了极简而降低色彩对比度。

## 键盘焦点指示

键盘操作时，焦点外边框是告诉用户「我当前聚焦在哪」的关键向导。组件库统一采用 `--astryx-focus-outline-*` 变量来管理焦点外观：宽度固定为 2px，实线样式，颜色采用主题强调色 `--astryx-color-accent`，并保持 3px 的向外间距。

不要在全局样式中写 `outline: none`。文档站只在自带内部圆角焦点效果的控件（如特定输入框）上，略微调整外轮廓，避免出现双层边框。

## 给无文字的按钮起名字

如果一个按钮只有图标没有文字，读屏软件就无法知道它是做什么的。因此，纯图标按钮必须提供可访问名称（Accessible Name）：

- `IconButton` 组件的 `label` 属性是必填的，它会直接作为无障碍名称念给读屏用户听。
- `NavItem` 的 `label` 同样必填。
- 纯装饰性的图形应当使用 `aria-hidden="true"` 隐藏，不要试图直接用图标类名充当文字内容。

如果你需要让某些说明文字能够被读屏软件听到、但又不想在视觉界面上占用版面，可以使用 `@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden` 提供的 `VisuallyHidden` 组件。

## 浮层与弹窗处理

弹窗和下拉浮层需要精细的无障碍焦点流转管理：

- **限制焦点**：使用 `useFocusTrap` 把键盘 Tab 切换限制在弹窗内，防止焦点跳到背后的主页面上。
- **还原焦点**：使用 `useRestoreFocus`，在弹窗关闭后，自动把焦点送回到刚才点击打开它的那个按钮上。
- **便捷关闭**：浮层的按下 Escape 键退出逻辑统一交给 `useDismiss` 的撤销栈管理，按由内向外的顺序逐层关闭。
- **锁定滚动**：浮层打开时，通过 `useScrollLock` 锁定背景的滚动，避免误触。

## 读屏播报与 AI 对话交互

- **主动通知**：某些操作完成后（比如点击复制按钮成功），如果界面只变化了按钮文字，读屏软件往往不会自动读取。此时可以通过 `useAnnounce` 触发语音播报；`useClipboard` 函数也支持传入 `announce` 参数，写入剪贴板成功后会主动提醒读者。
- **键盘导航**：列表和菜单的上下左右方向键切换，分别封装在 `useListFocus`、`useGridRovingFocus` 和 `useTypeahead`（字母快速跳转匹配）组合式函数中。
- **AI 流式输出**：`ChatMessageList` 的底层角色被标记为 `role="log"`。当 AI 助手的文本还在打字机式流式增长时，请保持 `isStreaming` 为 `true`，这样读屏软件会等到本轮打字停顿或完成后再朗读，不会每出来一个字都念一遍。

## 尊重减少动效设置

对于容易产生晕动反应的用户，组件库所有共享动画都严格遵循系统的 `prefers-reduced-motion` 设置。当用户开启「减少动效」时，大幅度的平移与缩放会自动降为 0，仅保留平滑的淡入淡出，具体细节可查看 [动画](/themes/motion)。

组件库的无障碍表现以各组件文档中的无障碍说明和代码库中的自动化测试为准。

body.en:
# Browser support

These components solve styling and layering with what browsers ship, not with JavaScript patches. The upside is small code, good accessibility, and no extra dependency. The cost is a floor: older browsers lose pieces.

The floor first.

| Browser | Minimum version |
| --- | --- |
| Chrome, Edge | 123 |
| Safari (including iOS) | 17.5 |
| Firefox | 120 |

`light-dark()` sets that floor, because nearly every color variable is written as `light-dark(light value, dark value)`. An older browser does not understand the function, drops the whole declaration, and the page is left without its colors.

## What we actually use

Every row below appears in `packages/core/styles`; none of it is copied from the upstream checklist.

| Feature | Where it is used | Chrome | Safari | Firefox |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light-dark()` | Every theme color variable | 123 | 17.5 | 120 |
| `@layer` | First line of every stylesheet, declaring the five `astryx.*` layers | 99 | 15.4 | 97 |
| `:has()` | Form state, lists, chat, and tabs, where a parent style depends on a child | 105 | 15.4 | 121 |
| `color-mix()` | Hover tints, sliders, code blocks, and other derived colors | 111 | 16.2 | 113 |
| `@property` | Registers the custom property behind the press animation so it can animate as a number | 85 | 16.4 | 128 |
| Popover API | Menus, tooltips, the command palette, and the toast viewport use native `popover` and `popovertarget` | 114 | 17 | 125 |
| `<dialog>` and `showModal()` | Dialogs, bottom sheets, and the lightbox | 37 | 15.4 | 98 |
| `@starting-style` | Entry animation start values for overlays, sheets, and toasts | 117 | 17.5 | 129 |
| Container queries `@container` | Pagination, steppers, and chat adapting to their own width | 105 | 16 | 110 |
| `text-wrap: balance` / `pretty` | Balanced headings, and body text that avoids a lone last word | 114 | 17.5 | 121 |
| `:dir()` | Direction checks in a few places, such as the slider | 120 | 16.4 | 49 |
| Logical properties | Padding, margin, radius, and offsets written as `padding-inline-start` and friends | 87 | 14.1 | 66 |

`@property` and `@starting-style` are "missing is fine": without them the press animation and the entry animation simply do not play, and the interface still works. `light-dark()` is what actually sets the floor.

The versions follow MDN and caniuse as of when this page was written. When in doubt, search caniuse for the feature name.

## Below the floor

- **Colors drop out.** `light-dark()` is not understood, `--astryx-color-*` resolves to nothing, and text may fall back to default black.
- **Overlays open, but may not sit next to the trigger.** Without the native popover API, menus and tooltips still open; CSS fallback positioning is less exact.
- **Dialogs may not open at all.** There is no fallback path when `showModal()` is unavailable.
- **Animations stop.** Entry and press motion disappear; content still shows.

Nothing goes to a blank page. The visuals just stop matching the design, which is why older browsers are not supported.

## Supporting older browsers anyway

We do not ship a fallback build for old browsers, and there is no bundled polyfill. Three options.

**1. If your audience is old, hold the floor.** Internal tools can usually push a browser update. That is the cheapest path.

**2. Detect with `@supports` and supply your own colors.** Check for `light-dark()` at the app entry and write fixed light values when it is missing:

```css
@supports not (color: light-dark(#fff, #000)) {
  :root {
    --astryx-color-text-primary: #000000;
    --astryx-color-background-surface: #ffffff;
  }
}
```

That restores colors only. Overlay positioning and animation do not improve.

**3. Needing full function on an old browser means changing code.** That covers a popover fallback, a `@starting-style` fallback, or rewriting the affected overlays in your project. That work is outside this library.

## Compatibility details already handled

- **iOS zooms the page on focus.** On iOS, focusing an input whose font size is below 16px zooms the page. Every input component lifts its font size to at least `1rem` on touch devices, using `@supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none)` so the rule only applies on iOS.
- **Reduced motion.** One global `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule flattens the distance, scale, and opacity deltas of entry and exit motion, and components add their own opt-outs. With the system setting on, animation does not play.
- **Scrollbars.** Scrollbar styling lives in one file, `scrollbars.css`, implemented with the `overlayscrollbars` runtime dependency. Colors are derived from the text color with `color-mix()`, so dark mode follows.

## Check your own browser

Paste this in the console to see which pieces your browser lacks.

```js
const checks = {
  'light-dark()': CSS.supports('color', 'light-dark(#fff, #000)'),
  '@layer': CSS.supports('at-rule', '@layer a, b;'),
  ':has()': CSS.supports('selector(:has(*))'),
  'color-mix()': CSS.supports('color', 'color-mix(in oklab, red, blue)'),
  'Popover API': typeof HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover === 'function',
  '@container': CSS.supports('container-type', 'inline-size'),
}
console.table(checks)
```

Any `false` maps to a row in the table above. When `light-dark()` is `false`, page colors are effectively unusable.

# 浏览器支持

这套组件不靠 JS 补丁解决样式和浮层问题，而是直接用了浏览器自带的现代能力。好处是代码小、无障碍好、没有额外依赖；代价是有一条底线：太老的浏览器上会掉东西。

先把底线说清楚：

| 浏览器 | 最低版本 |
| --- | --- |
| Chrome、Edge | 123 |
| Safari（含 iOS） | 17.5 |
| Firefox | 120 |

这个底线是 `light-dark()` 定的，因为几乎每个颜色变量都写成 `light-dark(浅色, 深色)`。比它老的浏览器看不懂这个函数，会把整条声明丢掉，页面就只剩黑白和无色状态。

## 我们实际用到的特性

下面每一条都在 `packages/core/styles` 里真实出现过，不是照抄原版清单。

| 特性 | 用在哪 | Chrome | Safari | Firefox |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light-dark()` | 所有主题颜色变量 | 123 | 17.5 | 120 |
| `@layer` 分层 | 每份样式表的第一行，声明 `astryx.*` 五层顺序 | 99 | 15.4 | 97 |
| `:has()` | 表单状态、列表、聊天、Tab 的父子联动样式 | 105 | 15.4 | 121 |
| `color-mix()` | 计算悬停底色、滑杆、代码块等的过渡色 | 111 | 16.2 | 113 |
| `@property` | 注册按压动画用的自定义属性，让它能做数字动画 | 85 | 16.4 | 128 |
| Popover API | 下拉菜单、提示、命令面板、Toast 视口：用原生 `popover` 和 `popovertarget` | 114 | 17 | 125 |
| `<dialog>` + `showModal()` | 对话框、底部抽屉、大图查看 | 37 | 15.4 | 98 |
| `@starting-style` | 浮层、抽屉、Toast 的入场动画起点 | 117 | 17.5 | 129 |
| 容器查询 `@container` | 分页、步骤条、聊天的窄宽自适应 | 105 | 16 | 110 |
| `text-wrap: balance` / `pretty` | 标题平衡换行、正文避免孤字 | 114 | 17.5 | 121 |
| `:dir()` | 滑杆等少数地方的方向判断 | 120 | 16.4 | 49 |
| 逻辑属性 | 内外边距、圆角、定位大量用 `padding-inline-start` 这类写法 | 87 | 14.1 | 66 |

`@property` 和 `@starting-style` 属于「没有也不崩」：缺了它们，按压动画和入场动画直接不播，界面照常能用。真正决定底线的是 `light-dark()`。

版本号按 MDN 和 caniuse 的记录写成，写这份文档时的数据；拿不准就去 caniuse 搜一下特性名。

## 低于底线会怎样

- **颜色全丢。** `light-dark()` 认不出来，`--astryx-color-*` 拿不到值，文字可能变成默认的黑色。
- **浮层还在，但可能不贴着触发器。** 原生 popover 不支持时，菜单和提示还能打开，位置靠 CSS 兜底，不会那么准。
- **对话框可能打不开。** `<dialog>` 的 `showModal()` 没有时，对话框组件没有降级路径。
- **动画不播。** 入场、按压这类动效消失，内容照样显示。

没有一条会让页面白屏。但视觉按预期走不了，所以老浏览器不算支持。

## 想支持更老的浏览器怎么办

我们没有提供老浏览器专用的回退包，也没有内置 polyfill。可行的做法有三种。

**1. 用户群很老，就守住底线。** 内部工具通常能推浏览器升级，这是最省事的路径。

**2. 用 `@supports` 探测，自己补一份颜色。** 可以在应用入口检查 `light-dark()` 在不在，不在就给变量写死浅色值：

```css
@supports not (color: light-dark(#fff, #000)) {
  :root {
    --astryx-color-text-primary: #000000;
    --astryx-color-background-surface: #ffffff;
  }
}
```

这只补回颜色，浮层定位和动画不会因此变好。

**3. 需要老浏览器上也完整可用，就得自己改。** 包括引入 popover 和 `@starting-style` 的降级写法，或者在项目里重写相关组件的浮层实现。这类改造不在组件库的范围内。

## 我们已经替你处理的兼容细节

- **iOS 输入框自动放大。** iOS 上输入框字号小于 16px 时，聚焦会自动放大页面。所有输入类组件在触摸设备上都把字号顶到至少 `1rem`，靠 `@supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none)` 只在 iOS 上生效。
- **减少动效。** 全局有一条 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 规则，把入场和退场的位移、缩放、透明度变化压成「没有」，各组件也有自己的关闭规则。系统开了「减弱动态效果」，动画就不播。
- **滚动条。** 滚动条样式集中在 `scrollbars.css`，靠 `overlayscrollbars` 这个运行时依赖实现，配色用 `color-mix()` 从文字色混出来，所以深色模式也能跟着走。

## 自己验一遍

在浏览器控制台里粘这段，能查到你手上这台浏览器缺哪几项：

```js
const checks = {
  'light-dark()': CSS.supports('color', 'light-dark(#fff, #000)'),
  '@layer': CSS.supports('at-rule', '@layer a, b;'),
  ':has()': CSS.supports('selector(:has(*))'),
  'color-mix()': CSS.supports('color', 'color-mix(in oklab, red, blue)'),
  'Popover API': typeof HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover === 'function',
  '@container': CSS.supports('container-type', 'inline-size'),
}
console.table(checks)
```

有一项是 `false`，就对照上面的表格看这一项影响什么。`light-dark()` 是 `false` 时，页面颜色基本不可用。

# Changelog

The two packages publish together. This page repeats what `CHANGELOG.md` already records. It is not a roadmap.

When you upgrade from an older version, read the [upgrade guide](/en/guide/migration) first. It lists every breaking change next to the old and the new way to write it.

## 0.1.0

First release. `@astryx-vue/core` provides the Vue 3 components, and `@astryx-vue/themes` provides the Neutral theme.

The change landed in pull request [#13](https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue/pull/13), commit [`85aa073`](https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue/commit/85aa073fb5f855847b6951528e5743dc50bc99aa).

body.en:
# CLI

`@astryx-vue/cli` looks up astryx-vue component docs and playground pages from the terminal, for people and for agents. The binary is `astryx-vue`. It is not Meta's `astryx` command, and it does not speak React or StyleX.

Install it as a dev dependency:

```sh
pnpm add -D @astryx-vue/cli
```

The package declares a `bin`, so the command is on `node_modules/.bin` right after installing:

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue component Button
npx astryx-vue search dialog --json
```

Without installing it, run `npx @astryx-vue/cli …`. The scope is required: the bare `astryx-vue` name on npm is not this package.

A script alias is optional, and only useful when an agent shell does not have `node_modules/.bin` on `PATH`:

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "astryx-vue": "astryx-vue"
  }
}
```

```sh
npm run astryx-vue -- component Button
```

## Commands

`astryx-vue component --list` lists the documented components. `astryx-vue component Button` prints one component's usage, props, slots, events, and examples.

`astryx-vue composable --list` lists the composables, and `astryx-vue composable useClipboard` prints one composable's parameters and return values. Vue calls these functions composables, so the CLI never says hook. `component useClipboard` still finds it and points at the `composable` command.

`astryx-vue docs` lists the guide and theme topics. `astryx-vue docs guide/dark-mode` prints one page's text, and `astryx-vue docs themes/tokens` works too.

`astryx-vue search dialog` ranks components, composables, docs topics, and page templates. `--type` narrows the domain to `component`, `composable`, `doc`, or `template`. `astryx-vue manifest --json` describes the commands, options, response types, error codes, and exit codes. `astryx-vue init --features agents` writes the agent context file.

## Templates

`astryx-vue template --list` lists the 57 playground pages, grouped by category. Every template is a page today; `--type block` answers with a note rather than an error. Each line says what the page needs: a ready template names only `vue` and `@astryx-vue/core`, so copying one leaves no install step.

`astryx-vue template login-card` prints one template's description, the components it uses, the packages it needs, and its source. `--skeleton` prints only the layout skeleton: component tags with layout attributes such as `gap`, `padding`, and `columns`, without text, handlers, or native HTML wrappers.

`astryx-vue template login-card ./src/pages` writes `src/pages/LoginCard.vue`. A path that ends in a file name is the file itself. An existing file is only replaced with `--overwrite` (or `-f`), and a path outside the project is refused. Copying rewrites the playground's demo photo paths to an inline grey placeholder and reports how many it replaced; it does not copy assets and does not install anything, it only names the packages the project is missing.

A few templates import something a project cannot install, such as the playground-only `@astryx-vue/playground-charts` alias. They are marked not ready: you can read them, and copying is refused with the reason.

## Build

`astryx-vue build "<idea>"` turns one sentence into a starting point: the closest page template, two alternatives, and the components to use, each with the command to run next. It also lists composables separately.

The ranking is local and deterministic: keyword matching over each template's slug, title, description, keywords, and components, with rare words weighted higher. There is no network call and no model. Chinese is matched by character pairs, so no spaces are needed.

`astryx-vue build` with no idea prints the workflow: pick a page, copy it, then look up each component before writing code.

## Themes

`astryx-vue theme` lists the built-in themes. `astryx-vue theme butter` prints the four steps that load one: the stylesheet import, the `data-astryx-theme` attribute, how to switch themes or run two side by side, and how to check the result. The steps are this site's own theme pages, so the command and the docs cannot disagree. It writes nothing.

## Upgrading and checking a project

`astryx-vue upgrade` reads the `@astryx-vue/core` version in the project's `package.json`, compares it with the version the CLI documents, and prints the sections of the [upgrade guide](/en/guide/migration) — what changed, how it was written before, how it is written now, what to do. It then looks through the project's own sources for the old names that guide replaces and lists file and line. Nothing is changed, and nothing is fetched from the network.

`astryx-vue doctor` reports five checks and edits nothing: whether core is installed and how its version compares, whether themes is installed, whether `vue` satisfies 3.5.0, whether a theme stylesheet is imported, and whether `data-astryx-theme` is set. Exit code is 0 when everything passed or only warned, and 1 when a check failed.

## Flags

`--json` prints a typed envelope on stdout. `--dense` shortens the text people read; together with `--json` it is ignored, and the envelope stays complete. `--zh` uses Simplified Chinese where this site has a translation. `--cwd` is the project directory `template` and `init` write inside.

The template `--json` types are `template.list`, `template.show`, `template.skeleton`, and `template.copy`; `build` returns `build.help` and `build.kit`. Errors carry a code such as `ERR_UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE`, `ERR_TEMPLATE_NOT_READY`, `ERR_FILE_EXISTS`, or `ERR_PATH_TRAVERSAL`.

## Agent file

`init` prints the setup guide — which packages to install (a canary package takes `@canary`, once it is on npm), the theme import, the locale snippet, and what to verify — and writes the managed block below. It creates `AGENTS.md` when no agent file exists. Without `--agent`, an agent file the project already has is reused, in the order `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`. `--agent claude` writes `CLAUDE.md`, `hermes` writes `.hermes.md` (or `HERMES.md` when the project already has one), `cursor` and `codex` write `AGENTS.md`, and `all` writes every known file that exists. `--agent-docs-path <file>` writes exactly that file.

The command owns only the block between these markers:

```html
<!-- Maintained by astryx-vue, do not edit manually -->
...
<!-- astryx-vue block end -->
```

Every run replaces that block with freshly generated text. Text outside the markers stays. If the file exists and the markers are missing, the block is appended.

The block names every package the CLI documents, marks the canary ones, and says plainly when a package is not on npm yet — those get no install command, so nobody is sent to a missing package. Then it describes a three-step workflow: run `build` to pick a page, run `template` to copy it, then run `component`, `composable`, or `docs` before writing code. It also says how to invoke the binary.

The install command follows the project's package manager: the `packageManager` field first, then a lockfile. When neither says which manager it is, all four forms are printed.

The sentences the CLI prints come from this docs site and from the playground pages. After a docs or template change, regenerate the catalog in the CLI package. The maintainer steps are in the `packages/cli` README.

This version does not include `swizzle`, `discover`, `gap-report`, `integration`, or `blog`, and there is no MCP server.

# 命令行

`@astryx-vue/cli` 是一个轻巧的命令行工具，用来在终端里随时查 astryx-vue 的组件文档和演练场页面，方便开发者和 AI Agent 使用。二进制命令名是 `astryx-vue`（请注意：它专为本项目服务，并非 Meta 原版的 `astryx` 命令，也不提供 React 或 StyleX 的功能）。

建议在项目中作为开发依赖安装：

```sh
pnpm add -D @astryx-vue/cli
```

包里声明了 `bin`，装完命令就在 `node_modules/.bin` 里，直接就能用：

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue component Button
npx astryx-vue search dialog --json
```

不安装、只想临时用时，运行 `npx @astryx-vue/cli …`。注意 scope 不能省略，因为 npm 上裸名 `astryx-vue` 并不是这个包。

脚本别名是可选项，只有当 agent 的环境没有把 `node_modules/.bin` 放进 `PATH` 时才需要在 `package.json` 里添加：

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "astryx-vue": "astryx-vue"
  }
}
```

配置后即可在终端运行：

```sh
npm run astryx-vue -- component Button
```

## 核心命令

- `astryx-vue component --list`：列出当前所有可用组件。
- `astryx-vue component Button`：快速查看指定组件的基本用法、Props 属性、插槽、事件以及代码示例。
- `astryx-vue composable --list`：列出组合式函数，`astryx-vue composable useClipboard` 打印其参数和返回值。Vue 里这类函数叫组合式函数（composable），所以命令与文档中统一不使用 hook 这个词。若误输入 `component useClipboard` 仍然能查到，并会友好提示改用 `composable` 命令。
- `astryx-vue docs`：列出指南与主题文档。`astryx-vue docs guide/dark-mode` 或 `astryx-vue docs themes/tokens` 可直接在终端阅读正文。
- `astryx-vue search dialog`：在组件、组合式函数、文档主题和页面模板里按相关度搜索。`--type` 可以限定为 `component`、`composable`、`doc` 或 `template`。
- `astryx-vue manifest --json`：输出 CLI 自身的接口定义清单（命令、选项、响应结构、错误码及退出码），方便被上层工具或脚本消费。
- `astryx-vue theme`：列出全部内置主题；`astryx-vue theme butter` 输出这套主题的接入四步（引哪个样式表、`data-astryx-theme` 写什么、怎么换主题或同时用两套、改完怎么验证）。
- `astryx-vue upgrade`：读项目里 `@astryx-vue/core` 的版本，和这个 CLI 对应版本比较，打印[升级指南](/guide/migration)里要做的每一件事，再在项目源码里指出旧名字所在文件和行号。不联网，不改文件。
- `astryx-vue doctor`：检查依赖装没装、版本对不对、主题样式引没引、主题属性设没设，只报告不改文件；有失败时退出码是 1。
- `astryx-vue init`：打印给 AI 助手的接入说明（装哪些包、主题样式引哪一行、语言怎么提供），并在项目根目录维护 agent 上下文文件。

## 页面模板与代码生成

- `astryx-vue template --list`：列出 57 个演练场页面模板，按分类分组。目前所有模板都是页面；`--type block` 会给出一句说明，不报错。每行还会说明这个页面要什么：可复制的模板只依赖 `vue` 和 `@astryx-vue/core`，落地后不用再装别的包。
- `astryx-vue template login-card`：打印一个模板的说明、用到的组件、要装的包和完整源码。`--skeleton` 只打印布局骨架（组件标签加上 `gap`、`padding`、`columns` 这类布局属性，不含文字、事件处理和原生 HTML 包裹层）。
- `astryx-vue template login-card ./src/pages`：将模板代码生成并写出到 `src/pages/LoginCard.vue`。如果文件已存在，需要加上 `--overwrite`（或 `-f`）才会覆盖，避免误冲掉已有代码。复制时会自动把演示图片替换为内联的灰色占位图，不依赖额外的静态图片资源。
- `astryx-vue build "<想法>"`：把一句话需求变成开发起点，在本地匹配出最接近的页面模板、备选方案以及需要搭配使用的组件与函数。打分完全在本地完成，无网络开销也无需调用外部大模型。

## 常用参数

- `--json`：以 JSON 格式输出带类型的结构化信封数据，适合被工具或脚本解析。模板相关的类型包括 `template.list`、`template.show`、`template.skeleton`、`template.copy`；`build` 返回 `build.help` 和 `build.kit`。出错时信封里带有错误码（如 `ERR_UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE`、`ERR_FILE_EXISTS` 等）。
- `--dense`：精简输出文本，降低阅读噪音；与 `--json` 配合使用时会被自动忽略，保持 JSON 结构完整。
- `--zh`：当文档具备中文翻译时，优先输出简体中文内容。
- `--cwd`：指定项目目录，`template` 和 `init` 只往这个目录下写文件，`upgrade` 和 `doctor` 只在这个目录里读。

## 配合 AI Agent（生成上下文文件）

项目里没有任何 agent 文件时，`init` 默认创建 `AGENTS.md`。不加 `--agent` 时会优先写项目里已有的配置文件，检测顺序为 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、`.cursorrules`、`.hermes.md`、`HERMES.md`。`--agent claude` 写 `CLAUDE.md`，`hermes` 写 `.hermes.md`，`cursor` 和 `codex` 写 `AGENTS.md`，`all` 则写所有已存在的已知文件。通过 `--agent-docs-path <file>` 也可以指定输出到任意文件。

命令行工具在维护这些文件时，只会在以下固定的起止标记之间更新内容：

```html
<!-- Maintained by astryx-vue, do not edit manually -->
...
<!-- astryx-vue block end -->
```

区块开头列出这个 CLI 覆盖的每个包，能发 canary 的标出来；npm 上还没有的包会直说「还没发布到 npm」，并且不给安装命令，免得有人照着敲一个装不到的包名。随后是三步工作流：用 `build` 挑页面，用 `template` 复制，写代码前用 `component`、`composable` 或 `docs` 查询用法。

`init` 打印的安装命令跟着项目走：先看 `packageManager` 字段，再看锁文件；两样都没有时把四种写法都列出来。

每次运行命令，工具只会用最新的组件库信息替换这两个标记之间的内容，标记之外由你自己撰写的项目规则会完好无损地保留下来。如果文件已存在但尚未包含这些标记，工具会安全地将其追加到文件末尾。

> **维护者提醒**：CLI 打印的内容均提取自当前文档站和演练场页面。当文档或模板修改后，需要重新生成 CLI 包内置的目录快照，操作步骤记录在 `packages/cli` 的 README 中。
>
> 这一版暂未包含 `swizzle`、`discover`、`gap-report`、`integration`、`blog`，也没有 MCP 服务。

body.en:
# Composables

Import composables from the package root:

```ts
import { useClipboard, useControllableState } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

There is no `@astryx-vue/core/composables` subpath. The functions exported from `packages/core/src/composables/index.ts` are below. Parameters are the TypeScript types.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `useControllableState` | A `v-model` that is controlled or internal. If the value is missing at setup, it stays internal. |
| `useAnnounce` | Announces to screen readers. Matches upstream `useAnnounce`. |
| `useClipboard` | Writes to the clipboard and keeps `isCopied` true for a short time. |
| `useHotkeys` | Global shortcuts. `mod+k` uses ⌘ on Apple platforms. |
| `useMediaQuery` | A media query as a ref, read once during setup. |
| `useDismiss` | Outside press and Escape for popups. Escape uses a stack; the innermost layer handles it. |
| `useFocusTrap` | Cycles Tab inside a container. |
| `useRestoreFocus` | Remembers focus when a popup opens and returns it on close. |
| `useScrollLock` | Locks `body` scroll with a reference count. |
| `useListFocus` | Arrow keys for a one-dimensional list. The default selector is `[role="menuitem"]`. |
| `useClickableContainer` | Makes a region activate on click, and leaves nested buttons, links, and inputs alone. |
| `useGridRovingFocus` | Arrow keys for a grid. |
| `useTypeahead` | Cycles matches as the same letter is pressed. It does not move focus; `onMatch` does. |
| `useCombobox` | A searchable option list and the current value. |
| `useNumberField` | A number with min, max, and step. |
| `useAsyncSource`, `createStaticSource` | A cancellable search source, and a local static source. |
| `useOverflow`, `computeOverflow` | Folds items that do not fit into an indicator. `computeOverflow` is pure. |
| `useLongPress` | Fires after a hold. Moving too far cancels it. |
| `useStreamingText` | Reveals text that has already arrived, at `natural`, `fast`, or `instant`. |
| `snapToGraphemeBoundary` | Snaps an offset to a grapheme boundary for streaming text. |
| `useChatStreamScroll` | Pins a transcript to the bottom, or lets it go. Reduced motion jumps instead of springing. |
| `useChatNewMessages` | Marks rows that arrived while the reader was not pinned to the bottom. |
| `useKeyboardHint` | The first time keyboard focus enters a group of arrow-key controls, shows a short hint beside the current item. |
| `useImageMode` | Decides whether a foreground should be dark or light from an image's brightness. Returns `fallback` when sampling fails. |
| `useContainerReveal` | Reveals inline actions on hover or keyboard focus. Returns classes for the container and the content. |
| `useMenuPress` | After a menu press, swallows the browser's extra click. `resetMenuPress` is for unmount and tests. |

`useClipboard` is also exported as `useCopyToClipboard` from `@astryx-vue/core` and from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`. The types are the same.

Some functions belong to one component and are not in the table above. Import them from that component's subpath. The package root re-exports them too:

| Function | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| `useToast` | `@astryx-vue/core/Toast` |
| `useImperativeDialog` | `@astryx-vue/core/Dialog` |
| `useImperativeAlertDialog` | `@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog` |
| `useOverlay` | `@astryx-vue/core/Overlay` |
| `useContextMenu`, `useContextMenuSize` | `@astryx-vue/core/ContextMenu` |
| `useDropdownMenuContext` | `@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu` |
| `useSideNavCollapse` | `@astryx-vue/core/SideNav` |
| `useListContext`, `useItemDescriptionId` | `@astryx-vue/core/List` |
| `useTheme`, `useMediaTheme` | `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` |
| `useIndicator` | `@astryx-vue/core/Indicator` |
| `useSemanticIcon` | `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` |
| `useSyntaxTheme` | `@astryx-vue/core/Code` |
| `useChatComposerContext`, `useChatComposerTokens`, `useChatPasteAsToken`, `useChatDictation`, `useSpeechRecognition` | `@astryx-vue/core/Chat` |

`provideAstryxLocale` and `useAstryxMessages` are in [Internationalization](/en/guide/i18n).

# 组合式函数

组件库将许多交互逻辑和无障碍底层能力，封装成了易于复用的 Vue 3 组合式函数（Composables）。通用函数可以直接从包根统一引入：

```ts
import { useClipboard, useControllableState } from '@astryx-vue/core'
```

> **注意**：包内没有 `@astryx-vue/core/composables` 这种子路径。所有在 `packages/core/src/composables/index.ts` 中导出的通用函数如下表所示，具体参数签名以 TypeScript 类型定义为准：

| 函数名称 | 主要用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `useControllableState` | 统一管理受控与非受控状态。常用于封装兼容 `v-model` 的自定义输入控件。 |
| `useAnnounce` | 触发屏幕阅读器读屏语音播报，帮助视障用户获取动态操作反馈。 |
| `useClipboard` | 将指定文本写入系统剪贴板，并在短时间内提供响应式的 `isCopied` 状态。 |
| `useHotkeys` | 注册页面全局快捷键。支持 `mod+k` 等直观写法，其中 `mod` 在 macOS 上对应 ⌘ 键。 |
| `useMediaQuery` | 响应式监听 CSS 媒体查询（Media Query），将其转化为响应式 Ref。 |
| `useDismiss` | 统一处理浮层的外部点击（Click Outside）与按下 Escape 键退出，内置撤销栈确保内层弹层优先响应。 |
| `useFocusTrap` | 在模态弹窗或抽屉容器内循环限制键盘 Tab 焦点，防止焦点跑出容器。 |
| `useRestoreFocus` | 弹窗打开时自动记住触发源，弹窗关闭后将焦点智能送回原来的按钮。 |
| `useScrollLock` | 带有引用计数的背景滚动锁定。即使打开多个嵌套弹窗，关闭时也能准确恢复页面滚动。 |
| `useListFocus` | 处理一维垂直或水平列表的键盘上下左右键导航，默认查找 `[role="menuitem"]` 元素。 |
| `useClickableContainer` | 让整块卡片区域都能点击，且点击卡片内部的按钮、输入框或超链接时，不会误触发外层容器的点击。 |
| `useGridRovingFocus` | 二维卡片网格的键盘方向键流转导航（Roving tabindex）。 |
| `useTypeahead` | 支持输入首字母在列表中快速定位匹配条目，不强行移动焦点，而是把匹配结果传递给 `onMatch` 回调。 |
| `useCombobox` | 封装可筛选、带联想搜索的下拉选择框状态与当前选中值。 |
| `useNumberField` | 封装支持最大值、最小值、步进（step）的数值微调输入逻辑。 |
| `useAsyncSource`、`createStaticSource` | 支持可取消的异步搜索数据源，以及本地纯前端静态数据集管理。 |
| `useOverflow`、`computeOverflow` | 当容器宽度不够时，智能计算哪些菜单项需要折叠收录到「更多」下拉菜单中。 |
| `useLongPress` | 移动端与桌面端的长按触发手势。若手指滑动超过阈值会自动取消长按。 |
| `useStreamingText` | 处理 AI 打字机流式输出的平滑文本呈现，支持自然停顿（`natural`）、快速（`fast`）与瞬间显示（`instant`）。 |
| `snapToGraphemeBoundary` | 将字符串截断偏移智能对齐到文字的「字素边界」（避免生硬切断 Emoji 或复合字符）。 |
| `useChatStreamScroll` | 智能跟随 AI 聊天对话流滚动。用户向上翻阅时保持原位，生成结束或位于底部时平滑吸底。 |
| `useChatNewMessages` | 当读者未贴合在对话流底部时，在页面上浮动提示有未读的新消息产生。 |
| `useKeyboardHint` | 当用户第一次通过键盘方向键切入一组控件时，在当前焦点项旁边短暂弹出操作提示气泡。 |
| `useImageMode` | 自动采样图片亮度，智能推断上层该使用深色还是浅色的前景文字；若采样失败则采用安全回退值。 |
| `useContainerReveal` | 仅在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦到容器时，才显示操作按钮，返回对应的样式类名。 |
| `useMenuPress` | 在菜单项按下后，吸收吞掉浏览器可能冗余触发的随后那次点击事件，防止误触。 |

> **别名提示**：`useClipboard` 拥有一个兼容旧版的名字 `useCopyToClipboard`，从包根或 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 均可引入，底层完全等价。

## 随特定组件绑定的组合式函数

部分与特定组件深度绑定的函数，既可以从该组件的专用子路径引入，也可以直接从包根引入：

| 函数名称 | 对应组件入口 |
| --- | --- |
| `useToast` | `@astryx-vue/core/Toast` |
| `useImperativeDialog` | `@astryx-vue/core/Dialog` |
| `useImperativeAlertDialog` | `@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog` |
| `useOverlay` | `@astryx-vue/core/Overlay` |
| `useContextMenu`、`useContextMenuSize` | `@astryx-vue/core/ContextMenu` |
| `useDropdownMenuContext` | `@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu` |
| `useSideNavCollapse` | `@astryx-vue/core/SideNav` |
| `useListContext`、`useItemDescriptionId` | `@astryx-vue/core/List` |
| `useTheme`、`useMediaTheme` | `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` |
| `useIndicator` | `@astryx-vue/core/Indicator` |
| `useSemanticIcon` | `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` |
| `useSyntaxTheme` | `@astryx-vue/core/Code` |
| `useChatComposerContext`、`useChatComposerTokens`、`useChatPasteAsToken`、`useChatDictation`、`useSpeechRecognition` | `@astryx-vue/core/Chat` |

多语言与国际化相关的 `provideAstryxLocale` 和 `useAstryxMessages`，请参阅 [国际化](/guide/i18n)。

# Contributing

The repository is <https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue>. Use GitHub Issues. The license is MIT.

Local development needs Node.js `^22.18.0`, `^24.11.0`, or `>=26`, and pnpm `>=11.21.0`. The root `package.json` `engines` field is the source of those ranges.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

`pnpm check` runs the package-boundary check, the export sync check, lint, typecheck, tests, the build, and publint on the published packages. A component or theme change is done when that command passes.

`packages/core/src/index.ts`, `composables/index.ts`, `styles.css`, and `neutral.css` are generated by `pnpm sync`. The file headers say not to edit them by hand. After adding an export or a style entry, run `pnpm sync` and commit the generated result.

`packages/core/locales/*.json` is the upstream Astryx catalog, vendored as data. Do not hand-copy it into `messages.ts`. Extra locales go through `loadAstryxCatalog`. The internationalization guide explains how.

Docs:

```sh
pnpm dev
```

`pnpm docs:build` builds the site only. Component sidebar groups come from each demo's `meta.ts`. Guide and theme pages should leave that grouping alone.

Releases use Changesets. The steps are in `RELEASING.md`. A docs-only change does not need a changeset. Changesets keep the two package versions in one group.

The upstream React implementation is a reference. APIs committed here stay on Vue props, events, slots, and composables. Do not add React or StyleX as a dependency of the public packages.

## How close to upstream

The goal is pixel-level parity: apart from being implemented in Vue instead of React, styles, layout, interactions, and copy should match upstream. React and Vue differ only at the implementation layer; a user should not be able to tell the two libraries apart.

`packages/core/locales/*.json` follows the latest upstream. Re-vendor with `node scripts/vendor-astryx-locales.mjs`. With no argument it takes the newest commit on upstream `main`; the commit actually used is recorded in `SOURCE.json` next to the catalogs.

## Comparison shots

Any change to a component, style, or interaction must include comparison shots in the pull request: upstream Astryx on the left, astryx-vue on the right, covering at least desktop and a 390px viewport, each in light and dark.

Reviewers judge the change by those shots and the resulting behaviour, not by reading every line of the diff. The shots are part of the submission, not optional. Docs-only, CI, and internal refactors do not need them.

# 贡献指南

感谢你对 astryx-vue 的关注！本项目完全开源，代码仓库托管在 <https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue>。如果你发现了 Bug 或有好的建议，欢迎在 GitHub Issues 提交讨论。本项目采用宽松友好的 MIT 开源许可证。

## 本地开发环境准备

请确保本地安装了符合要求的 Node.js 与 pnpm 版本（具体版本限制以根目录 `package.json` 中的 `engines` 字段为准）：
- Node.js：`^22.18.0`、`^24.11.0` 或 `>=26`
- pnpm：`>=11.21.0`

克隆仓库后，安装依赖并执行全套质量检查：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

`pnpm check` 会依次严格执行：包边界依赖检查、导出同步校验、ESLint 代码检查、TypeScript 类型检查、单元测试、打包构建以及发布包的 publint 检查。在修改任何组件或主题样式后，**以 `pnpm check` 全部通过作为完成的基本标准**。

## 自动生成的代码与同步

项目中部分聚合导出文件（如 `packages/core/src/index.ts`、`composables/index.ts`、`styles.css` 以及 `neutral.css`）是由自动化脚本 `pnpm sync` 统一扫描并生成的，文件顶部明确标注了「请勿手动编辑」。

当你在核心库中新增了组件导出或新的样式入口后，请运行 `pnpm sync`，并将自动生成的变化一同提交进 Git。

> **多语言文件说明**：`packages/core/locales/*.json` 是从 Meta 原版 Astryx 同步的多语言映射表，请勿直接手动修改它们。若要更新多语言或引入额外语言，请通过 `loadAstryxCatalog` 进行转换，详见 [国际化指南](/guide/i18n)。

## 本地启动文档站

```sh
pnpm dev
```

如需验证文档站打包是否正常，可运行 `pnpm docs:build`。请注意：组件文档在侧边栏里的分组归属来自每个组件示例目录下的 `meta.ts`，在修改普通文档指南或主题说明页时，请不要随意改动那些分组配置。

## 版本发布流程（Changesets）

项目使用 Changesets 进行版本发布管控。如果你的 Pull Request 仅修改了文档，则无需生成 changeset；如果包含了功能新增或修复，请通过 Changesets 记录改动。核心包与主题包的版本号会由 Changesets 保持统一同步。更详细的发版指引可参阅仓库内的 `RELEASING.md`。

## 设计对齐原则：追求像素级一致

原版 Astryx 基于 React 19 和 StyleX 实现，它的源码仅作为我们还原时的设计基准。提交到 astryx-vue 的所有公共 API，必须遵循标准的 Vue 3 惯用法（Props、事件、插槽和组合式函数），**不能把 React 或 StyleX 作为运行依赖引入到库中**。

我们的核心目标是**视觉与交互对齐**：除了使用 Vue 生态的标准语法之外，组件的间距、排版、色彩动效与内置文案，都力求与原版保持一致，保持两套库在视觉细节上一致。

若需从原版同步最新的多语言资源，可执行 `node scripts/vendor-astryx-locales.mjs`，该脚本默认会拉取原版 `main` 分支的最新提交，并将本次拉取使用的 Commit 哈希精准记录在同目录的 `SOURCE.json` 中。

## Pull Request 规范：必须附带对照截图

如果你对组件外观、结构样式或交互动效进行了修改，在提交 Pull Request 时**必须附带原版与 Vue 版的效果对照图**：
- 左侧为原版 Astryx，右侧为 astryx-vue；
- 至少覆盖 4 种组合场景：桌面宽屏、390px 移动窄屏、浅色模式、深色模式。

由于组件库对视觉质感要求极高，社区审查 PR 时会优先比对实际渲染截图与体验效果，而不仅仅是审查代码行变动。因此，视觉对照图是 PR 必不可少的一部分（纯文档修复、CI 脚本与底层重构除外）。

# Dark mode

Neutral does not ship a separate dark stylesheet. Each color is `light-dark(light, dark)`, and the element's `color-scheme` picks the stop.

After `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css` loads, `:root` and `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']` set `color-scheme` to `light dark`. The result follows the system, and it follows a `color-scheme` an ancestor already set.

To force one side, set the attribute on an element that wraps the UI:

```html
<html data-astryx-color-mode="dark">
```

```html
<html data-astryx-color-mode="light">
```

Those attributes set `color-scheme` to `dark` or `light`. You do not swap stylesheets.

The docs site's switch is VitePress `appearance`. Dark mode adds `dark` on `html` and sets `color-scheme: dark`, so Neutral's `light-dark()` uses the dark stop. That class belongs to the docs site. It is not an API the components require. In an app, use `data-astryx-color-mode` or set `color-scheme` yourself.

`Theme` can force one side for a subtree with `mode="dark"` or `mode="light"`. See [Theme](/en/components/theme). There is no parallel set of dark token names. To change a stop, override the original variable and write both sides inside `light-dark()`. See [Extending a theme](/en/themes/extending).
body.zh:
# 深色模式

Neutral 主题不需要单独引入一份额外的深色 CSS 样式表。所有颜色变量在底层均直接采用现代 CSS 标准的 `light-dark(浅色值, 深色值)` 语法，浏览器会根据元素当前所处的 `color-scheme` 状态，自动决定显示浅色还是深色。

当你引入 `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css` 之后，`:root` 根节点以及 `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']` 元素上的 `color-scheme` 默认被声明为 `light dark`。这意味着组件默认就能自适应操作系统的外观偏好，也能继承祖先节点已经设定的明暗模式。

## 手动强制指定浅色或深色

如果你希望在应用中提供手动切换按钮，只需在包裹界面的最外层元素（通常是 `<html>` 标签）上设置属性：

```html
<!-- 强制使用深色模式 -->
<html data-astryx-color-mode="dark">
```

```html
<!-- 强制使用浅色模式 -->
<html data-astryx-color-mode="light">
```

这两个属性会自动将下层的 `color-scheme` 分别置为 `dark` 或 `light`，整个页面的颜色变量会瞬间自适应切换，完全无需动态替换或重新请求任何 CSS 文件。

## 文档站的实现方式

文档站右上角的明暗切换开关，依托的是 VitePress 自带的 `appearance` 配置。当切换到深色模式时，VitePress 会在 `<html>` 上添加 `class="dark"`，并同步将 `color-scheme` 置为 `dark`，此时 Neutral 的 `light-dark()` 就会自然取深色那一档的色值。

这属于文档站本身的接入方式，组件库自身并不强制绑定必须叫 `.dark` 的类名。在你的实际业务项目中，推荐使用上面提到的 `data-astryx-color-mode` 属性，或者直接设置 CSS `color-scheme`。

## 局部区域独立切换明暗

有时你可能希望全局是浅色背景，但某一处代码编辑器或卡片单独以深色展示。你可以使用 `Theme` 组件，通过 `mode="dark"` 或 `mode="light"` 属性设置局部子树的明暗模式，具体用法请参阅 [Theme 组件](/components/theme)。

> **定制提示**：不要为深色模式重新取一套独立的变量名（比如不要额外造出 `--color-bg-dark`）。当你想修改某个颜色的具体色值时，依然直接覆盖原来的变量名，并在 `light-dark()` 函数中同时声明好浅色与深色的取值即可。更详尽的说明可参阅 [扩展主题](/themes/extending)。

# Quick start

Install the components and the theme. The peer dependency is Vue `^3.5.0`.

```sh
pnpm add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

Load the theme once from the app entry. Neutral includes Figtree and JetBrains Mono.

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

Import each component from its own subpath. That entry loads the matching structural styles.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Get started" />
</template>
```

Import every structural stylesheet at once with:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

Next, see how package entries work in [Installation](/en/guide/installation), how layers and variables connect in [Theme and styles](/en/guide/styling), or open [Components](/en/components/). To learn more about the background and design decisions, see [Introduction](/en/guide/why).

## For AI agents

Every page is also published as plain text, so an agent can read the docs without installing anything:

- [/llms.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms.txt) lists every page with a one-line summary. Chinese: [/llms-zh.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-zh.txt).
- [/llms-full.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-full.txt) puts the whole documentation in one file. Chinese: [/llms-full-zh.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-full-zh.txt).
- Add `.md` to any page address to read that single page as Markdown, for example [/en/components/button.md](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/en/components/button.md). Chinese pages have no `/zh` prefix: `/components/button.md`.

A component's Markdown file pulls its overview, props tables, examples with the demo source, and accessibility checks into one document. Every HTML page links to its Markdown version in the page head, and the command line has the same component text, see [CLI](/en/guide/cli).

# 快速开始

只要几分钟，就能在你的 Vue 3 项目里用上 astryx-vue。

首先安装核心组件包和主题包。组件库要求你的项目使用 Vue 3.5.0 或更新版本：

```sh
pnpm add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

在应用的入口文件（例如 `main.ts`）里引入一次主题样式。默认的 Neutral 主题为你准备好了基础配色，并自带了好看的正文字体（Figtree）与等宽字体（JetBrains Mono）：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

接着就可以直接在页面里使用组件了。推荐直接从具体的子路径引入组件，这样打包器只会加载该组件对应的样式，代码体积最轻巧：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="开始" />
</template>
```

如果你希望省去后顾之忧，也可以在入口处一次性引入所有组件的结构样式：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

下一步看 [安装](/guide/installation) 里的包入口，看 [主题与样式](/guide/styling) 里层和变量怎么接，或者直接打开 [组件](/components/)。想了解设计初衷与实现思路，请参阅 [介绍](/guide/why)。

## 给 AI Agent 使用

每一页文档都提供了一份纯文本，AI Agent 不需要额外安装工具就能直接读取：

- [/llms.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms.txt) 是英文目录，每页一行说明；中文版是 [/llms-zh.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-zh.txt)。
- [/llms-full.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-full.txt) 把全部英文文档合成一个完整文件；中文版是 [/llms-full-zh.txt](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/llms-full-zh.txt)。
- 任意页面网址后面加上 `.md` 就能直接获取这一页的原生 Markdown，例如 [/components/button.md](https://astryx-vue.pages.dev/components/button.md)。中文页面没有 `/zh` 前缀，英文页面在 `/en/` 路径下。

组件的 Markdown 把总览介绍、属性表、带演示源码的示例和无障碍检查整合在同一篇里。每个 HTML 页面都在 `<head>` 里指向自己的 Markdown 版；命令行里的组件文本提取见 [命令行](/guide/cli)。
