body.en:
# Internationalization

Strings that the components speak come from a message catalog. They are not hard-coded at every call site. The built-in locales are `en` and `zh-CN`. The type `AstryxLocale` is that pair.

Provide the locale once at the root. Descendants read it with `useAstryxLocale` and `useAstryxMessages`. If nobody provides one, the locale is `en`.

```ts
import { provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')
```

`provideAstryxLocale`, `useAstryxLocale`, `useAstryxMessages`, `useLocale`, `useTranslator`, `normalizeLocale`, `loadAstryxCatalog`, and `useCollator` come from `@astryx-vue/core/locale` and are re-exported from `@astryx-vue/core`. `formatCalendarMonth` and `weekdayNames` stay on `@astryx-vue/core/locale`.

`normalizeLocale` maps `zh`, `zh-CN`, and `zh-Hans` to `zh-CN`, the built-in Simplified Chinese catalog. Every other tag keeps its region and only has its case fixed, so `en-gb` becomes `en-GB` and dates, numbers, and sorting follow that region. Component copy has two built-in catalogs, Simplified Chinese and English; `en`, `en-GB`, or `fr-FR` without `messages` all read the English one. An empty or unparseable tag becomes `en`.

## Reading the locale outside a component

Components format dates, numbers, relative times, and sort order with the locale of the nearest `InternationalizationProvider`, never `navigator.language`. Do the same in your own helpers:

```ts
import { useLocale, useTranslator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

const { locale } = useLocale()
const { t } = useTranslator()

// Both follow the provider when it switches language.
const label = computed(() => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale.value).format(date))
const announce = () => t('@astryx.pagination.pageAnnounce', { current: 3 })
```

`t` takes an upstream `@astryx.*` key and returns the sentence for the active locale. An unknown key comes back unchanged, so a typo is easy to spot. It is safe to call from event handlers.

## Locales besides Chinese and English

Upstream Astryx ships about 30 React Intl JSON files in `packages/core/locales`, including `ja-JP`, `zh-TW`, and `ar-SA`. Those files are vendored, unchanged, under this package's `locales/` directory. They are not copied into TypeScript by hand. `loadAstryxCatalog` maps their keys onto `AstryxMessages`. Pass the result as the second argument of `provideAstryxLocale`.

Keys that do not fit a field are returned in `unmapped`, with the original sentence still attached. Nothing in the file is dropped quietly. Fields the file never fills stay in English; their paths are `fallbackFields`. Mapped keys missing from that file are `missingKeys`.

The built-in English matches upstream `en.json` word for word, and `pnpm check:i18n-catalog` keeps it that way. The built-in `zh-CN` is written here and reads more naturally than upstream `zh-CN.json`; do not replace it with that file. Use the loader for the other locales.

```ts
import { loadAstryxCatalog, provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
import catalog from '@astryx-vue/core/locales/ja-JP.json'

const loaded = loadAstryxCatalog('ja-JP', catalog)
provideAstryxLocale(loaded.locale, loaded.messages)
```

`provideAstryxLocale('ja-JP')` without `messages` still formats dates and `useCollator` in Japanese, but component sentences stay in English. `zh-TW` does not silently become Simplified Chinese.

To refresh the JSON, run `node scripts/vendor-astryx-locales.mjs`. It follows the latest upstream `main`; pass a commit to reproduce an earlier fetch. The commit used is written to `locales/SOURCE.json`, and the source and license are recorded in `packages/core/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

Then run `pnpm check:i18n-catalog` (it is part of `pnpm check`). It checks that:

- every built-in field exists in both `en` and `zh-CN`, with the same shape;
- the built-in copy uses every upstream placeholder, and the built-in English matches upstream word for word;
- every translation in the 29 locale files parses, uses the same placeholder names and kinds (`{name}`, `number`, `plural`, `select`) as the English source, and has no stale keys;
- every upstream key is either mapped in `packages/core/src/locale/upstream/` or listed with a reason in `scripts/i18n-catalog/coverage.mjs`.

## Locale-aware comparison

`useCollator` returns an `Intl.Collator` for the active locale, wrapped in a computed. With no provider, the locale is `en`.

```ts
import { useCollator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

const collator = useCollator({ numeric: true })
items.sort((a, b) => collator.value.compare(a.name, b.name))
```

`AstryxMessages` is the copy components actually read. Text that is not in that type is the `label` you passed, and it does not change with the locale.

The Chinese and English docs are two VitePress trees, `/` and `/en/`. That is the documentation language, not `provideAstryxLocale`. Component examples call `provideAstryxLocale` for the language of the page you are reading.

## Right-to-left and pseudo-locale testing

Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian read right to left. The components do most of that work for you, but two steps are yours.

### Step 1: tell the components the direction

`InternationalizationProvider` takes `dir`, either `'ltr'` or `'rtl'`. Leave it out and the direction is derived from `locale`: `ar-SA` and `he` resolve to `rtl`, everything else to `ltr`.

The derivation is `getLocaleDirection()`. It asks the browser for the writing direction through `Intl.Locale`; where that is unavailable it falls back to a built-in list of right-to-left languages (`ar`, `he`, `fa`, `ur`, `ps`, `sd`, and a few more). A tag it cannot parse resolves to `ltr` rather than throwing.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Direction derived from locale -->
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="ar-SA">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>

  <!-- English strings, forced right to left: for testing the layout -->
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="en" dir="rtl">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>
</template>
```

Inside a composable, read the direction with `useLocaleDirection()`. It returns a ref that follows the locale:

```ts
import { useLocaleDirection } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

const direction = useLocaleDirection()
// 'ltr' or 'rtl'
```

### Step 2: set `dir` on the DOM yourself

`dir` only decides what Astryx components read. It does not touch the DOM. That is your job, usually on `<html>`:

```ts
import { getLocaleDirection } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

// Keep it in sync when the locale changes in the browser
document.documentElement.dir = getLocaleDirection(locale.value)
document.documentElement.lang = locale.value
```

Skip this and text still runs left to right, punctuation and mixed-direction text flow the wrong way, and the scrollbar sits on the wrong side. The components mirror correctly inside a page that still looks backwards.

### What the components already do

- **Spacing and offsets.** Component styles lean on logical properties: `padding-inline-start`, `margin-inline-end`, `inset-inline-start`. Reverse the direction and those values swap sides with no second stylesheet.
- **Text alignment.** They use `text-align: start` and `end`, not `left` and `right`.
- **A few places need help.** Tooltip and hover-card `start` and `end` placements flip under `[dir='rtl']`; the breadcrumb slash is mirrored; the slider thumb is corrected with `:dir(rtl)`.
- **Arrow keys.** The calendar reads `document.documentElement.dir`, so with right-to-left text the left and right arrow keys swap. Scroll calculations also map to the logical axis.

That last point is why step 2 cannot be skipped: the calendar and the scroll logic read `dir` from the DOM, not from the provider.

### Pseudo-locale testing

The cheapest check needs no language pack, just two moves.

1. Set `dir` to `rtl` and put `dir="rtl"` on `<html>`. See whether the page still holds together.
2. Replace the strings with longer fake text and see whether the layout breaks.

Step 2 uses the `overrides` prop. It replaces the keys you name, per locale:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

// Keys match the upstream locale files. This one is deliberately long.
const pseudo = {
  '@astryx.table.noData': 'No data found, and this sentence is written far longer than anyone would, on purpose, to see whether the cell bursts',
}
</script>

<template>
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="en" :overrides="pseudo">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>
</template>
```

### Checklist

With the direction reversed and the text stretched, walk through these.

- Numbers, prices, and dates still read left to right instead of flipping with the paragraph.
- Icons and text are in the right order: the back arrow points right, and the dropdown chevron sits to the left of the label.
- The caret starts on the right in a text input, and the placeholder aligns right.
- The sidebar and side panels moved to the right, and the resize handle reversed with them. Whatever did not move has a hardcoded `left` or `right`.
- Buttons do not wrap, table columns do not collapse, and headings do not overflow their block.
- Numeric table columns stay right-aligned; numbers themselves run left to right.

Run that list once in dark mode and once at a narrow width and you have most of the coverage you need.

# 国际化

组件内部自带的提示文本（如搜索占位符、复制成功提示、清空按钮等）走统一的语言环境管理，没有把中文或英文硬编码在每个组件里。随包默认内置的语言是英文（`en`）和简体中文（`zh-CN`）。在 TypeScript 类型定义中，`AstryxLocale` 指的就是这两种内置语言代码。

通常只需在应用的顶层根组件提供一次语言配置，下层所有子组件就可以自动通过 `useAstryxLocale` 和 `useAstryxMessages` 读取当前的语言文本。未配置时，默认使用英文。

```ts
import { provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

// 全局配置为简体中文
provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')
```

与国际化相关的常用函数（如 `provideAstryxLocale`、`useAstryxLocale`、`useAstryxMessages`、`useLocale`、`useTranslator`、`normalizeLocale`、`loadAstryxCatalog` 和 `useCollator`）均可以从 `@astryx-vue/core/locale` 引入，在包根 `@astryx-vue/core` 也有重新导出。仅日历相关的底层格式化工具 `formatCalendarMonth` 和 `weekdayNames` 专属于 `@astryx-vue/core/locale`。

`normalizeLocale` 函数会自动标准化常见的语言标签：
- 把 `zh`、`zh-CN`、`zh-Hans` 等归一化为 `zh-CN`，对上内置的简体中文文案；
- 其他标签只规范大小写，地区信息会保留，例如 `en-gb` 变成 `en-GB`、`ja-jp` 变成 `ja-JP`。日期、数字、排序因此按这个地区的习惯来；
- 内置文案只分「简体中文」和「其他」两种：`en`、`en-GB`、`fr-FR` 这些没有交 `messages` 的语言，组件文字都用英文；
- 空值或无法解析的标签会自动回退到英文 `en`。

## 在组件之外读语言和翻译（useLocale、useTranslator）

组件里的格式化（日期、数字、相对时间、排序）都读最近一层 `InternationalizationProvider` 的语言，不读 `navigator.language`。你自己写的格式化函数也应该这样：

```ts
import { useLocale, useTranslator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

const { locale } = useLocale()
const { t } = useTranslator()

// 语言变了，这两个值会跟着变
const label = computed(() => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale.value).format(date))
const announce = () => t('@astryx.pagination.pageAnnounce', { current: 3 })
```

`t` 收的是原版的 `@astryx.*` 键，返回当前语言的成品文案。键认不出来时原样返回这个键，方便一眼看出写错了。在事件回调里也可以直接调用。

## 支持中文和英文以外的更多语言

原版 Astryx 在 `packages/core/locales` 目录下存放了约 30 份基于 React Intl 格式的语言 JSON 文件（包含 `ja-JP`、`zh-TW`、`ar-SA` 等）。我们将这些官方多语言资源完整同步在包内的 `locales/` 目录下。

你可以借助 `loadAstryxCatalog` 函数，将这些原版 JSON 转换映射为组件库可用的 `AstryxMessages` 结构，然后作为第二个参数传递给 `provideAstryxLocale`：

```ts
import { loadAstryxCatalog, provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'
import catalog from '@astryx-vue/core/locales/ja-JP.json'

// 加载日语语言包
const loaded = loadAstryxCatalog('ja-JP', catalog)
provideAstryxLocale(loaded.locale, loaded.messages)
```

加载器具备容错处理：
- 如果原版 JSON 中某些键名在 Vue 版中未被使用，会保存在返回对象的 `unmapped` 属性中，避免数据丢失；
- 如果某项文本在 JSON 中缺失，会自动回退到内置英文，涉及的字段路径记录在 `fallbackFields` 中；
- 如果组件需要某项文本但外部 JSON 根本没有提供，会记录在 `missingKeys` 中。

> **提示**：内置英文和原版 `en.json` 逐字一致，`pnpm check:i18n-catalog` 会守着这一点。内置的 `zh-CN` 是我们自己写的中文，比原版 `zh-CN.json` 更口语一些，请不要用原版的那份去覆盖它。其他语言才建议通过该加载器引入。
>
> 如果只调用 `provideAstryxLocale('ja-JP')` 而没有传入转换后的 `messages`，那么组件内部的日期和字母排序会按日语规则运行，但组件自带的提示语仍会保持英文；同理，传入 `zh-TW` 也不会自动偷懒降级为简体中文。

如果你是维护者，需要同步原版最新语言包，运行 `node scripts/vendor-astryx-locales.mjs` 即可，它默认拉原版 `main` 的最新提交；需要复现某一次抓取时，把提交号当参数传进去。实际用到的提交号写在 `locales/SOURCE.json`，来源与开源许可证说明记录在 `packages/core/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 中。

拉完后跑一次 `pnpm check:i18n-catalog`（`pnpm check` 里也会跑）。它会检查：

- 内置 `en` 和 `zh-CN` 的每个字段都有，而且形状一样；
- 内置文案用上了原版的每个占位符，内置英文和原版英文逐字一致；
- 29 种语言的每句译文都能解析，占位符的名字和写法（`{name}`、`number`、`plural`、`select`）和英文原文一致，没有过期的键；
- 原版新增的每个键，要么已经接进 `packages/core/src/locale/upstream/`，要么在 `scripts/i18n-catalog/coverage.mjs` 里写明了为什么暂不接入。

## 按当前语言排序字符串（useCollator）

在不同国家和语言下，文字的排序习惯差异很大（例如拼音排序与注音、假名排序）。`useCollator` 函数返回一个基于当前语言环境的 `Intl.Collator` 实例，并包装在 Vue 的 `computed` 中。未设置语言时默认按英文处理：

```ts
import { useCollator } from '@astryx-vue/core/locale'

const collator = useCollator({ numeric: true })
// 按照当前语言环境自然排序
items.sort((a, b) => collator.value.compare(a.name, b.name))
```

## 区分组件内置文案与业务文案

`AstryxMessages` 仅管理组件库内置的通用文案（如「复制」、「清除」等）。你在业务中自己写进组件的文字（例如 `<Button label="提交表单" />` 传入的 `label`），是由你的业务代码完全掌控的，切换组件库语言不会去修改你的业务文字。

文档站顶部切换的中英文，是通过 VitePress 路由实现的两个完全独立的页面树（分别位于根路径 `/` 和 `/en/`），属于文档网站层面的多语言；而文档中的实时组件示例，则会自动根据当前页面的文档语言调用 `provideAstryxLocale`。

## 从右往左排版与伪语言测试

阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语这些语言从右往左写。这件事组件库已经做了大半，但有两步得你自己做。

### 第一步：告诉组件方向

`InternationalizationProvider` 有一个 `dir` 属性，取 `'ltr'` 或 `'rtl'`。不传的话，方向由 `locale` 推出来：`ar-SA`、`he` 得到 `rtl`，其余得到 `ltr`。

推导靠 `getLocaleDirection()`。它先问浏览器要 `Intl.Locale` 的书写方向；浏览器还不支持时，退回一张内置的从右往左语言清单（`ar`、`he`、`fa`、`ur`、`ps`、`sd` 等）。认不出来的标签按 `ltr` 处理，不会报错。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'
</script>

<template>
  <!-- 方向由 locale 推出来 -->
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="ar-SA">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>

  <!-- 语言是英文，但强制按从右往左排版：用来测布局 -->
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="en" dir="rtl">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>
</template>
```

自己在组合式函数里要读方向，用 `useLocaleDirection()`，它返回一个 `ref`，语言变了会跟着变：

```ts
import { useLocaleDirection } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

const direction = useLocaleDirection()
// 'ltr' 或 'rtl'
```

### 第二步：自己设置 DOM 的 dir

`dir` 属性只决定 Astryx 组件读到的方向，它不会去改 DOM。这一步必须你来做，通常写在 `<html>` 上：

```ts
import { getLocaleDirection } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

// 浏览器里切换语言时同步一次
document.documentElement.dir = getLocaleDirection(locale.value)
document.documentElement.lang = locale.value
```

漏掉这一步的后果：文字仍然从左往右排，标点和混排文本的方向不对，滚动条位置也反。组件内部的镜像是对的，页面上看着还是反的。

### 组件做了什么

- **内外边距和定位。** 组件样式大量使用逻辑属性：`padding-inline-start`、`margin-inline-end`、`inset-inline-start`。方向一反，这些值自动换边，不需要第二套样式。
- **文字对齐。** 用的是 `text-align: start` 和 `end`，不是 `left` 和 `right`。
- **少数位置单独处理。** 提示框、悬停卡片的 `start`、`end` 弹层在 `[dir='rtl']` 下会翻边；面包屑的分隔斜杠会跟着改方向；滑杆的握把用 `:dir(rtl)` 单独修正。
- **键盘方向键。** 日历读 `document.documentElement.dir`：从右往左时，左右方向键的作用是反的。滚动相关的计算也会按书写方向换轴。

这也解释了为什么第二步不能省：日历和滚动这类逻辑读的就是 DOM 上的 `dir`，不是 provider 的值。

### 伪语言测试

最省事的做法不是装语言包，而是两步：

1. 把 `dir` 设成 `rtl`，`<html dir="rtl">` 也设上，看整个页面还站不站得住。
2. 把文案换成一段更长的假文字，看布局会不会被撑破。

第二步用 `overrides` 属性。它按语言覆盖指定键，只改你写的那几条：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InternationalizationProvider } from '@astryx-vue/core/InternationalizationProvider'

// 键和原版语言包一致。这里故意写长，用来挤布局
const pseudo = {
  '@astryx.table.noData': '没有找到任何数据，这句话被故意写得很长很长，用来检查单元格会不会被撑破',
}
</script>

<template>
  <InternationalizationProvider locale="zh-CN" :overrides="pseudo">
    <App />
  </InternationalizationProvider>
</template>
```

### 检查清单

方向改成 `rtl`、文案拉长以后，逐条看这几件：

- 数字、价格、日期还是从左往右读，没有跟着整段反过来。
- 图标和文字的顺序对了：返回箭头指向右边，下拉箭头在文字的左边。
- 输入框里的光标从右边开始，占位文字靠右对齐。
- 侧边栏和侧面板换到了右边，拖拽手柄的方向也跟着反了。哪一处没换，就是那一处写死了 `left` 或 `right`。
- 长文案下按钮不换行，表格列不塌，标题不溢出色块。
- 表格里的数字列仍然右对齐（数字本身从右往左写会很怪）。

这套检查在深色模式、窄屏下各跑一遍，差不多就够用了。

# Icons

Draw an icon with `Icon` and an Iconify name. You do not import a component for each glyph.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

`carbon:settings` is the Carbon collection's settings icon. `carbon-settings` is the same name once that collection is registered. A collection id that already contains a hyphen keeps the colon, as in `material-symbols:home`.

## Bundle only the icons you name

`@astryx-vue/core` does not include a collection. Install the one you want, and add the Vite plugin:

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

The plugin looks at `@iconify-json/*` in the nearest `package.json`. It scans source for static names and emits a module per icon, so the client bundle contains those drawings and not the rest of the JSON. If the Vite root has no `package.json` — VitePress points its root at the docs directory — the plugin walks up until it finds one. A second collection is another package: install `@iconify-json/lucide` and write `name="lucide:settings"`. You do not need UnoCSS for this.

Pass `collections: ['carbon']` when you want the plugin to ignore every other installed set.

## Names that are not written in source

The plugin cannot see a name built at runtime. Register the collection in the app entry, before anything renders. This includes the whole set in the bundle:

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

addCollection(carbon)
```

`addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` registers one icon when you already have its Iconify body.

## Slots

With no `size`, the icon is `1em` and uses `currentColor`. Button's `icon` and `end` slots, IconButton, and a field's start and end slots already size the box, so the icon fills it:

```vue
<Button label="Settings">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>

<IconButton label="Search">
  <Icon name="carbon:search" />
</IconButton>
```

A decorative icon is hidden from assistive technology. Set `label` only when the icon itself is the message. The component page has the sizes, colors, and slot examples.

## CSS classes

`icon` still accepts a CSS class, and so does `iconClass` on navigation and menu items. A class only draws something if your build generates it. UnoCSS is one way to do that. It is what the docs site uses for older examples. An application does not have to use it.

The glyphs the components draw themselves (`chevronDown`, `check`, and the rest) are not a general icon set. Use `name` for product icons.

## Semantic names

Inside the components, a semantic name is the job: search, close, check. Each one points at the Lucide icon that does the same job. Until that collection is registered, the built-in glyph stays.

The set follows the theme. `defineTheme({ icons })` points a semantic name at an Iconify id, and a child theme only lists the names it changes. `Icon`'s `icon` prop resolves those names. `name` is still a direct Iconify id, and it wins.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'

const carbon = defineTheme({
  name: 'withCarbon',
  icons: { search: 'carbon:search', close: 'carbon:close' },
})
</script>

<template>
  <Theme :theme="carbon">
    <Icon icon="search" />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

Read the current id with `useSemanticIcon` from `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`. The name-to-id table is on the Icon props page.
body.zh:
# 图标

在 astryx-vue 中，你可以直接使用 `Icon` 组件配合标准的 Iconify 图标名称来展示图标，再也不需要为每一个小图形单独繁琐地 `import` 不同的组件文件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

这里的 `carbon:settings` 表示 Carbon 图标集合中的 settings 图标。在图标集合注册后，你也可以写成中划线形式 `carbon-settings`；若集合本身的 ID 带中划线（如 `material-symbols`），则必须保留冒号，例如 `material-symbols:home`。

## 按需打包：只打包用到的图标

为了不给你的项目增加体积，`@astryx-vue/core` 核心包自身不内置全量图标库。你只需安装自己喜欢的图标包，并配置一个 Vite 插件：

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

在 `vite.config.ts` 中配置插件：

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

这个插件会读取离它最近的 `package.json` 中的 `@iconify-json/*` 依赖，静态扫描你的 Vue 模板中写到的静态图标名，并为用到的每个图标按需生成模块。最终打包进浏览器的，只有你实际用到的这几个 SVG 图标，而不是整套几万个图标的庞大文件。如果你的 Vite 根目录没有 `package.json`（比如 VitePress 文档站常设在子目录），插件会自动向上查找。

如果你还想用另一套图标（比如 Lucide），只需要再装一个包：`pnpm add -D @iconify-json/lucide`，然后在模板里直接写 `name="lucide:settings"` 即可。这完全基于标准构建，**不需要**引入 UnoCSS。

如果你只想让插件扫描指定的某几套图标集，可以传入过滤参数：`collections: ['carbon']`。

## 动态生成的图标名称

如果某个图标的名字是在 JavaScript 运行时动态拼接出来的（例如从后端接口返回，或者由变量组装而成），Vite 插件在静态构建阶段就无法提前发现它。

针对这种动态场景，你可以在应用初始化入口处，提前将整套图标集合注册进来（注意：这会把整套集合的数据打包进构建产物）：

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

// 注册整套图标集合
addCollection(carbon)
```

如果你只想注册单独某一个动态图标的数据，可以使用 `addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` 单独注册这一枚。

## 插槽搭配与尺寸

默认情况下，不传 `size` 属性时，图标会自适应当前文本的行内大小（`1em`），颜色也会自动继承当前文本的颜色（`currentColor`）。

很多组件已经为图标预留了专用的插槽。例如 `Button` 的 `icon`（前缀）与 `end`（后缀）插槽、`IconButton` 纯图标按钮，以及各类输入框的前后插槽，这些位置都提前定好了大小盒子，放进去的 `Icon` 会自动对齐：

```vue
<Button label="设置">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>

<IconButton label="搜索">
  <Icon name="carbon:search" />
</IconButton>
```

> **无障碍提醒**：纯装饰性的图标对读屏软件是默认隐藏的。只有当这个图标本身承担传达含义的职责（且旁边没有文字）时，才需要显式设置 `label` 属性。

## 兼容 CSS 类名图标

如果你的项目原本习惯使用 CSS 类名（例如 Tailwind、UnoCSS 的纯 CSS 图标），组件库的 `icon` 属性、导航与菜单上的 `iconClass` 属性依然完全兼容传入 CSS 类名。只要你的构建工具能够生成对应的类名样式，图形就能正常显示。不过，在全新项目中，我们最推荐使用上面提到的静态 `name` 方案。

## 语义化图标（跟随主题自由切换）

组件库内部有许多需要图标的场景（例如下拉箭头的展开折叠、搜索框的放大镜、对话框的关闭十字叉等）。我们并没有死板地把它们写死为某一种特定形状，而是使用「语义名」（例如 search、close、check）来进行逻辑描述。

默认情况下，这些语义名会自动对准 Lucide 图标集对应的图形；如果你的项目没有注册 Lucide，组件会降级绘制精简的内置基础矢量图形，不会显示成空白。

你也可以把整套语义图标绑定在主题配置中。通过 `defineTheme({ icons })`，你可以将语义名映射到任意你喜欢的 Iconify 图标集：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'

// 创建一个使用 Carbon 图标的主题定制
const carbonTheme = defineTheme({
  name: 'withCarbon',
  icons: {
    search: 'carbon:search',
    close: 'carbon:close',
  },
})
</script>

<template>
  <Theme :theme="carbonTheme">
    <!-- 这里传入的是语义名 "search"，它会自动解析并渲染出 carbon:search -->
    <Icon icon="search" />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

如果你想在代码里读取当前生效的语义图标 ID，可以使用从 `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` 导出的 `useSemanticIcon` 组合式函数。完整的语义名称列表与默认对应关系，可查阅图标组件的 API 属性页。

body.en:
# Installation

Install the two public packages together:

```sh
pnpm add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

```sh
npm install @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

```sh
yarn add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

`@astryx-vue/core` peers on `vue: ^3.5.0`. The theme package depends on `@fontsource/figtree` and `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` for the body and monospace faces. Both packages publish ESM only.

Entries differ by what you need:

| You need | Import |
| --- | --- |
| One component | A subpath such as `@astryx-vue/core/Button` |
| Composables, and components re-exported from the root | `@astryx-vue/core` |
| `provideAstryxLocale`, `useAstryxMessages` | `@astryx-vue/core/locale`, also on the root |
| A theme | `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`. Butter, Chocolate, Gothic, Matcha, Stone, and Y2K use the same path with their own file name. |
| Every structural sheet | `@astryx-vue/core/styles.css` |
| A global reset | `@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` |

`reset.css` is a global reset in the same family as Tailwind Preflight. Once imported, it changes the default look of plain HTML tags on the whole page:

- Every element is `box-sizing: border-box`, and borders start as 0-width solid lines.
- Headings, paragraphs, lists and similar tags lose their default margin and padding. Lists lose their bullets, and headings inherit their size and weight.
- Images, video and `svg` become block-level. `img` and `video` fit their container's width.
- Form controls inherit the font and color. Buttons lose the browser's own look.
- Disabled elements show the default pointer, not `not-allowed`.
- `::before`, `::after`, placeholders and the search field's clear button are reset too.

Every rule sits in the lowest layer, `astryx.reset`, with zero specificity, so any other layer and any unlayered style of yours overrides it. The file also declares the layer order itself, so the import order does not matter.

The reset is global by design. To keep your own page untouched, do not import `reset.css`. The components still work without it, because each structural sheet styles its own elements. The structural sheets and the theme declare the layer order themselves.

Subpaths and the package root export the same components. Docs and examples use subpaths so the import says which component it is, and so only that component's structural sheet loads. Importing `useClipboard` from the package root can pull other component modules along if the bundler does not drop unused re-exports. Prefer a subpath when you only need a component.

The two packages version together. The published release is `0.3.0`. See the [changelog](/en/guide/changelog) for what changed, and the [upgrade guide](/en/guide/migration) for what to do when you upgrade.

To look these docs up from the terminal, see [CLI](/en/guide/cli).
body.zh:
# 安装

astryx-vue 拆分为核心包与主题包两个部分，通常建议一起安装：

```sh
pnpm add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

```sh
npm install @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

```sh
yarn add @astryx-vue/core @astryx-vue/themes
```

`@astryx-vue/core` 的 peer 依赖是 `vue: ^3.5.0`。主题包附带了 `@fontsource/figtree` 与 `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`，用来提供正文与等宽代码字体。两个包均采用纯 ESM 格式发布。

组件、组合式函数（Composables）与样式有各自清晰的引入路径：

| 需要的内容 | 引入路径 |
| --- | --- |
| 具体的某个组件（推荐） | `@astryx-vue/core/Button` 等独立子路径 |
| 通用组合式函数与包根快捷导出 | `@astryx-vue/core` |
| `provideAstryxLocale`、`useAstryxMessages` | `@astryx-vue/core/locale`（包根也能拿到） |
| 主题样式 | `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`（Butter、Chocolate、Gothic、Matcha、Stone、Y2K 等主题也是同样路径，替换为对应文件名即可） |
| 所有组件的全部结构样式 | `@astryx-vue/core/styles.css` |
| 全局 reset | `@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` |

`reset.css` 是一份全局 reset，和 Tailwind Preflight 是同一类东西。引入以后，整个页面上普通 HTML 标签的默认样式会变：

- 所有元素都是 `box-sizing: border-box`，边框默认是 0 宽的实线。
- 标题、段落、列表等标签没有默认的外边距和内边距，列表没有圆点，标题继承父元素的字号和字重。
- 图片、视频、`svg` 变成块级元素，`img` 和 `video` 会自适应容器宽度。
- 表单控件继承字体和颜色，按钮去掉浏览器自带的外观。
- 禁用的元素显示默认指针，不显示 `not-allowed`。
- `::before`、`::after`、占位文字和搜索框的清除按钮也一并重置。

所有规则都放在优先级最低的 `astryx.reset` 层里，选择器优先级为 0，所以别的层和你自己没放进层的样式都能直接覆盖它。这个文件还会自己声明层级顺序，引入的先后顺序不影响结果。

这份 reset 是全局的。如果不想动你自己的页面，就不要引入 `reset.css`。组件不依赖它，因为每份结构样式都会给自己的元素写好样式。结构样式和主题样式也会自己声明好层级的先后顺序。

虽然子路径和包根导出的是同一批组件，但在文档和日常开发中，建议使用子路径（例如 `@astryx-vue/core/Button`）。这样引用意图清晰，而且打包器只会按需打包该组件独有的结构样式。如果你从包根引入 `useClipboard` 这类通用函数，在部分未能精细摇树（Tree-shaking）的打包配置下，可能会把其余组件也一同打包进来。所以仅仅使用组件时，请优先写子路径。

核心包与主题包保持相同的版本号节奏。当前已发布的版本为 `0.3.0`，版本演进记录可参阅 [更新日志](/guide/changelog)，升级注意事项见 [升级指南](/guide/migration)。

如果你希望在本地终端或借助 AI Agent 快速检索组件文档，可以了解我们的 [命令行工具](/guide/cli)。

body.en: # Page layout Build a page from the outside in. Settle the frame and how much room each region gets before you write any content. Doing it the other way round, content first, ends with every section inventing its own container, and the page turns into a column of nested cards. Four steps, working inward. 1. Pick the frame: `AppShell` for a whole page, `Layout` for one block inside it. 2. Divide the regions: what goes in the header, body, footer, and sides. 3. Align: every region shares one content line. 4. Tune spacing: set gaps first, then decide whether the content needs a denser component. ## Step 1: pick the frame The outer frame of a whole page is `AppShell`. It owns the top bar, side navigation, banner, and body, and it folds the side navigation into a drawer on narrow screens. ```vue ``` `AppShell` slots are `topNav`, `sideNav`, `banner`, the default body, and `mobileNav` for a custom drawer. `contentPadding` is the body region's padding, written on the spacing scale. Leave it out and the body sits flush, so the `Layout` inside owns the edges. Do not pad both the shell and the inner layout, or the two paddings add up. A block inside a page — one card, one dialog, one tab panel — uses `Layout`. `Layout` does not frame a whole page; it divides its own area. ## Step 2: divide the regions `Layout` has up to five regions. The default slot is the body; the rest are named slots. | Slot | What goes there | | --- | --- | | `header` | The block's title and primary action | | `start` | A sidebar or panel on the start edge | | default slot | The main content, usually wrapped in `LayoutContent` | | `end` | A sidebar or panel on the end edge | | `footer` | Buttons that must stay reachable, such as Save and Cancel | ```vue ``` With `height` on its default `fill`, `Layout` fills its container and only the body scrolls, so the header and footer stay put. With `auto` it grows with the content and the whole page scrolls. Once the header, body, and footer are in place, turn their dividers on with one `defaultHasDividers` instead of passing `hasDivider` to each region. ## Step 3: align on one content line Write `Layout`'s `padding` once. It lands on every region: the header, body, footer, and both side panels all take their inline padding from the same value, so their text lines up on one vertical line. Two habits break that line, and both are easy to avoid. - Wrapping the body in another `div` with `padding` pushes the body inward, away from the header. - Writing `padding` inside the header pushes the header outward, away from the body. To inset one region, use that region component's own `padding`, or reach for `HStack` with a `gap`. Don't add another box around the region. When body text runs too wide to read, cap it with `contentWidth`: a number is pixels, and you can also write `'100%'` or `'40rem'`. The narrowed body centers itself, and the dividers above and below still run the full width. ## Step 4: arrange the inside, then tune spacing Below the regions, `HStack`, `VStack`, and `Grid` do the arranging. They only place things; they draw no border and add no background. ```vue ``` `gap` and `padding` take a spacing step: `2` means `--astryx-spacing-2`, which is 8px. Writing a step rather than `16px` means the gap follows the theme and the root font size. `Grid`'s `columns` as a number means exactly that many columns, which suits a seven-day calendar. As `{ minWidth, max }` it adds and drops columns with the container width. With the gaps settled, look at density. Spacing is not the only dial on a block of content. - Dense, one-row-per-item data such as tables and lists uses rows and dividers, not a card per row. - `Card` is for self-contained widgets, galleries, and groups of settings. - Where a sidebar, drawer, or card has no room for the full layout, switch to the compact form of a component, such as `EmptyState`'s `isCompact`. ## Do and don't | Guidance | Practice | | --- | --- | | Do | Settle the frame and the regions before writing content. | | Do | Write padding once, on `Layout` or `AppShell`. | | Do | Separate regions with a divider, not with a wall of whitespace. | | Don't | Give every region its own `padding`; the text lines stop matching. | | Don't | Wrap every block in a `Card`; the page becomes a column of boxes. | | Don't | Use a `div` with an inline `margin` where `HStack`, `VStack`, or `Grid` fits. | ## Next - How each region changes as the screen narrows: [Responsive layout](/en/guide/responsive). - Pinned headers and footers, and side detail panels: [Patterns](/en/guide/patterns). - Every prop of `Layout`, `AppShell`, `Stack`, and `Grid`: [Layout](/en/components/layout), [AppShell](/en/components/app-shell), [Stack](/en/components/stack), [Grid](/en/components/grid).
body.zh: # 页面布局 搭界面要从外往里搭。先把页面的骨架和每一块占多大地方定下来，再往里填内容。反过来做，先写内容再补容器，最后每一段都会自己发明一个盒子，页面就变成一列层层包着的卡片。 下面四步，一步一步往里走。 1. 选外壳：整页用 `AppShell`，还是页面里的一块用 `Layout`。 2. 分区域：页眉、正文、页脚、侧边各放什么。 3. 对齐：所有区域共用一条内容线。 4. 调间距：先定间距，再决定要不要密度更紧的组件。 ## 第一步：选外壳 整页的外框交给 `AppShell`。它管顶栏、侧导航、横幅、正文，还会在窄屏把侧导航收进抽屉。 ```vue ``` `AppShell` 的插槽有 `topNav`、`sideNav`、`banner`、默认的正文，以及窄屏抽屉用的 `mobileNav`。 `contentPadding` 是正文区的内边距，用间距刻度写。不传就贴边，由里面的 `Layout` 自己管边距——所以外壳和内层不要同时加内边距，不然会叠成两倍。 页面里的一块——一张卡片、一个对话框、Tab 里的一栏——用 `Layout`。`Layout` 不负责整页，它只在自己的范围里分区域。 ## 第二步：分区域 `Layout` 最多分五块，默认插槽是正文，其余是具名插槽： | 插槽 | 放什么 | | --- | --- | | `header` | 这一块的标题和主操作 | | `start` | 起始边的侧栏或面板 | | 默认插槽 | 主要内容，通常包一层 `LayoutContent` | | `end` | 结束边的侧栏或面板 | | `footer` | 提交、取消这类必须一直够得着的按钮 | ```vue ``` `height` 取 `fill`（默认）时，`Layout` 撑满容器，只有正文在中间滚动，页眉和页脚留在原地。取 `auto` 时随内容长高，整页一起滚。 页眉、页脚、正文都齐了以后，把它们之间的线交给 `defaultHasDividers` 一次开，不用每个区域各写一个 `hasDivider`。 ## 第三步：对齐同一条内容线 `Layout` 的 `padding` 只写一次，它落在所有区域上：页眉、正文、页脚、两侧面板的左右内边距用的是同一个值。所以它们的文字自然对齐在同一条竖线上。 这条线会被两种写法打断，都很好躲： - 在 `LayoutContent` 里再包一层带 `padding` 的 `div`，正文就比页眉往里缩了一截。 - 在页眉里自己写 `padding`，页眉就比正文往外多了一截。 要缩进某一块，用那个区域组件自己的 `padding`，或者干脆用 `HStack` 加 `gap`，别在区域外面再套一层盒子。 正文太长不好读时，用 `contentWidth` 限制宽度：数字按像素，也可以写 `'100%'`、`'40rem'`。宽度收紧以后，正文在中间居中，上下的分隔线还是拉满整行。 ## 第四步：排局部，调间距 区域里再往下分，就该 `HStack`、`VStack`、`Grid` 出场了。它们只负责摆放，不画边框也不给底色。 ```vue ``` `gap`、`padding` 收的是间距刻度：`2` 就是 `--astryx-spacing-2`，也就是 8px。写刻度而不是写 `16px`，主题换了、根字号变了，间距会跟着一起动。 `Grid` 的 `columns` 写数字就是固定那么多列（日历那种一周七格适合这么写）；写 `{ minWidth, max }` 就是按容器宽度自动增减列数。 间距定完，再看密度。同样一块内容，可以调的不止间距： - 表格、列表这类一行一条的密集数据，用行和分隔线，不要每条包一张卡片。 - `Card` 留给独立的小部件、图集和设置分组。 - 侧栏、抽屉、卡片里放不下完整版式时，换成紧凑形态的组件（例如 `EmptyState` 的 `isCompact`）。 ## 该做与不该做 | 指引 | 实践 | | --- | --- | | 推荐 | 先定外壳和区域，再写内容。 | | 推荐 | 内边距只写一次，写在 `Layout` 或 `AppShell` 上。 | | 推荐 | 区域之间的边界用分隔线，不用留白硬撑。 | | 避免 | 每个区域各写一套 `padding`，文字线对不齐。 | | 避免 | 每一块内容都包一张 `Card`，页面变成一列盒子。 | | 避免 | 用 `div` 加内联 `margin` 代替 `HStack`、`VStack`、`Grid`。 | ## 接下来 - 窄屏下每个区域怎么变：见 [响应式布局](/guide/responsive)。 - 页眉页脚固定、侧边详情面板：见 [应用模式](/guide/patterns)。 - `Layout`、`AppShell`、`Stack`、`Grid` 的完整属性：见 [布局组件](/components/layout)、[AppShell](/components/app-shell)、[Stack](/components/stack)、[Grid](/components/grid)。

# Links and routers

A jump in the app is one of two things. A normal `href` lets the browser open the address. A route that should stay inside Vue Router, without a full page load, swaps the root for `RouterLink`.

Components that can swap their root take the same `as` prop. It accepts a component or a tag name. The swap happens only when `href` is set and the item is not disabled. Otherwise the root stays a button and `as` is ignored. On a custom component the same address is passed as both `href` and `to`. `RouterLink` reads `to`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem :as="RouterLink" href="/orders" label="Orders" />
</template>
```

`SideNavItem`, `TopNavItem`, `TopNavHeading`, `NavMenuItem`, and `SideNavHeading` work the same way. Top-nav mega-menu items and featured cards take `as` too. On `OverflowList`, `as` belongs to the list and is applied to visible items that have an `href` and are not disabled.

A button can swap its root when it has an `href` and is not disabled. While it is loading or disabled it goes back to a `<button>`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router'
</script>

<template>
  <Button :as="RouterLink" href="/orders" label="View orders" />
</template>
```

`Link`, `Avatar`, and `BreadcrumbItem` render an `<a>` when they have an address. They do not take `as`. An in-app path in `href` loads as a full page. When that jump has to stay inside the router, use one of the components above, or use the button.

`isExternalLink` on `Link` opens a new tab and adds `noopener noreferrer`. That is an address outside the app, not a route.

# 链接与路由

在单页应用（SPA）中，页面跳转通常分为两种情况：
1. **外部网站跳转**：由浏览器原生打开一个外部网址，这时使用普通的 HTML `href`。
2. **应用内部导航**：希望走 Vue Router 的路由拦截，实现页面无刷新切换，这时需要把组件底层的渲染根节点替换为 `RouterLink`。

## 使用 `as` 属性配合 Vue Router

astryx-vue 中所有支持导航跳转的组件，都统一提供了一个简洁的 `as` 属性。它既可以接收一个 Vue 组件（例如 `RouterLink`），也可以接收一个 HTML 标签名（例如 `'a'`）：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem :as="RouterLink" href="/orders" label="订单中心" />
</template>
```

底层逻辑如下：
- 只有当该组件传入了有效的目标地址 `href`、并且当前项**没有被禁用**时，底层的根元素才会真正被替换为 `as` 所指定的组件；
- 如果按钮处于禁用或加载状态，它会自动维持普通 `<button>`，防止触发跳转；
- 当把 `as` 指定为自定义组件（如 `RouterLink`）时，组件库会自动把目标地址同时赋给 `href` 和 `to` 属性，因此 `RouterLink` 能读取到 `to` 并正常工作。

同样支持 `as` 属性的组件包括：`SideNavItem`、`TopNavItem`、`TopNavHeading`、`NavMenuItem` 和 `SideNavHeading` 等。顶部导航的巨型下拉菜单项以及推荐卡片也同样支持。对于溢出折叠列表 `OverflowList`，直接把 `as` 配置在列表顶层，就能自动作用于内部那些带 `href` 且可点击的可见项。

## 按钮当作路由链接使用

常规的 `Button` 同样支持通过 `as` 化身为路由链接。如果按钮此时处于加载中（loading）或被禁用（disabled），它会自动回退为标准的 `<button>`，阻止跳转行为：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router'
</script>

<template>
  <Button :as="RouterLink" href="/orders" label="前往订单" />
</template>
```

## 注意事项：普通超链接组件

`Link`、`Avatar` 和 `BreadcrumbItem` 组件在传入地址时，底层会直接渲染为原生 `<a>` 标签，它们没有提供 `as` 属性。如果在这些组件的 `href` 上填写站内路径，会触发浏览器的完整整页刷新。如果你希望内部跳转不刷新页面，推荐使用上面支持 `as` 的导航组件，或者配合按钮来实现。

另外，`Link` 组件提供了 `isExternalLink` 属性。设置为 `true` 时，它会自动在浏览器新标签页中打开，并自动附带 `rel="noopener noreferrer"` 安全属性，专用于外链跳转。

# Upgrade guide

This version matches Astryx v0.7.1. The previous version matched 0.4.1.

Every section below is a change you can hit while upgrading. Each one says four things: what changed, how you wrote it before, how you write it now, and what to do.

Most projects only need three steps:

1. Rename `labelHidden` to `isLabelHidden`.
2. Replace `enableEscape` in `useDismiss` with `dismissOnEscape`.
3. Rename the old target names in your own theme.

## Styles and themes

### `reset.css` is now a full global reset

**What changed:** `@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` used to be a single line that declared the CSS layer order. It is now a full global reset, the same kind of thing as Tailwind Preflight (upstream #7355).

**Before:** you imported it to get the layer order.

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/reset.css'
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

**Now:** every stylesheet declares the layer order on its first line, so `reset.css` is no longer needed for that. Importing it changes the default look of plain HTML: headings, paragraphs and lists lose their default margins, lists lose their bullets, images and `svg` become block level, form controls inherit the font and color, buttons lose the browser chrome, and placeholder text is no longer faded.

**What to do:**

- Only wanted the layer order: delete the line. Components do not depend on it.
- Want one consistent starting point across browsers: keep it. Its rules sit in the lowest `astryx.reset` layer with zero specificity, so your own styles always win.
- Want one block of the page cleaned up: do not import the file, write styles for that block yourself.

More detail in [Installation](/en/guide/installation).

### Spacing tokens moved from px to rem

**What changed:** `--astryx-spacing-*` is now written in `rem` instead of `px`, and the numbers were converted. Every theme changed, Matcha and Y2K included (upstream #7359 #7374).

**Before:**

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 4px;
--astryx-spacing-4: 16px;
```

**Now:**

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 0.25rem;
--astryx-spacing-4: 1rem;
```

**What to do:** the browser default root size is 16px, so nothing looks different and most projects need no change. Only two cases move:

- The page sets `html { font-size: ... }`: spacing and padding now scale with it. That is the point of the change.
- Your own theme writes spacing in px: those steps stay fixed. Write them in rem if you want them to follow the root size.

More detail in [Space, radius, shadow](/en/themes/scale).

### Theme target names were renamed

**What changed:** a batch of old target names is gone and the hyphenated names replace them. A camelCase name such as `buttonIcon`, or a name that starts with a capital such as `Card`, now throws (upstream #7302).

**Before:**

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    progressbar: { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    textarea: { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**Now:**

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    'progress-bar': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    'text-area': { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**What to do:** search the keys under `components:` and rename them with this table.

| Removed | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`, `codeblock-copy-button`, `codeblock-header`, `codeblock-title` | `code-block`, `code-block-copy-button`, `code-block-header`, `code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`, `date-range-input-clear-icon`, `multi-selector-clear-icon`, `selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`, `progressbar-fill`, `progressbar-mark`, `progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`, `progress-bar-fill`, `progress-bar-mark`, `progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`, `radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`, `radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

The old names are still well-formed, so they do not throw, but no component uses them any more, so they have no effect. Full detail in [Extend a theme](/en/themes/extending).

### Components no longer emit bare `primary` or `sm` classes

**What changed:** components such as Button no longer put `.primary`, `.secondary`, `.ghost`, `.destructive`, `.sm`, `.md` or `.lg` on their element. That information now lives in `[data-variant]` and `[data-size]` (upstream #6121).

**Before:**

```css
.my-toolbar .astryx-button.primary {
  border-radius: 999px;
}
```

**Now:**

```css
.my-toolbar .astryx-button[data-variant='primary'] {
  border-radius: 999px;
}
```

**What to do:** look for "component class plus variant word" in your stylesheets and switch to the attribute selector (`[data-variant]`, `[data-size]`).

## Component APIs

### `labelHidden` is now `isLabelHidden`

**What changed:** the property that hides a field label is `isLabelHidden`. The old `labelHidden` still works and goes away in a later version.

**Before:**

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" labelHidden />
```

**Now:**

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" is-label-hidden />
```

**What to do:** replace `label-hidden` with `is-label-hidden` on Typeahead, Tokenizer, MultiSelector, Token, PowerSearch, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput and TimeInput.

PowerSearch hides its label by default, and its rule is slightly different: when both names are passed the new one wins, when only the old one is passed the old one wins, and when neither is passed the label stays hidden. Every other component hides the label when either name is true.

### Selector `variant="default"` is now `variant="input"`

**What changed:** the bordered input step is called `input`. `default` is the old name and still works.

**Before:**

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="default" />
```

**Now:**

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="input" />
```

**What to do:** replace `variant="default"` with `variant="input"`. Leaving `variant` out behaves as before, still a bordered input. `default` keeps working for now and goes away in a later version.

MultiSelector and ComplexSelector only have `input`, `secondary` and `ghost`, so they need no change.

### Four new styling properties

**What changed:** input components gained `containerClass`, `containerStyle`, `controlClass` and `controlStyle` (upstream #7336 #7339 #7337 #7341).

An input has two places you can style:

- The shell: the layer that holds the label, the control and the status message. Use `container*`.
- The control box: the box that draws the border and background and holds icons and the clear button. Use `control*`.

Components with them: TextInput, TextArea, NumberInput, FileInput, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput, TimeInput, Typeahead, Tokenizer, Selector, MultiSelector, ComplexSelector, CheckboxList, RadioGroup, RadioList, Slider, PowerSearch.

**Before:** you could only write `class` on the component root, and where it landed depended on the component.

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" class="mt-4" />
```

**Now:** use the new properties to target the shell or the control box.

```vue
<TextInput
  v-model="name"
  label="Name"
  container-class="mt-4"
  control-class="font-mono"
/>
```

**What to do:** nothing is required. A `class` or `style` written on the root keeps today's landing spot; it is not dropped and you get no warning. This differs from upstream, which drops it and points you at `control*`. Switch to `container*` or `control*` only when a style lands somewhere you did not want.

Two things to know:

- `container*` only applies when there is a shell. Inside `InputGroup`, or inside a `FormLayout` with a sideways label, there is no shell, so it does nothing and a development warning appears once.
- `control*` never lands on the native `input`.

### `useDismiss` takes `dismissOnEscape` instead of `enableEscape`

**What changed:** the option used to ask "should Escape be handled". It now asks "what should Escape do when it reaches this layer" (upstream #4881).

**Before:**

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  enableEscape: true,
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

**Now:**

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  dismissOnEscape: 'close',
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

Three values:

- `'close'`: close this layer. This is the default.
- `'block'`: swallow the key and stay open.
- `'ignore'`: leave the key alone, for an input that handles Escape itself.

**What to do:** `true` becomes nothing or `'close'`. `false` needs a choice: `'block'` stops Escape at this layer, `'ignore'` lets the key travel on.

## Behavior

### Tab and TabMenu must sit inside TabList, Step must sit inside Stepper

**What changed:** a `Tab` outside a `TabList` used to degrade silently. It now throws. The same happens when an overlay boundary resets the membership (upstream #6457).

**Before:** a `Tab` rendered without a `TabList` still appeared, only keyboard handling was wrong.

**Now:** you get `useTabListContext must be used within TabList`. A `Step` outside a `Stepper` gets `useStepperContext must be used within Stepper`.

**What to do:** wrap each member in its container. If you use one inside overlay content, put another local `TabList` or `Stepper` inside the overlay. The overlay is a new membership boundary, so the outer container does not count.

### `useAstryxLocale()` can return a tag with a region

**What changed:** locale tags keep their region now. `en-gb` becomes `en-GB`, `ja-jp` becomes `ja-JP`, and dates and numbers follow that region.

`zh`, `zh-CN` and `zh-Hans` still become `zh-CN`. A tag that cannot be parsed falls back to `en`.

**Before:** `useAstryxLocale()` always returned a short tag such as `en` or `zh-CN`.

**Now:**

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value === 'en' // false when the tag is en-GB
```

**What to do:** do not compare the whole tag. Check the start of it.

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value.startsWith('zh') // Chinese
```

### Navigation menus forward their attributes

**What changed:** `NavHeadingMenu` and `NavHeadingMenuItem` used to ignore `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*` and event listeners written on the root. These now land on the menu element (upstream #7331).

**What to do:** nothing. But if you worked around the old behavior with an extra wrapper or a DOM query, that workaround may now run twice. Check it and remove it.

## Text and language

### Default names follow the current language

**What changed:** default accessible names that you never passed as props now follow the current language. This covers dropdown menus, context menus, the more-options button, the dialog close button, banner expand and collapse, and the switch loading label (upstream #6125 #7289).

**Before:** screen readers always heard English: `Menu`, `Context menu`, `More options`, `Close`, `Expand`, `Collapse`, `Loading`.

**Now:** a Chinese page gets 菜单, 快捷菜单, 更多选项, 关闭, 展开, 收起, 加载中. An English page still gets the English sentences.

**What to do:** if a test or script depends on those exact English strings, pass them yourself: `label`, `closeButtonLabel`, `loadingLabel`, `expandLabel`, `collapseLabel`.

### Built-in English text now matches upstream word for word

**What changed:** the built-in English text now matches upstream exactly. The Chinese text was adjusted to match as well.

These are the visible changes:

| Component | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SideNav | Sidebar | Side navigation |
| AppShell mobile nav and mobile drawer | Navigation | Mobile navigation |
| MobileNav close button | Close | Close navigation |
| Selector and MultiSelector with no options | No matches | No options |
| Selector and MultiSelector read-only | Read-only | Read only |
| PowerSearch number equals / not equals | equals / does not equal | is / is not |
| Typeahead clear button | Clear | Clear selection |
| Typeahead and Tokenizer loading | Loading results | Loading |
| DateInput unavailable date | That date is not available | Invalid date |
| Pagination first and last buttons | First page / Last page | Go to first page / Go to last page |
| Stepper status words | Completed / Warning / Error | completed / warning / error |

FileInput's three error messages and Calendar's three range announcements changed too, both to the upstream sentences.

**What to do:** update your own assertions. If your product supplies this text, nothing moves.

### Numbers at a thousand and above get a separator

**What changed:** numbers inside built-in text use the separator of the current language, so `1234` becomes `1,234`.

This covers Pagination page numbers and totals, Selector and MultiSelector result counts, Carousel slide numbers, CommandPalette result counts, Lightbox positions, AvatarGroup overflow, table selection counts and Stepper step numbers.

**What to do:** update the places that assert this text.

## Nothing to change

These upstream breaking changes have no counterpart in the Vue version.

- The `astryx layout` command group: we have no such command.
- `astryx doctor` no longer reads the agent environment variables: we have no such behavior.
- `emptySearchResultsText`, `minSizePx` / `maxSizePx` on `useResizable`, `isRtl` on `useGridFocus` / `useListFocus`, and `isImeKeyEvent` from the hooks entry: none of these names exist in the Vue version, so writing them does nothing. Use `emptySearchText`, `minSize` / `maxSize` instead.

# 升级指南

这一版对齐 Astryx v0.7.1，上一版对齐 0.4.1。

下面每一条都是升级时会碰到的变化。每条写四件事：变了什么、以前怎么写、现在怎么写、怎么改。

多数项目只需要做三件事：

1. 把 `labelHidden` 换成 `isLabelHidden`。
2. 把 `useDismiss` 的 `enableEscape` 换成 `dismissOnEscape`。
3. 把自定义主题里的旧挂点名换成新名字。

## 样式与主题

### `reset.css` 现在是完整的全局 reset

**变了什么**：`@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` 以前只有一行，用来声明 CSS 层级顺序。现在是一份完整的全局 reset，和 Tailwind Preflight 是同一类东西（上游 #7355）。

**以前**：为了拿到层级顺序，所以引入它。

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/reset.css'
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

**现在**：每份样式表的第一行自己声明层级顺序，不再需要靠 `reset.css`。而引入它以后，整个页面上普通标签的默认样式会变：标题、段落、列表没有默认外边距，列表没有圆点，图片和 `svg` 变成块级，表单控件继承字体和颜色，按钮去掉浏览器外观，占位文字不再变淡。

**怎么改**：

- 只是想定层级顺序：删掉这一行。组件不依赖它。
- 想要一套浏览器一致的起点：保留。规则都在最低的 `astryx.reset` 层，选择器优先级是 0，你自己的样式随时能盖掉。
- 只想让某一块干净：不要引这个文件，给那一块自己写样式。

细节见 [安装](/guide/installation)。

### 间距 token 从 px 改成 rem

**变了什么**：`--astryx-spacing-*` 的单位从 `px` 改成 `rem`，数值跟着换算。全套主题都改了，包括 Matcha 和 Y2K（上游 #7359 #7374）。

**以前**：

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 4px;
--astryx-spacing-4: 16px;
```

**现在**：

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 0.25rem;
--astryx-spacing-4: 1rem;
```

**怎么改**：浏览器默认根字号是 16px，这时看起来完全一样，多数项目不用动。会变的只有两种情况：

- 页面自己写了 `html { font-size: ... }`：组件的间距和内边距会按同样比例放大或缩小。这是这次改动想要的效果。
- 自己的主题用 px 写间距：那几档仍然固定不变。想跟着根字号走，就改写成 rem。

细节见 [间距、圆角与阴影](/themes/scale)。

### 自定义主题里的挂点名改名

**变了什么**：一批旧的挂点名删掉了，改用带连字符的新名字。写驼峰（比如 `buttonIcon`）或者大写开头（比如 `Card`）会直接报错（上游 #7302）。

**以前**：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    progressbar: { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    textarea: { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**现在**：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    'progress-bar': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    'text-area': { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**怎么改**：全局搜 `components:` 里的键，对着下面这张表改名。

| 已删除 | 请改用 |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`、`codeblock-copy-button`、`codeblock-header`、`codeblock-title` | `code-block`、`code-block-copy-button`、`code-block-header`、`code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`、`date-range-input-clear-icon`、`multi-selector-clear-icon`、`selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`、`progressbar-fill`、`progressbar-mark`、`progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`、`progress-bar-fill`、`progress-bar-mark`、`progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`、`radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`、`radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

表里的旧名字本身写法合法，所以不会报错，但已经没有组件用它，写了不生效。完整说明见 [扩展主题](/themes/extending)。

### 组件不再输出 `primary`、`sm` 这类裸类名

**变了什么**：Button 这类组件不再往元素上加 `.primary`、`.secondary`、`.ghost`、`.destructive`、`.sm`、`.md`、`.lg`。这些信息改用 `[data-variant]`、`[data-size]` 属性（上游 #6121）。

**以前**：

```css
.my-toolbar .astryx-button.primary {
  border-radius: 999px;
}
```

**现在**：

```css
.my-toolbar .astryx-button[data-variant='primary'] {
  border-radius: 999px;
}
```

**怎么改**：搜自己的样式表里「组件类名 + 变体词」的组合，改成属性选择器（`[data-variant]`、`[data-size]`）。

## 组件 API

### `labelHidden` 改名 `isLabelHidden`

**变了什么**：隐藏字段标签的属性正名是 `isLabelHidden`。旧名 `labelHidden` 还留着，之后的版本会删。

**以前**：

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" labelHidden />
```

**现在**：

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" is-label-hidden />
```

**怎么改**：把 `label-hidden` 换成 `is-label-hidden`。涉及的组件：Typeahead、Tokenizer、MultiSelector、Token、PowerSearch、DateInput、DateRangeInput、DateTimeInput、TimeInput。

PowerSearch 默认就是隐藏标签。它的规则有点特别：两个名字都传时听新名；只传旧名时听旧名；都没传就保持隐藏。其余组件是两个名字任一为真就隐藏。

### Selector 的 `variant="default"` 改名 `variant="input"`

**变了什么**：带边框的输入框那一档，正名是 `input`。`default` 是旧名，还留着。

**以前**：

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="default" />
```

**现在**：

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="input" />
```

**怎么改**：把 `variant="default"` 换成 `variant="input"`。不传 `variant` 时行为和以前一样，仍然是带边框的输入框。`default` 这个值暂时还能用，之后的版本会删。

MultiSelector、ComplexSelector 只有 `input`、`secondary`、`ghost` 三档，不用改。

### 新增四个样式分层属性

**变了什么**：输入类组件新增 `containerClass`、`containerStyle`、`controlClass`、`controlStyle`（上游 #7336 #7339 #7337 #7341）。

一个输入控件有两个可以加样式的地方：

- 外壳：包着标签、控件和状态消息的那一层，用 `container*`。
- 本体：画边框和背景、里面装着图标和清除按钮的那个盒子，用 `control*`。

适用的组件：TextInput、TextArea、NumberInput、FileInput、DateInput、DateRangeInput、DateTimeInput、TimeInput、Typeahead、Tokenizer、Selector、MultiSelector、ComplexSelector、CheckboxList、RadioGroup、RadioList、Slider、PowerSearch。

**以前**：只能在组件根上写 `class`，落到哪里要看具体组件。

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" class="mt-4" />
```

**现在**：想把样式放到外壳或本体，用新属性。

```vue
<TextInput
  v-model="name"
  label="名字"
  container-class="mt-4"
  control-class="font-mono"
/>
```

**怎么改**：不用改也能跑。根上直接写的 `class` / `style` 保持各组件今天的落点，不会被丢掉，也不会警告——这一点和上游不同，上游会丢掉并提示改用 `control*`。只有当你发现样式落错了地方，才换成 `container*` 或 `control*`。

注意两件事：

- `container*` 只在有外壳的时候生效。放进 `InputGroup`，或者横向标签的 `FormLayout` 里时没有外壳，这时它不生效，开发环境会警告一次。
- `control*` 永远不会落到原生 `input` 上。

### `useDismiss` 的 `enableEscape` 换成 `dismissOnEscape`

**变了什么**：原来只问「要不要响应 Escape」，现在问「Escape 到了这一层该怎么处理」（上游 #4881）。

**以前**：

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  enableEscape: true,
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

**现在**：

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  dismissOnEscape: 'close',
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

三个取值：

- `'close'`：关掉这一层。不传就是这个。
- `'block'`：吃掉这次按键，但不关。
- `'ignore'`：不管这次按键，留给会自己 `preventDefault` 的输入组件。

**怎么改**：`true` 换成不传或 `'close'`。`false` 要分情况：想让 Escape 在这一层停住，用 `'block'`；想让按键继续往下走，用 `'ignore'`。

## 行为变化

### Tab、TabMenu 必须放在 TabList 里，Step 必须放在 Stepper 里

**变了什么**：以前把 `Tab` 放在 `TabList` 外面，会静默退化，不报错。现在会直接抛错。浮层边界把成员关系重置掉的情况也一样（上游 #6457）。

**以前**：先渲染一个 `Tab`，外面没有 `TabList`，页面照常出现，只是键盘操作不对。

**现在**：抛出 `useTabListContext must be used within TabList`。`Step` 在 `Stepper` 外面会抛 `useStepperContext must be used within Stepper`。

**怎么改**：把成员包进对应的容器。如果在浮层内容里再用一次，就在浮层里再放一层本地的 `TabList` 或 `Stepper`——浮层是新的成员边界，外面的容器不算数。

### `useAstryxLocale()` 可能返回带地区的标签

**变了什么**：语言标签现在保留地区。`en-gb` 收成 `en-GB`，`ja-jp` 收成 `ja-JP`，日期和数字按这个地区的习惯排。

`zh`、`zh-CN`、`zh-Hans` 仍然收成 `zh-CN`。认不出来的标签回到 `en`。

**以前**：`useAstryxLocale()` 返回的一定是 `en` 或 `zh-CN` 这样的短标签。

**现在**：

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value === 'en' // en-GB 时是 false
```

**怎么改**：不要用等号比整个标签，改成看开头。

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value.startsWith('zh') // 中文
```

### 导航菜单开始透传属性

**变了什么**：`NavHeadingMenu`、`NavHeadingMenuItem` 以前会忽略根上写的 `id`、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和事件监听。现在这些都会落到菜单元素上（上游 #7331）。

**怎么改**：不用改。但如果你以前因为这些属性不生效，绕开写了别的方案（比如在外面套一层再查 DOM），现在可能会重复，检查一下就能删掉。

## 文案与语言

### 不传名字时，默认名字跟当前语言

**变了什么**：下拉菜单、快捷菜单、更多选项、对话框关闭按钮、提示条展开/收起、开关加载中，这些没写在 props 里的默认无障碍名字，现在跟着当前语言走（上游 #6125 #7289）。

**以前**：不管页面是什么语言，读屏读到的都是英文 `Menu`、`Context menu`、`More options`、`Close`、`Expand`、`Collapse`、`Loading`。

**现在**：中文页面得到「菜单」「快捷菜单」「更多选项」「关闭」「展开」「收起」「加载中」。英文页面仍然是原来那几句。

**怎么改**：如果你的测试或脚本依赖那几句固定英文，就自己传进去：`label`、`closeButtonLabel`、`loadingLabel`、`expandLabel`、`collapseLabel`。

### 英文内置文案逐字对齐原版

**变了什么**：内置英文文案改成和原版一字不差。中文文案也有对应调整。

下面是用户看得见、也确实变了的几条：

| 组件 | 以前 | 现在 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SideNav | Sidebar | Side navigation |
| AppShell 手机端导航、手机抽屉 | Navigation | Mobile navigation |
| MobileNav 关闭按钮 | Close | Close navigation |
| Selector、MultiSelector 没有选项 | No matches | No options |
| Selector、MultiSelector 只读 | Read-only | Read only |
| PowerSearch 数字等于 / 不等于 | equals / does not equal | is / is not |
| Typeahead 清除按钮 | Clear | Clear selection |
| Typeahead、Tokenizer 加载中 | Loading results | Loading |
| DateInput 日期不可用 | That date is not available | Invalid date |
| Pagination 首末页按钮 | First page / Last page | Go to first page / Go to last page |
| Stepper 状态词 | Completed / Warning / Error | completed / warning / error |

FileInput 的三条报错和 Calendar 的三句日期范围播报也改了，都改成原版的句子。

**怎么改**：自己写的断言要跟着改。如果这些文字由你的文案覆盖，就不用动。

### 数字到一千以上加千分位

**变了什么**：内置文案里的数字按当前语言加千分位，比如 `1234` 变成 `1,234`。

涉及 Pagination 的页码和总数、Selector 和 MultiSelector 的结果数、Carousel 的序号、CommandPalette 的结果数、Lightbox 的位置、AvatarGroup 的溢出数、表格选中数、Stepper 的步骤号。

**怎么改**：断言这些文字的地方跟着改。

## 不用改的地方

下面这些上游的破坏性改动，Vue 版没有对应的东西，不用做任何事。

- 命令行的 `astryx layout` 命令组：我们没有这个命令。
- `astryx doctor` 不再读 agent 相关的环境变量：我们没有这个行为。
- `emptySearchResultsText`、`useResizable` 的 `minSizePx` / `maxSizePx`、`useGridFocus` / `useListFocus` 的 `isRtl`、从 hooks 导出的 `isImeKeyEvent`：这些名字在当前 Vue 版里都不存在，写了也不会生效。对应位置请用 `emptySearchText`、`minSize` / `maxSize`。

body.en:
# Patterns

A conversation is a composition. The transcript, bubbles, reasoning, tool calls, citations, and the composer are separate components, and the page decides how they sit together. Nothing here calls a model. The body is a slot. Long replies are Markdown, and a source becomes a citation.

Before any transcript exists, the page is a greeting and one composer. The mode can move among writing, coding, research, and creative work. Sensitive and deep modes insert a chip instead. @ opens people, and / opens commands. Files sit in the drawer, and a long paste becomes a chip too. The microphone appears only when the browser can recognize speech. Choosing a category writes that suggestion into the composer.

Once a thread exists, the transcript is a column and the composer stays at the bottom. While the assistant is still writing, send becomes stop and the log is marked as streaming. Reasoning opens first, a tool call moves from running to complete, and the answer carries a citation. A generated document opens from a card. The full playground page keeps that document in a resizable side panel, and below 768px it becomes a full-screen dialog.

Both examples below can be used. The full pages are in the playground: [AI Chat Landing](/en/playground/?template=ai-chat-landing) and [AI Chat Conversation](/en/playground/?template=ai-chat). Density, unread rules, and metadata are documented on [Chat](/en/components/chat).

## Pinned headers and footers

In a long region, a header scrolls out of sight and a commit button scrolls out of reach, so people scroll back and forth. `Layout` defaults to `height="fill"`: it fills its container and only the body scrolls, while the header and footer stay put.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'

const rows = [/* a long list */]
</script>

<template>
  <Layout :padding="4" default-has-dividers>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader>Orders</LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent>
      <OrderRow v-for="row in rows" :key="row.id" v-bind="row" />
    </LayoutContent>

    <template #footer>
      <LayoutFooter>
        <Button label="Save" />
        <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" />
      </LayoutFooter>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

A few notes.

- Write `padding` once, on `Layout`. The header, body, and footer share one inline padding, so their text lines up on one vertical line.
- `defaultHasDividers` draws the line on both the header and the footer, so neither region needs its own `hasDivider`.
- A title plus one primary action goes in `LayoutHeader`. When the header carries a row of interactive controls, such as filters, sort, or bulk actions, use `Toolbar` instead; it handles arrow-key movement by the toolbar accessibility rules.
- The footer holds only the actions that must stay reachable: Save, Submit, Next. Secondary actions stay in the body.

To check it: scroll the body to the bottom. The header and footer have not moved, the dividers still run edge to edge, and the header title still shares a left edge with the first line of the body.

## Side detail panels

In a master-detail view, selecting a row usually navigates away, and coming back means finding your place again. A fixed-width panel on the end edge keeps the list in place instead.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { EmptyState } from '@astryx-vue/core/EmptyState'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref<Order | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <LayoutContent>
      <OrderRow
        v-for="row in rows"
        :key="row.id"
        v-bind="row"
        @select="selected = row"
      />
    </LayoutContent>

    <template #end>
      <LayoutPanel :width="380" has-divider is-scrollable label="Order details">
        <OrderDetail v-if="selected" :order="selected" />
        <EmptyState
          v-else
          is-compact
          title="No order selected"
          description="Pick a row on the left and its details appear here."
        />
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

- A panel width between 340 and 420 works well. `width` as a number is pixels.
- `hasDivider` draws the edge facing the content. Do not draw a line on both sides.
- `isScrollable` lets long details scroll inside the panel without moving the list.
- Put an `EmptyState` in when nothing is selected. An empty panel collapses to a sliver, then the page jumps wider on the first selection.

To let people drag the width, hand `useResizable` to both the panel and a `ResizeHandle`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const detail = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 380,
  minSize: 320,
  maxSize: 560,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <LayoutContent>Body</LayoutContent>

    <template #end>
      <ResizeHandle
        direction="horizontal"
        is-reversed
        has-divider
        :resizable="detail.props"
        label="Resize the details panel"
      />
      <LayoutPanel :width="detail.size" :has-divider="false" is-scrollable label="Details">
        Detail content
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

On the end edge, turn `isReversed` on so dragging left makes the panel wider. The handle carries `has-divider` and the panel turns `hasDivider` off, so one edge draws one line.

On a narrow screen, do not squeeze. Let the panel go and show the details in a `Dialog` or a `BottomSheet` instead. See [Responsive layout](/en/guide/responsive).
body.zh:
# 应用模式

现代应用（尤其是 AI 产品）通常由许多部件紧密配合而成。在 astryx-vue 中，消息气泡、推理过程、工具调用（Tool Calls）、参考引用以及底部输入框等，都是一个个高内聚的独立组件，你可以根据具体场景自由组合，决定它们如何在页面上协同工作。

组件库本身专注做好前端界面与交互，不绑定任何特定的大语言模型或后端。组件的内容通过插槽自由注入，较长的文本可以直接用 Markdown 组件排版，信息来源则用引用组件标记。

## 场景一：初始落地页（无聊天记录时）

在用户还没有开始对话时，页面中间通常呈现欢迎问候语和一块功能丰富的输入区：
- 支持切换模式，比如写作、编程、深度研究或艺术创作；
- 包含安全性或思考深度的条件胶囊标记；
- 输入 `@` 可以提及人物或知识库，输入 `/` 可以呼出快捷命令；
- 支持在抽屉中添加附件，粘贴超长文本时会自动折叠为精巧的小卡片；
- 仅在浏览器支持语音录入时才露出麦克风按钮；
- 点击下方推荐的分类卡片，示例提示词会自动填入输入框。

## 场景二：对话进行中（有聊天往来时）

当对话开始后，上方是一条条自适应滚动的历史消息，底部紧跟输入区：
- 当 AI 正在生成回复时，发送按钮会自动切换为「停止生成」，当前消息状态标记为输出中；
- 思考推理过程可以先折叠或展开呈现；
- 工具调用状态会自动从「正在运行」平滑过渡到「调用完成」；
- 回答中包含的数字小角标可以直接对应到文章引用来源；
- 生成的长篇文档能够收录为卡片，点击即可在侧栏或全屏弹窗中精读。

在宽屏桌面端，整套演练场支持把参考文档放入右侧可拖拽调整宽度的侧面板中；当屏幕宽度变窄（小于 768px）时，会自动退化为全屏浮层。

## 交互演示

你可以直接在下方两套预设模式中上手试玩。完整的全屏页面可在演练场体验：[AI 对话落地页](/playground/?template=ai-chat-landing) 与 [AI 对话](/playground/?template=ai-chat)。关于各个子组件的排版密度与属性细节，可参阅 [对话组件](/components/chat)。

## 固定页眉与页脚

一块内容很长的区域，页眉一滚就看不见，提交按钮一滚就找不到，人就得来回滚。`Layout` 的 `height` 默认是 `fill`：它撑满容器，只有正文在中间滚动，页眉和页脚留在原地。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'

const rows = [/* 很长的列表 */]
</script>

<template>
  <Layout :padding="4" default-has-dividers>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader>订单</LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent>
      <OrderRow v-for="row in rows" :key="row.id" v-bind="row" />
    </LayoutContent>

    <template #footer>
      <LayoutFooter>
        <Button label="保存" />
        <Button label="取消" variant="secondary" />
      </LayoutFooter>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

几点：

- `padding` 只写在 `Layout` 上，页眉、正文、页脚共用同一个左右内边距，文字对齐同一条竖线。
- `defaultHasDividers` 一次给页眉和页脚都画线，不用两个区域各写一个 `hasDivider`。
- 页眉里放的是标题加一个主操作，用 `LayoutHeader`。页眉里要放一排可交互的控件（筛选、排序、批量操作），改用 `Toolbar`，它按工具栏的无障碍规则处理方向键。
- 页脚只放必须一直够得着的动作：保存、提交、下一步。次要动作留在正文里。

验证方法：把正文滚到底。页眉和页脚没动，分隔线还是通到两边，页眉标题和正文第一行的左边缘仍然对齐。

## 侧边详情面板

主从结构里，选中一行就跳走一个页面，人回来还得重新找位置。更好的做法是右边开一块固定宽度的面板，列表留着不动。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { EmptyState } from '@astryx-vue/core/EmptyState'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref<Order | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <LayoutContent>
      <OrderRow
        v-for="row in rows"
        :key="row.id"
        v-bind="row"
        @select="selected = row"
      />
    </LayoutContent>

    <template #end>
      <LayoutPanel :width="380" has-divider is-scrollable label="订单详情">
        <OrderDetail v-if="selected" :order="selected" />
        <EmptyState
          v-else
          is-compact
          title="还没有选择订单"
          description="在左边点一行，这里会显示它的详情。"
        />
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

- 面板宽度建议在 340 到 420 之间。`width` 写数字按像素。
- `hasDivider` 画出朝内容的那条边，两边不要都画线。
- `isScrollable` 让长详情自己滚，列表不受影响。
- 没选中任何行时放一个 `EmptyState`。空着会让面板塌成一条缝，选中时页面又突然变宽。

要让用户自己拖宽度，把 `useResizable` 拖到面板和 `ResizeHandle` 上：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const detail = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 380,
  minSize: 320,
  maxSize: 560,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <LayoutContent>正文</LayoutContent>

    <template #end>
      <ResizeHandle
        direction="horizontal"
        is-reversed
        has-divider
        :resizable="detail.props"
        label="调整详情面板宽度"
      />
      <LayoutPanel :width="detail.size" :has-divider="false" is-scrollable label="详情">
        详情内容
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

结束边的面板要把 `isReversed` 打开，往左拖才是变宽。分隔条本身要 `has-divider`，面板则关掉 `hasDivider`，一条边上只留一条线。

窄屏时不要硬挤。宽度不够就让面板退场，改用 `Dialog` 或 `BottomSheet` 展示详情，具体做法见 [响应式布局](/guide/responsive)。

summary.en: Every decision in this library follows from four sentences.
summary.zh: 这套组件库的每一个决定都从四句话出发。

zh: 主题无关是怎么做到的

body.en:
# Design principles

Every decision in this library follows from four sentences.

- **Components before raw HTML.** For anything a component already covers, don't hand-write the markup and restyle it.
- **Semantic tokens, not hardcoded values.** Colors, spacing, and radii are named by purpose, not by appearance. The name says "body text primary", not "dark grey".
- **App code knows nothing about the theme.** No hex colors and no pixel values in your own styles, so a theme swap or dark mode follows automatically.
- **The internals are open.** Every component is exported and composable. Build on top of one instead of fighting it.

## Eight hard rules

1. If a component covers it, don't hand-write it.
2. Lay out from the outside in: pick the frame and the regions before writing content. See [Page layout](/en/guide/layout).
3. Dense data renders as rows: `Table`, or a `List` with dividers, one item per row. `Card` is for self-contained widgets, galleries, and groups of settings.
4. Custom styles are plain CSS in `@layer astryx.overrides`. To mix in utility classes, see [Theme and styles](/en/guide/styling).
5. Colors, spacing, and radii come from semantic variables: `var(--astryx-color-text-primary)`, `var(--astryx-spacing-4)`.
6. Forms bind with `v-model`. `TextInput` and `CheckboxInput` require a value; there is no uncontrolled mode.
7. Navigation uses `as` to render `RouterLink` as the root element, or a `LinkProvider` at the top of the app. Don't hard-code `<a href>`.
8. When a prop is unclear, look it up: `astryx-vue component Button`. Don't guess, and don't invent props.

## How theme independence works

A theme file holds variables and no structure. Every color variable reads like this.

```css
--astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#171717, #fafafa);
```

`light-dark()` picks the light or the dark value from the current `color-scheme`, so writing `var(--astryx-color-text-primary)` is all your code needs; dark mode comes for free and there is no second stylesheet to keep in sync.

Component structure uses the same variables. Swap the theme to Gothic and every color in the page changes, with no edit to app code.

## Do and don't

| Guidance | Practice |
| --- | --- |
| Do | Place content with `HStack`, `VStack`, and `Grid`; they carry no color and no border. |
| Do | Write colors as `var(--astryx-color-*)` and spacing as `var(--astryx-spacing-*)`. |
| Do | When a component's behavior is unclear, run `astryx-vue component <Name>` first. |
| Don't | Stack inline styles on raw elements to get around a component. |
| Don't | Hardcode colors (`#fff`) or spacing (`16px`). |
| Don't | Write `<a href="/orders">` by hand; in-app navigation then reloads the page. |
| Don't | Wrap every list item and every page section in a `Card`. |
| Don't | Use `Badge` as decoration. It carries meaning: status, category, count. For a decorative value chip use `Token`; for a single status dot use `StatusDot`. |

## About styling

Upstream Astryx supports StyleX; we don't. Our approach is plain CSS plus CSS variables: component styles live in `@layer`, so a rule you write in the `astryx.overrides` layer wins without out-specificity tricks.

The full layer order, how to arrange `@layer`, and how to use Tailwind or UnoCSS alongside: [Theme and styles](/en/guide/styling).
body.zh:
# 设计原则

这套组件库的每一个决定都从四句话出发。

- **有组件就用组件。** 组件已经覆盖的东西，不要回头手写 HTML 再拼一遍样式。
- **用语义变量，不写死数值。** 颜色、间距、圆角按用途命名，不按长相命名。名字叫「正文主色」，不叫「深灰」。
- **代码不认识主题。** 业务代码里不出现具体色号和像素值，换主题、切深色就自动跟着变。
- **内部是开放的。** 每个组件都导出，也都能组合。想在上面再加一层就加，不用先跟它打架。

## 八条硬规则

1. 组件能覆盖的，就不要手写。
2. 布局从外往里：先选外壳和区域，再写内容。见 [页面布局](/guide/layout)。
3. 密集数据用行来排：`Table`、`List` 加分隔线，一条一行。`Card` 留给独立的小部件、图集和设置分组。
4. 自定义样式写普通 CSS，放在 `@layer astryx.overrides` 里。要和工具类一起用，见 [主题与样式](/guide/styling)。
5. 颜色、间距、圆角用语义变量：`var(--astryx-color-text-primary)`、`var(--astryx-spacing-4)`。
6. 表单用 `v-model` 双向绑定。`TextInput`、`CheckboxInput` 这些组件都要求传值，没有不受控模式。
7. 导航用 `as` 把根元素换成 `RouterLink`，或者在应用顶层放一个 `LinkProvider`。不要硬写 `<a href>`。
8. 属性拿不准就先查：`astryx-vue component Button`。不要猜，也不要编造 props。

## 主题无关是怎么做到的

主题文件里只有变量，没有结构。每个颜色变量长这样：

```css
--astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#171717, #fafafa);
```

`light-dark()` 会根据当前的 `color-scheme` 自动挑浅色或深色。所以业务代码只写 `var(--astryx-color-text-primary)`，深色模式自己就生效了，你不用写第二套样式。

组件自己的结构样式里也是同一套变量。你把主题换成 Gothic，页面所有颜色跟着换，业务代码一个字都不用改。

## 该做与不该做

| 指引 | 实践 |
| --- | --- |
| 推荐 | 用 `HStack`、`VStack`、`Grid` 摆放内容，它们不管颜色和边框。 |
| 推荐 | 颜色写 `var(--astryx-color-*)`，间距写 `var(--astryx-spacing-*)`。 |
| 推荐 | 不确定组件行为时，先跑 `astryx-vue component <名字>` 看一遍。 |
| 避免 | 在原生元素上堆内联样式，绕开组件。 |
| 避免 | 写死颜色（`#fff`）和间距（`16px`）。 |
| 避免 | 硬写 `<a href="/orders">`，站内跳转会整页刷新。 |
| 避免 | 每个列表项、每个页面区块都包一张 `Card`。 |
| 避免 | 拿 `Badge` 当纯装饰。它带含义：状态、分类、数量。只是个点缀的色块用 `Token`，只要一个圆点表示状态用 `StatusDot`。 |

## 关于样式写法

原版 Astryx 支持 StyleX，我们没有。我们的做法是普通 CSS 加 CSS 变量：组件样式全在 `@layer` 里，你在 `astryx.overrides` 层写自己的规则就能盖住它，不用靠增加选择器权重硬顶。

完整的分层顺序、`@layer` 该怎么排、怎么和 Tailwind 或 UnoCSS 一起用，见 [主题与样式](/guide/styling)。

summary.en: Decide what each region does as the width drops, then wire the components. A region can stay and get narrower, move into a layer that opens on demand, or leave the page. When three regions are sharing a row and none of them has room, drop one. Do not shrink all of them by the same amount.
summary.zh: 响应式设计应当顺应内容，而不是等比压缩。在开始搭界面之前，先思考各个区块在屏幕变窄时应当如何演变：某些辅助区域可以留下来并适当收缩；某些可以暂时收进按需展开的抽屉浮层中；而某些不关键的次要内容则可以直接隐藏。当三栏内容并排太挤时，应把次要的一栏收起或折叠，不要把文字和按钮压得变形。

body.en: # Responsive layout Decide what each region does as the width drops, then wire the components. A region can stay and get narrower, move into a layer that opens on demand, or leave the page. When three regions are sharing a row and none of them has room, drop one. Do not shrink all of them by the same amount. ## The shell breakpoint `mobileNav.breakpoint` on `AppShell` is the width where the side navigation moves into the drawer. The default is `md`. | Value | Width | | --- | --- | | `sm` | 640px | | `md` | 768px | | `lg` | 1024px | | `xl` | 1280px | | `2xl` | 1536px | | `none` | stays inline | Below that width the side navigation leaves the page and the drawer takes over. A top navigation inside the same shell uses that drawer instead of opening a second one. Set `mobileNav` to `false` to turn this off. Inside the shell, `useAppShellMobile()` reports whether the viewport is narrow and whether the drawer is open. Import it from `@astryx-vue/core`. ## Content `Layout` splits the page into header, start, content, end, and footer slots. `contentWidth` caps the content column. Dividers still run the full width. A number is pixels. Body text is easiest to read at about 40 to 60 characters a line, so hold the column with this prop instead of wrapping every section in its own container. A `LayoutPanel` in the end slot takes a fixed column with `width`. When the row gets too narrow for that column, do not keep it on the page next to the side navigation. ```vue ``` Above 1024px the page has three regions: the side navigation, the content, and a 380px side panel. At 1024px the side panel leaves the row. Open it in a [Dialog](/en/components/dialog) or a [BottomSheet](/en/components/bottom-sheet) when it is needed. At `md` (768px) the side navigation moves into the shell drawer. `useMediaQuery` reads the match during setup, then follows changes. ## Columns that reflow A numeric `columns` on `Grid` is that many columns at every width. It does not drop a column on its own. `:columns="7"` is still seven columns on a phone. To drop columns as the width drops, pass `{ minWidth, max }`. `minWidth` is the minimum pixel width of a column, and `max` is the most columns the grid will create. When another column would fall short of `minWidth`, the grid uses fewer columns. The last remaining column can shrink to the container. `gap` takes space between columns and counts toward whether another column fits. ```vue ``` On that same columns object, `repeat: 'fit'` collapses empty tracks so the columns that are present stretch across the row. The default, `fill`, keeps the empty tracks so every column stays the same width.
body.zh: # 响应式布局 响应式设计应当顺应内容，而不是等比压缩。在开始搭界面之前，先思考各个区块在屏幕变窄时应当如何演变：某些辅助区域可以留下来并适当收缩；某些可以暂时收进按需展开的抽屉浮层中；而某些不关键的次要内容则可以直接隐藏。当三栏内容并排太挤时，应把次要的一栏收起或折叠，不要把文字和按钮压得变形。 ## 页面外壳（AppShell）断点设置 `AppShell` 的 `mobileNav.breakpoint` 决定了侧边导航栏（SideNav）在什么时候自动折叠进移动端抽屉里。默认的折叠断点是 `md`。 | 选项值 | 触发宽度 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `sm` | 640px | 仅在超小手机屏幕上折叠 | | `md` | 768px | 平板及以下屏幕折叠（默认推荐） | | `lg` | 1024px | 小屏笔记本或横屏平板以下折叠 | | `xl` | 1280px | 普通桌面屏幕以下折叠 | | `2xl` | 1536px | 大屏幕以下折叠 | | `none` | 不收起 | 始终保持左侧栏常驻，不使用移动端抽屉 | 当视口宽度小于所设断点时，原本常驻的左侧栏会移出主版面，转由汉堡按钮和呼出的抽屉来接管。同属于一个外壳内的顶栏也会复用这只抽屉，避免重复生成弹层。如果传入 `:mobile-nav="false"`，则完全关闭移动端抽屉行为。 在 `AppShell` 内部的任何子组件里，你都可以随时调用 `useAppShellMobile()` 组合式函数，实时读取当前是否处于窄屏移动状态，以及抽屉是否正处于打开状态。 ## 内容版心与布局（Layout） `Layout` 负责把页面的布局结构清晰切分为：页眉（header）、起始侧（start）、主要内容（content）、结束侧（end）和页脚（footer）等插槽。 - **舒适阅读宽度**：通常一行正文文本在 40 到 60 个中文字符（或 60 到 80 个英文字符）时人眼读起来最不容易疲劳。`Layout` 提供了 `contentWidth` 属性（单位是像素），能方便地限制中间正文栏的宽度，同时保持上下的分隔线横向拉通铺满，无需在每个段落里层层包裹容器。 - **自适应侧面板**：放在结束插槽（end slot）里的 `LayoutPanel` 经常用来展示选中的条目详情。当屏幕变窄空间不够时，可以借助条件渲染在窄屏时隐藏它，改为需要时通过弹窗或底部抽屉查看。 ```vue ``` 在这个例子里： 1. 当屏幕宽于 1024px 时，呈现三栏结构：侧导航、正文、380px 的右侧面板； 2. 宽度小于 1024px 时，右侧面板隐藏，腾出完整空间显示正文；需要看详情时可通过 [Dialog](/components/dialog) 或 [BottomSheet](/components/bottom-sheet) 调出； 3. 进一步变窄到 `md`（768px）以下时，侧导航自动收录到移动端抽屉里。 `useMediaQuery` 在组件 setup 初始化时就会同步计算一次状态，并在窗口缩放时平滑响应。 ## 自动换行的网格布局（Grid） `Grid` 组件的 `columns` 属性如果直接写成固定的数字，例如 `:columns="7"`，那么即便在屏幕极窄的手机上，它也依旧会死板地强行挤成 7 列（适合用来做固定星期的日历排版）。 如果你希望网格能根据容器宽度自动增减列数，可以传入 `{ minWidth, max }` 配置对象： - `minWidth`：每列最小允许的宽度（像素）； - `max`：最多允许排成多少列。 容器放不下更多列时会自动少一列，并把剩余卡片顺延换行；当缩窄到只剩一列时，卡片宽度会自动伸展填满整个容器。`gap` 属性设置的卡片间隙，也会被精准计算进列宽的容量判断中。 ```vue ``` 此外，你还可以通过 `repeat` 属性控制未填满时的排版策略： - `repeat="fill"`（默认值）：保留空列占位，确保每一列的卡片都保持相同宽度。 - `repeat="fit"`：收起多余的空列，让已有的卡片均分并撑满整行空间。
