body.en:
# Theme and styles An app imports two things at minimum: a theme, and structural styles for the components it uses. ```ts import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button' import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css' ``` The `Button` entry loads the structural sheet for `button`. The theme entry loads Neutral's variables, including the `--astryx-button-*` names that button reads. Without the theme, the structure is there and the color and metrics are not. Without the structural sheet, the variables have no rules to feed. To load every structural sheet once, add this at the entry: ```ts import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css' import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css' ``` `styles.css` gathers the sheets in `packages/core/styles/`, including the shared motion in `motion.css`. `neutral.css` gathers the theme files in `packages/themes/neutral/` and loads Figtree and JetBrains Mono. The layer order is: ```css @layer astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides; ``` Application overrides belong in `astryx.overrides`. Unlayered global CSS beats these layers, so a bare `button { }` will paint over the component unless that is what you want. ## Using Tailwind or UnoCSS alongside They work together as long as the layer order is fixed. One rule matters: the position of every layer on the page is set by **where it first appears**. The reliable way is to declare all the layers in one statement at the top of your app entry. ```css @layer theme, base, astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides, components, utilities; @import 'tailwindcss'; @import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'; @import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'; ``` Earlier layers are weaker and later layers win. The utilities layer sits after `astryx.components`, so `class="p-0"` beats the padding a component sets. `astryx.overrides` sits before utilities, so it cannot beat them. When one rule must win over a utility class, do not reach for `overrides`; reorder the layers, or write the rule unlayered. One note on syntax: an `@layer` statement may come before `@import`. That is one of the few orders CSS allows; the other way round the whole block is discarded as invalid. ### Use our variables in utility classes No config needed; arbitrary values work as they are. ```html
...
``` Tailwind v4 can also register the variables as its own tokens, which reads shorter. ```css @theme inline { --color-surface: var(--astryx-color-background-card); --color-body: var(--astryx-color-text-primary); } ``` Then write `bg-surface` and `text-body`. Do not drop `inline`. Tailwind's guidance is that a theme value pointing at another variable needs it; without it the generated utility reads `--color-surface` itself rather than our variable, and colors scoped to a theme stop following. ### UnoCSS UnoCSS emits utilities as ordinary rules with no layer. Unlayered rules beat any `@layer`, so utilities win over component styles with no ordering work. The cost is the mirror image: layered CSS you write cannot beat a UnoCSS class. To override one, write a more specific selector, or write unlayered CSS. If you turn on UnoCSS's CSS layer output (`outputToCssLayers`), treat it like Tailwind and place its layers after `astryx.components`. ## Using CSS Modules or plain CSS Both work. Three things to keep in mind. **Class names do not collide.** ` ``` **Values still come from variables.** Your own class names are fine; colors and spacing are still `var(--astryx-*)`. Slipping a `#171717` in breaks both dark mode and theming. If the project uses no layers at all, write specific selectors. Avoid bare element selectors such as `button { }`, and avoid a global `* { }`. These styles do not require UnoCSS. The docs site uses UnoCSS only so example classes such as `i-carbon-*` can draw icons. That is the icon approach, not a styling dependency. See [Icons](/en/guide/icons). Variable names, `light-dark()`, and what the theme covers today are in [CSS variables](/en/themes/css-variables) and [Neutral](/en/themes/neutral).

# 主题与样式 要让组件漂亮且正确地呈现出来，一个应用通常需要引入两样东西：主题变量，以及组件的结构样式。 ```ts import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button' import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css' ``` 当你从子路径引入 `Button` 时，它会自动附带按钮本身的结构骨架样式。而引入的主题样式（例如 `neutral.css`）则负责注入 Neutral 主题的配色变量（包含按钮所需要的 `--astryx-button-*` 等）。两者分工明确：如果缺少主题，组件虽然有布局结构，但会缺失色彩与视觉质感；如果缺少结构样式，变量就找不到对应的 CSS 规则来生效。 如果你不想每次手动按需引入各组件的样式，可以在全局入口处一次性加载所有样式： ```ts import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css' import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css' ``` 其中 `styles.css` 汇总了 `packages/core/styles/` 下全部组件的结构样式，并自带了共享动画规则 `motion.css`；而 `neutral.css` 则汇总了 Neutral 主题的所有变量定义，并引入 Figtree 和 JetBrains Mono 字体。 ## 样式的层级顺序（CSS Layers） 为了保证业务代码覆盖样式时不被组件库的特异性（Specificity）困扰，所有样式都被组织在标准的 CSS `@layer` 规则中，层级先后关系如下： ```css @layer astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides; ``` 如果你需要在项目中覆盖组件样式，建议将自定义样式写在 `astryx.overrides` 层内。需要提醒的是，普通写在未分层环境下的全局 CSS 规则优先级天然高于所有的 `@layer`。因此在写全局样式时，请尽量避免使用未分层的纯标签选择器（如全局写 `button { ... }`），以免不小心破坏掉组件的默认外观。 ## 和 Tailwind / UnoCSS 一起用 可以一起用，前提是把层的顺序定死。 关键只有一条：页面上所有层的先后，由它们**第一次出现**的位置决定。所以最稳的做法是在应用入口的最上面写一行，把所有层一次排好： ```css @layer theme, base, astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides, components, utilities; @import 'tailwindcss'; @import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'; @import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'; ``` 排在前面的层更弱，排在后面的更强。工具类那一层排在 `astryx.components` 后面，所以 `class="p-0"` 能盖掉组件自带的内边距。`astryx.overrides` 排在工具类前面，所以它压不过工具类。某条样式必须赢过工具类时，别靠 overrides，改顺序或者不写成分层。 顺带说一句：`@layer` 语句可以写在 `@import` 前面，这是 CSS 里少数允许的顺序。反过来的话整段会被当成无效内容丢掉。 ### 在工具类里直接用我们的变量 不用改配置，任意值写法就能用： ```html
...
``` Tailwind v4 还可以把变量登记成自己的 token，写起来更短： ```css @theme inline { --color-surface: var(--astryx-color-background-card); --color-body: var(--astryx-color-text-primary); } ``` 之后写 `bg-surface`、`text-body`。`inline` 不能省。按 Tailwind 的说明，主题值引用了另一个变量时必须加它；不加的话生成出来的工具类读的是 `--color-surface` 自己，而不是我们的变量，按主题作用域切换颜色时就跟不准。 ### UnoCSS UnoCSS 默认把工具类输出成不分层的普通规则。未分层的规则赢过任何 `@layer`，所以工具类天然盖得住组件样式，不用调顺序。 代价是反过来的：你手写的分层 CSS 压不过 UnoCSS 的类。要盖它，选择器写具体一点，或者写成未分层。 如果你打开了 UnoCSS 的 CSS 层输出（`outputToCssLayers`），那就和 Tailwind 一样，把它的层排到 `astryx.components` 之后。 ## 和 CSS Modules、手写 CSS 一起用 这两种都能用，注意三点。 **类名不会冲突。** ` ``` **值仍然写变量。** 用自己的类名可以，但颜色和间距还是写 `var(--astryx-*)`。抄一个 `#171717` 进去，深色模式和换主题就断了。 如果项目完全不用分层，就把选择器写具体一点，别用裸标签选择器（`button { }`），也别在全局写 `* { }`。 ## 关于样式依赖 这套样式不要求 UnoCSS。文档站用 UnoCSS 只为了给示例里的 `i-carbon-*` 类提供图标，那是图标方案，不是组件样式的依赖。见 [图标](/guide/icons)。 更深入的变量命名规则、`light-dark()` 机制与主题支持范围，可继续阅读 [CSS 变量](/themes/css-variables) 和 [Neutral 主题](/themes/neutral)。

body.en:
# Introduction

astryx-vue is an open-source Vue 3 reimplementation of Meta's [Astryx](https://github.com/facebook/astryx) design language. The upstream documentation is located at <https://astryx.atmeta.com>, built on React 19 and StyleX. astryx-vue is an independent community project bringing the aesthetics and engineering precision of Astryx to the Vue ecosystem.

## Core Focus

Rather than wrapping React components or introducing runtime adapters, astryx-vue reimagines Astryx natively for Vue. The implementation strictly mirrors four foundations:

1. **Design Tokens**: Structured design tokens across color, spacing, radius, and elevation.
2. **CSS Variables**: Unified light/dark theme variables leveraging native `light-dark()`.
3. **Motion System**: Calibrated durations and easing curves with built-in reduced-motion support.
4. **Component Grain**: Faithful component divisions matching the original design system.

All APIs embrace standard Vue 3 idioms: typed props, events, slots, `v-model`, and composables without unnecessary runtime abstractions.

## Architecture and Packages

The project separates component structure from visual theming:

- `@astryx-vue/core`: Component implementations, composables, and structural CSS.
- `@astryx-vue/themes`: Theme tokens, typography, and color definitions (currently providing Neutral).

The styles use standard CSS layers (`@layer astryx.*`), requiring no specialized CSS-in-JS toolchains.

## Icons and Patterns

To keep bundle footprints minimal, the library does not package a proprietary icon font or heavy component suite. Controls such as `IconButton` and `NavItem` accept CSS icon classes, seamlessly integrating with solutions like UnoCSS `presetIcons`, Iconify, or Lucide.

For specialized workflows, the library provides cohesive component patterns including `Chat` layouts, `Citation` elements, and `Markdown` presentations.

## Differences from the Original

Most components map one-to-one to the original. The table below lists what this repository adds on top, things the original does not have. Each one is off by default or leaves existing behavior alone.

| Feature | Entry | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Custom scrollbars | [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/en/components/scrollbars-provider) | Wrap your app once and scrolling components swap native scrollbars for thin overlay ones. Without it nothing changes, and no extra code is bundled. |

New extras will keep being added to this table.

---

The public API strictly reflects current repository exports. Core styles and components follow native Web standards and modern Vue 3 patterns.
body.zh:
# 介绍

astryx-vue 是用 Vue 3 重新实现的开源组件库，视觉规范来自 Meta 的 [Astryx](https://github.com/facebook/astryx) 设计系统。原版文档在 <https://astryx.atmeta.com>，用 React 19 和 StyleX 开发。本项目由开源社区独立维护，让 Vue 开发者不用换技术栈，就能直接用上这套现代界面。

## 我们是怎么做的

我们并不是在 React 组件外面套一层壳，而是用 Vue 3 把整套界面的质感、排版与工程规范从底层重新做了一遍。组件库严格对齐原版的四个基础：

1. **设计变量（Tokens）**：统一间距、圆角和字号，改一处地方，所有组件都跟着生效。
2. **CSS 变量系统**：原生支持 `light-dark()`，不用写两套样式表，就能在浅色和深色之间切换，也方便层层覆盖。
3. **动效（Motion）**：带有自然的过渡节奏；用户在系统里开启「减少动效」时，会自动收起大幅位移，保护阅读体验。
4. **常用组件**：从小按钮、图标，到整套 AI 对话窗口和后台布局，常用的界面都有准备。

所有组件完全按照 Vue 3 的标准习惯来写：支持标准的 Props、事件、插槽、`v-model` 和组合式函数（Composables）。不需要任何多余的转换胶水层，代码打包出来干净小巧。

## 两个包各司其职

项目拆成了两个清晰的包，各管各的事：

- `@astryx-vue/core`：核心组件库，里面是所有 Vue 组件、常用工具函数（Composables）和组件骨架样式。
- `@astryx-vue/themes`：主题包，提供 Neutral 等配色变量和字体排版规则。

所有样式都用现代标准 CSS 编写，你的项目不需要引入 StyleX，也不需要配置专门的 CSS 编译器。

## 图标与成套界面

组件库本身不强行捆绑任何一套体积庞大的图标库。像 `IconButton`（图标按钮）或 `NavItem`（导航项）这样需要放图标的地方，支持直接传 CSS 类名。你可以选择自己喜欢的方案，无论是 UnoCSS `presetIcons`、Tailwind、Iconify 还是自己手写的 SVG，都能放进去。

对于平时常用的 AI 与协作界面，我们还准备好了成套的组合模式。比如 `Chat`（连续对话流）、`Citation`（参考来源标记）和 `Markdown`（长文排版渲染），不用你再从零开始到处拼装零件。

## 和原版的差别

绝大部分组件和原版一一对应。下面是本仓库额外加的、原版没有的能力。它们都默认关闭，或者不影响原有行为。

| 特性 | 入口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 自绘滚动条 | [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/components/scrollbars-provider) | 在应用外层套一层，滚动组件就从原生滚动条换成覆盖式的细滚动条。不套就没有任何变化，也不会多打包任何代码。 |

以后新增扩展能力，会继续加在这张表里。

---

当前所有公开可用的功能，请以仓库实际导出的内容为准。核心样式与组件都遵循原生 Web 标准与现代 Vue 3 规范打造。

body.en:
# Working with AI

An AI writing component code makes two mistakes more than any other: it guesses props, and it copies React idioms from upstream. One instruction file and one command line tool block both.

Two pieces:

- A note in the repo that tells the AI where to look and what not to write.
- A CLI that hands the AI the real props, slots, and examples on demand.

## Step 1: install the CLI

```sh
pnpm add -D @astryx-vue/cli
```

The binary lands in `node_modules/.bin` and is called `astryx-vue`. Without installing, run `npx @astryx-vue/cli …`; the scope is required, because the bare `astryx-vue` name on npm is not this package.

## Step 2: write the instruction file

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue init --features agents
```

This writes a managed note into the project. With no `--agent` it picks the file the project already has, in this order: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`. When none exists it creates `AGENTS.md`.

Which file for which tool:

| Tool | How to write it |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `--agent claude`, writes `CLAUDE.md` |
| Codex, Cursor | `--agent codex` or `--agent cursor`, writes `AGENTS.md` |
| A repo that already has a file | No `--agent`; the existing file is reused |
| Anything else | `--agent-docs-path <file>` names the file |

GitHub Copilot reads `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. The CLI does not write that file by default; point it there with `--agent-docs-path .github/copilot-instructions.md`. Relative paths resolve against the project directory, and a path that lands outside it is refused.

## What goes into the file

The text sits between two markers.

```html
<!-- Maintained by astryx-vue, do not edit manually -->
...
<!-- astryx-vue block end -->
```

Inside the block are four parts.

1. **What the project uses.** astryx-vue is an unofficial Vue 3 community port of Astryx. Components come from `@astryx-vue/core`, themes from `@astryx-vue/themes`. Do not use Meta's React packages, StyleX, or the bare `astryx` command.
2. **A three-step workflow.** Find a template with `build`, copy it with `template`, and look things up with `component`, `composable`, and `docs` before writing code.
3. **How to look things up.** `component --list`, `composable --list`, `docs <topic>`, `search`, and `manifest --json`, plus the `--json`, `--zh`, and `--dense` flags.
4. **How to run it, plus a few conventions.** Subpath imports, peer dependencies, and that the styles do not need UnoCSS.

Run the same command again to refresh. Only the text between the two markers is replaced; project rules you wrote outside them are left alone.

## Let the AI look things up

The instruction file only points the way. The answers live in the CLI. Hand these to the AI, or put them in your project rules.

```sh
# Which components exist
pnpm exec astryx-vue component --list

# One component's usage, props, slots, events, and examples
pnpm exec astryx-vue component Button

# A composable's parameters and return value
pnpm exec astryx-vue composable useClipboard

# One guide or theme topic
pnpm exec astryx-vue docs guide/dark-mode

# Search components, docs, and templates together
pnpm exec astryx-vue search "date picker"
```

Add `--json` when a script or agent reads the output: the reply is a typed envelope, and errors use the same shape with a non-zero exit code. `--dense` shortens the text for humans; `--zh` answers in Simplified Chinese.

Once the AI looks things up before it writes, invented props mostly stop happening.

## Starting from a template beats starting from nothing

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue build "order detail page, list on the left, detail on the right"
pnpm exec astryx-vue template --list
pnpm exec astryx-vue template detail-page ./src/pages
```

`build` scores keywords locally and answers with the closest template, two alternatives, and the components to use. No network, no external model. `template <slug> <dir>` writes `<Name>.vue`, swaps the demo photos for a grey placeholder, and reports which packages the project is still missing.

An existing file is never overwritten; pass `--overwrite` (or `-f`) to replace it.

## Rules worth giving the AI

These lines do more than a page of explanation.

- Run `astryx-vue component <Name>` before writing a component. Do not write props from memory.
- Import from `@astryx-vue/core/<Subpath>` or the package root only. Do not use Meta's `@astryxdesign/*` packages.
- Style with a theme plus `var(--astryx-*)` variables. No hex colors and no pixel values.
- Write padding once, on `Layout` or `AppShell`. Do not add another `div` with padding at each level. See [Page layout](/en/guide/layout).
- When a component's behavior is unclear, find the topic with `astryx-vue docs`. Do not invent an API.

## Next

- Every CLI flag and exit code: [CLI](/en/guide/cli).
- Which files `init` writes and how the markers work: the "Agent file" section of [CLI](/en/guide/cli).
body.zh:
# 配合 AI 写代码

AI 写组件代码时最容易犯两个错：一是猜 props，二是把原版 React 的写法搬过来。两个错都能靠一份说明加一条命令挡掉。

这套东西分两块：

- 一份写进项目的说明文件，让 AI 知道该查哪里、不该写什么。
- 一条命令行工具，让 AI 随时查到真实的 props、插槽和示例。

## 第一步：装命令行

```sh
pnpm add -D @astryx-vue/cli
```

装完命令就在 `node_modules/.bin` 里，名字是 `astryx-vue`。没装也能临时用 `npx @astryx-vue/cli …`，scope 不能省。

## 第二步：生成说明文件

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue init --features agents
```

这条命令会在项目里写一段受管理的说明。默认挑项目已有的那个文件，检测顺序是 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、`.cursorrules`、`.hermes.md`、`HERMES.md`；一个都没有就新建 `AGENTS.md`。

不同工具的落点：

| 工具 | 怎么写 |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `--agent claude`，写 `CLAUDE.md` |
| Codex、Cursor | `--agent codex` 或 `--agent cursor`，写 `AGENTS.md` |
| 已有文件的仓库 | 不加 `--agent`，沿用现有的那个 |
| 其他 | `--agent-docs-path <file>` 指定任意文件 |

GitHub Copilot 读 `.github/copilot-instructions.md`，命令行默认不写这个文件，用 `--agent-docs-path .github/copilot-instructions.md` 指过去就行。相对路径按项目目录解析，指到项目外面会被拒绝。

## 说明文件里写了什么

写进去的内容固定在两个标记之间：

```html
<!-- Maintained by astryx-vue, do not edit manually -->
...
<!-- astryx-vue block end -->
```

标记里面是四块：

1. **项目用的是什么。** astryx-vue 是 Astryx 的非官方 Vue 3 社区实现，组件在 `@astryx-vue/core`，主题在 `@astryx-vue/themes`。不要用 Meta 的 React 包、StyleX，也不要调用裸命令 `astryx`。
2. **三步工作流。** 先用 `build` 找模板，用 `template` 复制出来，写代码前用 `component`、`composable`、`docs` 查用法。
3. **怎么查。** 列出 `component --list`、`composable --list`、`docs <topic>`、`search`、`manifest --json` 这些命令，还有 `--json`、`--zh`、`--dense` 三个参数。
4. **怎么运行，以及几条约定。** 包含子路径导入、peer 依赖、样式不需要 UnoCSS 这几点。

再跑一次同样的命令就是刷新：命令只替换两个标记之间的内容，你在标记外面写的项目规范一个字都不会动。

## 让 AI 自己查

说明文件只是指路，真正的答案在命令行里。下面几条值得直接交给 AI，或者写进你的项目规范。

```sh
# 屏幕上有哪些组件
pnpm exec astryx-vue component --list

# 一个组件的用法、props、插槽、事件和示例
pnpm exec astryx-vue component Button

# 组合式函数的参数和返回值
pnpm exec astryx-vue composable useClipboard

# 一篇指南或主题正文
pnpm exec astryx-vue docs guide/dark-mode

# 跨组件、文档、模板一起搜
pnpm exec astryx-vue search "date picker"
```

给脚本或 agent 读的时候加 `--json`，返回带类型的结构化数据，出错时也走同一套结构并带非零退出码。加 `--dense` 可以拿到更短的文本，加 `--zh` 拿简体中文。

只要 AI 养成「写之前先查一次」的习惯，编造 props 这件事基本就不会发生了。

## 从模板起步比从零写快

```sh
pnpm exec astryx-vue build "订单详情页，左边列表右边详情"
pnpm exec astryx-vue template --list
pnpm exec astryx-vue template detail-page ./src/pages
```

`build` 在本地按关键词打分，给出最接近的模板、两个备选，以及要用的组件，不联网也不调外部模型。`template <slug> <目录>` 会把模板写成 `<Name>.vue`，顺手把演示图片换成灰色占位图，并告诉你项目还缺哪些包。

已存在的文件不会被覆盖，要替换得显式加 `--overwrite`（或 `-f`）。

## 给 AI 的几条规矩

把这几句抄进你的项目说明里，效果比长篇解释好：

- 写组件前先跑 `astryx-vue component <Name>`，不要凭记忆写 props。
- 只从 `@astryx-vue/core/<Subpath>` 或包根导入，不要用 Meta 的 `@astryxdesign/*`。
- 样式用官方主题加 `var(--astryx-*)` 变量，不要写死色号和像素。
- 内边距只写在 `Layout` 或 `AppShell` 上，不要每层再包一个带 padding 的 `div`。见 [页面布局](/guide/layout)。
- 拿不准的组件行为，去 `astryx-vue docs` 找对应主题，不要自己发明 API。

## 接下来

- 命令行的完整参数和退出码：见 [命令行](/guide/cli)。
- `init` 覆盖的文件和标记细节：见 [命令行](/guide/cli) 的「配合 AI Agent」一节。

# Themes

A theme sets the color, type, radius, shadow, and motion the components use. Structural styles stay in `@astryx-vue/core`.

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

Put `data-astryx-theme="neutral"` on the element that should take the theme. On `html`, that is the whole app. On a smaller element, only that subtree. Neutral also writes the same variables on `:root`, so importing `neutral.css` is enough for a single-theme app. The other themes do not touch `:root`.

Figtree and JetBrains Mono load with every theme. Butter, Chocolate, Gothic, Matcha, Stone, and Y2K also load their own text faces.

[Neutral](/en/themes/neutral), [Butter](/en/themes/butter), [Chocolate](/en/themes/chocolate), [Gothic](/en/themes/gothic), [Matcha](/en/themes/matcha), [Stone](/en/themes/stone), and [Y2K](/en/themes/y2k) each have an import snippet. Token names are shared; see [CSS variables](/en/themes/css-variables). How [design tokens](/en/themes/tokens) map onto those variables, and the [color](/en/themes/color), [typography](/en/themes/typography), and [motion](/en/themes/motion) pages, sit next to that. To change one value, read [Extending a theme](/en/themes/extending). To apply a theme object to one subtree, use the [Theme](/en/components/theme), [Media Theme](/en/components/media-theme), and [Syntax Theme](/en/components/syntax-theme) components.

body.en:
# Color

Neutral colors are `--astryx-color-*`. Each one uses `light-dark()` for the light stop and the dark stop. In the grid below, the left chip is light and the right chip is dark. Translucent colors sit on a checkerboard.

The set covers surfaces, text, icons, success, warning, error, and the blue, cyan, gray, green, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, and yellow groups for background, border, icon, and text. `Badge` variants use those names, for example `variant="blue"`.

Chart colors are `--astryx-color-data-*`, 56 of them, with the same names and values as upstream. Categorical colors give one color to each series, for example `--astryx-color-data-categorical-blue`, and the light and dark stops are the same hex. Sequential ramps run from 5 to 1, 5 darkest and 1 lightest, for example `--astryx-color-data-blue-5`. The gray ramp and `--astryx-color-data-neutral` change with the color scheme. The neutral one is for labels and reference lines.

The defaults live once in `@astryx-vue/themes/data.css`, on `:root`, and every theme entry imports that file. A theme's own stylesheet does not repeat them. To recolor a series, set only that variable, on `:root` or inside a theme, and a nested theme keeps whatever its parent set. Code that paints outside CSS, such as a canvas chart, can read the same defaults from `DATA_TOKEN_DEFAULTS` in `@astryx-vue/core/Theme`, or call `useTheme().token('--color-data-categorical-blue')`.

# 颜色

## 颜色是如何组织的？

在 Neutral 主题中，所有颜色变量都统一以 `--astryx-color-*` 开头。

为了让深色模式切换更流畅，每一个颜色变量底层都是通过 CSS 标准的 `light-dark()` 函数定义的。这意味着：
- **浅色与深色合二为一：** 变量内部同时存了浅色模式和深色模式该显示的颜色。
- **无需切换样式表：** 浏览器会根据当前页面或容器的 `color-scheme`（是白天还是黑夜）自动决定展示哪一个颜色，不需要为了深色模式额外打包或动态下载第二份 CSS。

在下方的参考色板中，每个色块左半边展示的是浅色模式效果，右半边展示的是深色模式效果；带有半透明度的颜色底下铺设了棋盘格背景，方便你一眼看清它的透明程度。

## 语义色与状态色

系统中的大部分颜色都具有明确的「语义用途」，而不是冷冰冰的十六进制代码：
- **基础层次：** 背景表面（surface/card）、各级文字（primary/secondary/tertiary）、图标和边框。
- **状态反馈：** 成功（success）、警告（warning）、错误（danger）与信息提示。
- **色彩家族：** 蓝（blue）、青（cyan）、灰（gray）、绿（green）、橙（orange）、粉（pink）、紫（purple）、红（red）、茶（teal）、黄（yellow）。每一组颜色都配齐了对应的浅底背景、边框、图标与文字前景色。例如 `Badge` 徽标组件的 `variant="blue"` 就会成套取用这组蓝色。

## 数据可视化与图表色

图表用的颜色以 `--astryx-color-data-*` 开头，一共 56 个，名字和取值都和原版一样：
- **分类色：** 用于柱状图、饼图等展示不同类别的场景（一条数据系列对应一种颜色，例如 `--astryx-color-data-categorical-blue`）。分类色在明暗模式下保持相同的色值，保证图表辨识度一致。
- **连续色阶：** 针对每种主色提供了 1 到 5 档深浅递进梯度（例如 `--astryx-color-data-blue-5` 到 `blue-1`），5 最深、1 最浅，适合热力图或进度占比。
- **中性灰阶与辅助色：** `--astryx-color-data-neutral` 会随明暗自动变换，专门用来绘制图表的坐标轴标签、网格参考线和说明文字。

这些默认值只放在一个地方：`@astryx-vue/themes/data.css`，写在 `:root` 上。每套主题的入口都会引入它，主题自己的样式表不再重复写一遍。这样做的好处是：

- 想改某一条系列的颜色，只要改那一个变量，写在 `:root` 上或者某个主题里都行。
- 嵌套的主题没写的颜色，会沿用外层的设置，不会被改回默认值。

在 CSS 以外画图的代码（比如 canvas 图表），可以从 `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` 导入 `DATA_TOKEN_DEFAULTS` 读同一组默认值，或者调用 `useTheme().token('--color-data-categorical-blue')`。

## 颜色变量参考

body.en:
# CSS variables

Themes and component styles use CSS variables and cascade layers. You do not install UnoCSS or StyleX to use them.

`packages/themes/neutral/base.css` declares the layer order:

```css
@layer astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides;
```

Semantic tokens sit in `astryx.tokens`. Structural component styles sit in `astryx.components` and come from `@astryx-vue/core`. Application overrides belong in the last layer, `astryx.overrides`. Unlayered styles, and later layers, both beat earlier layers.

Names follow the upstream tokens and add `--astryx-`. The primary text color is `--astryx-color-text-primary`. Colors are written as:

```css
--astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#171717, #fafafa);
```

`light-dark()` reads the element's `color-scheme`. Neutral sets `color-scheme: light dark` on `:root` and `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']`, so the result follows the system or whatever the docs site already set. Forcing one side is described in [Dark mode](/en/guide/dark-mode). [`Theme`](/en/components/theme) can set the same variables on one subtree.

Components also have their own variables, such as `--astryx-button-primary-background`. Those names are defined in `packages/themes/neutral/<component>.css` and usually point at a semantic token. Prefer overriding the semantic token. Override the component variable only when that component has to diverge.

## Scrollbar variables

With a [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/en/components/scrollbars-provider) in place, these variables control how the scrollbar looks. They all have defaults that follow the theme tokens, so changing them is optional.

| Variable | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-size` | `10px` | Scrollbar thickness |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-thumb` | Secondary text color at 45% | Thumb color |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-thumb-hover` | Secondary text color at 70% | Thumb color on hover and drag |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-track` | `transparent` | Track background |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-radius` | `9999px` | Corner radius of track and thumb |

You can set them on any ancestor, and they only affect scrollbars inside it. See the [component page](/en/components/scrollbars-provider) for details and examples.

`@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` is a single declaration, `@layer astryx.reset`. It is not a browser reset. Import it only when you need that layer to exist first.

Load every structural sheet at once with:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

Importing a component from a subpath such as `@astryx-vue/core/Button` loads that component's structural sheet. The theme is still a separate import. See [Theme and styles](/en/guide/styling).
body.zh:
# CSS 变量与样式分层

astryx-vue 的所有主题和组件样式，完全基于现代 CSS 标准规范构建（采用 CSS 变量与 `@layer` 级联层）。这意味着你的项目不需要安装 UnoCSS、Tailwind CSS，也不需要安装 StyleX 编译器，就能原生获得清晰可控的样式优先级。

## 样式的五个层级（@layer）

为了防止自定义样式和组件内置样式“打架”，我们在 `packages/themes/neutral/base.css` 开头预先规定了五个样式的加载顺序：

```css
@layer astryx.reset, astryx.tokens, astryx.base, astryx.components, astryx.overrides;
```

从左到右，优先级依次由低到高递增：

1. **`astryx.reset`（重置层）：** 最底层的基准样式。
2. **`astryx.tokens`（设计令牌层）：** 定义通用的颜色、字号、圆角和间距等 CSS 变量。
3. **`astryx.base`（全局基础层）：** 网页的基础排版和通用样式规则。
4. **`astryx.components`（组件结构层）：** `@astryx-vue/core` 中所有组件的基础结构、布局与默认外观。
5. **`astryx.overrides`（用户覆盖层）：** 留给你在项目中写业务自定义样式的地方。排在最右侧，保证你写的样式能够稳稳压过前面所有默认样式。

**规则很直观：** 排在更靠后层级的样式，会自动覆盖排在前面的层级；而在 `@layer` 之外手写的未分层普通 CSS，优先级比所有分层样式都高。

## 变量命名与双模配色

所有通用设计变量的命名直接对应 Astryx 原始规范，并统一带上 `--astryx-` 前缀。

例如，文本主色的变量名就是 `--astryx-color-text-primary`。它的值定义如下：

```css
--astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#171717, #fafafa);
```

`light-dark()` 函数会根据当前元素的 `color-scheme` 属性自动在浅色（第一个值）和深色（第二个值）之间切换。Neutral 主题在 `:root` 和 `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']` 上声明了 `color-scheme: light dark`，因此默认能够自动跟随操作系统或文档站的明暗开关变化。如果需要强制某一侧，请参阅 [深色模式配置指南](/guide/dark-mode)。

## 组件专用变量 vs 全局语义变量

除了全局的 `--astryx-color-*` 这类语义变量，部分组件还拥有自己的细分变量（例如按钮的背景色 `--astryx-button-primary-background`）：

- **平时换外观：** 强烈建议优先修改全局语义变量（如改变文字主色、基础圆角），这样整个系统的所有组件都能整齐划一地改变。
- **个别组件特殊定制：** 只有当你只想让某个组件“特立独行”时，才去针对性地覆盖它自己的专用变量。

## 滚动条变量

套了 [`ScrollbarsProvider`](/components/scrollbars-provider) 后，滚动条的外观由下面这几个变量控制。它们都有默认值，并且跟着主题 token 走，改不改都行。

| 变量 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-size` | `10px` | 滚动条粗细 |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-thumb` | 次要文字色 45% | 滑块颜色 |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-thumb-hover` | 次要文字色 70% | 悬停和拖动时的滑块颜色 |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-track` | `transparent` | 轨道背景 |
| `--astryx-scrollbar-radius` | `9999px` | 轨道和滑块圆角 |

这些变量可以写在任何祖先元素上，只影响它里面的滚动条。完整说明和示例见 [组件页](/components/scrollbars-provider)。

## 如何引入样式

### 方式一：按需引入（推荐）

当你从组件子路径（例如 `@astryx-vue/core/Button`）引入单个组件时，该组件所需的骨架样式会自动打包并加载进来。你只需要在应用根入口引入一次主题样式文件即可：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

### 方式二：一次性引入全部组件结构样式

如果你希望一次性把所有组件的结构样式都准备好，可以显式引入全局包样式：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

更多细节请查阅 [主题与样式使用指南](/guide/styling)。

body.en:
# Extending a theme

`@astryx-vue/themes` ships Neutral, Butter, Chocolate, Gothic, Matcha, Stone, and Y2K. Each one is a CSS entry such as `butter.css` plus the stylesheets in that theme's directory. There is no runtime theme registry.

## Override variables

Change the look by overriding CSS variables. Put the override in the `astryx.overrides` layer so it beats the token layer without rewriting structural styles:

```css
@layer astryx.overrides {
  :root {
    --astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#1a1a1a, #f5f5f5);
    --astryx-radius-element: 0.5rem;
  }
}
```

Load that sheet after the theme CSS, for example `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`.

Every theme selects `[data-astryx-theme='…']`. Neutral also selects `:root`, so importing `neutral.css` applies it globally. The other themes stay on the attribute.

When one component has to diverge, override the variable from that theme's component file, for example `--astryx-button-primary-background` in `packages/themes/neutral/button.css`. Use the names in that file.

Do not keep a separate dark palette. Colors are already `light-dark()`. Switching is described in [Dark mode](/en/guide/dark-mode).

## Build a theme in Vue

To change one subtree, wrap it in [`Theme`](/en/components/theme) and pass a `defineTheme()` object. `color`, `typography`, `radius`, and `motion` generate a token set from a few numbers. The seven shipped themes stay handwritten CSS.

```ts
import { defineTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'

const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  // One hex, or a light seed and a dark seed.
  color: { accent: ['#0064E0', '#48CAE4'] },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  // Values only this theme family uses. Names stay as written.
  localTokens: { '--brand-ink': ['#0A2540', '#E6F0FF'] },
  components: {
    'button': { 'variant:primary': { borderRadius: '999px' } },
    'card-header': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
  },
  // Larger body text on touch screens narrower than the lg breakpoint.
  adaptations: {
    rules: [{
      when: { pointer: 'coarse', width: { below: 'lg' } },
      value: { typography: { scale: { base: 16, ratio: 1.1736 } } },
    }],
  },
})
```

### Overriding theme tokens

`Theme` writes its tokens into a `<style>` that sits inside the wrapper element. The rule selector is `:scope.astryx-theme`, which weighs as much as two classes, and that `<style>` comes later in the document than your stylesheets. So a plain rule on the wrapper loses when it sits inside `@layer astryx.overrides` and names fewer than three classes. Pick one of these:

- Put the override in CSS that is not inside any `@layer`. Unlayered styles beat every layered style, so this always wins. It is the simplest choice.
- Inside `@layer astryx.overrides`, stack at least three classes on the wrapper (`.wrapper.wrapper.wrapper`), or wrap the `Theme` in your own element with an id and select through it (`#brand .wrapper`). `Theme` does not put an `id` on its wrapper, so `#id` alone does not match it.

The same holds for adapted tokens, with or without a matching condition. A value passed in the wrapper's own `style` attribute also wins.

Theme names must be unique. Two `Theme` components with the same `name` share one set of rules. If their values differ, the one that renders later wins for both. Give different themes different names.

### Theme targets

Keys under `components` are theme targets, named `<component-kebab>-<part>`: `button`, `card-header`, `radio-indicator`, `progress-bar-fill`. Each target is a stable `astryx-*` class on one element. Style keys under a target match the attributes that element reflects: `variant:primary` matches `[data-variant="primary"]`, a state such as `checked` matches `[data-checked="checked"]`, and `+` joins two keys.

Run-together and camelCase names are not targets. `defineTheme()` throws for `buttonIcon` or `Card`, and a run-together name such as `progressbar` matches nothing. Upstream removed these spellings in 0.7.0; this package follows. The old names and their replacements:

| Removed | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`, `codeblock-copy-button`, `codeblock-header`, `codeblock-title` | `code-block`, `code-block-copy-button`, `code-block-header`, `code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`, `date-range-input-clear-icon`, `multi-selector-clear-icon`, `selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`, `progressbar-fill`, `progressbar-mark`, `progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`, `progress-bar-fill`, `progress-bar-mark`, `progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`, `radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`, `radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

Components also do not render bare value classes such as `.primary` or `.sm`. A selector like `.astryx-button.primary` in your own CSS becomes `.astryx-button[data-variant="primary"]`.

A `:hover` style applies to the enabled control only. Disabled and `aria-disabled` elements skip it. For `card`, `dialog`, `bottom-sheet`, `dropdown-menu`, `context-menu`, and `segmented-control`, a themed `borderRadius` or `padding` also reaches the inner parts that follow it, such as a card's header corners. On `chat` a themed `borderRadius` and `padding` land on the composer, and on `progress-bar-mark` a themed `width` and `height` land on the tick itself.

### Local tokens

`localTokens` holds values only one theme family uses, keyed by their full custom-property name. The name is kept exactly as written; no prefix is added. A shared token name such as `--color-accent` is refused here, because components already read it. A theme that extends this one inherits the local tokens and may change their values. A reference loop among them is an error.

### Adaptations

`adaptations.rules` is an ordered list of `{ when, value }`. `when` can hold a width range by named breakpoint (`sm` 640, `md` 768, `lg` 1024, `xl` 1280, `2xl` 1536 CSS px; change them with `widthBreakpoints`), a `pointer` of `coarse` or `fine`, a `contrast` preference, and a reduced-`motion` preference. Every field in one `when` must match. `value` can set the same things a theme does. A partial type scale, radius, or motion is completed from the theme's own config. Rules apply after the theme, in order, so a later matching rule wins. They apply through CSS only: `useTheme().token()` keeps returning the theme's root values. An adapted token sits after the root tokens with the same selector, so while its condition matches it wins by cascade order; no `!important` is involved. To override an adapted token, follow the rules in [Overriding theme tokens](#overriding-theme-tokens).

### `extends`

`extends` starts from everything another theme resolved to: tokens, local tokens, component styles, `onDark` and `onLight`, adaptations, icons, and indicators. The new theme's own values win. Inherited adaptation rules are worked out again against the new theme's scale.

### Bad values

A token or style value that would end its CSS declaration early, such as `red; } body { display: none`, is dropped with a console warning. The rest of the theme still applies. Valid CSS that only looks unusual, such as a `;` inside a quoted string or a data URL, is kept.

## Tailwind

This package does not ship a Tailwind bridge. Styles are plain CSS variables and `@layer`, so a Tailwind or UnoCSS project can read them directly, for example `bg-[var(--astryx-color-background-surface)]`, or map them in its own theme config.
body.zh:
# 扩展与自定义主题

`@astryx-vue/themes` 开箱自带了 7 套主题：Neutral（中性默认）、Butter（黄油暖金）、Chocolate（巧克力暖棕）、Gothic（哥特深邃）、Matcha（抹茶淡绿）、Stone（石石板岩）与 Y2K（复古千禧）。

每一套主题本质上都是一个已经写好的 CSS 文件（例如 `butter.css`）。包内不包含复杂的运行时主题注册或状态管理逻辑，因此运行性能极高、对打包工具完全透明。

## 场景一：只修改个别变量（最常用的做法）

如果你只想微调某个颜色或把所有圆角稍微改大一点，只需要在你的项目样式里覆盖对应的 CSS 变量即可。

**推荐做法：** 将覆盖代码写在 `@layer astryx.overrides` 里面，这样既能稳定覆盖默认主题，又绝对不会破坏组件原有的布局骨架：

```css
/* 确保这段样式在引入 @astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css 之后加载 */
@layer astryx.overrides {
  :root {
    /* 把主文本色调深一点 */
    --astryx-color-text-primary: light-dark(#1a1a1a, #f5f5f5);
    /* 把全站组件的基础圆角改成 8px */
    --astryx-radius-element: 0.5rem;
  }
}
```

## 场景二：在页面局部区域套用计算主题

如果不是全站修改，而是希望某个特定的弹窗、侧边栏或卡片拥有一套独立生成的品牌色，可以使用 Vue 组件 [`Theme`](/components/theme)，搭配 `defineTheme()` 工具函数。`color`、`typography`、`radius`、`motion` 这几项只要给几个数，就能算出一整套变量：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'

const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  // 一个颜色；也可以写 [浅色种子, 深色种子]，深浅两套各自从自己的种子算
  color: { accent: ['#0064E0', '#48CAE4'] },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  radius: { base: 4, multiplier: 1.5 },
})
</script>

<template>
  <!-- 外部维持默认主题 -->
  <Button label="默认风格按钮" />

  <!-- 局部子树应用新主题 -->
  <Theme :theme="brand">
    <Button variant="primary" label="品牌风格按钮" />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

`Theme` 会把这组 CSS 变量写到子树的根节点上，并且会重新绑定文字、按钮等别名，防止它们停留在外层已经算好的颜色上。

### 覆盖主题的变量

`Theme` 会把变量写进外层元素里面的一个 `<style>` 里。这条规则的选择器是 `:scope.astryx-theme`，权重相当于两个 class，而且这个 `<style>` 在文档里排在你的样式表后面。所以，如果你的覆盖写在 `@layer astryx.overrides` 里，只用一个或两个 class 去选外层元素，是压不过它的。可以这样选：

- 把覆盖写在没放进任何 `@layer` 的普通样式里。不分层的样式总是赢过分层里的，所以一定能赢。这是最省事的办法。
- 如果一定要写在 `@layer astryx.overrides` 里，可以在外层元素上叠至少 3 个 class（`.wrapper.wrapper.wrapper`）；也可以在 `Theme` 外面自己再包一个带 id 的元素，用 `#brand .wrapper` 这样的写法去选。`Theme` 不会把 `id` 写到它的外层元素上，所以单写 `#id` 是选不中的。

适配出来的变量也一样，不管条件有没有成立。直接写在外层元素 `style` 属性里的值同样会赢。

主题名要唯一。两个 `name` 相同的 `Theme` 共用一份样式。如果它们的值不一样，后渲染的那个会对两边都生效。不同的主题请起不同的名字。

## 场景三：只让某个组件与众不同

### 用 `components` 给组件的某个部位换样式

`components` 里的每个键叫「换肤挂点」（theme target），写法是 `组件名-部位`，全部小写、用短横线连起来，例如 `button`、`card-header`、`radio-indicator`、`progress-bar-fill`。每个挂点就是元素上一个固定的 `astryx-*` 类名。

挂点下面的键用来挑选状态：

- `base`：这个部位本身。
- `variant:primary`：`variant` 等于 `primary` 的时候，对应元素上的 `[data-variant="primary"]`。
- `checked` 这种单个词：对应 `[data-checked="checked"]`。
- 用 `+` 把两个条件连起来，两个都满足才生效。

```ts
const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    'button': { 'variant:primary': { borderRadius: '999px' } },
    'card-header': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
  },
})
```

几点细节：

- `:hover` 只对能点的控件生效，禁用的按钮不会因为鼠标悬停而变色。
- `card`、`dialog`、`bottom-sheet`、`dropdown-menu`、`context-menu`、`segmented-control` 这几个组件，主题里改了 `borderRadius` 或 `padding`，里面跟着它走的部位也会一起变，比如卡片头部的圆角。`chat` 的 `borderRadius` 和 `padding` 会写到输入区的圆角和内边距上，`progress-bar-mark` 的 `width` 和 `height` 会写到那根刻度线上。

### 旧写法已经不再支持

上游在 0.7.0 删掉了一批旧名字，我们也跟着删了。驼峰写法（比如 `buttonIcon`）或者大写开头（比如 `Card`）会直接报错；连在一起的旧名（比如 `progressbar`）不会报错，但什么都匹配不到。请改成右边的新名字：

| 已删除 | 请改用 |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`、`codeblock-copy-button`、`codeblock-header`、`codeblock-title` | `code-block`、`code-block-copy-button`、`code-block-header`、`code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`、`date-range-input-clear-icon`、`multi-selector-clear-icon`、`selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`、`progressbar-fill`、`progressbar-mark`、`progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`、`progress-bar-fill`、`progress-bar-mark`、`progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`、`radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`、`radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

组件也不再输出 `.primary`、`.sm` 这种光秃秃的类名。你自己的 CSS 里如果写了 `.astryx-button.primary`，请改成 `.astryx-button[data-variant="primary"]`。

### 直接覆盖组件变量

如果你只想覆盖单个组件的颜色，也可以直接改它的专属变量。例如 `packages/themes/neutral/button.css` 里，按钮背景对应的是 `--astryx-button-primary-background`：

```css
@layer astryx.overrides {
  .special-container {
    --astryx-button-primary-background: light-dark(#4338ca, #6366f1);
  }
}
```

## 进阶：主题自己的变量、环境适配和继承

### 主题局部变量 `localTokens`

有些值只有你这一套主题用得上，比如品牌的墨水色。把它放进 `localTokens`，键就是完整的 CSS 变量名，原样保存，不会加前缀：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  localTokens: { '--brand-ink': ['#0A2540', '#E6F0FF'] },
  components: { 'card-header': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } } },
})
```

不能拿共享的名字（比如 `--color-accent`）来当局部变量，因为组件已经在读它了。继承这套主题的子主题会一起继承局部变量，也可以改它们的值。局部变量之间不能互相引用成一个圈，否则会报错。

### 按环境调整 `adaptations`

有时候只想在某些环境下换一组值，比如「手机这类触屏、而且屏幕比较窄的时候，正文字号放大一点」。`adaptations.rules` 是一串按顺序排好的规则，每条写成 `{ when, value }`：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  adaptations: {
    rules: [{
      when: { pointer: 'coarse', width: { below: 'lg' } },
      value: { typography: { scale: { base: 16, ratio: 1.1736 } } },
    }],
  },
})
```

- `when` 可以写屏幕宽度范围（用断点名：`sm` 640、`md` 768、`lg` 1024、`xl` 1280、`2xl` 1536，单位都是 CSS 像素，可以用 `widthBreakpoints` 改）、`pointer`（`coarse` 粗指针，也就是手指；`fine` 细指针，也就是鼠标）、`contrast`（对比度偏好）、`motion`（是否减弱动效）。同一条 `when` 里写的条件要全部满足。
- `value` 能写的东西和主题本身一样。只写了一半的字号阶梯、圆角或动效，缺的部分会从主题自己的设置里补上。
- 规则按顺序在主题之后生效，同时满足好几条时，后面的赢。
- 这些规则只通过 CSS 生效，`useTheme().token()` 读到的始终是主题本身的值。
- 规则里的变量排在根 token 后面，选择器和根 token 一样，所以条件成立时按层叠顺序盖过根值，没有用 `!important`。想覆盖它，请看下面的「覆盖主题的变量」。

### 继承 `extends`

`extends` 会把另一套主题算好的东西全部带过来：变量、局部变量、组件样式、`onDark` 和 `onLight`、环境规则、图标和指示器。新主题自己写的值优先。继承来的环境规则会按新主题的字号阶梯重新算一遍。

### 写错的值会被丢掉

如果某个值会提前结束这条 CSS 声明，比如 `red; } body { display: none`，它会被丢掉，控制台里会有一条警告，主题里其他的值照常生效。看起来奇怪但其实合法的 CSS，比如引号里的分号、data URL，会原样保留。

## 注意事项

1. **不需要另外准备深浅两套样式表：** 因为变量本身采用 `light-dark()` 机制，覆盖时也推荐同时写下浅色和深色两个取值。
2. **多主题隔离：** 预设主题除了 Neutral 会同时挂在 `:root` 上，其他 6 套都是通过属性选择器 `[data-astryx-theme='...']` 局部隔离的，多主题并存时互不干扰。关于明暗切换的完整细节，请参阅 [深色模式配置](/guide/dark-mode)。
3. **Tailwind：** 本包不提供 Tailwind 桥接文件。样式本身就是普通的 CSS 变量和 `@layer`，Tailwind 或 UnoCSS 项目可以直接写 `bg-[var(--astryx-color-background-surface)]`，或者在自己的主题配置里做映射。

# Motion

Durations come from the Neutral motion scale. The bases are fast 125, medium 300, and slow 700. Neighbors use a 0.75 ratio, and the results are rounded to 5 milliseconds. There is one easing token, `--astryx-ease-standard`: `cubic-bezier(0.24, 1, 0.4, 1)`.

Shared enter and exit keyframes live in `@astryx-vue/core` at `styles/motion.css`. They are available when you import `@astryx-vue/core/styles.css`, or any component sheet that pulls that file in. Existing components still use their own animation names, and these shared utility classes provide reusable motion primitives:

| Class | Keyframes |
| --- | --- |
| `astryx-motion-fade-in` / `fade-out` | `astryx-fade-in` / `astryx-fade-out` |
| `astryx-motion-scale-in` / `scale-out` | `astryx-scale-in` / `astryx-scale-out` |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-above` / `out` | from above |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-below` / `out` | from below |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-start` / `out` | from the start side |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-end` / `out` | from the end side |

Distance and scale read `--astryx-motion-offset`, `--astryx-motion-scale-from`, and the opacity variables. When the system asks for reduced motion, those distances and the scale collapse to zero, opacity jumps to the end state, and the shared classes use a duration of `0.01ms`. Component duration tokens are left alone.

Replay the samples below. With reduced motion on, they sit at the end state.

# 动画与过渡

界面的动效就像演员走位时的节奏感：太快了显得生硬突兀，太慢了又让人觉得卡顿拖沓。astryx-vue 的动效体系沿袭了 Astryx 的标准规范，旨在提供干脆、克制且符合物理规律的交互体验。

## 动画时长梯级（Duration）

动画时长基于 Neutral 预设的运动刻度计算而成。系统划定了三个基础参考档位：
- **快速交互（fast）：** `125ms`，适合开关、复选框点击、图标翻转等微小的即时反馈。
- **常规操作（medium）：** `300ms`，适合下拉菜单展开、卡片悬浮浮起等大多数界面过渡。
- **大型进出场（slow）：** `700ms`，适合大型全屏抽屉、模态弹窗的推入推出。

相邻档位之间按照约 0.75 的步长递增或递减，最终结果四舍五入精确到 5 毫秒，避免出现不规则的零碎时间。

## 缓动曲线（Easing）

整套设计系统只保留了一条最核心的标准缓动曲线：
- **`--astryx-ease-standard`**：数值为 `cubic-bezier(0.24, 1, 0.4, 1)`。

这是一条具有减速特征的曲线：起步迅速，在接近终点时平滑减速落定。

## 共享进出场关键帧

在 `@astryx-vue/core` 的 `styles/motion.css` 中，我们预制了一组通用的进入与退出 CSS 类名。只要你的项目引入了 `@astryx-vue/core/styles.css` 或者使用了带样式的组件，就可以在任何你自己的 HTML 元素或 Vue 过渡（`<Transition>`）中直接复用它们：

| 进场类名 / 出场类名 | 动画视觉效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `astryx-motion-fade-in` / `astryx-motion-fade-out` | 纯淡入 / 纯淡出 |
| `astryx-motion-scale-in` / `astryx-motion-scale-out` | 缩放轻微放大进场 / 缩小退场 |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-above` / `out` | 从上方轻微滑入 / 向上滑出 |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-below` / `out` | 从下方轻微滑入 / 向下滑出 |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-start` / `out` | 从行起始侧（默认左侧）滑入 / 滑出 |
| `astryx-motion-slide-in-end` / `out` | 从行结束侧（默认右侧）滑入 / 滑出 |

位移距离和缩放比例分别由 `--astryx-motion-offset` 与 `--astryx-motion-scale-from` 变量控制。

## 关爱易眩晕用户：无障碍减少动效支持

如果用户在操作系统的辅助功能中开启了「减少动态效果（prefers-reduced-motion: reduce）」，astryx-vue 会自动做出安全响应：
- 所有位移距离和缩放比例自动归零。
- 透明度直接瞬间跳到最终可见状态。
- 通用共享类的过渡时间自动缩短为极微小的 `0.01ms`，彻底避免画面大幅晃动对晕动症或光敏感用户造成身体不适。

**注意：** 为了保证关键交互状态不发生破坏性错位，组件自身特定的内部时长 token 保持原值，无障碍规则主要通过限制大幅位移与缩放来保障体验。

body.en:
# Neutral

Neutral is the theme `@astryx-vue/themes` ships today. Load it with:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

That entry loads `fonts.css`, then each file under `neutral/` in name order, including `base.css`. `fonts.css` loads Figtree and JetBrains Mono at 400, 500, 600, 700, and 400 italic. Figtree also includes 600 italic. Those are the faces `font-synthesis: none` can use. The browser does not invent a missing weight or italic.

`--astryx-font-family-body` and `--astryx-font-family-heading` name Figtree first, then `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `Segoe UI`, `Roboto`, `Helvetica`, `Arial`, and `sans-serif`. `--astryx-font-family-code` follows upstream and names the platform monospace stack first: `ui-monospace`, `SF Mono`, `Monaco`, `Consolas`, `Liberation Mono`, `Courier New`, and `monospace`.

Override those three variables to use your own fonts. You can also skip the bundled `fonts.css` and load Figtree yourself, for example with `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` in the document head.

Semantic tokens live in `packages/themes/neutral/base.css`. Names follow upstream `tokens.stylex.ts` and add an `--astryx-` prefix. Each token writes its light and dark stops with `light-dark()`. A value comes from the Neutral theme when that theme overrides it, and from the upstream default otherwise.

Every color, radius, and shadow matches upstream v0.7.1 `neutralTheme.ts`. Palettes come from the approved grey, text, icon, border, background, status, and categorical stops. `--astryx-radius-none` is `0px` and the light stop of `--astryx-color-text-secondary` is `#474747`, as upstream ships them.

Component colors reference the semantic variables instead of repeating hex values. `--astryx-badge-info-background` points at the approved status fill, for example, so changing one semantic variable updates every component that reads it.

The variables sit on `:root` and `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']`, with `color-scheme: light dark`. Light and dark follow the element's `color-scheme`. Force one side with `data-astryx-color-mode="light"` or `"dark"` on an ancestor. See [Dark mode](/en/guide/dark-mode).

On a touch device (coarse pointer) narrower than the `lg` breakpoint (1024px), the body size floor rises from 14px to 16px and the type ratio changes from 1.2 to 1.1736. Body text stays readable and Display 1 keeps its desktop 42px. Desktop sizes do not change.

# Neutral（中性默认主题）

Neutral 是 astryx-vue 的默认主题。它的基调是中性黑白灰，适用于各类企业级后台、中台系统和工具型网页。

## 引入方式

只需在你的前端入口文件（如 `main.ts`）中加入这行引入：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

这一行代码会完成这几件事：
1. **自动加载字体资源：** 加载西文字体 Figtree 与等宽代码字体 JetBrains Mono（包含 400 常规、500 中粗、600 半粗、700 加粗以及 400/600 斜体）。因为声明了 `font-synthesis: none`，所以系统严格使用真实设计的字重，不会让浏览器去硬拉变形生成伪粗体或伪斜体。
2. **引入所有组件主题样式：** 依次加载 `neutral/` 目录下的所有样式，包括全局基准 `base.css`。
3. **注入全局根节点：** 会自动将基础变量挂载在 `:root` 和 `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']` 上，因此无需任何额外配置，引入即全站生效。

## 字体回退栈（Font Stack）

- **正文与标题（Body & Heading）：**
  `--astryx-font-family-body` 和 `--astryx-font-family-heading` 优先使用 Figtree，随后按系统习惯回退：
  `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`。
- **等宽代码（Code）：**
  `--astryx-font-family-code` 和原版一样优先用系统等宽字体：
  `ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace`。

想换成自己的字体，覆盖上面三个变量即可；也可以不引入内置的 `fonts.css`，改用 Google Fonts 加载 Figtree，例如在 `<head>` 里放 `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">`。

## 和原版设计保持一致

Neutral 的每一个颜色、圆角和阴影值都和上游 v0.7.1 的 `neutralTheme.ts` 一致：

- **色板：** 灰阶、文字、图标、边框、背景、状态色和十种分类色都取自上游审定色板（`neutralPaletteRefs.generated.ts`）。
- **直角定义 `--astryx-radius-none`：** 和上游一样是 `0px`，方形头像和骨架屏保持直角。
- **辅助文本色 `--astryx-color-text-secondary`：** 浅色 `#474747`、深色 `#9e9e9e`，与上游一致。

组件级配色不再各写一份十六进制值，而是引用语义变量（例如 `--astryx-badge-info-background` 指向上游审定的状态色）。改一个语义变量，用到它的组件会一起更新。

## 手机上字号更大

在触屏设备（粗指针）且视口窄于 `lg` 断点（1024px）时，正文字号基准从 14px 提升到 16px，字阶比例从 1.2 调整为 1.1736。这样正文够大好读，而 Display 1 仍保持桌面端的 42px。桌面端字号不受影响。

## 明暗深色模式

Neutral 在定义时就声明了 `color-scheme: light dark`。因此只要你使用 `light-dark()` 变量，它会自动跟随操作系统或文档站当前的外观切换。

如果你需要在页面的某一个特定区域固定显示深色或浅色，只需在父容器元素上添加属性 `data-astryx-color-mode="light"` 或 `"dark"`。具体说明请参阅 [深色模式指南](/guide/dark-mode)。

# Space, radius, and shadow

Spacing runs from `--astryx-spacing-0` through `--astryx-spacing-12`, with `0.5` and `1.5` in between. The values are rem: `--astryx-spacing-2` is `0.5rem` and `--astryx-spacing-4` is `1rem`. At the browser's default 16px root font size each step is 4px times the step, so `--astryx-spacing-2` is 8px. When a reader raises the browser font size, or a page sets `html { font-size }`, gaps and padding grow with the text in the same ratio. At a 20px root, `--astryx-spacing-4` is 20px instead of 16px.

These tokens used to be fixed px. Nothing looks different at the default root. A custom theme that writes spacing in px keeps fixed px; write rem to follow the root font size.

Control heights are `--astryx-size-element-sm` (28px), `md` (32px), and `lg` (36px). They stay px.

Radii run from `--astryx-radius-none` to `--astryx-radius-full`. `--astryx-radius-none` stays `0` in this package. It does not adopt upstream Neutral's `0.25rem`. `--astryx-radius-chat` is 28px. Neutral does not override it. At a 16px root that equals the `1.75rem` page radius.

Shadows have three elevations, `low`, `med`, and `high`, plus inset shadows for hover, selected, success, warning, and error. The outer shadows use offset and blur, and the light and dark stops differ.

The focus ring uses `--astryx-focus-outline-width`, `style`, `color`, and `offset`. The color follows `--astryx-color-accent`.

# 间距、圆角与阴影

做界面就像搭积木，间距、圆角和阴影是保证整个网页视觉呼吸感和层次感的“度量衡”。astryx-vue 将这些基础尺度做成了规整的标尺，让不同组件拼在一起时浑然一体。

## 间距标尺（Spacing）

间距变量从 `--astryx-spacing-0` 到 `--astryx-spacing-12`：
- **单位是 rem：** 例如 `--astryx-spacing-2` 是 `0.5rem`，`--astryx-spacing-4` 是 `1rem`。rem 的意思是「根字号的几倍」。
- **默认看起来和以前一样：** 浏览器默认根字号是 16px，这时每一档都是 4px 乘档位，比如 spacing-1 是 4px，spacing-2 是 8px，spacing-4 是 16px。
- **会跟着字号一起变大：** 读者在浏览器里把默认字号调大，或者页面写了 `html { font-size }`，组件之间的间距和内边距会按同样的比例放大。比如根字号改成 20px，`--astryx-spacing-4` 就从 16px 变成 20px，文字变大以后不会挤在一起。
- **微调档：** 为了照顾紧凑布局中的微小缝隙，特别补充了 `0.5`（默认 2px）和 `1.5`（默认 6px）两个中间档位。

以前这组变量写死成 px。默认根字号下外观没有变化。自定义主题如果自己用 px 写间距，那几档仍然固定不变；想让它们跟随根字号，就改写成 rem。

## 交互控件高度（Size）

常用的表单输入框、按钮等可点击交互控件，统一划分为三个标准高度尺寸（这几档仍是 px）：
- **小尺寸（sm）：** `--astryx-size-element-sm` 为 `28px`，适合紧凑工具栏或密集数据表格。
- **中尺寸（md）：** `--astryx-size-element-md` 为 `32px`，绝大多数页面的默认尺寸。
- **大尺寸（lg）：** `--astryx-size-element-lg` 为 `36px`，适合宽敞表单或重要操作界面。

## 圆角系统（Radius）

圆角范围从纯直角 `--astryx-radius-none` 一路延伸到胶囊全圆角 `--astryx-radius-full`：
- **纯直角（none）：** 在本库中保持严格的 `0px`（不采用原版 Neutral 将其设为 4px 的做法），用于方形头像或纯矩形结构。
- **容器与卡片圆角：** 包含针对元素与容器的一组平滑梯度。
- **聊天对话泡专属圆角：** `--astryx-radius-chat` 为 `28px`（在默认 16px 根字号下相当于 `1.75rem`），专门用来呈现饱满圆润的现代 AI 对话气泡。

## 阴影与景深（Shadow）

阴影用来在平面屏幕上建立上下层级的纵深感：
- **外阴影（Drop Shadow）：** 包含 `low`（低投影，微弱浮起）、`med`（中投影，常用卡片与下拉菜单）、`high`（高投影，模态弹窗与大浮层）三档。针对深色和浅色模式，外阴影的透明度与弥散范围做了精细适配，深色模式下不会显得突兀发灰。
- **内阴影（Inner Shadow）：** 包含悬停（hover）、选中（active/selected）、成功（success）、警告（warning）和错误（danger）五种内凹或状态投影。

## 键盘焦点环（Focus Outline）

为了保证良好的无障碍键盘导航体验，系统通过四个变量规范了组件被 Tab 键聚焦时的视觉光环：
- `--astryx-focus-outline-width`：描边宽度。
- `--astryx-focus-outline-style`：描边线型（通常为实线 solid）。
- `--astryx-focus-outline-color`：颜色跟随强调色 `--astryx-color-accent`，明亮显眼。
- `--astryx-focus-outline-offset`：焦点环距离控件边缘的外扩间隙，保证描边不紧贴文字或边框。

## 标尺尺寸与视觉参考

body.en:
# Design tokens

A design token is a decision the system can reuse: a color, a space step, a radius, a duration. Components read tokens instead of hard-coding those numbers. Changing theme means changing the numbers.

astryx-vue follows upstream Astryx `tokens.stylex.ts` and `dataTokens.stylex.ts`. The public form is a CSS variable, not a StyleX object. Names and values match upstream, with one difference: every semantic token here has an `--astryx-` prefix, so upstream's `--spacing-4` is `--astryx-spacing-4` here. The prefix stays because existing custom themes already use these names. `defineTheme()` accepts either spelling. Color tokens use `light-dark()` so both schemes live in one declaration.

Where a value comes from:

1. If Neutral overrides it, that override is used.
2. If Neutral does not override it, the upstream default is used.
3. If a component theme file declares the same name again, the later declaration wins. Style extensions should target the semantic layer.

The token name is the stable interface. The current numbers live in `packages/themes/neutral/base.css`, and the chart colors in `packages/themes/data.css`. The swatches and bars in these docs are parsed from those files. There is no second list to keep in sync.

| Page | Variables |
| --- | --- |
| [Color](/en/themes/color) | `--astryx-color-*`, including `--astryx-color-data-*` for chart categories and sequential ramps |
| [Typography](/en/themes/typography) | `--astryx-font-*`, `--astryx-text-*` |
| [Motion](/en/themes/motion) | `--astryx-duration-*`, `--astryx-ease-*`, and the shared keyframes |
| [Space, radius, shadow](/en/themes/scale) | `--astryx-spacing-*`, `--astryx-size-*`, `--astryx-radius-*`, `--astryx-shadow-*`, border and focus |

Outside a component, reference `var(--astryx-color-text-primary)`. Naming and cascade layers are in [CSS variables](/en/themes/css-variables).

# Design token（设计令牌）

## 什么是 Design token？

做界面时，我们经常会遇到很多重复出现的设计决定：比如主色调选哪个蓝、按钮圆角是多大、卡片之间空开几像素、弹窗弹出来要花几毫秒。

如果把这些具体数字硬编码写死在每个组件的 CSS 里，以后只要想改个圆角或换个主题色，就得翻遍整个项目的代码挨个修改，不仅费时而且特别容易改漏。

Design token（设计令牌）就是把这些通用的设计决定统一抽出来，给它们起一个固定、清晰的名字。组件本身不写死具体数字，只引用对应的 token。以后换主题，本质上就是把这批 token 背后的具体数值整套替换掉。

## 在 astryx-vue 中是如何实现的？

astryx-vue 的 token 严格对齐原版 Astryx（原版在 `tokens.stylex.ts` 和 `dataTokens.stylex.ts` 中维护），名字和取值都一样。但在前端输出层面，我们并没有把它们做成 StyleX 对象，而是全部编译成了现代标准的 **CSS 自定义属性（CSS 变量）**。

这样设计的好处很明显：**不用引入任何专门的 CSS-in-JS 编译器，只要写原生 CSS，在哪都能直接读到和修改。**

1. **统一的前缀规范：** 每一条语义化 token 都有统一的 `--astryx-` 前缀，避免和你项目已有的其他全局变量起冲突。这是我们和原版唯一有意不同的地方：原版的 `--spacing-4`，在这里叫 `--astryx-spacing-4`。前缀会一直保留，因为已经有用户的自定义主题在用这些名字。`defineTheme()` 两种写法都认。
2. **原生双模配色：** 颜色相关的 token 采用标准 CSS 的 `light-dark()` 函数书写，一条变量就同时包含了浅色和深色两套色值，不需要分开发布两份样式表，切换模式时也不需要刷掉整套样式。
3. **层级覆盖规则：**
   - 如果 Neutral 主题覆盖了某个变量，优先使用 Neutral 的值。
   - 如果 Neutral 没覆盖，则回退使用原版的默认规范值。
   - 如果在自定义样式中想要微调，只需通过 CSS 层级（`@layer astryx.overrides`）重新给变量赋值即可。

数值以 `packages/themes/neutral/base.css` 的声明为准，图表配色以 `packages/themes/data.css` 为准。文档中的色板与尺寸参考也是直接由这两个文件解析生成的。

## Token 分类总览

你可以按照功能分类查看具体的变量名称与视觉效果：

| 类别文档 | 变量前缀与说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [颜色](/themes/color) | `--astryx-color-*`：包含文字、表面背景、状态提示色，以及图表用的 `--astryx-color-data-*` |
| [排版与字体](/themes/typography) | `--astryx-font-*`、`--astryx-text-*`：包含字体族、字号尺寸、字重和行高梯级 |
| [动画刻度](/themes/motion) | `--astryx-duration-*`、`--astryx-ease-*`：包含持续时间、缓动曲线与共享关键帧 |
| [间距、圆角与阴影](/themes/scale) | `--astryx-spacing-*`、`--astryx-size-*`、`--astryx-radius-*`、`--astryx-shadow-*` 等通用尺寸标尺 |

## 在组件外部使用

如果你在编写自己的业务组件或页面时，也希望外观完全符合这套设计规范，直接在你的 CSS 里引用这些变量即可：

```css
.my-custom-card {
  /* 背景直接引用主题卡片背景色 */
  background: var(--astryx-color-background-card);
  /* 文字直接引用主题主要文字色 */
  color: var(--astryx-color-text-primary);
  /* 边框圆角直接引用元素通用圆角 */
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
  /* 内边距直接引用第 4 档标尺（1rem，默认 16px，跟随根字号） */
  padding: var(--astryx-spacing-4);
}
```

更多关于 CSS 分层和覆盖层级的规则，请阅读 [CSS 变量](/themes/css-variables)。

# Typography

Two font stacks live on Neutral's semantic tokens.

`--astryx-font-family-body` and `--astryx-font-family-heading` start with Figtree, then `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `Segoe UI`, `Roboto`, `Helvetica`, `Arial`, and `sans-serif`. `--astryx-font-family-code` starts with JetBrains Mono, then `ui-monospace`, `SFMono-Regular`, `Menlo`, `Consolas`, and `monospace`.

The theme package loads Figtree and JetBrains Mono at 400, 500, 600, 700, and 400 italic. Figtree also includes 600 italic. Importing a theme entry loads both faces.

Weight tokens are `--astryx-font-weight-normal` (400), `medium` (500), `semibold` (600), and `bold` (700). `--astryx-font-weight-regular` points at `normal`. Components already use that name. Upstream calls the token `normal`.

The `type` values on `Text` and `Heading` map to the `--astryx-text-*` sizes, weights, and line heights: `display-1` through `display-3`, and body, large, label, code, and supporting. Display sizes use weight 400. Scale comes from size, not from bold.

`Heading` also takes `level` from 1 to 6, which renders `h1` to `h6` and sets that level's default size, weight, and line height. When the outline calls for an `h2` at a different size, override it with `type`.

<TokenReference locale="en" :sections="['font', 'type']" />

## Do and don't

Bigger is not better. One rule of thumb: body text is `body`, a page gets one `display-1` through `display-3`, and everything else separates itself by level.

**Do:**

- Use one `display-*` per page. A landing page hero and a key figure on a dashboard are the two places it earns its keep. Display weight is 400; the size carries the impact, not bold.
- Pick `level` by outline. If the page runs `h1` then `h2` then `h3`, write that. When a size looks wrong, adjust `type` or `weight` on the spot; don't skip a level to get a size.
- Put supporting text in `supporting`. Table notes, timestamps, and help text belong there: 12px instead of the body's 14px, in the secondary color.
- Use `type="code"` on `Text`, or the `Code` component, for inline code. Both switch to the monospace stack.
- Wrap headings with `text-wrap="balance"` and body text with `text-wrap="pretty"`. The first evens out a two-line heading; the second avoids a lone word on the last line.
- Pair long text with `max-lines`. A truncated `Heading` or `Text` shows the full string in a tooltip on hover.

**Don't:**

- Don't use `h4` as a small section heading. `level` 4 is the 14px bold eyebrow size, smaller than `level` 5. For a step down, use `level="5"`, or give the `h4` a `type`.
- Don't express importance with size. Important things get weight, color, and position; size belongs to hierarchy.
- Don't hand-write `font-size` and `line-height`. `font-size: 18px` drifts from the `--astryx-text-*` line height and weight, and a theme change leaves it misaligned.
- Don't add `letter-spacing` to headings for style. On Chinese text it only looks loose.
- Don't set long body copy in all caps. Eyebrows and labels are fine; sentences are hard work.
- Don't mix more than three sizes in one block. If it needs more hierarchy, use a list or a subheading.

# 排版与字体

文字是界面传递信息的重要媒介。好的排版能让内容层次分明，读起来更轻松。astryx-vue 的排版系统在字体、字重和字号层级上都设定了规范。

## 预置字体与字体栈（Font Family）

主题包在引入时会自动加载两款高品质开源西文字体：
1. **正文与标题字体（Figtree）：** 现代、开阔且具有优秀易读性的几何无衬线字体。内置 400（常规）、500（中粗）、600（半粗）、700（加粗）以及 400/600 斜体。
2. **代码等宽字体（JetBrains Mono）：** 专门为代码阅读设计的等宽字体，符号辨识度高。内置 400、500、600、700 及斜体。

当设备由于网络或其他原因未能加载上述 Web 字体时，系统会平滑回退到操作系统内置的高品质系统字体栈：
- `--astryx-font-family-body` 与 `--astryx-font-family-heading` 回退至苹果 PingFang、Windows Segoe UI、Roboto 等。
- `--astryx-font-family-code` 回退至 SFMono、Menlo、Consolas 等等宽字体。

## 字重标准（Font Weight）

系统规范了 4 个清晰的字重阶梯：
- `--astryx-font-weight-normal`：`400`（常规文字）
- `--astryx-font-weight-medium`：`500`（中等强调）
- `--astryx-font-weight-semibold`：`600`（模块小标、加粗按钮）
- `--astryx-font-weight-bold`：`700`（主标题）

同时提供了 `--astryx-font-weight-regular` 别名（等同于 400），兼容已有组件。

## 文本与标题尺寸阶梯（Type Scale）

通过 `Text`（正文）与 `Heading`（标题）组件的 `type` 属性，可以直接调用 `--astryx-text-*` 预设的一整套尺寸、行高与字重组合：
- **醒目展示大字（Display）：** `display-1` 到 `display-3`，用于落地页 Hero 标语或重点数字看板。这类大字重在尺寸冲击力，字重保持在克制的 400，依靠尺寸本身拉开层次，不会显得臃肿笨重。
- **文章标题（Headings）：** `Heading` 的 `level` 取 1 到 6，决定渲染成 `h1` 到 `h6`，同时给出这一级的默认字号、字重和行高。想要标题语义是 `h2`、字号却用别的档位，用 `type` 覆盖。
- **常用正文与说明（Content）：** 包含 `body`（标准正文）、`large`（引导段落）、`label`（表单标签）、`code`（内联代码）与 `supporting`（辅助小字），行高均经过细致微调，长时间阅读也不易串行。

## 排版阶梯与字体预览

<TokenReference locale="zh" :sections="['font', 'type']" />

## 该做与不该做

字号档位不是越大越好。一条经验：正文用 `body`，一页只有一个 `display-1` 到 `display-3`，剩下的都靠级别拉开层次。

**该做：**

- 一页只用一个 `display-*`。落地页的主标语、看板上的关键数字，这两处才用得上。Display 的字重是 400，靠尺寸本身有冲击力，不靠加粗。
- 标题按大纲选 `level`。页面结构是 `h1` 下面 `h2`、`h2` 下面 `h3`，就照这个写。字号不合适当下就用 `type` 或 `weight` 调，不要为了字号去跳级。
- 辅助文字用 `supporting`。表格注释、时间戳、帮助文本都归它：字号从正文的 14px 降到 12px，颜色也换成次要色。
- 内联代码用 `Text` 的 `type="code"`，或者 `Code` 组件。它会自动换成等宽字体栈。
- 标题换行用 `text-wrap="balance"`，正文用 `text-wrap="pretty"`。前者让两行标题长度接近，后者避免最后一行只剩一个字。
- 长文本配 `max-lines` 加截断提示。`Heading` 和 `Text` 截断后，鼠标悬停会显示全文。

**不该做：**

- 不要用 `h4` 当小标题。`level` 4 是 14px 加粗的眉题尺寸，比 `level` 5 还小。要一个小一号的小标题，用 `level="5"`，或者给 `h4` 加 `type`。
- 不要用字号表达重要程度。重要的东西加粗、给颜色、给位置，尺寸留给层级。
- 不要手写 `font-size` 和 `line-height`。写 `font-size: 18px` 会跟 `--astryx-text-*` 的行高和字重脱节，换主题就错位。
- 不要给标题加 `letter-spacing` 做「设计感」。中文字加了字距只是散。
- 不要用全大写英文字母做正文。眉题和标签可以用，长句看着费劲。
- 不要在一段里混用三种以上字号。要分层次，改用列表或小标题。

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

const MOBILE_MAX_WIDTH = 767
const ARTIFACT_TITLE = 'JWT Token Refresh: Design & Rollout'
const ARTIFACT_SUBTITLE = 'Document · Updated just now'

const ARTIFACT_CONTENT = `## Overview

Our API gateway authenticates every request with a short-lived JWT access token. Until now, an expired token meant an immediate \`401\` — even when the user still held a valid refresh token. This document describes the silent-refresh flow we just shipped and how we're rolling it out.

## The Problem

Token validation ran **before** any refresh logic, so the middleware rejected expired tokens outright:

1. A request arrives with an expired access token
2. \`validateToken()\` throws \`TokenExpiredError\`
3. The catch block returns \`401\` — \`refreshToken()\` is never reached

The result was users getting logged out whenever an access token lapsed mid-session.

## The Fix

The middleware now catches \`TokenExpiredError\` specifically and attempts a silent refresh before rejecting. On success it reissues an access token and continues the request; on failure it falls back to \`401\`.

- **Transparent** — valid sessions never see an interruption
- **Safe** — a missing or invalid refresh token still returns \`401\`
- **Cheap** — refresh only runs on the expiry path, not on every request

## Testing

The refresh path is covered end to end:

| Scenario | Expected |
|----------|----------|
| Valid token passes through | 200 |
| Expired token, valid refresh | 200 + new access token |
| Expired token, invalid refresh | 401 |
| Malformed token | 401 |

## Rollout & Monitoring

1. Ship behind the \`silent_refresh\` flag at 5% of traffic
2. Watch the \`auth.refresh.success\` and \`auth.refresh.failure\` counters
3. Alert if the failure rate exceeds **2%** over any 5-minute window
4. Ramp to 100% once metrics hold steady for 24 hours`

const FOUND_ISSUE = `Found the issue. In \`middleware.ts\`, the token validation runs **before** the refresh check. When a token expires, the middleware rejects the request immediately instead of attempting a refresh.

Here's the problematic sequence:

1. Request arrives with an expired access token
2. \`validateToken()\` throws \`TokenExpiredError\`
3. The catch block returns \`401\` — never reaching \`refreshToken()\`

The fix is to catch \`TokenExpiredError\` specifically and attempt a refresh before rejecting:`

const MIDDLEWARE_CODE = `async function authMiddleware(req: Request) {
  try {
    const decoded = validateToken(req.headers.authorization);
    req.user = decoded;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof TokenExpiredError) {
      // Attempt silent refresh before rejecting
      const refreshed = await refreshToken(req.cookies.refreshToken);
      if (refreshed) {
        req.user = refreshed.user;
        req.newAccessToken = refreshed.accessToken;
        return next(req);
      }
    }
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }
  return next(req);
}`

const TEST_RESULTS = `Added a test for the refresh flow. All **4 tests** pass:

| Test | Status |
|------|--------|
| Valid token passes through | Pass |
| Expired token triggers refresh | Pass |
| Expired token with invalid refresh returns 401 | Pass |
| Malformed token returns 401 immediately | Pass |`

const TEST_CODE = `describe('authMiddleware', () => {
  it('refreshes an expired token silently', async () => {
    const expiredToken = createExpiredJWT(mockUser);
    const validRefresh = createRefreshToken(mockUser);

    const req = mockRequest({
      authorization: \`Bearer \${expiredToken}\`,
      cookies: { refreshToken: validRefresh },
    });

    const res = await authMiddleware(req);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(req.user.id).toBe(mockUser.id);
    expect(req.newAccessToken).toBeDefined();
  });
});`

const DESIGN_INTRO = `I've drafted a design doc covering the problem, the fix, and the test matrix — pulling straight from the changes we just made.

Open the document below to review it. Want me to expand any section?`

const ROLLOUT_REPLY = `On it — adding a **Rollout & Monitoring** section with a staged flag ramp and the alert thresholds. Updating the document now.`

const SOURCES = {

}

const MENTION_ITEMS = [

  { id: 'alex', label: 'Alex Johnson', description: 'Frontend' },

  at: string
}

interface LiveAssistant {
  kind: 'assistant'
  id: number
  at: string
  reasoning: string
  reasoningStreaming: boolean
  reasoningDuration?: string
  tools: ChatToolCallItem[]
  answer: string
  answerStreaming: boolean
  showArtifact: boolean
  stopped: boolean
}

type LiveTurn = LiveUser | LiveAssistant

const composerMode = ref<'ask' | 'edit'>('ask')
const attachments = ref<string[]>([])
const isArtifactDialogOpen = ref(false)
const isArtifactOpen = ref(true)
const isStreaming = ref(false)
const liveTurns = ref<LiveTurn[]>([])
const activeAssistantId = ref<number | null>(null)
const reasoningSource = ref('')
const reasoningLive = ref(false)
const answerSource = ref('')
const answerLive = ref(false)
const reasoningText = useStreamingText(reasoningSource, reasoningLive)
const answerText = useStreamingText(answerSource, answerLive)
const rootRef = useTemplateRef<ComponentPublicInstance>('root')
const composerInputRef = useTemplateRef<ChatComposerInputHandle>('composerInput')
const fileInputRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('fileInput')

const artifactResize = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 640,
  minSize: 480,
  maxSize: 960,
  autoSaveId: 'ai-chat-artifact-panel',
})

const placeholder = computed(() => composerMode.value === 'ask' ? 'Ask anything...' : 'Describe your edit...')

let nextId = 1
let timers: number[] = []

function rootWidth(): number {
  // ref 落在 VStack 组件上，量宽度要拿组件根元素。
  const element = rootRef.value?.$el
  return element instanceof HTMLElement ? element.offsetWidth : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
}

function openArtifact() {
  if (rootWidth() <= MOBILE_MAX_WIDTH)
    isArtifactDialogOpen.value = true
  else
    isArtifactOpen.value = true
}

function addFiles(files: File[]) {
  if (files.length === 0)
    return
  attachments.value = [...attachments.value, ...files.map(file => file.name)]
}

function onPickFiles(event: Event) {
  const input = event.target
  if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement))
    return
  addFiles(Array.from(input.files ?? []))
  input.value = ''
}

function removeAttachment(name: string) {
  attachments.value = attachments.value.filter(item => item !== name)
}

function mention() {
  const input = composerInputRef.value
  if (!input)
    return
  input.focus()
  input.insertText('@')
}

function copyArtifact() {
  const text = `${ARTIFACT_TITLE}\n\n${ARTIFACT_CONTENT}`
  void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text)
}

function clearTimers() {
  for (const id of timers)
    window.clearTimeout(id)
  timers = []
}

function displayedReasoning(turn: LiveAssistant): string {
  if (turn.id === activeAssistantId.value && reasoningLive.value)
    return reasoningText.value
  return turn.reasoning
}

function displayedAnswer(turn: LiveAssistant): string {
  if (turn.id === activeAssistantId.value && answerLive.value)
    return answerText.value
  return turn.answer
}

function stop() {
  clearTimers()
  const turn = liveTurns.value.find(item => item.kind === 'assistant' && item.id === activeAssistantId.value)
  if (turn && turn.kind === 'assistant') {
    if (reasoningLive.value)
      reasoningSource.value = reasoningText.value
    if (answerLive.value)
      answerSource.value = answerText.value
    reasoningLive.value = false
    answerLive.value = false
    turn.reasoning = reasoningSource.value
    turn.answer = answerSource.value
    turn.reasoningStreaming = false
    turn.answerStreaming = false
    turn.stopped = true
    turn.tools = turn.tools.map(tool => tool.status === 'running' || tool.status === 'pending'
      ? { ...tool, status: 'error', errorMessage: 'Stopped' }
      : tool)
  }
  reasoningLive.value = false
  answerLive.value = false
  isStreaming.value = false
}

function beginAssistant() {
  const turn = reactive<LiveAssistant>({
    kind: 'assistant',
    id: nextId,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    reasoning: '',
    reasoningStreaming: true,
    tools: [],
    answer: '',
    answerStreaming: false,
    showArtifact: false,
    stopped: false,
  })
  nextId += 1
  activeAssistantId.value = turn.id
  liveTurns.value = [...liveTurns.value, turn]
  isStreaming.value = true
  reasoningSource.value = REASONING
  reasoningLive.value = true

  timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => {
    if (!isStreaming.value)
      return
    reasoningLive.value = false
    turn.reasoning = REASONING
    turn.reasoningStreaming = false
    turn.reasoningDuration = '1.2s'
    turn.tools = [{ name: 'read', target: 'middleware.ts', status: 'running', node: 'cli:remote-server' }]
  }, 700))

  timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => {
    if (!isStreaming.value)
      return
    turn.tools = [{ name: 'read', target: 'middleware.ts', status: 'complete', duration: '38ms', node: 'cli:remote-server' }]
    answerSource.value = LIVE_ANSWER
    answerLive.value = true
    turn.answerStreaming = true
  }, 1400))

  timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => {
    if (!isStreaming.value)
      return
    answerLive.value = false
    turn.answer = LIVE_ANSWER
    turn.answerStreaming = false
    turn.showArtifact = true
    isStreaming.value = false
  }, 2400))
}

function onSubmit(value: string) {
  if (isStreaming.value)
    return
  const files = attachments.value
  attachments.value = []
  liveTurns.value = [...liveTurns.value, {
    kind: 'user',
    id: nextId,
    text: value,
    files,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
  }]
  nextId += 1
  beginAssistant()
}

onBeforeUnmount(clearTimers)

const mobileActions = [
  {
    type: 'section' as const,
    title: 'Version',
    items: [
      { label: 'v2 (current)' },
      { label: 'v1' },
    ],
  },
  { type: 'divider' as const },
  { label: 'Copy', icon: 'copy', onClick: copyArtifact },
  { label: 'Share', icon: 'i-heroicons-share' },
]
</script>

                  <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">

                  <ChatMessageMetadata>

                    </template>

                </ChatMessage>

                <ChatSystemMessage>

                    <template #metadata>

                <ChatMessage sender="assistant">

                  </template>
                  <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost">
                    <Markdown density="compact" :content="DESIGN_INTRO" />
                  </ChatMessageBubble>
                  <ChatMessageBubble variant="ghost" width="100%">
                    <ClickableCard :label="`Open ${ARTIFACT_TITLE}`" variant="muted" :padding="3" :max-width="360" @click="openArtifact">

      <Layout>
        <template #header>

            </VStack>

    </Dialog>
  </VStack>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ChatComposerInputHandle, ChatComposerTrigger } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import {

  ChatComposer,

const CATEGORY_SUGGESTIONS: Record<string, Array<{ heading: string, body: string, prompt: string }>> = {

  ],
