    { heading: 'Design a concept', body: 'Explore product or visual design ideas', prompt: 'Help me design a concept for' },
    { heading: 'Create a tagline', body: 'Craft a memorable phrase for a brand or product', prompt: 'Create a catchy tagline for' },
  ],
}

const MENTION_ITEMS = [
  { id: 'cindy', label: 'Cindy Zhang', description: 'Design Systems' },
  { id: 'alex', label: 'Alex Johnson', description: 'Frontend' },
  { id: 'sam', label: 'Sam Rivera', description: 'Backend' },
  { id: 'jordan', label: 'Jordan Lee', description: 'Product' },
  { id: 'taylor', label: 'Taylor Kim', description: 'Design' },
  { id: 'morgan', label: 'Morgan Chen', description: 'Infrastructure' },
]

const COMMAND_ITEMS = [
  { id: 'summarize', label: 'summarize', description: 'Summarize the conversation' },
  { id: 'translate', label: 'translate', description: 'Translate text to another language' },
  { id: 'search', label: 'search', description: 'Search the web or documents' },
  { id: 'code', label: 'code', description: 'Generate or explain code' },
  { id: 'help', label: 'help', description: 'Show available commands' },
]

const TOKEN_MODES: Record<string, string> = {
  sensitive: '/sensitive',
  deep: '/deep-mode',
}

const composerTriggers: ChatComposerTrigger[] = [
  {
    character: '@',
    menuLabel: 'People',
    searchSource: createStaticSource(MENTION_ITEMS),
    onSelect: item => ({ value: `@${item.id}`, label: item.label, variant: 'blue' }),
  },
  {
    character: '/',
    menuLabel: 'Commands',
    searchSource: createStaticSource(COMMAND_ITEMS),
    onSelect: item => ({ value: `/${item.label}`, label: `/${item.label}`, variant: 'yellow' }),
  },
]

const mode = ref<string | null>('auto')
const category = ref<string | null>(null)
const attachments = ref([
  'project_brief.pdf',
  'wireframes_v2.fig',
  'api_spec.yaml',
  'user_research.csv',
  'brand_guidelines.pdf',
])
const draft = ref('')
const isModeMenuOpen = ref(false)
const composerInputRef = useTemplateRef<ChatComposerInputHandle>('composerInput')
const shouldFocusComposer = ref(false)
const dictation = useChatDictation({ input: composerInputRef })

const suggestions = computed(() => (category.value ? CATEGORY_SUGGESTIONS[category.value] : null))
const modeLabel = computed(() => {
  if (mode.value === 'writing')
    return 'Writing'
  if (mode.value === 'coding')
    return 'Coding'
  if (mode.value === 'research')
    return 'Research'
  if (mode.value === 'creative')
    return 'Creative'
  return 'Auto'
})

async function applySuggestion(prompt: string) {
  draft.value = prompt
  if (category.value)
    mode.value = category.value
  await nextTick()
  composerInputRef.value?.focus()
}

function insertMention(item: typeof MENTION_ITEMS[number]) {
  const input = composerInputRef.value
  if (!input)
    return
  input.focus()
  input.insertToken({ value: `@${item.id}`, label: item.label, variant: 'blue' })
}

function insertModeToken(label: string) {
  composerInputRef.value?.focus()
  composerInputRef.value?.insertToken({ value: label, label, variant: 'orange' })
  shouldFocusComposer.value = true
}

function onModeOpenChange(isOpen: boolean) {
  isModeMenuOpen.value = isOpen
  if (!isOpen && shouldFocusComposer.value) {
    shouldFocusComposer.value = false
    window.setTimeout(() => composerInputRef.value?.focus(), 50)
  }
}

function addFiles(files: File[]) {
  attachments.value = [...attachments.value, ...files.map(file => file.name)]
}

function removeAttachment(name: string) {
  attachments.value = attachments.value.filter(item => item !== name)
}

function chooseMode(key: string) {
  const tokenLabel = TOKEN_MODES[key]
  if (tokenLabel)
    insertModeToken(tokenLabel)
  else
    mode.value = key
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill" :content-width="720" :padding="6">
    <LayoutContent>
      <VStack :gap="8" align="center" class="page">
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
            <Icon name="heroicons:sparkles" size="md" color="accent" />
            <Text type="large">
              Hi, Andrew
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <Heading :level="1" type="display-2">
            Where should we start?
          </Heading>
        </VStack>

        <ChatComposer v-model="draft" class="composer" placeholder="Ask anything">
          <template #input>
            <ChatComposerInput
              ref="composerInput"
              class="composer-input"
              :triggers="composerTriggers"
              @files="addFiles"
            />
          </template>
          <template v-if="attachments.length" #drawer>
            <ChatComposerDrawer :count="attachments.length">
              <Token
                v-for="name in attachments"
                :key="name"
                :label="name"
                @remove="removeAttachment(name)"
              />
            </ChatComposerDrawer>
          </template>
          <template #headerActions>
            <DropdownMenu :has-chevron="false" :menu-width="240">
              <template #trigger="triggerProps">
                <IconButton v-bind="triggerProps" label="Reference" variant="ghost" size="sm">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:at-symbol" />
                </IconButton>
              </template>
              <DropdownMenuItem
                v-for="item in MENTION_ITEMS"
                :key="item.id"
                :label="item.label"
                :description="item.description"
                @click="insertMention(item)"
              />
            </DropdownMenu>
          </template>
          <template #footerActions>
            <DropdownMenu
              :menu-width="200"
              :is-menu-open="isModeMenuOpen"
              @open-change="onModeOpenChange"
            >
              <template #trigger="triggerProps">
                <Button v-bind="triggerProps" :label="modeLabel" variant="ghost" size="md">
                  <template #icon>
                    <Icon v-if="mode === 'writing'" name="heroicons:pencil-square" size="sm" />
                    <Icon v-else-if="mode === 'coding'" name="heroicons:code-bracket" size="sm" />
                    <Icon v-else-if="mode === 'research'" name="heroicons:magnifying-glass" size="sm" />
                    <Icon v-else-if="mode === 'creative'" name="heroicons:light-bulb" size="sm" />
                    <Icon v-else name="heroicons:sparkles" size="sm" />
                  </template>
                  <template #end>
                    <Icon icon="chevronDown" size="sm" color="inherit" />
                  </template>
                </Button>
              </template>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Auto" @click="chooseMode('auto')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:sparkles" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Writing" @click="chooseMode('writing')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:pencil-square" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Coding" @click="chooseMode('coding')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:code-bracket" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Research" @click="chooseMode('research')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:magnifying-glass" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Creative" @click="chooseMode('creative')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:light-bulb" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuDivider />
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Sensitive" @click="chooseMode('sensitive')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:lock-closed" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem label="Deep Mode" @click="chooseMode('deep')">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:clock" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenu
              :menu-width="200"
              :items="[
                { label: 'Preferences' },
                { label: 'Keyboard shortcuts' },
                { label: 'About' },
              ]"
            >
              <template #trigger="triggerProps">
                <Button v-bind="triggerProps" label="Settings" variant="ghost" size="md">
                  <template #icon>
                    <Icon name="heroicons:cog-6-tooth" size="sm" />
                  </template>
                  <template #end>
                    <Icon icon="chevronDown" size="sm" color="inherit" />
                  </template>
                </Button>
              </template>
            </DropdownMenu>
          </template>
          <template #sendActions>
            <ChatDictationButton :dictation="dictation" />
          </template>
        </ChatComposer>

        <VStack :gap="6" class="categories">
          <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="category" label="Category" size="lg">
            <ToggleButton value="writing" label="Writing">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:pencil-square" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="coding" label="Coding">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:code-bracket" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="research" label="Research">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:magnifying-glass" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </ToggleButton>
            <ToggleButton value="creative" label="Creative">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:light-bulb" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </ToggleButton>
          </ToggleButtonGroup>

          <Grid v-if="suggestions" :columns="{ minWidth: 280 }" :gap="3">
            <ClickableCard
              v-for="suggestion in suggestions"
              :key="suggestion.heading"
              :label="suggestion.heading"
              variant="muted"
              :padding="3"
              @click="applySuggestion(suggestion.prompt)"
            >
              <VStack :gap="0.5">
                <Heading :level="4">
                  {{ suggestion.heading }}
                </Heading>
                <Text type="body" color="secondary" size="sm">
                  {{ suggestion.body }}
                </Text>
              </VStack>
            </ClickableCard>
          </Grid>
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>

<style scoped>
.page { min-height: 100%; }
.composer { width: 100%; }
.composer-input { min-height: 84px; }
.categories { padding-inline: var(--astryx-spacing-3); width: 100%; }
</style>

import {

      { key: 'list', name: 'List', desc: 'List displays a vertical set of related items. It supports selection, icons, and metadata for building menus, nav lists, and more.' },

]
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill" :content-width="1200">
    <LayoutContent :padding="8">
      <VStack :gap="10">
        <Card variant="gray" :padding="10">
          <HStack :gap="8" :align="'center'">
            <StackItem size="fill">
              <VStack :gap="4">
                <Text type="display-1">
                  Web overview
                </Text>
                <Text type="large" color="secondary">
                  An open-source UI library to help developers quickly build

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { OutlineItem, TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Card,
  Center,
  CodeBlock,
  Divider,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutPanel,
  Outline,
  pixel,
  Section,
  Selector,
  StackItem,
  Tab,
  TabList,
  Table,
  Text,
  useMediaQuery,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue'

/** 线性图标用内联 SVG 画出，不依赖外部图标字体。 */
function strokeIcon(path: string): Component {
  return defineComponent({
    render: () => h('svg', {
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24',
      fill: 'none',
      stroke: 'currentColor',
      'stroke-width': 1.5,
      'stroke-linecap': 'round',
      'aria-hidden': 'true',
      style: 'width:1em;height:1em',
    }, [h('path', { d: path })]),
  })
}

const PlusIcon = strokeIcon('M12 5v14M5 12h14')
const FullscreenIcon = strokeIcon('M4 9V4h5M20 15v5h-5M15 4h5v5M9 20H4v-5')

interface GuidanceRow extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  type: 'do' | 'dont'
  text: string
}

interface Example {
  title: string
  description: string
  code: string
}

const OUTLINE_ITEMS: OutlineItem[] = [
  { id: 'usage', label: 'Usage', level: 2 },
  { id: 'best-practices', label: 'Best practices', level: 3 },
  { id: 'examples', label: 'Examples', level: 2 },
]

const OUTLINE_OPTIONS = OUTLINE_ITEMS.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: item.label }))

const USAGE = 'Buttons provide visual cues for actions and events. These fundamental components allow users to commit actions and navigate a page flow. Use a Button when a user needs to submit a form, start a new task or action, or trigger a new UI element to appear on the page.'

const BEST_PRACTICES: GuidanceRow[] = [
  { id: 'do-1', type: 'do', text: 'Convey clear action hierarchy: Each surface should only have 1 primary button. A majority of buttons should be in default or flat style.' },
  { id: 'do-2', type: 'do', text: 'Promote clarity: Consider labels alongside icons where appropriate.' },
  { id: 'dont-1', type: 'dont', text: 'Overuse primary or special buttons: Overusing colored buttons will result in a page with less intentionality, create visual confusion and a lack of page hierarchy.' },
]

const EXAMPLES: Example[] = [
  {
    title: 'Semantics',
    description: 'We have four semantic buttons types: flat, default, primary, and destructive. Flat buttons are used to limit visual prominence, whereas primary emphasizes a single action. Use destructive for deletions that trigger dialog confirmations.',
    code: `<Button label="Flat" variant="ghost" />\n<Button label="Default" variant="secondary" />\n<Button label="Primary" variant="primary" />\n<Button label="Destructive" variant="destructive" />`,
  },
  {
    title: 'Default button with badge',
    description: 'Buttons can include a badge to highlight new or updated actions.',
    code: `<Button\n  label="Button"\n  variant="default"\n/>`,
  },
]

const GUIDANCE_COLUMNS: TableColumn<GuidanceRow>[] = [
  {
    key: 'type',
    header: 'Guidance',
    width: pixel(125),
    renderCell: row => h(Badge, { label: row.type === 'do' ? 'Do' : 'Dont', variant: row.type === 'do' ? 'success' : 'error' }),
  },
  {
    key: 'text',
    header: 'Practices',
    renderCell: row => h(Text, { type: 'body', textWrap: 'wrap' }, () => row.text),
  },
]

const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)')
const activeId = ref<string | undefined>(OUTLINE_ITEMS[0]?.id)
/** 每个示例卡片各自记住自己是看描述还是看代码。 */
const exampleTabs = ref<Record<number, string>>({})

function tabFor(index: number): string {
  return exampleTabs.value[index] ?? 'description'
}

function setTab(index: number, value: string): void {
  exampleTabs.value = { ...exampleTabs.value, [index]: value }
}

function scrollToId(id: string): void {
  activeId.value = id
  const target = document.getElementById(id)
  if (target != null) {
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
    window.history.pushState(null, '', `#${id}`)
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="auto" :content-width="960">
    <template v-if="!isMobile" #end>
      <LayoutPanel :is-scrollable="false" label="On this page" role="complementary" class="outline-panel">
        <Outline v-model:active-id="activeId" :items="OUTLINE_ITEMS" />
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :is-scrollable="false" :padding="8">
      <VStack :gap="8">
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Text type="display-1">
            Button
          </Text>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            March 30, 2026 · Updated 5:40 p.m. PST
          </Text>
          <Selector
            v-if="isMobile"
            label="On this page"
            is-label-hidden
            :options="OUTLINE_OPTIONS"
            :model-value="activeId"
            width="100%"
            @update:model-value="scrollToId($event as string)"
          />
        </VStack>

        <Card variant="muted" :padding="0">
          <Center :height="360">
            <Button label="Button" variant="secondary">
              <template #icon>
                <PlusIcon />
              </template>
              <template #end>
                <Badge label="New" variant="info" />
              </template>
            </Button>
          </Center>
        </Card>

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="usage" :level="2">
            Usage
          </Heading>
          <Text type="large" weight="normal">
            {{ USAGE }}
          </Text>
          <Heading id="best-practices" :level="3">
            Best practices
          </Heading>
          <Table
            :data="BEST_PRACTICES"
            :columns="GUIDANCE_COLUMNS"
            id-key="id"
            dividers="none"
            density="spacious"
          />
        </VStack>

        <Divider />

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="examples" :level="2">
            Examples
          </Heading>
          <Text type="large" weight="normal">
            Explore common configurations, variations, and states for this component.
          </Text>
        </VStack>

        <VStack :gap="8">
          <Card v-for="(example, i) in EXAMPLES" :key="i" :padding="0">
            <Section variant="transparent" :padding="3">
              <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <Text type="body" weight="medium">
                    {{ example.title }}
                  </Text>
                </StackItem>
                <HStack :gap="1" align="center">
                  <Button label="Open in Craft" variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    <template #icon>
                      <Icon icon="externalLink" size="sm" />
                    </template>
                  </Button>
                  <Button label="Send to CLI" variant="ghost" size="sm" />
                  <IconButton label="Fullscreen" variant="ghost" size="sm">
                    <FullscreenIcon />
                  </IconButton>
                </HStack>
              </HStack>
            </Section>
            <Center :height="280">
              <HStack v-if="i === 0" :gap="3" align="center">
                <Button label="Flat" variant="ghost" />
                <Button label="Default" variant="secondary" />
                <Button label="Primary" variant="primary" />
                <Button label="Destructive" variant="destructive" />
              </HStack>
              <Button v-else label="Button" variant="secondary" />
            </Center>
            <Section variant="muted" :padding="3" :dividers="['top']">
              <VStack :gap="3">
                <TabList
                  class="tab-flush"
                  size="sm"
                  :value="tabFor(i)"
                  :on-change="(value: string) => setTab(i, value)"
                >
                  <Tab value="description" label="Description" />
                  <Tab value="code" label="Code" />
                </TabList>
                <Text v-if="tabFor(i) === 'description'" type="body">
                  {{ example.description }}
                </Text>
                <CodeBlock

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { OutlineItem } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import {

  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const OUTLINE_ITEMS: OutlineItem[] = [
  { id: 'prerequisites', label: 'Prerequisites', level: 2 },
  { id: 'install-package', label: 'Install the package', level: 2 },
  { id: 'configure-theming', label: 'Configure theming', level: 2 },
  { id: 'next-steps', label: 'Next steps', level: 2 },
]

const OUTLINE_OPTIONS = OUTLINE_ITEMS.map(item => ({
  value: item.id,
  label: item.label,
}))

/** 两行样式导入。拆成数组再 join，避免这行被目录生成器当成真的 import。 */
const STYLE_IMPORT = ['import \'@astryxdesign/core/reset.css\';', 'import \'@astryxdesign/core/astryx.css\';'].join('\n')

const activeId = ref<string | undefined>(OUTLINE_ITEMS[0]?.id)
const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)')

function scrollToId(id: string) {
  activeId.value = id
  const target = document.getElementById(id)
  if (target != null) {
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
    window.history.pushState(null, '', `#${id}`)
  }
}

function copyPrompt() {
  void navigator.clipboard.writeText(
    'Help me get set up with Product Name. Based on my project, do the following: 1. Install @astryxdesign/core and the StyleX compiler. 2. Wrap my app in ThemeProvider. 3. Replace one existing component with an Astryx equivalent. After setup, suggest relevant next steps based on my project.',
  )
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="auto" :content-width="960">
    <template v-if="!isMobile" #end>
      <LayoutPanel
        :is-scrollable="false"
        label="On this page"
        role="complementary"
        class="outline-panel"
      >
        <Outline v-model:active-id="activeId" :items="OUTLINE_ITEMS" />
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :is-scrollable="false" :padding="8">
      <VStack :gap="8">
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Text type="display-1">
            Getting started with Product Name
          </Text>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Last updated March 30, 2026
          </Text>
          <Selector
            v-if="isMobile"
            label="On this page"
            is-label-hidden
            :options="OUTLINE_OPTIONS"
            :model-value="activeId"
            width="100%"
            @update:model-value="scrollToId($event as string)"
          />
        </VStack>

        <Card>
          <VStack :gap="3">
            <HStack :gap="2" :align="'center'">
              <StackItem size="fill">
                <HStack :gap="2" :align="'center'">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:sparkles" size="sm" color="secondary" />
                  <Text type="body" weight="semibold">
                    AI Assistance
                  </Text>
                </HStack>
              </StackItem>
              <Button
                label="Copy prompt"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                @click="copyPrompt"
              >
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:clipboard-document" />
                </template>
              </Button>
              <DropdownMenu
                :items="[
                  { label: 'Open in v0', onClick: () => {} },
                  { label: 'Open in Claude', onClick: () => {} },
                  { label: 'Open in ChatGPT', onClick: () => {} },
                  { label: 'Open in Cursor', onClick: () => {} },
                ]"
              >
                <template #trigger="triggerProps">
                  <IconButton
                    v-bind="triggerProps"
                    label="More options"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                  >
                    <Icon icon="chevronDown" />
                  </IconButton>
                </template>
              </DropdownMenu>
            </HStack>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Help me get set up with Product Name. Based on my project, do
              the following: 1. Install @astryxdesign/core and the StyleX
              compiler. 2. Wrap my app in ThemeProvider. 3. Replace one
              existing component with an Astryx equivalent.
            </Text>
          </VStack>
        </Card>

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="prerequisites" :level="2">
            Prerequisites
          </Heading>
          <List density="compact" list-style="disc">
            <ListItem label="Node.js 18+" />
            <ListItem label="React 18 or 19" />
            <ListItem label="A package manager (npm, yarn, or pnpm)" />
          </List>
        </VStack>

        <Divider />

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="install-package" :level="2">
            Install the package
          </Heading>
          <Text type="body">
            Every project starts with installing the core package. This
            gives you access to all components, tokens, and utilities.
          </Text>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Text type="body" weight="bold">
              Step 1: Install the core package
            </Text>
            <CodeBlock code="npm install @astryxdesign/core" language="bash" width="100%" />
          </VStack>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Text type="body" weight="bold">
              Step 2: Import the precompiled styles
            </Text>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Astryx ships precompiled CSS, so there is no build plugin to
              configure. Import the reset and component stylesheets once at
              your app entry point.
            </Text>
            <CodeBlock
              :code="STYLE_IMPORT"
              language="tsx"
              width="100%"
            />
          </VStack>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Text type="body" weight="bold">
              Step 3: Import your first component
            </Text>
            <CodeBlock
              :code="`import { Button } from '@astryxdesign/core/Button';\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return <Button label="Hello Astryx" variant="primary" />;\n}`"
              language="tsx"
              width="100%"
            />
          </VStack>
        </VStack>

        <Divider />

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="configure-theming" :level="2">
            Configure theming
          </Heading>
          <Text type="body">
            Astryx ships with a default theme that works out of the box. To
            customize colors, typography, and spacing, wrap your app in a
            theme provider.
          </Text>
          <CodeBlock
            :code="`import { ThemeProvider } from '@astryxdesign/core/Theme';\n\nexport default function App({ children }) {\n  return (\n    <ThemeProvider theme="default">\n      {children}\n    </ThemeProvider>\n  );\n}`"
            language="tsx"
            width="100%"
          />
          <Text type="body" color="secondary">
            See the theming guide for the full list of customizable tokens.
          </Text>
        </VStack>

        <Divider />

        <VStack :gap="4">
          <Heading id="next-steps" :level="2">
            Next steps
          </Heading>
          <List density="compact" list-style="disc">
            <ListItem label="Fundamental concepts — How theming, layout, and composition work" />
            <ListItem label="Component API reference — Props, variants, and examples for every component" />
            <ListItem label="Accessibility — Built-in a11y features and ARIA patterns" />
            <ListItem label="CLI tools — Scaffold projects and manage templates" />
            <ListItem label="Design tokens — Colors, spacing, typography, and sizing" />
          </List>
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>

.outline-panel {

const PRODUCT_IMAGES = [

const PRODUCTS = [

  { name: 'Ember Bowl', details: 'Glaze: Sage\nSize: 6 in', price: 42.0, qty: 2, image: PRODUCT_IMAGES[1] },
  { name: 'Terra Cup', details: 'Glaze: Oat\nSize: 14 in', price: 65.0, qty: 1, image: PRODUCT_IMAGES[2] },

]

const DISCOUNT = 15.0
const SHIPPING = 0
const TAX = Math.round((SUBTOTAL - DISCOUNT) * 0.0825 * 100) / 100
const TOTAL = SUBTOTAL - DISCOUNT + SHIPPING + TAX
const fmt = (n: number) => `$${n.toFixed(2)}`

interface ActivityItem {
  type: 'event' | 'comment' | 'update'
  user: string
  text: string
  time: string
  reactions?: number
  changes?: string[]
}

const activeTab = ref('details')

const showSidePanel = ref(true)
const isPanelDialogOpen = ref(false)

const isPanelShown = computed(() => isNarrow.value ? isPanelDialogOpen.value : showSidePanel.value)

function togglePanel() {
  if (isNarrow.value)
    isPanelDialogOpen.value = !isPanelDialogOpen.value
  else

}
</script>

                      </Text>

                      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                        ・
                      </Text>

                    </HStack>

                      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                        ・
                      </Text>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  Card,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  LayoutPanel,
  ProgressBar,
  SegmentedControl,
  SegmentedControlItem,
  StackItem,
  Text,
  Timestamp,
  useMediaQuery,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

type Period = 'WoW' | 'MoM' | 'QoQ'
type Rag = 'green' | 'amber' | 'red'

interface Kpi {
  key: string
  label: string
  value: string
  delta: Record<Period, number>
  higherIsBetter: boolean
}

interface Okr {
  objective: string
  owner: string
  actual: number
  target: number
  unit: string
}

interface TrendSeries {
  key: string
  title: string
  unit: string
  color: string
  kind: 'area' | 'line'
  data: { t: number, label: string, current: number, prior: number }[]
}

interface Callout {
  status: 'success' | 'warning' | 'info'
  title: string
  detail: string
}

const COLORS = {
  blue: 'var(--astryx-color-data-categorical-blue, #0171E3)',
  green: 'var(--astryx-color-data-categorical-green, #0B991F)',
  orange: 'var(--astryx-color-data-categorical-orange, #EB6E00)',
  purple: 'var(--astryx-color-data-categorical-purple, #6B1EFD)',
  prior: 'var(--astryx-color-text-secondary, #737373)',
}

const PERIOD_SUBTITLE: Record<Period, string> = {
  WoW: 'Week of Jun 23 – Jun 29, 2026 vs. prior week',
  MoM: 'June 2026 vs. May 2026',
  QoQ: 'Q2 2026 vs. Q1 2026',
}

const KPIS: Kpi[] = [
  { key: 'revenue', label: 'Net revenue', value: '$4.82M', delta: { WoW: 2.4, MoM: 6.1, QoQ: 14.3 }, higherIsBetter: true },
  { key: 'arr', label: 'ARR', value: '$58.1M', delta: { WoW: 1.1, MoM: 3.8, QoQ: 11.2 }, higherIsBetter: true },
  { key: 'nrr', label: 'Net revenue retention', value: '112%', delta: { WoW: 0.3, MoM: -0.8, QoQ: 2.1 }, higherIsBetter: true },
  { key: 'churn', label: 'Gross churn', value: '1.9%', delta: { WoW: 0.4, MoM: 1.6, QoQ: -0.7 }, higherIsBetter: false },
  { key: 'cac', label: 'CAC payback', value: '14.2 mo', delta: { WoW: -0.2, MoM: -3.4, QoQ: -8.1 }, higherIsBetter: false },
  { key: 'nps', label: 'NPS', value: '48', delta: { WoW: 1.0, MoM: 4.0, QoQ: 6.0 }, higherIsBetter: true },
]

const OKRS: Okr[] = [
  { objective: 'Reach $60M ARR', owner: 'Dana Whitfield · CRO', actual: 58.1, target: 60, unit: 'M' },
  { objective: 'Expand into 3 new enterprise verticals', owner: 'Marcus Lin · VP Sales', actual: 2, target: 3, unit: '' },
  { objective: 'Ship AI copilot GA', owner: 'Priya Raman · VP Product', actual: 82, target: 100, unit: '%' },
  { objective: 'Improve gross margin to 78%', owner: 'Tom Okafor · CFO', actual: 75.4, target: 78, unit: '%' },
]

const WEEK_LABELS = ['W1', 'W2', 'W3', 'W4', 'W5', 'W6', 'W7', 'W8', 'W9', 'W10', 'W11', 'W12']

function makeTrend(base: number, growth: number, priorGap: number, wobble: number) {
  return WEEK_LABELS.map((label, i) => {
    const drift = base * (1 + (growth * i) / 11)
    const current = Math.round(drift + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * base * wobble)
    return { t: i, label, current, prior: Math.round(current * (1 - priorGap)) }
  })
}

const TRENDS: TrendSeries[] = [
  { key: 'revenue', title: 'Net revenue', unit: 'k', color: COLORS.blue, kind: 'area', data: makeTrend(980, 0.24, 0.12, 0.03) },
  { key: 'pipeline', title: 'Qualified pipeline', unit: 'k', color: COLORS.green, kind: 'area', data: makeTrend(3200, 0.31, 0.18, 0.05) },
  { key: 'activation', title: 'Activation rate', unit: '%', color: COLORS.purple, kind: 'line', data: makeTrend(42, 0.28, 0.09, 0.04) },
  { key: 'support', title: 'Support CSAT', unit: '%', color: COLORS.orange, kind: 'line', data: makeTrend(88, 0.06, 0.03, 0.02) },
]

const NARRATIVE: Record<Period, Callout[]> = {
  WoW: [
    { status: 'success', title: 'Net revenue up 2.4% week-over-week', detail: 'Driven by three enterprise renewals closing early in the East region; expansion ARR contributed 60% of the lift.' },
    { status: 'warning', title: 'Gross churn ticked up 0.4 points', detail: 'Two mid-market logos churned on price; both flagged in QBRs last month. Save-play in motion for the remaining at-risk cohort.' },
    { status: 'info', title: 'CAC payback holding at 14.2 months', detail: 'Paid acquisition efficiency steady; the shift toward partner-sourced pipeline is starting to show in blended CAC.' },
  ],
  MoM: [
    { status: 'success', title: 'Revenue accelerating: +6.1% month-over-month', detail: 'Second consecutive month of accelerating growth. New-logo bookings and expansion both above plan; net-new pipeline covers 3.2x of next quarter target.' },
    { status: 'warning', title: 'NRR dipped 0.8 points to 112%', detail: 'A seasonal downgrade cycle in the SMB segment pulled retention down slightly. Enterprise NRR remains above 120%.' },
    { status: 'success', title: 'CAC payback improved 3.4 points', detail: 'Sales efficiency gains from the new SDR playbook are compounding; payback now inside the 15-month board target.' },
  ],
  QoQ: [
    { status: 'success', title: 'Strong quarter: revenue +14.3%, ARR +11.2%', detail: 'Best quarter on record for net-new ARR. Two of three new verticals landed anchor customers; the AI copilot beta is converting at 2x the baseline trial rate.' },
    { status: 'success', title: 'Churn down 0.7 points quarter-over-quarter', detail: 'Retention initiatives launched in Q1 are paying off; gross churn at a two-year low and NRR up 2.1 points.' },
    { status: 'warning', title: 'Gross margin at 75.4%, short of the 78% goal', detail: 'Infrastructure cost from the AI copilot GA ramp is the primary drag. Finance projects margin recovery once usage-based pricing lands next quarter.' },
  ],
}

const CALLOUT_ICON: Record<Callout['status'], string> = {
  success: 'success',
  warning: 'warning',
  info: 'info',
}

const CALLOUT_ICON_COLOR: Record<Callout['status'], 'success' | 'warning' | 'accent'> = {
  success: 'success',
  warning: 'warning',
  info: 'accent',
}

const CALLOUT_LABEL: Record<Callout['status'], string> = {
  success: 'Positive',
  warning: 'Needs attention',
  info: 'Context',
}

/** Delta 的方向和幅度决定图标与配色：方向有利且幅度大是绿，方向不利且幅度大是红。 */
function ragFor(deltaPct: number, higherIsBetter: boolean): Rag {
  const favorable = higherIsBetter ? deltaPct >= 0 : deltaPct <= 0
  const magnitude = Math.abs(deltaPct)
  if (favorable)
    return magnitude >= 1 ? 'green' : 'amber'
  return magnitude >= 3 ? 'red' : 'amber'
}

function okrRag(pct: number): Rag {
  if (pct >= 90)
    return 'green'
  if (pct >= 70)
    return 'amber'
  return 'red'
}

const RAG_ICON = { green: 'success', amber: 'warning', red: 'error' } as const
const RAG_PROGRESS = { green: 'success', amber: 'warning', red: 'error' } as const

const period = ref<Period>('WoW')
const isNarrow = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 1024px)')

const subtitle = computed(() => PERIOD_SUBTITLE[period.value])
const callouts = computed(() => NARRATIVE[period.value])
const okrSummary = computed(() => {
  const onTrack = OKRS.filter(okr => (okr.actual / okr.target) * 100 >= 90).length
  return `${onTrack} of ${OKRS.length} on track`
})

function deltaText(delta: number): string {
  return `${delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${delta.toFixed(1)}%`
}

function deltaIcon(delta: number): string {
  if (delta === 0)
    return 'chevronRight'
  return delta < 0 ? 'arrowDown' : 'arrowUp'
}

function okrPercent(okr: Okr): number {
  return Math.round((okr.actual / okr.target) * 100)
}

function ownerName(owner: string): string {
  return owner.split('·')[0].trim()
}

function trendDelta(trend: TrendSeries): number {
  const latest = trend.data[trend.data.length - 1]
  return Math.round(((latest.current - latest.prior) / latest.prior) * 100)
}

/** 图表画布高度 200，左侧留给 y 轴刻度，底部留给 x 轴标签。 */
const CHART = { h: 200, padLeft: 40, padRight: 8, padTop: 5, padBottom: 30 }
const CHART_INNER_H = CHART.h - CHART.padTop - CHART.padBottom
const X_TICKS = [0, 3, 7, 11]

/** 四张卡片宽度相同，只量第一张；viewBox 和像素一比一，图撑满卡片也不会被拉伸。 */
const chartWidth = ref(360)
const chartInnerW = computed(() => chartWidth.value - CHART.padLeft - CHART.padRight)
let chartObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null
function bindChart(el: unknown, index: number) {
  if (index !== 0 || !(el instanceof SVGSVGElement) || chartObserver || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined')
    return
  chartObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
    if (entry && entry.contentRect.width > 0)
      chartWidth.value = entry.contentRect.width
  })
  chartObserver.observe(el)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => chartObserver?.disconnect())

/**
 * 0 起步、一共 5 个刻度的 y 轴，步长和 recharts 默认的取整规则一致：
 * 原始步长按数量级取 0.05（个位数时取 0.1）的整数倍再向上取整。
 */
function niceTicks(max: number): number[] {
  const raw = max / 4
  const digits = Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)) + 1
  const unit = 10 ** digits * (digits === 1 ? 0.1 : 0.05)
  const step = Math.ceil(raw / unit) * unit
  return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => Math.round(i * step * 100) / 100)
}

/** 单调三次样条（等价于 recharts 的 monotone 曲线），返回 SVG 路径。 */
function monotonePath(pts: { x: number, y: number }[]): string {
  const n = pts.length
  const dx: number[] = []
  const slope: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    dx.push(pts[i + 1].x - pts[i].x)
    slope.push((pts[i + 1].y - pts[i].y) / dx[i])
  }
  const m: number[] = [slope[0]]
  for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++)
    m.push(slope[i - 1] * slope[i] <= 0 ? 0 : (slope[i - 1] + slope[i]) / 2)
  m.push(slope[n - 2])
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    if (slope[i] === 0) {
      m[i] = 0
      m[i + 1] = 0
      continue
    }
    const a = m[i] / slope[i]
    const b = m[i + 1] / slope[i]
    const h = Math.hypot(a, b)
    if (h > 3) {
      m[i] = (3 * a / h) * slope[i]
      m[i + 1] = (3 * b / h) * slope[i]
    }
  }
  let d = `M${pts[0].x.toFixed(1)},${pts[0].y.toFixed(1)}`
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    const w = dx[i] / 3
    d += `C${(pts[i].x + w).toFixed(1)},${(pts[i].y + m[i] * w).toFixed(1)},${(pts[i + 1].x - w).toFixed(1)},${(pts[i + 1].y - m[i + 1] * w).toFixed(1)},${pts[i + 1].x.toFixed(1)},${pts[i + 1].y.toFixed(1)}`
  }
  return d
}

/** 一张趋势卡的几何：网格刻度、x 轴标签、当前期曲线（含面积）和上期虚线。 */
function trendGeometry(trend: TrendSeries) {
  const max = Math.max(...trend.data.flatMap(row => [row.current, row.prior]))
  const ticks = niceTicks(max)
  const top = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
  const x = (i: number) => CHART.padLeft + (i / 11) * chartInnerW.value
  const y = (v: number) => CHART.padTop + CHART_INNER_H - (v / top) * CHART_INNER_H
  const curve = (key: 'current' | 'prior') => monotonePath(trend.data.map((row, i) => ({ x: x(i), y: y(row[key]) })))
  const current = curve('current')
  const baseline = CHART.padTop + CHART_INNER_H
  return {
    yTicks: ticks.map(value => ({ value, y: y(value) })),
    xTicks: X_TICKS.map(i => ({ label: WEEK_LABELS[i], x: x(i) })),
    current,
    prior: curve('prior'),
    area: `${current}L${x(11).toFixed(1)},${baseline}L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${baseline}Z`,
    baseline,
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill" :content-width="1440">
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader :padding="6" has-divider>
        <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between" wrap="wrap">
          <VStack :gap="1">
            <Heading :level="1">
              Weekly Business Review
            </Heading>
            <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
              <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                {{ subtitle }}
              </Text>
              <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                · Generated
              </Text>
              <Timestamp value="2026-06-30T08:00:00Z" format="date" type="body" color="secondary" />
            </HStack>
          </VStack>
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
            <SegmentedControl v-model="period" label="Comparison period">
              <SegmentedControlItem label="WoW" value="WoW" />
              <SegmentedControlItem label="MoM" value="MoM" />
              <SegmentedControlItem label="QoQ" value="QoQ" />
            </SegmentedControl>
            <Button label="Export" variant="secondary">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:arrow-down-tray" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </Button>
          </HStack>
        </HStack>
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="6" class="page-content">
      <VStack :gap="10">
        <VStack v-if="isNarrow" :gap="6">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between">
            <Heading :level="2">
              What changed & why
            </Heading>
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              AI summary
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Card v-for="callout in callouts" :key="callout.title" :padding="5">
              <HStack :gap="3" align="start">
                <Icon
                  :icon="CALLOUT_ICON[callout.status]"
                  :color="CALLOUT_ICON_COLOR[callout.status]"
                  size="md"
                  :label="CALLOUT_LABEL[callout.status]"
                />
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <VStack :gap="1">
                    <Heading :level="4">
                      {{ callout.title }}
                    </Heading>
                    <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                      {{ callout.detail }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </StackItem>
              </HStack>
            </Card>
          </VStack>
        </VStack>

        <VStack :gap="6">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between">
            <Heading :level="2">
              Scorecards
            </Heading>
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              Performance metrics
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <Grid :gap="2" class="scorecard-grid">
            <Card v-for="kpi in KPIS" :key="kpi.key" :padding="5">
              <VStack :gap="1">
                <Text type="label" color="secondary">
                  {{ kpi.label }}
                </Text>
                <HStack :gap="4" align="center">
                  <Heading :level="2">
                    {{ kpi.value }}
                  </Heading>
                  <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                    <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                      {{ deltaText(kpi.delta[period]) }}
                    </Text>
                    <Icon
                      :icon="deltaIcon(kpi.delta[period])"
                      size="xsm"
                      :color="RAG_ICON[ragFor(kpi.delta[period], kpi.higherIsBetter)]"
                    />
                  </HStack>
                </HStack>
              </VStack>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </VStack>

        <VStack :gap="6">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between">
            <Heading :level="2">
              Goal attainment
            </Heading>
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              {{ okrSummary }}
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <Card :padding="6">
            <VStack :gap="6">
              <template v-for="(okr, i) in OKRS" :key="okr.objective">
                <Divider v-if="i > 0" />
                <VStack :gap="2">
                  <HStack h-align="between" align="center" :gap="3">
                    <StackItem size="fill">
                      <Heading :level="4">
                        {{ okr.objective }}
                      </Heading>
                    </StackItem>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      {{ okrPercent(okr) }}%
                    </Text>
                  </HStack>
                  <ProgressBar
                    :value="okr.actual"
                    :max="okr.target"
                    :variant="RAG_PROGRESS[okrRag(okrPercent(okr))]"
                    :label="okr.objective"
                    is-label-hidden
                  />
                  <HStack h-align="between" align="center" :gap="4">
                    <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                      <Avatar size="sm" :name="ownerName(okr.owner)" />
                      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                        {{ okr.owner }}
                      </Text>
                    </HStack>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      {{ okr.actual }}{{ okr.unit }} / {{ okr.target }}{{ okr.unit }} target
                    </Text>
                  </HStack>
                </VStack>
              </template>
            </VStack>
          </Card>
        </VStack>

        <VStack :gap="6">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between">
            <Heading :level="2">
              Trends
            </Heading>
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              Current vs. prior period · trailing 12 weeks
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <Grid :columns="{ minWidth: 330, repeat: 'fit' }" :gap="3">
            <Card v-for="(trend, index) in TRENDS" :key="trend.key" :padding="5">
              <VStack :gap="6">
                <HStack h-align="between" align="center">
                  <HStack :gap="2">
                    <Heading :level="3">
                      {{ trend.title }}
                    </Heading>
                    <Heading :level="3" color="secondary">
                      {{ trend.data[trend.data.length - 1].current.toLocaleString('en-US') }}{{ trend.unit }}
                    </Heading>
                  </HStack>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                    {{ trendDelta(trend) >= 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ trendDelta(trend) }}% vs prior
                  </Text>
                </HStack>
                <svg
                  :ref="(el: unknown) => bindChart(el, index)"
                  class="trend-chart"
                  :viewBox="`0 0 ${chartWidth} ${CHART.h}`"
                  role="img"
                  :aria-label="trend.title"
                >
                  <defs>
                    <linearGradient :id="`grad-${trend.key}`" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                      <stop offset="5%" :stop-color="trend.color" stop-opacity="0.3" />
                      <stop offset="95%" :stop-color="trend.color" stop-opacity="0.04" />
                    </linearGradient>
                  </defs>
                  <g v-for="tick in trendGeometry(trend).yTicks" :key="tick.value">
                    <line :x1="CHART.padLeft" :x2="chartWidth - CHART.padRight" :y1="tick.y" :y2="tick.y" class="chart-grid" />
                    <text :x="CHART.padLeft - 8" :y="tick.y" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle" class="chart-tick">{{ tick.value }}</text>
                  </g>
                  <text
                    v-for="(tick, tickIndex) in trendGeometry(trend).xTicks"
                    :key="tick.label"
                    :x="tick.x"
                    :y="CHART.h - 8"
                    :text-anchor="tickIndex === trendGeometry(trend).xTicks.length - 1 ? 'end' : 'middle'"
                    class="chart-tick"
                  >{{ tick.label }}</text>
                  <path v-if="trend.kind === 'area'" :d="trendGeometry(trend).area" :fill="`url(#grad-${trend.key})`" />
                  <path :d="trendGeometry(trend).prior" fill="none" :stroke="COLORS.prior" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4" />
                  <path :d="trendGeometry(trend).current" fill="none" :stroke="trend.color" stroke-width="2" />
                </svg>
                <HStack :gap="5" align="center">
                  <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                    <span class="legend-swatch" :style="{ backgroundColor: trend.color }" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      Current
                    </Text>
                  </HStack>
                  <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                    <span class="legend-swatch" :style="{ backgroundColor: COLORS.prior }" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      Prior
                    </Text>
                  </HStack>
                </HStack>
              </VStack>
            </Card>
          </Grid>
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>

    <template v-if="!isNarrow" #end>
      <LayoutPanel :width="400" :padding="6" has-divider role="complementary" label="What changed and why">
        <VStack :gap="6">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" h-align="between">
            <Heading :level="2">
              What changed & why
            </Heading>
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              AI summary
            </Text>
          </HStack>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Card v-for="callout in callouts" :key="callout.title" :padding="5">
              <HStack :gap="3" align="start">
                <Icon
                  :icon="CALLOUT_ICON[callout.status]"
                  :color="CALLOUT_ICON_COLOR[callout.status]"
                  size="md"
                  :label="CALLOUT_LABEL[callout.status]"
                />
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <VStack :gap="1">
                    <Heading :level="4">
                      {{ callout.title }}
                    </Heading>
                    <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                      {{ callout.detail }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </StackItem>
              </HStack>
            </Card>
          </VStack>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>

<style scoped>
.legend-swatch {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;

function genSpark(
  seed: number,
  start: number,
  end: number,
  volatility: number,
  N: number = 96,
): number[] {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  const rand = () => {
    s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return s / 0x100000000;
  };
  const points: number[] = [];
  let drift = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const t = i / (N - 1);
    const trend = start + (end - start) * t;
    // Multiple overlaid waves at different frequencies for session-like rhythm
    // plus high-frequency chop.
    const wave =
      Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2.3 + seed * 0.13) * volatility * 1.4 +
      Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 5.7 + seed * 0.41) * volatility * 0.9 +
      Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 13.1 + seed * 0.07) * volatility * 0.5;
    // Loosely-correlated random walk so adjacent ticks jitter rather than glide.
    drift = drift * 0.55 + (rand() - 0.5) * volatility * 2.2;
    // Occasional sharper spike to mimic news-driven moves.
    const spike = rand() < 0.04 ? (rand() - 0.5) * volatility * 4 : 0;
    points.push(trend + wave + drift + spike);
  }
  return points;
}

function byPhase<T extends { phase: ReleasePhase }>(items: T[], phase: Phase) {
  return phase === 'all' ? items : items.filter(item => item.phase === phase)

/** 两张图并排、一样宽；`width` 跟着第一张图的实际宽度走，viewBox 和像素一比一。 */
const CHART = reactive({ width: 640, height: 280, left: 56, right: 16, top: 12, bottom: 34 })
const chartEl = ref<SVGSVGElement | null>(null)
let chartObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null
onMounted(() => {
  if (!chartEl.value || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined')
    return
  chartObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
    if (entry && entry.contentRect.width > 0)
      CHART.width = entry.contentRect.width
  })
  chartObserver.observe(chartEl.value)
})
onBeforeUnmount(() => chartObserver?.disconnect())
const POINTS = 96
const X_LABELS = ['00:00', '04:50', '09:30', '14:20', '19:00', '23:50']

function noise(i: number, seed: number) {
  const x = Math.sin(i * 127.1 + seed * 311.7) * 43758.5453
  return x - Math.floor(x)
}

/** 基线 + 慢波 + 抖动，偶尔来一根尖峰，读起来像真实遥测。 */
function telemetry(base: number, swing: number, jitter: number, seed: number) {
  return Array.from({ length: POINTS }, (_, i) => {
    const wave = Math.sin((i / POINTS) * Math.PI * 4 + seed) * swing
    const wobble = (noise(i, seed) - 0.5) * jitter
    const spike = noise(i, seed + 41) > 0.86 ? jitter * 2.4 : 0
    return Math.max(0, base + wave + wobble + spike)
  })
}

function chartX(i: number) {
  return CHART.left + (i / (POINTS - 1)) * (CHART.width - CHART.left - CHART.right)
}

function chartY(value: number, max: number) {
  const inner = CHART.height - CHART.top - CHART.bottom
  return CHART.top + (1 - value / max) * inner
}

function chartPath(values: number[], max: number) {
  return values.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${chartX(i).toFixed(1)},${chartY(v, max).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')

const UPTIME_DAYS = 90
type UptimeStatus = 'operational' | 'degraded' | 'down'

/** 可用性条的三种颜色：用状态点那套填充色（图例和条一致），不用文字前景色，那套在站点里偏深。 */
const UPTIME_COLOR: Record<UptimeStatus, string> = {
  operational: 'var(--astryx-status-dot-success-background, #198100)',
  degraded: 'var(--astryx-status-dot-warning-background, #ffce2f)',
  down: 'var(--astryx-status-dot-error-background, #c9303a)',
}
const UPTIME_LABEL: Record<UptimeStatus, string> = {
  operational: 'Operational',
  degraded: 'Partial degradation',
  down: 'Downtime',
}
const UPTIME_ORDER: UptimeStatus[] = ['operational', 'degraded', 'down']
const DAY_UPTIME: Record<UptimeStatus, number> = { operational: 100, degraded: 98.4, down: 82 }
const UPTIME_ENV_RISK: Record<Environment, number> = { production: 1, staging: 1.6, development: 3 }
const UPTIME_STATUS_RISK: Record<HealthStatus, number> = { healthy: 1, warning: 3.5, critical: 7 }
const UPTIME_TODAY: Record<HealthStatus, UptimeStatus> = { healthy: 'operational', warning: 'degraded', critical: 'down' }

interface ServiceUptime {
  service: string
  status: HealthStatus
  days: UptimeStatus[]
  uptime: number
}

/** 每个服务一串 90 天的状态：风险按环境和当前状态放大，种子固定所以每次渲染都一样。 */
function buildUptime(service: string, environment: Environment, status: HealthStatus): ServiceUptime {
  let seed = 7
  for (let i = 0; i < service.length; i++)
    seed = (seed * 31 + service.charCodeAt(i)) % 9973
  const risk = UPTIME_ENV_RISK[environment] * UPTIME_STATUS_RISK[status]
  const downCount = Math.round(UPTIME_DAYS * Math.min(0.09, 0.005 * risk) * (0.6 + 0.8 * noise(seed, 3.7)))
  const degradedCount = Math.round(UPTIME_DAYS * Math.min(0.32, 0.02 * risk) * (0.6 + 0.8 * noise(seed, 5.9)))
  const ranked = [...Array.from({ length: UPTIME_DAYS }).keys()].sort((a, b) => noise(b, seed) - noise(a, seed))
  const days: UptimeStatus[] = Array.from({ length: UPTIME_DAYS }, () => 'operational')
  for (let k = 0; k < downCount; k++)
    days[ranked[k]] = 'down'
  for (let k = downCount; k < downCount + degradedCount; k++)
    days[ranked[k]] = 'degraded'
  days[UPTIME_DAYS - 1] = UPTIME_TODAY[status]
  const cleanDay = DAY_UPTIME.operational - 0.02 - noise(seed, 11.3) * 0.06
  let served = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < UPTIME_DAYS; i++)
    served += days[i] === 'operational' ? cleanDay - noise(i, seed + 1) * 0.02 : DAY_UPTIME[days[i]]
  return { service, status, days, uptime: served / UPTIME_DAYS }
}

function dayLabel(i: number): string {
  const ago = UPTIME_DAYS - 1 - i
  if (ago === 0)
    return 'Today'
  return ago === 1 ? 'Yesterday' : `${ago} days ago`
}

const uptimeEntries = computed(() => {
  const worst = new Map<string, HealthStatus>()

    if (previous === undefined || SEVERITY_RANK[row.status] < SEVERITY_RANK[previous])

  }
  return [...worst.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .map(([service, status]) => buildUptime(service, environment.value, status))
})

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ISOTimeString } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, ref, useId } from 'vue'
import {
  Banner,
  Button,
  Center,
  CheckboxList,
  CheckboxListItem,
  DateInput,
  Dialog,
  DialogHeader,
  Divider,
  Field,
  FieldStatus,
  FormLayout,
  HStack,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutFooter,
  LayoutHeader,
  MetadataList,
  MetadataListItem,
  MultiSelector,
  RadioList,
  RadioListItem,
  SegmentedControl,
  SegmentedControlItem,
  Selector,
  StackItem,
  Step,
  Stepper,
  Switch,
  TextArea,
  TextInput,
  TimeInput,
  useToast,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'

const STEPS = ['Report', 'Schedule', 'Delivery']

const DATASETS = [
  { value: 'pipeline', label: 'Sales pipeline' },
  { value: 'revenue', label: 'Revenue and bookings' },
  { value: 'churn', label: 'Churn and retention' },
  { value: 'support', label: 'Support tickets' },
  { value: 'usage', label: 'Product usage' },
]

const SECTIONS = [
  { value: 'summary', label: 'Executive summary', description: 'Headline numbers and week-over-week change.' },
  { value: 'charts', label: 'Trend charts', description: 'Twelve-week series for each headline metric.' },
  { value: 'breakdown', label: 'Segment breakdown', description: 'Split by region, plan, and account size.' },
  { value: 'anomalies', label: 'Anomaly callouts', description: 'Metrics more than two standard deviations off trend.' },
]

const RECIPIENTS = [
  { value: 'exec', label: 'exec-staff@northwind.dev' },
  { value: 'sales', label: 'Sales leadership (9 people)' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'finance@northwind.dev' },
  { value: 'amara', label: 'Amara Diallo' },
  { value: 'felix', label: 'Felix Tran' },
]

const TIMEZONES = [
  { value: 'pt', label: 'Pacific Time (PT)' },
  { value: 'et', label: 'Eastern Time (ET)' },
  { value: 'gmt', label: 'Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)' },
  { value: 'cet', label: 'Central European Time (CET)' },
]

const WEEKDAYS = [
  { value: 'mon', label: 'Monday' },
  { value: 'tue', label: 'Tuesday' },
  { value: 'wed', label: 'Wednesday' },
  { value: 'thu', label: 'Thursday' },
  { value: 'fri', label: 'Friday' },
]

function blockedMessage(count: number) {
  return count === 1
    ? 'One problem above needs fixing first.'
    : `${count} problems above need fixing first.`
}

const showToast = useToast()
const cadenceInputID = useId()
const cadenceLabelID = useId()

const step = ref(0)
const attempted = ref<ReadonlySet<number>>(new Set())

const name = ref('')
const dataset = ref('pipeline')
const sections = ref<string[]>(['summary', 'charts'])
const note = ref('')

const cadence = ref('weekly')
const weekday = ref('mon')
const time = ref<ISOTimeString | undefined>('08:00' as ISOTimeString)
const timezone = ref('pt')
const startDate = ref<Date | null>(null)

const recipients = ref<string[]>(['exec'])
const format = ref('pdf')
const skipEmpty = ref(true)

function resetDraft() {
  step.value = 0
  attempted.value = new Set()
  name.value = ''
  dataset.value = 'pipeline'
  sections.value = ['summary', 'charts']
  note.value = ''
  cadence.value = 'weekly'
  weekday.value = 'mon'
  time.value = '08:00' as ISOTimeString
  timezone.value = 'pt'
  startDate.value = null
  recipients.value = ['exec']
  format.value = 'pdf'
  skipEmpty.value = true
}

function handleOpenChange(isOpen: boolean) {
  if (!isOpen)
    resetDraft()
}

type StepErrors = Partial<Record<'name' | 'sections' | 'time' | 'startDate' | 'recipients', string>>

/** 每个步骤的必填项检查，顺序和 STEPS 一致。 */
function collectErrors(): StepErrors[] {
  return [
    {
      ...(name.value.trim() ? {} : { name: 'Give the report a name.' }),
      ...(sections.value.length === 0 ? { sections: 'Include at least one section.' } : {}),
    },
    {
      ...(time.value ? {} : { time: 'Pick a send time.' }),
      ...(startDate.value ? {} : { startDate: 'Pick a start date.' }),
    },
    {
      ...(recipients.value.length === 0 ? { recipients: 'Add at least one recipient.' } : {}),
    },
  ]
}

function errorsForStep(index: number): StepErrors {
  return attempted.value.has(index) ? collectErrors()[index]! : {}
}

const currentErrors = computed(() => errorsForStep(step.value))
const isLastStep = computed(() => step.value === STEPS.length - 1)

const cadenceSummary = computed(() => {
  if (cadence.value === 'daily')
    return `Every weekday at ${time.value ?? '—'}`
  if (cadence.value === 'weekly')
    return `${WEEKDAYS.find(d => d.value === weekday.value)?.label ?? weekday.value}s at ${time.value ?? '—'}`
  return `1st of the month at ${time.value ?? '—'}`
})

function goNext() {
  attempted.value = new Set(attempted.value).add(step.value)
  const errs = collectErrors()
  if (Object.keys(errs[step.value]!).length !== 0)
    return
  if (!isLastStep.value) {
    step.value += 1
    return
  }
  showToast({
    body: `${name.value.trim()} is scheduled · ${cadenceSummary.value}`,
    uniqueID: 'report-scheduled',
  })
  resetDraft()
}
</script>

<template>
  <Center height="100dvh">
    <Dialog
      is-open
      is-inline
      :width="620"
      purpose="form"
      @update:open="handleOpenChange"
    >
      <Layout height="fill" :padding="4" default-has-dividers>
        <template #header>
          <DialogHeader title="Schedule a report" @update:open="handleOpenChange" :has-divider="false" />
          <LayoutHeader :has-divider="false">
            <Stepper
              :active-step="step"
              orientation="horizontal"
              density="compact"
              label="Report setup progress"
            >
              <Step
                v-for="(label, i) in STEPS"
                :key="label"
                :step="i"
                :label="label"
                :status="Object.keys(errorsForStep(i)).length > 0 ? 'error' : undefined"
              />
            </Stepper>
          </LayoutHeader>
        </template>
        <template #default>
          <LayoutContent>
            <VStack :gap="5">
              <FormLayout v-if="step === 0" default-optionality="optional">
                <TextInput
                  v-model="name"
                  label="Report name"
                  is-required
                  placeholder="Weekly pipeline review"
                  description="Used as the email subject line."
                  :status="currentErrors.name ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.name } : undefined"
                />
                <Selector v-model="dataset" label="Dataset" :options="DATASETS" />
                <CheckboxList
                  v-model="sections"
                  label="Sections to include"
                  density="compact"
                  :status="currentErrors.sections ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.sections } : undefined"
                >
                  <CheckboxListItem
                    v-for="section in SECTIONS"
                    :key="section.value"
                    :value="section.value"
                    :label="section.label"
                    :description="section.description"
                  />
                </CheckboxList>
              </FormLayout>

              <FormLayout v-else-if="step === 1" default-optionality="optional">
                <Field
                  label="How often"
                  :input-id="cadenceInputID"
                  :label-id="cadenceLabelID"
                  is-group-label
                >
                  <SegmentedControl
                    v-model="cadence"
                    label="How often"
                    :aria-labelledby="cadenceLabelID"
                    layout="fill"
                  >
                    <SegmentedControlItem value="daily" label="Weekdays" />
                    <SegmentedControlItem value="weekly" label="Weekly" />
                    <SegmentedControlItem value="monthly" label="Monthly" />
                  </SegmentedControl>
                </Field>
                <Selector
                  v-if="cadence === 'weekly'"
                  v-model="weekday"
                  label="Day of the week"
                  :options="WEEKDAYS"
                />
                <FormLayout direction="horizontal" default-optionality="optional">
                  <TimeInput
                    v-model="time"
                    label="Send at"
                    is-required
                    :status="currentErrors.time ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.time } : undefined"
                  />
                  <Selector v-model="timezone" label="Time zone" :options="TIMEZONES" />
                </FormLayout>
                <DateInput
                  v-model="startDate"
                  label="First run"
                  is-required
                  :status="currentErrors.startDate ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.startDate } : undefined"
                />
                <Banner
                  status="info"
                  :title="cadenceSummary"
                  description="Data is cut at the send time, so a report at 08:00 covers everything up to 08:00."
                />
              </FormLayout>

              <FormLayout v-else default-optionality="optional">
                <MultiSelector
                  v-model="recipients"
                  label="Recipients"
                  is-required
                  :options="RECIPIENTS"
                  has-search
                  trigger-display="badges"
                  description="Groups resolve at send time, so new members are included automatically."
                  :status="currentErrors.recipients ? 'error' : 'default'"
                  :status-message="currentErrors.recipients"
                />
                <RadioList v-model="format" label="Attachment format" size="sm">
                  <RadioListItem value="pdf" label="PDF" description="Best for reading. Charts render as images." />
                  <RadioListItem value="csv" label="CSV" description="Raw rows, no charts or summary." />
                  <RadioListItem value="both" label="Both" description="PDF in the body, CSV attached." />
                </RadioList>
                <Switch
                  v-model="skipEmpty"
                  label="Skip the send when there is no new data"
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
                <TextArea
                  v-model="note"
                  label="Note in the email"
                  :rows="2"
                  :max-length="200"
                  placeholder="Numbers are provisional until finance closes the month."
                />
                <Divider />
                <MetadataList columns="single">
                  <MetadataListItem label="Report">
                    {{ name.trim() || 'Untitled' }}
                  </MetadataListItem>
                  <MetadataListItem label="Runs">
                    {{ cadenceSummary }}
                    {{ TIMEZONES.find(t => t.value === timezone)?.label.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/)?.[1] ?? '' }}
                  </MetadataListItem>
                  <MetadataListItem label="Sent to">
                    {{ recipients.length === 0 ? '—' : `${recipients.length} ${recipients.length === 1 ? 'recipient' : 'recipients'}` }}
                  </MetadataListItem>
                </MetadataList>
              </FormLayout>
            </VStack>
          </LayoutContent>
        </template>
        <template #footer>
          <LayoutFooter>
            <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
              <Button
                label="Back"
                variant="secondary"
                :is-disabled="step === 0"
                @click="step = Math.max(0, step - 1)"
              />
              <StackItem size="fill" />
              <FieldStatus
                v-if="Object.keys(currentErrors).length > 0"
                type="error"
                variant="detached"
                :message="blockedMessage(Object.keys(currentErrors).length)"
              />
              <Button
                :label="isLastStep ? 'Schedule report' : 'Continue'"
                variant="primary"
                @click="goNext"
              />
            </HStack>
          </LayoutFooter>
        </template>
      </Layout>
    </Dialog>
  </Center>
</template>

  {

const TAKEN_SLUGS = ['admin', 'app', 'api', 'northwind', 'support']
const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/
const SLUG_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$/

function money(n: number) {

}
