const isNarrow = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 640px)')

const step = ref(0)
/** 用户尝试离开过的步骤；没进过这个集合的步骤不会提前标红。 */
const attempted = ref<ReadonlySet<number>>(new Set())

const name = ref('Northwind Robotics')
const slug = ref('northwind-robotics')
const region = ref('us-east')
const visibility = ref('invite')

const invites = ref(
  'amara.diallo@northwind.dev\nfelix.tran@northwind.dev\nrosa.marchetti@northwind.dev',
)
const role = ref('member')
const sendNow = ref(true)
const inviteNote = ref('')

const planId = ref('growth')
const seats = ref(8)
const addons = ref<string[]>(['audit'])
const digest = ref(true)

const acceptedTerms = ref(false)

const emails = computed(() => parseEmails(invites.value))
const invalidEmails = computed(() => emails.value.filter(email => !EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)))
const plan = computed(() => PLANS.find(p => p.id === planId.value) ?? PLANS[0])
const addonCostPerSeat = computed(() =>
  ADDONS.filter(a => addons.value.includes(a.id)).reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.price, 0),
)
const monthlyTotal = computed(() => (plan.value.pricePerSeat + addonCostPerSeat.value) * seats.value)

/** 每一关的报错规则；按钮、Stepper 的颜色、Review 的问题清单都读它。 */
const errorsByStep = computed<Array<Record<string, string>>>(() => {
  const workspace: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (!name.value.trim())
    workspace.name = 'Enter a name for the workspace.'

  if (!slug.value.trim()) {
    workspace.slug = 'Enter a URL for the workspace.'
  }
  else if (!SLUG_PATTERN.test(slug.value)) {
    workspace.slug = 'Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.'
  }
  else if (TAKEN_SLUGS.includes(slug.value)) {
    workspace.slug = `terrace.app/${slug.value} is already taken.`
  }

  const team: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (invalidEmails.value.length > 0)
    team.invites = `Not a valid email address: ${invalidEmails.value.join(', ')}`

  const planStep: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (seats.value < 1) {
    planStep.seats = 'A workspace needs at least one seat.'
  }
  else if (seats.value > plan.value.seatLimit) {
    planStep.seats = `${plan.value.label} tops out at ${plan.value.seatLimit} seats. Choose a larger plan or reduce the seat count.`
  }
  else if (seats.value < emails.value.length + 1) {
    planStep.seats = `You are inviting ${emails.value.length} ${emails.value.length === 1 ? 'person' : 'people'} plus yourself, so you need at least ${emails.value.length + 1} seats.`
  }

  const review: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (!acceptedTerms.value)
    review.terms = 'Accept the terms to create the workspace.'

  return [workspace, team, planStep, review]
})

function shownErrors(index: number): Record<string, string> {
  return attempted.value.has(index) ? errorsByStep.value[index] : {}
}

const currentErrors = computed(() => shownErrors(step.value))
const isLastStep = computed(() => step.value === STEPS.length - 1)

/** 前面已经尝试过、仍然有问题没解决的步骤，在 Review 里集中列出来。 */
const outstanding = computed(() =>
  STEPS.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, index: i, issues: Object.values(shownErrors(i)) }))
    .filter(s => s.index !== step.value && s.issues.length > 0),
)

function markAttempted(index: number) {
  attempted.value = new Set(attempted.value).add(index)
}

function goNext() {
  markAttempted(step.value)
  if (Object.keys(errorsByStep.value[step.value]).length)
    return
  if (!isLastStep.value)
    step.value += 1
}

/** Skip 不是换名字的 Next：它放弃这一步已经填的东西，再往前走。 */
function goSkip() {
  invites.value = ''
  inviteNote.value = ''
  step.value = Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, step.value + 1)
}

function goTo(index: number) {
  if (index > step.value)
    markAttempted(step.value)
  step.value = index
}

function visibilityLabel(value: string) {
  return value === 'invite'
    ? 'Invite only'
    : value === 'domain'
      ? 'Anyone at northwind.dev'
      : 'Anyone with the link'
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill" :content-width="720" :padding="5" default-has-dividers>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader :has-divider="false">
        <VStack :gap="isNarrow ? 3 : 5">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
            <StackItem size="fill">
              <Heading :level="1">
                Create workspace
              </Heading>
            </StackItem>
            <Button label="Cancel" variant="ghost" />
          </HStack>
          <Stepper
            :active-step="step"
            orientation="horizontal"
            density="balanced"
            indicator-position="on-track"
            label="Create workspace progress"
            @step-click="goTo"
          >
            <Step
              v-for="(s, i) in STEPS"
              :key="s.label"
              :step="i"
              :label="s.label"
              :is-optional="s.isOptional"
              :status="Object.keys(shownErrors(i)).length ? 'error' : undefined"
            />
          </Stepper>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent>
      <VStack v-if="step === 0" :gap="5">
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Heading :level="2">
            Workspace details
          </Heading>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Name your workspace and pick where its data lives. The region is permanent — moving data later means a migration.
          </Text>
        </VStack>
        <FormLayout default-optionality="optional">
          <TextInput
            v-model="name"
            label="Workspace name"
            is-required
            placeholder="Acme Inc."
            :status="currentErrors.name ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.name } : undefined"
          />
          <TextInput
            v-model="slug"
            label="Workspace URL"
            is-required
            placeholder="acme"
            :description="`terrace.app/${slug.trim() || 'your-workspace'}`"
            :status="currentErrors.slug ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.slug } : undefined"
          />
          <Selector
            v-model="region"
            label="Data region"
            :options="REGIONS"
            description="Where projects, files, and audit logs are stored at rest."
          />
          <RadioList v-model="visibility" label="Who can join">
            <RadioListItem
              value="invite"
              label="Invite only"
              description="People join only when an admin invites them."
            />
            <RadioListItem
              value="domain"
              label="Same domain"
              description="Anyone with a verified @northwind.dev address can join without an invite."
            />
            <RadioListItem
              value="open"
              label="Anyone"
              description="Anyone with the workspace link can request to join."
            />
          </RadioList>
        </FormLayout>
      </VStack>

      <VStack v-else-if="step === 1" :gap="5">
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Heading :level="2">
            Invite your team
          </Heading>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Teammates get an email when the workspace is created. You can skip this and invite people later from settings.
          </Text>
        </VStack>
        <FormLayout default-optionality="optional">
          <TextArea
            v-model="invites"
            label="Email addresses"
            :rows="4"
            placeholder="jordan@acme.com
priya@acme.com"
            description="One address per line, or separate them with commas."
            :status="currentErrors.invites
              ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.invites }
              : emails.length > 0
                ? { type: 'success', message: `${emails.length} ${emails.length === 1 ? 'address' : 'addresses'} ready to invite.` }
                : undefined"
          />
          <RadioList
            v-model="role"
            label="Default role for invitees"
            description="Each person's role can be changed individually after they join."
          >
            <RadioListItem value="admin" label="Admin" description="Manage billing, members, and workspace settings." />
            <RadioListItem value="member" label="Member" description="Create and edit projects. No access to admin settings." />
            <RadioListItem value="guest" label="Guest" description="View and comment on projects they are added to." />
          </RadioList>
          <Divider />
          <Switch
            v-model="sendNow"
            label="Send invites as soon as the workspace is created"
            description="Turn this off to create the workspace now and send invites yourself later."
            label-position="start"
            label-spacing="spread"
          />
          <TextArea
            v-if="sendNow"
            v-model="inviteNote"
            label="Add a note to the invite"
            :rows="2"
            :max-length="280"
            placeholder="We're moving planning off email — join us here."
          />
        </FormLayout>
      </VStack>

      <VStack v-else-if="step === 2" :gap="5">
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Heading :level="2">
            Choose a plan
          </Heading>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Billed monthly per seat. Change plans or add capabilities at any time from workspace settings.
          </Text>
        </VStack>
        <FormLayout default-optionality="optional">
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Text type="label">
              Plan
            </Text>
            <Grid :columns="{ minWidth: 200 }" :gap="3">
              <SelectableCard
                v-for="p in PLANS"
                :key="p.id"
                :label="`${p.label} plan`"
                :is-selected="planId === p.id"
                :padding="4"
                @change="planId = p.id"
              >
                <VStack :gap="2">
                  <HStack :gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
                    <Text type="label">
                      {{ p.label }}
                    </Text>
                    <Badge v-if="p.id === 'growth'" variant="success" label="Recommended" />
                  </HStack>
                  <Text type="large" weight="bold">
                    {{ p.pricePerSeat === 0 ? 'Free' : `${money(p.pricePerSeat)}/seat` }}
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                    {{ p.description }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
              </SelectableCard>
            </Grid>
          </VStack>
          <NumberInput
            v-model="seats"
            label="Seats"
            :min="1"
            :max="plan.seatLimit"
            is-integer-only
            :description="`Includes you. ${plan.label} allows up to ${plan.seatLimit}.`"
            :status="currentErrors.seats ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.seats } : undefined"
          />
          <CheckboxList
            v-model="addons"
            label="Add-ons"
            description="Billed per seat alongside the plan."
          >
            <CheckboxListItem
              v-for="a in ADDONS"
              :key="a.id"
              :value="a.id"
              :label="`${a.label} — ${money(a.price)}/seat`"
              :description="a.description"
            />
          </CheckboxList>
          <Divider />
          <Switch
            v-model="digest"
            label="Weekly usage digest"
            description="Email admins a summary of seats and activity every Monday."
            label-position="start"
            label-spacing="spread"
          />
        </FormLayout>
        <Card variant="muted" :padding="5">
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" justify="between">
            <VStack :gap="0.5">
              <Text type="label">
                Estimated monthly cost
              </Text>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ seats }} {{ seats === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats' }} × {{ money(plan.pricePerSeat + addonCostPerSeat) }}{{ addonCostPerSeat > 0 ? ` (${money(plan.pricePerSeat)} plan + ${money(addonCostPerSeat)} add-ons)` : '' }}
              </Text>
            </VStack>
            <Text type="display-3">
              {{ money(monthlyTotal) }}
            </Text>
          </HStack>
        </Card>
      </VStack>

      <VStack v-else :gap="5">
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Heading :level="2">
            Review and create
          </Heading>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Nothing is saved until you create the workspace. Use the steps above to go back and edit.
          </Text>
        </VStack>

        <Banner
          v-if="outstanding.length > 0"
          status="error"
          :title="`${outstanding.length} ${outstanding.length === 1 ? 'step needs' : 'steps need'} attention`"
          :collapsible="false"
        >
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Text v-for="s in outstanding" :key="s.label" type="supporting">
              <Text type="supporting" display="inline" weight="bold">{{ s.label }}</Text>: {{ s.issues.join(' ') }}
            </Text>
            <HStack :gap="2">
              <Button
                :label="`Go to ${outstanding[0].label}`"
                variant="secondary"
                size="sm"
                @click="step = outstanding[0].index"
              />
            </HStack>
          </VStack>
        </Banner>

        <MetadataList orientation="vertical">
          <MetadataListItem label="Workspace name">
            {{ name.trim() || '—' }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Workspace URL">
            terrace.app/{{ slug.trim() || '—' }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Data region">
            {{ REGIONS.find(r => r.value === region)?.label ?? region }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Who can join">
            {{ visibilityLabel(visibility) }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Invitations">
            {{ emails.length === 0
              ? 'None'
              : `${emails.length} ${emails.length === 1 ? 'person' : 'people'} as ${ROLE_LABELS[role]}${sendNow ? '' : ', sent later'}` }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Plan">
            {{ plan.pricePerSeat === 0 ? `${plan.label} (Free)` : `${plan.label} · ${money(plan.pricePerSeat)}/seat` }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Add-ons">
            {{ addons.length === 0 ? 'None' : ADDONS.filter(a => addons.includes(a.id)).map(a => a.label).join(', ') }}
          </MetadataListItem>
          <MetadataListItem label="Estimated monthly cost">
            {{ money(monthlyTotal) }} · {{ seats }} {{ seats === 1 ? 'seat' : 'seats' }}
          </MetadataListItem>
        </MetadataList>

        <Divider />

        <CheckboxInput
          v-model="acceptedTerms"
          label="I agree to the Terms of Service and the Data Processing Addendum"
          :status="currentErrors.terms ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.terms } : undefined"
        />
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>

    <template #footer>
      <LayoutFooter>
        <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
          <StackItem size="fill" :style="{ flexBasis: 0 }">
            <Button v-if="STEPS[step].isOptional" label="Skip" variant="ghost" @click="goSkip" />
          </StackItem>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            {{ step + 1 }} of {{ STEPS.length }}
          </Text>
          <StackItem size="fill" :style="{ flexBasis: 0 }">
            <HStack :gap="3" justify="end">
              <Button
                label="Back"
                variant="secondary"
                :is-disabled="step === 0"
                @click="step = Math.max(0, step - 1)"
              />
              <Button
                :label="isLastStep ? 'Create workspace' : 'Next'"
                variant="primary"
                @click="goNext"
              />
            </HStack>
          </StackItem>
        </HStack>
      </LayoutFooter>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>

templates.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  Banner,
  Button,
  Card,
  CheckboxList,
  CheckboxListItem,
  FieldStatus,
  FormLayout,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  MetadataList,
  MetadataListItem,
  RadioList,
  RadioListItem,
  Selector,
  Spinner,
  StackItem,
  Step,
  Stepper,
  Switch,
  Text,
  useToast,
  VisuallyHidden,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, reactive, ref, watchEffect } from 'vue'

// ── 数据 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const REPOS = [
  { id: 'web', name: 'northwind/web', branch: 'main', packageManager: 'pnpm 11', lockfile: 'pnpm-lock.yaml', testRunner: 'Vitest', testCount: 1284, description: 'Marketing site and the signed-in dashboard.' },
  { id: 'api', name: 'northwind/api', branch: 'main', packageManager: 'npm 10', lockfile: 'package-lock.json', testRunner: 'Jest', testCount: 862, description: 'GraphQL gateway and the billing workers.' },
  { id: 'design', name: 'northwind/design-system', branch: 'trunk', packageManager: 'pnpm 11', lockfile: 'pnpm-lock.yaml', testRunner: 'Vitest', testCount: 431, description: 'Component library published to the internal registry.' },
]

const TRIGGERS = [
  { id: 'pr', label: 'Pull requests', description: 'Every push to a branch with an open pull request.' },
  { id: 'push', label: 'Pushes to the default branch', description: 'Direct commits and merges, after the fact.' },
  { id: 'tag', label: 'Release tags', description: 'Tags matching v*, so a release is verified before it ships.' },
]

const JOBS = [
  { id: 'lint', label: 'Lint', description: 'ESLint and Prettier over the changed files. Needs 1 GB.', memoryGB: 1, seconds: 74 },
  { id: 'unit', label: 'Unit tests', description: 'The full suite, sharded across the available cores. Needs 2 GB.', memoryGB: 2, seconds: 203 },
  { id: 'build', label: 'Production build', description: 'The build that would ship, with bundle size reported. Needs 2 GB.', memoryGB: 2, seconds: 126 },
  { id: 'e2e', label: 'End-to-end tests', description: 'Playwright against a preview deployment. Needs 4 GB.', memoryGB: 4, seconds: 391 },
]

const RUNNERS = [
  { id: 'small', label: 'Small', memoryGB: 2, cores: 2, rate: '$0.008' },
  { id: 'medium', label: 'Medium', memoryGB: 4, cores: 4, rate: '$0.016' },
  { id: 'large', label: 'Large', memoryGB: 8, cores: 8, rate: '$0.032' },
]

const NODE_VERSIONS = [
  { value: '22', label: 'Node 22 · Active LTS' },
  { value: '20', label: 'Node 20 · Maintenance' },
  { value: '24', label: 'Node 24 · Current' },
]

const STEP_META = [
  { kind: 'human', label: 'Repository' },
  { kind: 'human', label: 'Pipeline' },
  { kind: 'auto', label: 'Connect' },
  { kind: 'auto', label: 'Inspect the project' },
  { kind: 'auto', label: 'Trial run' },
  { kind: 'human', label: 'Review and enable' },
] as const

const AUTO_STEPS = [2, 3, 4]
const TICK_MS = 800
const SETTLE_MS = 560

type AutoStatus = 'idle' | 'passed' | 'failed'
interface AutoState {
  status: AutoStatus
  done: number
}

/** "3m 12s"：试跑的耗时由跑过的任务相加。 */
function duration(seconds: number) {
  return seconds < 60
    ? `${seconds}s`
    : `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0')}s`
}

// ── 状态 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const showToast = useToast()

const active = ref(0)
const auto = reactive<Record<number, AutoState>>({
  2: { status: 'idle', done: 0 },
  3: { status: 'idle', done: 0 },
  4: { status: 'idle', done: 0 },
})

const repoId = ref('web')
const triggers = ref<string[]>(['pr'])
const jobs = ref<string[]>(['lint', 'unit', 'build'])
const runnerId = ref('small')
const nodeVersion = ref('22')
const strictBranches = ref(true)

const repo = computed(() => REPOS.find(r => r.id === repoId.value) ?? REPOS[0])
const runner = computed(() => RUNNERS.find(r => r.id === runnerId.value) ?? RUNNERS[0])
const selectedTriggers = computed(() => TRIGGERS.filter(t => triggers.value.includes(t.id)))
const selectedJobs = computed(() => JOBS.filter(j => jobs.value.includes(j.id)))
const isDone = computed(() => active.value >= STEP_META.length)

/** 试跑唯一会出问题的地方：任务要的内存比 runner 多。 */
const starvedJob = computed(() => selectedJobs.value.find(j => j.memoryGB > runner.value.memoryGB))

const trialSeconds = computed(() => 38 + selectedJobs.value.reduce((total, job) => total + job.seconds, 0))

const triggerSummary = computed(() =>
  selectedTriggers.value.length === 0
    ? 'nothing yet'
    : selectedTriggers.value
        .map(t => t.label.toLowerCase())
        .join(' and ')
        .replace('pushes to the default branch', `pushes to ${repo.value.branch}`),
)

/** 每个自动步骤实际做的一串检查，展开时逐条打勾。 */
const checksFor = computed<Record<number, Array<{ id: string, label: string }>>>(() => ({
  2: [
    { id: 'auth', label: 'Authenticating as the Northwind CI app' },
    { id: 'perms', label: `Confirming write access to ${repo.value.name}` },
    { id: 'hook', label: `Registering a webhook for ${triggerSummary.value}` },
  ],
  3: [
    { id: 'manifest', label: 'Reading package.json' },
    { id: 'pm', label: 'Detecting the package manager' },
    { id: 'runner', label: 'Locating the test runner' },
    { id: 'cache', label: `Hashing ${repo.value.lockfile} for the cache key` },
  ],
  4: [
    { id: 'provision', label: `Provisioning the ${runner.value.label.toLowerCase()} runner` },
    { id: 'install', label: 'Restoring the cache and installing' },
    ...selectedJobs.value.map(job => ({ id: job.id, label: `Running ${job.label.toLowerCase()}` })),
  ],
}))

/** 自动推进：一次只挂一个定时器，要么勾一条检查，要么结算这一步再交给下一步。 */
watchEffect((onCleanup) => {
  const index = active.value
  if (!AUTO_STEPS.includes(index))
    return

  const state = auto[index]
  if (state.status !== 'idle')
    return

  const checks = checksFor.value[index]

  if (state.done >= checks.length) {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      auto[index] = { ...auto[index], status: 'passed' }
      active.value += 1
    }, SETTLE_MS)
    onCleanup(() => clearTimeout(timer))
    return
  }

  const starved = starvedJob.value
  const failingIndex = starved == null ? -1 : checks.findIndex(check => check.id === starved.id)

  const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    auto[index] = state.done === failingIndex
      ? { ...auto[index], status: 'failed' }
      : { ...auto[index], done: state.done + 1 }
  }, TICK_MS)
  onCleanup(() => clearTimeout(timer))
})

/** 倒退或重进步骤时，从这一步起的自动结果全部作废：它们算的是旧输入。 */
function goToStep(index: number) {
  active.value = index
  for (const step of AUTO_STEPS) {
    if (step >= index)
      auto[step] = { status: 'idle', done: 0 }
  }
}

/** 折叠的步骤显示各自结算的结果，读的是展开时写入的同一份状态。 */
function summaryFor(index: number): string | undefined {
  if (index >= active.value)
    return undefined
  switch (index) {
    case 0:
      return `${repo.value.name} · ${triggerSummary.value}`
    case 1:
      return `${selectedJobs.value.length} ${selectedJobs.value.length === 1 ? 'job' : 'jobs'} · ${runner.value.label.toLowerCase()} runner, ${runner.value.memoryGB} GB · Node ${nodeVersion.value}`
    case 2:
      return 'Connected · webhook #4471 · write access confirmed'
    case 3:
      return `${repo.value.packageManager} · ${repo.value.testRunner} · ${repo.value.testCount.toLocaleString()} tests found`
    case 4:
      return `${selectedJobs.value.length} ${selectedJobs.value.length === 1 ? 'job' : 'jobs'} passed in ${duration(trialSeconds.value)}`
    case 5:
      return `Enabled · ${selectedJobs.value.length} ${selectedJobs.value.length === 1 ? 'job' : 'jobs'} gate every merge`
    default:
      return undefined
  }
}

/** 两个人工步骤共用一套规则；Step 的颜色、确认行、字段提示都读它。 */
const errorsByStep = computed<Array<Record<string, string>>>(() => {
  const repository: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (triggers.value.length === 0)
    repository.triggers = 'Pick at least one event, or nothing would ever start a run.'

  const pipeline: Record<string, string> = {}
  if (jobs.value.length === 0)
    pipeline.jobs = 'Pick at least one job for the pipeline to run.'

  return [repository, pipeline, {}, {}, {}, {}]
})

const currentErrors = computed<Record<string, string>>(() =>
  isDone.value ? {} : errorsByStep.value[active.value],
)

function isStepBroken(index: number) {
  return Object.keys(errorsByStep.value[index]).length > 0
}

function confirmStep() {
  if (Object.keys(currentErrors.value).length !== 0)
    return
  if (active.value === STEP_META.length - 1) {
    showToast({ body: 'Continuous integration is on', uniqueID: 'ci-enabled' })
  }
  active.value += 1
}

const hasFailure = computed(() => AUTO_STEPS.some(step => auto[step].status === 'failed'))

/** 把进度和自动结果合并成一个状态。 */
function phaseOf(index: number): 'passed' | 'pending' | 'failed' | 'running' {
  if (STEP_META[index].kind === 'human')
    return index < active.value ? 'passed' : 'pending'
  if (auto[index].status === 'failed')
    return 'failed'
  if (auto[index].status === 'passed')
    return 'passed'
  return index === active.value ? 'running' : 'pending'
}

function errorCountLabel() {
  const count = Object.keys(currentErrors.value).length
  return count === 1 ? 'One problem above needs fixing first.' : `${count} problems above need fixing first.`
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill" :content-width="800" :padding="5">
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader :has-divider="false">
        <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
          <StackItem size="fill">
            <VStack :gap="0.5">
              <Heading :level="1">
                Set up continuous integration
              </Heading>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                Answer the first two steps and the rest check themselves.
              </Text>
            </VStack>
          </StackItem>
        </HStack>
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent>
      <VStack :gap="6">
        <VisuallyHidden as="div" aria-live="polite">
          {{ isDone
            ? 'All checks passed. Ready to review and enable.'
            : STEP_META[active].kind === 'auto'
              ? `${STEP_META[active].label}: ${phaseOf(active) === 'failed' ? 'failed' : 'running'}`
              : '' }}
        </VisuallyHidden>

        <Stepper
          :active-step="active"
          class="ci-wizard"
          orientation="vertical"
          density="compact"
          label="Continuous integration setup progress"
          @step-click="goToStep"
        >
          <Step
            v-for="(meta, index) in STEP_META"
            :key="meta.label"
            :step="index"
            :label="meta.label"
            :is-disabled="index > active"
            :status="phaseOf(index) === 'failed' || isStepBroken(index) ? 'error' : phaseOf(index) === 'passed' ? 'success' : undefined"
          >
            <template v-if="phaseOf(index) === 'running' || phaseOf(index) === 'failed'" #icon>
              <Spinner v-if="phaseOf(index) === 'running'" size="sm" shade="inherit" />
              <Icon v-else icon="error" size="sm" />
            </template>
            <template v-if="summaryFor(index)" #end>
              <StackItem size="fill">
                <HStack :gap="3" align="center" justify="end">
                  <StackItem size="fill">
                    <Text
                      type="supporting"
                      color="secondary"
                      justify="end"
                      :max-lines="1"
                    >
                      {{ summaryFor(index) }}
                    </Text>
                  </StackItem>
                  <Text
                    type="supporting"
                    color="accent"
                    weight="medium"
                    text-wrap="nowrap"
                  >
                    {{ meta.kind === 'auto' ? 'Run again' : 'Edit' }}
                  </Text>
                </HStack>
              </StackItem>
            </template>

            <VStack v-if="index === active" :padding-block-end="2">
              <FormLayout v-if="index === 0" default-optionality="optional">
                <Selector
                  v-model="repoId"
                  label="Repository"
                  :options="REPOS.map(r => ({ value: r.id, label: r.name }))"
                  :description="`${repo.description} Default branch is ${repo.branch}.`"
                />
                <CheckboxList
                  v-model="triggers"
                  label="Run the pipeline on"
                  description="Every event you pick costs build minutes, so start with the one that gates a merge."
                  density="compact"
                  :status="currentErrors.triggers ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.triggers } : undefined"
                >
                  <CheckboxListItem
                    v-for="t in TRIGGERS"
                    :key="t.id"
                    :value="t.id"
                    :label="t.label"
                    :description="t.description"
                  />
                </CheckboxList>
                <HStack :gap="2" align="center" wrap="wrap">
                  <Button label="Continue" variant="primary" @click="confirmStep" />
                  <FieldStatus
                    v-if="Object.keys(currentErrors).length"
                    type="error"
                    variant="detached"
                    :message="errorCountLabel()"
                  />
                </HStack>
              </FormLayout>

              <FormLayout v-else-if="index === 1" default-optionality="optional">
                <CheckboxList
                  v-model="jobs"
                  label="Jobs"
                  description="They run in parallel on one machine, so the largest appetite sets the size you need."
                  density="compact"
                  :status="currentErrors.jobs ? { type: 'error', message: currentErrors.jobs } : undefined"
                >
                  <CheckboxListItem
                    v-for="job in JOBS"
                    :key="job.id"
                    :value="job.id"
                    :label="job.label"
                    :description="job.description"
                  />
                </CheckboxList>
                <RadioList
                  v-model="runnerId"
                  label="Runner"
                  description="Charged per minute while a job is running."
                >
                  <RadioListItem
                    v-for="r in RUNNERS"
                    :key="r.id"
                    :value="r.id"
                    :label="`${r.label} · ${r.memoryGB} GB`"
                    :description="`${r.cores} cores, ${r.rate} per minute.`"
                  />
                </RadioList>
                <Selector
                  v-model="nodeVersion"
                  label="Node version"
                  :options="NODE_VERSIONS"
                  description="Used for every job unless a job overrides it."
                />
                <HStack :gap="2" align="center" wrap="wrap">
                  <Button label="Start checks" variant="primary" @click="confirmStep" />
                  <Button label="Back" variant="ghost" @click="goToStep(index - 1)" />
                  <FieldStatus
                    v-if="Object.keys(currentErrors).length"
                    type="error"
                    variant="detached"
                    :message="errorCountLabel()"
                  />
                </HStack>
              </FormLayout>

              <FormLayout v-else-if="index === 5" default-optionality="optional">
                <Card variant="muted" :padding="4">
                  <MetadataList orientation="vertical">
                    <MetadataListItem label="Repository">
                      {{ repo.name }}
                    </MetadataListItem>
                    <MetadataListItem label="Triggers">
                      {{ triggerSummary }}
                    </MetadataListItem>
                    <MetadataListItem label="Runner">
                      {{ `${runner.label}, ${runner.memoryGB} GB · Node ${nodeVersion}` }}
                    </MetadataListItem>
                    <MetadataListItem label="Toolchain">
                      {{ `${repo.packageManager} · ${repo.testRunner}, ${repo.testCount.toLocaleString()} tests` }}
                    </MetadataListItem>
                  </MetadataList>
                </Card>
                <Switch
                  v-model="strictBranches"
                  label="Require branches to be up to date before merging"
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
                <HStack :gap="2" align="center" wrap="wrap">
                  <Button label="Enable continuous integration" variant="primary" @click="confirmStep" />
                  <Button label="Back" variant="ghost" @click="goToStep(index - 1)" />
                </HStack>
              </FormLayout>

              <VStack v-if="meta.kind === 'auto'" :gap="4">
                <Stepper
                  :active-step="auto[index].done"
                  orientation="vertical"
                  density="compact"
                  indicator-position="on-track"
                  :label="`${meta.label} checks`"
                  :style="{ marginInlineStart: '-28px' }"
                >
                  <Step
                    v-for="(check, i) in checksFor[index]"
                    :key="check.id"
                    :step="i"
                    :label="check.label"
                    :status="i < auto[index].done ? 'success' : i === auto[index].done && auto[index].status === 'failed' ? 'error' : undefined"
                  >
                    <template v-if="i === auto[index].done" #icon>
                      <Icon v-if="auto[index].status === 'failed'" icon="error" size="sm" />
                      <Spinner v-else size="sm" shade="inherit" />
                    </template>
                  </Step>
                </Stepper>

                <Banner
                  v-if="auto[index].status === 'failed' && starvedJob"
                  status="error"
                  :title="`${starvedJob.label} ran out of memory`"
                  :description="`The job asked for ${starvedJob.memoryGB} GB and the ${runner.label.toLowerCase()} runner has ${runner.memoryGB} GB. Size the runner up, or drop the job from the pipeline.`"
                >
                  <Button
                    label="Back to the pipeline"
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    @click="goToStep(1)"
                  />
                </Banner>
              </VStack>
            </VStack>
          </Step>
        </Stepper>

        <Text v-if="hasFailure" type="supporting" color="secondary">
          Setup is paused at the failed step above. Fix what it found and the remaining checks will pick up from there.
        </Text>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CSSProperties } from 'vue'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  Card,
  Center,
  Divider,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  Link,
  Section,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const BG_URL = '/template-assets/building.png'

const pageStyle: CSSProperties = {
  backgroundImage: `url(${BG_URL})`,
  backgroundSize: 'cover',
  backgroundPosition: 'center',
}

type Step = 'email' | 'sso-confirm' | 'password-fallback'

interface SSOProvider {
  name: string
  abbr: string
}

const SSO_PROVIDERS: Record<string, SSOProvider> = {
  'google.com': { name: 'Google Workspace', abbr: 'G' },
  'microsoft.com': { name: 'Microsoft Entra ID', abbr: 'M' },
  'okta.com': { name: 'Okta', abbr: 'O' },
  'meta.com': { name: 'Meta SSO', abbr: 'M' },
  'apple.com': { name: 'Apple Business', abbr: 'A' },
}

function getProvider(email: string) {
  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase()
  return domain ? (SSO_PROVIDERS[domain] ?? null) : null
}

function isValidEmail(email: string) {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@][^\s.@]*\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)
}

const step = ref<Step>('email')
const email = ref('')
const password = ref('')
const loginFailed = ref(false)
const isLoading = ref(false)

const provider = computed(() => getProvider(email.value))
const emailValid = computed(() => isValidEmail(email.value))

function handleContinue() {
  if (!emailValid.value)
    return
  if (provider.value)
    step.value = 'sso-confirm'
  else
    step.value = 'password-fallback'
}

function handleBack() {
  step.value = 'email'
  loginFailed.value = false
  isLoading.value = false
}

function handleSignIn() {
  if (!password.value) {
    loginFailed.value = true
    return
  }
  isLoading.value = true
  loginFailed.value = false
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    isLoading.value = false
    loginFailed.value = true
  }, 2000)
}

function onEmailKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter')
    handleContinue()
}

function onPasswordChange(value: string) {
  password.value = value
  loginFailed.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <Center axis="both" :padding="6" min-height="100%" :style="pageStyle">
    <Card :padding="8" width="100%" :max-width="400">
      <VStack :gap="4" h-align="stretch">
        <template v-if="step === 'email'">
          <VStack :gap="1" h-align="center">
            <Text type="display-1" as="h2">
              Welcome back
            </Text>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary" size="sm">
              Enter your details to sign in to your account
            </Text>
          </VStack>
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <TextInput
              v-model="email"
              label="Work email"
              is-label-hidden
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@company.com"
              size="lg"
              @keydown="onEmailKeydown"
            />
            <TextInput
              v-model="password"
              label="Password"
              is-label-hidden
              type="password"
              placeholder="Password"
              size="lg"
            />
          </VStack>
          <Link href="#" size="sm" color="secondary">
            Having trouble signing in?
          </Link>
          <Button
            label="Sign in"
            variant="primary"
            size="lg"
            :is-disabled="!emailValid"
            @click="handleContinue"
          />
          <Divider label="Or sign in with" />
          <Button
            label="Continue with SSO"
            variant="secondary"
            size="lg"
            :is-disabled="!emailValid"
            @click="handleContinue"
          />
          <VStack h-align="center">
            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
              Don't have an account?
              <Link href="#" size="sm">
                Request access
              </Link>
            </Text>
          </VStack>
        </template>

        <template v-else-if="step === 'sso-confirm' && provider">
          <VStack :gap="2" h-align="center">
            <Avatar :name="provider.name" :size="48" />
            <Text type="display-3" as="h2">
              Sign in with {{ provider.name }}
            </Text>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary" size="sm">
              You will be redirected back after signing in.
            </Text>
          </VStack>
          <Card :padding="0">
            <Section variant="muted" :padding="4">
              <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:shield-check" color="secondary" />
                <VStack :gap="0">
                  <Text type="label">
                    {{ provider.name }}
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                    {{ email }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
              </HStack>
            </Section>
          </Card>
          <VStack :gap="3">
            <Button
              :label="`Continue with ${provider.name}`"
              variant="primary"
              size="lg"
              :is-loading="isLoading"
              @click="isLoading = true"
            />
            <Button
              label="Use a different email"
              variant="ghost"
              size="lg"
              @click="handleBack"
            />
          </VStack>
        </template>

        <template v-else-if="step === 'password-fallback'">
          <VStack :gap="1" h-align="center">
            <Text type="display-1" as="h2">
              Welcome back
            </Text>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary" size="sm">
              {{ email }}
            </Text>
          </VStack>
          <VStack :gap="4">
            <VStack :gap="1">
              <TextInput
                :model-value="password"
                label="Password"
                type="password"
                size="lg"
                :status="loginFailed ? { type: 'error', message: 'Incorrect password. Try again.' } : undefined"
                @update:model-value="onPasswordChange"
              />
              <VStack v-if="loginFailed" h-align="end">
                <Link href="#" size="sm" color="secondary">
                  Forgot password?
                </Link>
              </VStack>
            </VStack>
            <Button
              label="Sign in"
              variant="primary"
              size="lg"
              :is-loading="isLoading"
              @click="handleSignIn"
            />
            <Button
              label="Use a different email"
              variant="ghost"
              size="lg"
              @click="handleBack"
            />
          </VStack>
        </template>
      </VStack>
    </Card>
  </Center>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  AspectRatio,
  Button,
  Card,
  Center,
  Dialog,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  Kbd,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  ListItem,
  SegmentedControl,
  SegmentedControlItem,
  SelectableCard,
  Selector,
  SideNav,
  SideNavItem,
  SideNavSection,
  StackItem,
  Switch,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  Token,
  useMediaQuery,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, defineComponent, h, ref, watch } from 'vue'

/** Below this the dialog swaps its rail for a strip of tabs. */
const NARROW_VIEWPORT = '(max-width: 640px)'

/** Floor for every control that sits in a row's right column. */
const CONTROL_WIDTH = 192

function noop() {}

type PanelId
  = | 'profile'
    | 'security'
    | 'billing'
    | 'appearance'
    | 'notifications'
    | 'shortcuts'
    | 'language'
    | 'privacy'
    | 'integrations'
    | 'developer'

interface PanelConfig {
  id: PanelId
  label: string
  description: string
  icon: string
}

/** Heroicons outline, one set, so every row icon carries the same stroke weight. */
const ICONS = {
  user: 'heroicons:user',
  userCircle: 'heroicons:user-circle',
  briefcase: 'heroicons:briefcase',
  tag: 'heroicons:tag',
  clock: 'heroicons:clock',
  signal: 'heroicons:signal',
  key: 'heroicons:key',
  lockClosed: 'heroicons:lock-closed',
  shieldCheck: 'heroicons:shield-check',
  fingerPrint: 'heroicons:finger-print',
  computerDesktop: 'heroicons:computer-desktop',
  devicePhone: 'heroicons:device-phone-mobile',
  cube: 'heroicons:cube',
  users: 'heroicons:users',
  envelope: 'heroicons:envelope',
  receiptPercent: 'heroicons:receipt-percent',
  creditCard: 'heroicons:credit-card',
  paintBrush: 'heroicons:paint-brush',
  swatch: 'heroicons:swatch',
  documentText: 'heroicons:document-text',
  bars3: 'heroicons:bars-3',
  handRaised: 'heroicons:hand-raised',
  atSymbol: 'heroicons:at-symbol',
  chatBubble: 'heroicons:chat-bubble-left-right',
  speakerWave: 'heroicons:speaker-wave',
  commandLine: 'heroicons:command-line',
  language: 'heroicons:language',
  mapPin: 'heroicons:map-pin',
  globeAlt: 'heroicons:globe-alt',
  calendarDays: 'heroicons:calendar-days',
  magnifyingGlass: 'heroicons:magnifying-glass',
  eye: 'heroicons:eye',
  sparkles: 'heroicons:sparkles',
  arrowDownTray: 'heroicons:arrow-down-tray',
  trash: 'heroicons:trash',
  folder: 'heroicons:folder',
  codeBracket: 'heroicons:code-bracket',
  link: 'heroicons:link',
  beaker: 'heroicons:beaker',
  documentMagnifyingGlass: 'heroicons:document-magnifying-glass',
  pencilSquare: 'heroicons:pencil-square',
  arrowDownOnSquare: 'heroicons:arrow-down-on-square',
  cog: 'heroicons:cog-6-tooth',
  puzzlePiece: 'heroicons:puzzle-piece',
  bell: 'heroicons:bell',
  sun: 'heroicons:sun',
  moon: 'heroicons:moon',
} as const

const PANEL_GROUPS: { label: string, panels: PanelConfig[] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'Account',
    panels: [
      { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', description: 'How you appear to everyone else in the workspace.', icon: ICONS.userCircle },
      { id: 'security', label: 'Login & security', description: 'Sign-in methods and the devices signed in right now.', icon: ICONS.lockClosed },
      { id: 'billing', label: 'Billing', description: 'Your plan, seats, and where invoices are sent.', icon: ICONS.creditCard },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Workspace',
    panels: [
      { id: 'appearance', label: 'Appearance', description: 'Theme and density for this browser.', icon: ICONS.paintBrush },
      { id: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications', description: 'What reaches you, and where it arrives.', icon: ICONS.bell },
      { id: 'shortcuts', label: 'Keyboard shortcuts', description: 'Rebind or switch off any shortcut on this surface.', icon: ICONS.commandLine },
      { id: 'language', label: 'Language & region', description: 'Language, formats, and time zone.', icon: ICONS.globeAlt },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Advanced',
    panels: [
      { id: 'privacy', label: 'Privacy', description: 'What you share, and what we keep.', icon: ICONS.shieldCheck },
      { id: 'integrations', label: 'Connected apps', description: 'Services with access to this workspace.', icon: ICONS.puzzlePiece },
      { id: 'developer', label: 'Developer', description: 'API access and pre-release features.', icon: ICONS.codeBracket },
    ],
  },
]

const PANELS = PANEL_GROUPS.flatMap(group => group.panels)

function panelConfig(id: PanelId) {
  return PANELS.find(panel => panel.id === id) ?? PANELS[0]
}

const settings = ref({
  displayName: 'Alex Johnson',
  jobTitle: 'Product designer',
  pronouns: 'they',
  showLocalTime: true,
  presence: 'available',
  twoFactor: true,
  billingEmail: 'billing@example.com',
  emailInvoices: true,
  theme: 'system',
  accent: 'blue',
  font: 'system',
  density: 'comfortable',
  reduceMotion: false,
  emailMentions: true,
  emailComments: false,
  weeklyDigest: true,
  desktopAlerts: true,
  notificationSounds: false,
  quietHours: 'none',
  language: 'en-US',
  region: 'US',
  timezone: 'PT',
  weekStart: 'sun',
  discoverable: true,
  readReceipts: true,
  activityStatus: false,
  personalization: true,
  apiAccess: false,
  webhookUrl: '',
  earlyAccess: false,
  verboseLogging: false,
})

function update<K extends keyof typeof settings.value>(key: K, value: (typeof settings.value)[K]) {
  settings.value = { ...settings.value, [key]: value }
}

/** `Selector` reports `string | number | null`; only a picked option reaches the state. */
function updateFromSelector<K extends keyof typeof settings.value>(key: K, value: string | number | null) {
  if (value == null)
    return
  update(key, String(value) as (typeof settings.value)[K])
}

// SegmentedControl 的 update:modelValue 事件参数在我们的类型里是 unknown，用可写
// computed 走 v-model，让 defineModel 那侧的 string 类型生效。
const density = computed({
  get: () => settings.value.density,
  set: (value: string) => update('density', value),
})

const weekStart = computed({
  get: () => settings.value.weekStart,
  set: (value: string) => update('weekStart', value),
})

const activePanel = ref<PanelId>('profile')
const titleId = 'settings-dialog-title'
const isNarrow = useMediaQuery(NARROW_VIEWPORT)
const searchQuery = ref('')
const searchActiveIndex = ref(0)

const SEARCHABLE_SETTINGS = [
  { title: 'Display name', description: 'The name shown on your posts and comments', panel: 'profile' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.userCircle },
  { title: 'Two-factor authentication', description: 'Require a second step when signing in', panel: 'security' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.key },
  { title: 'Active sessions', description: 'Devices currently signed in to this account', panel: 'security' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.computerDesktop },
  { title: 'Plan', description: 'Your current subscription and seat count', panel: 'billing' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.creditCard },
  { title: 'Color theme', description: 'Light, dark, or follow the system', panel: 'appearance' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.paintBrush },
  { title: 'Interface density', description: 'How much breathing room rows and lists get', panel: 'appearance' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.bars3 },
  { title: 'Email notifications', description: 'Mentions, comments, and the weekly digest', panel: 'notifications' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.envelope },
  { title: 'Quiet hours', description: 'Hold desktop notifications until the morning', panel: 'notifications' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.clock },
  { title: 'Keyboard shortcuts', description: 'Rebind a shortcut, or switch one off', panel: 'shortcuts' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.commandLine },
  { title: 'Time zone', description: 'Used for scheduling and timestamps', panel: 'language' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.globeAlt },
  { title: 'Read receipts', description: 'Let people see when you have read a message', panel: 'privacy' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.shieldCheck },
  { title: 'Export my data', description: 'Download everything this account holds', panel: 'privacy' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.arrowDownTray },
  { title: 'Connected apps', description: 'Calendar, storage, and chat integrations', panel: 'integrations' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.puzzlePiece },
  { title: 'API access', description: 'Personal access tokens and webhooks', panel: 'developer' as PanelId, icon: ICONS.codeBracket },
]

const normalizedSearch = computed(() => searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase())
const isSearchActive = computed(() => normalizedSearch.value.length > 0)
const searchResults = computed(() => {
  if (!isSearchActive.value)
    return []
  const q = normalizedSearch.value
  return SEARCHABLE_SETTINGS.filter(setting =>
    setting.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    || setting.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    || panelConfig(setting.panel).label.toLowerCase().includes(q),
  )
})

watch(normalizedSearch, () => { searchActiveIndex.value = 0 })

function selectPanel(panel: PanelId) {
  activePanel.value = panel
  searchQuery.value = ''
}

function onSearchKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === 'Escape' && searchQuery.value) {
    event.preventDefault()
    searchQuery.value = ''
    return
  }
  const results = searchResults.value
  if (!isSearchActive.value || results.length === 0)
    return
  if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    event.preventDefault()
    searchActiveIndex.value = (searchActiveIndex.value + 1) % results.length
  }
  else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    event.preventDefault()
    searchActiveIndex.value = (searchActiveIndex.value - 1 + results.length) % results.length
  }
  else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    event.preventDefault()
    const hit = results[searchActiveIndex.value]
    if (hit)
      selectPanel(hit.panel)
  }
}

const THEME_CHOICES = [
  { value: 'light', label: 'Light', icon: ICONS.sun },
  { value: 'dark', label: 'Dark', icon: ICONS.moon },
  { value: 'system', label: 'System', icon: ICONS.computerDesktop },
]

const INTERFACE_FONTS = [
  { value: 'system', label: 'System', stack: 'system-ui, sans-serif' },
  { value: 'serif', label: 'Serif', stack: 'Georgia, serif' },
  { value: 'mono', label: 'Monospace', stack: 'ui-monospace, monospace' },
]

/** The chosen face as a token override, so every `Text` in the preview follows it. */
const fontPreviewStyle = computed(() => ({
  '--astryx-font-family-body': INTERFACE_FONTS.find(font => font.value === settings.value.font)?.stack ?? '',
}))

const PRONOUN_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'none', label: 'Not specified' },
  { value: 'they', label: 'they/them' },
  { value: 'she', label: 'she/her' },
  { value: 'he', label: 'he/him' },
]

const PRESENCE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'available', label: 'Available' },
  { value: 'busy', label: 'Busy' },
  { value: 'away', label: 'Away' },
]

const ACCENT_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'blue', label: 'Blue' },
  { value: 'teal', label: 'Teal' },
  { value: 'purple', label: 'Purple' },
  { value: 'orange', label: 'Orange' },
]

const QUIET_HOURS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'none', label: 'Off' },
  { value: 'evening', label: '18:00 – 09:00' },
  { value: 'night', label: '22:00 – 07:00' },
]

const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'en-US', label: 'English (US)' },
  { value: 'en-GB', label: 'English (UK)' },
  { value: 'fr', label: 'Français' },
  { value: 'de', label: 'Deutsch' },
  { value: 'ja', label: '日本語' },
]

const REGION_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'US', label: 'United States' },
  { value: 'GB', label: 'United Kingdom' },
  { value: 'DE', label: 'Germany' },
  { value: 'JP', label: 'Japan' },
]

const TIMEZONE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'PT', label: 'Pacific (GMT-08:00)' },
  { value: 'MT', label: 'Mountain (GMT-07:00)' },
  { value: 'CT', label: 'Central (GMT-06:00)' },
  { value: 'ET', label: 'Eastern (GMT-05:00)' },
  { value: 'UTC', label: 'UTC (GMT+00:00)' },
]

const SHORTCUTS = [
  { id: 'search', label: 'Search everything', keys: 'mod+k', icon: ICONS.magnifyingGlass },
  { id: 'new', label: 'New item', keys: 'mod+n', icon: ICONS.pencilSquare },
  { id: 'save', label: 'Save', keys: 'mod+s', icon: ICONS.arrowDownOnSquare },
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Open settings', keys: 'mod+,', icon: ICONS.cog },
]

const shortcutEnabled = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({
  search: true,
  new: true,
  save: true,
  settings: true,
})

const SearchIcon = defineComponent({
  render: () => h(Icon, { name: ICONS.magnifyingGlass }),
})
</script>

<template>
  <Center height="100dvh">
    <Dialog
      is-open
      is-inline
      purpose="form"
      :width="1120"
      max-height="min(800px, calc(100dvh - 2rem))"
      :padding="0"
      class="settings-dialog-frame"
      :aria-labelledby="titleId"
      @open-change="noop"
    >
      <VStack class="settings-dialog-shell" :gap="0">
        <Layout>
          <template v-if="!isNarrow" #start>
            <SideNav aria-label="Settings sections" class="settings-side-nav">
              <template #header>
                <HStack :gap="2" align="center" :padding-inline="2" :min-height="32" width="100%">
                  <Heading :id="titleId" :level="4">
                    Settings
                  </Heading>
                </HStack>
              </template>
              <template #top>
                <TextInput
                  v-model="searchQuery"
                  label="Search settings"
                  is-label-hidden
                  placeholder="Search settings"
                  size="sm"
                  width="100%"
                  has-clear
                  :start-icon="SearchIcon"
                  @keydown="onSearchKeydown"
                />
              </template>
              <template v-if="isSearchActive">
                <VStack
                  v-if="searchResults.length === 0"
                  id="settings-search-results"
                  :gap="0.5"
                  :padding="2"
                >
                  <Text type="label">
                    No settings found
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
                <VStack v-else id="settings-search-results" :gap="0" is-scrollable>
                  <ListItem
                    v-for="(result, index) in searchResults"
                    :key="result.title"
                    :label="result.title"
                    :description="result.description"
                    :is-selected="index === searchActiveIndex"
                    @mouseenter="searchActiveIndex = index"
                    @click="selectPanel(result.panel)"
                  >
                    <template #startContent>
                      <Icon :name="result.icon" size="sm" color="secondary" />
                    </template>
                  </ListItem>
                </VStack>
              </template>
              <template v-else>
                <SideNavSection
                  v-for="group in PANEL_GROUPS"
                  :key="group.label"
                  :title="group.label"
                  class="settings-side-nav-section"
                >
                  <SideNavItem
                    v-for="panel in group.panels"
                    :key="panel.id"
                    :label="panel.label"
                    :is-selected="panel.id === activePanel"
                    @click="selectPanel(panel.id)"
                  >
                    <template #icon>
                      <Icon :name="panel.icon" size="sm" color="primary" />
                    </template>
                  </SideNavItem>
                </SideNavSection>
              </template>
            </SideNav>
          </template>

          <LayoutContent is-scrollable :padding="4">
            <VStack v-if="isNarrow" :gap="2" class="settings-narrow-header">
              <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <Text :id="titleId" type="label">
                    Settings
                  </Text>
                </StackItem>
                <IconButton label="Close" variant="ghost" size="sm" @click="noop">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:x-mark" size="sm" />
                </IconButton>
              </HStack>
              <TextInput
                v-model="searchQuery"
                label="Search settings"
                is-label-hidden
                placeholder="Search settings"
                size="sm"
                width="100%"
                has-clear
                :start-icon="SearchIcon"
                role="combobox"
                aria-autocomplete="list"
                aria-controls="settings-search-results"
                :aria-expanded="isSearchActive && searchResults.length > 0"
                @keydown="onSearchKeydown"
              />
              <VStack
                v-if="isSearchActive && searchResults.length === 0"
                id="settings-search-results"
                :gap="0.5"
                :padding="2"
              >
                <Text type="label">
                  No settings found
                </Text>
                <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                  Try theme, notifications, or sessions.
                </Text>
              </VStack>
              <VStack
                v-else-if="isSearchActive"
                id="settings-search-results"
                as="ul"
                role="listbox"
                aria-label="Search results"
                :gap="0"
              >
                <ListItem
                  v-for="(result, index) in searchResults"
                  :key="result.title"
                  role="option"
                  :aria-selected="index === searchActiveIndex"
                  :label="result.title"
                  :description="result.description"
                  :is-selected="index === searchActiveIndex"
                  @mouseenter="searchActiveIndex = index"
                  @click="selectPanel(result.panel)"
                >
                  <template #startContent>
                    <Icon :name="result.icon" size="sm" color="secondary" />
                  </template>
                </ListItem>
              </VStack>
              <HStack
                v-else
                as="nav"
                aria-label="Settings sections"
                :gap="1"
                wrap="nowrap"
                is-scrollable
              >
                <Button
                  v-for="panel in PANELS"
                  :key="panel.id"
                  :label="panel.label"
                  :variant="panel.id === activePanel ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'"
                  size="sm"
                  @click="selectPanel(panel.id)"
                >
                  <template #icon>
                    <Icon :name="panel.icon" size="sm" />
                  </template>
                </Button>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>

            <HStack v-else width="100%" justify="end" class="settings-close-anchor">
              <HStack class="settings-close-backing">
                <IconButton label="Close" variant="ghost" size="sm" @click="noop">
                  <Icon name="heroicons:x-mark" size="sm" />
                </IconButton>
              </HStack>
            </HStack>

            <VStack :gap="4" class="settings-panel">
              <HStack :gap="2" align="start">
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <VStack :gap="0.5">
                    <Heading :level="2">
                      {{ panelConfig(activePanel).label }}
                    </Heading>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      {{ panelConfig(activePanel).description }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </StackItem>
                <VStack v-if="!isNarrow" aria-hidden="true" :width="32" />
              </HStack>

              <VStack v-if="activePanel === 'profile'" :gap="5" class="settings-cards">
                <VStack :gap="1.5">
                  <Text type="supporting" weight="semibold" color="secondary">
                    Identity
                  </Text>
                  <Card variant="muted" :padding="0" width="100%">
                    <div role="list">
                      <div class="settings-row" role="listitem">
                        <div class="settings-row-main">
                          <span class="settings-row-icon"><Icon :name="ICONS.user" size="sm" color="secondary" /></span>
                          <div class="settings-row-text">
                            <Text type="label">
                              Display name
                            </Text>
                            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                              Shown on your posts, comments, and mentions.
                            </Text>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="settings-row-control">
                          <TextInput
                            v-model="settings.displayName"
                            label="Display name"
                            is-label-hidden
                            size="sm"
                            :width="CONTROL_WIDTH"
                            @update:model-value="v => update('displayName', v)"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Divider variant="subtle" role="presentation" />
                      <div class="settings-row" role="listitem">
                        <div class="settings-row-main">
                          <span class="settings-row-icon"><Icon :name="ICONS.briefcase" size="sm" color="secondary" /></span>
                          <div class="settings-row-text">
                            <Text type="label">
                              Job title
                            </Text>
                            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                              Appears under your name on your profile card.
                            </Text>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="settings-row-control">
                          <TextInput
                            v-model="settings.jobTitle"
                            label="Job title"
                            is-label-hidden
                            size="sm"
                            :width="CONTROL_WIDTH"
                            @update:model-value="v => update('jobTitle', v)"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Divider variant="subtle" role="presentation" />
                      <div class="settings-row" role="listitem">
                        <div class="settings-row-main">
                          <span class="settings-row-icon"><Icon :name="ICONS.tag" size="sm" color="secondary" /></span>
                          <div class="settings-row-text">
                            <Text type="label">
                              Pronouns
                            </Text>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="settings-row-control">
                          <Selector
                            :model-value="settings.pronouns"
                            label="Pronouns"
                            is-label-hidden
                            size="sm"
                            :width="CONTROL_WIDTH"
                            :options="PRONOUN_OPTIONS"
                            @update:model-value="v => updateFromSelector('pronouns', v)"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                </VStack>

                <VStack :gap="1.5">
                  <Text type="supporting" weight="semibold" color="secondary">
                    Availability
                  </Text>
                  <Card variant="muted" :padding="0" width="100%">
                    <div role="list">
                      <div class="settings-row" role="listitem">
                        <div class="settings-row-main">
                          <span class="settings-row-icon"><Icon :name="ICONS.clock" size="sm" color="secondary" /></span>
                          <div class="settings-row-text">
                            <Text type="label">
                              Show my local time
                            </Text>
                            <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                              Helps people across time zones pick a sane hour.
                            </Text>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="settings-row-control">
                          <Switch
                            :model-value="settings.showLocalTime"
                            label="Show my local time"
                            is-label-hidden
                            @update:model-value="v => update('showLocalTime', v)"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Divider variant="subtle" role="presentation" />
                      <div class="settings-row" role="listitem">
                        <div class="settings-row-main">
                          <span class="settings-row-icon"><Icon :name="ICONS.signal" size="sm" color="secondary" /></span>
                          <div class="settings-row-text">
                            <Text type="label">
                              Presence
                            </Text>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="settings-row-control">
                          <Selector
                            :model-value="settings.presence"
                            label="Presence"
                            is-label-hidden
                            size="sm"

/* 待 core 修复后去掉：原版 Dialog 的最大宽度是 min(100%, 100dvw - 2 × 16px)，两侧各留 16px。 */
.settings-dialog-frame {
  max-width: min(100%, calc(100dvw - 2rem));
}
.settings-dialog-shell {
  height: min(800px, calc(100dvh - 2rem));
}
.settings-side-nav {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
/* 待 core 修复后去掉：SideNav 的内容区在分组之间多了 4px 间距、底部内边距 4px（原版无间距、底部 8px）。 */
.settings-side-nav .astryx-side-nav__body {
  gap: 0;
  padding-block-end: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
}
/* 待 core 修复后去掉：Switch 的行是 inline-flex，外层多出行高基线空隙（28 对 24），开关被顶高 2px。 */
.settings-row-control .astryx-switch-row {
  display: flex;
}
.settings-side-nav-section {
  /* 待 core 修复后去掉 gap：SideNavSection 在标题和条目之间多了 2px 间距，原版没有。 */
  gap: 0;
  padding-block: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
}
.settings-close-anchor {
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  height: 0;
}
.settings-close-backing {
  display: flex;
  background-color: var(--astryx-color-background-surface);
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
}
.settings-narrow-header {
  padding-block-end: var(--astryx-spacing-3);
}
/* The column every row measures itself against: rows stack on the width the
   panel actually got, not on the viewport's. */
.settings-panel {
  container-type: inline-size;
  container-name: settings-panel;
}
/* One row: name and explanation beside the control, the control's own width
   held open, and any extra content spanning the row underneath. */
.settings-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-3);
  padding: var(--astryx-spacing-4);
}
.settings-row-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
  min-width: 0;
}
/* The icon box aligns to the title's box; a hair of top padding makes it read
   level with the cap height beside it. */
.settings-row-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding-block-start: var(--astryx-spacing-0-5);
}
.settings-row-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-0-5);
  max-width: 420px;
}
.settings-row-control {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.settings-row-detail {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.font-preview {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-1);
  padding: var(--astryx-spacing-3);
  background-color: var(--astryx-color-background-surface);
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
}
@container settings-panel (max-width: 480px) {
  .settings-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
  }
  .settings-row-text {
    max-width: none;
  }
}
.theme-swatch {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--astryx-color-background-muted);
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
}
.theme-swatch[data-theme='dark'] {
  background: #1a1a1a;
}
.theme-swatch[data-theme='system'] {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--astryx-color-background-muted) 50%, #1a1a1a 50%);
}
</style>
