  { label: '(GMT+00:00) UTC', value: 'UTC' },
  { label: '(GMT+01:00) London', value: 'GMT+1' },
]

/** 每行一个字段；`isReadOnly` 的那一行只显示，不给编辑入口。 */
interface PersonalField {
  key: string
  label: string
  isReadOnly?: boolean
}

const PERSONAL_FIELDS: PersonalField[] = [
  { key: 'legalName', label: 'Legal name' },
  { key: 'preferredName', label: 'Preferred first name' },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email address' },
  { key: 'phone', label: 'Phone number' },
  { key: 'identity', label: 'Identity verification', isReadOnly: true },
  { key: 'address', label: 'Residential address' },
  { key: 'mailingAddress', label: 'Mailing address' },
  { key: 'emergencyContact', label: 'Emergency contact' },
] as const

/** 值留空的字段显示占位文案，和原版一致。 */
const PERSONAL_PLACEHOLDERS: Record<string, string> = {
  preferredName: 'Not provided',
  address: 'Not provided',
  mailingAddress: 'Not provided',
}

const HELP_CARDS = [
  {
    icon: 'heroicons:lock-closed',
    title: 'Why isn\'t my info shown here?',
    body: 'We\'re hiding some account details to protect your identity.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'heroicons:pencil-square',
    title: 'Which details can be edited?',
    body: 'Contact info and personal details can be edited. If this info was used to verify your identity, you\'ll need to get verified again the next time you book—or to continue hosting.',
  },
  {
    icon: 'heroicons:share',
    title: 'What info is shared with others?',
    body: 'We only release contact information after a reservation is confirmed.',
  },
]

// ── 状态 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const isNarrow = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)')

const mobileView = ref<'nav' | 'detail'>('nav')
const activeNav = ref('Personal information')
const activeTab = ref('login')

const expandedRow = ref<string | null>(null)
const language = ref('en-CA')
const currency = ref('CAD')
const timezone = ref('ET')

const personal = reactive<Record<string, string>>({
  legalName: 'Alex Johnson',
  preferredName: '',
  email: 'a***n@example.com',
  phone: '+1 ***-***-0123',
  address: '',
  mailingAddress: '',
  emergencyContact: 'Provided',
})

const readReceipts = ref(true)
const searchEngines = ref(true)
const showCity = ref(true)
const showTripType = ref(true)
const showStayLength = ref(true)
const showServices = ref(true)
const aiFeatures = ref(true)

function selectNav(label: string) {
  activeNav.value = label
  mobileView.value = 'detail'
}

function labelForOption(options: { label: string, value: string }[], value: string) {
  return options.find(o => o.value === value)?.label ?? value
}

function personalValue(key: string) {
  const value = personal[key]
  return value || PERSONAL_PLACEHOLDERS[key] || value
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout
    v-if="isNarrow && mobileView === 'nav'"
    height="fill"
    :style="fillViewport"
  >
    <LayoutContent :padding="2">
      <VStack :gap="4" :style="sideNavPadding">
        <Heading :level="2" :style="sideNavHeading">
          Account settings
        </Heading>
        <List density="spacious">
          <ListItem
            v-for="item in NAV_ITEMS"
            :key="item.label"
            :label="item.label"
            @click="selectNav(item.label)"
          >
            <template #startContent>
              <Icon size="md" :name="item.icon" />
            </template>
            <template #endContent>
              <Icon name="heroicons:chevron-right" size="sm" color="secondary" />
            </template>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Divider />
        <List density="spacious">
          <ListItem label="Professional hosting tools">
            <template #startContent>
              <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:wrench-screwdriver" />
            </template>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>

  <Layout
    v-else
    height="fill"
    :content-width="1200"
    :style="fillViewport"
  >
    <template v-if="!isNarrow" #start>
      <LayoutPanel :has-divider="true" :padding="0">
        <VStack :gap="4" :style="sideNavPadding">
          <Heading :level="2" :style="sideNavHeading">
            Account settings
          </Heading>
          <List density="spacious">
            <ListItem
              v-for="item in NAV_ITEMS"
              :key="item.label"
              :label="item.label"
              :is-selected="activeNav === item.label"
              @click="selectNav(item.label)"
            >
              <template #startContent>
                <Icon size="md" :name="item.icon" />
              </template>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
          <Divider />
          <List density="spacious">
            <ListItem label="Professional hosting tools">
              <template #startContent>
                <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:wrench-screwdriver" />
              </template>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="4">
      <VStack :gap="0">
        <Toolbar
          v-if="isNarrow"
          :label="`Back to Account settings — ${SECTION_TITLES[activeNav] ?? activeNav}`"
          :gap="2"
        >
          <template #start>
            <Button
              label="Back to Account settings"
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              is-icon-only
              @click="mobileView = 'nav'"
            >
              <template #icon>
                <Icon name="heroicons:arrow-left" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </Button>
            <Heading :level="2">
              {{ SECTION_TITLES[activeNav] ?? activeNav }}
            </Heading>
          </template>
        </Toolbar>

        <VStack v-if="activeNav === 'Login & security'" :gap="6">
          <Heading v-if="!isNarrow" :level="2">
            Login & security
          </Heading>
          <TabList :value="activeTab" has-divider @update:value="activeTab = $event">
            <Tab value="login" label="Login" />
            <Tab value="shared" label="Shared access" />
          </TabList>

          <VStack v-if="activeTab === 'login'" :gap="8">
            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Login
              </Heading>
              <Divider />
              <template v-for="row in LOGIN_ROWS" :key="row.label">
                <HStack justify="between" align="start" :style="rowPadding">
                  <VStack :gap="0">
                    <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                      {{ row.label }}
                    </Text>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                      {{ row.value }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                  <Link v-if="row.action" size="md" href="#">
                    {{ row.action }}
                  </Link>
                </HStack>
                <Divider />
              </template>
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Social accounts
              </Heading>
              <Divider />
              <template v-for="row in SOCIAL_ROWS" :key="row.label">
                <HStack justify="between" align="start" :style="rowPadding">
                  <VStack :gap="0">
                    <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                      {{ row.label }}
                    </Text>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                      {{ row.value }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                  <Link size="md" href="#">
                    {{ row.action }}
                  </Link>
                </HStack>
                <Divider />
              </template>
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Device history
              </Heading>
              <Divider />
              <HStack
                v-for="(device, i) in DEVICE_ROWS"
                :key="i"
                :gap="3"
                align="start"
                :style="rowPadding"
              >
                <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:computer-desktop" />
                <StackItem size="fill">
                  <VStack :gap="0">
                    <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
                      <Text type="body" weight="semibold">
                        {{ device.label }}
                      </Text>
                      <Badge v-if="device.badge" :label="device.badge" />
                    </HStack>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                      {{ device.location }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </StackItem>
                <Link v-if="device.action" size="md" href="#">
                  {{ device.action }}
                </Link>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Account
              </Heading>
              <Divider />
              <HStack justify="between" align="start" :style="rowPadding">
                <VStack :gap="0">
                  <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                    Deactivate your account
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                    This action cannot be undone
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
                <Link size="md" href="#">
                  Deactivate
                </Link>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>
          </VStack>

          <VStack v-else :gap="8">
            <VStack :gap="2">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Shared access
              </Heading>
              <Divider />
              <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                Review each request carefully before approving access. We'll email your employee or co-worker a 4-digit code that lets them log into your account with their trusted device.
              </Text>
            </VStack>
            <Card variant="muted">
              <HStack :gap="4" align="start">
                <Center :width="48" :height="48" :style="iconBox">
                  <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:lock-closed" />
                </Center>
                <VStack :gap="1">
                  <Text type="body" weight="bold">
                    Adding devices from people you trust
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="body" color="secondary">
                    When you approve a request, you grant someone full access to your account. They'll be able to change reservations and send messages on your behalf.
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
              </HStack>
            </Card>
          </VStack>
        </VStack>

        <VStack v-else-if="activeNav === 'Languages & currency'" :gap="6">
          <Heading v-if="!isNarrow" :level="2">
            Languages & currency
          </Heading>
          <VStack :gap="0">
            <template
              v-for="row in [
                { key: 'language', label: 'Preferred language', options: LANGUAGES, current: language },
                { key: 'currency', label: 'Preferred currency', options: CURRENCIES, current: currency },
                { key: 'timezone', label: 'Time zone', options: TIMEZONES, current: timezone },
              ]" :key="row.key"
            >
              <VStack v-if="expandedRow === row.key" :gap="4" :style="rowPadding">
                <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                  {{ row.label }}
                </Text>
                <Selector
                  v-if="row.key === 'language'"
                  v-model="language"
                  :label="row.label"
                  is-label-hidden
                  size="lg"
                  :options="row.options"
                />
                <Selector
                  v-else-if="row.key === 'currency'"
                  v-model="currency"
                  :label="row.label"
                  is-label-hidden
                  size="lg"
                  :options="row.options"
                />
                <Selector
                  v-else
                  v-model="timezone"
                  :label="row.label"
                  is-label-hidden
                  size="lg"
                  :options="row.options"
                />
                <HStack :gap="2">
                  <Button label="Save" variant="primary" @click="expandedRow = null" />
                  <Button label="Cancel" variant="ghost" @click="expandedRow = null" />
                </HStack>
              </VStack>
              <HStack v-else justify="between" align="start" :style="rowPadding">
                <VStack :gap="0">
                  <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                    {{ row.label }}
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                    {{ labelForOption(row.options, row.current) }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
                <Link size="md" href="#" @click.prevent="expandedRow = row.key">
                  Edit
                </Link>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </template>
          </VStack>
        </VStack>

        <VStack v-else-if="activeNav === 'Personal information'" :gap="6">
          <Heading v-if="!isNarrow" :level="2">
            Personal info
          </Heading>
          <VStack :gap="0">
            <template v-for="field in PERSONAL_FIELDS" :key="field.key">
              <VStack
                v-if="!field.isReadOnly && expandedRow === field.key"
                :gap="4"
                :style="rowPadding"
              >
                <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                  {{ field.label }}
                </Text>
                <TextInput
                  v-model="personal[field.key]"
                  :label="field.label"
                  is-label-hidden
                />
                <HStack :gap="2">
                  <Button label="Save" variant="primary" @click="expandedRow = null" />
                  <Button label="Cancel" variant="ghost" @click="expandedRow = null" />
                </HStack>
              </VStack>
              <HStack v-else justify="between" align="start" :style="rowPadding">
                <VStack :gap="0">
                  <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                    {{ field.label }}
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                    {{ field.isReadOnly ? 'Verified' : personalValue(field.key) }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
                <Link
                  v-if="!field.isReadOnly"
                  size="md"
                  href="#"
                  @click.prevent="expandedRow = field.key"
                >
                  Edit
                </Link>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </template>
          </VStack>

          <Card :padding="4">
            <VStack :gap="4">
              <template v-for="(card, i) in HELP_CARDS" :key="card.title">
                <Divider v-if="i > 0" />
                <HStack :gap="3" align="start">
                  <Center :width="48" :height="48" :style="iconBox">
                    <Icon size="md" :name="card.icon" />
                  </Center>
                  <VStack :gap="0">
                    <Text type="body" weight="semibold" display="block">
                      {{ card.title }}
                    </Text>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" display="block">
                      {{ card.body }}
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </HStack>
              </template>
            </VStack>
          </Card>
        </VStack>

        <VStack v-else-if="activeNav === 'Privacy'" :gap="6">
          <Heading v-if="!isNarrow" :level="2">
            Privacy
          </Heading>
          <VStack :gap="8">
            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Messages
              </Heading>
              <VStack :style="rowPadding">
                <Switch
                  v-model="readReceipts"
                  label="Show people when I've read their messages."
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
              </VStack>
              <HStack justify="between" align="center" :style="rowPadding">
                <Text type="body" weight="semibold">
                  Blocked people
                </Text>
                <Link size="md" href="#">
                  View
                </Link>
              </HStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="0">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Listings
              </Heading>
              <VStack :style="rowPadding">
                <Switch
                  v-model="searchEngines"
                  label="Include my listing(s) in search engines"
                  description="Turning this on means search engines, like Google, will display your listing page(s) in search results."
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
              </VStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="4">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Reviews
              </Heading>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                Choose what's shared when you write a review.
                <Link href="#" size="sm">
                  Learn more
                </Link>
              </Text>
              <VStack :gap="4">
                <Switch
                  v-model="showCity"
                  label="Show my home city and country"
                  description="Ex: City and country"
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
                <Switch
                  v-model="showTripType"
                  label="Show my trip type"
                  description="Ex: Stayed with kids or pets"
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
                <Switch
                  v-model="showStayLength"
                  label="Show my length of stay"
                  description="Ex: A few nights, about a week, etc."
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
                <Switch
                  v-model="showServices"
                  label="Show my booked services"
                  description="Ex: Gourmet brunch or tasting menu"
                  label-position="start"
                  label-spacing="spread"
                />
              </VStack>
              <Divider />
            </VStack>

            <VStack :gap="4">
              <Heading :level="3">
                Data privacy
              </Heading>
              <Card>
                <HStack justify="between" align="center">
                  <Text type="body">
                    Request my personal data
                  </Text>
                  <Link size="md" href="#">
                    Request
                  </Link>
                </HStack>
              </Card>
              <Switch
                v-model="aiFeatures"
                label="Help improve AI-powered features"
                description="When this is on, we use your data to develop and improve AI models."
                label-position="start"
                label-spacing="spread"
              />
              <Card>
                <HStack justify="between" align="center">
                  <Text type="body">
                    Delete my account
                  </Text>
                  <Link size="md" href="#">
                    Delete
                  </Link>
                </HStack>
              </Card>
              <Card variant="muted">
                <HStack :gap="4" align="start">
                  <Center :width="48" :height="48" :style="iconBox">
                    <Icon size="md" name="heroicons:shield-check" />
                  </Center>
                  <VStack :gap="1">
                    <Text type="body" weight="bold">
                      Committed to privacy
                    </Text>
                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                      We're committed to keeping your data protected. See details in our
                      <Link href="#" size="sm">
                        Privacy Policy
                      </Link>.
                    </Text>
                  </VStack>
                </HStack>
              </Card>
            </VStack>
          </VStack>
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import type { TreeListItemData } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { defineComponent, h, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import {
  AppShell,
  Button,
  Card,
  CommandPalette,
  createStaticSource,
  Divider,
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  Kbd,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  SideNav,
  Stack,
  TextInput,
  TopNav,
  TreeList,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'

const searchQuery = ref('')

const noop = () => {}

function iconComponent(className: string): Component {
  return defineComponent({
    render: () => h('span', { class: className, 'aria-hidden': 'true', style: 'width:1em;height:1em' }),
  })
}

const FILE_TREE: TreeListItemData[] = [
  {
    id: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    icon: 'i-heroicons-folder',
    isExpanded: true,
    children: [
      {
        id: 'components',
        label: 'components',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-folder',
        isExpanded: true,
        children: [
          { id: 'AppShell.tsx', label: 'AppShell.tsx', icon: 'i-heroicons-document', isSelected: true },
          { id: 'TopNav.tsx', label: 'TopNav.tsx', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
          { id: 'SideNav.tsx', label: 'SideNav.tsx', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: 'hooks',
        label: 'hooks',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-folder',
        isExpanded: true,
        children: [
          { id: 'useTheme.ts', label: 'useTheme.ts', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
          { id: 'useResizable.ts', label: 'useResizable.ts', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
        ],
      },
      { id: 'index.tsx', label: 'index.tsx', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
      { id: 'App.tsx', label: 'App.tsx', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'public',
    label: 'public',
    icon: 'i-heroicons-folder',
    isExpanded: false,
    children: [
      { id: 'favicon.ico', label: 'favicon.ico', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
      { id: 'robots.txt', label: 'robots.txt', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'package.json', label: 'package.json', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
  { id: 'tsconfig.json', label: 'tsconfig.json', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
  { id: 'README.md', label: 'README.md', icon: 'i-heroicons-document' },
]

type MenuEntry = [label: string, shortcut: string]

const MENU_WIDTH = 280

const MENUS: { label: string, groups: MenuEntry[][] }[] = [
  {
    label: 'File',
    groups: [
      [['New File', '⌘N'], ['New Window', '⇧⌘N']],
      [['Open...', '⌘O'], ['Save', '⌘S'], ['Save As...', '⇧⌘S']],
      [['Close Editor', '⌘W']],
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Edit',
    groups: [
      [['Undo', '⌘Z'], ['Redo', '⇧⌘Z']],
      [['Cut', '⌘X'], ['Copy', '⌘C'], ['Paste', '⌘V']],
      [['Find', '⌘F']],
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'View',
    groups: [
      [['Command Palette', '⇧⌘P']],
      [['Explorer', '⇧⌘E'], ['Search', '⇧⌘F']],
      [['Toggle Terminal', '⌃`'], ['Zen Mode', '⌘K']],
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Window',
    groups: [
      [['Minimize', '⌘M'], ['Zoom', '']],
      [['Next Tab', '⌃⇥'], ['Previous Tab', '⌃⇧⇥']],
      [['Bring All to Front', '']],
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Help',
    groups: [
      [
        ['Documentation', ''],
        ['Release Notes', ''],
        ['Report Issue', ''],
        ['About', ''],
      ],
    ],
  },
]

const CODE_LINES = [
  '38%', '62%', '54%', '0%', '46%', '70%', '58%', '34%', '0%', '50%', '66%', '42%', '60%', '28%',
]

const EDITOR_TABS = ['AppShell.tsx', 'TopNav.tsx', 'theme.ts']

const COMMANDS = [
  { id: 'new-file', label: 'New File' },
  { id: 'open-file', label: 'Open File…' },
  { id: 'save-all', label: 'Save All' },
  { id: 'find-in-files', label: 'Find in Files' },
  { id: 'toggle-terminal', label: 'Toggle Terminal' },
  { id: 'go-to-symbol', label: 'Go to Symbol…' },
  { id: 'appshell', label: 'AppShell.tsx' },
  { id: 'topnav', label: 'TopNav.tsx' },
  { id: 'sidenav', label: 'SideNav.tsx' },
  { id: 'use-theme', label: 'useTheme.ts' },
  { id: 'theme', label: 'theme.ts' },
]

const isPaletteOpen = ref(false)
const searchSource = createStaticSource(COMMANDS)

function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {

onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown))

<script setup lang="ts">
import {

} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue'
import type { VNodeChild } from 'vue'

type Modality = 'text' | 'image' | 'audio' | 'video' | 'document'

const MODALITY_ORDER: Modality[] = ['text', 'image', 'audio', 'video', 'document']

/** 原版用 lucide 描边图标；这里按 lucide 的路径自绘成组件，颜色走 currentColor。 */
function lucideIcon(nodes: Array<[string, Record<string, string | number>]>, strokeWidth = 2) {
  return () => h('svg', {
    'xmlns': 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',
    'viewBox': '0 0 24 24',
    'fill': 'none',
    'stroke': 'currentColor',
    'stroke-width': strokeWidth,
    'stroke-linecap': 'round',
    'stroke-linejoin': 'round',
    'width': '1em',
    'height': '1em',
    'aria-hidden': 'true',
    'style': { fill: 'none' },
  }, nodes.map(([tag, attrs]) => h(tag, attrs)))
}

const TextTypeIcon = lucideIcon([
  ['path', { d: 'M12 4v16' }],
  ['path', { d: 'M4 7V5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h14a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2' }],
  ['path', { d: 'M9 20h6' }],
], 1.5)
const ImageIcon = lucideIcon([
  ['rect', { width: 18, height: 18, x: 3, y: 3, rx: 2, ry: 2 }],
  ['circle', { cx: 9, cy: 9, r: 2 }],
  ['path', { d: 'm21 15-3.086-3.086a2 2 0 0 0-2.828 0L6 21' }],
])
const AudioLinesIcon = lucideIcon([['path', { d: 'M2 10v3m4-7v11m4-14v18m4-13v7m4-10v13m4-8v3' }]])
const VideoIcon = lucideIcon([
  ['path', { d: 'm16 13 5.223 3.482a.5.5 0 0 0 .777-.416V7.87a.5.5 0 0 0-.752-.432L16 10.5' }],
  ['rect', { width: 14, height: 12, x: 2, y: 6, rx: 2 }],
])
const FileTextIcon = lucideIcon([
  ['path', { d: 'M6 22a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.704.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8v12a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z' }],
  ['path', { d: 'M14 2v5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5M10 9H8m8 4H8m8 4H8' }],
])

/** 布尔格的「支持 / 不支持」，和原版一样是描边圆形图标（lucide circle-check / circle-x）。 */
function outlineCircle(paths: string[]) {
  return lucideIcon([['circle', { cx: 12, cy: 12, r: 10 }], ...paths.map((d): [string, Record<string, string>] => ['path', { d }])])
}
const CircleCheckIcon = outlineCircle(['m9 12 2 2 4-4'])
const CircleXIcon = outlineCircle(['m15 9-6 6', 'm9 9 6 6'])

const MODALITY_ICON = {
  text: TextTypeIcon,
  image: ImageIcon,
  audio: AudioLinesIcon,
  video: VideoIcon,
  document: FileTextIcon,
}

/** 选择器里每个提供商的图标。 */
const PROVIDER_ICON: Record<string, string> = {
  'Northwind': 'i-heroicons-cpu-chip',
  'Calder Labs': 'i-heroicons-sparkles',
  'Halcyon': 'i-heroicons-bolt',
  'Sable AI': 'i-heroicons-cube',
}

const MODALITY_LABEL: Record<Modality, string> = {
  text: 'Text',
  image: 'Image',
  audio: 'Audio',
  video: 'Video',
  document: 'Document',
}

interface Model {
  id: string
  name: string
  provider: string
  context: number
  maxOutput: number
  cutoff: string
  inputModalities: Modality[]
  outputModalities: Modality[]
  hasOpenWeights: boolean
  inputPrice: number
  outputPrice: number
  cachedPrice: number
  speed: number
  latency: number
  mmlu: number
  humanEval: number
  math: number
  rateLimit: number
  hasStreaming: boolean
  hasTools: boolean
  hasFineTuning: boolean
}

const MODELS: Model[] = [
  { id: 'atlas-4-flash', name: 'Atlas 4 Flash', provider: 'Northwind', context: 1_000_000, maxOutput: 65_536, cutoff: 'Mar 2026', inputModalities: ['text', 'image'], outputModalities: ['text'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 0.1, outputPrice: 0.4, cachedPrice: 0.025, speed: 186, latency: 0.28, mmlu: 78.4, humanEval: 84.1, math: 71.2, rateLimit: 4_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: true, },
  { id: 'atlas-4-pro', name: 'Atlas 4 Pro', provider: 'Northwind', context: 2_000_000, maxOutput: 131_072, cutoff: 'Mar 2026', inputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'audio', 'document'], outputModalities: ['text', 'audio'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 1.25, outputPrice: 5.0, cachedPrice: 0.31, speed: 74, latency: 0.62, mmlu: 88.7, humanEval: 93.4, math: 89.1, rateLimit: 1_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: false, },
  { id: 'meridian-2-5-flash', name: 'Meridian 2.5 Flash', provider: 'Calder Labs', context: 1_048_576, maxOutput: 8_192, cutoff: 'Jan 2026', inputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'video'], outputModalities: ['text'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 0.075, outputPrice: 0.3, cachedPrice: 0.019, speed: 214, latency: 0.24, mmlu: 76.9, humanEval: 81.7, math: 68.4, rateLimit: 2_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: true, },
  { id: 'meridian-2-5-pro', name: 'Meridian 2.5 Pro', provider: 'Calder Labs', context: 2_097_152, maxOutput: 65_536, cutoff: 'Jan 2026', inputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'audio', 'video', 'document'], outputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'audio'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 1.25, outputPrice: 10.0, cachedPrice: 0.31, speed: 62, latency: 0.71, mmlu: 89.3, humanEval: 92.8, math: 91.6, rateLimit: 360, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: false, },
  { id: 'orion-mini-3', name: 'Orion Mini 3', provider: 'Halcyon', context: 262_144, maxOutput: 32_768, cutoff: 'Nov 2025', inputModalities: ['text'], outputModalities: ['text'], hasOpenWeights: true, inputPrice: 0.05, outputPrice: 0.2, cachedPrice: 0.012, speed: 248, latency: 0.19, mmlu: 71.2, humanEval: 74.6, math: 58.9, rateLimit: 8_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: true, },
  { id: 'orion-3-ultra', name: 'Orion 3 Ultra', provider: 'Halcyon', context: 524_288, maxOutput: 65_536, cutoff: 'Nov 2025', inputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'document'], outputModalities: ['text', 'image'], hasOpenWeights: true, inputPrice: 0.9, outputPrice: 2.7, cachedPrice: 0.22, speed: 96, latency: 0.48, mmlu: 85.1, humanEval: 89.2, math: 82.3, rateLimit: 1_200, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: true, },
  { id: 'kestrel-v4-turbo', name: 'Kestrel V4 Turbo', provider: 'Sable AI', context: 400_000, maxOutput: 16_384, cutoff: 'Feb 2026', inputModalities: ['text', 'image', 'document'], outputModalities: ['text'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 0.3, outputPrice: 1.2, cachedPrice: 0.075, speed: 142, latency: 0.33, mmlu: 82.6, humanEval: 87.3, math: 77.8, rateLimit: 3_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: true, hasFineTuning: false, },
  { id: 'kestrel-v4-lite', name: 'Kestrel V4 Lite', provider: 'Sable AI', context: 128_000, maxOutput: 8_192, cutoff: 'Feb 2026', inputModalities: ['text'], outputModalities: ['text'], hasOpenWeights: false, inputPrice: 0.04, outputPrice: 0.16, cachedPrice: 0.01, speed: 265, latency: 0.17, mmlu: 68.4, humanEval: 70.1, math: 54.2, rateLimit: 10_000, hasStreaming: true, hasTools: false, hasFineTuning: false, },
]

const DEFAULT_SLOTS = ['atlas-4-flash', 'meridian-2-5-flash', 'kestrel-v4-turbo']
const MIN_SLOTS = 2

const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const price = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 3 })
const whole = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })
const decimal = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })

type GroupKey = 'Overview' | 'Pricing' | 'Performance' | 'Availability' | 'Benchmarks' | 'Limits'

interface SpecRow extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  label: string
  group: GroupKey
  better?: 'higher' | 'lower'
  get: (model: Model) => number | string | boolean
  format?: (value: number) => string
  unit?: string
  isScore?: boolean
  /** 整格自绘（跳过排名）。 */
  renderValue?: (model: Model) => VNodeChild
  /** 模态行：格子位置固定，缺的项画成暗色。 */
  modalities?: (model: Model) => Modality[]
}

// ===== 30 天可用性条 =====

const UPTIME_DAYS = 30
const UPTIME_END = new Date('2026-09-07T00:00:00Z')
const dayFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })
const uptimeFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })

/** 用模型 id 做种子的 xorshift：每个模型有自己固定的故障历史。 */
function dailyUptime(seed: number, days: number): number[] {
  let state = seed || 1
  const next = () => {
    state ^= state << 13
    state ^= state >>> 17
    state ^= state << 5
    return Math.abs(state % 1000) / 1000
  }
  const rough = next()
  const outageOdds = 0.01 + rough * 0.05
  const degradedOdds = outageOdds + 0.03 + rough * 0.09
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const roll = next()
    if (roll < outageOdds)
      out.push(96.5 + next() * 2.4)
    else if (roll < degradedOdds)
      out.push(99.0 + next() * 0.9)
    else
      out.push(99.95 + next() * 0.05)
  }
  return out
}

function hashId(id: string): number {
  let hash = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i++)
    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + id.charCodeAt(i)
  return hash
}

function uptimeStatus(value: number): { color: string, status: string } {
  if (value >= 99.95)
    return { color: 'var(--astryx-color-success)', status: 'Operational' }
  if (value >= 99)
    return { color: 'var(--astryx-color-warning)', status: 'Degraded' }
  return { color: 'var(--astryx-color-error)', status: 'Outage' }
}

/** 一行文字（平均值，悬停时换成当天读数）加一条 30 根的日柱。 */
const UptimeStrip = defineComponent({
  props: { modelId: { type: String, required: true } },
  setup(props) {
    const hovered = ref<number | null>(null)
    const days = computed(() => dailyUptime(hashId(props.modelId), UPTIME_DAYS).map((uptime, i) => {
      const date = new Date(UPTIME_END)
      date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() - (UPTIME_DAYS - 1 - i))
      return { uptime, date: dayFormat.format(date), ...uptimeStatus(uptime) }
    }))
    const average = computed(() => days.value.reduce((total, day) => total + day.uptime, 0) / days.value.length)
    /** 颜色是日柱唯一的编码，读屏用户拿到的是同一份统计。 */
    const spoken = computed(() => {
      const tally: Record<string, number> = {}
      for (const day of days.value)
        tally[day.status] = (tally[day.status] ?? 0) + 1
      return `Last ${UPTIME_DAYS} days: ${['Operational', 'Degraded', 'Outage'].filter(status => tally[status] > 0).map(status => `${tally[status]} ${status.toLowerCase()}`).join(', ')}.`
    })
    return () => {
      const day = hovered.value == null ? undefined : days.value[hovered.value]
      return h(VStack, { gap: 1, hAlign: 'end', width: '100%' }, () => [
        h(VisuallyHidden, null, () => spoken.value),
        h(HStack, { height: 24, vAlign: 'center' }, () => h(Text, { type: 'body', color: 'primary' }, () =>
          day == null ? `${uptimeFormat.format(average.value)}% average` : `${day.date} · ${uptimeFormat.format(day.uptime)}% · ${day.status}`)),
        h('div', { style: { display: 'flex', width: '100%', height: '28px' }, role: 'img', ariaLabel: `Last ${UPTIME_DAYS} days uptime`, onMouseleave: () => { hovered.value = null } },
          days.value.map((d, i) => h('div', { key: i, style: { flex: '1 1 0', minWidth: 0, padding: '0 1px', display: 'flex' }, onMouseenter: () => { hovered.value = i } },
            h('div', { style: { flex: 1, borderRadius: '2px', background: d.color } })))),
      ])
    }
  },
})

const SPEC_ROWS: SpecRow[] = [
  { id: 'provider', group: 'Overview', label: 'Provider', get: m => m.provider },
  { id: 'context', group: 'Overview', label: 'Context window', unit: 'tokens', better: 'higher', get: m => m.context, format: v => compact.format(v) },
  { id: 'max-output', group: 'Overview', label: 'Max output', unit: 'tokens', better: 'higher', get: m => m.maxOutput, format: v => compact.format(v) },
  { id: 'cutoff', group: 'Overview', label: 'Knowledge cutoff', get: m => m.cutoff },
  { id: 'input-modalities', group: 'Overview', label: 'Input modalities', get: () => '', modalities: m => m.inputModalities },
  { id: 'output-modalities', group: 'Overview', label: 'Output modalities', get: () => '', modalities: m => m.outputModalities },
  { id: 'open-weights', group: 'Overview', label: 'Open weights', get: m => m.hasOpenWeights },
  { id: 'input-price', group: 'Pricing', label: 'Input', unit: '/1M', better: 'lower', get: m => m.inputPrice, format: v => price.format(v) },
  { id: 'output-price', group: 'Pricing', label: 'Output', unit: '/1M', better: 'lower', get: m => m.outputPrice, format: v => price.format(v) },
  { id: 'cached-price', group: 'Pricing', label: 'Cached input', unit: '/1M', better: 'lower', get: m => m.cachedPrice, format: v => price.format(v) },
  { id: 'blended', group: 'Pricing', label: 'Blended (3:1)', unit: '/1M', better: 'lower', get: m => (m.inputPrice * 3 + m.outputPrice) / 4, format: v => price.format(v) },
  { id: 'speed', group: 'Performance', label: 'Output speed', unit: 'tok/s', better: 'higher', get: m => m.speed, format: v => String(Math.round(v)) },
  { id: 'latency', group: 'Performance', label: 'Time to first token', unit: 'sec', better: 'lower', get: m => m.latency, format: v => decimal.format(v) },
  { id: 'mmlu', group: 'Benchmarks', label: 'MMLU-Pro', better: 'higher', get: m => m.mmlu, format: v => decimal.format(v), isScore: true },
  { id: 'human-eval', group: 'Benchmarks', label: 'HumanEval', better: 'higher', get: m => m.humanEval, format: v => decimal.format(v), isScore: true },
  { id: 'math', group: 'Benchmarks', label: 'MATH', better: 'higher', get: m => m.math, format: v => decimal.format(v), isScore: true },
  { id: 'rate-limit', group: 'Limits', label: 'Rate limit', unit: '/min', better: 'higher', get: m => m.rateLimit, format: v => whole.format(v) },
  { id: 'streaming', group: 'Limits', label: 'Streaming', get: m => m.hasStreaming },
  { id: 'tools', group: 'Limits', label: 'Function calling', get: m => m.hasTools },
  { id: 'fine-tuning', group: 'Limits', label: 'Fine-tuning', get: m => m.hasFineTuning },
  { id: 'usage', group: 'Availability', label: 'Uptime (30d)', get: m => m.name, renderValue: m => h(UptimeStrip, { modelId: m.id }) },
]

const GROUP_ORDER: GroupKey[] = ['Overview', 'Pricing', 'Performance', 'Availability', 'Benchmarks', 'Limits']

const slots = ref<string[]>([...DEFAULT_SLOTS])
const highlightBest = ref(true)

const modelById = new Map(MODELS.map(m => [m.id, m]))

const selectedModels = computed(() =>
  slots.value.map(id => modelById.get(id)).filter((m): m is Model => m != null),
)

const bestByRow = computed(() => {
  const best = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const row of SPEC_ROWS) {
    if (!row.better)
      continue
    const values = selectedModels.value
      .map(row.get)
      .filter((v): v is number => typeof v === 'number')
    if (!values.length)
      continue
    best.set(row.id, row.better === 'higher' ? Math.max(...values) : Math.min(...values))
  }
  return best
})

function selectSlot(index: number, modelId: string): void {
  slots.value = slots.value.map((current, i) => (i === index ? modelId : current))
}

function removeSlot(index: number): void {
  if (slots.value.length <= MIN_SLOTS)
    return
  slots.value = slots.value.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
}

function addModel(): void {
  const next = MODELS.find(m => !slots.value.includes(m.id))
  if (next)
    slots.value = [...slots.value, next.id]
}

const collapsedGroups = ref(new Set<string>())

function toggleGroup(key: string): void {
  const next = new Set(collapsedGroups.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  collapsedGroups.value = next
}

const grouped = useTableGroupedRows<SpecRow>(() => ({
  data: SPEC_ROWS,
  groupBy: row => row.group,
  groupOrder: GROUP_ORDER,
  collapsedGroups: collapsedGroups.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: row => row.id,
  renderGroupHeader: groupKey => h(HStack, { gap: 2, vAlign: 'center', style: { position: 'sticky', insetInlineStart: 'var(--astryx-spacing-6)', width: 'fit-content' } }, () =>
    h(Heading, { level: 3, accessibilityLevel: 2 }, () => groupKey),
  ),
}))

const sticky = useTableStickyColumns<SpecRow>({ startKeys: ['spec'] })

/** 正被悬停或聚焦的模型列；清除（即移除该列）只在这时出现。 */
const activeHeader = ref<number | null>(null)

/** 模型列的表头就是一个选择器；已被其它列选中的模型不可再选，保留至少 MIN_SLOTS 列时才显示清除。 */
function renderModelHeader(index: number, modelId: string) {
  const setActive = (value: boolean) => {
    activeHeader.value = value ? index : (activeHeader.value === index ? null : activeHeader.value)
  }
  return h('div', {
    class: 'model-header',
    style: { flex: '1 1 100%', minWidth: 0 },
    onMouseenter: () => setActive(true),
    onMouseleave: () => setActive(false),
    onFocusin: () => setActive(true),
    onFocusout: () => setActive(false),
  }, h(Selector, {
    'modelValue': modelId,
    'label': `Model ${index + 1}`,
    'isLabelHidden': true,
    'size': 'lg',
    'hasClear': activeHeader.value === index && slots.value.length > MIN_SLOTS,
    'options': MODELS.map(option => ({
      value: option.id,
      label: option.name,
      description: option.provider,
      icon: PROVIDER_ICON[option.provider],
      disabled: option.id !== modelId && slots.value.includes(option.id),
    })),
    'onUpdate:modelValue': (next: string | number | null) => next == null ? removeSlot(index) : selectSlot(index, String(next)),
  }))
}

const columns = computed<TableColumn<SpecRow>[]>(() => [
  {
    key: 'spec',
    header: 'Models',
    width: pixel(220),
    renderCell: row => h(HStack, { vAlign: 'center', height: 24 }, () => h(Text, { type: 'label', color: 'secondary' }, () => row.label)),
  },
  ...slots.value.map((modelId, index) => {
    const model = modelById.get(modelId)
    return {
      key: `slot-${index}`,
      width: proportional(1, { minWidth: 236 }),
      align: 'end' as const,
      header: () => renderModelHeader(index, modelId),
      renderCell: (row: SpecRow) => {
        if (!model)
          return h(Text, { type: 'supporting' }, () => '—')
        if (row.renderValue)
          return row.renderValue(model)
        if (row.modalities) {
          const included = row.modalities(model)
          const explanation = MODALITY_ORDER.map(modality => `${MODALITY_LABEL[modality]}: ${included.includes(modality) ? 'supported' : 'not supported'}`).join('; ')
          return h(Tooltip, { content: explanation, hasHoverIndication: false, touchTrigger: 'tap' }, () => h(HStack, { gap: 3, vAlign: 'center', hAlign: 'end', height: 24, tabindex: 0, role: 'group', ariaLabel: 'Model modalities' }, () => MODALITY_ORDER.map(modality =>
            h(HStack, { width: 20, height: 20, hAlign: 'center', vAlign: 'center' }, () => h(Icon, {
              icon: MODALITY_ICON[modality],
              size: 'md',
              color: included.includes(modality) ? 'primary' : 'disabled',
            })),
          )))
        }
        const value = row.get(model)
        if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
          return h(HStack, { gap: 1, hAlign: 'end', vAlign: 'center', height: 24 }, () => h(Icon, {
            icon: value ? CircleCheckIcon : CircleXIcon,
            label: value ? 'Supported' : 'Not supported',
            size: 'md',
            color: value ? 'success' : 'error',
          }))
        }
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
          return h(HStack, { gap: 1, vAlign: 'center', hAlign: 'end', height: 24 }, () => h(Text, { type: 'large', weight: 'normal' }, () => value))
        }
        const best = bestByRow.value.get(row.id)
        const isBest = highlightBest.value && best != null && value === best
        if (row.isScore) {
          return h(HStack, { gap: 1, vAlign: 'center', hAlign: 'end', height: 24 }, () => [
            h(HStack, { width: 56, vAlign: 'center' }, () => h(ProgressBar, { label: `Score ${decimal.format(value)} out of 100`, isLabelHidden: true, value, variant: 'accent', width: '100%' })),
            h(Text, { type: 'large', hasTabularNumbers: true, weight: isBest ? 'semibold' : 'normal' }, () => row.format?.(value) ?? String(value)),
          ])
        }
        const formatted = row.format?.(value) ?? String(value)
        return h(HStack, { gap: 1, vAlign: 'center', hAlign: 'end', height: 24, class: isBest ? 'best-cell' : undefined }, () => [
          h(Text, { type: 'large', hasTabularNumbers: true, weight: isBest ? 'semibold' : 'normal' }, () => formatted),
          row.unit ? h(Text, { type: 'large', weight: 'normal', color: isBest ? 'primary' : 'secondary' }, () => row.unit) : null,
        ])
      },
    }
  }),
])

.table-frame :deep(.astryx-table td.astryx-table__group:first-child) {

/* 胜出的格子整格铺满底色：抵掉 spacious 密度下单元格自己的内边距。 */

}
</style>

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

const NOW_MS = Date.now()

/** 把整批日期平移，让积压跨过今天，最新的活儿大约在三周后。 */
const DATE_SHIFT_MS = NOW_MS + 21 * DAY_MS - Math.max(...seedJobs.map(j => Date.parse(j.scheduledAt)))

/** 过去的活儿不可能还在等， authored 状态只在日期撑得住时保留。 */
function statusForDate(authored: JobStatus, when: number): JobStatus {
  if (when > NOW_MS)
    return 'scheduled'
  const isRecent = when > NOW_MS - 45 * DAY_MS
  if (authored === 'scheduled')
    return isRecent ? 'overdue' : 'completed'
  if (authored === 'in_progress' && !isRecent)
    return 'completed'
  return authored
}

/** 原始几条按日历往回循环五轮，凑出一条更长的积压。 */
const allJobs: ServiceJob[] = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, cycle) =>
  seedJobs.map((job, index) => {
    const cycleDays = cycle === 0 ? 0 : cycle * 37 + ((index * 13) % 29)
    const when = Date.parse(job.scheduledAt) + DATE_SHIFT_MS - cycleDays * DAY_MS
    const scheduledOn = new Date(when)
    return {
      ...job,
      id: cycle === 0 ? job.id : `SJ-${1999 - (cycle - 1) * seedJobs.length - index}`,
      status: statusForDate(job.status, when),
      scheduledAt: scheduledOn.toISOString(),
      scheduledOn,
      quoted: cycle === 0 ? job.quoted : job.quoted + ((index * 17) % 9) * 10,
    }
  }),
).flat()

const TECHNICIANS = Array.from(new Set(allJobs.map(j => j.technician))).sort()
const CUSTOMERS = Array.from(new Set(allJobs.map(j => j.customer))).sort()

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

function formatTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso)
  const hours = d.getUTCHours()
  const minutes = String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')
  const suffix = hours < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'
  const hour12 = hours % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hours % 12
  return `${hour12}:${minutes}${suffix}`
}

function formatDate(iso: string, withYear = false): string {
  const d = new Date(iso)
  const base = `${MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()]} ${d.getUTCDate()}`
  return withYear ? `${base}, ${d.getUTCFullYear()}` : base
}

const formatScheduled = (iso: string): string => `${formatDate(iso)}, ${formatTime(iso)}`
const formatMoney = (amount: number): string => `$${amount.toLocaleString('en-US')}`

// ============= Power Search 配置 =============

/** 字段定义同时喂给筛选行的子句和高级搜索模式，两种模式读写同一组 filter。 */
const fieldDefs = [
  { key: 'summary', type: 'string', label: 'Job' },
  { key: 'id', type: 'string', label: 'ID' },
  { key: 'customer', type: 'enum', label: 'Customer', enumValues: CUSTOMERS.map(v => ({ value: v, label: v })) },
  { key: 'technician', type: 'enum', label: 'Technician', enumValues: TECHNICIANS.map(v => ({ value: v, label: v })) },
  { key: 'status', type: 'enum', label: 'Status', enumValues: (Object.keys(STATUS_META) as JobStatus[]).map(v => ({ value: v, label: STATUS_META[v].label })) },
  { key: 'priority', type: 'enum', label: 'Priority', enumValues: (Object.keys(PRIORITY_META) as Priority[]).map(v => ({ value: v, label: PRIORITY_META[v].label })) },
  { key: 'scheduledOn', type: 'date', label: 'Scheduled' },
  { key: 'quoted', type: 'number', label: 'Quote' },
] as const

const { config: searchConfig, applyFilters } = usePowerSearchConfig(fieldDefs, 'Jobs')

/** 屏幕打开时只显示进行中的活儿——除了 Completed 以外的所有状态。 */
const INITIAL_FILTERS: PowerSearchFilter[] = [
  { field: 'status', operator: 'is_any_of', value: { type: 'enum_list', value: ['scheduled', 'in_progress', 'on_hold', 'overdue'] } },
]

/** Upcoming 预置子句：排期在今天之后。 */
const UPCOMING_FILTER: PowerSearchFilter = {
  field: 'scheduledOn',
  operator: 'after',
  value: { type: 'date_absolute', unixSeconds: Math.floor(NOW_MS / 1000) },
}

const filters = ref<PowerSearchFilter[]>([...INITIAL_FILTERS])
const isPowerSearch = ref(false)
const query = ref('')

const hasFilters = computed(() => filters.value.length > 0 || query.value !== '')

function sameFilter(a: PowerSearchFilter, b: PowerSearchFilter): boolean {
  return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)
}

/** 写某个字段的单条子句；null 表示撤掉这个字段的筛选。 */
function setFieldFilter(fieldKey: string, next: PowerSearchFilter | null): void {
  activeSavedViewId.value = null
  const rest = filters.value.filter(f => f.field !== fieldKey)
  filters.value = next ? [...rest, next] : rest
}

function togglePreset(preset: PowerSearchFilter): void {
  activeSavedViewId.value = null
  filters.value = filters.value.some(f => sameFilter(f, preset))
    ? filters.value.filter(f => !sameFilter(f, preset))
    : [...filters.value.filter(f => f.field !== preset.field), preset]
}

function clearAll(): void {
  filters.value = []
  query.value = ''
  activeSavedViewId.value = null
}

const isUpcoming = computed(() => filters.value.some(f => sameFilter(f, UPCOMING_FILTER)))

// ============= 多选字段 =============

/** 多选字段共用一套读写：一条 is_any_of 子句装整个列表。 */
function readMultiValues(fieldKey: string): string[] {
  const active = filters.value.find(f => f.field === fieldKey)
  const raw = active ? (active.value as { value?: unknown }).value : null
  if (Array.isArray(raw))
    return raw.map(String)
  return raw == null ? [] : [String(raw)]
}

function writeMultiValues(fieldKey: string, next: string[]): void {
  setFieldFilter(
    fieldKey,
    next.length === 0
      ? null
      : { field: fieldKey, operator: 'is_any_of', value: { type: 'enum_list', value: next } },
  )
}

const statusFilter = computed({
  get: () => readMultiValues('status'),
  set: value => writeMultiValues('status', value),
})
const customerFilter = computed({
  get: () => readMultiValues('customer'),
  set: value => writeMultiValues('customer', value),
})
const technicianFilter = computed({
  get: () => readMultiValues('technician'),
  set: value => writeMultiValues('technician', value),
})

// ============= Priority 单选 =============

const priorityFilter = computed<string | null>({
  get: () => {
    const active = filters.value.find(f => f.field === 'priority')
    const raw = active ? (active.value as { value?: unknown }).value : null
    return raw == null ? null : String(raw)
  },
  set: (value) => {
    setFieldFilter(
      'priority',
      value == null
        ? null
        : { field: 'priority', operator: 'is', value: { type: 'enum', value } },
    )
  },
})

// ============= Quote 区间 =============

const QUOTE_MIN = 0
const QUOTE_MAX = Math.ceil(Math.max(...allJobs.map(j => j.quoted)) / 500) * 500
const QUOTE_STEP = 100

function quoteBound(operator: string, fallback: number): number {
  const found = filters.value.find(f => f.field === 'quoted' && f.operator === operator)
  return found ? Number((found.value as { value: number }).value) : fallback
}

const quoteLow = computed(() => quoteBound('greater_than_or_equal', QUOTE_MIN))
const quoteHigh = computed(() => quoteBound('less_than_or_equal', QUOTE_MAX))
const hasQuoteFilter = computed(() => quoteLow.value > QUOTE_MIN || quoteHigh.value < QUOTE_MAX)

/** 拖动中的区间；松手后才写进 filters，和原版一致。 */
const quoteDraft = ref<[number, number]>([QUOTE_MIN, QUOTE_MAX])
watch([quoteLow, quoteHigh], () => {
  quoteDraft.value = [quoteLow.value, quoteHigh.value]
})

function commitQuote(next: [number, number]): void {
  quoteDraft.value = next
  activeSavedViewId.value = null
  const rest = filters.value.filter(f => f.field !== 'quoted')
  const bounds: PowerSearchFilter[] = []
  if (next[0] > QUOTE_MIN) {
    bounds.push({ field: 'quoted', operator: 'greater_than_or_equal', value: { type: 'integer', value: next[0] } })
  }
  if (next[1] < QUOTE_MAX) {
    bounds.push({ field: 'quoted', operator: 'less_than_or_equal', value: { type: 'integer', value: next[1] } })
  }
  filters.value = [...rest, ...bounds]
}

/** 区间收起后的整句，没动过就是占位的「Quote」。 */
const quoteLabel = computed(() => {
  if (!hasQuoteFilter.value)
    return undefined
  if (quoteLow.value > QUOTE_MIN && quoteHigh.value < QUOTE_MAX)
    return `Quote ${formatMoney(quoteLow.value)} – ${formatMoney(quoteHigh.value)}`
  return quoteLow.value > QUOTE_MIN ? `Quote over ${formatMoney(quoteLow.value)}` : `Quote under ${formatMoney(quoteHigh.value)}`
})

// ============= 结果集 =============

const results = computed(() => {
  const byFilters = applyFilters(filters.value, allJobs)
  const term = query.value.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!term)
    return byFilters
  return byFilters.filter(j =>
    j.summary.toLowerCase().includes(term)
    || j.customer.toLowerCase().includes(term)
    || j.id.toLowerCase().includes(term),
  )
})

/** 筛选或搜索一变就回到第一页，顶部进度条站一班岗。 */
const isLoading = ref(false)
let loadingTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
watch([filters, query], () => {
  isLoading.value = true
  clearTimeout(loadingTimer)
  loadingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    isLoading.value = false
  }, 450)
})
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(loadingTimer))

/** 视图选项里拖动排序：按住把手，行跟着指针走，松手落位。 */
const columnRowRefs = new Map<string, HTMLElement>()
const reorderDropKey = ref<string | null>(null)

function columnRowRef(key: string) {
  return (el: unknown) => {
    if (el == null)
      columnRowRefs.delete(key)
    else
      columnRowRefs.set(key, el as HTMLElement)
  }
}

let reorderSession: { key: string, pointerId: number, fromIndex: number } | null = null

function onGripPointerDown(event: PointerEvent, key: string): void {
  const fromIndex = view.value.columnKeys.indexOf(key)
  if (fromIndex < 0)
    return
  reorderSession = { key, pointerId: event.pointerId, fromIndex }
  ;(event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)
}

function onGripPointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
  if (reorderSession == null)
    return
  const over = [...columnRowRefs.entries()].find(([, el]) => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    return event.clientY >= rect.top && event.clientY <= rect.bottom
  })
  reorderDropKey.value = over?.[0] ?? null
}

function onGripPointerUp(): void {
  if (reorderSession == null)
    return
  const { key, fromIndex } = reorderSession
  const toKey = reorderDropKey.value
  reorderSession = null
  reorderDropKey.value = null
  if (toKey == null || toKey === key)
    return
  const toIndex = view.value.columnKeys.indexOf(toKey)
  if (toIndex < 0)
    return
  updateView((current) => {
    const next = [...current.columnKeys]
    next.splice(fromIndex, 1)
    next.splice(toIndex, 0, key)
    return { ...current, columnKeys: next }
  })
}

  data: () => results.value,

  defaultSort: [{ sortKey: 'priority', direction: 'ascending' }],
})

const SORT_RANKS: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {
  priority: { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 },
  status: { overdue: 0, on_hold: 1, in_progress: 2, scheduled: 3, completed: 4 },
}

/**
 * 分组时组序优先于排序键（原版 comparator 先比组），保证一个组的行连续、
 * 分页切点落在组边界；不分组时直接用排序组合的结果。
 */
const groupMajorData = computed(() => {
  if (!isGrouped.value)
    return sortedData.value
  const order = GROUP_ORDERS[groupField.value]
  const rank = new Map(order.map((key, index) => [key, index]))
  return [...results.value].sort((a, b) => {
    const byGroup = (rank.get(groupKeyOf(a, groupField.value)) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
      - (rank.get(groupKeyOf(b, groupField.value)) ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
    if (byGroup !== 0)
      return byGroup
    for (const { sortKey, direction } of sortConfig.sort) {
      const av = a[sortKey]
      const bv = b[sortKey]
      const ranks = SORT_RANKS[sortKey]
      let cmp: number
      if (ranks != null) {
        cmp = (ranks[String(av)] ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (ranks[String(bv)] ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
      }
      else if (typeof av === 'number' && typeof bv === 'number') {
        cmp = av - bv
      }
      else {
        cmp = String(av ?? '').localeCompare(String(bv ?? ''))
      }
      if (cmp !== 0)
        return direction === 'ascending' ? cmp : -cmp
    }
    return 0
  })
})

// ============= 无限加载 =============

const PAGE_SIZE = 15
const SKELETON_ROWS = 5

const loadedCount = ref(PAGE_SIZE)
const isLoadingNext = ref(false)
let nextTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
let inFlight = false

/** 分组时把分页切点补齐到当前组末尾，不把一个组截成两半。 */
const visibleCount = computed(() => {
  const items = groupMajorData.value
  if (loadedCount.value >= items.length)
    return items.length
  if (!isGrouped.value)
    return loadedCount.value
  const openKey = groupKeyOf(items[loadedCount.value - 1], groupField.value)
  let end = loadedCount.value
  while (end < items.length && groupKeyOf(items[end], groupField.value) === openKey)
    end++
  return end
})

const pagedData = computed(() => groupMajorData.value.slice(0, visibleCount.value))

watch(groupMajorData, () => {
  loadedCount.value = PAGE_SIZE
  isLoadingNext.value = false
})

function loadNext(count: number): void {
  if (inFlight)
    return
  inFlight = true
  isLoadingNext.value = true
  clearTimeout(nextTimer)
  nextTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    loadedCount.value = visibleCount.value + count
    isLoadingNext.value = false
    inFlight = false
  }, 500)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(nextTimer))

const hasNext = computed(() => visibleCount.value < sortedData.value.length)

const sentinelRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
let sentinelScrollRoot: HTMLElement | null = null

/** 哨兵的滚动容器：页面滚就是 document，内容区内部滚就是那个容器。 */
function scrollRootOf(el: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement | null {
  let node = el?.parentElement ?? null
  while (node != null) {
    const overflowY = getComputedStyle(node).overflowY
    if ((overflowY === 'auto' || overflowY === 'scroll') && node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight)
      return node
    node = node.parentElement
  }
  return null
}

/** 哨兵距滚动容器底部不足 240px 就取下一批，和原版的 IntersectionObserver 同语义。 */
function checkSentinel(): void {
  const el = sentinelRef.value
  if (el == null || !hasNext.value)
    return
  const elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
  const rootRect = sentinelScrollRoot == null
    ? { top: 0, bottom: window.innerHeight }
    : sentinelScrollRoot.getBoundingClientRect()
  if (elRect.top - rootRect.bottom < 240)
    loadNext(PAGE_SIZE)
}

function bindSentinel(el: HTMLElement | null): void {
  if (sentinelScrollRoot != null && sentinelScrollRoot !== document.scrollingElement) {
    sentinelScrollRoot.removeEventListener('scroll', checkSentinel)
    sentinelScrollRoot = null
  }
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', checkSentinel)
  window.removeEventListener('resize', checkSentinel)
  if (el == null)
    return
  sentinelScrollRoot = scrollRootOf(el)
  const root = sentinelScrollRoot ?? document.scrollingElement
  if (root != null && root !== document.scrollingElement)
    root.addEventListener('scroll', checkSentinel, { passive: true })
  window.addEventListener('scroll', checkSentinel, { passive: true })
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkSentinel)
  checkSentinel()
}

 * 保存视图带结构化筛选，高级搜索表达不了，所以应用视图时退出高级搜索。

function applySavedView(saved: SavedView | null): void {
  activeSavedViewId.value = saved?.id ?? null
  filters.value = saved ? cloneFilters(saved.filters) : []

  if (saved == null)

  isSavedViewsBarOpen.value = true
}

  editing.value = null
}

function deleteSavedView(id: string): void {
  savedViews.value = savedViews.value.filter(item => item.id !== id)

  editing.value = null

const OPERATOR_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  is: 'is',
  is_any_of: 'is any of',
  greater_than_or_equal: '≥',
  less_than_or_equal: '≤',
  after: 'after',
}

function filterValueText(filter: PowerSearchFilter): string {
  const raw = (filter.value as { value?: unknown }).value
  const label = (v: unknown) => {
    const keyValue = String(v ?? '')
    return VALUE_LABELS[keyValue] ?? keyValue
  }
  return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.map(label).join(', ') : label(raw)
}

/** 一条子句按高级搜索的说法拼成一句，保存视图在任何地方读法一致。 */
function filterTokenLabel(filter: PowerSearchFilter): string {
  const field = fieldDefs.find(f => f.key === filter.field)
  const name = field?.label ?? filter.field
  const operator = OPERATOR_LABELS[filter.operator] ?? filter.operator
  const raw = filter.value as { value?: unknown, unixSeconds?: number }
  let value: string
  if (typeof raw.unixSeconds === 'number') {
    value = formatDate(new Date(raw.unixSeconds * 1000).toISOString(), true)
  }
  else if (Array.isArray(raw.value) && raw.value.length > 1) {
    const [first, ...rest] = raw.value.map(v => VALUE_LABELS[String(v)] ?? String(v))
    value = `${first} +${rest.length}`
  }
  else if (field?.type === 'number' && typeof raw.value === 'number') {
    value = formatMoney(raw.value)
  }
  else {
    value = filterValueText(filter)
  }
  return `${name} ${operator} ${value}`
}

function labelOf(options: { value: string, label: string }[], value: string): string {
  return options.find(option => option.value === value)?.label ?? value
}

const DENSITY_PADDING: Record<Density, number> = { compact: 8, balanced: 12, spacious: 16 }

function skeletonCellStyle(key: string): Record<string, string> {
  const column = COLUMN_DEFS.get(key)
  const width = column?.width as { type?: string, value?: number, minWidth?: number } | undefined
  if (width?.type === 'pixel')
    return { width: `${width.value}px`, flexShrink: '0' }
  if (width?.type === 'proportional')
    return { flex: `${width.value ?? 1} 1 ${width.minWidth ?? 120}px` }
  return { flex: '1 1 120px' }
}
