                          :label="powerSearchLabel"
                          :tooltip="powerSearchLabel"
                          is-icon-only
                          size="sm"
                          :is-pressed="isPowerSearch"
                          @pressed-change="isPowerSearch = $event"
                        >
                          <template #icon>
                            <Icon :name="isPowerSearch ? 'heroicons:adjustments-horizontal-solid' : 'heroicons:adjustments-horizontal'" size="sm" />
                          </template>
                        </ToggleButton>
                        <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                          {{ results.length }} {{ results.length === 1 ? 'result' : 'results' }}
                        </Text>
                        <template v-if="hasFilters">
                          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                            •
                          </Text>
                          <Text type="supporting">
                            <Link color="primary" @click="clearAll">
                              Clear all
                            </Link>
                          </Text>
                        </template>
                      </HStack>
                    </StackItem>
                  </HStack>
                </StackItem>

                <HStack :gap="3" align="center" class="tf-end">
                  <ToggleButton
                    v-if="isPowerSearch"
                    :label="powerSearchLabel"
                    :tooltip="powerSearchLabel"
                    is-icon-only
                    size="sm"
                    :is-pressed="isPowerSearch"
                    @pressed-change="isPowerSearch = $event"
                  >
                    <template #icon>
                      <Icon name="heroicons:adjustments-horizontal-solid" size="sm" />
                    </template>
                  </ToggleButton>

                  <Popover
                    placement="below"
                    alignment="end"
                    :width="660"
                    label="View options"
                  >
                    <template #content>
                      <HStack :gap="0" class="tf-view-popover">
                        <Section variant="transparent" :padding="1" :dividers="['end']" class="tf-view-rail">
                          <VStack :gap="1">
                            <Button
                              v-for="section in VIEW_SECTIONS"
                              :key="section.key"
                              :label="section.label"
                              :variant="viewSection === section.key ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'"
                              class="tf-rail-item"
                              @click="viewSection = section.key"
                            >
                              <template #icon>
                                <Icon :name="section.icon" size="sm" />
                              </template>
                            </Button>
                          </VStack>
                        </Section>

                        <StackItem size="fill" class="tf-view-pane">
                          <VStack :gap="0" :padding="4" :padding-block-end="3">
                            <Heading :level="3">
                              {{ VIEW_SECTIONS.find(s => s.key === viewSection)?.title }}
                            </Heading>
                          </VStack>

                          <!-- Columns：两栏穿梭列表，拖动把手排序。 -->
                          <VStack v-if="viewSection === 'columns'" :gap="0" class="tf-transfer">
                            <HStack :gap="0" class="tf-transfer-panels">
                              <VStack :gap="0" class="tf-transfer-panel">
                                <HStack
                                  :gap="2"
                                  align="center"
                                  h-align="between"
                                  :padding-block="2"
                                  class="tf-transfer-head tf-transfer-pad-start"
                                >
                                  <Text type="label" color="secondary">
                                    Displayed columns
                                  </Text>
                                  <Button
                                    label="Restore"
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    class="tf-transfer-head-action"
                                    @click="updateView(v => ({ ...v, columnKeys: [...DEFAULT_COLUMN_KEYS] }))"
                                  />
                                </HStack>
                                <VStack :gap="0" class="tf-transfer-body">
                                  <VStack
                                    v-if="displayedColumns.length === 0"
                                    :gap="0"
                                    align="center"
                                    h-align="center"
                                    :padding-block="4"
                                    class="tf-transfer-empty tf-transfer-pad-start"
                                  >
                                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                                      No columns are displayed.
                                    </Text>
                                  </VStack>
                                  <template v-else>
                                    <div
                                      v-for="key in displayedColumns"
                                      :key="key"
                                      :ref="columnRowRef(key)"
                                      class="tf-transfer-row tf-transfer-pad-start"
                                      :class="{ 'tf-transfer-row--drop': reorderDropKey === key }"
                                    >
                                      <IconButton
                                        :label="`Reorder ${COLUMN_LABELS[key]}`"
                                        variant="ghost"
                                        size="sm"
                                        class="tf-transfer-grip"
                                        @pointerdown="onGripPointerDown($event, key)"
                                        @pointermove="onGripPointerMove"
                                        @pointerup="onGripPointerUp"
                                        @pointercancel="onGripPointerUp"
                                      >
                                        <Icon name="heroicons:grip-vertical" size="sm" />
                                      </IconButton>
                                      <StackItem size="fill">
                                        <Text type="body">
                                          {{ COLUMN_LABELS[key] }}
                                        </Text>
                                      </StackItem>
                                      <IconButton
                                        :label="`Remove ${COLUMN_LABELS[key]}`"
                                        :tooltip="key === LOCKED_COLUMN_KEY ? LOCKED_COLUMN_MESSAGE : undefined"
                                        variant="ghost"
                                        size="sm"
                                        :is-disabled="key === LOCKED_COLUMN_KEY"
                                        class="tf-transfer-end-action"
                                        @click="updateView(v => ({ ...v, columnKeys: v.columnKeys.filter(k => k !== key) }))"
                                      >
                                        <Icon name="heroicons:x-mark" size="sm" />
                                      </IconButton>
                                    </div>
                                  </template>
                                </VStack>
                              </VStack>

                              <VStack :gap="0" class="tf-transfer-panel tf-transfer-panel--divider">
                                <HStack
                                  :gap="2"
                                  align="center"
                                  h-align="between"
                                  :padding-block="2"
                                  class="tf-transfer-head tf-transfer-pad-end"
                                >
                                  <Text type="label" color="secondary">
                                    Available columns
                                  </Text>
                                  <Button
                                    label="Select all"
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="sm"
                                    class="tf-transfer-head-action"
                                    :is-disabled="view.columnKeys.length === ALL_COLUMN_KEYS.length"
                                    @click="updateView(v => ({ ...v, columnKeys: [...v.columnKeys, ...ALL_COLUMN_KEYS.filter(k => !v.columnKeys.includes(k))] }))"
                                  />
                                </HStack>
                                <VStack :gap="0" class="tf-transfer-body">
                                  <VStack
                                    v-if="availableColumns.length === 0"
                                    :gap="0"
                                    align="center"
                                    h-align="center"
                                    :padding-block="4"
                                    class="tf-transfer-empty tf-transfer-pad-end"
                                  >
                                    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                                      All columns are displayed.
                                    </Text>
                                  </VStack>
                                  <div
                                    v-for="key in availableColumns"
                                    :key="key"
                                    class="tf-transfer-row tf-transfer-pad-end"
                                  >
                                    <StackItem size="fill">
                                      <Text type="body">
                                        {{ COLUMN_LABELS[key] }}
                                      </Text>
                                    </StackItem>
                                    <IconButton
                                      :label="`Add ${COLUMN_LABELS[key]}`"
                                      variant="ghost"
                                      size="sm"
                                      class="tf-transfer-end-action"
                                      @click="updateView(v => ({ ...v, columnKeys: [...v.columnKeys, key] }))"
                                    >
                                      <Icon name="heroicons:plus" size="sm" />
                                    </IconButton>
                                  </div>
                                </VStack>
                              </VStack>
                            </HStack>
                          </VStack>

                          <VStack v-else-if="viewSection === 'density'" :gap="0" :padding-inline="4" :padding-block-end="4">
                            <RadioList v-model="view.density" label="Density" is-label-hidden>
                              <RadioListItem
                                v-for="option in DENSITY_OPTIONS"
                                :key="option.value"
                                :value="option.value"
                                :label="option.label"
                              />
                            </RadioList>
                          </VStack>

                          <VStack v-else-if="viewSection === 'sticky'" :gap="4" :padding-inline="4" :padding-block-end="4">
                            <RadioList v-model="view.stickyStart" label="First columns">
                              <RadioListItem
                                v-for="option in STICKY_START_OPTIONS"
                                :key="option.value"
                                :value="option.value"
                                :label="option.label"
                              />
                            </RadioList>
                            <RadioList v-model="view.stickyEnd" label="Last columns">
                              <RadioListItem
                                v-for="option in STICKY_END_OPTIONS"
                                :key="option.value"
                                :value="option.value"
                                :label="option.label"
                              />
                            </RadioList>
                          </VStack>

                          <VStack v-else :gap="0" :padding-inline="4" :padding-block-end="4">
                            <RadioList v-model="view.grouping" label="Grouping" is-label-hidden>
                              <RadioListItem
                                v-for="option in GROUPING_OPTIONS"
                                :key="option.value"
                                :value="option.value"
                                :label="option.label"
                              />
                            </RadioList>
                          </VStack>
                        </StackItem>
                      </HStack>
                    </template>
                    <Button label="View options" variant="ghost" size="sm">
                      <template #end>
                        <Icon name="heroicons:chevron-down" size="sm" />
                      </template>
                    </Button>
                  </Popover>

                  <template v-if="!isSavedViewsBarOpen">
                    <IconButton
                      label="Create saved view"
                      tooltip="Create saved view"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      @click="creatingName = ''"
                    >
                      <Icon name="heroicons:bookmark" size="sm" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </template>

                  <ToggleButton
                    label="Saved views"
                    tooltip="Saved views"
                    is-icon-only
                    size="sm"
                    :is-pressed="isSavedViewsBarOpen"
                    @pressed-change="onSavedViewsToggle"
                  >
                    <template #icon>
                      <Icon name="heroicons:bookmark" size="sm" />
                    </template>
                    <template #pressedIcon>
                      <Icon name="heroicons:bookmark-solid" size="sm" />
                    </template>
                  </ToggleButton>
                </HStack>
              </HStack>
            </VStack>
          </Section>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="4" label="Service jobs">
      <EmptyState
        v-if="results.length === 0"
        title="No jobs match these filters"
        description="Try clearing a filter, or switch to power search to build a broader query."
      >
        <template #icon>
          <Icon name="heroicons:magnifying-glass" size="lg" />
        </template>
        <template #actions>
          <Button label="Clear all" @click="clearAll" />
          <Button label="Power search" variant="secondary" @click="isPowerSearch = true" />
        </template>
      </EmptyState>

      <template v-else>
        <Table
          :data="tableRows"
          :columns="columns"
          :id-key="tableIdKey"
          :density="view.density"
          dividers="rows"
          has-hover
          text-overflow="wrap"
          vertical-align="top"
          :row-count="results.length"
          :plugins="tablePlugins"
        />

        <div v-if="hasNext" ref="sentinelRef" class="tf-sentinel">
          <div v-if="isLoadingNext" class="tf-skeleton" role="status" aria-label="Loading more jobs">
            <div
              v-for="row in SKELETON_ROWS"
              :key="row"
              class="tf-skeleton-row"
              :style="{ paddingInline: `${DENSITY_PADDING[view.density]}px` }"
            >
              <div class="tf-skeleton-cell tf-skeleton-cell--select">
                <Skeleton :width="16" :height="16" :radius="1" :index="row" />
              </div>
              <div
                v-for="(key, index) in view.columnKeys"
                :key="key"
                class="tf-skeleton-cell"
                :style="skeletonCellStyle(key)"
              >
                <VStack v-if="key === 'summary' && view.density !== 'compact'" :gap="2">
                  <Skeleton :height="14" :index="row * 4 + index" />
                  <Skeleton width="40%" :height="11" :index="row * 4 + index + 1" />
                </VStack>
                <Skeleton v-else :height="12" :index="row * 4 + index" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div v-else-if="results.length > PAGE_SIZE" class="tf-loaded">
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            All {{ results.length }} jobs loaded
          </Text>
        </div>
      </template>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>

  <!-- 创建保存视图 -->
  <Dialog :is-open="creatingName != null" purpose="form" :width="400" @open-change="creatingName = $event ? '' : null">
    <DialogHeader
      title="Create new saved view"
      subtitle="Captures the filters and the table configuration as they are now."
      has-divider
      @open-change="creatingName = $event ? '' : null"
    />
    <Section variant="transparent" :padding="4">
      <VStack :gap="4">
        <TextInput :model-value="creatingName ?? ''" label="Name" has-auto-focus @update:model-value="creatingName = $event" />
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Text type="label">
            This view saves
          </Text>
          <MetadataList columns="single" :label="{ position: 'start', width: 104 }">
            <MetadataListItem label="Filters">
              <Text v-if="filters.length === 0" type="body">
                None
              </Text>
              <HStack v-else :gap="1" wrap="wrap">
                <Token
                  v-for="(filter, index) in filters"
                  :key="`${filter.field}-${filter.operator}-${index}`"
                  :label="filterTokenLabel(filter)"
                  :description="`${filter.field} ${filter.operator} ${filterValueText(filter)}`"
                  size="sm"
                />
              </HStack>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Columns">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ view.columnKeys.length }} of {{ ALL_COLUMN_KEYS.length }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Density">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(DENSITY_OPTIONS, view.density) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Grouping">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(GROUPING_OPTIONS, view.grouping) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Frozen start">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(STICKY_START_OPTIONS, view.stickyStart) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Frozen end">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(STICKY_END_OPTIONS, view.stickyEnd) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
          </MetadataList>
        </VStack>
        <HStack h-align="end">
          <Button
            label="Create"
            variant="primary"
            :is-disabled="(creatingName ?? '').trim() === ''"
            @click="createSavedView(creatingName ?? '')"
          />
        </HStack>
      </VStack>
    </Section>
  </Dialog>

  <!-- 编辑保存视图（只改名，配置是保存时定格的） -->
  <Dialog :is-open="editing != null" purpose="form" :width="400" @open-change="!$event && (editing = null)">
    <DialogHeader
      title="Edit saved view"
      subtitle="Renaming only. The configuration is what was captured when the view was saved."
      has-divider
      @open-change="!$event && (editing = null)"
    />
    <Section v-if="editing != null" variant="transparent" :padding="4">
      <VStack :gap="4">
        <TextInput v-model="editing.name" label="Name" />
        <VStack :gap="1">
          <Text type="label">
            This view saves
          </Text>
          <MetadataList columns="single" :label="{ position: 'start', width: 104 }">
            <MetadataListItem label="Filters">
              <Text v-if="editing.filters.length === 0" type="body">
                None
              </Text>
              <HStack v-else :gap="1" wrap="wrap">
                <Token
                  v-for="(filter, index) in editing.filters"
                  :key="`${filter.field}-${filter.operator}-${index}`"
                  :label="filterTokenLabel(filter)"
                  :description="`${filter.field} ${filter.operator} ${filterValueText(filter)}`"
                  size="sm"
                />
              </HStack>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Columns">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ editing.view.columnKeys.length }} of {{ ALL_COLUMN_KEYS.length }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Density">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(DENSITY_OPTIONS, editing.view.density) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Grouping">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(GROUPING_OPTIONS, editing.view.grouping) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Frozen start">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(STICKY_START_OPTIONS, editing.view.stickyStart) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Frozen end">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ labelOf(STICKY_END_OPTIONS, editing.view.stickyEnd) }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
          </MetadataList>
        </VStack>
        <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
          <Button label="Delete" variant="destructive" @click="deleteSavedView(editing.id)" />
          <StackItem size="fill">
            <HStack h-align="end">
              <Button label="Save" variant="primary" @click="saveEditedView(editing)" />
            </HStack>
          </StackItem>
        </HStack>
      </VStack>
    </Section>
  </Dialog>
</template>

}

}

  transition: width var(--astryx-duration-fast) var(--astryx-ease-standard);
}

.tf-search:focus-within {
  width: 240px;
}

.tf-overflow-slot {
  display: flex;
  flex-grow: 1;
  flex-shrink: 100;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 228px;
  padding-inline-end: 184px;
}

.tf-meta {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-inline: 8px -184px;
}

.tf-chrome {
  border: var(--astryx-border-width) solid var(--astryx-color-border-emphasized);
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
}

  background-color: var(--astryx-color-background-surface);
}

.tf-value {
  font-weight: var(--astryx-font-weight-normal);
}

  font-weight: var(--astryx-font-weight-normal);

}

.tf-rail-item {

  width: 100%;
}

  min-width: 0;
}

  min-height: 0;
}

  min-height: 0;
}

  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}

.tf-transfer-panel--divider {
  border-inline-start: var(--astryx-border-width) solid var(--astryx-color-border);
}

.tf-transfer-head {
  padding-inline: 16px;
}

.tf-transfer-pad-end {
  padding-inline: 16px;
}

.tf-transfer-head-action {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tf-transfer-body {
  min-height: 120px;
}

  flex: 1;
}

  display: flex;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-1);
  align-items: center;

  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 0 var(--astryx-color-accent);
}

  cursor: grab;
  touch-action: none;
}

  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* 详情面板：分区自带 16px  gutter，分隔线拉满宽。 */
.tf-detail {
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.tf-history-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--astryx-spacing-2);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--astryx-radius-element);
}

.tf-history-row:hover {
  background-color: var(--astryx-color-overlay-hover);
}

/* 无限加载：哨兵给足高度，骨架行按列宽铺满。 */

  min-height: 56px;
}

.tf-skeleton-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  align-items: center;
}

.tf-skeleton-cell {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-block: 14px;
}

.tf-skeleton-cell--select {
  width: 48px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  justify-content: center;
}

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 56px;
}

  cursor: pointer;

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  Avatar,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleGroup,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  LayoutPanel,
  pixel,
  proportional,
  ResizeHandle,
  StackItem,
  Tab,
  TabList,
  Table,
  Text,
  Thumbnail,
  Token,
  Toolbar,
  useResizable,
  useTableRowStatus,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import type { TableColumn, TablePlugin } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue'

type Category = 'inbox' | 'escalations' | 'waiting' | 'resolved'
type Priority = 'urgent' | 'high' | 'normal'

interface Attachment {
  id: string
  name: string
  src: string
}

interface ThreadMessage {
  id: string
  sender: string
  senderEmail: string
  receivedFull: string
  body: string[]
  attachments?: Attachment[]
}

interface Conversation extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  sender: string
  senderEmail: string
  subject: string
  preview: string
  tags: string[]
  receivedAt: string
  receivedFull: string
  isUnread: boolean
  priority: Priority
  category: Category
  assignee: string | null
  body: string[]
  attachments: Attachment[]
  replies?: ThreadMessage[]
}

const CATEGORIES: { value: Category, label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox' },
  { value: 'escalations', label: 'Escalations' },
  { value: 'waiting', label: 'Waiting' },
  { value: 'resolved', label: 'Resolved' },
]

/** Inbox 是全部，其余三个是它的切面：一封会话同一时刻只有一个归属。 */
function inCategory(item: Conversation, category: Category): boolean {
  return category === 'inbox' || item.category === category
}

/** 每个标签徽章显示该标签下的未读数。 */
function unreadByCategory(): Record<Category, number> {
  const counts: Record<Category, number> = { inbox: 0, escalations: 0, waiting: 0, resolved: 0 }
  for (const item of CONVERSATIONS) {
    if (!item.isUnread)
      continue
    counts.inbox += 1
    if (item.category !== 'inbox')
      counts[item.category] += 1
  }
  return counts
}

/**
 * Stack 的内边距写在 CSS 变量上，嵌套的 Stack 会继承同一个值，
 * 所以给容器加内边距时用内联样式，避免子容器被动带上同样的留白。
 */
function spacing(step: number): string {
  return `var(--astryx-spacing-${String(step).replace('.', '-')}, ${step * 4}px)`
}

/** 头像与姓名之间的间距，正文的缩进也用它。 */
const THREAD_HEADER_GAP = 3
/** 头像的渲染宽度，正文缩进要对齐它。 */
const AVATAR_SIZE = 36
/** 正文的最大阅读宽度。 */
const MESSAGE_MEASURE = 680

const category = ref<Category>('inbox')
/** `undefined` 表示用户还没选过，按列表首条兜底；`null` 表示用户主动关掉了阅读栏。 */
const chosenId = ref<string | null | undefined>(undefined)

/** 面板默认占内容区的 2/3，百分比相对内容区算，不写死像素。 */
const surfaceEl = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
const PANE_MIN_WIDTH = 440

const pane = useResizable({
  containerRef: surfaceEl,
  defaultSize: '66.67%',
  minSize: PANE_MIN_WIDTH,
  maxSize: '100%',
})

/** Layout 是组件，ref 拿到的是实例；这里取它的根元素当宽度基准。 */
function setSurface(instance: unknown): void {
  surfaceEl.value = (instance as { $el?: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el ?? null
}

const visible = computed(() => CONVERSATIONS.filter(item => inCategory(item, category.value)))

const openId = computed<string | null>(() => {
  if (chosenId.value === null)
    return null
  if (chosenId.value != null && visible.value.some(item => item.id === chosenId.value))
    return chosenId.value
  return visible.value[0]?.id ?? null
})

const openConversation = computed(() => visible.value.find(item => item.id === openId.value) ?? null)

const unreadCount = computed(() => CONVERSATIONS.filter(item => item.isUnread).length)
const unreadCounts = unreadByCategory()

/** 会话按时间正序展开，最新一条在最后并且默认展开。 */
function threadMessages(conversation: Conversation): ThreadMessage[] {
  return [
    ...(conversation.replies ?? []),
    {
      id: conversation.id,
      sender: conversation.sender,
      senderEmail: conversation.senderEmail,
      receivedFull: conversation.receivedFull,
      body: conversation.body,
      attachments: conversation.attachments,
    },
  ]
}

function openThread(id: string): void {
  chosenId.value = id
}

const rowStatus = useTableRowStatus<Conversation>({
  getStatus: item => (item.isUnread ? { color: 'accent', label: 'Unread' } : null),
})

/**
 * 状态点列：16px 缩进 + 8px 圆点 + 密度在每格后留的 12px，共 36px。
 * 原版用同样的 `transformColumns` 把插件自带的 28px 改成 36px（列 key 是插件内部的 `__rowStatus`）。
 */
const STATUS_GUTTER_WIDTH = 36
const alignStatusGutter: TablePlugin<Conversation> = {
  transformColumns: cols => cols.map(col => col.key === '__rowStatus' ? { ...col, width: pixel(STATUS_GUTTER_WIDTH) } : col),
}

/** 点到按钮、链接、勾选框这类控件时不算点中行本身。 */
const INTERACTIVE_WITHIN_ROW = 'button, input, a, label, [role="checkbox"], [role="button"], [role="menuitem"]'

function isRowItself(event: { target: EventTarget | null }): boolean {
  return !(event.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest(INTERACTIVE_WITHIN_ROW)
}

/** 整行可点、可聚焦；当前打开的那一行整行铺上强调色浅底，并标 aria-current。 */
const inboxRows: TablePlugin<Conversation> = {
  rowPatch(item) {
    return {
      attrs: { 'tabindex': '0', 'aria-current': item.id === openId.value ? 'true' : undefined },
      class: 'inbox-row',
      onClick: (event) => {
        if (isRowItself(event))
          openThread(item.id)
      },
    }
  },
  cellPatch({ row, kind }) {
    if (kind !== 'body' || row == null || row.id !== openId.value)
      return null
    return { style: { backgroundColor: 'var(--astryx-color-accent-muted)' } }
  },
}

const columns: TableColumn<Conversation>[] = [
  {
    key: 'conversation',
    header: 'Conversation',
    width: proportional(1, { minWidth: 160 }),
    renderCell: item => h(VStack, {
      gap: 0.5,
    }, () => [
      h(Text, { maxLines: 1, weight: item.isUnread ? 'semibold' : 'normal' }, () => item.sender),
      h(Text, { maxLines: 1, color: 'secondary' }, () => item.subject),
    ]),
  },
  {
    key: 'receivedAt',
    header: 'Received',
    width: pixel(120),
    align: 'end',
    renderCell: item => h(HStack, {
      gap: 1,
      vAlign: 'center',
      hAlign: 'end',
    }, () => [
      item.attachments.length === 0
        ? null
        : h(Icon, { name: 'heroicons:paper-clip', size: 'sm', color: 'gray', label: 'Has attachments' }),
      h(Text, {
        color: 'secondary',
        hasTabularNumbers: true,
        justify: 'end',
        maxLines: 1,
        weight: item.isUnread ? 'semibold' : 'normal',
      }, () => item.receivedAt),
    ]),
  },
]

const threadActions = [
  { id: 'archive', label: 'Archive', icon: 'heroicons:archive-box' },
  { id: 'move', label: 'Move to folder', icon: 'heroicons:folder-arrow-down' },
  { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'heroicons:trash' },
]

          </VStack>

                  :label="PRIORITY_LABEL[openConversation.priority]"

                <Token
                  v-for="tag in openConversation.tags"
                  :key="tag"
                  size="sm"
                  :label="tag"
                />
              </HStack>

              <VStack :gap="2">
              <CollapsibleGroup
                :key="openConversation.id"
                type="multiple"
                density="spacious"
                :default-value="[openConversation.id]"
              >
                <Collapsible
                  v-for="message in threadMessages(openConversation)"
                  :key="message.id"
                  :value="message.id"

                            {{ message.senderEmail }}
                          </Text>
                        </VStack>

/**
 * Give every folder the newest commit beneath it — message and date together,
 * taken from the same child so the two columns never describe different
 * commits. Runs bottom-up, so a folder always agrees with what is inside it.

// ============= README + 搜索 + 折叠辅助 =============

/** 目录给每个文件取它下面最新的那次提交，两列才不会各说各的。 */
function withRollups(nodes: RepoEntry[]): RepoEntry[] {
  return nodes.map((node) => {
    if (!node.children || node.children.length === 0)
      return node
    const children = withRollups(node.children)
    const newest = children.reduce((latest, child) => (child.committedAt > latest.committedAt ? child : latest))
    return { ...node, children, commitMessage: newest.commitMessage, committedAt: newest.committedAt }
  })
}

const ROLLED_UP = withRollups(REPO_TREE)
const DEFAULT_EXPANDED = ['src']

/** 搜索命中的判定，行和计数共用一套，两边不会各算各的。 */
function isMatch(node: RepoEntry, needle: string): boolean {
  return node.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || node.commitMessage.toLowerCase().includes(needle)
}

function countMatches(nodes: RepoEntry[], needle: string): number {
  return nodes.reduce(
    (total, node) => total + (isMatch(node, needle) ? 1 : 0) + (node.children ? countMatches(node.children, needle) : 0),
    0,
  )
}

/** 留下命中的行和它们的祖先，祖先只是路径。 */
function pruneTree(nodes: RepoEntry[], needle: string): RepoEntry[] {
  const out: RepoEntry[] = []
  for (const node of nodes) {
    const children = node.children ? pruneTree(node.children, needle) : []
    if (isMatch(node, needle) || children.length > 0)
      out.push(children.length > 0 ? { ...node, children } : node)
  }
  return out
}

function collectIds(nodes: RepoEntry[], into: Set<string>): Set<string> {
  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (node.children?.length) {
      into.add(node.id)
      collectIds(node.children, into)
    }
  }
  return into
}

/** 时间用固定时钟倒推，保证每台机器上都是「2 小时前」。 */
const relativeFormat = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('en-US', { numeric: 'auto' })

const AGE_UNITS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, number]> = [
  ['year', 365 * 86_400_000],
  ['month', 30 * 86_400_000],
  ['day', 86_400_000],
  ['hour', 3_600_000],
  ['minute', 60_000],
]

function commitAge(epochMs: number): string {
  const elapsed = NOW - epochMs
  for (const [unit, size] of AGE_UNITS) {
    if (elapsed >= size || unit === 'minute')
      return relativeFormat.format(-Math.floor(elapsed / size), unit)
  }
  return 'just now'
}

/** 当前目录里有 README 才显示预览，表格和预览卡不会互相矛盾。 */
function readmeFor(folderId: string | null): string | null {
  let entries = REPO_TREE
  if (folderId != null) {
    for (const segment of folderId.split('/')) {
      const next: RepoEntry | undefined = entries.find(entry => entry.name === segment && entry.kind === 'folder')
      if (next?.children == null)
        return null
      entries = next.children
    }
  }
  const hasReadme = entries.some(entry => entry.kind !== 'folder' && /^readme\.md$/i.test(entry.name))
  return hasReadme ? (READMES[folderId ?? ''] ?? null) : null
}

/** 表头和正文各自量宽，≤720 时按钮收成图标、搜索框收成图标按钮。 */

function watchWidth(target: typeof headerEl, width: typeof headerWidth): void {
  let observer: ResizeObserver | null = null
  watch(target, (element) => {
    observer?.disconnect()
    observer = null
    if (!element || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined')
      return
    observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      width.value = entry?.contentRect.width ?? null

  onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect())

// ============= 状态 =============

const needle = computed(() => query.value.trim().toLowerCase())

const data = computed(() => (isSearching.value ? withRollups(pruneTree(ROLLED_UP, needle.value)) : ROLLED_UP))
const expandedIds = computed(() =>
  isSearching.value ? collectIds(data.value, new Set<string>()) : manualExpandedIds.value,
)

const { sort, sortConfig } = useTableSortableState<RepoEntry>({ data: () => data.value })

const SIBLING_COMPARATORS: Record<string, (a: RepoEntry, b: RepoEntry) => number> = {
  name: (a, b) => Number(b.kind === 'folder') - Number(a.kind === 'folder') || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  message: (a, b) => a.commitMessage.localeCompare(b.commitMessage),
  committed: (a, b) => a.committedAt - b.committedAt,
}

/** 只排同一层的兄弟节点，文件夹的层级关系不会被排序打散。 */
function applySiblingSort(siblings: RepoEntry[]): RepoEntry[] {
  if (sort.value.length === 0)
    return siblings
  const list = [...siblings]
  for (const entry of [...sort.value].reverse()) {
    const compare = SIBLING_COMPARATORS[entry.sortKey]
    if (compare == null)
      continue
    const direction = entry.direction === 'descending' ? -1 : 1
    list.sort((a, b) => compare(a, b) * direction)
  }
  return list
}

A small, embeddable vector canvas. Draw shapes, group them, and serialise the
result to JSON that round-trips without loss.

### Install

\`\`\`bash
npm install canvas-editor
\`\`\`

### Usage

\`\`\`ts
const {Canvas} = await import('canvas-editor');

const canvas = new Canvas(document.querySelector('#root'));

\`\`\`

### Status

| Area        | State    | Notes                                  |
| ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Rendering   | Stable   | Dirty-rect redraw, no full repaints    |
| Serialising | Stable   | Round-trips groups and nested shapes   |
| Plugins     | Beta     | API may change before 1.0              |

### Contributing

Read [the contributing guide](#) first. In short:

- One change per pull request, with a test that fails without it.
- Run \`npm test\` before pushing.
- Conventional commits — the changelog is generated from them.

> Issues tagged \`good first issue\` are a reasonable place to start.
`;

 * string standing for the repo root.
 *
 * Whether a preview appears is decided by the tree, not by this map — a
 * folder shows one only if it actually contains a README file. This just
 * supplies the body for the folders that do, so the two cannot disagree
 * about which folders have one.
 */
const READMES: Record<string, string> = {
  '': README,
  docs: DOCS_README,
};
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="auto" :content-width="1440">
    <template #header>
      <Toolbar :ref="setHeader" label="Repository" size="sm" :dividers="['bottom']">
        <template #start>
          <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
            <Heading :level="1" class="repo-visually-hidden">
              {{ ROOT_NAME }}
            </Heading>
            <Breadcrumbs label="Folder path">
              <BreadcrumbItem
                v-for="(crumb, index) in crumbs"
                :key="crumb.id ?? 'root'"
                :is-current="index === crumbs.length - 1"
                @click="index < crumbs.length - 1 ? selectedFolderId = crumb.id : undefined"
              >
                {{ crumb.label }}
              </BreadcrumbItem>
            </Breadcrumbs>
            <Badge label="Public" variant="neutral" />
          </HStack>
        </template>
        <template #end>
          <template v-for="stat in REPO_STATS" :key="stat.label">
            <IconButton
              v-if="isNarrowHeader"
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              :label="`${STAT_ACTION[stat.label]}: ${stat.value}`"
            >
              <Icon :name="stat.icon" size="sm" />
            </IconButton>
            <Button v-else size="sm" :label="STAT_ACTION[stat.label]">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon :name="stat.icon" size="sm" />
              </template>
              <template #end>
                <Badge :label="stat.value" />
              </template>
            </Button>
          </template>
        </template>
      </Toolbar>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="4">
      <EmptyState
        v-if="data.length === 0"
        title="No matching files"
        description="No file or folder in this project matches your search."
      >
        <template #actions>
          <Button label="Clear search" variant="secondary" @click="query = ''" />
        </template>
      </EmptyState>

      <VStack v-else :ref="setBody" :gap="6">
        <HStack :gap="2" align="center" wrap="wrap">
          <DropdownMenu has-chevron size="sm" :items="branchItems" :button="{ label: 'main', size: 'sm', icon: BranchIcon }" />
          <HStack :gap="1" align="center">
            <template v-for="ref in REF_COUNTS" :key="ref.label">
              <IconButton v-if="isNarrowBody" :label="ref.label" variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <Icon :name="ref.icon" size="sm" />
              </IconButton>
              <Button v-else :label="ref.label" variant="ghost" size="sm" />
            </template>
          </HStack>
          <StackItem size="fill">
            <HStack :gap="2" h-align="end" align="center">
              <Text v-if="isSearching && matchCount > 0" type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ matchCount }} {{ matchCount === 1 ? 'result' : 'results' }}
              </Text>
              <IconButton v-if="isNarrowBody && !isSearchOpen" variant="ghost" size="sm" label="Go to file" @click="openSearch">
                <Icon name="heroicons:magnifying-glass" size="sm" />
              </IconButton>
              <TextInput
                v-else
                ref="searchInput"
                v-model="query"
                label="Go to file"
                is-label-hidden
                placeholder="Go to file"
                has-clear
                :start-icon="SearchIcon"
              />
              <DropdownMenu has-chevron size="sm" :items="addFileItems" :button="{ label: 'Add file', size: 'sm' }" />
              <Button label="Code" variant="primary" size="sm">
                <template #icon>
                  <Icon name="heroicons:code-bracket" size="sm" />
                </template>
              </Button>
            </HStack>
          </StackItem>
        </HStack>

        <Card :padding="0" class="tt-fixed-layout">
          <Table
            :data="visibleData"
            :columns="columns"
            id-key="id"
            density="compact"
            dividers="none"
            is-striped
            text-overflow="truncate"
            :plugins="{ tree: treePlugin, sort: sortPlugin, resize: resizePlugin }"
          />
        </Card>

        <Card v-if="readme != null" :padding="0">
          <Section variant="transparent" :padding="0" :padding-block-start="1">
            <TabList v-model:value="readmeTab" size="sm" has-divider>
              <Tab value="readme" label="Readme" />
              <template v-if="hasRepoTabs">
                <Tab value="conduct" label="Code of conduct" />
                <Tab value="license" label="MIT license" />
                <Tab value="security" label="Security" />
              </template>
            </TabList>
          </Section>
          <Section variant="transparent" :padding="6">
            <Markdown
              v-if="activeTab === 'readme'"
              :heading-level-start="2"
              content-align="center"
              :content-width="680"
              :content="readme"
            />
            <Text v-else color="secondary">
              {{ TAB_PLACEHOLDER[activeTab as keyof typeof TAB_PLACEHOLDER] }}
            </Text>
          </Section>
        </Card>

        <template v-if="!isSidebarInline">
          <Divider />
          <AboutPanel />
        </template>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>

    <template v-if="isSidebarInline" #end>
      <LayoutPanel :width="296" :padding="4" :is-scrollable="false" role="complementary" label="About this repository">
        <AboutPanel />
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>

<style scoped>
/* 原版 Table 默认 `table-layout: fixed`，列宽严格按声明的比例分；core 目前是 auto，列宽按内容算。 */
.tt-fixed-layout :deep(.astryx-table) {
  table-layout: fixed;
}
</style>

<style>
.repo-visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  border: 0;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">

import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

interface FileSystemItem {

const FILESYSTEM: FileSystemItem[] = [

      {
        id: 'work',

        type: 'folder',
        children: [
          { id: 'q1-report', name: 'Q1-report.xlsx', type: 'file' },
          { id: 'presentation', name: 'team-presentation.pptx', type: 'file' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'downloads',

    type: 'folder',
    children: [
      { id: 'archive', name: 'archive.zip', type: 'file' },
      { id: 'installer', name: 'installer.dmg', type: 'file' },
      { id: 'photo', name: 'photo-2026.jpg', type: 'file' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'login-screenshot', name: 'login-02-screenshot.png', type: 'file' },

const viewMode = ref('column')
const selectedPath = ref<string[]>(['applications', 'chrome-apps', 'component-lab'])

function findItem(items: FileSystemItem[], id: string): FileSystemItem | null {
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.id === id)
      return item
    if (item.children) {
      const found = findItem(item.children, id)
      if (found)
        return found
    }
  }
  return null
}

function getFileExtension(name: string): string {
  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.')
  return dot > 0 ? name.substring(dot + 1).toUpperCase() : 'File'
}

const columns = computed(() => {
  const cols: { items: FileSystemItem[], selectedId: string | null }[] = []
  cols.push({ items: FILESYSTEM, selectedId: selectedPath.value[0] ?? null })
  let currentItems: FileSystemItem[] = FILESYSTEM
  for (let i = 0; i < selectedPath.value.length; i++) {
    const selected = currentItems.find(item => item.id === selectedPath.value[i])
    if (selected?.children && selected.children.length > 0) {
      cols.push({
        items: selected.children,
        selectedId: selectedPath.value[i + 1] ?? null,
      })
      currentItems = selected.children
    }
    else {
      break
    }
  }
  return cols
})

const currentFolderName = computed(() => {
  if (selectedPath.value.length === 0)
    return 'Home'
  const lastId = selectedPath.value[selectedPath.value.length - 1]
  const item = findItem(FILESYSTEM, lastId)
  if (item?.type === 'folder')
    return item.name
  if (selectedPath.value.length >= 2) {
    const parent = findItem(FILESYSTEM, selectedPath.value[selectedPath.value.length - 2])
    return parent?.name ?? 'Home'
  }
  return 'Home'
})

const selectedFile = computed(() => {
  if (selectedPath.value.length === 0)
    return null
  const lastId = selectedPath.value[selectedPath.value.length - 1]
  const item = findItem(FILESYSTEM, lastId)
  return item?.type === 'file' ? item : null
})

function handleSelect(columnIndex: number, itemId: string): void {
  selectedPath.value = [...selectedPath.value.slice(0, columnIndex), itemId]
}

function goBack(): void {
  if (selectedPath.value.length > 0)
    selectedPath.value = selectedPath.value.slice(0, -1)
}
</script>

            <SegmentedControlItem value="gallery" label="Gallery" is-label-hidden>

          </IconButton>
          <IconButton variant="ghost" size="sm" label="Share">

          </IconButton>
          <IconButton variant="ghost" size="sm" label="Tags">
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-tag" size="sm" />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton variant="ghost" size="sm" label="More">
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-ellipsis-horizontal" size="sm" />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton variant="ghost" size="sm" label="Search">
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-magnifying-glass" size="sm" />
          </IconButton>
        </template>
      </Toolbar>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="0" :is-scrollable="false">
      <HStack class="column-row" height="100%">
        <Section
          v-for="(col, colIndex) in columns"
          :key="colIndex"
          :width="240"
          :padding="2"
          variant="transparent"
          :dividers="colIndex < columns.length - 1 || selectedFile != null ? ['end'] : undefined"
          class="scrollable fixed-column"
        >
          <List density="compact" :has-dividers="false">
            <ListItem
              v-for="item in col.items"
              :key="item.id"
              :label="item.name"
              :is-selected="col.selectedId === item.id"
              :on-click="() => handleSelect(colIndex, item.id)"
            >
              <template #startContent>
                <Icon
                  :icon="item.type === 'folder' ? 'i-heroicons-folder-solid' : 'i-heroicons-document'"
                  :color="item.type === 'folder' ? 'accent' : 'secondary'"
                  size="sm"
                />
              </template>
              <template
                v-if="item.type === 'folder' && item.children != null && item.children.length > 0"
                #endContent
              >
                <Icon icon="i-heroicons-chevron-right" size="xsm" color="secondary" />
              </template>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </Section>

        <Section
          v-if="selectedFile"
          :padding="6"
          variant="transparent"
          class="scrollable detail-column"
        >
          <VStack :gap="4" hAlign="center">
            <Avatar :name="selectedFile.name" :size="96" />
            <VStack :gap="1" hAlign="center">
              <Text type="label">
                {{ selectedFile.name }}
              </Text>
              <Text type="supporting">
                {{ getFileExtension(selectedFile.name) }} Document
              </Text>
            </VStack>
            <MetadataList title="Information">
              <MetadataListItem label="Created">
                March 28, 2026 at 2:15 PM
              </MetadataListItem>
              <MetadataListItem label="Modified">
                Yesterday, 10:27 PM
              </MetadataListItem>
              <MetadataListItem label="Kind">
                {{ getFileExtension(selectedFile.name) }} Document
              </MetadataListItem>
            </MetadataList>
          </VStack>
        </Section>
      </HStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>

<style scoped>
.page {
  height: 100dvh;
}

.column-row {
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
}

.scrollable {
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.fixed-column {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.detail-column {
  flex-grow: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-basis: 320px;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Card,
  Divider,
  EmptyState,

  IconButton,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  MoreMenu,
  Section,

  StatusDot,
  Text,
  Toolbar,
  Tooltip,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue'

type ColumnId = 'todo' | 'in-progress' | 'in-review' | 'done'
type Priority = 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'

interface WorkItem {
  id: string
  column: ColumnId
  ref: string
  priority: Priority
  title: string
  description: string
  lastEdited: string
  dueDate: string
}

interface ColumnMeta {
  id: ColumnId
  title: string
  variant: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'success'
  tooltip: string
  emptyTitle: string
  emptyDescription: string
  emptyIcon: string
}

interface DropTarget {
  column: ColumnId
  index: number
}

interface DragState {
  id: string
  width: number
  height: number
  offsetX: number
  offsetY: number
  pointerX: number
  pointerY: number
  target: DropTarget | null
}

const COLUMNS: ColumnMeta[] = [

    tooltip: 'Items that have been handled.',
    emptyTitle: 'Nothing done yet',
    emptyDescription: 'Completed items appear here.',
    emptyIcon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
  },
]

const PRIORITY_META: Record<Priority, { label: string, variant: 'error' | 'warning' | 'teal' }> = {
  high: { label: 'High', variant: 'error' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', variant: 'warning' },
  low: { label: 'Low', variant: 'teal' },

const INITIAL_ITEMS: WorkItem[] = [
  {

  {

    lastEdited: '1d ago',
    dueDate: 'Jul 11',
  },
  {
    id: 'p1',
    column: 'in-progress',
    ref: 'Task 4825',

    description: 'Go through the pending changes, leave comments, and merge the ones that are ready.',
    lastEdited: '4d ago',
    dueDate: 'Jun 28',
  },
]

const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 5

const items = ref<WorkItem[]>([...INITIAL_ITEMS])
const sprint = ref('003')
const drag = ref<DragState | null>(null)

const columnEls = new Map<ColumnId, HTMLElement>()
const cardEls = new Map<string, HTMLElement>()
let teardownDrag: (() => void) | null = null

const itemsByColumn = computed(() => {
  const map: Record<ColumnId, WorkItem[]> = {
    todo: [],
    'in-progress': [],
    'in-review': [],
    done: [],
  }
  for (const item of items.value)
    map[item.column].push(item)
  return map
})

const draggedItem = computed(() => drag.value ? items.value.find(it => it.id === drag.value!.id) : undefined)

function setColumnEl(id: ColumnId, el: HTMLElement | null): void {
  if (el)
    columnEls.set(id, el)
  else
    columnEls.delete(id)
}

function setCardEl(id: string, el: HTMLElement | null): void {
  if (el)
    cardEls.set(id, el)
  else
    cardEls.delete(id)
}

function moveItem(id: string, to: ColumnId): void {
  items.value = items.value.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, column: to } : item)
}

function computeTarget(px: number, py: number, draggedId: string): DropTarget | null {
  for (const [colId, el] of columnEls.entries()) {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (px < r.left || px > r.right || py < r.top || py > r.bottom)
      continue
    const ids = itemsByColumn.value[colId]
      .filter(it => it.id !== draggedId)
      .map(it => it.id)
    let index = ids.length
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      const cardEl = cardEls.get(ids[i])
      if (!cardEl)
        continue
      const cr = cardEl.getBoundingClientRect()
      if (py < cr.top + cr.height / 2) {
        index = i
        break
      }
    }
    return { column: colId, index }
  }
  return null
}

function commitDrag(id: string, target: DropTarget): void {
  const moved = items.value.find(it => it.id === id)
  if (!moved)
    return
  const rest = items.value.filter(it => it.id !== id)
  const updated: WorkItem = { ...moved, column: target.column }
  const colItems = rest.filter(it => it.column === target.column)
  const anchor = colItems[target.index]
  if (!anchor) {
    items.value = [...rest, updated]
    return
  }
  const at = rest.indexOf(anchor)
  items.value = [...rest.slice(0, at), updated, ...rest.slice(at)]
}

function menuItemsFor(item: WorkItem) {
  const moveTargets = COLUMNS
    .filter(c => c.id !== item.column)
    .map(c => ({
      label: `Move to ${c.title}`,
      onClick: () => moveItem(item.id, c.id),
    }))
  return [
    { label: 'Open', onClick: () => {} },
    { label: 'Assign to me', onClick: () => {} },
    { type: 'divider' as const },
    ...moveTargets,
  ]
}

function onCardPointerDown(event: PointerEvent, id: string): void {
  if (event.button !== 0)
    return
  const target = event.target as HTMLElement
  if (target.closest('button, [role="menuitem"], [role="menu"]'))
    return
  const el = cardEls.get(id)
  if (!el)
    return
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
  const startX = event.clientX
  const startY = event.clientY
  const offsetX = startX - rect.left
  const offsetY = startY - rect.top
  const { width, height } = rect
  let started = false
  let dropTarget: DropTarget | null = null

  function onMove(ev: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!started && Math.abs(ev.clientX - startX) + Math.abs(ev.clientY - startY) < DRAG_THRESHOLD)
      return
    started = true
    dropTarget = computeTarget(ev.clientX, ev.clientY, id)
    drag.value = {
      id,
      width,
      height,
      offsetX,
      offsetY,
      pointerX: ev.clientX,
      pointerY: ev.clientY,
      target: dropTarget,
    }
  }

  function onUp(): void {
    teardownDrag?.()
    if (started && dropTarget)
      commitDrag(id, dropTarget)
    drag.value = null
  }

  function teardown(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
    teardownDrag = null
  }
  teardownDrag = teardown
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp)
}

function columnCards(colId: ColumnId): WorkItem[] {
  const colItems = itemsByColumn.value[colId]
  return drag.value ? colItems.filter(it => it.id !== drag.value!.id) : colItems
}

function ghostIndex(colId: ColumnId): number | null {
  if (!drag.value?.target || drag.value.target.column !== colId)
    return null
  return drag.value.target.index
}

watch(drag, (state) => {
  if (state) {
    const previous = document.body.style.userSelect
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none'
    return () => {
      document.body.style.userSelect = previous
    }
  }
  return undefined
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  teardownDrag?.()
})
</script>

            :key="meta.id"

          >

                  <EmptyState

                    :key="item.id"
                  >
                    <div
                      v-if="ghostIndex(meta.id) === index"
                      class="drag-ghost"

                    />
                    <Card
                      :ref="(el) => setCardEl(item.id, el as HTMLElement | null)"
                      :padding="3"
                      class="board-card"
                      @pointerdown="onCardPointerDown($event, item.id)"
                    >
                      <VStack :gap="2">

                          <HStack :gap="1" align="center" wrap="wrap">
                            <Badge :label="item.ref" variant="neutral" />
                            <Badge :label="PRIORITY_META[item.priority].label" :variant="PRIORITY_META[item.priority].variant" />
                          </HStack>

                        </HStack>
                        <VStack :gap="1">
                          <Heading :level="4">

                          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary" :max-lines="2">

                          </Text>

                        <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">

                        </Text>
                      </VStack>
                    </Card>
                  </template>
                  <div
                    v-if="ghostIndex(meta.id) === columnCards(meta.id).length"
                    class="drag-ghost"
                    :style="{ height: `${drag?.height ?? 0}px` }"
                  />
                </VStack>
              </LayoutContent>
            </Layout>
          </Card>
        </HStack>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>

    <Card

      :style="{

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import {
  Button,
  Card,
  Center,
  Dialog,
  Divider,
  EmptyState,
  Grid,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  LayoutPanel,
  List,
  ListItem,
  Section,
  SegmentedControl,
  SegmentedControlItem,
  Selector,
  Spinner,
  Tab,
  TabList,
  Table,
  Text,
  TextArea,
  TextInput,
  Toolbar,
  useMediaQuery,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue'

type BlockType = 'hero' | 'text' | 'image' | 'button' | 'cards' | 'features' | 'cta'
type ViewportSize = 'desktop' | 'tablet' | 'phone'
type SidebarTab = 'blocks' | 'properties'

interface Block {
  id: string
  type: BlockType
  label: string
  props: Record<string, unknown>
}

type Transaction = {
  id: string
  name: string
  category: string
  date: string
  amount: string
  isPositive?: boolean
}

const BLOCK_META: Record<BlockType, { label: string, icon: string }> = {
  hero: { label: 'Hero', icon: 'i-carbon-grid' },
  text: { label: 'Text', icon: 'i-carbon-document' },
  image: { label: 'Image', icon: 'i-carbon-image' },
  button: { label: 'Button', icon: 'i-carbon-cursor-1' },
  cards: { label: 'Cards', icon: 'i-carbon-column' },
  features: { label: 'Features', icon: 'i-carbon-star' },
  cta: { label: 'CTA', icon: 'i-carbon-megaphone' },
}

const CATEGORY_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  'Food & Drink': 'i-carbon-shopping-bag',
  'Groceries': 'i-carbon-shopping-cart',
  'Income': 'i-carbon-money',
  'Transport': 'i-carbon-chat',
  'Entertainment': 'i-carbon-play',
}

const VIEWPORT_MAX: Record<ViewportSize, number> = {
  desktop: 960,
  tablet: 768,
  phone: 375,
}

let nextId = 5
function uid() {
  return String(nextId++)
}

const DEFAULT_BLOCKS: Block[] = [
  {
    id: '2',
    type: 'features',
    label: 'Recent Transactions',
    props: {
      heading: 'Recent Transactions',
      description: 'Your latest account activity.',
      items: [
        { id: 't1', name: 'Blue Bottle Coffee', category: 'Food & Drink', date: 'Today, 10:24 AM', amount: '-$6.50' },
        { id: 't2', name: 'Whole Foods Market', category: 'Groceries', date: 'Yesterday', amount: '-$142.30' },
        { id: 't3', name: 'Stripe Payout', category: 'Income', date: 'Oct 12', amount: '+$4,200.00', isPositive: true },
        { id: 't4', name: 'Uber Technologies', category: 'Transport', date: 'Oct 11', amount: '-$24.10' },
        { id: 't5', name: 'Netflix Subscription', category: 'Entertainment', date: 'Oct 10', amount: '-$19.99' },
      ],
    },
  },
  {
    id: '3',
    type: 'text',
    label: 'Syncing State',
    props: {
      heading: 'Syncing your accounts',
      description: 'We\'re pulling in your latest transactions.\nThis usually takes a few seconds.',
      buttonLabel: 'Cancel',
    },
  },
  {
    id: '4',
    type: 'cta',
    label: 'Trust Notice',
    props: {
      heading: 'Adding devices from people you trust',
      description: 'When you approve a request, you grant someone full access to your account. They\'ll be able to change reservations and send messages on your behalf.',
    },
  },
]

/** 新增区块的初始属性，按类型给一份说得过去的默认值。 */
function defaultProps(type: BlockType): Record<string, unknown> {
  switch (type) {
    case 'hero':
      return { heading: 'New Hero', subheading: 'Subtitle goes here', buttonLabel: 'Click Me', alignment: 'center' }
    case 'text':
      return { content: 'Enter your text here.' }
    case 'image':
      return {}
    case 'button':
      return { label: 'Button', variant: 'primary', size: 'md' }
    case 'cards':
      return {
        cards: [
          { title: 'Pricing', description: 'Flexible plans for every team size.' },
          { title: 'Support', description: 'Get help whenever you need it.' },
        ],
      }
    case 'features':
      return {
        heading: 'Activity',
        description: '',
        items: [{ id: 't1', name: 'New Item', category: 'General', date: 'Today', amount: '$0.00' }],
      }
    case 'cta':
      return { heading: 'Call to Action', description: 'Description text', primaryLabel: 'Primary', secondaryLabel: 'Secondary' }
  }
}

const ALIGNMENTS = [
  { label: 'Left', value: 'left' },
  { label: 'Center', value: 'center' },
  { label: 'Right', value: 'right' },
]
const VARIANTS = [
  { label: 'Primary', value: 'primary' },
  { label: 'Secondary', value: 'secondary' },
  { label: 'Ghost', value: 'ghost' },
]
const SIZES = [
  { label: 'Small', value: 'sm' },
  { label: 'Medium', value: 'md' },
  { label: 'Large', value: 'lg' },
]

const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)')

const blocks = ref<Block[]>([...DEFAULT_BLOCKS])
const selectedId = ref<string | null>(null)
const pageTitle = ref('Page Editor')
const isEditingTitle = ref(false)
const viewport = ref<ViewportSize>('desktop')
const sidebarTab = ref<SidebarTab>('blocks')
const isCustomizeOpen = ref(false)

const selectedBlock = computed(() => blocks.value.find(b => b.id === selectedId.value) ?? null)

const canvasStyle = computed(() => ({
  maxWidth: `${VIEWPORT_MAX[viewport.value]}px`,
  width: '100%',
  marginInline: 'auto',
}))

const transactionColumns: TableColumn<Transaction>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    header: 'Transaction',
    renderCell: item => h(HStack, { gap: 3, align: 'center' }, () => [
      h(Icon, { icon: CATEGORY_ICONS[item.category] ?? 'i-carbon-star' }),
      h(VStack, { gap: 0 }, () => [
        h(Text, { type: 'label', weight: 'semibold' }, () => item.name),
        h(Text, { type: 'supporting', color: 'secondary' }, () => item.category),
      ]),
    ]),
  },
  {
    key: 'date',
    header: 'Date',
    renderCell: item => h(Text, { type: 'body', color: 'secondary' }, () => item.date),
  },
  {
    key: 'amount',
    header: 'Amount',
    renderCell: item => h(Text, { type: 'label', weight: 'semibold', hasTabularNumbers: true }, () => item.amount),
  },
  {
    key: 'actions',
    header: '',
    renderCell: () => h(Button, { label: 'More', variant: 'ghost', size: 'sm', isIconOnly: true }, () => h(Icon, { icon: 'i-carbon-overflow-menu-horizontal', size: 'sm' })),
  },
]

function selectBlock(id: string) {
  selectedId.value = id
}

function addBlock(rawType: string) {
  const type = rawType as BlockType
  const block: Block = { id: uid(), type, label: BLOCK_META[type].label, props: defaultProps(type) }
  blocks.value = [...blocks.value, block]
  selectedId.value = block.id
}

function updateBlockProp(key: string, value: unknown) {
  if (!selectedBlock.value)
    return
  const target = selectedBlock.value.id
  blocks.value = blocks.value.map(b => (b.id === target ? { ...b, props: { ...b.props, [key]: value } } : b))
}

/** 在图层里上下移动一格，越界的调用直接忽略。 */
function moveBlock(id: string, delta: number) {
  const index = blocks.value.findIndex(b => b.id === id)
  const next = index + delta
  if (index < 0 || next < 0 || next >= blocks.value.length)
    return
  const copy = [...blocks.value]
  const [moved] = copy.splice(index, 1)
  copy.splice(next, 0, moved)
  blocks.value = copy
}

function setSidebarTab(value: string) {
  sidebarTab.value = value as SidebarTab
}

/** 区块属性里的列表按渲染需要取出来，模板里就不用写类型断言。 */
function itemsOf(block: Block) {
  return (block.props.items as Transaction[]) ?? []
}

function cardsOf(block: Block) {
  return (block.props.cards as { title: string, description: string }[]) ?? []
}

function buttonVariantOf(block: Block) {
  return (block.props.variant as 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost') ?? 'primary'
}

function buttonSizeOf(block: Block) {
  return (block.props.size as 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg') ?? 'md'
}

function deleteBlock(id: string) {
  blocks.value = blocks.value.filter(b => b.id !== id)
  if (selectedId.value === id)
    selectedId.value = blocks.value[0]?.id ?? null
}
</script>
