                        <Icon icon="i-carbon-mobile" size="sm" />
                      </template>
                    </SegmentedControlItem>
                  </SegmentedControl>
                </template>
                <template #end>
                  <HStack :gap="2">
                    <Button label="Preview" variant="ghost" is-icon-only>
                      <template #icon>
                        <Icon icon="i-carbon-view" size="sm" />
                      </template>
                    </Button>
                    <Button label="Publish" variant="primary" />
                  </HStack>
                </template>
              </Toolbar>
            </VStack>
          </Section>

          <VStack :gap="0">
            <TabList layout="fill" :value="sidebarTab" @update:value="setSidebarTab($event)">
              <Tab value="blocks" label="Blocks" />
              <Tab value="properties" label="Properties" />
            </TabList>
            <Divider />
          </VStack>

          <Section variant="transparent" :padding="4">
            <VStack v-if="sidebarTab === 'blocks'" :gap="4">
              <VStack :gap="1">
                <Heading :level="4">
                  Add Block
                </Heading>
                <List density="balanced">
                  <ListItem
                    v-for="(meta, type) in BLOCK_META"
                    :key="type"
                    :label="meta.label"
                    @click="addBlock(String(type))"
                  >
                    <template #startContent>
                      <Icon :icon="meta.icon" color="secondary" />
                    </template>
                  </ListItem>
                </List>
              </VStack>

              <VStack :gap="1">
                <Heading :level="4">
                  Layers
                </Heading>
                <List density="balanced">
                  <ListItem
                    v-for="block in blocks"
                    :key="block.id"
                    :label="block.label"
                    :is-selected="block.id === selectedId"
                    @click="selectBlock(block.id)"
                  >
                    <template #startContent>
                      <Icon :icon="BLOCK_META[block.type].icon" color="secondary" />
                    </template>
                    <template #endContent>
                      <HStack :gap="1">
                        <Button label="Move up" variant="ghost" size="sm" is-icon-only @click="moveBlock(block.id, -1)">
                          <template #icon>
                            <Icon icon="i-carbon-chevron-up" size="sm" />
                          </template>
                        </Button>
                        <Button label="Move down" variant="ghost" size="sm" is-icon-only @click="moveBlock(block.id, 1)">
                          <template #icon>
                            <Icon icon="i-carbon-chevron-down" size="sm" />
                          </template>
                        </Button>
                        <Button label="Delete" variant="ghost" size="sm" is-icon-only @click="deleteBlock(block.id)">
                          <template #icon>
                            <Icon icon="i-carbon-trash-can" size="sm" />
                          </template>
                        </Button>
                      </HStack>
                    </template>
                  </ListItem>
                </List>
              </VStack>
            </VStack>

            <template v-else-if="selectedBlock">
              <VStack :gap="4">
                <template v-if="selectedBlock.type === 'hero'">
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.heading ?? '')"
                    label="Heading"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('heading', $event)"
                  />
                  <TextArea
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.subheading ?? '')"
                    label="Subheading"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('subheading', $event)"
                  />
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.buttonLabel ?? '')"
                    label="Button Label"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('buttonLabel', $event)"
                  />
                  <Selector
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.alignment ?? 'center')"
                    label="Alignment"
                    :options="ALIGNMENTS"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('alignment', $event)"
                  />
                </template>
                <template v-else-if="selectedBlock.type === 'text'">
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.heading ?? '')"
                    label="Heading"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('heading', $event)"
                  />
                  <TextArea
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.description ?? '')"
                    label="Description"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('description', $event)"
                  />
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.buttonLabel ?? '')"
                    label="Button Label"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('buttonLabel', $event)"
                  />
                </template>
                <template v-else-if="selectedBlock.type === 'button'">
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.label ?? '')"
                    label="Label"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('label', $event)"
                  />
                  <Selector
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.variant ?? 'primary')"
                    label="Variant"
                    :options="VARIANTS"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('variant', $event)"
                  />
                  <Selector
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.size ?? 'md')"
                    label="Size"
                    :options="SIZES"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('size', $event)"
                  />
                </template>
                <template v-else-if="selectedBlock.type === 'features' || selectedBlock.type === 'cta'">
                  <TextInput
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.heading ?? '')"
                    label="Heading"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('heading', $event)"
                  />
                  <TextArea
                    :model-value="String(selectedBlock.props.description ?? '')"
                    label="Description"
                    @update:model-value="updateBlockProp('description', $event)"
                  />
                </template>
                <EmptyState v-else title="No configurable properties" is-compact />
              </VStack>
            </template>
            <EmptyState
              v-else
              title="No block selected"
              description="Select a block to edit its properties"
              is-compact
            />
          </Section>
        </VStack>
      </LayoutPanel>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="8">
      <VStack :gap="4" :style="canvasStyle">
        <template v-if="blocks.length > 0">
          <Card
            v-for="block in blocks"
            :key="block.id"
            class="clickable"
            :class="{ 'selected-card': block.id === selectedId }"
            :padding="block.type === 'image' ? 0 : 6"
            @click="selectBlock(block.id)"
          >
            <VStack v-if="block.type === 'hero'" :gap="4">
              <Heading :level="2">
                {{ String(block.props.heading || 'Hero Heading') }}
              </Heading>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ String(block.props.subheading || 'Subtitle text goes here') }}
              </Text>
              <Button v-if="block.props.buttonLabel" :label="String(block.props.buttonLabel)" />
            </VStack>

            <template v-else-if="block.type === 'text'">
              <EmptyState
                v-if="block.props.heading"
                :title="String(block.props.heading)"
                :description="String(block.props.description ?? '')"
              >
                <template #icon>
                  <Spinner />
                </template>
                <template v-if="block.props.buttonLabel" #actions>
                  <Button :label="String(block.props.buttonLabel)" variant="secondary" />
                </template>
              </EmptyState>
              <Text v-else type="body">
                {{ String(block.props.content || 'Text content goes here') }}
              </Text>
            </template>

            <EmptyState
              v-else-if="block.type === 'image'"
              title="Image Block"
              description="Drop an image or enter a URL"
              is-compact
            >
              <template #icon>
                <Icon icon="i-carbon-image" />
              </template>
            </EmptyState>

            <Center v-else-if="block.type === 'button'" :padding="4">
              <Button
                :label="String(block.props.label ?? 'Button')"
                :variant="buttonVariantOf(block)"
                :size="buttonSizeOf(block)"
              />
            </Center>

            <Grid v-else-if="block.type === 'cards'" :columns="2" :gap="4">
              <Card v-for="card in cardsOf(block)" :key="card.title" :padding="4">
                <VStack :gap="1">
                  <Text type="label" weight="semibold">
                    {{ card.title }}
                  </Text>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                    {{ card.description }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
              </Card>
            </Grid>

            <VStack v-else-if="block.type === 'features'" :gap="3">
              <HStack :gap="3" align="center" justify="between">
                <VStack :gap="1">
                  <Heading :level="3">
                    {{ block.props.heading }}
                  </Heading>
                  <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                    {{ block.props.description }}
                  </Text>
                </VStack>
                <Button label="View All" variant="secondary" size="sm" />
              </HStack>
              <Table
                :data="itemsOf(block)"
                :columns="transactionColumns"
                id-key="id"
                dividers="rows"
              />
            </VStack>

            <HStack v-else-if="block.type === 'cta'" :gap="4" align="start">
              <Center class="icon-circle" :width="48" :height="48">
                <Icon icon="i-carbon-locked" size="sm" />
              </Center>
              <VStack :gap="2">
                <Heading :level="4">
                  {{ block.props.heading }}
                </Heading>
                <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                  {{ block.props.description }}
                </Text>
              </VStack>
            </HStack>
          </Card>
        </template>
        <EmptyState
          v-else
          title="No blocks yet"
          description="Add blocks from the sidebar to start building your page"
        >
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-carbon-add-alt" />
          </template>
        </EmptyState>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>

  <Dialog
    :is-open="isMobile && isCustomizeOpen"
    variant="fullscreen"
    purpose="info"
    :padding="0"
    @update:is-open="isCustomizeOpen = $event"
  >
    <Layout height="fill">
      <template #header>
        <LayoutHeader has-divider>
          <HStack :gap="3" align="center" justify="between">
            <Heading :level="3">
              Customize
            </Heading>
            <Button label="Close" variant="ghost" is-icon-only @click="isCustomizeOpen = false">
              <template #icon>
                <Icon icon="i-carbon-close" size="sm" />
              </template>
            </Button>
          </HStack>
        </LayoutHeader>
      </template>
      <LayoutContent :padding="0">
        <Section :padding="4">
          <Text>
            Block library and properties
          </Text>
        </Section>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<style scoped>
.page {
  height: 100dvh;
}

.sidebar-panel {
  width: 320px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.mobile-sidebar {
  width: 100%;
}

  cursor: pointer;
}

.selected-card {
  outline: 2px solid var(--astryx-color-border-blue);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.icon-circle {
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--astryx-color-background-muted);
}

templates.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PowerSearchFilter } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import {
  Button,
  Divider,
  EmptyState,
  Heading,
  HStack,
  Icon,
  Layout,
  LayoutContent,
  LayoutHeader,
  LayoutPanel,
  List,
  ListItem,
  MetadataList,
  MetadataListItem,
  PowerSearch,
  ResizeHandle,
  SegmentedControl,
  SegmentedControlItem,
  StackItem,
  StatusDot,
  Text,
  Timestamp,
  Token,
  useMediaQuery,
  usePowerSearchConfig,
  useResizable,
  VStack,
} from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

type Severity = 'sev1' | 'sev2' | 'sev3'
type Status = 'investigating' | 'mitigated' | 'resolved'

interface TimelineEvent {
  at: string
  label: string
  detail: string
}

interface Incident extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  title: string
  service: string
  severity: Severity
  status: Status
  commander: string
  startedAt: string
  impact: string
  timeline: TimelineEvent[]
}

const INCIDENTS: Incident[] = [
  {
    id: 'INC-2417',
    title: 'Checkout API elevated 5xx rate',
    service: 'checkout-api',
    severity: 'sev1',
    status: 'investigating',
    commander: 'Priya Raman',
    startedAt: '2026-06-30T21:14:00Z',
    impact: '12% of checkout requests failing in us-east',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-30T21:14:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Paging monitor: checkout-api 5xx > 5% for 10m' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T21:19:00Z', label: 'Commander assigned', detail: 'Priya Raman took command' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T21:31:00Z', label: 'Suspect identified', detail: 'Deploy 8f31c2 correlates with error onset' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2416',
    title: 'Search indexing lag above 30 minutes',
    service: 'search-indexer',
    severity: 'sev2',
    status: 'investigating',
    commander: 'Marcus Webb',
    startedAt: '2026-06-30T19:42:00Z',
    impact: 'New listings not searchable; stale results served',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-30T19:42:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Indexing lag alarm crossed 30m threshold' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T20:05:00Z', label: 'Mitigation attempted', detail: 'Doubled indexer worker pool; lag still climbing' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2415',
    title: 'Webhook delivery retries exhausting queue',
    service: 'webhooks',
    severity: 'sev3',
    status: 'investigating',
    commander: 'Ana Duarte',
    startedAt: '2026-06-30T18:20:00Z',
    impact: 'Third-party webhook delivery delayed up to 15m',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-30T18:20:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Queue depth alarm on webhook-delivery' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2414',
    title: 'Payments settlement job stalled',
    service: 'payments',
    severity: 'sev1',
    status: 'mitigated',
    commander: 'Priya Raman',
    startedAt: '2026-06-30T14:03:00Z',
    impact: 'Settlement batch delayed; no customer-visible impact',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-30T14:03:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Settlement job heartbeat missed twice' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T14:26:00Z', label: 'Mitigated', detail: 'Job restarted on standby worker; batch draining' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2413',
    title: 'CDN cache hit ratio degraded in eu-west',
    service: 'edge-cdn',
    severity: 'sev2',
    status: 'mitigated',
    commander: 'Tom Okafor',
    startedAt: '2026-06-30T11:47:00Z',
    impact: 'Origin load 3x baseline; p95 latency +180ms in EU',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-30T11:47:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Cache hit ratio dropped below 80%' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T12:12:00Z', label: 'Mitigated', detail: 'Rolled back cache-key config change' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2412',
    title: 'Login rate limiting misfiring for SSO users',
    service: 'auth',
    severity: 'sev2',
    status: 'resolved',
    commander: 'Ana Duarte',
    startedAt: '2026-06-29T22:31:00Z',
    impact: 'SSO users intermittently blocked at login',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-29T22:31:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Support surge: SSO login failures' },
      { at: '2026-06-29T23:02:00Z', label: 'Mitigated', detail: 'Raised limiter threshold for SSO IdP ranges' },
      { at: '2026-06-30T09:15:00Z', label: 'Resolved', detail: 'Limiter keying fixed to per-user; monitors green 8h' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'INC-2411',
    title: 'Notification digests sent twice',
    service: 'notifications',
    severity: 'sev3',
    status: 'resolved',
    commander: 'Marcus Webb',
    startedAt: '2026-06-29T08:12:00Z',
    impact: 'Duplicate daily digest for ~40k users',
    timeline: [
      { at: '2026-06-29T08:12:00Z', label: 'Incident declared', detail: 'Duplicate-send reports from support' },
      { at: '2026-06-29T10:40:00Z', label: 'Resolved', detail: 'Dedup key restored in scheduler; backfill verified' },
    ],
  },
]

const STATUS_ORDER: Status[] = ['investigating', 'mitigated', 'resolved']

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<Status, string> = {
  investigating: 'Investigating',
  mitigated: 'Mitigated',
  resolved: 'Resolved',
}

const STATUS_TOKEN_COLOR: Record<Status, 'red' | 'yellow' | 'green'> = {
  investigating: 'red',
  mitigated: 'yellow',
  resolved: 'green',
}

const SEVERITY_DOT: Record<Severity, 'error' | 'warning' | 'neutral'> = {
  sev1: 'error',
  sev2: 'warning',
  sev3: 'neutral',
}

const SERVICE_VALUES = [
  { value: 'checkout-api', label: 'checkout-api' },
  { value: 'search-indexer', label: 'search-indexer' },
  { value: 'webhooks', label: 'webhooks' },
  { value: 'payments', label: 'payments' },
  { value: 'edge-cdn', label: 'edge-cdn' },
  { value: 'auth', label: 'auth' },
  { value: 'notifications', label: 'notifications' },
]

const SEVERITY_VALUES = [
  { value: 'sev1', label: 'SEV1' },
  { value: 'sev2', label: 'SEV2' },
  { value: 'sev3', label: 'SEV3' },
]

const FIELD_DEFINITIONS = [
  { key: 'title', type: 'string', label: 'Title' },
  { key: 'service', type: 'enum', label: 'Service', enumValues: SERVICE_VALUES },
  { key: 'severity', type: 'enum', label: 'Severity', enumValues: SEVERITY_VALUES },
  { key: 'commander', type: 'string', label: 'Commander' },
] as const

const statusFilter = ref('all')
const filters = ref<PowerSearchFilter[]>([])
const selectedId = ref<string | null>(INCIDENTS[0].id)
const { config, applyFilters } = usePowerSearchConfig(FIELD_DEFINITIONS, 'Incidents')

// 窄屏藏掉右侧详情，让密集的行保持满宽。
const isNarrow = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 1024px)')

const inspector = useResizable({ defaultSize: 380, minSize: 320, maxSize: 480 })

const visible = computed(() => {
  const searched = applyFilters(filters.value, INCIDENTS)
  return statusFilter.value === 'all'
    ? searched
    : searched.filter(incident => incident.status === statusFilter.value)
})

const groups = computed(() => STATUS_ORDER
  .map(status => ({ status, items: visible.value.filter(incident => incident.status === status) }))
  .filter(group => group.items.length > 0))

const selected = computed(() => visible.value.find(incident => incident.id === selectedId.value) ?? null)
const openCount = computed(() => INCIDENTS.filter(incident => incident.status === 'investigating').length)

function nextAction(status: Status): string {
  if (status === 'investigating')
    return 'Mark mitigated'
  return status === 'mitigated' ? 'Resolve' : 'Reopen'
}
</script>

<template>
  <Layout height="fill">
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
          <StackItem size="fill">
            <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
              <Heading :level="1">
                Incidents
              </Heading>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ openCount }} investigating
              </Text>
            </HStack>
          </StackItem>
          <SegmentedControl v-model="statusFilter" label="Filter by status" size="sm">
            <SegmentedControlItem label="All" value="all" />
            <SegmentedControlItem label="Investigating" value="investigating" />
            <SegmentedControlItem label="Mitigated" value="mitigated" />
            <SegmentedControlItem label="Resolved" value="resolved" />
          </SegmentedControl>
          <Button label="Declare incident" size="sm">
            <template #icon>
              <Icon :icon="'i-heroicons-plus'" size="sm" />
            </template>
          </Button>
        </HStack>
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>

    <LayoutContent :padding="0">
      <VStack class="incident-content" :gap="0">
        <HStack class="incident-search">
          <StackItem size="fill">
            <PowerSearch
              :config="config"
              :filters="filters"
              placeholder="Search incidents..."
              :result-count="visible.length"
              @update:filters="value => { filters = value }"
            />
          </StackItem>
        </HStack>
        <VStack class="incident-rows" is-scrollable :gap="0">
          <EmptyState
            v-if="groups.length === 0"
            title="No matching incidents"
            description="Adjust the status filter or clear search filters."
          >
            <template #icon>
              <Icon :icon="'i-heroicons-bell-alert'" size="lg" />
            </template>
          </EmptyState>
          <template v-for="group in groups" :key="group.status">
            <HStack :gap="2" align="center" class="incident-group-header">
              <Text type="label" color="secondary">
                {{ STATUS_LABEL[group.status] }}
              </Text>
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ group.items.length }}
              </Text>
            </HStack>
            <List density="compact" has-dividers>
              <ListItem
                v-for="incident in group.items"
                :key="incident.id"
                :label="incident.title"
                :description="`${incident.id} · ${incident.service} · ${incident.impact}`"
                :is-selected="incident.id === selected?.id"
                @click="selectedId = incident.id"
              >
                <template #startContent>
                  <StatusDot
                    :variant="SEVERITY_DOT[incident.severity]"
                    :label="incident.severity.toUpperCase()"
                    :is-pulsing="incident.severity === 'sev1' && incident.status === 'investigating'"
                  />
                </template>
                <template #endContent>
                  <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
                    <Token
                      size="sm"
                      :color="STATUS_TOKEN_COLOR[incident.status]"
                      :label="STATUS_LABEL[incident.status]"
                    />
                    <Timestamp :value="incident.startedAt" format="relative" color="secondary" />
                  </HStack>
                </template>
              </ListItem>
            </List>
          </template>
        </VStack>
      </VStack>
    </LayoutContent>

    <template v-if="!isNarrow" #end>
      <ResizeHandle
        direction="horizontal"
        has-divider
        :is-always-visible="false"
        :resizable="inspector.props"
        label="Resize inspector"
      />
      <LayoutPanel :width="inspector.size" :padding="0" label="Incident details">
        <VStack v-if="selected" :gap="4" class="incident-inspector">
          <VStack :gap="2">
            <HStack :gap="2" align="center">
              <StatusDot :variant="SEVERITY_DOT[selected.severity]" :label="selected.severity.toUpperCase()" />
              <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
                {{ selected.id }}
              </Text>
              <Token
                size="sm"
                :color="STATUS_TOKEN_COLOR[selected.status]"
                :label="STATUS_LABEL[selected.status]"
              />
            </HStack>
            <Heading :level="2">
              {{ selected.title }}
            </Heading>
          </VStack>

          <HStack :gap="2">
            <Button :label="nextAction(selected.status)" size="sm" />
            <Button label="Escalate" variant="secondary" size="sm" />
          </HStack>

          <Divider />

          <MetadataList columns="single" :label="{ position: 'start', width: 96 }">
            <MetadataListItem label="Service">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ selected.service }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Severity">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ selected.severity.toUpperCase() }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Commander">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ selected.commander }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Started">
              <Timestamp :value="selected.startedAt" format="date_time" />
            </MetadataListItem>
            <MetadataListItem label="Impact">
              <Text type="body">
                {{ selected.impact }}
              </Text>
            </MetadataListItem>
          </MetadataList>

          <Divider />

          <VStack :gap="2">
            <Heading :level="3">
              Timeline
            </Heading>

body.en:
# Neutral

Neutral is the theme `@astryx-vue/themes` ships today. Load it with:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

That entry loads `fonts.css`, then each file under `neutral/` in name order, including `base.css`. `fonts.css` loads Figtree and JetBrains Mono at 400, 500, 600, 700, and 400 italic. Figtree also includes 600 italic. Those are the faces `font-synthesis: none` can use. The browser does not invent a missing weight or italic.

`--astryx-font-family-body` and `--astryx-font-family-heading` name Figtree first, then `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `Segoe UI`, `Roboto`, `Helvetica`, `Arial`, and `sans-serif`. `--astryx-font-family-code` follows upstream and names the platform monospace stack first: `ui-monospace`, `SF Mono`, `Monaco`, `Consolas`, `Liberation Mono`, `Courier New`, and `monospace`.

Override those three variables to use your own fonts. You can also skip the bundled `fonts.css` and load Figtree yourself, for example with `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` in the document head.

Semantic tokens live in `packages/themes/neutral/base.css`. Names follow upstream `tokens.stylex.ts` and add an `--astryx-` prefix. Each token writes its light and dark stops with `light-dark()`. A value comes from the Neutral theme when that theme overrides it, and from the upstream default otherwise.

Every color, radius, and shadow matches upstream v0.7.1 `neutralTheme.ts`. Palettes come from the approved grey, text, icon, border, background, status, and categorical stops. `--astryx-radius-none` is `0px` and the light stop of `--astryx-color-text-secondary` is `#474747`, as upstream ships them.

Component colors reference the semantic variables instead of repeating hex values. `--astryx-badge-info-background` points at the approved status fill, for example, so changing one semantic variable updates every component that reads it.

The variables sit on `:root` and `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']`, with `color-scheme: light dark`. Light and dark follow the element's `color-scheme`. Force one side with `data-astryx-color-mode="light"` or `"dark"` on an ancestor. See [Dark mode](/en/guide/dark-mode).

On a touch device (coarse pointer) narrower than the `lg` breakpoint (1024px), the body size floor rises from 14px to 16px and the type ratio changes from 1.2 to 1.1736. Body text stays readable and Display 1 keeps its desktop 42px. Desktop sizes do not change.
body.zh:
# Neutral（中性默认主题）

Neutral 是 astryx-vue 的默认主题。它的基调是中性黑白灰，适用于各类企业级后台、中台系统和工具型网页。

## 引入方式

只需在你的前端入口文件（如 `main.ts`）中加入这行引入：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

这一行代码会完成这几件事：
1. **自动加载字体资源：** 加载西文字体 Figtree 与等宽代码字体 JetBrains Mono（包含 400 常规、500 中粗、600 半粗、700 加粗以及 400/600 斜体）。因为声明了 `font-synthesis: none`，所以系统严格使用真实设计的字重，不会让浏览器去硬拉变形生成伪粗体或伪斜体。
2. **引入所有组件主题样式：** 依次加载 `neutral/` 目录下的所有样式，包括全局基准 `base.css`。
3. **注入全局根节点：** 会自动将基础变量挂载在 `:root` 和 `[data-astryx-theme='neutral']` 上，因此无需任何额外配置，引入即全站生效。

## 字体回退栈（Font Stack）

- **正文与标题（Body & Heading）：**
  `--astryx-font-family-body` 和 `--astryx-font-family-heading` 优先使用 Figtree，随后按系统习惯回退：
  `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`。
- **等宽代码（Code）：**
  `--astryx-font-family-code` 和原版一样优先用系统等宽字体：
  `ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace`。

想换成自己的字体，覆盖上面三个变量即可；也可以不引入内置的 `fonts.css`，改用 Google Fonts 加载 Figtree，例如在 `<head>` 里放 `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">`。

## 和原版设计保持一致

Neutral 的每一个颜色、圆角和阴影值都和上游 v0.7.1 的 `neutralTheme.ts` 一致：

- **色板：** 灰阶、文字、图标、边框、背景、状态色和十种分类色都取自上游审定色板（`neutralPaletteRefs.generated.ts`）。
- **直角定义 `--astryx-radius-none`：** 和上游一样是 `0px`，方形头像和骨架屏保持直角。
- **辅助文本色 `--astryx-color-text-secondary`：** 浅色 `#474747`、深色 `#9e9e9e`，与上游一致。

组件级配色不再各写一份十六进制值，而是引用语义变量（例如 `--astryx-badge-info-background` 指向上游审定的状态色）。改一个语义变量，用到它的组件会一起更新。

## 手机上字号更大

在触屏设备（粗指针）且视口窄于 `lg` 断点（1024px）时，正文字号基准从 14px 提升到 16px，字阶比例从 1.2 调整为 1.1736。这样正文够大好读，而 Display 1 仍保持桌面端的 42px。桌面端字号不受影响。

## 明暗深色模式

Neutral 在定义时就声明了 `color-scheme: light dark`。因此只要你使用 `light-dark()` 变量，它会自动跟随操作系统或文档站当前的外观切换。

如果你需要在页面的某一个特定区域固定显示深色或浅色，只需在父容器元素上添加属性 `data-astryx-color-mode="light"` 或 `"dark"`。具体说明请参阅 [深色模式指南](/guide/dark-mode)。

en.title: `reset.css` is now a full global reset
en.body:
**What changed:** `@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` used to be a single line that declared the CSS layer order. It is now a full global reset, the same kind of thing as Tailwind Preflight (upstream #7355).

**Before:** you imported it to get the layer order.

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/reset.css'
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

**Now:** every stylesheet declares the layer order on its first line, so `reset.css` is no longer needed for that. Importing it changes the default look of plain HTML: headings, paragraphs and lists lose their default margins, lists lose their bullets, images and `svg` become block level, form controls inherit the font and color, buttons lose the browser chrome, and placeholder text is no longer faded.

**What to do:**

- Only wanted the layer order: delete the line. Components do not depend on it.
- Want one consistent starting point across browsers: keep it. Its rules sit in the lowest `astryx.reset` layer with zero specificity, so your own styles always win.
- Want one block of the page cleaned up: do not import the file, write styles for that block yourself.

More detail in [Installation](/en/guide/installation).

en.title: Spacing tokens moved from px to rem
en.body:
**What changed:** `--astryx-spacing-*` is now written in `rem` instead of `px`, and the numbers were converted. Every theme changed, Matcha and Y2K included (upstream #7359 #7374).

**Before:**

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 4px;
--astryx-spacing-4: 16px;
```

**Now:**

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 0.25rem;
--astryx-spacing-4: 1rem;
```

**What to do:** the browser default root size is 16px, so nothing looks different and most projects need no change. Only two cases move:

- The page sets `html { font-size: ... }`: spacing and padding now scale with it. That is the point of the change.
- Your own theme writes spacing in px: those steps stay fixed. Write them in rem if you want them to follow the root size.

More detail in [Space, radius, shadow](/en/themes/scale).

en.title: Theme target names were renamed
en.body:
**What changed:** a batch of old target names is gone and the hyphenated names replace them. A camelCase name such as `buttonIcon`, or a name that starts with a capital such as `Card`, now throws (upstream #7302).

**Before:**

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    progressbar: { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    textarea: { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**Now:**

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    'progress-bar': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    'text-area': { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**What to do:** search the keys under `components:` and rename them with this table.

| Removed | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`, `codeblock-copy-button`, `codeblock-header`, `codeblock-title` | `code-block`, `code-block-copy-button`, `code-block-header`, `code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`, `date-range-input-clear-icon`, `multi-selector-clear-icon`, `selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`, `progressbar-fill`, `progressbar-mark`, `progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`, `progress-bar-fill`, `progress-bar-mark`, `progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`, `radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`, `radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

The old names are still well-formed, so they do not throw, but no component uses them any more, so they have no effect. Full detail in [Extend a theme](/en/themes/extending).

en.title: Components no longer emit bare `primary` or `sm` classes
`labelHidden` is now `isLabelHidden`
en.body:
**What changed:** the property that hides a field label is `isLabelHidden`. The old `labelHidden` still works and goes away in a later version.

**Before:**

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" labelHidden />
```

**Now:**

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" is-label-hidden />
```

**What to do:** replace `label-hidden` with `is-label-hidden` on Typeahead, Tokenizer, MultiSelector, Token, PowerSearch, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput and TimeInput.

PowerSearch hides its label by default, and its rule is slightly different: when both names are passed the new one wins, when only the old one is passed the old one wins, and when neither is passed the label stays hidden. Every other component hides the label when either name is true.

en.title: Selector `variant="default"` is now `variant="input"`
en.body:
**What changed:** the bordered input step is called `input`. `default` is the old name and still works.

**Before:**

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="default" />
```

**Now:**

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="input" />
```

**What to do:** replace `variant="default"` with `variant="input"`. Leaving `variant` out behaves as before, still a bordered input. `default` keeps working for now and goes away in a later version.

MultiSelector and ComplexSelector only have `input`, `secondary` and `ghost`, so they need no change.

en.title: Four new styling properties
en.body:
**What changed:** input components gained `containerClass`, `containerStyle`, `controlClass` and `controlStyle` (upstream #7336 #7339 #7337 #7341).

An input has two places you can style:

- The shell: the layer that holds the label, the control and the status message. Use `container*`.
- The control box: the box that draws the border and background and holds icons and the clear button. Use `control*`.

Components with them: TextInput, TextArea, NumberInput, FileInput, DateInput, DateRangeInput, DateTimeInput, TimeInput, Typeahead, Tokenizer, Selector, MultiSelector, ComplexSelector, CheckboxList, RadioGroup, RadioList, Slider, PowerSearch.

**Before:** you could only write `class` on the component root, and where it landed depended on the component.

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" class="mt-4" />
```

**Now:** use the new properties to target the shell or the control box.

```vue
<TextInput
  v-model="name"
  label="Name"
  container-class="mt-4"
  control-class="font-mono"
/>
```

**What to do:** nothing is required. A `class` or `style` written on the root keeps today's landing spot; it is not dropped and you get no warning. This differs from upstream, which drops it and points you at `control*`. Switch to `container*` or `control*` only when a style lands somewhere you did not want.

Two things to know:

- `container*` only applies when there is a shell. Inside `InputGroup`, or inside a `FormLayout` with a sideways label, there is no shell, so it does nothing and a development warning appears once.
- `control*` never lands on the native `input`.

en.title: `useDismiss` takes `dismissOnEscape` instead of `enableEscape`
en.body:
**What changed:** the option used to ask "should Escape be handled". It now asks "what should Escape do when it reaches this layer" (upstream #4881).

**Before:**

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  enableEscape: true,
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

**Now:**

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  dismissOnEscape: 'close',
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

Three values:

- `'close'`: close this layer. This is the default.
- `'block'`: swallow the key and stay open.
- `'ignore'`: leave the key alone, for an input that handles Escape itself.

**What to do:** `true` becomes nothing or `'close'`. `false` needs a choice: `'block'` stops Escape at this layer, `'ignore'` lets the key travel on.

en.title: Tab and TabMenu must sit inside TabList, Step must sit inside Stepper
en.body:
**What changed:** a `Tab` outside a `TabList` used to degrade silently. It now throws. The same happens when an overlay boundary resets the membership (upstream #6457).

**Before:** a `Tab` rendered without a `TabList` still appeared, only keyboard handling was wrong.

**Now:** you get `useTabListContext must be used within TabList`. A `Step` outside a `Stepper` gets `useStepperContext must be used within Stepper`.

**What to do:** wrap each member in its container. If you use one inside overlay content, put another local `TabList` or `Stepper` inside the overlay. The overlay is a new membership boundary, so the outer container does not count.

en.title: `useAstryxLocale()` can return a tag with a region
en.body:
**What changed:** locale tags keep their region now. `en-gb` becomes `en-GB`, `ja-jp` becomes `ja-JP`, and dates and numbers follow that region.

`zh`, `zh-CN` and `zh-Hans` still become `zh-CN`. A tag that cannot be parsed falls back to `en`.

**Before:** `useAstryxLocale()` always returned a short tag such as `en` or `zh-CN`.

**Now:**

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value === 'en' // false when the tag is en-GB
```

**What to do:** do not compare the whole tag. Check the start of it.

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value.startsWith('zh') // Chinese
```

en.title: Navigation menus forward their attributes
en.body:
**What changed:** `NavHeadingMenu` and `NavHeadingMenuItem` used to ignore `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*` and event listeners written on the root. These now land on the menu element (upstream #7331).

**What to do:** nothing. But if you worked around the old behavior with an extra wrapper or a DOM query, that workaround may now run twice. Check it and remove it.

en.title: Default names follow the current language
en.body:
**What changed:** default accessible names that you never passed as props now follow the current language. This covers dropdown menus, context menus, the more-options button, the dialog close button, banner expand and collapse, and the switch loading label (upstream #6125 #7289).

**Before:** screen readers always heard English: `Menu`, `Context menu`, `More options`, `Close`, `Expand`, `Collapse`, `Loading`.

**Now:** a Chinese page gets 菜单, 快捷菜单, 更多选项, 关闭, 展开, 收起, 加载中. An English page still gets the English sentences.

**What to do:** if a test or script depends on those exact English strings, pass them yourself: `label`, `closeButtonLabel`, `loadingLabel`, `expandLabel`, `collapseLabel`.

en.title: Built-in English text now matches upstream word for word
en.body:
**What changed:** the built-in English text now matches upstream exactly. The Chinese text was adjusted to match as well.

These are the visible changes:

| Component | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SideNav | Sidebar | Side navigation |
| AppShell mobile nav and mobile drawer | Navigation | Mobile navigation |
| MobileNav close button | Close | Close navigation |
| Selector and MultiSelector with no options | No matches | No options |
| Selector and MultiSelector read-only | Read-only | Read only |
| PowerSearch number equals / not equals | equals / does not equal | is / is not |
| Typeahead clear button | Clear | Clear selection |
| Typeahead and Tokenizer loading | Loading results | Loading |
| DateInput unavailable date | That date is not available | Invalid date |
| Pagination first and last buttons | First page / Last page | Go to first page / Go to last page |
| Stepper status words | Completed / Warning / Error | completed / warning / error |

FileInput's three error messages and Calendar's three range announcements changed too, both to the upstream sentences.

**What to do:** update your own assertions. If your product supplies this text, nothing moves.

en.title: Numbers at a thousand and above get a separator
en.body:
**What changed:** numbers inside built-in text use the separator of the current language, so `1234` becomes `1,234`.

This covers Pagination page numbers and totals, Selector and MultiSelector result counts, Carousel slide numbers, CommandPalette result counts, Lightbox positions, AvatarGroup overflow, table selection counts and Stepper step numbers.

**What to do:** update the places that assert this text.

zh.title: `reset.css` 现在是完整的全局 reset
zh.body:
**变了什么**：`@astryx-vue/core/reset.css` 以前只有一行，用来声明 CSS 层级顺序。现在是一份完整的全局 reset，和 Tailwind Preflight 是同一类东西（上游 #7355）。

**以前**：为了拿到层级顺序，所以引入它。

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/core/reset.css'
import '@astryx-vue/core/styles.css'
```

**现在**：每份样式表的第一行自己声明层级顺序，不再需要靠 `reset.css`。而引入它以后，整个页面上普通标签的默认样式会变：标题、段落、列表没有默认外边距，列表没有圆点，图片和 `svg` 变成块级，表单控件继承字体和颜色，按钮去掉浏览器外观，占位文字不再变淡。

**怎么改**：

- 只是想定层级顺序：删掉这一行。组件不依赖它。
- 想要一套浏览器一致的起点：保留。规则都在最低的 `astryx.reset` 层，选择器优先级是 0，你自己的样式随时能盖掉。
- 只想让某一块干净：不要引这个文件，给那一块自己写样式。

细节见 [安装](/guide/installation)。

zh.title: 间距 token 从 px 改成 rem
zh.body:
**变了什么**：`--astryx-spacing-*` 的单位从 `px` 改成 `rem`，数值跟着换算。全套主题都改了，包括 Matcha 和 Y2K（上游 #7359 #7374）。

**以前**：

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 4px;
--astryx-spacing-4: 16px;
```

**现在**：

```css
--astryx-spacing-1: 0.25rem;
--astryx-spacing-4: 1rem;
```

**怎么改**：浏览器默认根字号是 16px，这时看起来完全一样，多数项目不用动。会变的只有两种情况：

- 页面自己写了 `html { font-size: ... }`：组件的间距和内边距会按同样比例放大或缩小。这是这次改动想要的效果。
- 自己的主题用 px 写间距：那几档仍然固定不变。想跟着根字号走，就改写成 rem。

细节见 [间距、圆角与阴影](/themes/scale)。

zh.title: 自定义主题里的挂点名改名
zh.body:
**变了什么**：一批旧的挂点名删掉了，改用带连字符的新名字。写驼峰（比如 `buttonIcon`）或者大写开头（比如 `Card`）会直接报错（上游 #7302）。

**以前**：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    progressbar: { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    textarea: { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**现在**：

```ts
defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  components: {
    'progress-bar': { base: { color: 'var(--brand-ink)' } },
    'text-area': { base: { borderRadius: '8px' } },
  },
})
```

**怎么改**：全局搜 `components:` 里的键，对着下面这张表改名。

| 已删除 | 请改用 |
| --- | --- |
| `base-table` | `table` |
| `checkbox` | `checkbox-indicator` |
| `codeblock`、`codeblock-copy-button`、`codeblock-header`、`codeblock-title` | `code-block`、`code-block-copy-button`、`code-block-header`、`code-block-title` |
| `date-input-clear-icon`、`date-range-input-clear-icon`、`multi-selector-clear-icon`、`selector-clear-icon` | `input-clear-icon` |
| `hovercard` | `hover-card` |
| `navicon` | `nav-icon` |
| `popover-surface` | `popover` |
| `progressbar`、`progressbar-fill`、`progressbar-mark`、`progressbar-track` | `progress-bar`、`progress-bar-fill`、`progress-bar-mark`、`progress-bar-track` |
| `radio`、`radio-dot` | `radio-indicator`、`radio-indicator-dot` |
| `statusdot` | `status-dot` |
| `textarea` | `text-area` |

表里的旧名字本身写法合法，所以不会报错，但已经没有组件用它，写了不生效。完整说明见 [扩展主题](/themes/extending)。

zh.title: 组件不再输出 `primary`、`sm` 这类裸类名
`labelHidden` 改名 `isLabelHidden`
zh.body:
**变了什么**：隐藏字段标签的属性正名是 `isLabelHidden`。旧名 `labelHidden` 还留着，之后的版本会删。

**以前**：

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" labelHidden />
```

**现在**：

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" is-label-hidden />
```

**怎么改**：把 `label-hidden` 换成 `is-label-hidden`。涉及的组件：Typeahead、Tokenizer、MultiSelector、Token、PowerSearch、DateInput、DateRangeInput、DateTimeInput、TimeInput。

PowerSearch 默认就是隐藏标签。它的规则有点特别：两个名字都传时听新名；只传旧名时听旧名；都没传就保持隐藏。其余组件是两个名字任一为真就隐藏。

zh.title: Selector 的 `variant="default"` 改名 `variant="input"`
zh.body:
**变了什么**：带边框的输入框那一档，正名是 `input`。`default` 是旧名，还留着。

**以前**：

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="default" />
```

**现在**：

```vue
<Selector v-model="fruit" :options="options" variant="input" />
```

**怎么改**：把 `variant="default"` 换成 `variant="input"`。不传 `variant` 时行为和以前一样，仍然是带边框的输入框。`default` 这个值暂时还能用，之后的版本会删。

MultiSelector、ComplexSelector 只有 `input`、`secondary`、`ghost` 三档，不用改。

zh.title: 新增四个样式分层属性
zh.body:
**变了什么**：输入类组件新增 `containerClass`、`containerStyle`、`controlClass`、`controlStyle`（上游 #7336 #7339 #7337 #7341）。

一个输入控件有两个可以加样式的地方：

- 外壳：包着标签、控件和状态消息的那一层，用 `container*`。
- 本体：画边框和背景、里面装着图标和清除按钮的那个盒子，用 `control*`。

适用的组件：TextInput、TextArea、NumberInput、FileInput、DateInput、DateRangeInput、DateTimeInput、TimeInput、Typeahead、Tokenizer、Selector、MultiSelector、ComplexSelector、CheckboxList、RadioGroup、RadioList、Slider、PowerSearch。

**以前**：只能在组件根上写 `class`，落到哪里要看具体组件。

```vue
<TextInput v-model="name" label="名字" class="mt-4" />
```

**现在**：想把样式放到外壳或本体，用新属性。

```vue
<TextInput
  v-model="name"
  label="名字"
  container-class="mt-4"
  control-class="font-mono"
/>
```

**怎么改**：不用改也能跑。根上直接写的 `class` / `style` 保持各组件今天的落点，不会被丢掉，也不会警告——这一点和上游不同，上游会丢掉并提示改用 `control*`。只有当你发现样式落错了地方，才换成 `container*` 或 `control*`。

注意两件事：

- `container*` 只在有外壳的时候生效。放进 `InputGroup`，或者横向标签的 `FormLayout` 里时没有外壳，这时它不生效，开发环境会警告一次。
- `control*` 永远不会落到原生 `input` 上。

zh.title: `useDismiss` 的 `enableEscape` 换成 `dismissOnEscape`
zh.body:
**变了什么**：原来只问「要不要响应 Escape」，现在问「Escape 到了这一层该怎么处理」（上游 #4881）。

**以前**：

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  enableEscape: true,
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

**现在**：

```ts
useDismiss({
  container,
  isEnabled,
  dismissOnEscape: 'close',
  onDismiss: close,
})
```

三个取值：

- `'close'`：关掉这一层。不传就是这个。
- `'block'`：吃掉这次按键，但不关。
- `'ignore'`：不管这次按键，留给会自己 `preventDefault` 的输入组件。

**怎么改**：`true` 换成不传或 `'close'`。`false` 要分情况：想让 Escape 在这一层停住，用 `'block'`；想让按键继续往下走，用 `'ignore'`。

zh.title: Tab、TabMenu 必须放在 TabList 里，Step 必须放在 Stepper 里
zh.body:
**变了什么**：以前把 `Tab` 放在 `TabList` 外面，会静默退化，不报错。现在会直接抛错。浮层边界把成员关系重置掉的情况也一样（上游 #6457）。

**以前**：先渲染一个 `Tab`，外面没有 `TabList`，页面照常出现，只是键盘操作不对。

**现在**：抛出 `useTabListContext must be used within TabList`。`Step` 在 `Stepper` 外面会抛 `useStepperContext must be used within Stepper`。

**怎么改**：把成员包进对应的容器。如果在浮层内容里再用一次，就在浮层里再放一层本地的 `TabList` 或 `Stepper`——浮层是新的成员边界，外面的容器不算数。

zh.title: `useAstryxLocale()` 可能返回带地区的标签
zh.body:
**变了什么**：语言标签现在保留地区。`en-gb` 收成 `en-GB`，`ja-jp` 收成 `ja-JP`，日期和数字按这个地区的习惯排。

`zh`、`zh-CN`、`zh-Hans` 仍然收成 `zh-CN`。认不出来的标签回到 `en`。

**以前**：`useAstryxLocale()` 返回的一定是 `en` 或 `zh-CN` 这样的短标签。

**现在**：

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value === 'en' // en-GB 时是 false
```

**怎么改**：不要用等号比整个标签，改成看开头。

```ts
const locale = useAstryxLocale()
locale.value.startsWith('zh') // 中文
```

zh.title: 导航菜单开始透传属性
zh.body:
**变了什么**：`NavHeadingMenu`、`NavHeadingMenuItem` 以前会忽略根上写的 `id`、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和事件监听。现在这些都会落到菜单元素上（上游 #7331）。

**怎么改**：不用改。但如果你以前因为这些属性不生效，绕开写了别的方案（比如在外面套一层再查 DOM），现在可能会重复，检查一下就能删掉。

zh.title: 不传名字时，默认名字跟当前语言
zh.body:
**变了什么**：下拉菜单、快捷菜单、更多选项、对话框关闭按钮、提示条展开/收起、开关加载中，这些没写在 props 里的默认无障碍名字，现在跟着当前语言走（上游 #6125 #7289）。

**以前**：不管页面是什么语言，读屏读到的都是英文 `Menu`、`Context menu`、`More options`、`Close`、`Expand`、`Collapse`、`Loading`。

**现在**：中文页面得到「菜单」「快捷菜单」「更多选项」「关闭」「展开」「收起」「加载中」。英文页面仍然是原来那几句。

**怎么改**：如果你的测试或脚本依赖那几句固定英文，就自己传进去：`label`、`closeButtonLabel`、`loadingLabel`、`expandLabel`、`collapseLabel`。

zh.title: 英文内置文案逐字对齐原版
zh.body:
**变了什么**：内置英文文案改成和原版一字不差。中文文案也有对应调整。

下面是用户看得见、也确实变了的几条：

| 组件 | 以前 | 现在 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SideNav | Sidebar | Side navigation |
| AppShell 手机端导航、手机抽屉 | Navigation | Mobile navigation |
| MobileNav 关闭按钮 | Close | Close navigation |
| Selector、MultiSelector 没有选项 | No matches | No options |
| Selector、MultiSelector 只读 | Read-only | Read only |
| PowerSearch 数字等于 / 不等于 | equals / does not equal | is / is not |
| Typeahead 清除按钮 | Clear | Clear selection |
| Typeahead、Tokenizer 加载中 | Loading results | Loading |
| DateInput 日期不可用 | That date is not available | Invalid date |
| Pagination 首末页按钮 | First page / Last page | Go to first page / Go to last page |
| Stepper 状态词 | Completed / Warning / Error | completed / warning / error |

FileInput 的三条报错和 Calendar 的三句日期范围播报也改了，都改成原版的句子。

**怎么改**：自己写的断言要跟着改。如果这些文字由你的文案覆盖，就不用动。

zh.title: 数字到一千以上加千分位
zh.body:
**变了什么**：内置文案里的数字按当前语言加千分位，比如 `1234` 变成 `1,234`。

涉及 Pagination 的页码和总数、Selector 和 MultiSelector 的结果数、Carousel 的序号、CommandPalette 的结果数、Lightbox 的位置、AvatarGroup 的溢出数、表格选中数、Stepper 的步骤号。

**怎么改**：断言这些文字的地方跟着改。
